reviews.name: Herin Jin
reviews.text: Very quiet and calm atmosphere. There are lots of spaces with seatings and tables with numerous accessible plugs. One of my favourite places to work at:)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Herin Jin, we are pleased you had a positive experience with us and thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review score. We hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Gift Wwararom
reviews.text: They treated so well before we signed the contract but after that, everything was terrible. A/C is not stable. Wifi is sometimes down. Bad smell during days. WORST THING is we've been waiting for half a year to get the retainer refund back eventhough we chased more than 10 times - calling to email to talk to their helpdesk which is not professional at all.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Gift, we are sorry to hear you have experienced some problems with the service. Please reach out to us via our Facebook page (www.facebook.com/spacesworks) with your contact details so we can look into this further and help resolve any issues. Thank you.

reviews.name: Paolo F.
reviews.text: It's actually about 200/month, never mind what they say on the website (it's just meant to draw you in and upsell you for a multi month contract). So, if you only go here 70-80% of the month. That's $56–$137 more per month than using a cafe if you spend $3-6 on average. But co-working isn't quieter, the internet isn't better, coffee is worse (usually), and youre stuck in the same location. little to no value here in reality.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Paolo, thank you for sharing your detailed feedback with us. We're sorry to hear about your experience. We’d love to help but haven’t been able to identify your account based on the information you provided. Please contact your centre team so they can assist you. Alternatively, you may log a ticket through the Help section of your online account. Thank you.

reviews.name: jamie crisp
reviews.text: Constant battle over billing. Every month was a drama. I would suggest anyone looking for co-working space to look elsewhere. The customer service is terrible and they lock you into terms and clauses that are not explained. If you are interested in co-working space, I'd strongly suggest you look elsewhere. The answer to everything is to raise a ticket in the app. There's zero personal interaction, everything through a souless app. Look elsewhere, there's plenty of cheaper options available in the area. (oh it's part of Regus so I'd avoid them too)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi, thank you for your review. We would love to try and help resolve this issue. Please raise a case through the Help section of your online account. Thanks

title: JustCo – Samyan Mitrtown | Coworking & Office Space
ownerDescription:
JustCo at Samyan Mitrtown, Bangkok is a large-scale coworking space and serviced office spanning six floors and 12,000 sqm. Located within Bangkok CBD, it offers direct access to Sam Yan MRT station from the basement floor. The centre features hot desks, private offices, meeting rooms, breakout and collaboration spaces, quiet pods, event space, and a foosball and game room. Regular member events also support networking, knowledge sharing, and business opportunities.

For on-demand access, download the JustCo App to find, book, and unlock coworking spaces, hot desks, and meeting rooms across Asia. No membership needed.

title: P's Thai Massage 2
ownerDescription: Traditional Original Thai Massage
address: 137, 4 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Rachael Sutherland
reviews.text:
Ple {68}  - In the last 3+ months I have had countless thai massages. I was heading to a different massage parlour when i went down the Asok BTS steps and decided to give P’s a go.

I had originally booked for 1 hour which then got extended to 1.5 hours. Had I not needed to get back, i’d have stayed even longer, all thanks to Ple!

Ple was one of the sweetest girls I have ever came across and performed the greatest thai massage *of my life*.

She was incredibly kind and clearly a master of her craft, her pressure and skill was exactly what I needed.

Thank you Ple, i hope our paths cross again one day and wish the best to you and your family. With love, Rachael, Scotland.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Rachael,

Thank you so much for your amazing review and for sharing such a heartfelt story. Reading your kind words truly made us smile.

We are absolutely delighted that Ple gave you such a memorable experience and that you consider it the best Thai massage of your life. Your compliments about her kindness, skill, and professionalism mean so much, and we have already shared your beautiful message with her. She was genuinely touched by your words.

We hope you had a wonderful stay in Bangkok and that your travels bring you back again one day. It would be our pleasure to welcome you again, and we wish you all the very best in Scotland.

P.S. We believe this review was intended for our P's Thai Massage No. 4 branch, where Ple works. No worries at all—we've already made sure she received your wonderful message. Thank you again for making her day!

Warm regards,
P's Thai Massage

reviews.name: Michael Bethuy | aACE Software
reviews.text: I was up early and looking to kill time until my friend woke up. I wandered into P’s Thai Massage at 8am - two hours before it opens -  and received a terrific head and neck massage from Bella. She started softly and gradually increased the pressure. It was a perfect start to the day. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your fantastic 5-star review!

We're delighted to hear that your visit turned into such a great start to your day. It's wonderful to know you enjoyed your head and neck massage and that the treatment was exactly what you were looking for.

We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience and your recommendation. We hope to welcome you again whenever you're looking for another relaxing break.

reviews.name: Fatima Khursheed
reviews.text:
This massage spot is perfectly located near Nana Station, making it super convenient to stop by after a long day. I opted for a foot massage combined with shoulders and head massage, and it was an incredibly relaxing experience from start to finish.

A special shout-out to Nun, who worked wonders with her amazing technique. She really took the time to release all the tension in my shoulders and back, leaving me feeling completely refreshed. If you’re visiting, I highly recommend asking for Nun—she truly exceeded my expectations with her skill and care.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Fatima Khursheed, thank you very much for your comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Bryan Barnard
reviews.text:
Having spent many hours walking around Bangkok when i first arrived P's was recommended to me by a local. First impressions were good. Hygienic, quiet atmosphere and as a bonus very close to Nana BTS. A 1 hour foot massage cost me 350 baht and my masseuse was Yoon 65. She was very professional, listening to my needs and immediately adjusting pressure when requested. All round excellent job and just what my feet needed.
Over the the last 5 weeks i have been a regular visitor, and Yoon has given similar excellent result for full body oil, and head & neck massages. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Bryan Barnard,
Thank you very much for your wonderful 5-star review! reviews.name: Follow Fauzia
reviews.text:
Well we came here for a nice one hour massage and ended up being a one hour 30 minute massage an hour 4 feet and then 30 minutes for head and shoulders for me and then two of the other ladies that I was with also did the same one did an extra 30 minutes on her legs cause she’s addicted to foot massages 😂

This place is really good the only annoying thing was that we had paid for the 60 min massage, and then write 10 minutes into the
Massage we decided we wanted an additional 30 minutes and right away instead of waiting for us to finish our massage the 60 minutes or even the additional 30 minutes they immediately requested payment so our massage stopped and I just said to them respectfully for me I said can I just pay for the 30 minutes additional after I’m done my hour and a half massage like why would you disturb a client for an additional 30 minutes immediately like as if we’re not gonna pay or as if we’re gonna run away ?

I think there has to be a little bit of etiquette around that! Otherwise it disturbs a massage that you’ve already paid for! The other two girls and ended up paying right away and I just said to them can I just pay for mine after it’s not like I’m going anywhere! She agreed the lady at the front counter!

Other than that the lady that I had she was amazing I had a great foot massage and she had her smile on and she was doing the best job she could and I was completely satisfied she was amazing !  🤩

The moment I finished my hour and a half massage the first thing the woman says oh don’t forget to pay for the 30 minutes and again I thought that was so annoying it’s not like we’re gonna run away I mean you have our shoes for crying out loud 😂 like wt!

Anyway of course I got paid for my additional 30 minutes and then left ! It was pouring heavy rain outside and we were right next to the Nana BTS - so one thing that she did was open up an umbrella and she walked us eight steps to the BTS station so we wouldn’t get wet so that was really nice of her to do that!

Highly recommended to go here I’ve been to their other location which is really good as well !

Follow Fauzia for more massage places cause as you know Thailand is full of them and if you can find the right one that gives you the right pressure and makes you feel great and satisfactory that that’s all you really need !! 🩷🩷🩷🙏🏼
Follow us on our social media channels such as TikTok YouTube Facebook Instagram !! 🥳🥳🥳🥳
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Follow Fauzia, thank you very much for your comment, and five stars recommend, we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

Thank you for taking the time to write such a review. We're sorry that you weren't comfortable with the payment process. It has nothing to do with you personally. Unfortunately, we've had countless bad experiences with some customers over the past few years, so we've had to implement this policy. We know some customers don't like it, but at the end of the day, we can't read some people's minds and try to prevent such problems. And yes, there are some people who just left without paying, that's the sad thing.

reviews.text: I had an aroma massage today for 60min. Everyone was very nice. It's  quiet inside despite the busy location of the shop. Therapist was Toon (1) and she did an amazing job with the right pression. Thank you. I will most certainly come back.

reviews.name: Dicky Don
reviews.text:
Firstly, I would like to address the unprofessional conduct of the receptionist, whose name is SUSHI.

Upon entering the establishment, she remained focused on her phone and did not acknowledge our arrival with a greeting or any form of basic customer service. This created a poor first impression and felt discourteous.

Secondly, we had several questions regarding the services offered. Instead of receiving helpful assistance, we were met with dismissive and rude responses, including, "So what do you want?" This manner of communication was inappropriate and fell well below the standard of customer service I would expect.

Thirdly, the receptionist gave the impression that customer satisfaction and the success of the business were of little importance to her. Regardless of one's role, professionalism, courtesy, and respect toward customers are essential. Employees represent the business they work for and should conduct themselves accordingly.

That said, I would also like to commend the three therapists (92, 46, and 30). They demonstrated excellent professionalism, maintained positive attitudes throughout the session, and delivered a high standard of service. Their efforts deserve recognition.

It is unfortunate that an otherwise positive experience was overshadowed by the receptionist's behavior. I sincerely hope management addresses this matter, as a business should not lose customers because of one employee's poor attitude and lack of professionalism.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Dicky Don,
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We truly appreciate your kind words about our therapists and are delighted to hear that they provided you with a professional and enjoyable massage experience. We will be sure to pass your compliments on to them.

We are sorry to learn that your experience at reception did not reflect the standard of hospitality we aim to provide. Your comments have been noted and will be reviewed carefully. We believe that every guest should feel welcomed, respected, and assisted from the moment they arrive.

Thank you again for bringing this to our attention. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with the complete experience our guests expect.

reviews.name: Charles Canfield
reviews.text: I went here here for a one hour Thai balm massage and requested only head neck and shoulders because I suffer from migraine headaches. After I explained to Too, Masseuse #1 that I wanted and that I did not want feet, arms and legs, she listened.  She is a great masseuse and a nice person. Thank you Toon for relieving my pain!

reviews.name: Todd Smart
reviews.text: A great place to relax and get a massage. Fast and friendly service with very fast WiFi to catch up on all your emails and chats. After the massage cool water is provided and you enjoy it either on the go or inside. Hugely recommended and I will return here for another massage.

reviews.name: U E
reviews.text: Great place to have a massage right by the nana station exit. The girls are sitting in blue uniforms right outside. It has a clean, quiet and relaxed vibe with great Air conditioning. I did a 1 hour foot and 1 hour head and shoulders massage for 300 baht each hour. It's cash only and you pay upfront before your massage starts. I selected the massage person number 94 based on someone's recommendation, her name was Palm.  She was absolutely amazing. Her English wasn't too good, but she could understand enough to adjust the massage according to how you wanted. She did the best upper shoulder and back massage I have ever had. After the massage my pain was gone. So if you can, I recommend getting her. Also, make sure to tip if you are happy with the massage, and hand it to them directly. I think 10-20% is sufficient depending on how generous you feel.

reviews.name: Krakatoaprods
reviews.text:
I have had many different massages in my travels around the world and Thai massage is most definitely the best and most beneficial in my view!

Today I had my first experience of Tok Sen, an ancient style of massage from the north of Thailand that uses a wooden mallet and wedge to create rhythmic vibrations that penetrate deep into the muscles to relieve chronic stiffness and tension.

The massage I received from one of the amazing staff at the Phailin Tok Sen shop, was a clever fusion of traditional Thai massage with the additional benefits of deep tissue Tok Sen. It was TOTALLY AMAZING!!! The masseuse immediately recognised that my lower back issues were creating problems for my knees and starting tapping away……90 minutes later I was floating out of the door feeling totally regenerated and ready for a nice cup of jasmine tea, a banana (!!!) and a lovely chat with Onphailin, the owner and person responsible for the development of this particular massage style.

It’s a relatively small shop and not the easiest place to find, but I cannot recommend it highly enough and will definitely be going back again for another session. First Class and Five Stars!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much hope to see you again 🙏

OMG THE BEST MASSAGE IN CHIANGMAI!!!
Came to Chiangmai for a massage expedition. I went to several popular massage brands like vintage, makkha, antique, sense, calm, oasis and several other less well known ones. They were all fine and nice for their environments. On my last day I wanted to try Tok Sen massage because I have this chronic shoulder pain. I searched and found Phailin. It’s located by the old town in a small alley, the shop is small and cozy. I got the one hour Tok Sen massage and it was a fun experience however the true experience lies within the actual massage. I had told my massage therapist about my shoulder pain and he customized the session to my needs and it was one of the best massages I’ve ever had. I was so happy and my body relieved of pain. There were no fluffed movements, everything  the therapist did was targeted towards a goal. I highly recommend this gem of a spot! A++!
P.S. they earned their 5 stars for their craft and nothing else!!

reviews.text:

The warmth from the herbal compress was incredibly soothing, releasing a wonderful aroma that immediately calmed my mind. The hot stones were a game-changer; the heat penetrated deep into my muscles, melting away all the tension in my back and shoulders. My therapist was exceptional—she knew exactly how to blend the heat therapy with the smooth, rhythmic strokes of the oil massage to ensure deep relaxation.
By the end of the session, I felt completely rejuvenated and light, as if I were walking on air. It was a truly satisfying experience that perfectly balanced therapeutic relief with luxury. If you are looking to de-stress, this combination is a must-try!

reviews.text:
The location and ambience were wonderful very peaceful, relaxing, and beautifully designed.

The experience is definitely on the expensive side, but the therapists were highly skilled and did an excellent job in untying knots. That was the highlight of the visit for us. The onsen itself, however, wasn't particularly memorable and didn't feel special.

One area that could be improved is the check-in process. There seemed to be some confusion regarding our booking, as the receptionist repeatedly asked for payment even after we explained that we had already prepaid through Klook. Unfortunately, I didn't catch her name, but the interaction left us uncertain about whether there were additional charges for the onsen. It wasn't a major issue, but it did create some unnecessary confusion at the start of our visit.

Overall, it was a good experience with a beautiful setting and excellent therapists. While we enjoyed our time there, we would mainly recommend it to those specifically looking for a spa and onsen experience and who don't mind paying a premium for it.

ownerDescription: practice and absorb the magic of authentic Thai home cooking, whilst you relax, unwind and enjoy a genuine holiday experience.

reviews.name: Amy Gillions
reviews.text:
We cannot recommend this cooking class enough! Due to it being low season, it was just myself and my partner in the class which felt like a real privilege.
The market trip was so interesting and we learned so much. It was lovely to see a part of Chiang Mai with only locals and it felt very authentic.
The class itself was fantastic - not only was the food amazing but we learned a lot and enjoyed Pom and Vasin’s company for the afternoon.
Small touches such as purchasing us some fruit we hadn’t yet tried in Thailand (mangosteen) and taking these brilliant photos and videos made it the highlight of our trip.
Lastly (and most importantly for me), they were so understanding and accommodating of our dietary needs (vegetarian and gluten free). As a coeliac, the entire class being gluten free made for such a relaxing experience and meaning I could sit back and enjoy eating the range of delicious food.
The price which includes pick up and drop off, the market trip, ingredients and cooking class experience was extremely good value.
I cannot say enough good things about this place, we loved our experience so much. Thank you!

reviews.name: Shyla M
reviews.text: This was one of my favorite experiences while vacationing in Thailand. It was a private class for my small group of 5 people. They conveniently picked us up and dropped us back off at our hotel. We made a stop at a local market to learn how to buy different kinds of rice, watch how coconut cream and milk are made and to pick up a few fruits to try. The cooking space with a demonstration area, individual cooking stations and dinning area was so impressive. I loved that they had mirrors stationed on the ceiling so that you could see what was happening in the pots and pans while the chefs were doing demonstrations. I loved the set up of first watching a demonstration, tasting the model and then cooking your own dish. All of the ingredients were carefully prepped and portioned before class which saved a tremendous amount of time allowing us to focus on the fun parts of cooking. They pay close attention to hygiene and food safety so I had no worries about eating anything. We made 4 dishes and while I am not usually good at cooking, each one was absolutely fantastic!  I will definitely be recreating these dishes at home and impressing all of my friends. Overall, this was a 10/10 experience!!

This was one of the highlights of our Chiang Mai short trip, which was going for a Thai cooking class. We had searched for a few other classes before deciding on this specific one, because a month before, researched and asked each one if they cater to Halal cooking requirements (halal meats, ingredients, utensils) - they said yes and gave us great assurance. We have to thank this wonderful team of husband & wife, Vasin & Pom whom runs this class from their home and speaks excellent English, as they picked us up at hotel in the city in the morning and drop us back after the class. They gave very informative, enjoyable and great cooking teaching instructions. Not shy away from any cooking and ingredients questions and tips that came to mind. Their kitchen class was neat, nice, well equipped and airy. Firstly Vasin & Pom took turn to demonstrate the cooking in front, then we proceed to our cooking section to make our own which included the fantastic sourish creamy Tom Yum with Prawns, Chicken Paneang curry, Stir fried chicken with Basil and Sticky rice with Mango. We had our cooking results as lunch. It was all seem so easy to prepare and delicious! 😋
Both their kind, warmth, down to earth and hospitality really shines through, and would definitely recommend friends to their class. 🙏🙏

reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our experience with Vasin and Pom at their beautiful Cooking at Home facility. Everything is so well organized and we learned to make and enjoy eating four delicious Thai delicacies. Vasin would demonstrate each dish with step-by step directions. There was even a large mirror above the cooking area where we could see exactly what he was doing. After each dish was demonstrated we went to our own area and replicated each dish with his guidance. We thoroughly enjoyed this experience and would highly recommend it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your feedback.
We very happy to shared our family recipes with you both.
And we are glad you enjoyed.

Wishing you have a wonderful trip around Thailand.

Culinary regards
Vasin & Pom

reviews.name: Ash Toji
reviews.text: It was a splendid session! Pom’s syllabus covers from the raw ingredients at the wet market until the final scoop. Her husband is a great teacher and a funny guy too.. they made the learning fun and enjoyable, and makes everyone feels like home. Definitely a recommended place to learn Thai cuisine and desert! They are very generous in pouring their knowledge in Thai cooking. ❤️❤️❤️ thank you for the experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback.
We glad you enjoyed and learn something from us.

We hope you will enjoy cooking Thai food at your home too.

Vasin & Pom

reviews.name: Rob Algie
reviews.text:
A wonderful husband & wife team whose recipe for teaching people how to cook Thai dishes is as polished as the recipes themselves. Everything from the local market tour, the kitchen set up, the quantity of dishes taught and the quality of the teaching is first class, clearly the result of many years of perfection and an innate passion for excellence.

I took some friends visiting from the UK to the Cooling@home Thai Culinary School and the entire event was a rich and fun learning experience for all. We each made four dishes by ourselves after being taught how to do so and each and every dish was bursting with a spectrum of flavours; just as one would experience in a professional Thai restaurant!.

This school is not only an excellent venue to learn the intricacies around Thai cooking but also makes an excellent team building venue for companies.

I live and reside in Chiang Mai and will definitely visit again to expand my repertoire once I have practiced all of the dishes taught during my first visit.

Rob Algie
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Rob for your feedback.
We glad you all enjoyed the cooking.
And we looking forward to see you again in our kitchen.

Culinary regards
Vasin & Pom

Vasin & Pom

They make an effort to have community events so if you’re working alone you can still have a work environment that is welcoming with friends that you see everyday!  Its in a great location about 5-10 min walk from the BTS. There is a climbing and cross fit gym that is in the same facility so getting a work out in is really easy! W District is close by so getting beers or dinner after work is effortless! Street food, coffee shops, just about everything you could need is right here! You don’t have to walk far! I’ve spent many months here and it doesn’t disappoint!!!

title: 3 Monkey Massage
ownerDescription: We are happy to provide services to help you relax.

plusCode: RC44+HW Wichit, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: putribiotech
reviews.text: I went with a friend and we tried the sport massage and aloe Vera massage  . The sport massage is really good for releasing knots and tension on the muscle. The pressure is  really good for my back. The aloe Vera is a good for sunburn after the whole day in the beach. The ladies running the place are very friendly. It’s recommended to call or WhatsApp them first before coming because sometimes they are busy.

reviews.name: A80s M
reviews.text: 3 Monkey massage has been great, we have been going there nearly every day for the whole week. Cheap, clean and good quality massage. Not a spa quality ambient but I cannot fault the massage quality I got from there, for the price. It is up the hill, a bit of a steep walk up and it is normally hot if you go during the day. Overall, less than half of the hotel prices and great massage. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Mupps Andy
reviews.text: One of the best places for massage in Phuket. Very authentic and experienced masseurs. They exactly know your pain points to focus without over powering on the area while being gentle. Should say very relaxing, authentic and soothing massage. Highly recommendable, and a should visit place!

reviews.name: Gabriel Lee
reviews.text:
The best massage I had during my trip to Thailand! Professional and World-class level massage! The masseuse at 3 monkey massage has many years of experience and you can notice the difference in the high quality massage that she provides.

- She was super thorough
- Oil massage and Thai Massage
- really helped to loosen up some knots under my scapulas.
- She also did a fantastic job massaging the rest of my muscles.

3 monkey massage is a cute little business near the top of a hill with a gorgeous view of the ocean below.

I highly recommend you treat yourself to a fantastic massage here for an incredible value!

Also, don’t forget to tip this incredibly hard working business owner as so many businesses are working hard to recover after the pandemic.

reviews.name: Sid R
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I went for a 90 min Thai massage and it was wonderful!! They were so kind and a thorough massage experience. Bring cash!

reviews.text: Amazing place! The atmosphere is peaceful and clean, and the massage therapists really know what they’re doing. I had a traditional Thai massage and it was perfect. Will definitely come back!

reviews.text: At 3 Monkeys Massage, you are not just a guest – you’re family. Tantiwa, a local therapist with a big heart, created this space for relaxation, healing and genuine Thai hospitality. Whether you need a deep tissue massage or a moment of peace, this is your sanctuary.

reviews.name: Daniel Mihai
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience at 3 Monkeys Massage! The staff is very friendly and professional. I left feeling so relaxed and refreshed. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Cape Panwa!

reviews.text:

We are thrilled and can highly recommend the salon!

reviews.name: Terence Li
reviews.text:
BEST MASSAGE EVER!
My girlfriend and I have stayed nearby for two nights and we had the best massage in Phuket during the entire trip. The boss lady is really good. She even fixed my old injury from sports by massaging deeply in the body tissue without telling her about my injury. You can just let her know if it’s too painful and she will adjust the power accordingly. If you have any soreness or pain, it’s definitely a must go option.

reviews.name: Dianne Ng
reviews.text: The place is clean and good, went there unplanned because the massage parlour next door was busy, had a really relaxing time. Reception and I used google translate to communicate. Masseur couldn’t speak much English but made sure I was ok. Been to many massages, this aromatherapy was good (: only wish I got a longer massage!

reviews.name: graham silverthorne
reviews.text: I highly recommend this massage. The lead masseuse, Cat, is extremely talented with some technical training from Hua Hin. I was a bit nervous going for Thai massage with a rotator cuff problem in my left shoulder but after 5 visits in two weeks I can say Cat improved my mobility and reduced my pain by about 70%+. I was so pleased I took the risk and found someone who knew what she was doing. Her massage technique is brilliant, she is modest and kind - but with very strong hands! I enjoy regular massage so I have lots of experiences  to compare this with - this was one of the best.

reviews.name: Justin B
reviews.text: Very nice and very clean massage family business. The price / quality of the massage is through the roof. Miss Miki and her family are amongst the kindest people I have met in my travels to Thailand, and that says alot, definitely go here for a very good authentic thai massage.

reviews.name: R V
reviews.text: A nice and spacious gym great for workout for couple of hours. Exercise equipments are in good condition and have sofa to sit down and rest after workout. This gym is not far from Big C and few minutes away from the train station.

reviews.name: Radwane SEBIANE
reviews.text: It's a great gym with all the necessary equipment. There's even an area for practicing combat sports.

reviews.name: Valentino Rocco
reviews.text: If you’re a cat lover and workout this will be a perfect place for you. The equipment is not much comparing to the other but it’s enough. They also have cardio space for you to work on such as treadmill, climb, must thai and etc. The staff is super nice and helpful too

reviews.name: Marcin Sciesinski
reviews.text: My favorite gym and very affordable. The AC is a life saver for a foreigner, like me.

reviews.name: Chandan Kumar
reviews.text:
I’ve been a regular member at this gym and generally have had a good experience. However, today I was quite disappointed with the behavior of one of the staff members. I politely asked for assistance in adjusting a machine that I had trouble with earlier. Instead of being helpful, he responded in a dismissive and reluctant manner, as if he didn’t want to assist at all. When I pointed out the machine, he made a minimal effort, vaguely said it couldn’t be adjusted (I couldn't catch exactly what he said), and walked away without even making eye contact. Later, I tried again on my own and, with a bit more effort, managed to adjust the machine without any issue.

I understand that everyone can have an off day, but as a paying member, I believe a basic level of courtesy and willingness to help should be expected from gym staff. I hope this feedback helps improve the experience for other members in the future.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback and for bringing this to our attention.
We sincerely apologize for the unpleasant experience you had with one of our staff members today. Please be assured that we will look into this matter and take necessary steps to improve our staff’s service attitude. We are committed to ensuring that all our members receive courteous, attentive and helpful service at all times. 
Thank you once again for letting us know, and we hope to provide you with a much better experience moving forward.

reviews.name: Jaylen Miller
reviews.text: It was a good gym to use. No extra or unnecessary rules. Just walked in, paid for my day pass and got to work. The smell of the men's bathroom was horrid tho. Other than that I didn't have any issues. Good selection of equipment available but it's all pretty old and you have to scour the gym for the weights you're trying to use.

reviews.name: Meiry Peruch Mezari
reviews.text: Nice gym, very well equipped, ac + fan work very well. Not crowded at all in the evening. Day pass was 90 baht, very reasonable! The cats are the cherry on top!

reviews.name: Max Bruhn
reviews.text: Going here for a while. Modern gym with lots of machines and Aircon. During peak hours very crowded though because it's very small. They also have a room used for martial arts training and stretching. They have just opened a new coffee shop inside with very good espresso for decent prices. Overall recommended if you are not bound to come during peak hours (5-9pm)

It can get busy but you will meet some great likeminded people and if you are into bulking, special diets, Muay Thai or competition body building this is a great place to come and get information.

reviews.name: Joel Wheelwright Janer
reviews.text:
After spending five fulfilling weeks filled with new recipes, techniques and flavours, Chef Lucas' expertise and depth of knowledge in both the bakery and pastry fields became clear.

I learnt simpler and more practical methods to produce similar results to my own experience until now, while learning entirely new techniques that were made to seem easy when they were once daunting.

The location is easily accessible, the equipment and resources involved in the lessons are more than satisfactory, the Chef and staff are all friendly professionals creating a good learning environment.

Whether you join for a day, a week, or the full five week course, all I can say is that it will be worth your time.

reviews.text: So happy to choose this school for my first international culinary class. The environment is good, very convenient, the instructor & kitchen crew is really nice and helpful. The admin also very helpful. It was a very very very good and unforgetable experience for me.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind review! 😊 We’re happy to be part of your first international culinary experience. Wishing you all the best on your cooking journey! 👩‍🍳❤️

reviews.name: Anna Huynh
reviews.text:
I have always wanted to attend culinary school and coming to Thailand, I’m glad I chose Siam Culinary Academy. Although it’s a 5 week program, I signed up for two weeks which is allowed. If I had the time, I would have done the entire 5 weeks. (If you only have time for one, choose week 3).  I like that this school does not do the tourist one day cooking class since its focus is being a culinary school. It’s great for those serious about cooking, being a chef, or restaurant business. Each class we do hands on training from prep to cook to taste. Great part too is being able to eat your leftovers as they are boxed in takeaways. Make sure you find accommodations with microwave access. The school recommendations for places to stay are all good: you can check out my review for The Bedrooms Boutique.
Class size is small and Chef Lyn breaks it down for you to understand easily. I had a great time learning from her and about her work experiences too. We get hard copies and electronic copies of all recipes covered each week. Overall I loved my experience. It has given me a deeper appreciation for Thai cuisine and more skills in the kitchen! If you want to learn more about living and learning in Thailand, this is a great opportunity.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Anna, for your kind words and wonderful feedback! 🌸😊🙏 This really means a lot to our team. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed your experience with us.

reviews.text:
What I like most about this gym is that it’s quiet and not overcrowded, so you can really focus on your training.

I took a private session with Kru Sut, and it was an excellent experience. He’s a very knowledgeable coach who taught me a lot of Muay Thai techniques and skills. His instructions are clear, precise, and easy to understand. He quickly identifies what needs to be improved and explains it in a way that makes it easy to apply immediately, which helped improve my technique during the session.

He’s also an excellent pad holder with great timing and rhythm, making every round effective and enjoyable.

I’ll definitely be coming back to train with Kru Sut again. Highly recommended if you’re looking for quality Muay Thai coaching.

address: 14/4 Soi Sathon 2, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: t F
reviews.text:
I ordered an aromatherapy massage and initially the therapist applied firm pressure, which was very pleasant and exactly what I had expected. However, as the session progressed, the pressure became extremely light—more like gentle stroking than an actual massage. As a result, the treatment no longer felt effective or enjoyable.

I remained hopeful that the pressure would improve during the rest of the session, but unfortunately it never did. By the end, I was left feeling disappointed, as the massage did not provide the level of relief or relaxation I had anticipated.

In addition, there was little to no aroma from the essential oils throughout the treatment. Since the aromatic aspect is one of the key elements of an aromatherapy massage, the lack of fragrance significantly diminished the overall relaxing experience.

Overall, I was disappointed because the service did not meet the standard I expected from a professional aromatherapy massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking a time to share your feedback, We’re truly sorry that your aromatherapy massage did not meet your expectations, particularly regarding the massage pressure and the aroma of the essential oil.

We really appreciate you bringing this to our attention. We will discuss your feedback with our team and make sure we improve these areas to provide a better and more consistence experience to our customer. We sincerely hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a much better experience  next time.

reviews.name: Adrian Kim
reviews.text: I was hesitant to visit this massage place with my daughter at first. While it isn’t a five-star venue, the quality of the massage absolutely deserves five stars. The therapists were excellent, and I would definitely go back again.

reviews.name: Emily Kim
reviews.text: I’ve been to many massage places in Bangkok and Chiang Mai….but this was by far the best massage experience I’ve ever had. The masseuse used lots of different techniques and adjusted the pressure based on my liking. Honestly the best two hours of my life, I have no clue why some reviews are so low?!

reviews.name: Pyrate Gal
reviews.text:
This place is complicated. I've gotten great massages here as well as mediocre massages here. Guess we can start with the price, about 350baht per hour for a thai balm/tiger balm oil massage which is great.

But some of the massage therapists want you to wear a full outfit while getting an oil massage....? How is it possible to spread oil throughout the body with all of those clothes on? Just felt like an absolute waste of money, what a pity.

Other times though, the massage therapists are amazing. Professional! Like sometimes my titties be out here because the therapist is stretching my arms but it's because they're actually massaging the body appropriately, everything felt professional.

But unfortunately, there's no way to call and ask to reserve a therapist. They don't have line either so you can't make a booking unless you come in person which is very inconvenient. Additionally, there's a 100 baht "booking fee" for asking for a specific therapist. :| So pay more for a good massage or throw your money away.

In addition to the booking fee, the therapists ask for tip as well :| There's just a lot of obscured fees and costs. It would be nicer if the price was more clear from the beginning.

If you live in the area or stay nearby, it's worth trying two or three times until you get a good therapist and then see if you want to continue. The price even with the booking fee is fair. The tip makes it a bit more pricey but it's up to your discernment on if it's a good deal for you still or not. Booking fee + oil + tip takes it to about 550 baht per hour for a thai balm massage. So use that price as a reference to compare elsewhere. Better deals can be had especially if you live in another area.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback. We’re happy you had some great massage experiences here. The clothing is provided for comfort and privacy during treatment. The 100THB fee for requesting a specific therapist goes directly to them, and tips are optional. We appreciate your comments and will keep improving.

reviews.name: Kunal Haria
reviews.text: It's a good price for the location. It's clean. Massage was okay/good. I would recommend. It lost a couple of stars are prices have gone up a bit. Prices are fixed, so can't negotiate. Paid 300 for an hour - balm massage

reviews.name: Travel Twitch
reviews.text: I visited this place 3 times while I was staying in the area, I got massaged by different ladies on all occasions and the massages were all very satisfying and enjoyable.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your visit. We are very happy to hear your comment.

reviews.name: Martin Handl
reviews.text: Very good massage, amazing prices, friendly staff. I was there with my 9yo son a staff were super nice to him a gave him kid friendly massage. Only downside is interior which is clean but dated
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your visit. We are happy that you had a good time with us.

reviews.name: Mateusz Danieluk
reviews.text: After more than a month in Thailand and visiting multiple places with massage this one was one of the best . Foot massage was strong and relaxing. They also took care of our baby so we could relax :)

reviews.name: Starla
reviews.text: My family of 4 opted for the 2 hour Thai Balm massage after a long flight. The staff was friendly, welcoming and did a wonderful job on each of our massages. We will only come here next time we are in BKK. 🙏🏽💗

reviews.name: Allen M
reviews.text: Excellent massage in a clean place. Only 200 bahts per hour. Highly recommend this place

reviews.name: petaluma brad
reviews.text:
Strong massage is available if you ASK and want a great deep tissue experience. Not only will the therapist switch if one is not strong enough, they will elbow, knee, even walk on your tightest muscles and knots. Don't waste your time or theirs with a 1 hour session, you need to give the massage techs time to work into the areas that need tension relief, book a 90 minute or 2 hours.
The rooms are clean, no smells, floors are clean, solid walls between Thai massage clients with a gap at the ceiling connected to the hall and adjacent clients. Airflow is good, no mustiness. Each massage is customized to what you tell the therapist you need, full relaxing, focused back/shoulders/neck, just the tight muscles and knots, or a standard Thai massage. They will adjust massage techniques and concentrate on where you need the most attention. The foot massage lobby is should not be used to judge the quality of the treatment. Try it and you'll be pleasantly surprised at the detail and attention the therapists give you. And to top it off their quality and prices can't be beat. Open from 10am to midnight.

reviews.name: Gorf Lee
reviews.text:
Worst massage experience I’ve ever had in Thailand😓
The masseur fell asleep while she was helping me to massage…
And only keep rubbing my back and scratching my head with no skills.
Masseurs keep chatting with each other which is a bit noisy.
The very first time that I hope time can go faster while massaging….

reviews.name: Martin Lindner
reviews.text: Too much of a gamble. Went twice before checking the reviews here but can confirm that only one lady is working hard. On my first visit I happened to have her and I enjoyed it. The second time a different lady was appointed and it was so weak I was thinking of writing this review for most of the time. No pressure just gently touching.

reviews.name: Cara Cheng
reviews.text: I bought a membership package here, but every time I try to book an appointment, no one picks up the phone. It’s impossible to get through. Extremely frustrating and disappointing. I do not recommend this place at all.

reviews.name: The Angry Stringinstrument
reviews.text: Service is okay nothing outstanding. Friendly staffs. Place is not the most modern looking one but the massage is really good. After long walk, this is the place to stop by. I fell asleep a couple of time. They have a bit of a problem managing bookings tho.

reviews.name: Chinawat Koawthanapong
reviews.text: Bad experience. I came once , it was 250bath/hr. But today, it is 350bath/hr. Bad manner service and not good at massage. You will regret to come here

reviews.name: Krishan Hewitt
reviews.text: We got the 2 hour Thai balm massage for 600thb. Probably the best massage we had throughout Thailand. Highly recommend

reviews.name: One Galleria Pte Ltd
reviews.text: Really really good traditional Thai massage and very affordable!

reviews.name: Dan LaRoche
reviews.text: I’ve seen several of their therapists on my trip and every single one is talented! Great Thai massages and amazing value.

reviews.name: Marta Mascheroni
reviews.text: pleasant effective massage. My legs feel very light and I'm really happy to have tried it. very honest price

title: Spaces Summer Hill
ownerDescription: ซัมเมอร์ฮิลล์อยู่ห่างจากสถานีรถไฟฟ้า BTS พระโขนงเพียงไม่กี่ก้าว และเป็นจุดที่เดินทางขึ้นทางด่วนได้อย่างสะดวก ซัมเมอร์ฮิลล์เป็นไลฟ์สไตล์มอลล์ใหม่ที่มีการออกแบบเป็นเอกลักษณ์ ตั้งอยู่ตรงหัวมุมตัดระหว่างถนนสุขุมวิทและถนนพระราม 4 โดยได้แรงบันดาลใจจากสิ่งต่างๆ ในฤดูร้อนตัดกับฉากหลังที่เป็นตัวเมือง อาคารสำนักงานเกรด A แห่งนี้ตั้งอยู่ใจกลางสุขุมวิทซึ่งเป็นย่านคอนโดมิเนียมที่อยู่อาศัย รวมทั้งโรงเรียนไทยและโรงเรียนนานาชาติชั้นนำหลายแห่ง ซัมเมอร์ฮิลล์เป็นสถานที่ซึ่งคุณสามารถพบปะพูดคุย พักผ่อนหย่อนใจ และเติมพลังของคุณได้ ทุกคนสามารถเพลิดเพลินไปกับร้านค้า ร้านกาแฟ และร้านอาหารมากมาย มีสิ่งอำนวยความสะดวกหลากหลาย ไม่ว่าจะเป็นร้านสะดวกซื้อ ฟิตเนส รวมถึงร้านจำหน่ายอุปกรณ์การศึกษาและผลิตภัณฑ์เพื่อสุขภาพ อีกทั้งยังมีลานจอดรถให้บริการอีกด้วย

reviews.name: Ammara Wanjiam
reviews.text: Excellent service and a fantastic team! Special thanks to Sudarat, Community Manager, for her professionalism, responsiveness, and willingness to help. The entire center team is friendly, supportive, and always ensures everything runs smoothly. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Michael Studley
reviews.text:
Super friendly staff, great location, affordable offices, nice amenities, clean.

I know it's common in all offices in BKK but Aircon is off after 6pm, weekends, and public holidays making it very very uncomfortable to work in during those times.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Michael Studley, many thanks for taking the time to leave us this review and we will share your feedback internally. You can also share this by raising a ticket through the Help section of your online account. Thank you.

reviews.name: Sukawat Keratimanoch
reviews.text: A new concept of rental office. This place offer a nice and cool working space. It’s also allow you to connect with new friends and opportunities. You can rent from a single desk to a small private room or large private room. Either you are start up or relocated firm, you find what it fit here. Great location and easy to commute.

reviews.name: Stanley Cheung
reviews.text:
IT IS A SCUM!!! Charging me “10%” late charge of the monthly rent on the first bill. First, this term is not written on the invoice and service agreement but written in an unaware document after the service agreement signed. Second, it’s insane and not fair to prepay the rent 15 days early otherwise the late charge applied. Third, terrible customer service to escalate this complaint and this late charge can’t be waived. Regret to join!!

Reply:-
I talked and emailed to your manager called Noyna and I left this complaint in your move in survey email as well before I posted this review. But NO ONE care! Instead of taking the initiative to follow up and investigate my case, you put me back to the queue to raise a ticket online?! What a terrble customer services you guys is doing?! reviews.name: Mueang Ittitep
reviews.text: So stylist with the see through glass-wall. I really like the common area so large with the cafe inside. Their staff also help professionally.

reviews.name: Jonas De Vuyst
reviews.text: I inquired about renting a desk here but the receptionist didn’t really speak English. Actually, I was in the wrong building at first. It’s very hard to find.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Jonas, thank you for your feedback. I'm sorry to hear about the language barrier and difficulty finding us. Please raise a ticket through the Help section of your online account so our team can review and assist you directly.

reviews.name: wareeporn olantawornkul
reviews.text: Nice place great for working,, with everything you need / near BTS
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi, thank you for the fantastic review! We're thrilled to hear you found our space great for working and conveniently located near the BTS. We can't wait to welcome you back!

reviews.name: Patcha Thin
reviews.text:
Co working space with great location next to bts Phrakanong, there’s a good place for working, easy to find some food etc,

Only one thing there’s no free coffeee for subscriber ( other they provide it!)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Patcha, many thanks for taking the time to leave us this review and we will share your feedback internally. You can also share this by raising a ticket through the Help section of your online account. Thank you.

reviews.name: benjamin florent
reviews.text: Excellent location, friendly staff, weekly events ... a place for starting an activity

reviews.name: Tasha LP
reviews.text:
⚠️🚨 SCAM ALERT 🚨⚠️

This place is good only if you plan to be a member for eternity. Becoming a member is as easy as a breeze, and facilities are nice, but if you want to cancel, that's when the nightmare starts. Moving to WeWork, I've been trying to cancel my membership at Regus/Spaces since May 2023, without success because there was some kind of error in the system that did not allow me to cancel my membership. I contacted the lady who signed me up for my membership, and she tried to help me without success. After bouncing many emails with her, having our emails forwarded to regional offices, talking to regional office, IT support, and everything in between—I STILL COULD NOT CANCEL. I'm definitely not tech-illiterate.

The most bizarre thing is nobody was able to help me terminate my membership—the system wasn't working, plus they have this policy that doesn't allow employees to help cancel on your behalf. So, in the case that you want to terminate, and the system doesn't give you any option to self-terminate, then you are pretty much stuck. I hung on to this membership I'd stopped using for months after that. The lady (Spaces employee!) recommended that I report fraud and terminate my credit card (can you believe it?! Check the screenshot), so I finally did a few months ago (not that I haven't already been paying for nothing for the past six months), but the company still kept invoicing me up until now. I emailed them again today saying that I had been trying to cancel but wasn't able to. Again, new people on the other end of the company told me that I have to do it myself and I'm still a member on the system—all over again.

⚠️⚠️ Do not become a member! This is an unethical, bad business, and you will be screwed over. ⚠️⚠️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Natasha Patamapongs, thank you for taking the time to leave us feedback. We are so sorry to hear that you have had a less than positive experience with us. Please rest assured that your concerns were escalated to our global customer services and your centre team to provide further support. Your ticket reference number is C-1525062-K7Y6. Thanks.

reviews.name: Andre Russ
reviews.text:
An excellent facility with friendly and accommodating staff.

Location is great with the entrance located directly near the stairs of the BTS Sky Train.

Coffee was delicious and there are a selection of restaurants close by.

It's a busy hub, but the energy is positive and friendly.

reviews.name: David Led
reviews.text: Seems like a nice place for co-working

reviews.name: Shayan Naveed
reviews.text: I really like this co-working space(s). Friendly staff, great services and good location. Love the design and ambiance here. I can get my work done before/after gym in the area. Also next to some cool food trucks.

reviews.name: Matthew Shockey
reviews.text:
Bad business practices. After inquiring online, the company used an automatic dialer and called me 6 times per day the last 3 days until i finally answered the phone today to let them know I'm no longer interested. Hopefully i do not hear back.

If i wanted to speak on the phone, i would have called. I'll take my business to a company that doesn't harass me 24 hours a day.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi, we appreciate your feedback. We’d like to learn more about your experience to help us make improvements in the future, please email comments@iwgplc.com to share more details. Thank you.

reviews.name: Sesiri Pathirane
reviews.text: Fred, Lake and the whole team are great! Amazing support for all the startups! Plenty of networking opportunities for folks running startups!

reviews.name: Faadzil Osman
reviews.text: Excellent service, great vibes, an all round peaceful working space where you can focus or relax and you can always rely on lovely community manager lady too if you need any assistance!

reviews.name: Grey Reality

reviews.name: Ray Lee
reviews.text: Conven8ent workspace shared by different business, Starbucks right belie

reviews.name: Naxchakhun Ph Number-four
reviews.text: Best location! Nice ambience with cool people

reviews.name: Liam Dillon
reviews.text: Excellent facility, great location with friendly staff.

title: Mon Massage
subTitle: มนต์ นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ
ownerDescription: Get an Authentic Thai massage experience here. Best quality and super relax massage at Chinda Thawin,Si Phraya Samyan นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ ร้านสะอาด นวดแล้วสบายกายสบายใจ ราคามิตรภาพ ต้องที่ร้านมนต์ นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ
address: 4 1 Chinda Thawin Alley, Khwaeng Maha Phruttharam, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: Seiko Suzuki
reviews.text: My son and I both got express 30 minute Thai massages for 200baht each before heading to the airport. I wish I had more time because the massage was phenomenal! My son had a different woman working on him and he enjoyed his massage as well. The pressure was firm, just how we like it. The place is no frills, but we walked away very relaxed and happy! Thank you Mon Massage🙏

reviews.name: Kasey C
reviews.text: Best massage I’ve had in Thailand - if you are looking for strong and experienced masseuses for muscle pain, this is it. Must (my masseuse) was kind, friendly, and proactive with checking in regarding pressure. The place is home style with three floors (foot massages are on the first floor in a living room-like space), body massages on second and third floors. I appreciated that the massage table had a hole for your head (as opposed to a pillow which strains the neck when lying face down). Prices are extremely reasonable - 400 baht for 60 min oil, 500 baht for sport massage. Cash only.

reviews.name: Fufu Ren
reviews.text:
This place is definitely 5 stars! I’ve been there so many times and today grandma says someone complained here not good and asked me to leave a review. I said OK very good 😂

But seriously their massage is very good, it is the strongest massage I’ve had anywhere. If you can’t take weight in any shape of form just tell them to go very light.

reviews.name: Will
reviews.text:
Located a short distance into the alley. The establishment isn't fancy like a spa but homely like massage from ur senior auntie.

The person who massaged me did body first then foot. The body was v well done. She was considerate and the strokes were firm. She even asked if I wanted my body to be twisted.

However maybe she is tried afterwards,  the food massage was very forgettable. However I observed the ladies whom were beside me massaging. All of them had strong fingers and arms and their strokes were all long and firm.

Slight con: the chairs a bit worn out.

Boss lady is a teochew. And if u speak teochew, chat her up.

reviews.name: Steve Bush
reviews.text:
We couldn't even get a massage here. We first went at noon and the lady (no English) told us to come back at 2:30. When we came back, she said to come back at 4:00 but we might not get in. The place was empty, so maybe their staff got sick that day.
Instead, we went to Yours Massage Spa a few minutes away, got right in and had a great massage for less than the Mon price.

reviews.name: Bel
reviews.text: I had one hour of foot massage followed by one hour of Thai massage. She brought me upstairs to an a/c room where I changed into their clothes and lied down for the massages.  My masseuse worked hard and attentively for the entire 2 hour period.  If you have any tired or knotted up muscles, you should try the massage here. I noticed after the 2 hr massage, my face glowed. I got very relaxed. If value and quality is what you are after, this is the place to come to for massages. But if you prefer a grand decor with luxurious, stylish or elegant ambience and furniture, then this is not the place for you.

reviews.name: Jenny Wong
reviews.text: Comfortable foot massage with friendly staff. Totally worth it! Only 280 baht, and not many tourists come here. If you like authentic Thai massages, you should come here.

reviews.name: Katriya Huhtala
reviews.text: Very professional and skilled staff. Best massage I have had in Bangkok. Recommended!

reviews.name: HATIM ALMAGHRABI
reviews.text: Excellent massage, friendly staff, professional and welcoming from the moment you arrive tell you leave.  Highly recommended.

reviews.name: TB
reviews.text:
Had a really deep back, neck and shoulders massage for 370 baht.

The masseuse was great and asked me to tell her if it was too painful.

Great value!

reviews.name: Elias K.
reviews.text: We opted for the one-hour balm oil Thai massage, which was really good (320 baht). We were taken upstairs and asked to lie down in neighbouring beds. Only criticism is that the two lovely ladies were constantly chatting to each other throughout the massage, which took away from the relaxing nature of the massage experience.

reviews.name: Ashlee P
reviews.text: Second time back on our holiday! Such beautiful, kind people that give the best massages. Highly recommend to everyone wanting to relax. It is also extremely clean, all blankets, clothing are freshly washed.

reviews.name: Karolina Brak
reviews.text:
I can only agree with previous positive reviews - this was the best Thai massage I have had during my stay in Thailand. Lady who massaged me has great talent - from the very beginning I knew that I’m in good hands. The massage was perfect - not too strong, but also not too light, very relaxing and pain relieving.

Apart from the massage - I really liked the music playing in the background and cheerful staff 😁And it’s really inexpensive.

My husband also had Thai massage and also was delighted.

So sad it’s our last day in Thailand and we can’t go there once more…
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for coming with rain. As an owner and teacher of the maseuses. my heart is fullfill for your praise that my students is skillful. Thank you again.

reviews.name: Sofie
reviews.text: Had my first Thai massage here today and was really thrilled. The atmosphere in the salon is pleasant. During the massage, relaxing music was playing, I was asked about pressure and well-being, and at the end of the one-hour massage, I was given some tea. I also consider the 280 baht to be reasonable in comparison to other salons.

reviews.name: Sabrina Koch
reviews.text: We had full body massage with oil, it was pretty good, we were happy with it. They were attentive and careful, worked well on the painful parts.

reviews.name: Rayfill
reviews.text: Took a massage here on my last day in Thailand. The people working here are very friendly and fun. First they clean your feet and then it's massage time. I had the 1 hour neck/shoulder/back massage and after it felt great! I recommend this place, especially if you're staying in one of the hotels nearby!

reviews.name: Daniil Tkachuk
reviews.text:
Just have randomly came to this place with friends for a foot massage and it was so good! The lady was really trying hard and was doing it great! One of the best massages I’ve ever had in Thailand!
I think I might even come back here for sport massage even though I live pretty far from the place!

reviews.name: k k
reviews.text: Ok, so this is hands down the best THAI massage place we’ve been to in Thailand. During last 3-4 weeks, we checked over 10 places, including fancy spa, massage school and “sidewalk” massage spots across the country. During our last day of holidays, we found this place and it’s amazing. Seriously, don’t look further, just go and enjoy a solid, tough Thai massage here
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for coming with rain. As an owner and teacher of the maseuses. my heart is fullfill for your praise that my students is quite skillful. Thank you again.

reviews.name: Juliana Keefler-Johnson
reviews.text: Had a fantastic experience! The staff were so kind and lovely and the facilities are nice and clean. The massage room was relaxing and the massage itself was one of the best I’ve had. Great value and would come back!

reviews.name: Chayata S
reviews.text: the massage is soooooooooooo great. They are so skilled unlike any other places I’ve been to. A must visit!

title: Thai Cooking Class by Sawasdee Thai Cuisine
ownerDescription: Experience Thai culture through cooking! Design your own 3-course cooking menu, stroll around the local market (for morning class) or pick a dessert from our dessert class (for afternoon class). Enjoy your delicious creations with unlimited soft drinks. Bring home photos, a recipe booklet and new skills! Morning class 11:15AM / Afternoon class 03:00 PM. Classes are around 2 hours.
address: 32 Kade Kwan Rd Kata Beach, Karon, Muang, Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: R8C2+HF Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Nichola Roberts
reviews.text:
What a wonderful morning and experience.

We started with a visit to the local market where my lovely assistant for the session, Guid, showed me around. She explained the ingredients and helped me pick out some treasures to take back to the UK, which made it feel really special and authentic.

Back at the kitchen I met my chef for the morning, Jan. She guided me step by step through creating some incredible Thai dishes. She was so warm and patient, sharing her knowledge of flavours, smells and traditional cooking. We joked that I was Chef India and she was Chef Thailand, both sharing our love of food.

Guid also kept me cool and hydrated the whole time, which was very appreciated in the Phuket heat!

Such a lovely experience with two wonderful ladies. I learned so much and would highly recommend this class to anyone visiting Phuket who loves food and wants to learn real Thai cooking. khop khun mak ka 🙏
Nichola xxx
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for cooking with us 🌞! We are very happy to hear you had fun at the class and will pass on your compliments to Guide and Jan - khob khun kaa! 🥳

reviews.name: Dwayne McConney
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed the cooking class at Sawasdee! I never knew cooking Thai food could be so easy! Special thanks to Beer, Korn and Chef Jan for guiding us through everything! They were great and so helpful! Make sure to book a morning session as it includes a trip to the local market!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for cooking with us 🥳! We are very happy to hear that you enjoyed the class and I will pass your kind compliments to the team 🌟.

reviews.name: Paola Prada
reviews.text:
We had a truly wonderful experience with the Sawasdee Thai Cuisine cooking class. Everything was perfect from beginning to end. First, we visited a local market, which was such a nice and authentic way to start the experience. Then we cooked a papaya salad, followed by a soup, and then the main dish, my favorite, Pad Thai.

The whole class was very well guided by Chef Jan and Beer. They were both amazing at explaining everything, always very kind, friendly, and smiling. They made the experience feel easy, fun, and welcoming.

We were also offered drinks, water, mocktails, and soda, which was a lovely touch. Pook also helped us take photos the whole time, which made the experience even more special and memorable.

At the end, they gave us a small gift and a certificate, which was such a thoughtful detail.

I completely recommend this experience with Sawasdee Thai Cuisine!

reviews.name: Tariq ALNOUFAIY
reviews.text:
We did the morning cooking class with Sawasdee Thai Cuisine, and it was honestly one of the highlights of our trip.

They start by taking you to a local market first. It’s not a “shopping for the class” stop. It’s more of a guided walk so you can see the local produce and ingredients. If you want to buy something, it’s for you and not required for the class.
Back at the class, which is held at the restaurant in the resort, we cooked three dishes: papaya salad, Tom Yum soup, and green curry. The papaya salad was surprisingly simple and so delicious. The Tom Yum had amazing flavor and was easier than I expected. And the green curry was incredible. I’m not exaggerating, it came out better than many dishes we’ve had at local restaurants.
I went with my son and we both had a great time. It was fun, relaxed, and really well organized. Big thanks to our hosts Beer and Korn for being so helpful and clear, and to Chef Jan who was patient, funny, and made everything feel easy.
I genuinely recommend this to anyone visiting Phuket, even if you don’t usually like cooking. We’re already saying we want to do a cooking class in every country we visit now.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for cooking with us and for such an amazing review 🌞! We are very happy to hear that you and your son had fun at the class. I will pass on your compliments to Beer, Korn and Chef Jan 🌟.  Doing a cooking class in every country you visit sounds really fun 🥳!!

title: The Urban Office
ownerDescription:
The Urban Office seeks to redefine the modern working experience by offering mindfully designed and cost-effective coworking and flexible work spaces.
Our vision is to help freelancers, entrepreneurs, start-ups, SMEs and global companies open and succeed in new markets, by customizing workspace and business solutions for all work needs.
We are located in S-Metro Building, a Grade A office building situated in the heart of Bangkok’s Sukhumvit Phrom Phong Shopping District.
Our focus is on creating happiness in the workplace. We believe in enabling the fusion of diverse ideas and people to build a better future.
address: Level 20, S-Metro Building 725 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: BB Bright
reviews.text: The atmosphere is relaxing, and the coworking space is excellent. There are comfortable sofas and phone booths for work calls. Free coffee and drinks are provided every day, and the staff are super friendly and welcoming. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ron Travels
reviews.text:
I spent one month in this co-working space and just love it. It really feels like a mix between office and creative space. The atmosphere is great, plants everywhere, art and a breath taking view over Bangkok city.

For me it is the best co-working space in Bangkok that I have been so far. It isn't cheap but you will get good value for your money, fresh coffee and very friendly and supportive staff that speaks fluent English. Just give it a try!

reviews.name: Panthita Arbnguen
reviews.text:
Quiet, clean, and super comfortable workspace
Perfect for focusing, taking meetings, or just changing the atmosphere from working at home.
Fast Wi-Fi, great coffee, and a really productive vibe. Definitely one of my favorite co-working spaces so far

reviews.name: Kristijan Pribicevic
reviews.text:
I spent a full day working at The Urban Office at Phrom Phong in Bangkok, and it was a genuinely great experience.

From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere felt both professional and creative. The space is modern, clean, and thoughtfully designed, with plenty of natural light and beautiful views over the city. It strikes that perfect balance between focused work environment and inspiring creative hub. There are plants, art, and stylish details everywhere, which make it feel welcoming rather than corporate.

The Wi-Fi was fast and reliable throughout the day, and the workstations were comfortable even after several hours. I also appreciated the quiet corners for deep focus as well as the well-equipped meeting rooms. The coffee was excellent, the pantry well stocked, and everything was very well maintained.

What really stood out to me was the staff. They were friendly, attentive, and spoke excellent English. They made me feel welcome right away and were always happy to help.

Even though I was only there for one day, I could easily imagine working from here regularly. It offers great value for the quality you get. I would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for a premium co-working space in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Belle vongsuphar
reviews.text:
Great Co-Working Space with a Beautiful View

I recently visited the urban office co-working space, and I had a great time! The space is clean, well-maintained, and has a great atmosphere for productivity. The staff is friendly and welcoming. One of the best parts is the amazing view, which makes working here even more enjoyable. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to work!

reviews.name: Keith Zhang
reviews.text:
I’ve had an amazing experience at urban office. The space is modern, well-designed, and thoughtfully laid out — perfect for productivity and focus. The facilities are top-notch, with comfortable workstations, fast and reliable Wi-Fi, and plenty of natural light.

The community vibe here is fantastic — a great mix of professionals and creatives — and the staff go out of their way to make sure everyone feels welcome and supported. They’re friendly, attentive, and always ready to help.

great coffee, well-stocked pantry, and clean, well-maintained spaces. The meeting rooms are well-equipped, and there are plenty of quiet corners when you need some deep focus.

reviews.name: Sp namM
reviews.text: Great atmosphere, quiet and comfortable for working. Free tea and coffee are provided, and the staff are very friendly and welcoming.

reviews.name: Ivan Krylov
reviews.text: Equipped with reliable high-speed internet and essential office amenities, it has everything you need for a smooth workday

reviews.name: Sergey Shinin
reviews.text: I was sitting right near the window. The view is amazing - all the Bangkok city in front of your eyes. Comfortable chairs, good tables, fast internet connection, phone booths for zoom calls. Urban Coworking has everything that I needed. And of course, the managers in the reception are helpful and very friendly.

reviews.name: Demian Venzke
reviews.text: Freezing cold and not well equipped. Very pricy for a day pass as well. We paid 800 THB for a day and decided after a few hours to leave because it was too cold and the kitchen had a bad smell :/ cannot recommend it. A bunch of places were reserved already so you don’t have a lot of hot desk places to sit. The table wasn’t clean too. There seems to be a doctors office, too. I saw a guy in a lab coat receiving patients there. Little bit weird but okay. The staff was kind though.

reviews.name: Marcos Valera
reviews.text:
Coworking seems good, and I believe the day pass is around 600 THB. I’m aware there are three phone booths, good services, and great views.

I came here from the other side of the city to work, but I wasn’t able to pay because they don’t accept mobile or digital contactless payments. You’ll need a physical debit/credit card if you want to pay.

They also keep your passport/ID while you’re in the building (common in BKK, but not something I experienced in other coworking spaces), which I personally don’t like. It’s also worth mentioning that they have a sign warning you that photos and videos may be taken for public communications.

Overall, the space looks great, and if facilities are your priority (and you have cash or alternative payment methods), this could be a solid place to work. However, in terms of privacy, it’s by far the worst coworking I’ve been to.

reviews.name: Chris
reviews.text: Calm vibe, good location, clean and professional. The wifi is fast, the staff is friendly, and it's well appointed.

reviews.name: มณีรตน์ อินทนู
reviews.text: A wonderful place to work and relax. The atmosphere is calm, comfortable, and perfect for staying productive.

reviews.text: The atmosphere is very quiet and relaxed.  The desks are nice, spaced out and comfy. Would recommend to friends. The reception people are also very kind.

reviews.text: I needed a place to work for a last-minute project and The Urban Office was the place to go. The physical infrastructure itself is stunning with an absolutely vibrant atmosphere, breathtaking views, ergonomic office furniture, comfortable chairs, good tables, fast internet connection, phone booths for zoom calls : a real dynamic community culture. The Urban Office has everything that I needed. It’s very convenient, close to Phrom Phong BTS station, this workspace is top-notch for productivity, comfort, convenience with unrivaled facilities, client service and amenities available. Will come back for sure!

reviews.text: I have been to so many coworking spaces in Bangkok but The Urban Office is really good. I went there to try Free trial on Friday, Love it. I will go back there for sure. If you are looking for a coworking space with quiet  and green environment,  I would suggest you to try this place !!

title: Sinbi Muay Thai
subTitle: Sinbi Muay Thai Training Camp - Phuket
description: Large gym offering a number of Muay Thai training camps in an open-air setting.

Sinbi Muay Thai Camp is a massive, open air gym with 3 full size rings, 30 bags , a stretching/shadowboxing and warmup area, a fully kitted weights room which has a selection of free weights, kettle bells, benches, isolation machines and spinning bikes, rowers and a high rise roof which allows a breeze to flow through he gym to help cool you down.

We also have the largest Muay Thai shop in Phuket stocking absolutely the best in Muay Thai equipment at the best prices.

The Sinbi Apartments is a 21 room facility located just a 300 meter walk from the camp. We offer a mix of private rooms, shared rooms as well as 2 VIP rooms and Penthouse room. Featuring amazing views from the rooftop terrace and a tranquil swimming pool

reviews.text: Great gym with a blend of young and experienced trainers. I had a pleasure to do pads with a trainer that had 600+ professional fights! Group sessions are very well organized and suitable for all levels. They also have a small stadium where they organize fight nights.
