Sinbi Muay Thai Team

reviews.name: Alejandro Gonzalez
reviews.text:
Sinbi Muay Thai is a top-tier gym. The group classes are well organized, well paced, and never boring. The trainers do a great job refining technique while keeping things fun and challenging.

Big shoutout to Bao V, who I trained with most. His attention to detail is excellent and his pad combos are creative, tough, and effective.

The atmosphere is welcoming, everyone’s friendly, and their stadium is also a blast to check out for a night of quality fights. Highly recommend Sinbi if you want serious training with a great vibe.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the amazing review 🙏

We’re really happy to hear you enjoyed the structure and energy of our group classes — our trainers work hard to keep sessions technical, challenging, and fun at the same time.

BaoV will be very proud to read your shoutout! His creativity on the pads and attention to detail are exactly what we aim for at Sinbi.

We’re also glad you enjoyed the atmosphere and had a great time at the stadium. That combination of serious training and a welcoming vibe is what we’re all about.

Hope to see you back at Sinbi again soon! 🥊🔥

reviews.name: Rebecca Rooney
reviews.text:
I spent 2.5 months training at Sinbi during the low season. The gym attracts a lot of members, but at no point did I ever feel that I was forgotten about or lost to the crowd. During my first class in the gym, I felt as though I had a shadow. One of the trainers (BaoV) was my pad holder, then checked in on me all through the class. I appreciated it, because the heat was getting to me!

Every class you get 5 rounds of pads, one on one with a trainer and they put a complete effort in with you. After being a regular face in the gym, you develop relationships with trainers, they become very chummy and playful with you and it makes you feel at home. I had no bad days at Sinbi, I loved it, and I recommend the gym highly. Thank you Sinbi 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🙏🥊

We are very happy to hear that you enjoyed your 2.5 months training with us at Sinbi. Our goal is always to make every student feel welcome and supported, regardless of the size of the class, so it means a lot to hear that you felt looked after from your very first session.

We will pass your kind words on to BaoV and all the trainers. Building friendships and creating a family atmosphere is a big part of what makes training at Sinbi special, and we are glad you felt at home here.

Thank you for choosing Sinbi Muay Thai and for being part of our gym family. We hope to welcome you back again in the future for more training, laughs, and Muay Thai. 🙏🥊

Sinbi Muay Thai Team

reviews.name: Eliel Vega
reviews.text: I had both a good and bad experience at this gym. Sinbi Muay thai definitely met my expectations, their professional website and facilities made training worth it. I especially enjoyed their apartments, where the housekeepers were always there to help and did an amazing job. However, the shortfall was with their trainers and the overall atmosphere. A lot of the trainers were immature and quite young, as an 18 year old I was never partnered with the more experienced Kru's (teachers). Play is fine, but sometimes the young trainers went too far with their hitting "corrections," where it became stressful rather than a learning opportunity. The class size was manageable, however you will not improve unless you pay private classes or are friends already with the instructors. I would return to this gym, it is quite far however.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We appreciate both the positive comments and the areas where you feel we could improve.

We are happy to hear that you enjoyed our facilities, apartments, and the support from our housekeeping team. We are also sorry to hear that your experience with some of the trainers and the training atmosphere did not fully meet your expectations.

We would like to mention that we always encourage students to communicate with us during their stay if they have concerns or are not comfortable with any aspect of training. We would have appreciated the opportunity to speak with you while you were here and address any issues directly.

Our trainers come from different backgrounds and levels of experience, and all are here to help students learn authentic Muay Thai. We take feedback regarding coaching style and student experience seriously, and we will discuss your comments with the team.

We are glad to hear that overall Sinbi met many of your expectations, and we appreciate your honesty. We hope if you return in the future, you will feel comfortable speaking with our management team so we can help make your experience even better.

Thank you again for your feedback.

Sinbi Muay Thai Team

reviews.name: Nicola
reviews.text:
I came to Phuket specifically to learn the art of Muay Thai and picked Sinbi Muay Thai gym to train at. I have trained this sport back in my home country but ever since I trained at Sinbi, I felt that the krus have helped me to improve and I really loved that the Krus really go into the details of correcting my mistakes and bad habits. I really appreciate that the krus were all so patient with me as l am a very slow learner.

This is truly an eye-opening experience to have learn Muay. Thai from the authentic source and I am so glad to have learn Muay Thai from the krus of Sinbi.

No doubt the group session is very crowded but there are also plenty of krus on the floor to conduct the training. I did not get lost in the crowd and I was given ample attention from the krus.

I felt so welcomed in this gym. Special shout out to Kru Fon, Kru Beer and Kru Jin. They're very nice krus who are so skilled in what they do. All of the krus at Sinbi are very passionate about what they do. It’s very evident that they show a lot of pride in teaching this art to the world.

I definitely will come back to Sinbi to learn more from the krus and to get better at the sport.

The gym is so well-maintained, and it is very very clean. However it does get very very humid as there is no fan in the gym. I supposed gyms like this don't usually have fans installed but it would definitely be a very nice touch to have big ceiling fans to help with the ventilations in the gym. The weather can get very unforgiving and heat level is quite intense at times. Not too sure if this may be something that the gym might wish to explore in the near future. 🙂

Overall, really enjoyed my time training at Sinbi. Thank you everyone at Sinbi!! ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Nic, for taking the time to share such a detailed review. 🙏🥊

We are very happy to hear that you enjoyed your experience at Sinbi and that our Krus were able to help you improve your Muay Thai technique. Our trainers take great pride in sharing authentic Muay Thai and helping students of all levels develop, so it means a lot to hear your kind words about their patience, guidance, and attention to detail.

We will make sure to pass your special thanks on to Kru Fon, Kru Beer, and Kru Jin. They will be very happy to hear your feedback. 🙏

We also appreciate your comments regarding the gym environment and ventilation. Phuket’s heat and humidity can definitely be challenging, especially during intense training sessions, and we are always looking for ways to improve the training experience for our students.

Thank you again for choosing Sinbi Muay Thai for your Muay Thai journey. We look forward to welcoming you back to continue your training and help you progress even further. 🥊🙏

Sinbi Muay Thai Team

reviews.name: Noor Md
reviews.text: Still a decent gym nonetheless but they became pretty commercial and crowded. It's hard for the coaches to guide you on the details and fundamentals as many people come and go. The third ring which I did my padwork have some holes and wasn't flat. There's many other underrated gyms around Rawai that is much better.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback and for taking the time to share your experience 

We’re glad you still found the gym to be decent, and we appreciate your  comments. As a busy gym, we do welcome a high number of students, which helps us keep the gym running and support our full team of trainers.

Our trainers are attentive and approachable, and  encourage students to communicate what they want to work on during training so we can help in the best way possible. With many different levels and goals, this really helps us give each student the right attention 🙏

We also appreciate you mentioning the ring — we will pass this on to our team to check and improve.

Thank you again for your feedback, and we hope to welcome you back to Sinbi in the future 💪

reviews.name: Sabina Sumez
reviews.text:
Our visit to the Muay Thai event was very disappointing.

During the fights, we felt that some of the judges’ decisions appeared clearly biased, especially against fighters who do not train at their gym. This left us with a very negative impression of the entire event.

We advise tourists and visiting fighters who are considering competing at one of their events to think carefully before signing up. We also recommend watching their live fight recordings on YouTube and forming your own opinion.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback.

We understand that fight results can sometimes be disappointing and that people may have different opinions on decisions made during a bout.

Muay Thai is a competitive sport, and the official referees and judges are responsible for scoring each fight based on what they see in the ring. While decisions may sometimes be viewed differently by fighters, teams, or spectators, we respect the judging process and the role of the officials.

We appreciate you attending our event and taking the time to share your thoughts.

Sinbi Muay Thai Team

reviews.name: Shosho
reviews.text: I always get butterflies going into a new gym, but I felt the warm Thai welcome as soon as I arrived to Sinbi. My Muay Thai gym in Western Australia (Primal) had a group come over and train, so with their recommendation, I knew it had to be good. The group classes are really well structured, making the two hours fly by. It’s a big gym with a number of people, yet I never felt lost in the crowd, so to speak. I had a couple of 1-1 sessions and I learnt so much with the Kru’s. Sinbi also hold fights on Saturday nights at their stadium. You HAVE TO DO THIS! It was so much fun!! I’d definitely come back to train again at Sinbi!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind words and thoughtful review! 🙏 We’re so happy to hear that you felt the warm Thai welcome from the moment you arrived. It means a lot to us that you chose Sinbi on the recommendation of your team at Primal — they’re an awesome crew!

We're glad the structured classes, personal training sessions with our Kru’s, and the overall vibe made you feel right at home. It's great to know you never felt lost, even with the buzz of a busy gym — that’s exactly the experience we strive to create.

And yes — the Saturday night fights are always a blast! 😄 We're thrilled you enjoyed them and we’d absolutely love to welcome you back anytime you’re in Phuket again. Keep training hard and hope to see you soon! 🥊🇹🇭

— Team Sinbi

reviews.name: Dalton Allen
reviews.text:
Great gym with great coaches and staff.

They offer training to all skill levels from beginner to fighters, locals and foreigners, and everyone speak English well.

I have never fought and i don't plan on fighting, but have trained a bit in the past. My skills and techniques vastly improved. The coaches take time to teach everyone and not just the fighters.

Spent 1 month training here and loved ever minute of it.

Highly recommend this gym.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🙏Thank you very much for taking the time to rate and review us, Dalton and for the positive feedback. We really appreciate it. We are very pleased you enjoyed training with us and saw an improvement. Hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Linus
reviews.text:
Did a private with Kru Bow. What an awesome high level and technical session. We went straight into set-ups and technical work after a couple light back & forth rounds of us moving around. Also, I love that he had those pads for calf kicks. It's hard to train calf kicks properly elsewhere since most trainers don't have those type of pads.

The gym itself is huge and spacious. I went in the late morning hours when it was quieter with other trainers doing their private sessions. Would love to check out their group classes if I'm in the area in the future.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for the great review! 🙏

We’re glad you enjoyed your private session with Kru Bow and the technical training. He’s a fantastic trainer and always focuses on details like setups and timing.

Happy to hear you liked the calf kick pads as well — we try to provide the right equipment so fighters can train techniques properly.

Hope to see you back at Sinbi again soon, and you’re always welcome to join the group classes next time! 🥊

reviews.name: Andras Varsanyi
reviews.text: Great gym for muay thai training for all levels. Went there for a 3 day mini training camp. Morning/evening 2-hour trainings lead by an excellent staff of trainers. Good selection of equipment and great trainee to trainer ratios at reasonable prices. I am a newbie to muay thai but definitely learned many techniques and got stronger every day.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your thoughtful review! We're glad you had a great experience during your mini training camp. It’s fantastic to hear that you learned new techniques and saw progress in just a few days. We hope to see you back as you continue your Muay Thai journey!

reviews.name: Anna Kormosova
reviews.text:
The best gym in Phuket. Trainers here at Sinbi are high  level, very skilled and always happy to help you progress in Muay Thai. There is lots of quality training partners and plenty opportunities for fighting.

Highly recommending this gym. It will touch your heart I promise. If you are in Phuket is  definitely necessary visit Sinbi.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Anna,  thank you very much for taking the time to review and recommend Sinbi.  We really appreciate the positive feedback and your support.  We are very happy you enjoy training with us!

reviews.name: Sophie Jones
reviews.text: Incredible experience learning and training Muay Thai at Sinbi!!! Would rate 10/10 if I could. Came as a total beginner and did not feel out of place at all. Very grateful to have had such experienced and patient trainers. You can really push yourself hard here if you immerse yourself in the experience. 100% want to come back ❤️❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Sophie,

Thank you so much for the amazing review 🙏❤️

We’re really happy to hear you had such a great experience training with us, especially starting as a complete beginner — that’s exactly the environment we aim to create. Our trainers will be glad to hear your kind words 😊

It’s great that you pushed yourself and fully immersed in the training — that’s where the real progress happens! 💪🥊

You’re always welcome back at Sinbi, and we’d love to have you train with us again anytime.

Safe travels and see you next time ❤️

– Sinbi Muay Thai Team

reviews.name: Carlo Schuler
reviews.text: I had an amazing 10-day stay at Sinbi Muay Thai. The entire experience was incredible, and I saw significant improvement in my skills. The trainers are exceptional, and I especially want to highlight Senrak. Training with him was an absolute honor—he’s an outstanding trainer with deep knowledge and expertise. I’m already looking forward to coming back. Highly recommend Sinbi Muay Thai to anyone serious about improving their Muay Thai skills!"
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Carlo, thank you so much for the 5 star rating! We really appreciate it.  🙏🙏

reviews.name: Miranda Bravo
reviews.text:
I am relatively new to Muay Thai and cannot express how grateful I am that I got to train at Sinbi. Everyone there is so kind and the trainers helped me improve so much in my 2 months there. The gym is huge with lots of equipment and they do an excellent job of managing big classes even when there are lots of people. I really appreciate that they give the same amount of attention and care to beginners that they do to their fighters - it's easy to feel at home there 🥹
In a typical group class, you run for about 10 minutes, stretch do shadowboxing, pad work, bag work, technique and/or clinching,
conditioning (usually sit ups & push ups), and stretching again. You also have the option of sparring while others do bag work. The trainers all try to get a sense of your level and provide a great mix of feedback and energy to keep your cardio in check. Plus, every kru has their own style so it's fun to work with different people on the pads!
I also want to mention that I took several private sessions with Kru Dew and not only had so much fun every time, but also received lots of great advice and practice that helped me improve. Thank you, Dew!
Overall, I recommend Sinbi to absolutely anyone looking to learn Muay Thai for the first time or improve their skills or train professionally. It's an excellent gym that so many people choose for a reason!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Miranda, thank you so much for taking the time to rate and review us, for your detailed breakdown of what can be expected in a session and your positive feedback. We really appreciate it. We are so happy you enjoyed training with us and hope to see you again soon 🙏🙏

reviews.name: Marisa Davis
reviews.text: Great experience at Sinbi Muay Thai! I showed up for a morning group training session. I was a complete beginner and had no problem following the class. There are a lot of teachers and I had one to show me and correct all my moves at all time. All teachers are very friendly and are amazing at teaching. They are precise, patient and funny. We started with running and warming up, then some basic techniques, pair work, pad work, drills on punching bags and finished with some stretching. I enjoyed every minute of it and didn't see time fly by. I will definitely return for more sessions next time I come to Phuket!! Thank you to all the Khrus kha!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Marisa, for taking the time to rate and review and recommend us. We really appreciate your positive feedback and our very happy you enjoyed training with us  and will be coming back! See you again soon!

reviews.name: António Araújo
reviews.text:
Best place to train Muay Thai in Phuket. Great gym and training area, well organized and the coolest trainers you will find.

Been training here for the last 5 months and loving it. Family vibe with professional and qualified trainers.

Highly recommended for all levels
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review and kind words, Antonio. We are so pleased you enjoy training at our gym. We really appreciate the support!

reviews.name: Alex J.
reviews.text: The trainers are very good and nice. Plenty of space for training and good material. Unfortunately I got sick and attended only 2 days out of the week that I paid for. When I came back I asked them if I could resume my week, they said no. Also you pay for 6 days not 7. Unfortunately the owner thinks a bit too much about cash.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for your feedback, and we’re glad to hear you enjoyed the trainers, space, and facilities.

We’re sorry to hear that you were unwell during your stay and hope you’re feeling better now.

Regarding your request, our training packages are based on a fixed duration (1 week = 6 consecutive training days), as the gym is closed on Sundays. This is standard for our weekly pass.

Unfortunately, we’re not able to pause, extend, or carry over unused days. This policy is applied consistently to all guests, as we’re unable to verify individual circumstances or make exceptions on a case-by-case basis.

Like any gym or training facility, we operate with clear and consistent policies so that all customers are treated fairly.

For guests who prefer more flexibility, we offer a **10-session package**, which can be used at your own pace and is valid for 6 months.

We understand this may not have been the outcome you were hoping for, but we aim to be transparent and fair to all customers.

Thank you again for your feedback, and we do hope to welcome you back again in the future.

Kind regards,
Sinbi Muay Thai Team

reviews.name: Fion Feng
reviews.text: Muay Thai is culture , is martial arts. Sinbi Muay Thai is PEOPLE !!! I got the recommended when I was in Bangkok. Spent 2 weeks in April 2024, then come back 3 months later. As a 41 old woman, I want to fight inside the ring to get over the fear of life. The most important, I know Sinbi gym will protect me, to show everything they know to get me the victory! By end of 2024 , I made it , we made it 🥊🦾 I will see all of you soon ! ❤️ ฟีฟี
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for sharing your inspiring journey with us! We are thrilled to hear that you found a supportive community at Sinbi Muay Thai and that you felt safe and empowered during your training. Your determination to face your fears and aim for victory in the ring is truly commendable. We can’t wait to welcome you back for more training and to witness your continued progress. See you soon, ฟีฟี! 🥊❤️

reviews.name: Andres
reviews.text: Did a private session with MAD for 1000baht. Awesome trainer! Very patient, knowledgeable and friendly, great for any level of muay thai! Plenty of space and equipment, very good gym!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind review! 🙏

We’re really happy to hear you enjoyed your private session with MAD — he’ll be glad to know you appreciated his coaching. He’s a great trainer for all levels and always puts a lot of care into each session.

Great to hear you liked the space and equipment as well 💪

Hope to see you back at Sinbi again soon! 🥊

title: Isla Reformer Pilates Samui
ownerDescription:
Isla Pilates: Koh Samui’s Premier Boutique Reformer Studio

Discover the island’s only studio featuring 10 custom wooden reformers in the heart of Chaweng. At Isla Pilates, we blend the precision of classical Pilates with laid-back island luxury. Whether you are a beginner or a pro, our bilingual (English/Thai) instructors guide you through small group classes like Signature Flow, Glutes & Core, Jumpboard HIIT, and Reformer Yoga Sculpt.

We specialize in low-impact strength training to sculpt your body and calm your mind. Enjoy our air-conditioned, zen-inspired space and connect with our community.

Visit us for a drop-in class or full membership, then relax with a matcha at our on-site Isla Cafe.

Book your reformer spot today!
address: 4, Chaweng, 3rd floor, 38, Bo Put, Surat Thani 84320, Thailand
plusCode: G2PX+8G Koh Samui, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand

reviews.name: Lydia Espin
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Such a beautiful Pilates studio and café in Koh Samui. The classes were fantastic, the instructors were so welcoming and professional, and the whole space has such a lovely, relaxing atmosphere.

A special mention to Nadia, the manager, who was absolutely wonderful. She was so warm and welcoming and even took the time to play with my children, which made the whole experience feel extra special.

I also loved having the café there — the food and drinks were delicious and it was the perfect place to sit and relax after a class.

One of my favourite finds in Koh Samui and somewhere I would 100% recommend. I’ll definitely be back next time I’m on the island! 🤍

reviews.name: Elisha Jantamanee
reviews.text: Had an amazing time in Nek's class, she's so kind and the session flows perfectly with thoughtful transitions and engaging workout. Loving the environments too, and great coffee afterwards. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Wunda Stone
reviews.text: Great experience here as my first time doing pilates. I enjoyed most of the strength works as well as stretches with teacher Nek and teacher Yui. Good and consistent guidance throughout my three sessions at this beautiful studio/ cafe. The exercises are tough at times, but the entire experience is nothing but fun and rightfully challenging.

reviews.name: Liamay Kelly
reviews.text:
I did a three-pack trial class with Kru Yui, and it was genuinely the best Pilates I’ve done. She pays so much attention to detail. It was very challenging but in the right way, and it had me sweating and shaking towards the end of each class. I genuinely feel fitter after three lessons.

The Matcha downstairs is also excellent. I highly recommend this place if you are in Koh Samui!!

reviews.name: Isabelle Fausch
reviews.text:
I’ve done several classes with Nek aka Nex and she has honestly been an outstanding Pilates instructor throughout. Every class is challenging, motivating, and so enjoyable at the same time. She creates such a welcoming atmosphere and always makes everyone feel comfortable and supported, no matter your level.

I’ve genuinely loved my time at this studio — the energy, the people, and the whole experience are amazing. Also, the café is such a bonus… probably the best matcha latte I’ve had in Samui 🫶 and their workout clothes are so cute and stylish too. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a Pilates studio with great vibes, amazing instructors and a lovely community. I‘ll come back one day for sure!! 🤍🧘🏼‍♀️🫰🏻✨

reviews.name: Thananya Thamawatvimol
reviews.text: It was my first time trying Pilates. The atmosphere was great, the coffee was so good, and the instructor was excellent. Highly recommended — you should definitely come and try it!

reviews.name: C G
reviews.text:
It was my first time doing Pilates and I absolutely loved it. Teacher Nek was incredibly helpful and friendly, while also being very motivating. She guided me throughout the class in such a discreet and encouraging way that I never felt uncomfortable.

I can highly recommend this class to everyone. You can also buy cute Pilates outfits and grip socks on-site, and there’s a café downstairs. A perfect concept!

Overall, it was a 10/10 experience. Thanks again to Teacher Nek for such a wonderful session.

reviews.name: Natalia Abramova
reviews.text: A super comfortable studio with reformers — everything is beautiful and clean. Just perfect for practice, and downstairs there’s a café with delicious food and coffee. Today there was a class with a teacher Yui and she is amazing, my glutes was an fire and my body happy.

reviews.name: Natalie F
reviews.text: Wonderful studio, came for a class with Nek and she was wonderful! You can buy grip socks here too incase you don’t have them with you. 🧘‍♀️

reviews.name: Irina M
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this place for Pilates classes. Thanks to the small group sizes, the instructor has time to give personal attention to everyone. The sessions take place in a pleasant and welcoming atmosphere. The instructors are attentive, supportive, and always ready to help. I really enjoyed the classes and will definitely keep coming back. It’s a wonderful space to focus on your body and well-being.

They also have a cozy cafe downstairs where you can enjoy a coffee or tea before or after class. It makes the whole experience even nicer.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks a lot for your feedback ☀️ Isla Pilates offers professional reformer Pilates classes right in Chaweng — beginner or advanced, everyone’s welcome.

reviews.name: Pimmy Thongnoi
reviews.text: Loved the class! The studio was super cute and aesthetic, it’s perfect for a little island Pilates session. The instructor was super nice and made sure everyone felt comfortable.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks a lot for the 5 stars ☀️ Reformer Pilates at Isla Koh Samui is all about building core strength and island confidence.

reviews.name: Gamil T
reviews.text: It was my first training session with Yui, and I immediately felt comfortable. She explained everything clearly, corrected gently, and created a very positive atmosphere. I really enjoyed the class and would definitely train with her again

reviews.name: Siriwan Phlaokhunthod
reviews.text:
Tried Pilates for the first time and it honestly exceeded my expectations 🤍

At first, I thought it would just be light stretching, but it actually works your deep muscles—especially your core, back, and overall stability. You can really feel your body waking up.

The instructor was super attentive, constantly helping adjust my posture, which made the session both safe and effective. After the class, I felt lighter, more aligned, and incredibly relaxed.

If you’re looking to improve your posture, build strength, or relieve tension from sitting too long, I definitely recommend Pilates. It’s beginner-friendly and suitable for all levels.

reviews.name: Damon Don
reviews.text: Went for my first pilates session with Teacher Nek! She is very patient and helpful with me, making the exercises enjoyable yet kinda strenuous at the same time. I had a really great time with my loved ones here. Will definitely come again when I’m back in Samui.

reviews.name: Ambre
reviews.text: I had such a wonderful experience during this beach yoga class this morning. Practicing yoga by the sea was absolutely magical, and the atmosphere was calm and uplifting. The instructor was incredibly kind, welcoming, and attentive, making everyone feel comfortable no matter their level. I truly enjoyed every moment and left feeling relaxed, energized, and happy. I would 100% recommend this class to anyone looking for a special and peaceful yoga experience.

reviews.name: Tatiana Fedoseeva
reviews.text: I really like this studio! Great workouts. I work from home and «Stretch and Restore” classes are just wonderful for me. Teacher Nek is beautiful

reviews.name: Olejkowa Szkoła & Sklep
reviews.text: Very good pilates classes and the most amazing avo toast I’ve had!

reviews.name: Jessica Stückler
reviews.text: I’m very happy with the studio and the variety of classes offered. I always feel comfortable and welcomed, both in the studio and during the sunrise beachfront yoga sessions. Such a beautiful and calming experience.

reviews.name: Ola Speelman
reviews.text: Very relaxing place and cute studio. After having tried pilates reformer all over the world I will say it’s quite pricey for what it is . Classes are not consistent - meaning let’s say on one leg we did 4 types of exercise and then on the other we did 3..:: not the end of the world bit for the prize  i expected bit more …. No hints on how to align springs for beginners or more advanced participants. Etc . But overall nice experience , no regrets. Just at this prize point and for much less You can find better trainings ( in my opinion) but maybe not in such nice and clean facilities.

reviews.name: Sian McKechnie
reviews.text: Class was meant to start at 10am, instructor didn’t arrive until 10:10am and then proceeded to take 10 minutes to set up the reformers. As an instructor myself, the cueing wasn’t consistent and some of the techniques were being taught incorrectly. Lovely studio but there are tweaks that need to be made.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello Sian, the class you booked today was 10:20am, not 10am. (you can check the online schedule that will confirm it)

Which is the reason why the teacher arrived at 10:10am.

Which means you just arrived earlier 🙏🏽

We hope to see you again at our studio

title: Bangkok Fight Lab - Jiu-Jitsu MMA & Muay Thai
subTitle: Bangkok Fight Lab
description: Spacious training facility offering traditional boxing & Muay Thai classes, plus a plant-based cafe.
ownerDescription: Bangkok Fight Lab is Bangkok's leading BJJ and MMA gym, located near On Nut BTS on Sukhumvit Soi 50. Led by Morgan Perkins, a Pedro Sauer 3rd degree black belt with 30 years experience, we offer Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (Gi & No-Gi), MMA, Muay Thai, Western Boxing, and Kids BJJ. Our coaches are active competitors and champions. We welcome beginners, hobbyists, competitors, expats, and visitors. Team Pedro Sauer affiliate.
address: 137 Sukhumvit 50 Aly, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 102600, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:

We're proud to announce that Zhang has been promoted to Brown Belt in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.

Zhang has been an integral part of the Bangkok Fight Lab family — not only as a dedicated competitor and training partner, but as a coach who gives back to the next generation through our Kids BJJ program. His son Elliott trains alongside him, which says everything about the culture he represents.

reviews.name: Hyunseok Oh
reviews.text:
Tyler is a very experienced grappler.
He is also very kind and has excellent technical knowledge and teaching ability.

I trained with him every day for about 10 days, and I improved a lot during that time.
I’ll definitely visit again as soon as possible.

The gym members are also very kind, and the gym feels very safe to train in.
The owner and the front desk staff are very kind and welcoming as well.

Thank you so much!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the kind words!

reviews.name: Xavier Arnau Martinez (Xavi)
reviews.text: Our kid joined BJJ classes 6 months ago and we're pretty happy with it so far. Besides the great physical activity and confidence-building aspects of BJJ, he's also found it's a fantastic way for kids to stay focused while learning techniques and internalizing foundational discipline. Classes are three times a week with never less than 2 coaches for a group ( many days are 4) of 10-14 kids. The gym has its own parking lot for 5-7 cars, which is super convenient when coming from school. The pricing is reasonable too.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Xavi. We really enjoy having your son on the mat training with us and he is making good progress!

reviews.name: Gav Diskin
reviews.text:
Bangkok Fight Lab is one of the top martial arts gyms in Bangkok—whether you’re a beginner, serious competitor, or just looking to stay fit, this place has it all.

The Gi Jiu-Jitsu classes are led by a black belt under Pedro Sauer, offering world-class instruction with a solid traditional foundation. For No-Gi, Coach Tyler (a black belt under Craig Jones) delivers outstanding classes—he’s highly skilled and breaks down techniques in a way that’s easy to understand and apply, regardless of your experience level.

The gym also offers Muay Thai classes that are beginner-friendly, but for those looking to compete, they can even help you arrange fights in Bangkok. On top of that, the MMA classes are taught by an experienced coach who’s had numerous high-level fights, making this a true one-stop gym for all things combat sports.

A great bonus is the free ice bath sessions every Tuesday and Friday, which are perfect for recovery. The gym also has kids’ Jiu-Jitsu classes, making it a great environment for families.

The receptionist is always friendly and helpful, creating a welcoming vibe from the moment you walk in. You can also purchase training attire and gear on-site, which is super convenient.

And after training, don’t miss the lovely woman just outside selling delicious, refreshing drinks—the perfect way to cool down.

Located just 5 minutes from On Nut BTS, Bangkok Fight Lab is convenient, professional, and community-oriented. Highly recommended for anyone looking to train in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much for the kind words Gav!

reviews.name: Kay Sureerat
reviews.text: This place is not just about teaching kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ). I chose this academy for my child because the coaches don't teach them that winning is the only thing that matters. Instead, they encourage the kids to always give their best, while helping them develop the mindset of martial arts and apply its values to everyday life
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Kay!

reviews.name: Lee Moran
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Bangkok Fight Lab and its owner, Morgan. I originally applied for the Destination Thailand Visa (DTV) through the Los Angeles Embassy, which required a Sports Authority of Thailand (SAT) gym document. At the time, Fight Lab did not have this certification.

Morgan went above and beyond to help me. Knowing I was traveling soon, he immediately referred me to another gym so I wouldn’t lose time. At the same time, he personally went to the SAT and secured the required certification within just two days. On top of that, he refunded me the full 30,000 baht without hesitation.

This level of integrity, professionalism, and dedication is rare. Even though I couldn’t train at Fight Lab this time, Morgan’s reputation and the way he handled the situation make me want to return and train at his gym in the future. Highly recommended for anyone serious about Muay Thai and looking for a trustworthy gym in Thailand.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the review Lee and hope to see you in 6 months!  😀

reviews.name: Tyler Adorno
reviews.text: If you need to train while in BKK, just do yourself the favor and come here. Great international gym with solid guys. Honorable mentions to coach Tyler and Detch. They always put on great classes
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much Tyler!

reviews.name: Joseph Daly
reviews.text: This was an amazing experience training here as a visitor. BJJ morning class was taught by Johnny and was top notch. Muay Thai class was taught by Daniel and others. The instruction for both classes was very detailed and also a ton of fun! The owner Morgan makes the place so welcoming to visitors. Highly recommend training at Bangkok fight lab!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Was very nice meeting you Joe! Thanks for the review and see you again soon!

reviews.name: AYE-1 DV
reviews.text:
I first walked threw the door at Bangkok Fight Lab in Nov 2023. I’ve had some time to put some thought into this review so here it goes....

I’ve read alot of “Muay Thai” Gym reviews since my first time in Thailand. A Lot of the reviews claim the same thing, That the gym being reviewed is “THE BEST IN THAILAND!” They May be right! I’m not going to make that claim about BFL! I just want to make it clear why I chose BFL over most other gyms in Bangkok, I’ve trained at several!

BFL in mind is the “Total Package!” for combat sports training! I didn’t know where to train when i was planning my trip. I was looking for somewhere that had Jiu Jitsu as well as Muay Thai! I think i found BFL via a google search. I figured I’d give them a shot for a week and if I didn’t like it, I’d just move on to the next gym! I’m a bit paticular when it comes to being coached and i had no clue how my first week of training would go! I was first greeted by Professor Morgan and to my suprise, he spoke English and is from America. I liked him immediatly, first impression! I do believe he’s the owner. You might also be greeted by Tong at the front desk, he’s super nice and speaks English and is a native Thai!

What I like alot about BFL is the eclectic coaching staff! I’ll break down what I mean about The BJJ instructors first, then I’ll give you my thoughts on the Muay Thai coaches...

Professor Morgan is the head BJJ instructor and I personally think he’s a bit brilliant! He’s very personable & laid back as a coach! I think he has a smooth but stern coaching style and he’s funny at times as well. Which is a good thing, It makes the atmosphere of the gym more relaxing. You feel like you’re actually learning something when you take Morgans class! He reminds me of a Jedi in a few ways, like the force is with him and he’s very mindfull of the way he teaches!

Professor Colin on the other hand is a bit rougher around the edges! He’s a MAN’S MAN! A bit of an original roughneck! I dig that in a Coach! Collin really knows his Bjj! Right when you think he’s not paying attention to what your doing, he seems to chime in with laser like focus and corrects you on what your doing wrong! He’s very professional and in my opinion.. “REAL!” He’s SOLID! Ya Know what I’m saying???

Professor Tyler is the No-Gi instructor and he’s just plain awesome! He’s like your chill older brother! Probably one of the “VERY BEST” No-Gi instructors in the world! This guy talks the talk and walks the walk! He’s really good at breaking everything down clearly and concisely, whether you’re a beginer or more experienced! He really takes the time to instruct you and help you grow as a Bjj Practitioner!

As far as the Muay Thai Coaching goes..

First I want to say, They don’t speak English at all, really! But they all know how to teach Muay Thai! Theres usually an English speaking regular that helps assist the coaches too! I don’t know all their names off the top of my head. The Bjj Instructors names are easier to remember! The class usually starts with 5 min stretching, followed by 10 min jumping rope and then rounds with the Coaches on pads and bag work, followed by sparring. I think the coaches are excellent at building what techniques they will have you train based on your skill level! These guys know what they're doing! Some days you will be training new techniques with a partner, It just depends on what day you’re there!

Side note, I haven’t taken any of the MMA Classes but I assure you.. they are just as good as the BJJ & Muay Thai Classes!

So I hope this review helps you if you’re trying to decide if BFL is worth your while or not! I’m not saying it’s the best gym in Thailand. But it sure ranks up there in my humble opinion!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We still miss you!

reviews.name: Jordan Thompson
reviews.text:
Bangkok Fight Lab is a great gym with a friendly and welcoming atmosphere.The gym is clean, professional and clearly well cared for.

The trainers are very kind and enthusiastic. I would reccomend Bangkok Fight Lab for both beginners and serious professional fighters.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Jordan! Glad you're enjoying it.

reviews.name: Pele
reviews.text:
Bangkok Fight Lab holds a special place in my heart.
It taught me what it means to be truly passionate about something—to dedicate yourself to it, to trust others, and to treat people with kindness.

Bangkok Fight Lab is a place for personal growth, and a place where you can meet people who eventually feel like family.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I really miss you Pele

reviews.name: El Dorado
reviews.text: Great gym with a nice mix of classes. Jui jitsu, muay thai, no gi jui jitsu, mma, and a western boxing class. They have class morning until night on almost everyday. The owner and teachers are very friendly. For the money  you can't beat the monthly membership whether it's striking or all of the classes combined. Great way to get in shape or just up your game.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Glad you enjoyed training with us!

reviews.name: David Vergel
reviews.text:
Phenomenal gym with an outstanding culture and community. You’ll find practitioners of all levels here, from brand new students to active competitors.

All the coaches are fantastic. Tyler breaks down advanced no-gi techniques into simple, digestible steps. Morgan’s gi classes are packed with essential concepts, and Detch’s MMA class will sharpen your reactions and push your conditioning to the next level.

They also have some very notable drop ins from time to time
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Was great having you train with us David!

reviews.name: J E
reviews.text: Bangkok Fight Lab is a must visit if you're in Bangkok. Nogi classes with Tyler are awesome as he does a great job conveying the technique to students. He truly cares about the progression of his students. The striking classes are also awesome with great coaches. Dont forget to grab a tea from the tea lady outside!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you JE!

reviews.name: Krystle Phillips
reviews.text:
I absolutely love this gym. I've been a somewhat good student for about 4 months lol.

There is something about the energy of the place. The coaches, the students even the person that greets you.

It's an entirely wholesome experience.

Don't let my words make you think the training is easy. They meet you where you are yes but they push you. I always leave spent and happy.

I've never done Muay Thai before and this gym. This gym! Made me fall in love with the discipline. Let me put it this way I'm moving from the area and one of the first things on the list to my relator is how far is it from MY gym :)

Notable mention the Ice Baths. A must try. I did 5 minutes and I'm bragging
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for training with us !

reviews.name: Rapee-arpa Nidhi-u-tai
reviews.text: I initially came to watch my boyfriend train and was immediately impressed by how attentive and encouraging the first coach was. I even brought two friends to try a class, and though it was a different coach that day, he was equally fantastic and supportive. What truly stands out is how friendly and welcoming everyone is – from the coaches to the other students, there's a genuine sense of community and encouragement. I felt so comfortable and motivated! Can't wait to register for my own membership soon!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Gus Reeves
reviews.text:
BFL is the best place to train Jiu Jitsu in Bangkok! Very high level coaching for both Gi, and No-Gi, and they also provide great fundamental classes for beginners as well. My skill improved exponentially since I started training there. About 8 months ago I was very close to brand new to the sport, and a couple weeks ago I did well in a competition! I couldn’t have done it without Morgan (Gi instructor) and Tyler (No-Gi instructor). Not only because of the training but also their ability to corner during competition. They both pointed out things in my matches at very critical moments that I was able to capitalize on.
On top of this, BFL has a great gym culture! I got to know a lot of good people there. I will miss training there and hopefully be back soon!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We will miss you a lot, Gus!!

reviews.name: Sam BG
reviews.text: I trained here for a month and loved it. I did BJJ and Muay Thai and it was brilliant. I was a bit lost in Muay Thai since there is no clear order or instructions given. So it is very confusing for anyone new and even a few classes in I had to ask other team members what we needed to do now since this wasn’t really communicated. But the coaches were great. I had one who usually had a Chelsea vest top on who was such much fun to train with. Overall my experience here was so good and I hope I can come back someday.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the review, Sam. Glad you enjoed training here.

reviews.name: Ralf Sannikov
reviews.text:
The best place to train! Many super good coaches so you will get a lot of 1:1 time.

The people training there are warm and intelligent. Soft sparring for technique is playful and fun, so no need to worry about injuries.

You will be pushed but not broken. 💪

Love the place and people. My only regret is not joining sooner. 😄

See you next year! 🙏🙇‍♂️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for training with us!

reviews.name: Ibb Alam
reviews.text: Great place, awesome coaches and top notch people. Been training here since mid January 2026, I'm a complete newbie to BJJ and No Gi, loving every class! Highly recommend it here whether you're here for a short or longer time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It’s great having you here, Ibb. Thank you!

reviews.name: Sal Ali
reviews.text:
Train here regularly when visiting Bangkok. I have visited dozens of combat gyms across the world and would easily reccommend this gym.

The staff and instructors are welcoming with open arms and make sure each student is attended to at an individual manner. The muay thai training is authentic, the mma classes, and grappling classes are engaging and fun. Few gyms strike the balance of foreigner friendly/thai feeling as well as BFL.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Sal 🙏

title: Pradara Thai Massage
subTitle: Pradara Thai Massage Phetchaburi 15
address: 2, 6-7 Soi Phetchaburi 15, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

reviews.name: nuevo
reviews.text:
This massage parlor has many branches nearby, but I really liked this one.

The staff at the counter were friendly, and there were many skilled massage therapists.

The environment was clean and quiet. There was also an elevator to different floors, which was a great barrier-free space for customers.

I highly recommend this massage parlor.

reviews.name: The Traveller
reviews.text:
Pradara Thai Massage is a nice place to stop by and relax, especially after a long day of walking. The environment was comfortable and suitable for unwinding.

However, the therapist’s skill was just average and didn’t quite meet my expectations. I was hoping for a better massage experience, so it was a bit disappointing.

Overall, it’s an okay place for a quick massage, but there is room for improvement.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your comment. However, from the picture you posted, we want to let you know that you posted on the wrong branch. We would really appreciated if you could remove your comments and post on the right branch. This will allow the appropriate management team to investigate what happened and address your concerns directly with the staff involved. Thank you.

reviews.name: tan lok qian
reviews.text:
I’ve been getting manicures and pedicures for years, but this was the first time I truly felt how dedicated and professional a nail technician could be.

I had a wound on my heel, and without me even asking, she carefully cleaned it with alcohol, applied medication, and covered it with a plaster. She was incredibly patient while scrubbing away the dead skin and trimming my side nails gently to make sure I was comfortable.

When painting my nails, she went over them several times, checking every detail to make sure the finish was perfect. You can really tell that she’s not just doing her job—she genuinely cares about her clients and takes pride in her work.

I’m so impressed with her professionalism, patience, and attention to detail. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be coming back! Her name is ‘’Boom’’ , highly recommend

reviews.name: S R C
reviews.text: Beautiful and relaxing. The wonderful ladies took out all the aches and pains and gave my husband and I a fantastic Thai facial. Post massage with a cup of tea surrounded by serenity. What a stunning way to end a 5 day trip to Bangkok. A must do before catching a flight 👍🏻

reviews.name: Xiao Zhu
reviews.text:
Saw so many content creator recommended this place. It's okay, not bad but I don't get the hype. The massage pressure is not that strong compared to other places.

But 2 things I like about this place: First, their staff is not sitting outside calling people on the street so it feel more safe and less pressure to walk by. Second, they accept other payment method besides cash which most place are only accept cash so it's very helpful for us the cashless people.

reviews.name: Pippa Kassim
reviews.text: Had an amazing foot massage after walking for hours in pratunam. Worth the price!

reviews.name: Derrick Chew
reviews.text:
Soi 15 Pratunam
Visited on 26 and 28, and was served by masseur, Toey, on foot and full body massage respectively.
Toey was friendly and cheerful, and she provided wonderful massage. Her strength is excellence.

reviews.name: Vin Kway
reviews.text:
I took the 90-minute aroma full body massage (950 baht), but unfortunately the experience wasn’t great. The massage pressure was too soft and didn’t target the areas I needed, even after I mentioned it. The leg pre-wash was also not done properly.

Overall, I left feeling disappointed and felt the service didn’t match the price.

reviews.name: Tiana Lau
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I did a 2-hour head, shoulder, and neck massage. I was attended by Puff and my boyfriend by Eid ，both had amazing pressure. They didn’t just do a standard massage; they really knew our pain points and focused on them. 100% recommended, and we’ll definitely be back for them! ❤️

reviews.name: benny daniel
reviews.text: The worst massage I've ever had in Thailand. Felt like the masseuse had no idea what to do, like it was her first time. Unprofessional to say the least. The place is noisy, full of talking and giggling. No relaxed atmosphere. Waste of time and money.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are sincerely sorry for the unpleasant experience .We will take on your comments and inform our team immediately regarding this situation. Again, we sincerely sorry again and will use your feedback to improve our service and ensure a better experience for our customers in the future.

reviews.name: Wong Shwu Chyi
reviews.text:
Very disappointed with the massage service. The masseur was clearly cutting corners and only used one simple technique throughout the whole session. Other customers received full service including massage on the toes, foot sole, calves, and acupressure using the wooden stick, but for me she only massaged the toes and upper part of the calves.

I even asked why the wooden stick wasn’t used, and she replied, “You want ah?” This is supposed to be a full set service, not something customers need to request one by one. After I mentioned it was included in the package, she only used it briefly just for show.

Overall felt very unfair and unprofessional compared to the service others received.

reviews.name: Arun A
reviews.text:
Got back, neck, shoulder, foot massage for 350 bhat/1 hour.
It was MINDBLOWING. I highly recommend this place.

Extremely skillful masseuse, who gave one of the best back massages I've had ever. Used both her forearm & elbow skillfully to clear the bad stress of carrying 10kg backpack from my back.

I will visit this place again before I depart Bangkok. Feel Very relaxed and ecstatic after the massage.

Hot stone therapy for your back also provided for 10 mins at the end.

Do not miss this massage in this place!!

reviews.name: Ken Wong
reviews.text:
One of the best Massage shop in Bangkok and recommend to have a try.

Great interior atmosphere, friendly staff with good massage skill, clear price and friendly owner.

reviews.name: Thomas Lim
reviews.text:
One of the best Thai massages along the street. Friendly boss at the counter and professional masseurs, their skill is tiptop and I feel refreshed after the 1 hour foot massage session.

1 hour foot massage starts from 250 baht and they will free a short hot stone session end of the massage, highly recommended!

reviews.name: Hooi yoong Khor
reviews.text: Very disappointed. Been here last year and repeat again today. May be bad luck. Their service and skill not good as before. Feel waste time. Just like rubbing …🥲🥲🥲 request for hard massage but still same no improvement in strength. Really disappointed. Don’t think will revisit again.

reviews.name: J T
reviews.text: Recommended by a lot of travellers. And it’s not disappointing. No more happy hour but it’s 500baht for two hours Thai massage. The lady is strong that I wished for even tho she’s tired. Can pay by card but not Amex with 3% surcharge. The whole process is fast. Free ginger tea at the end.

reviews.name: Aaron Gan
reviews.text:
I chose the 1-hour full body package for 950 Thai Baht because I wanted to try it out. However, I was very disappointed with the experience. Throughout the entire session, it felt like they were just touching me, and there was no sense of relief or comfort at all.

Also, the session was supposed to be a full-body massage for 1 hour, but only my feet and shoulders were attended to—my back wasn’t even properly massaged.

reviews.name: The Traveller
reviews.text: Worse massager ever !!! I choose 1.5 hr fullbody massage with aroma oil it turn out disaster !! The masseur around 50yrs old above really dont know how to massage no pressure but only hard rubbing. Told her little pressure but she cant understand english, in the end i did not do 1.5 hrs but just end at 1 hr. Very very waste of money...if u all believe those good review then good luck

reviews.name: Faisal Abdulla
reviews.text: The other branch facing the main street next to 100 baht shop has the worst massage ever, the Massager is so thin and her hands it's like knife I told her to make soft message but her finger bones are going through my body, she even didn't complete the whole message she didn't do my chest part. Really bad message I don't really recommend👎

reviews.name: monmon mendoza
reviews.text: Clean, nice ambiance spa. Service is good and affordable. Thai Massage & Foot massage only 500bhat.

title: Pai Spa
address: 156 Ram Buttri Aly, Talardyod, Phanakorn, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

reviews.name: Carlos Diaz
reviews.text: This was my first massage in Bangkok and I was very impressed. As soon as we walked in we were taken care of. The staff are very nice and try to work with what you need. They took their time with the massage, and it didn’t feel rushed at all. The tea they offer is just fine. Didn’t expect a meal or anything. But overall very happy with their service and I’d recommend it to anyone coming to Thailand.

reviews.name: Antonio Galvez Ortega
reviews.text:
There was no privacy during  the Massage, the curtain was opened with more people next to each other, because of this I could feel the  air conditioning on maximum power so you feel really freezing , I told the masseur 5 times to close the courtain but he kept opening it. No relaxing at all, you very very uncomfortable.
On top of that, has been the worst massage I have ever had in Thailand , no Thai technique, very simple with no effort, for me is not professional.
This is my third time in Thailand , and I don’t recommend this place if you really want to experience a nice Thai massage.

reviews.name: Mohamad Maraghy
reviews.text:
one of the best spa and massage places in bangkok
the stuff are friendly and welcoming you kindly
the service is perfect and clean
the place is so nice and seems luxury
i have body scrub and aroma therapy massage
the prices are high from other places because they offer high services with excellent quality materials
you can ask for private room for extra 100baht with shower and towels and robe

reviews.name: Rick Dumont
reviews.text: We had an outstanding one hour couples massage here courtesy of the Old Capital Bike Inn. Very clean and comfortable.

reviews.name: Ye Wang
reviews.text: I like strong massage. Best thai traditional massage I have ever had. Don’t do those cheap ones outside, go to this one and it worths every minute and every penny and I gave a big tip!

reviews.name: Denis Nudel
reviews.text:
Great Thai massage among a bunch of very low quality establishments on that street.
Only experienced the same quality in Chiang Mai.
Nowhere in Bangkok or Phuket could find anything comparable (price & quality).

reviews.name: Bangrui Chen
reviews.text: Good deal! 3hour 3800 for two people :) quiet and lovely place, friendly staff and excellent service.

reviews.name: Maxwell Dowe
reviews.text:
After 28 hours of travel, my group and I visited this spa, and it was truly the best massage experience of our lives. The hospitality and professionalism were unparalleled. From the stunning decor and thoughtfully designed interiors to the impeccable cleanliness and relaxing atmosphere, everything was a perfect 10/10.

The staff were incredibly kind, highly skilled, and epitomized true hospitality. As for the massages themselves—absolutely transformative. Every muscle in my body was expertly worked, leaving me feeling completely renewed and revitalized.

Do yourself a favor and book an appointment—you won’t regret it!

reviews.name: Dzina
reviews.text: Great experience, everything was clean, fast and clear. Staff was friendly, professional and fun- we had few laughs:) Definitely would recommend if you prefer more intimate, quiet massage rather than the one on the street

reviews.name: Security_Chick Doncaster
reviews.text: Excellent service in a calming and professional atmosphere. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a proper Thai massage, this is not a ‘feel good’ street service, this is proper treatment.

reviews.name: Gabriel Huang
reviews.text: What an experience! Set in a historic 140 year old building, that is clean and pristine inside with beautiful wood decor. Thai traditional massage was excellent, hitting all the points with great pressure, controlled and gently moving with time. The teas served before and after tasted great too! This is worth a visit. Thanks!!

reviews.name: Camille Daux
reviews.text:
Very nice place, clean inside. I went twice, they offered tea and the staff was very friendly.
The first time I got a foot massage and I found it was a bit weak but maybe its supposed to be or it was the masseuse?
The second time, I got the Thai massage and it was the perfect amount of intense! The good thing is that the masseuse really cater to you, my friend next to me is a lot more sensitive than I am and the masseuse noticed it thus she got a bit of a different massage.
The staff is very nice and friendly, it's a bit more expensive than the other massage parlours on the street but it's worth the price.

reviews.name: Sabrina Almighty
reviews.text: You get what you pay for, and Pai Spa is worth every penny. I've been here for the first time many years ago. I love that the place hasn't changed a bit. The staff is very welcoming and professional, the facility clean and well maintained. I also like that they ask for medical conditions and preferences (mild, moderate, strong massage, and areas the massage giver should avoid) at check-in. Pai Spa is definitely among the best massage places I've been to.

reviews.name: Jessie Busuttil
reviews.text:
Thank you to masseuses Jit and Ae for the great experience at Pai Spa.

We had no booking and were catered for immediately, the spa is a typical old Thai house and very beautiful, we had the couples East meets west package and it surely didn’t disappoint.

reviews.name: Reese Pan
reviews.text: aroma therapy is not professional. When we were showering the staff were pushing all the time. worst message in Thailand. Despite the back pain they occurred, they lack of time and attitude is so so, they are in a rush. Watch your wallet too. After message they give you tea no cookies even poorer than some small shop. No welcome at all. Watch your wallet.

reviews.name: Michael Wenzel
reviews.text: For myself the best massage what I get in Thailand till now. Stuff are really friendly and also at the massage the have the feeling for customers. Price are higher as in the rest of the area here but I found this was 100% ok for me. Also the atmosphere are nice totally for relaxing. Nice rooms really clean. We will come again.

reviews.name: Kelsey Ray
reviews.text: This place is an oasis near Khaosan Road. I absolutely love it! Beautiful old building, professional and skilled staff - all for the same pricing as a standard massage parlor. Definitely go here! I come here for a traditional Thai massage every time I'm in Bangkok. Thank you!

reviews.name: Paul Johns
reviews.text: This was a wonderful experience. My wife and I selected the doubles package for foot bath, massage and facial. While the first and last were good, the massage was excellent! I selected the firm massage and was stretched and maneuvered to my limits, my masseuse actually walked on me! In any case. When all said and done, the price was reasonable, the atmosphere calming and the building beautiful. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.name: Sailesh Shankar
reviews.text: Recommended by Ayothorn Bangkok reception and it was worth the visit. Had a couples 90 min massage. Neat and tidy place and quiet.

reviews.name: Xsenia Demmi
reviews.text:
An amazing experience, massage ladies know what they are doing for sure.
And atmosphere in the salon is very nice.
Thank you

ownerDescription:
Muaythai shorts, Customize muaythai shorts &
Equipment
address: 28/3-4 ถ. ช้างคลาน ตำบล ช้างม่อย เมือง เชียงใหม่ 50100 เมือง Chiang Mai 50000, Thailand
street: 28/3-4 ถ. ช้างคลาน ตำบล ช้างม่อย เมือง เชียงใหม่ 50100
plusCode: Q2P2+J7 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: K1 Brate
reviews.text: Great Muay Thai shop with super friendly staff and really helpful advice. Huge selection of gear, and I got a hand-embroidered custom pair of Muay Thai shorts that turned out amazing. You can tell they really care about quality and the sport. Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.name: Gaby [Apasolento_Viajes]
reviews.text:
I was looking for Muay Thai shorts as for a friend who asked me to get them. First, I checked the street market, where prices range between 300–400 THB (the more touristy, budget versions).

Then I found this shop and wow, the difference in quality was immediately noticeable. It’s a specialized store with a great selection of designs and many sizes available. Prices start around 900 THB (at least for the shorts I liked).

You can also customize them by adding your name for an extra 300 THB, but it takes about 2 days. Since I was leaving the city and didn’t have time, I bought them without customization.

The staff was very friendly and patient, helping me choose the right size and find the design I wanted.
Whether you’re a Muay Thai enthusiast or a professional, you’ll definitely find what you’re looking for here. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Aukje Nutma
reviews.text: This shop is amazing! They offer a ton of different Muay Thai gear, and it is way better than all the crap you find on the market. I got customized shorts, and the guy who owns the shop is so sweet he really works with you to make your perfect shorts. Great customer service too! I wasn't able to pick up my shorts in time, so the owner actually took the effort to personally bring them to my hostel. Had an awesome experience, would definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Tee Morrissey
reviews.text:
This is by far the best place to go to get shorts customised. The staff are lovely, very friendly, professional and extremely prompt with their services.

They have a great range of Muay Thai gear at competitive prices, I wish I knew about this place earlier and I’ll be coming back to get more pairs of shorts customised.

reviews.name: El
reviews.text:
Could not recommend this shop and owner more! He was so helpful in assisting us with correct sizing and accommodating our preference in style of Muay Thai shorts.

The selection was great and was all really affordable too.

We both ended up going for some custom Thaikla shorts - the stores own brand. We got to customise our names in Thai, choose the colour and design and the lovely owner is even shipping this to our address in Pai for us.

Such great service, definitely check this place out if you're looking for training gear as this place isn't short of options!!

reviews.name: พัฒน์ชลีภรณ์ โพธิกุลชัย
reviews.text: All muaythai gears is here! 🇹🇭🥊 You can even design your own shorts. So, If you want to training muaythai, We also have gym too @thaiklamuaythaigym 🔥

reviews.name: Gilbert Darmawan
reviews.text: Nice shop, staffs are very friendly, good service and decent selections, for gloves they have fairtex twins and infight style, visit them when you’re in chiang mai

reviews.name: jesse leinhardt
reviews.text: The workers are so nice we designed two pairs for a good price and got them in two days I highly recommend definitely a must when your in Thailand training

reviews.name: D. H.
reviews.text: A very good shop with a really nice owner. The prices are very good and they offer the option of having MUAY THAI shorts individually embroidered. The result is very high quality. The shorts can be shipped all over the world if required. I would buy equipment from this shop again at any time
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you 🙏

reviews.name: Ben Gonzales
reviews.text: I’ve come to this shop multiple times to get Muay Thai shorts customized for my friends back home. Noom does an excellent job taking the time during the consultation to get what you want exactly right. I highly recommend this place for customizing your shorts.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you 🙏

reviews.name: Saxík
reviews.text: Really nice and friendly place, where you can make your own Thai-Box custom made shorts. I made 9x pieces for my gym. Materials are TOP quality, even fit of shorts. Highly highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you 🙏

reviews.name: Tyler Garay
reviews.text: Just received my custom shorts, they fit and feel fantastic. The cut is very nice, everything was made exactly as described. I couldn’t be more satisfied. Shipping took only 3 days to reach the US, came just in time for my fight. Communication was super easy, and they’re very kind! I’m very satisfied. Thank you so much!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much

reviews.name: Zachary Oliveira
reviews.text: Amazing place! It’s nice that they have alot of gear in stock that you can try for size. Big selection of shorts including customizable ones. The owner is very knowledgeable, speaks good English. Best prices around!

reviews.name: Tess Ngu
reviews.text: I came around 8 and he was very accommodating as I had to call my friend to see the sizes! Lots of colors and designs ❤️

reviews.name: Edwin Chiam
reviews.text: Love this shop and the owner, friendly and knows his stuff well. Good amount of brands like fairtex and primo including Thai Kla which I bought a pair of Muay Thai Shorts. The prices are competitive and if you are in the area and is looking for Muay Thai stuff, this is the shop to go for.

reviews.name: Doris Deng
reviews.text: Such a good shop! My friend just bought a pair of boxing gloves, so good to use. Now I come to buy another pair. The owner is enthusiastic. Customers can try and feel the products here

reviews.name: Josh Cowper
reviews.text: Incredible service and amazing staff, they customised my shorts perfectly to the design I wanted in time for my fight

reviews.name: Lukas Steipe
reviews.text:
This shop came highly recommended by several friends, and for good reason! Just the absolutely nicest owner, and great selection of gear with very good prices. They can also make custom shorts with pretty much anything you want, and the quality is amazing. 10/10, definitely check them out!
Update: The shorts came out UNBELIEVABLY good. I am absolutely blown away by what they were able to do with the colours and custom patches! To say they are exactly what I wanted would be an understatement.

reviews.name: Alex Herchen
reviews.text:
Exceptional Quality and Service - A Must-Visit for Any Muay Thai Enthusiast!

As someone from Canada who’s passionate about mma, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience at this Muay Thai shop. From the moment I walked in, I was blown away by the broad selection of high-quality gear.

I had custom Muay Thai shorts made and was thrilled with the outcome. Not only were the prices excellent for the quality provided, but the custom designs were also available quickly. The level of craftsmanship and attention to detail exceeded my expectations.

The owners, Piboy and his wife, are fantastic! They’re extremely helpful and accommodating, ensuring you leave with exactly what you need. Their customer service is truly unparalleled.

If you’re in the market for Muay Thai gear, don’t miss out on this gem. I couldn’t be more satisfied and highly recommend this shop to anyone, whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned pro.

reviews.name: Mikhael Bagdasarov
reviews.text:
Best store on Chiang Mai for muay thai equipment!!!
Very professional staff! Piboy is the best - gave me the exact and most honest information.
Also, the best prices you will find!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you
