reviews.name: STACEY CUELLAR
reviews.text:
If you’re coming to Bangkok to learn Muay Thai, this is the place.
I trained here for over a month with no prior experience, and the coaches focus heavily on proper technique and fundamentals, which helped me progress quickly. They truly care about your development, no matter your level.
I couldn’t have found a better place to train and fall in love with Muay Thai. I completed my Level 1 certification through intensive training, attending group classes with the unlimited package.
Now I’m honestly sad to leave, but grateful I found Master O’s gym. He’s an incredible person, just like the entire team and the students who train here.
Highly recommend this gym to anyone serious about learning Muay Thai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you krub. We will miss you too.

reviews.name: Filippo Dattola
reviews.text:
I cannot praise this place enough.
Master O and his team are AMAZING!!! The focus on correct technique, the familiar atmosphere, and the personal attention each student gets make this gym incredible. The coaches cover all generations (15-60 years), are extremely knowledgeable and most of them speak English really well.
Thank you so much, Master 🙏🙏🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review and we hope to train with you again soon krub.

reviews.name: Thomas Tattersall
reviews.text: This is a great gym with very talented and friendly trainers. The gym feels very welcoming to fighters of all levels. Master O is so nice and accommodating both inside and outside the gym. He helped me and my friends get Sak Yant and accompanied us through the whole process.

reviews.name: jesse patterson
reviews.text:
An amazing gym ran by the wonderful & caring Master O. He has an equally great staff, all of who that generally care about your progress and pace the training to your specific needs.

I highly recommend it here for new comers who want to try something new or for passionate fighters getting ready for a match.

All of you will be missed by us and very much looking forward to the next time we come back to train Krub!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you krub.  We enjoy have you here too.

reviews.name: Michael S
reviews.text:
Great training with a real focus on technique — not like the commercial Muay Thai gyms in Bangkok or the islands.

Tremendous team — big thanks to Master O, Ohm, Ajarn Korn, Kru M, Pete and Pooh!

Really welcoming, warm atmosphere — they looked after both me and my sister from the start.

If you want to learn Muay Thai the proper way, this is the spot. Forget everything else — just great people. Lots of love 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We glad that you have a good time training here.

reviews.name: Faraj G
reviews.text: Welcoming and friendly environment for all different levels and skills of Muay Thai, from beginners to experienced. I learned a lot from my sessions with the team, who taught in detail the different techniques and areas of improvements for myself. The team here is all experienced, knowledgeable and patient with their clients. Highly recommended place to learn and improve whatever your skill set is. I will do the sessions again once I’m back in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review and we hope to see you again soon krub.

reviews.name: Inka Tila
reviews.text: Trained here for the semester I spent studying in Thailand, and loved every single workout! Very experienced, considerate and knowledgeable coaches who actually want to improve you as a fighter. I had only trained muay thai for a few months before coming to Thailand and I was worried that my level wasn’t good enough to keep up with the training sessions. But at Master O they really focus on developing your technique and take all skill levels into consideration individually and equally! They increase the challenge level when you get better, so this gym has a lot to offer for more experienced fighters too.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you krub.

reviews.name: James Au
reviews.text:
Last two weeks, I’ve attended training at Master O’s Academy, and it’s been an amazing experience.

Don’t let the small gym fool you—Master O is a true expert in his art. Every detail he teaches, from the snap of your jab to the way you shift your weight and twist your shoulders, is designed to help you unlock real power in your punches and kicks.

Master O and his team are professional and attentive. They watch your form closely and give great tips—like punching as if you're pressing an elevator button. It might sound silly, but it really helped make my punches sharper and more accurate.

Master O explains techniques by blending his deep knowledge of Muay Thai tradition with practical, technical application. It was truly insightful and added a lot of depth to the training.

Classes are conducted fully in English and are easy to follow. Whether you're a beginner or have some experience in Muay Thai, I highly recommend training with Master O. You’ll learn a lot and enjoy every session
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review krub.

reviews.name: Thomas Lau
reviews.text: Took a private lesson for technical Muay Thai/Muay Boran training. Very attentive trainer, giving good tips and corrections. I would say you get very good training for a reasonable price. After the first lesson I decided to buy 10 private lesson.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review.

reviews.name: Jabari Ka Bey
reviews.text: Great energy, better teaching. Took my Muay Thai to the next level! So grateful for Master O and all of the instructors.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review.

reviews.name: Radin
reviews.text: Amazing experience Master O and all the other coaches were extremely knowledgeable and helpful in teaching all aspects of Muay Thai, highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review krub.

reviews.name: Antonio Duplessis
reviews.text: Incredible experience! If you're in Bangkok and want top of the line Muay Thai training, this is your spot. I traveled from Canada and this gym was the top of my list to train at. The technique, patience, and ability to teach from Kru Ohm was better than I could have imagined. He was motivating and extremely knowledgeable. Master O was also extremely kind and knowledgeable. No matter what skill level you are, this is a great gym to train at. I will be back.

reviews.name: Andrew Baker
reviews.text: I made friends and memories at Master O Muay Thai that I will never forget. All of the staff were always gracious and patient, really making sure you understand the technique of Muay Thai. They even taught some of the history of Muay Thai. Whether you have martial arts experience or are a total beginner, I would reccomend Master O to everyone visiting Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you krub.

reviews.name: Enrique Garcia
reviews.text: Very friendly and good training club. Taught techniques really well and gave good small pointers too. Highly recommend, I have sparred before but my techniques aren’t that good, so they showed me those really well. Even if you are completely new they will be able to help you.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review krub.

reviews.name: Pravish Vishnudas
reviews.text:
Had a good time training in Fundamentals of Muay Thai with Master O. Great expertise, humble personality and excellent training. Enjoyed the one on one sessions with him.

If you are in bangkok book a session, let him know whats your goal in Muay thai, and then he will give you a customised training.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you krub.

reviews.name: Farah Gailani
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Master O Muay Thai for anyone who visits Bangkok to get a full Thai cultural experience and learn the techniques of Muay Thai.

The entire team is so helpful and friendly, you basically get a 1 on 1 Muay Thai trainer who teaches you the accurate way of Muay Thai. It is suitable for people of all fitness level and ages.

I will definitely come back again when visiting Bangkok ❤️🤍💙🤍❤️ Kap khun ka!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review krub.

reviews.name: Rahimi Azmi
reviews.text:
Finally found a place that not only teaches you correct punching and kicking form, they are also share intricate Muay Thai techniques that not many gyms do. One of those gyms certified to conduct training under the Kru Muay Thai Association. The trainers are very technique -driven. After a few sessions of corrective work on my punching and kicking techniques, I am able to generate more speed and power now.

Took the first private class for a tryout and after I realised how much knowledge I could gain from this humble gym, I decided to sign up for another 10-session private package for kids and myself. Trainers spoke good English and instructions were easy to understand. I’ve learned so much from these sessions.

Very pleased with how the entire experience at this gym. The kids were awarded certificates which made them very happy and pleased. Kudos to all the trainers at Master O Muay Thai. Very hospitable, friendly and experts of the craft.

Will be my go-to whenever I’m in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you krub.

reviews.name: Amr Hussein
reviews.text: I'm very pleased that I choose this gym, Master O muay thai Academy is the best for place for teaching Muay Thai, the gym is located in a nice neighbourhood, Sathorn, Bangkok, the Academy is full of champions, their knowledge and support are the highlight, despite your level of experience in martial arts, they will guide you through a wonderful learning journey from the beginning till the end, I would like to express my gratitude to Master O, Master Om, Master Korn, Master beat and Master Bu, the whole team is lovely, knowledgeable and supportive, if you are in bangkok, and you want to learn Muay Thai, this is the place you should go.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you krub.

reviews.name: Filippos Xanthos
reviews.text:
Had a private session with Mr Korn to learn the techniques of Muay Thai.

Had a great training and great time.
Thank you , I hope I will be back next year for more.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you. We hope to see yoo again soon too. Keep training.

reviews.name: Sean Gilmore
reviews.text:
Some gyms are only good for sparring, or hitting pads as hard as you can. Master O's gym CAN give you that experience, but for me the real value came from the fine tuning of techniques I had been doing wrong for years. This is an amazing gym for both experienced AND beginer fighters, because Master O has valuable knowledge he can give to both.  My Muay Thai skill level was that of a low level amateur fighter coming into the class, so I had experience, but I am not a pro or even a champion amateur. Even so, Master O showed great respect for my current level, while tweaking my skills to give me better technique in just a single class than I could get from 10 lessons at another gym. In the class I was in he taught beginners that had never thrown a punch, myself, and a Muay Thai trainer that hadn't been practicing for awhile. All of us left the class feeling like we learned a ton.

This school also offers weapons training, which I took advantage of the next day. Despite never having used a double sword before, by the end of the class I waa doing basic sparring drills.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review krub.

reviews.name: Latte
reviews.text: This street offers many massage shops but Royal Outcall offered an authentic and realistic priced treatment. There was  tranquil music that took me away, the wide bed that I personally prefer so I can lay down with my arms wide and the slight sound of Bangkok traffic in the background which is for me like listening to a waterfall and just zone out. The staff was very kind and my masseuse May applied the right pressure, did some solutions I didn't have before. It was overall a very good experience that I surely will repeat. 10/10 recommended.

reviews.name: Frans Zoen
reviews.text: There are many shops on this street but this one sticks out because of good service and high quality. I  had a two hour Thai massage by May which was very strong and relaxing. The location is small but very convenient. Good price, clean shop, relaxing atmosphere and music. Will come again for sure to do another massage.

reviews.name: Lori Parker
reviews.text:
Well, I would give it a bit better rating because my nail service was fine, but a few things weren't. I have really brittle nails, so I like getting gel polish, but my nails still feel very thin and bendable, but they are pretty!
My friend had a 30 minute neck and shoulder massage and she said the lady did a fine job with her head (similar to a facial), but her shoulders and neck were not helped. It was as if the masseuse didn't actually know what she was doing and she poked around like a little kid giving a massage. But they didn't make matters worse and cause pain. We were short 100 baht to pay cash (because my nails service ended up being 100 more than I expected because they charged me to get old gel off) so they let me use my credit card to do phone pay...but now my card has been shut down for thousands of dollars in fraudulent charges! I'm not certain it was through this transaction that my credit card info got stolen, but be thoughtful and use cash to pay.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Lori, for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We are glad to hear that you found your nail service pretty, but we are very sorry that your overall experience did not meet your expectations.

We sincerely apologize for the concerns with the massage service and the misunderstanding regarding the pricing for gel removal. We also take your comment about the payment experience very seriously. Please be assured that our business does not process fraudulent transactions, and we recommend contacting your bank immediately for assistance in such matters. If you want to check from our system payment we use https://stripe.com/th please contact the support if you need any information for the payment bank account. 

Your feedback is valuable and will help us improve our services and communication. We truly hope you will give us another opportunity to serve you better in the future.

With respect
Royal Massage Bangkok team

reviews.name: Beth Porto
reviews.text: Had one of the top 2 massages I have experienced in SE Asia!  I got the 90 minute Thai Oil massage and I almost regret not bumping it up to 2 hours for an extra $200 baht.  The masseuse I was with has a nice, firm touch and worked out so many sore areas that I had from the gym.  Totally relaxed the rest of the day.  The place is small and unassuming on Sukhumvit Alley but don't let that stop you from going in.  Great massage at a great price of $800 baht for 1.5 hours.

reviews.name: Ingrid Carluer
reviews.text:
Definitely one of the best massages I've gotten! I chose the oil massage for 1hour and it was just great, with the right amount  of pressure, the masseuse was able to work some painful spots I had and I felt totally relaxed afterwards!
Bonus, they are open late at night! 🙂

reviews.name: Theo
reviews.text: I just finished my massage, which was terribly painful, and the masseuse only massaged us for an hour instead of an hour and a half, yet we still paid for an hour and a half! We're not complaining because we're civilized people, but this massage parlor is absolutely one to avoid!! The massage was rushed and the time allotted was completely disregarded…
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We sincerely apologize for your experience and truly appreciate your feedback. This is not the standard we aim to provide.

We take this matter seriously and have already addressed the staff involved, as punctuality and service time are basic rules of our company. There is no excuse for this.

We also followed up the next day and processed a partial refund of 200 THB on March 13 at 14:01 to your girlfriend Ms. Sukanya account, adjusting the charge to 1 hour of service.

Regarding the discomfort during the massage, we deeply regret that the pressure was not suitable for you. Our therapists are trained to adjust based on client preference, and clients are always welcome to request changes at any time.

We truly apologize again and will continue improving to ensure this does not happen in the future. 

Kind regards,
Royal Massage Team 🙏

reviews.name: VERITY HEALD
reviews.text:
Amazing massage!
Myself and my friend both went for 1.5 hour massages (different areas) - We both had an incredible experience, our bodies felt great afterwards and less tight. Such a precise and thorough massage from both staff members. Also very lovely staff. Very reasonable prices! (cheap!)
Would highly recommend anybody to go here for a massage!

reviews.name: B H
reviews.text:
My wife and I got a great one hour foot massage as no appointment walk-ins here and were very happy with the service. Finished with a nice short shoulder massage.
These women work hard, please consider a good tip if you are happy.

reviews.name: J Richard
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely amazing experience at Royal Massage Bangkok. From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed by a serene atmosphere, calming scents, and a team of highly professional and friendly staff. The ambiance is perfect for relaxation, with soft lighting, tranquil music, and a spotless environment that immediately puts you at ease.

The massage itself was exceptional. My therapist was highly skilled, attentive, and intuitive, knowing exactly where to apply pressure and how to release tension. Especially helpful with my bad back

What sets Royal Massage apart is their attention to detail and genuine care for customers. They take the time to ensure your comfort, adjusting pressure levels and techniques based on your preferences. It’s truly a luxury experience at a very reasonable price.

reviews.name: Haylee Wong (hayZZZ)
reviews.text: Lovely experience. Clean. Professional. Nice relaxing vibe. The staff were kind. Some road noises but did not mind

reviews.name: MIHIR OZA
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Royal Massage with my wife. It was our first time getting a massage, and we both opted for the Thai oil massage. It was incredibly refreshing and relaxing. Initially, I felt a bit uncomfortable since it was my first time and I was being massaged by a lady, but the therapist was very professional and made me feel at ease.

She handled everything really well, and once the massage started, I felt completely relaxed and rejuvenated. The overall experience was excellent, and I’m really glad we chose Royal Massage. Thank you to the team for such a great experience. We’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.name: . MICHIRU
reviews.text:
This place is a hard no. The leather on the massage sofa is cracked and rough — it rubbed against the back of my thighs and made me itch.

The massage technique was terrible. I had muscle pain immediately afterward and even got delayed soreness (a bad sign of poor technique).

There are plenty of much better massage places around. Do yourself a favor and go literally anywhere else.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are truly sorry to hear about your disappointing experience and that our service did not meet your expectations. Please accept our sincere apologies for the discomfort you felt with both the facilities and the massage technique.

Your feedback is very valuable to us, and we will take immediate steps to review and improve both our equipment and therapist training to ensure this does not happen again.

We hope you might consider giving us another chance in the future so we can provide you with the quality experience you deserve.

Warm regards,
Royal Massage Bangkok

reviews.name: Candy Tan
reviews.text: Request to increase strength and the therapist use a wooden stick to add pressure on e bottom of the feet and toes. The wooden stick slip twice from the toes and pushes towards in-between the toes which is painful, when I withdrew my leg from it, the therapist laugh and ask is it painful! Said that the stick slip is cause by the oil and is accident. After that she just turn to chat with another therapist and the foot massage is only 3/10 strength. Is that the way a therapist should behave? To me it is Very unprofessional. For the price of 350baht an hour, there are better choice from the nearby massage shop.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Candy Tan,

We’re truly sorry to hear about your experience. What happened was not acceptable, and we’ll be addressing it with our team. Thank you for your honest feedback — it helps us improve. We hope to have a chance to make it right in the future.

Warm regards,
Kanyakorn 
Owner

reviews.name: Peter Frier
reviews.text: In last 3 weeks  I had massage in this place 5 times. 3 of them  with Tao. She is just perfect with her job.  She is strong but she knows exactly where it's need to be done. Very professional  and you feel  result after. I would recommend it to anyone who is looking  for good massage.  Thank you and I hope  to see you again when  back in Bangkok 😊

reviews.name: Wyman Ho
reviews.text: I visited this place and had an exceptional experience. The staff was professional and welcoming, creating a relaxing and comfortable environment from the moment I walked in. The massage itself was fantastic—therapists are skilled and attentive, tailoring the session to my specific needs. Despite the place being somewhat small, it felt intimate and cozy, enhancing the overall experience. The pricing is affordable, making it a great value for the quality of service provided. I highly recommend for anyone looking to unwind and rejuvenate!

reviews.name: Jim Lamborn
reviews.text: I just got into Bangkok after a long flight. Hotel room not ready so headed to this place to relax and fill in some  time. I had an incredible 1 hour massage. very professional and clean. I had a lot of stretching which really ironed out some sore spots from plane travel. Very reasonable prices - a little more expensive than some questionable places nearby but you only every get what you pay for. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Abraham
reviews.text: Today was my last day of two week long holidays in Thailand and decided to have a massage before leaving to the airport. As I was staying nearby went to Royal massage and had a traditional Thai massage. I opted for a one hour massage but it was so good that I decided to extend for 90 minutes. The place is neat and clean, the massauer is very good. I felt rejuvenated after a tiring day. Really enjoyed the massage. Very reasonable rates too. Thanks for the service. Now there's no time for another one!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear valued customer,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience with us! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your traditional Thai massage at Royal Massage Bangkok and that it left you feeling rejuvenated after a long day.

It's fantastic to hear that you found our establishment clean and our masseur skilled. Providing a relaxing and comfortable environment for our clients is a top priority for us, and we're glad that you felt at ease during your visit.

We appreciate your kind words about our rates as well. We strive to offer competitive prices while maintaining the highest standards of quality and service.

We understand that time was limited for you, but we're delighted that you chose to spend some of it with us. It was a pleasure serving you, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back for another invigorating massage in the future, perhaps during your next visit to Thailand.

Safe travels, and thank you again for choosing Royal Massage Bangkok!

Warm regards,

Annie
owner
Royal Massage

reviews.name: Janos S
reviews.text: I like how profesional they look but got dissapointed. I went there 9 in the morning, but the shop was closed. Maybee should change your opening times so next time I know can have massage not just the walk..
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback, Janos 🙏
Our shop opens from 10:00 AM to midnight, which is the standard opening time for massage shops in Thailand by law. The 24-hour service you see online refers to our outcall (home/hotel) massage, where our admin team is available 24/7 for booking via phone, LINE, WhatsApp, WeChat, or Telegram.
We truly appreciate your visit — next time, please call or message us before coming, so we can make sure a therapist is available for you. Hope to welcome you soon for a relaxing massage 💆‍♂️✨

Warm regards,
Royal Massage Bangkok Team

reviews.name: Khalid Al Feisal
reviews.text: I arrived in Bangkok after a long trip from the Mediterranean Sea, and I was tired. I decided to search for the nearest place to enjoy a massage. I contacted your shop after browsing the website. One of your dedicated employees came to me and worked magic on my body and I felt afterwards that it would only be the first time and not the last (Miss Paeng is an amazing, professional and a good example of dedicated customer service). I really hope to visit your shop soon to enjoy again and I found it important to take some of my time to share this amazing experience (and most importantly the reasonable and affordable prices). Thank you, Royal Massage
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your wonderful experience! We're delighted to hear that Miss Paeng provided exceptional service, and we can't wait to welcome you back soon!

reviews.name: db cc
reviews.text:
Every time I’m in Bangkok I dedicate one night to an out call massage with Anny. An out call is when the therapist comes to you at your place. Be it your hotel or residence.
Anny is a real gem. She’s kind, experienced and has decent massage skill. She’s also very professional and punctual! Thank u again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
"Thank you for your thoughtful review! We're absolutely delighted to know that you've had consistently positive experiences with Anny's out call massage service during your visits to Bangkok. It's heartening to hear that her professionalism, punctuality, and skillful approach meet your expectations every time.

Your continued patronage and the time you take to dedicate a night for a massage with Anny on each visit is a testament to the quality of service we strive to provide. We highly value your trust and appreciation and will definitely convey your kind words to Anny.

We look forward to continuing to serve you on your future visits to Bangkok. Thank you once again for your support and for sharing your experience!
With best regards.
kanyakorn (Anny)

title: So Thai Spa
ownerDescription:
So Thai Spa Bangkok is a leading authentic Thai Spa and Massage in Bangkok

So Thai Spa has been serving customers for over 10 years. Due to COVID-19 pandemic, we regret to inform you that our Sukhumvit 31 branch is currently closed. Currently located in the heart of Bangkok, near Silom, Sathorn, Bang Rak, riverside and Icon Siam and famous tourist attractions.

Experience the best of Thai massage and spa treatments in a convenient and relaxing setting. Our certified therapists will use their expertise to help you unwind and rejuvenate.

We also offer special packages for couples and groups. So Thai Spa is the perfect place to relax and rejuvenate after a long day.
address: 181, 16 Surawong Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: Sofía Rivera-Patton
reviews.text: It was incredible. We got into Bangkok around 3 am the night before, so we decided to take it easy and get a massage the next day. We weren’t sure which to go to because there are so many options, but the receptionist at our hotel recommended this one. While it is a little pricier than some of the other ones nearby, it was well worth it. We didn’t have an appointment and they took us right away. Served us iced tea and let us pick which massage we wanted, explaining the difference with each. We both chose hot oil aroma massages, so they brought out the oils for us to choose which we wanted. They also got our requests for pressure levels. Then we went upstairs and they gave us foot massages and scrub, and then brought us to our room and gave us time to take off our clothes and get covered with the sheet they offer. Our masseuses were incredibly nice and regularly checked in about pressure levels and making sure we were comfortable with where they were massaging. It was incredibly relaxing, especially after a long travel day. Afterwards they brought us warm tea and we were on our way. 10/10 experience, if it’s in your budget I would definitely splurge for the 4 hands hot oil massage. We tried to fit another massage into our busy bangkok schedule, and it unfortunately did not work out, but I could not recommend it more. I will be back next time in Bangkok, it was the most relaxing experience.

reviews.name: Matt
reviews.text: Booked the 2-hour So Thai Signature couples massage through the website. Good communication and quick email confirmation. Nicely decorated space. Tea served at the beginning and end. Allowed to choose the aroma of oil used. Great massage overall and the masseuses adjusted pressure/technique when requested. One thing that caught os off guard was that after checking in at the reception you’re taken out a side door into a parking lot and back to another space where services are performed. All well decorated and no issues though. Would definitely book again!

reviews.name: Abraham Gardner
reviews.text: After a long international flight, So Thai Spa was exactly what I needed. I left feeling much more relaxed and far less stiff, and the whole visit had a calm, soothing feel from start to finish. My masseuse, Sun, was excellent and really made the experience stand out. I’d happily come back whenever I’m in the area.

reviews.name: Simmy Kailath
reviews.text: It was a great experience. Everyone was so friendly and respectful. We had our session with Mai and Lilli. They very so calm and respectful and yet you immediately know that the are masters of their profession. I felt so relaxed after these 90minutes full body massage. So thankful for the relief of some musclepain as well. We felt safe and comfortable all the time. Thank you so much. Special mention again goes to Lilli and Mai.

reviews.name: HSU THET HTAR
reviews.text:
What an amazing experience! The massage was absolutely worth it from start to finish. A special thank you to Cher and Ann for taking such wonderful care of my mom and me. They were both professional, attentive, and made us feel completely relaxed throughout the session.

Their techniques were excellent, and they made sure we were comfortable the entire time. We left feeling refreshed, relieved, and so much better than when we arrived.

If you’re looking for a great Thai massage with exceptional service, I highly recommend asking for Cher and Ann. Thank you for making our visit so memorable.

reviews.name: SF
reviews.text: We had the 4 hour couples massage with the herbal compress and aromatic oil and thoroughly enjoyed 🫶 Fon and Tan were very professional and we left feeling super relaxed! Very much enjoyed the beautiful shower after the body scrub. Only thing I would change would be a slightly more comfortable head hole on the massage bed but otherwise the pillow was awesome. Would come back!

reviews.name: Mat Mora
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience! I went with two friends and we had an amazing, deeply relaxing time. Sun was my masseuse and her service was exceptional, I’m truly grateful. I arrived feeling stressed and stiff after a long international flight, and coming here was the best decision I could have made.

The staff are incredibly kind, the service is top-tier, and the space is beautiful, calm, and peaceful. They let you choose the scent of essential oil for your massage, washed my feet beforehand, and even ironed my shirt,  it was so wrinkled, and thanks to them I left feeling relaxed and looking sharp. I will definitely be coming back.

reviews.name: Pritisha Joshi
reviews.text:
We went there as a family and from
Booking to actual experience team was very responsive and great skills of the masseuses. We took Thai massages and right amping of pressure and comfort. Thank you team So Thai specially Noi and Csea , it was great! Khap khun kha🙏🏽

reviews.name: Arti Soejitno
reviews.text: Good hygiene, friendly staffs, big variety of massage menu. However the massage is not too strong although we came after lunch time and already requested for a strong one. Bit too expensive for such price and not so special.

reviews.name: daliberry
reviews.text: My partner and I had the absolute best couple's massage experience at So Thai Spa (Surawong). From the moment we walked into the beautiful, tranquil space, we felt completely taken care of. The therapists have truly great healing hands perfectly balancing pressure and technique to melt away all our travel tension. The private couple’s room was serene, clean, and incredibly relaxing. Highly recommend their couple packages if you're looking for a peaceful escape in the middle of Bangkok!

reviews.name: WK
reviews.text:
Love it at So Thai Spa. A warm atmosphere I found when I stepped in, not to mention polite and efficient front-desk receptionists
My masseuse (Sonya) was amazing: I felt my stress melted away!!  The ambience in massage room was so calm and clean too. Can’t wait to come back.

reviews.name: Oliver Harry
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a high-quality, authentic Thai spa experience without the five-star luxury price tag, So Thai Spa (located in the Sukhumvit/Asok area) is one of the best value-for-money options in Bangkok. Set in a charming, traditional Thai-style house, it combines a serene atmosphere with professional spa services.
Ambiance and Service:
The spa offers a cozy, peaceful environment away from the main road. Upon arrival, you are welcomed with a cold drink and a warm greeting from the polite staff. The rooms are clean, private, and tastefully decorated with traditional Thai elements. Couples and groups can also book private rooms together.
Best Signature Treatments:
So Thai Signature Combination: A popular package combining a traditional Thai massage, oil massage, and a foot massage to cover full-body relaxation.
Herbal Compress Massage: Uses warm, steamed Thai herbs to relieve deep muscle soreness and improve circulation.
Body Scrub & Herbal Wrap: Great for deep skin exfoliation and hydration after spending time out in the city's humidity.
Facilities & Amenities:
While simpler than ultra-luxury resort spas, So Thai Spa excels in cleanliness and consistency. The therapists are highly experienced, attentive, and adjust pressure according to your preference. Soft music and soothing essential oil scents complete the experience.
Final Verdict:
So Thai Spa hits the sweet spot between affordable street massage shops and expensive luxury retreats. Excellent technique, clean private rooms, and fair pricing make it a top recommendation for tourists visiting Bangkok.

reviews.name: Yana Malakhova
reviews.text: It was incredible experience. I have had Thai Massage, and it felt soo good. The staff are amazing, very nice and friendly. This place is definitely must visit in Bangkok🩵

reviews.name: Jun Goy
reviews.text: Very nice and very professional therapist , will observe your reaction and ask if you are okay throughout the whole massage. I was having a bloated stomach while massaging , when they saw it they immediately offer a warm water for me . Very professional

reviews.name: Cyrus David Pastelero
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience with Vi and Poo! We booked the couples massage promotion, and it was truly relaxing from start to finish. They were both professional, attentive, and made us feel completely at ease.

The food was also delicious, especially the coconut ice cream, which was my favorite. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and we’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.name: Rileyy Annee
reviews.text: 10/10 couples massage! my partner and i very much enjoyed this. getting massages while on vacation hits different and the two women who performed them knew what they were doing. would recommend and honestly coming back before we leave back home.

reviews.name: Ellen Joy Perez
reviews.text:
We had the So Thai Luxury (4 hrs) For Couple and we really enjoyed it.

Fon and Wan did a very good job and they were very kind. They gave me medicine as I have colds and they noticed it during the massage.

We did this before our 13 hours flight to home so we really feel relax now. Many thanks and well recommended!

reviews.name: Zeynep Naz Şahin
reviews.text:
Our Thai massage experience was absolutely amazing. The place was exceptionally clean, and the staff were incredibly welcoming and attentive from the moment we arrived. The complimentary refreshments made us feel very comfortable from the start.

Their hands felt truly magical—they were so skilled, healing, and deeply relaxing. We had the 90-minute Thai massage, and it exceeded all our expectations. We highly, highly recommend it to anyone looking for an authentic and unforgettable massage experience. The tea served afterward was also absolutely delicious. We will definitely come back on our next visit!

reviews.name: Siddharth Verma
reviews.text: My wife and I opted for the nirvana experience. Our therapists Moo and Mai were wonderful. They started with us throughout and we had one of the best massage experiences of our lives. Would highly recommend

reviews.name: Nikita Lindsay
reviews.text: OMG! Two hours of stress relief and whole body relaxation. The staff at So Thai Spa were inviting and kind as soon as we arrived and accommodating throughout our spa experience. My husband and I both received the Signature package with Thai Oil and Herbal Ball compress. This was so worth our time in Bangkok!

title: TREASURE Spa Thonglor - Thong Lo 13
subTitle: TREASURE Spa Thonglor @Thonglor 13
ownerDescription:
Treasure Spa Thonglor is rooted in a tropical garden in soi Thonglor 13. Far enough from the tourist trail to feel like your own discovery. Among Thonglor and Ekamai's highest-rated spas, recognised by guests with TripAdvisor Travelers' Choice 2025.
The Gold Element - three hours of rose gold scrub, golden oil massage, gold facial, and high tea overlooking the garden. For those wanting more, the four-hour Rose and Champagne journey adds champagne bath, jade facial, and warm rose massage. Fresh Orient follows an authentic Thai sequence. Treatments from 90 minutes to a full half-day. Private couple suites - treated together in one room, side by side. Solo guests welcome. Reservations recommended. BTS Thong Lo - Soi Torsak, Thonglor 13.
address: 33 S. Torsak Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Anjie Best
reviews.text:
This is a really beautiful and cozy spa located near Thong Lo BTS. I did the 60 minute aroma massage and it was amazing! You can choose from a selection of aromatherapy oils, then you're led to a nicely sized room to enjoy your massage. The experience is peaceful and relaxing. The staff is patient and kind.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.name: Connie Lai
reviews.text: My third time here. It was called Leyana. However, the surprises never stop. Still found it the best and my most favorite spa in Bangkok. Nim was the latest but also the best masseur to me. She is an asset to the shop. Thank you for giving me another spa memory.

reviews.name: Welly Wang
reviews.text: Great massage spot. Great service. The masseuse is very professional and they even ask you if there are spots where you’d like them to focus on. Very knowledgeable and professional. And then you get to take a nice shower after too. Nice and clean bathroom. After your massage, you’ll find hot tea and biscuits waiting for you on the table to conclude your lovely experience.

reviews.name: Lai Freya
reviews.text: It’s a really quiet and open space. The staff are so polite, and I felt super relaxed afterward. The receptionist was great, too!

reviews.name: Céline TENIERE
reviews.text: Super quick appointment, excellent welcome for a truly special moment in an absolutely charming setting. I highly recommend it! 🙏 Thank you and see you very soon!

reviews.name: Rena She
reviews.text: Amazing Therapist, thanks for the 165mins ultimate experience 💆🏻‍♀️🫶🏻 And love the lemongrass massage oil too.

reviews.name: Anissa
reviews.text: Amazing massage session. Loosen most of my knots and tension. Felt very light afterwards. Calming ambience. Will definitely come back again!

reviews.name: Man G Choy
reviews.text:
It was our first spa in Bangkok, and because we got a good deal it was very worth it.

The place is spacious, very well maintained and clean. Staff are very friendly and polite. They took the time on the  spa and massages and we felt like royalties during the whole thing. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Angie B
reviews.text: Excellent masseur called Na ! Reception n staff are friendly and welcoming, redeemed Klook voucher without issues. Facilities and the toilets feels a little worn out and old, they seemed to have seen better days, so just something for management to take note. Love the garden view while resting. Refreshments were all delicious. Keep it up.👍

reviews.name: Dhershini Govin
reviews.text: Thoroughly enjoyed the spa experience here this afternoon! Jessie from reception is kind- packed some lovely cookies for me to take home! Kran is the masseuse to look for!! Fingers are magic!! Very nice ! Will be back!

reviews.name: CJ Baker
reviews.text:
Coming from the U.S. on a month long birthday trip, this was a perfect way to start off. We were greeted with warm and kind smiles, even though we arrived past our appointment time due to traffic. Every one who works there was friendly and helpful with knowledge and experience.

My partner and I were able to get the couples massage, which included a big tub and lots of privacy. Both of us were treated very professionally, and the massage was the best one I've ever had. Add in the manager even offered to call us a "Grab ride" to get us to our dinner, that set it over the top.

Thank you for a wonderful Thai experience and for such hospitality in this getaway trip.

reviews.name: Ho Ivan
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience.
Skillful masseur and nice receptionist. Spacious and very clean.
They offered different teas, which is kind of surprise.
Waffle is just alright.…. Though nice to change a bit, as very boring to have mango sticky rice everywhere.

reviews.name: 686 Chan Hok-pan
reviews.text:
Wonderful spa and massage experience.
Feel refreshing after massage !
Can go more shopping 🛍️

reviews.name: Habeb Hamadi
reviews.text: The spa Cozy and well decorated gives relaxing feeling , Had the spa retreat with and it was amazing. i felt great. One of the best massages I’ve ever had. Warm welcoming , Very professional , friendly and Providing your with herbal drink , allowing you to choose the aroma smell and ask you for any specific areas that wanted the masseur to concentrate on and how tough wanted them to be. reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your visit, We are so very thankful for your patronage, Habeb Hamadi

reviews.name: ruby tso
reviews.text: The staff is nice and professional, massage very good and relax. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Shauna N.
reviews.text: Great massage. The pressure was strong enough to relieve my aches, but relaxing at the same time. Thank you for the wonderful massage!

reviews.name: Lang Doong Ho
reviews.text: Pleasant environment with large rooms. Will come back again. Took a lot of videos but only photo of the services. Night lighting enhance the middle Eastern Tent feel of the reception. Very clean

reviews.name: 貝卡beccaenelmundo
reviews.text:
Wonderful massage session!
When you arrive at the spa centre, the staff will let you write down anything to pay attention to about your body condition, and the area you wish for focus on for the massage.
Wait area is bright and cozy, massage room is spacious and comfortable.
My massage lady was absolutely amazing, she did cover all body parts that I mentioned to focus on, and her strength and pressing was on the spot!
If you're in Bangkok, and looking for a proper oil massage experience, this is a must try place!

reviews.name: Elvis Do
reviews.text: Booked in advanced our slot and did deep tissues and back revival massage. This is a spa and not your off the street massage places in Bangkok. Much better presentation and service but of course comes with a bit more $$. The massage was amazing, she really worked my back in but my preference is heavy pressure. The have packages and also shuttle service back home. Come, enjoy and come out happy ! Thank you !

reviews.name: Denise Tan
reviews.text: It was such a great experience with masseuse Na 🤍 She is so amazing! She is meticulous and skillful at capturing where my knots and pressure points are. The place is relaxing and clean. Highly recommended!

title: Phuket Thai Cooking Class by Chef VJ
description: Traditional Thai cookery school offering market visits, fruit tasting & free transport.
ownerDescription: Whether Thai food is your favorite or cooking is your hobby, there is no better way to learn Thai cooking when you are in Thailand. Phuket Thai Cooking Class by VJ is an ideal home-style learning environment which is different from other cooking classes and hotels which offer the courses. Come and join us to make your next vacation a culinary adventure and learn essential skills and techniques you can use everyday!
address: 31 Patak Rd Kata Beach, Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: R894+VQ Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Julene Gatot
reviews.text: Wonderful experience! Highly recommend doing this cooking class when in Phuket. Not only do you cook one of the best Thai food ever, you will gain a deeper appreciation for it; learning about the herbs and spices used and the preparation methods involved, especially when making your own curry with the mortar and pestle. The market tour is highly recommended as well. Everything is prepared very well for the prep and cooking, and everyone was super helpful. Once again, thank you for the great experience!

reviews.name: Sharifa Tucker
reviews.text: Gig and the team were great, really welcoming and clear instructions throughout. The market tour was brilliant, a lovely way to learn more about thai cooking and ingredients. We cooked different meals and they cater to allergies and intolerances too. They made the entire day fun, a great way to meet people as well.

reviews.name: Fulya Arman
reviews.text:
I joined Jane’s market tour and cooking class, and it was a fantastic experience.

The market tour was especially insightful—we learned a lot about Thai ingredients and how they’re used in authentic cooking. During the class, we prepared Tom Yum, Pad Thai, and red curry chicken, along with mango sticky rice. Everything was explained clearly, and we picked up plenty of useful tips.

The best part? After each dish, we got to enjoy what we cooked—which made the whole experience even more fun and rewarding.

I learned a lot, ate very well, and would highly recommend this class to anyone who loves Thai food!

reviews.name: Sally-Anne Kahl
reviews.text:
We did the “favourite class” with the market tour and loved our experience. Gigi was our chef guide and was super helpful, encouraging and informative. The dishes were all super tasty, large portions and the ingredients were all good quality. Pad See Ew was the best! I can’t fault the experience and highly recommend! 🫶🏽
The only piece of feedback I would give is sharper knives! 😌

reviews.name: Mauve Verne
reviews.text: Excellent cooking class with tasty food! The market trip was well worth it and included some fruit tasting and shopping. Making the food was the best part of it all. The mango sticky rice is also to die for! Great addition to your vacation if you’re looking to explore authentic Thai cuisine

reviews.name: Janese Finnie
reviews.text: A lovely cooking experience! We made three main dishes and a dessert from scratch along with learning about each ingredient and how the locals use them. I would definitely recommend this experience if you’re looking for something hands on to do that involves eating!

reviews.name: Mel S
reviews.text:
Phuket Thai Cooking Class with Chef Gigi was one of the highlights of our trip. Chef Gigi was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and made the entire experience fun and easy to follow. The ingredients were fresh, the dishes were absolutely delicious, and we learned so much about authentic Thai cooking along the way.

The class was well organized, hands-on, and welcoming for all skill levels. We left full, happy, and excited to recreate the recipes at home. Highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Phuket!

reviews.name: Jo Mo
reviews.text:
Had a great half day with VJ and her team, and even made some friends along the way.

If you’re especially new to Southeast Asian cooking, I’d heartily recommend joining in the market tour too.

VJ shared quite a few insights about local produce, and the multitude of ingredients used in the wonderful local cuisine.

The class transitioned to an air-conditioned kitchen nearby, and we had nothing to worry about under the close eye and supervision of VJ and her team, as we cooked up a flurry of local dishes, which, I might add, were more delicious than most of the dishes we had tried outside earlier!

All in all, we were very well looked after, and I would heartily recommend this experience to anyone who enjoys food and is looking for a unique experience in Phuket.

reviews.name: Radovana P
reviews.text: The cooking class was amazing! The cooking team was super friendly and helpful. They explained everything regarding ingredients and cooking very clearly. And their English was perfect! Highly recommend

reviews.name: dottydavey
reviews.text: Such an incredible experience. The market store and fruit tasting was great. The foods were absolutely incredible and such friendly staff! We did 2 stir fry’s, tom yum and curry. Highly highly recommend, worth every cent!

reviews.name: Ellen Kobori-Fox
reviews.text: An amazing culinary experience! Gigi was a stellar host and the class makes traditional Thai dishes accessible. We learned a lot in just a few hours and had so much fun! Despite hosting our group of 20, the class was run so thoughtfully and smoothly.

reviews.name: Hannah Marie
reviews.text: Great cooking class experience. Jane has a true love for Thai food and culture, and you can tell by the way she teaches! 10/10 recommend this class!

reviews.name: Marie Korol
reviews.text: An amazing experience from start to finish! Huge thanks to Chef VJ and the girls for the flawless organization. The atmosphere was so welcoming and fun. I finally learned the secrets behind a perfect Pad Thai and discovered so many unique Thai ingredients. If you’re looking for a dynamic, professional, and delicious masterclass — this is it. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Naziere Bond

title: Watchara MuayThai Gym

reviews.name: Rayner Lim
reviews.text:
My rating:
2.5/5 - average
5/5 - a must-try, willing to travel for it

TLDR: 4.5/5
A fairly good first time experience as a tourist, experience may vary if you go there long term.

I visited Watchara MuayThai Gym to get a feel for the local training scene.

It's situated in a very convenient location that's a short walk away from the BTS station.

The gym is air-conditioned. Depending on your preference, this makes training much more bearable in the Bangkok heat. The space felt clean and well-maintained.
There are vending machines outside for water and two changing cubicles with one shower available. They do not provide towels, so make sure to bring your own. The toilet entry takes 2 baht, just ask the staff for entry and they will provide you the coins.

The workout was solid and well-paced. The 90 minutes consisted of:
1. Stretching and warm-ups
2. Shadow boxing
3. Extensive pad work (plenty of rounds)

I definitely got a great workout and a high volume of pad work. You rotate between the few coaches there and each have something to say for technical corrections on your form and technique. Your mileage may vary. For my one and only session, it is just working on the basic strikes, jabs and kicks, with slight variations.

From reading other comments, this gym appears to partner with platforms like Klook for "Muay Thai experiences." I have this booking via Pelago as mentioned. During my time there, several groups of tourists arrived for regular classes to try the sport. I don’t find their training to be catering to tourists and i saw that there are locals who train at the gym too but it's good to know if you're looking for a specific type of training environment.

Overall, it was a good session and experience. Equipment was well-maintained. Professional coaches that keep you engaged, keep children entertained while imparting their craft. I would likely return to try their regular group classes the next time I am in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Honest Reviews Only
reviews.text:
I visited Watchara MuayThai Gym over the weekend to get a feel for the local training scene. I booked a 90 min private session in advance via Facebook Messenger. They were responsive and the process was straightforward.

It's situated in a very convenient location that's a short walk away from the BTS station. One of the biggest selling points here is that the gym is air-conditioned. Depending on your preference, this makes training much more bearable in the Bangkok heat. The space felt clean and well-maintained.

There are vending machines outside for water and two changing cubicles with one shower available. They do not provide towels, so make sure to bring your own.

The workout was solid and well-paced. The 90 minutes consisted of:
1. Stretching and warm-ups
2. Shadow boxing
3. Extensive pad work (plenty of rounds)
4. Light sparring

While I definitely got a great workout and a high volume of pad work, I noticed the coach didn't spend much time on technical corrections. My experience would have been better if there had been more focus on refining my fundamentals and improving my technique.

It is worth noting that this gym appears to partner with platforms like Klook for "Muay Thai experiences." During my time there, several groups of tourists arrived for regular classes to try the sport. This isn't necessarily a negative, but it’s good to know if you're looking for a specific type of training environment.

Overall, it was a good session and experience. Good and well-maintained facilities and equipment. Professional coaches. I would likely return to try their regular group classes the next time I am in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Weiting Wang
reviews.text:
Location: 5/5
Environment: 5/5
Facilities: 5/5

Excellent air-conditioned gym, that is suitable for all levels of people doing muay thai. All the necessary equipments are provided as well. All the trainers speak some english so its great for foreigners as well. We went for both private and group sessions, enjoyed both immensely! We were on holiday for 2 weeks and came for 1 private session, 5 bundled group sessions, and 2 more at the end of our trip because we really loved it!

Group session is super fun, you get to do pad work and some sparring. The trainers makes sure that everyone gets their opportunity to go through everything. This is also a great chance to make some friends as well!

For private session, i would recommend this for people that are interested in getting a very detailed guide on your techniques, and also the chance to spar with your trainer.

All the trainers are super fun, cheerful and a little playful as well. It is also family friendly, but be prepared to give it your all! There is a bathroom inside to shower, so just remember to bring your own toiletries. There is a 7-11 nearby as well, if you need anything last minute.

The location is super convenient, located near the Phloen Chit BTS. Just exit from exit 3, take the lift down and walk 3-5mins and you'll be here.

reviews.name: Yuzu R
reviews.text:
First came a couple of years ago and enjoyed it. Also was my first experience with muay thai then
So I decided to visit them again recently, but now I feel like their trainers are very bored of the work to be honest (Group session both times btw).

But first, the structure. Stretching, alternated bagwork and padwork (padwork is 3 rounds, short intervals. Do PT between each interval), and finish off with practice light sparring with other members in the group (also 3 rounds) and cool down stretch.
During my first visit, the trainer(s) were energetic and a little playful which made it fun. This time, the trainers all kept looking at the clock during padwork and some even just decided to stop first before time was even up, and they were p unenthusiastic. Not much advice given either, and not a whole lot of technique learnt. If the group session is big, you get lots of bagwork time which is kinda.. boring? I mean sure it helps with self practice.

The thing I liked about the session was the light sparring at the end. They will give shin padding and teach some blocking methods. Then we do light sparring with the others to practice blocking n attacking which is fun (coming from someone who is usually nervous and not the best when it comes to actual sparring). It is more affordable than other places at 480thb for 1.5hrs, but despite that I am not sure if I will be a repeat customer just due to the overall experience

Big shoutout to coaches M and Tian they’re some of the best Muay Thai trainers I’ve ever met. Skilled, positive, and they truly care about their students.

reviews.name: Vieli Manuel
reviews.text:
Beginner here. I can highly recommend this gym for both private and group classes. The place is air-conditioned, clean, and fully equipped. For every session they provide gloves, hand wraps, and shin guards if you need them.

Classes are very well structured. It’s not just an hour of mindless rope skipping and  push-ups. They include proper warm-up and cool-down phases, shadowboxing, padwork with feedback, and most importantly sparring at your level. The trainers pay close attention to technique, quickly spot your weaknesses, and give clear corrections that really help you improve.

In the group classes, people from all over the world train together, which makes it a lot of fun and a great way to connect.

I also appreciated their flexibility. I had to cancel a few sessions due to sickness and injury, sometimes on short notice, and they were always very understanding and let me reschedule without any issues.
The prices are honestly more than fair, especially considering that both group and private classes last 1.5 hours.

Thank you, Watchara Team! Special thanks to Day 💪

reviews.text: We were beginners to this sport, and the guys at the club made it such an amazing experience! We borrowed everything we needed and the sparring was so cool! After 90 min you truly feel like you know some of the basics🤩
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: thank you very much! Happy that you guys enjoyed 🤓🙏🏼🙏🏼

reviews.name: Tarun Jain
reviews.text: I spent a day training Muay Thai, the staff is soo friendly and supportive. The exercise and the process of training is well explained and showcased. I will definitely come again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much 🙏🏼🙏🏼

reviews.name: Andy Pham
reviews.text:
Not a bad Muay Thai gym experience, I do feel the training routine was geared more towards tourists. It was challenging but not what you'd get at a Muay Thai gym you'd want to learn technique. Starts off with a stretch, rounds on the bag or with a coach, and then last 10 mins dedicated to sparring.

Not bad if you know what you're in for but otherwise I'd look around for other Muay Thai gyms for training
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much 🙏🏼🙏🏼

reviews.name: Danny Quah
reviews.text: Watchara is a gem of a find. The instructors are fun, great with kids, and with a touch of competitiveness that makes an amateur adult trying to relive their old sporting days enjoy. Double five star. Highly recommended!!

reviews.name: Amber Malik
reviews.text: I had an amazing private session with Tiah (I'm probably spelling that wrong, sorry). It was my second time training muay thai and I felt very encouraged. I would absolutely recommend, especially for beginners.

reviews.name: Anita B.
reviews.text: It was my 1st Muay Thai training ever and I’m glad that I chose such a good spot for it! I joined a group class at 5:30 pm and it was so nice! Even tho I was the only woman but I didn’t feel awkward or anything. The training was intense - for me at least and you get to train individually with different trainers, you do cardio in between, you do a warm up at the beginning etc.! All in all it was just perfect, when I come back to BKK this is the gym I’m going for again! Definitely. THANK YOU!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much 🤓🙏🏼🙏🏼

reviews.name: Quoc Duy Pham
reviews.text: Just had a personal training session for my 10-year-old son, and it was awesome. The trainer was super skilled and really patient with him. Taught him some cool new moves and tweaked a few basics. My son had a blast the whole 90 minutes and is already begging to go back. Big thumbs up from us!

reviews.name: Amy
reviews.text: Purchased a 90 minutes one on one muaythai class on Klook and it was such a great experience! The instructor has been very patient with me which the last time I did muaythai was years ago. Great, sweaty work out and a nice refresh session! Would definitely come back if I am in town again!

reviews.name: Felix P
reviews.text: Very good gym. Caters for all levels, for experienced or intermediate MT students, highly suggest PT class booked in advance. Group classes can get quite crowded so you get a good workout but everything a little rushed and you don’t get much feedback on technique alignment. Will definitely come again when I’m back in BKK.

reviews.name: kiran kumar
reviews.text: I had a fantastic time training at this Muay Thai gym. The trainers are highly skilled, patient, and genuinely passionate about teaching authentic techniques. Whether you’re a beginner or experienced fighter, they tailor the sessions to your level

reviews.name: HJ Agency
reviews.text:
We love this place so much, the only place to go in BKK in our opinion.

Great environment, a mix of fun enjoyment but also serious learning and skill building.

M was our trainer and we did several sessions during which we felt super supported and left with much stronger knowledge and passion for the sport! Huge thank you to M who made everything fun and informative. Also, the best workout you will ever have.

We will be back!!!

title: Bakanaz Cuisine
ownerDescription: By experience of being professional trekking tour guide for more than 20 years, LUE and THO have to take foreign tourists to explore the jungle, observe the way of life of rural people, stay overnight in the village, and serving meals preparing at the spot. We noticed that some of our clients had participated with enthusiasm how to get local ingredients and cook by themselves…and they did enjoy their productive activities at each meals. So often we have a question from each of our tourists group “Where can we learn to cook Thai simple dishes?”

reviews.name: Odette Eboli
reviews.text: What a delight to delve into the Thai cuisine in such a laid back and professional way. The method of the recipes were well presented and we had ample time to savor the delights and take photos. I would highly recommend the course!!

reviews.name: E P (EP)
reviews.text: We found this cooking class on Google Maps as it was nearby where we were staying. We were looking for a place that wasn’t overly touristy, and we were very happy with the result. We loved our cooking class with Chef Loui. We prepared five amazing dishes: Tom kha Kai, Red curry, Spring Rolls, Pad Thai, and Mango with Sticky Rice. The facility was very clean and well organized, the instruction was presented clearly and with patience. I highly recommend the cooking classes here if you are looking for something laid back yet professional/orderly.

reviews.text: Love this place everything is so goood love uncle loo the main chef he is the sweetest. The staff is great and friendly. Fresh ingredients and learned alot

reviews.name: Elizabeth

reviews.name: Hayden

reviews.name: Thomas
reviews.text:
Expérience culinaire à ne pas manquer!😁
Si vous aimez la nourriture thaïlandaise et la bonne cuisine, c est une activé à réaliser en couple, famille ou entre amis
Le chef et son second vous présentent et cuisinent devant vous 4 plats traditionnels. Vous pouvez goûter à toutes les étapes de la cuisson.
Après chaque plat présenté, vous réalisez vous même la meme recette
Une fois les 4 plats finalisés, vous dégustez vos mets....c est encore meilleur qu'au restaurant.
Vous repartez avec les recettes réalisées et un beau tablier.
Merci à l équipe de bakanaz cuisone, nous avons adorés
reviews.textTranslated:
A culinary experience not to be missed! 😁
If you love Thai food and good cuisine, this is the perfect activity for couples, families, or groups of friends. The chef and his sous-chef will present and cook four traditional dishes right in front of you. You can taste every step of the cooking process.
After each dish is presented, you'll prepare the same recipe yourself.
Once all four dishes are finished, you'll enjoy your creations... it's even better than in a restaurant!
You'll leave with the recipes you made and a beautiful apron.
Thank you to the Bakanaz Cuisine team, we loved it!

reviews.name: Seb 26
reviews.text:
Je ne peux que vous recommander cette adresse pour un cours de cuisine thai
On se croirait dans TOP CHEF!!!
Les chefs sont des Pro , prennent le temps d 'expliquer chaque ingrédients et leur but.
Le chef nous montre la recette on goûte et après on va la reproduire  individuellement.  Avec l assistance de chez pour notre groupe de 6. , 2 chef!!!!

I highly recommend this place for a Thai cooking class!

The chefs are pros, taking the time to explain each ingredient and its purpose. The chef shows us the recipe, we taste it, and then we recreate it individually. With the assistance of the staff for our group of six, there were two chefs!

Book without hesitation!

reviews.name: Lionel Roquain
reviews.text: Une expérience formidable pour tout le monde que l’on soit un cuisinier expérimenté ou un novice qui n’a jamais touché une casserole. Les chefs nous transmettent leur passion de la cuisine thaïlandaise. En plus, c’était le meilleur repas que l’on a dégusté en Thaïlande . À faire absolument !
reviews.textTranslated: A fantastic experience for everyone, whether you're an experienced cook or a complete novice who's never even touched a saucepan. The chefs share their passion for Thai cuisine. Plus, it was the best meal we had in Thailand. A must-do!

reviews.name: Valentine Marc Franceschini
reviews.text:
Super cours de cuisine en couple avec des chefs qui parlent un français parfait et nous ont partagé leur savoir faire sur 5 recettes thaï incontournables. Un moment très agréable et un vrai régal, on a adoré !
Merci à l’équipe pour leur gentillesse 🙏🏻
reviews.textTranslated:
Fantastic cooking class for couples with chefs who speak perfect French and shared their expertise on 5 must-try Thai recipes. A truly enjoyable experience and a real treat, we loved it!

Thank you to the team for their kindness 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Antoine MAZILLE
reviews.text: Super expérience ! La chef explique super bien les plats, montre comment faire et puis c’est parti ! Cuisiner dans la bonne humeur et se régaler avec des plats typiques, check !
reviews.textTranslated: Fantastic experience! The chef explains the dishes really well, shows you how to make them, and then you're off! Cooking in a fun atmosphere and enjoying delicious traditional dishes, check!

reviews.name: Christophe Thinlot
reviews.text: Superbe expérience avec 2 chefs d'une extrême gentillesse et bienveillance!! Quelle découverte des saveurs et des épices thaïlandaises!! Le plaisir de préparer ses plats et de les déguster dans un cadre magnifique !! Merci à Tho et son chef cuisinier!!
reviews.textTranslated: A superb experience with two incredibly kind and welcoming chefs! What a discovery of Thai flavors and spices! The pleasure of preparing and enjoying your dishes in a beautiful setting! Thank you to Tho and his chef!

reviews.name: Hervé Jaccard
reviews.text: Super matinée de cuisine en famille. Des chefs super accueillants qui ont l’envie de partager. Des plats délicieux à préparer et à déguster.
reviews.textTranslated: A fantastic morning of cooking with the family. Super welcoming chefs who are eager to share their knowledge. Delicious dishes to prepare and enjoy.

reviews.name: Bill Douglas
reviews.text: Des cours de cuisine thaïe en français avec deux top chefs ! Merci à eux pour les explications, conseils, qualité des produits et repas final. La mise en pratique d'une efficacité à toute épreuve permet de s'exercer sur au moins 4 plats. Idéal pour des ados qui ont adoré l'expérience. Hautement recommandé !
reviews.textTranslated: Thai cooking classes in French with two top chefs! Many thanks to them for the explanations, advice, quality ingredients, and the final meal. The hands-on approach was incredibly effective, allowing participants to practice at least four dishes. Ideal for teenagers who loved the experience. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Shereen hussain
reviews.text: What an amazing experience! Everything was perfect from start to finish. The instructors were incredibly friendly, patient, and made the class so much fun. We learned to cook authentic Thai dishes step by step, and every dish turned out delicious. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the whole experience was well organized. This was definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Phuket. I highly recommend this cooking class to anyone visiting Thailand. Thank you for such a wonderful and memorable experience!

reviews.name: Justine Tan
reviews.text: A most wonderful experience for me n family. Chefs were most welcoming, and explanation in english is clear which allows us ample time to taste and appreciate the dishes that we made.  We have time to taste different herbs n pick up tips of how cooking the ingredients will yield different tastes. I highly recommended coming for a session when u are on Bang Tong beach side. Exceed my expectation of cooking school catered for tourists. Well done seasoning!

reviews.name: Louise Hodge
reviews.text:
We had the incredible experience at Seasoning Cooking class. Everything is perfect from the views, the kind and knowledgeable chefs/owners, and the wonderful choice in dishes. I recommend this experience to anyone in Phuket - it is a 5* experience and I cannot think of any way to improve it.

The recipes are delicious, the timing of the day is perfect and the chefs encourage you to present the food beautifully. They catered to my allergies perfectly and showed so much knowledge about Thai cooking - I will be taking these skills and recipes home with me and think of this experience when I cook these dishes.

The best thing we have done on our travels, thank you very much!

reviews.name: Roc Boronat
reviews.text: What an experience! The place is decoraded with very good taste and the cooks explain the recipees super well and help you a lot while cooking. And the result is superb. Omg. Don't leave the area without coming here to learn some recipees! And by the way... don't have a generous breakfast before coming, because you'll eat a lot for a lot of time. It's 4 recepees, and each one is very, very generous. Thanks a lot for the experience, cooks! 😌

reviews.name: Georges Abou Chebel
reviews.text:
Top experience, chill environment and great people.
We really enjoyed this cooking class!
Came in thinking I should end up becoming master chef, but actually it was about learning about their food culture and culinary heritage.

Just come, relaxed, think, ask and enjoy!

reviews.name: Noelia Fonseca
reviews.text:
We joined the Seasoning Thai Cooking Class as a group of eight, including four kids aged 11–14, and it turned out to be one of the highlights of our trip. The staff were incredibly friendly, charismatic, and truly knowledgeable, not only about every fresh ingredient we used, but also about the rich cultural and historical background behind traditional Thai cuisine.

The whole experience felt relaxed and welcoming from the moment we arrived. The setting is absolutely beautiful!A peaceful green oasis surrounded by lush plants, herbs, and seasonal spices that make you feel deeply connected to the food you’re preparing.

The 4-course menu was very well thought through, and each dish was explained and guided step-by-step. The kids were fully engaged, and the results were genuinely impressive: an incredibly delicious meal that we proudly cooked ourselves.

This cooking class offers the perfect blend of education, culture, and fun in a stunning environment. I would definitely recommend this experience to anyone visiting Phuket families, couples, or anyone who wants to learn authentic Thai cooking in the most wonderful setting.

reviews.name: Sabrina O.
reviews.text:
An absolutely unforgettable experience!

From the moment we arrived, we felt so welcome. The entire team is incredibly kind, passionate, and attentive, making sure everyone has an amazing time.

We learned so much about Thai cuisine, local ingredients, and traditional cooking techniques. The explanations were clear, interesting, and full of little tips that we’ll definitely use again.

The ingredients were exceptionally fresh, and every dish we cooked was absolutely delicious. It was so rewarding to prepare authentic Thai food and enjoy it together at the end.

The setting is simply breathtaking. The beautiful surroundings create such a peaceful and authentic atmosphere, making the whole experience even more special.

This is so much more than just a cooking class—it’s a true cultural experience that we’ll always remember. Thank you to the entire Seasoning Kitchen team for your warmth, kindness, and professionalism. We would recommend this experience to anyone visiting Phuket, and we would love to come back one day!

Thank you for creating such wonderful memories for our family!

reviews.name: Chloe Brown
reviews.text: From the beginning to the end it was a very high quality experience. We learnt so much about the Thai dishes and making them along side was also so amazing. The instructors and staff were so friendly and made the experience so memorable. Thank you so much for having me and my family! It definitely made our trip to Thailand so much better. I recommend this Thai cooking class to everyone visiting Thailand. We wish you all the best for the future!🤍

reviews.name: 540 WOO
reviews.text: So glad we made it here! What an awesome Thai cooking experience with such a great team, the instructor and chef are very friendly, knowledgeable and professional! Thank you once again for sharing sm. It’s indeed an eye opening experience for us. Not to mention, the atmosphere here is STUNNING!!! 😍💖 Cats greeting!!! LOVE KA

reviews.name: MichaelEverywhere
reviews.text:
World-Class Thai Cooking Experience with a MasterChef in Phuket

Seasoning Phuket Thai Cooking Class provides a professional culinary experience in Choeng Thale. The session is led by a MasterChef and his wife, whose expertise is evident in every detail of the programme.

The introductory lesson is highly informative and provides a technical understanding of Thai flavours and techniques before cooking begins at the private stations. We prepared four signature dishes: Tom Yum, Pad Thai, Green Curry, and Mango Sticky Rice. While the recipes are adapted for Westerners, they remain remarkably close to authentic Thai flavours.

The portions are generous and provided more than we could eat in one sitting. The owners are excellent and ensure you can take away everything you cannot finish.

Key Features:

Picturesque Setting: A stunning garden kitchen with a relaxed and professional atmosphere.

Expert Instruction: Direct guidance from a MasterChef at individual cooking stations.

Exceptional Service: Highly organised and welcoming from start to finish.

This is a world-class activity for anyone in the Bang Tao, Laguna, or Surin area.

reviews.name: ariel dominguez
reviews.text:
100/10 Recommend!
They put a lot of thought into EVERYTHING!
Come hungry, you get a lot of food and the first dish is quick so you won’t be hungry long.
They give you a fabulous rundown of popular spices and herbs which was educational and helpful when it came time to cook. The outdoor space is beautiful! And Yes the food was wonderful! Some of the best we have had on our trip. The flavors of the spices and fresh ingredients truly made an already great experience next level. One of our favorite things we have done since being in Thailand and now we can take our new cooking skills home with us :)

reviews.name: Mary Oluwalana
reviews.text: I had the most amazing time at this cooking class. My sister booked this experience for her birthday trip and we were a group of 7. The hostess was a dream, she was thorough, explained in great detail the history behind all ingredients that went into every dish. The chef was incredible as well. Very hands on and was always there to help. The Food ?!?! The flavours ?! I’m speechless. It was delicious, every single dishhhhhh. The environment was very clean, the garden was decorated very beautifully. We were able to enjoy all the dishes as soon as were done preparing them so we ate them fresh which allowed for the team to set out our stations for the next dish we were going to prepare. There was no long waiting times, everything flowed so seamlessly. We were also able to take some of our dishes home because wow the portions were big and very filling. I want to shout out the Amazing Chef and Host for being so professional but also friendly, accommodating and made us feel like home. I would rate the whole experience a 10/10. They even took the group picture of us for us. We had the best time and it was definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Thailand. Thank you Seasonings from your Favourite student Mary hehe

reviews.text: We spontaneously booked the cooking class for a rainy day and it was the best decision! We had so much fun and learned a lot about the Thai way of cooking.
