title: Sasi's Lovemade Kitchen
ownerDescription: Step into a private, welcoming home kitchen right beside Phoenix Golf Course in Pattaya for an authentic Thai cooking experience with Sasi. Discover our organic herb garden, learn time-honoured techniques, and share in Thailand's rich culinary heritage. With over 500 classes taught, Sasi offers an intimate, hands-on journey through traditional flavours, fresh coconut milk-making, and a sit-down meal together. Perfect for couples, families, and small groups looking for a genuine cultural connection through food.
address: Phoenix Gold Golf & Country Club, 114/28, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
plusCode: RX86+RF Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri, Thailand

reviews.name: Donna Dunn
reviews.text:
Sasi’s passion for cooking from the heart shines through in everything she does. Listening to her share stories about Thai culture and traditions was just as enjoyable as learning the recipes themselves.

Together, we prepared and cooked a wonderful selection of authentic dishes, including spicy papaya salad, sour and spicy shrimp soup with lemongrass, steamed fish in a spicy lime-garlic sauce, and red curry fish in coconut milk. Every dish was absolutely delicious—our challenge now is to recreate them at home!

To finish, we enjoyed a delightful mango sticky rice dessert and a beautiful coconut ice cream cake to celebrate our Anniversary.

Sasi made our 30th wedding anniversary incredibly special, creating memories we’ll treasure for years to come. We highly recommend this experience to anyone wanting to learn authentic Thai cooking in a warm, welcoming, and memorable setting. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Donna — my computer is helping me find the right words, but these are all my own feelings! 😊❤️

Dear Donna,

Thank you so much for your beautiful words! It makes me so happy to know that you enjoyed not only the cooking but also the stories about Thai culture and traditions. For me, food is so much more than just cooking — it is about sharing our culture, bringing people together and making lovely memories.

It was a real pleasure to celebrate your 30th wedding anniversary with you. I feel very lucky that you chose to spend such a special occasion in my kitchen, and I hope the recipes bring back happy memories whenever you cook them at home.

Wishing you both many more wonderful years together, filled with love, happiness and delicious food! ❤️

With lots of love from Thailand,
Sasi 🇹🇭

reviews.name: Doris Cheung
reviews.text:
Simply amazing. Beautiful house on the golf course, well done lit spacious and modern. Our group had so much fun learning about coconut and its nutritional value and all sorts of usage in Thai cuisine and beyond. What an experience trying to crack open a coconut, using the rabbit to shred the flesh out of the coconut and then squeezing the milk out of the shredded flesh later for our dishes.

The detox welcome drink was beautifully done and tasted refreshing. On top of all the dishes we made together, we got to taste lovely cocktail and desserts made by Khun Sasi. Love is surely the best secret ingredient to good cooking.

reviews.name: KL Chiu
reviews.text:
This is so much more than just a cooking class—it is a deeply immersive cultural experience! From start to finish, we learned exactly how traditional Thai dishes are crafted using the finest, most natural ingredients. The hosts shared incredible stories and historical backgrounds, giving us a true understanding of how Thai food has evolved and the deep respect behind their culinary traditions.

reviews.name: Jake Dunning
reviews.text:
This was a really great day, learning to cook authentic and healthy Thai food in a beautiful setting with a wonderful teacher, Sasi. It really did feel like being taught how to cook proper Thai dishes by a friend in their own home, and we were made to feel more like friends and guests rather than clients or customers; Sasi’s warmth and friendliness are truly genuine.

Sasi is a very knowledgeable cook and a great teacher, and she also explains the Thai approach to cooking and eating. She's also a lot of fun, and a great host, and makes a mean house-style Pina colada!

Previously, I had done a four-day cookery course in Chiang Mai, which was good, but it just did not compare to this, even though it was longer. Harvesting some of the herbs and making your own coconut milk from scratch, as we did, made it much more rewarding, as well as making the dishes really fresh and tasty. Even a common staple like pad Thai was better than any pad Thai I’d eaten in the last 30 years, in Thailand or in any other country. I think this is down to the love, care and attention Sasi takes and encourages when cooking, as well as the top cooking tips that you simply do not get from following cookery books. We also made super-fresh som tam, getting the balance of flavours just right (the key to amazing Thai dishes), some fried chicken wings to go with the som tam, and a Phanaeng curry, again with perfectly balanced flavours (salty, sweet, and makrut lime for this particular dish).

Making your curry pastes from scratch really does make a huge difference. Usually when I cook, I don’t enjoy the dishes as much as my guests seem to enjoy them, but the cookery day with Sasi was so rewarding and enjoyable, and in such a lovely setting, I really enjoyed every mouthful of what we cooked, as if it was made by the finest Thai chef. This is not average Thai restaurant-style food though, like you might get in a Thai restaurant in Europe (or even Bangkok) - it’s a level above, fresher and healthier, with a focus on high quality ingredients, including organic herbs from Sasi’s garden. The day also made me appreciate the complexity of Thai flavours, but don’t be put off, as the dishes are perfectly achievable at home for someone with reasonable cookery skills. Sasi also understands that we are not all going to sit at home on a 'rabbit' grating coconut to press for milk, so she also explains shop-bought substitutes that can be bought, and which are the best type to buy.

Twenty-eight years (!) after my first Thai cookery course, I’ve been inspired again to make the effort, to source good quality, fresh Thai ingredients (often available in big cities in the UK now), and to make my own curry pastes once again (it’s worth the additional effort, as they are so much better than shop-bought versions, and they keep in the fridge for a bit, so you can make several meals).

Thank you, Sasi, and I hope to visit your home in the future, to learn how to prepare some other dishes AND have the best Thai feast at the end of it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Jake! ❤️ I'm humbled by your words... and feel a bit sorry that it took so long for me to reply. But here I am... :-)

Wow, thank you so much for taking the time to write such a beautiful and detailed review. It makes me very happy to read your words, especially because you understand so well what I want to share with my guests.

For me, Thai cooking is not just about following a recipe. It is about understanding the ingredients, learning how to balance the flavours, and knowing why we do things in a certain way. A little more sweet, a little more sour, a little more salty… we taste, we adjust, and slowly the dish becomes just right. 😊

I'm so happy you enjoyed picking the herbs, making fresh coconut milk and preparing the curry pastes from scratch. These traditional ways take a little more time, but they help us understand our food in a different way. And I love that you also appreciated learning which ingredients and shop-bought alternatives we can use at home. We cannot all sit with a coconut grater every day! 😂🥥

Your words about the Pad Thai really made me smile! And I am especially happy that you enjoyed eating the food you prepared yourself. Sometimes when we cook with our own hands, understand the ingredients and put care into every step, the food tastes even more special.

What you said about feeling like friends in my home means a lot to me. I never want my guests to feel like just customers coming for a cooking lesson. I want everyone to feel welcome, relax, enjoy themselves, ask questions, laugh and share a lovely meal together. For me, this is the happiness of cooking.

And now, after 28 years, I'm so happy that our day together has inspired you to start making your own curry pastes again! ❤️ I hope you have lots of fun experimenting with fresh ingredients back home in the UK.

Thank you again, Jake, for such kind words and for appreciating not only the food, but also the traditions, care and love behind it. It would be a real pleasure to welcome you back to my home and cook together again. We still have many more Thai dishes to explore — and of course, another Piña Colada waiting for you! 😂🍹

Sending you lots of love from Pattaya,
Sasi ❤️🇹🇭

reviews.name: Grace Wang
reviews.text:
5/5 ⭐️ Absolutely unforgettable Thai cooking experience!

Our family and friends joined a cooking class at Sasi’s Lovemade Kitchen, and it was truly one of the best cultural experiences we’ve ever had. We cooked four dishes—Tom Yum Goong, Coconut Chicken Soup, Glass Noodles with Minced Shrimp, and Green Curry—and every step was fun, hands-on, and surprisingly educational.

We started by harvesting fresh herbs and vegetables from Sasi’s organic garden. Everything was picked right before cooking—the fragrance of the herbs alone was amazing. Then came the highlight: making coconut milk from scratch. We cracked open real coconuts, collected the fresh coconut water, used the traditional Thai “rabbit” grater to scrape the coconut meat, and hand-pressed the milk twice. The taste compared to store-bought coconut milk is simply incomparable.

For the green curry, we stir-fried the herbs to release their aroma, then pounded them into a paste with basil leaves—the whole kitchen smelled incredible. The Tom Yum paste was bright, fresh, and full of flavor, and the BBQ prawns added the perfect smoky touch.

At the end, we sat together and enjoyed the dishes we made ourselves, and everything tasted unbelievably delicious.

Sasi is a warm, patient, and knowledgeable teacher, and the entire experience feels authentic, personal, and full of joy. If you want to learn real Thai cooking—this is THE place. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
I joined Sasi’s Lovemade Kitchen with friends and kids.
Held at Sasi’s beautiful home inside a golf course, we were welcomed by towering banana trees and a lovely garden. The East-meets-West decor and floral arrangements were also charming.

We picked herbs from the garden and even cracked coconuts were truly special experiences. The dishes which made with mostly organic ingredients were gentle and delicious.

Menu:
•	Pomelo Salad
•	Green Curry
•	Crab Curry (Poo Phad Phong Curry)

We enjoyed welcome drinks, pina coladas, coconut sweets during breaks, and even surprise giant river prawn BBQ and wine, making for a luxurious lunch. It was more than just a cooking class — it was a beautiful lesson in the true spirit of hospitality, showing how to warmly welcome guests into your home.
Highly recommended!

reviews.text: The place to go if you want to emerge yourself in the Thai kitchen. We did a vegan morning cooking class which exceeded every expectation. Pon was an amazing host and the class was full of surprises. Make sure you come hungry, especially for the morning class!

reviews.name: Michele Dastin-van Rijn
reviews.text: A great epicurean experience! We hit all the basics to make almost every Thai dish starting with red and green curry pastes. We learned some cooking tricks that will definitely be incorporated into our prep. The owner, Ponlee, and staff are lovely. Best of all, she accommodated my need for gluten free cooking.

reviews.name: Ella Henson
reviews.text: The express cooking class with Jenny was fantastic! The food was delightful, with plenty of time to relax and enjoy between making the next dish. The class went for closer to 3 hours, but no complaints about that, we had a wonderful time 😊

reviews.name: Cameron Tweed
reviews.text: Had a great meal here. The restaurant was quiet but the staff were very attentive and friendly. Would recommend any of the curries (but I’m sure all the other food is great!) - you can taste how fresh the curry paste is here too. Nice to try black sticky rice and the mango portion was very generous! So good it has convinced us to do the cooking class too.

reviews.name: Ellen S
reviews.text: Fantastic cooking school. Great hands on cooking and then you get to eat what you cooked. The food was fresh and delicious! We bought the cookbook and look forward to continue to cook these excellent recipes

reviews.name: Jane K
reviews.text:
First it's important to note that although Green Garden Cooking School website is in French they definitely do classes in English. Just send them an email to ask about available dates.
We had a delightful morning with Pon, her son Oo and aunties. The class is held in Pon's home in a small street not far from the river in the old city area. Easy to find by tuktuk or walking. We were staying about 10-15min walk away so it was a very relaxing start for us. The class begins with a trip to the local market (Thewet) which is a wet market - fresh produce, veggies, fruit, fish, meat etc. It's not hectic at all - the local people shopping - and Pon knows mostly everyone.
Then back to Pon's house to prepare the dishes. We cooked 2 different kinds of soups, 2 curries, made a green curry paste, spring rolls and a dessert. We also  asked to make Som Tum as we have become addicted to it while in Thailand!
Pon prepares all the veg & other ingredients in advance so the emphasis is on how easy it is to make the deliciousness come together quickly. And before you know it you're eating a fab dish. So don't eat too much before you come otherwise you won't fit it all in!
This is a unique experience because you are in a down to earth, happy family home that doubles as a home stay and pop up restaurant. There are family and friends coming & going all through the class and a constant stream of chatting & laughter.
Pon and her family have much they are pleased to share about food & Thai life in general so it isn't simply a cooking class. It is a lot more - an experience with heart & soul.
Sanuk maak maak :)
Ps Pon can make her classes vegetarian or vegan on request.

reviews.name: Prat Prathnadi
reviews.text:
250 baht a day use. The place is clean, not crowded between 7-11am weekday. Lots of equipment to work all parts of the body.  Cardio stuff is down stairs and the weights are upstairs. The bathroom is clean and well maintained. There is water faucet that dispenses cold water. Overall the place is good, but not great.

The two times I went, a Wednesday and Friday, they have no clean towels to wipe the sweats. So you need to bring your own towel. At this rate, I expect the towels to be available. There is no excuses that the washing machine was down.

reviews.name: Mari Lahdenperä
reviews.text:
I've been to this gym for a month now. Amazing gym 🤗 The weight lifting room is smaller, but it has everything you need and it's never crowded. Many leg machines, assistant pull up machine, racks, small to big dumbells and all the basic machines too.

1st floor cardio, 2nd floor weights and 3rd floor 2 class rooms, which you can use for training/warmup/streching outside of class times. They have classes 9AM-11.15 & 5-8.30PM. The yoga classes here are amazing 🔥 So amazing that I've been to morning yoga classes 3x/week and even started Fly Yoga basics on Thursdays (must try! 🥳). Classes are included to the membership. One month 1799THB (50e).

Clean toilets, showers and free water dispencers. Staff is super friendly. The class teachers are amazing and speak fluent english. 80% customers are Thai and 20% tourists.

10/10 would recommend 🥳🤗 I will definitely be back here every year when I come to Chiang Mai.

reviews.text: omg i love this place ❤️ i had such an amazing week here, visiting a couple of classes each day! the coaches are super professional, nice, funny, motivated and motivating! all the courses are on a really high level, what i even loved more! it’s really not overcrowded, i even had three classes all by myself with the trainer (thx again for not cancelling, i really appreciate the efforts 🙏) also the staff at the reception has always been so welcoming and friendly! the gym facilities are outstanding, probably the best treadmill i’ve ever used. you can even lock your stuff and take a shower. the whole gym is super clean and the weekly price for 800 baht includes all the classes, so it’s really cheap for what you get! i really wanna thank den, golf, ohm and patrick for this memorable awesome time 🙏❤️i miss you already 😅

reviews.text: Great and clean gym. Lots of devices. On two floors - cardio part at the ground floor, weight lifting room and other machines in the first floor. Wardrobe’s look clean and tidy. A bit pricey I would say for Thai, but overall good value. Also offering shakes after workout. Will be coming back.

reviews.name: Degen Hill
reviews.text:
Great gym. Located within the Chiangmai Ram compound, ABSolute has everything you need for a solid workout. Cardio room is downstairs, with weight training room upstairs. Has dumbbell free weights, straight dumbbell bars, 2 squat racks, smith machine, lots of cable machines, and a free weight leg press. At only 250 baht for 1 day, I’d highly recommend this gym.

Some interesting artwork as well…

reviews.text: This is the best gym in Chiang Mai.  The equipment here is new and well maintained.  There are three, air conditioned areas (treadmills/cardio, weights/machines, and yoga zumba) on three levels.  A locker area with  keys and showers is provided and the staff is friendly and speaks English. Daily and monthly rates are fairly priced for such a clean, modern facility. You will find a good mix of both Thai and foreigners here.  ABSolute Gym raises the bar for gyms in Chiang Mai.

reviews.text:
Pros:
-- It’s CLEAN, bright, lots green!
-- The personal training lessons blew out my mind (awesome)
Super clear instructions from trainer Den!
•
So I had one year of good lessons with personal trainers in Taiwan so at first I wasn’t quite sure if I could be the same satisfied with the trainers here, especially since English is not their first language — I was so worried the instructions would be not clear and I could hurt myself.
.
I took the one-week membership first and during that time, through the experience of group lessons such as HIIT, Circuit, Step, and Bosu Ball, I got to know those personal trainers’ styles. Then I started the one-on-one lessons!
.
Cons:
— the locks of the ladies’ toilets are funny, girls should be aware to turn that 3 times throughout the way down to lock it properly. It will be great to put an ALERT on the doors!
-- It’s a shame the showers are with no shower heads

reviews.name: Adelita
reviews.text:
I can't say I'm in love with this gym, partly because it's expensive, and because it lacks adequate equipment and layout logistics.

I don't really understand why they have all the floors split up the way they do?  It sounds good on paper, but when you try to do a CrossFit style workout, or skipping with weights, or pull-ups, the layout and the lack of equipment and space really show.

Would it kill them to double up on the kettle bells the have ALL THE WAY UP ON THE 3RD FLOOR?  Or double up on the dumbbells because the lighter ones get used up quickly?  Or maybe add a rower or an echo bike amongst the sea of treadmills?  Or better yet, add a couple treadmills in the functional fitness area?

These are small inconveniences because you can try to make all of this work but it would be nice to have a gym provide these things for the price that you're paying to use it.  On a positive note, I really appreciate the cleanliness and the security, though.  The staff is super friendly and the facility is conveniently located.

reviews.text: I recently had a fantastic stay at Absolute Gym, located near Chiang Mai's old town. The gym is new, clean, and well-equipped with a variety of modern cardio machines, free weights, and spacious group fitness studios. I purchased a weekly membership, which offered great value and included access to engaging yoga classes. The instructors were exceptional, especially in assisting foreigners like myself. I also tried personal training and was impressed by the trainers' knowledge and friendly demeanor. The gym's reception staff was welcoming and helpful. reviews.text: I'm from Taiwan and this is my second time in Chiang Mai. The gym environment is clean and comfortable. I like it very much.

reviews.name: Amanda
reviews.text:
I got a week long pass while on vacation and used this gym exclusively for cardio. The machines are Steelflex which isn’t a brand I’m familiar with but I’ve been living in Peloton-world for so long that I wouldn’t recognize most brands.

In terms of aesthetics and function they remind me of the serviceable 10 year old “workhorse” machines you find at the tiny hotel gyms. Only there are a lot more of them at ABSolute Gym. They have treadmills, ellipticals, recumbent bikes, and regular stationary bikes. Plus some bikes for spinning.

The cardio room was never crowded - at most I saw three other people in there. It’s air conditioned which is nice but I would’ve appreciated it being one or two degrees cooler since I was doing cardio. Several of the machines were out of service the entire week which was odd, particularly as the signs seemed pretty worn and like they’d been there a while.

The women’s locker room was a little run down but fairly clean. The machines were pretty clean and they have a cart with cleaning spray and towels at the back of the room so you can sanitize the machine when you’re done.

This is the first gym I’ve been to that doesn’t provide towels - maybe it’s a Thailand thing?

The staff was respectful and professional but not overly friendly. This place served my needs for a nearby place to get some cardio done in an efficient way.

ownerDescription: ร้านสะอาด บริการดี ใส่ใจบริการ นวดสบาย ผ่อนคลายทุกระดับ

reviews.name: Alexander Cillan
reviews.text:
Very affordable massage place, but unfortunately the quality didn’t really match our expectations.

We booked a foot, shoulders, head, and back massage, but more than half of the session was focused only on the feet. The pressure throughout the massage was extremely light. Instead of a proper massage, it felt more like gentle rubbing rather than actual muscle work. If you’re looking for a stronger or more therapeutic massage, this probably won’t be the place.

Another downside was the noise. The door was often left open, so traffic and street sounds were constantly coming in, which made it harder to relax.

The only clear positive point is the price, around 300 THB for one hour, which is quite cheap. Still, considering how unsatisfied we felt when leaving, even that price didn’t fully make up for the experience.

Overall, a very mediocre massage experience. Cheap, but you shouldn’t expect much.

The price is reasonable and the massage skills are good, but the space is small and it is crowded with many foreign customers.

ownerDescription: Traditional Muay Thai gym. We are a small community gym with more then 50 years experience. From beginner to champion we had them all. All level welcome 🙏🏽
address: 470, 34 Changklan Rd, Chang Khlan Sub-district Sub-district, Mueang, Chiang Mai 50100, Chiang Mai 50300, Thailand

reviews.name: Alexander Witkin
reviews.text:
As a Martial Arts enthusiast (and massage therapist), one of my main intentions here in Thailand 🇹🇭 was to train in the sacred and beautiful expression of Muay Thai, which is adorned with respect and lots of sweat 😅!

I got my training gear and sought out to explore various gyms around Chiang Mai, until one captured my full heart and attention.
After some research, I decided to try out this gym first. It was closest to me which was important because my main transport is by bicycle.  Also, it had the * cheapest prices I saw and awesome reviews - it was a no-brainer to come here 1st 🥇.

Lo-and behold, I have been training here ever since, as often as I can, sometimes twice a day, for almost 4 weeks now, and it’s been nothing short of incredible. Ninja 🥷 the cat 🐈‍⬛, the brotherly love, our awesome Coach Gem 💎 (who speaks many languages: Turkish, German, English, Thai and maybe another 🤔, and is decorated with over 120 fights) and other Thai coaches are awesome too!

To top it off, there are some genuinely skilled and fierce fighters here with hearts of gold. If you’re a Martial Artist who really appreciates a brotherly/sisterly family vibe, with solid coaching and training, then this gym is for you!  I’m pretty much a total beginner in MT and I feel my technique has a solid foundation already - their attention to detail and technique is great and this is what you need for a solid, fierce foundation 🙏

I highly recommend for all levels- from beginners to advanced fighters, you can gain a lot from this gym and the special characters who train here.

Im truly grateful, thank you Coaches Chembo and Kru Gao!  Chang Puak MT will always hold a place in my heart!  I pray I can continue to return to Chiang Mai often, throughout my life and train here for many, many years to come! ☺️🙏🌟💚👊🥊

reviews.name: Maciej Tymiński
reviews.text:
Great place to train for both, beginners and experienced fighters. If you are a beginner, it is a good place because people here are very welcoming. From day one I felt like a part of the team which was the most important aspect of my journey. No ego, no problems, just bunch of friendly people trying to better themselves. If you are more advanced, this place is great to get further understanding of Muay Thai as the coaches are knowledgeable and experienced.

If at the moment you don’t have your own gear you can start with one that is available on place, the gear is clean and in good condition, similarly to the facility itself.

I spent over a month training here few times a week and it was a blast, had lots of fun, learned a lot and can’t wait to be back. Big thank you to the whole Chang Puak Muay Thai Team!

reviews.name: Jakob Rodermund
reviews.text:
Chang Puak Muay Thai Review

This is hands down the best Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai—I can say that confidently after training here for the past four weeks. The gym has just reopened following renovations, and everything is impressively organized by the head coach and owner. He speaks fluent English, German, and Thai, so everyone can follow along. The other coaches are equally experienced, having all competed themselves.

Training usually begins with a quick but intense warm-up, often including a group run. After that, you move into one-on-one pad work, where the coaches tailor their instruction perfectly to your level—whether you’re a beginner, intermediate, or pro. All levels are welcome, and you’ll receive great coaching no matter your experience. Next comes heavy-bag work to sharpen your techniques, followed by light Thai-style sparring or clinch drills. Everything stays pretty basic but fun, just as you’d expect in a traditional Thai gym.

Although it’s primarily a local Thai gym—with many fighters boasting hundreds of bouts—the small number of foreigners are always warmly welcomed. The gym is easy to reach: it’s only a 5–10 minute scooter ride from the Old Town and is located in a Thai neighborhood full of affordable, high-quality food options for post-training meals.

Facilities include showers, toilets, and changing rooms, all disinfected daily to maintain high hygiene standards. They’ve also added a cold plunge, which is fantastic for recovery, and they plan to introduce a dedicated weights room for strength and conditioning soon. On top of all that, their prices are very fair—considerably cheaper than other Muay Thai gyms, yet the training quality is superior.

Go see for yourself by taking session—I highly recommend Chang Puak MT if you’re looking for an authentic Muay Thai experience in the Chiang Mai area. In the meantime, follow their Instagram channel to see the gym in action (changpuak.muaythai)

Special thanks to Cem, Benji, Kru Roen, and Pattson for the excellent coaching over the past few weeks. If you’re planning to fight, they’ll take great care of you!

reviews.name: Luukas Sandberg
reviews.text: The best gym if you really want to train hard and improve your Muay Thai. I trained here for a month and improved so much. I highly recommend this gym to everyone, no matter your experience level. ขอบคุณ🙏

★★★★★

Great Muay Thai gym with a professional setup and a really good atmosphere. It has a strong community feel, and you can tell the coach puts a lot of heart into what he does. Training is focused and structured, but still enjoyable.

It’s a great place for professional fighters as well as for people who train as a hobby. I’m more on the hobby side myself, and I always feel welcome, supported, and pushed to improve at my own pace.
Definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Daniel Mooney
reviews.text: I’ve been training at this gym for the last few weeks and my development as a fighter has been greatly improved. The coaches are very attentive to detail and also really easy to get a long with creating a fun atmosphere to learn and grow. Couldn’t recommend this gym more for people looking to train Muay Thai with a good vibe.

reviews.name: Tristen Jones
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at Chang Puak Gym in Chiang Mai for about two months, and it’s been an amazing experience. The training is real Muay Thai challenging but rewarding and I’ve grown so much, both physically and mentally.

What makes this place special isn’t just the training, it’s the people. There’s a real sense of community here. You meet people from all over the world Asia, Europe, the U.S., everywhere and somehow everyone becomes family. We push each other, laugh together, and look out for one another. It’s the kind of place that makes you feel at home, even when you’re far from home.

The coach is also incredible. He speaks Turkish, German, Thai, and English, so he connects easily with everyone. He’s patient, knowledgeable, and always willing to explain things until you get it right.

Whether you’re here to fight, get fit, or just experience Muay Thai culture, this gym welcomes you with open arms. I’m really grateful to have found it.

reviews.name: Dawit Kiflie

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Perfect Gym – Experienced Trainers & Great Community!

Whether you’re a beginner or an advanced athlete, every exercise is explained step by step, and the trainers ensure that the technique is executed correctly. Another big plus is the gym’s community. Many locals train here regularly, creating a very friendly and supportive atmosphere. Whether it’s training tips or motivation, you always get help. This positive sense of community makes training even more enjoyable and pushes you to do your best.

The equipment is modern, there is plenty of space for all training levels, and cleanliness is top-notch. If you’re looking for a gym where you’ll receive professional guidance and feel comfortable, this is the place for you!

Highly recommended – a perfect combination of expertise and a strong, supportive community!

reviews.name: Mel San Juan
reviews.text:
The coaching team is exceptional. Each coach brings their own focus and strengths. We had just under a year of regular training in Australia and wanted to improve our technique and confidence. We got that and far more, especially in timing, distance management, fight IQ, balance and control. Alongside near-daily group classes, we booked 1:1 sessions with Coach Oat, Coach Tom and Coach Mike, and every one was outstanding. We chose 1:1’s based on coaches we as individuals felt strongest connections with in group classes, but once again every coach brings something truly special and valuable and I wouldn’t hesitate to work with any coach at the academy it’s a really exceptional team…. And beyond the skill development, the environment is FUN, the coaches are also fun and playful which makes learning really positive and fun. I think that’s important! And another benefit is they hire a videographer to take clips of your training during group classes, and I really appreciated this because it’s a nice memory, and since I was training for 2 weeks I got to see my own progress over that period it was really validating to see myself improve in skill, and show up more confidently!

Even without 1:1s, the group classes are great value. Each includes about five rounds of pad work with the coaches, which gave us more individual attention than the gyms I've trained at in Sydney.

I also loved the Thai style and the "sabai sabai" mindset. It's grounding, and I'm taking it home to my training in Sydney.

The talent in the gym is unreal too. Many coaches are current or former ONE Championship or Rajadamnern champions, and other active ONE fighters (and champions) train there regularly. Learning alongside that level of skill was a real highlight.

I'm so grateful for the experience and would go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.name: Q, Edmond
reviews.text:
Visited Let’s Relax Spa Central Park Mall on 28 May 2026 for a 2-hour massage session and left extremely disappointed.

The biggest issue was that the actual effective massage time was significantly less than the 2 hours we paid for. Therapists started late, ended early (didn't compensate the late start), and there were repeated periods of what felt like stalling rather than proper massage (frequent walking in and out, time spent away, long stretches of minimal effort, and excessive time wiping off oil). One therapist also accidentally hit a painful spot with her elbow, causing discomfort instead of relaxation.

The experience was further affected by hygiene and environment concerns. Our feet were not washed before treatment and it's gross and unsanitary for the masseur to just go ahead rubbing our unwashed feet and then bringing the same hands across our entire body. About halfway through, the in-room music stopped completely and loud noise from a nearby room became disruptive. When asked, we were simply told, “shop has closed,” despite our paid session still being in progress.

The reception area was unattended (all staff has gone home) when we finished and we had to figure out how to leave the closing mall ourselves until the same therapist saw us and eventually showed us the exit.

For a premium-priced spa, this experience fell far below expectations in professionalism, service quality, and value for money. I also emailed management regarding these concerns but they did not bother to response so far. I will not be returning and cannot recommend this spa to others. Bangkok has many massage establishments that charge less while providing a far more professional and customer-focused experience.

reviews.name: Viktor Cheung
reviews.text:
I have been visiting Let’s Relax for 15 years, but it is clear that as they have expanded, the quality of service has plummeted. My recent visit with a group of four was easily in the top 3 worst massage experiences of my life.

For our 2-hour package (1-hour body wrap and 1-hour oil massage), the experience was unprofessional from start to finish:

Poor Environment: The room was freezing, the bed was not heated for the wrap, and the wrap itself was applied ice-cold without warning. There was no music and the lights were left glaringly bright. To make matters worse, the headrest was not set up properly, leaving me with a sore neck until I had to intervene to fix it myself.

Lack of Training & Communication: There was a significant language barrier, making it impossible to communicate. Furthermore, despite filling out a form requesting specific areas to avoid, the therapist completely ignored these instructions and pressured those exact spots.

Unprofessional Conduct: The therapist appeared completely untrained and impatient. The movements were aggressive and rushed, as if she couldn't wait to finish her shift. It felt less like a spa treatment and more like being handled roughly. Even the music was turned off mid-session because the staff claimed they weren't allowed to play it after 11 PM.

Declining Standards: Even the signature mango sticky rice—once a highlight of visiting here—has suffered a severe drop in quality; the mango served was poor and nowhere near the standard they used to maintain.

This used to be a reliable brand, but the rapid expansion has clearly come at the expense of proper training and guest comfort. Based on this experience, this place should be called "Not Relax." I cannot recommend this outlet and will not be returning.

Highly recommend you try this place, the lady who helped me was genuinely nice and very cool. 10/10 Next time I come to Chiang Mai I hope I can come to this place 🙏🏾🫶🏾🫶🏾 I also have read the comments about pressure and how it wasn’t good but the ladies here are older and people should take that into consideration before expecting a lot from them. reviews.text:
The man doing my foot massage was terrible - he moved incredibly fast and was rubbing my leg with so much friction that I felt like my skin was going to pull off. And when I say foot massage, I really mean leg massage since he only rubbed my calves; my foot was just a place to rest his inactive hand. On top of the already bad massage, he stopped massaging entirely for long periods of time while he talked to other employees.

Before the massage even started, they asked me to change out of my pants into some looser fitting pants. As I was changing the lady holding the curtain just dropped the curtain entirely so the whole staff could see me standing in my underwear. It was sort of funny, but also an incredible invasion of my privacy and I imagine most people (myself included) wouldn't want that.

I'll never come here again, and I recommend everyone else to find ANYWHERE else to go for a massage.

Edit: forgot to mention that they stopped the massage at 45 minutes and then charged me for the full hour. I was happy to pay and have it finished honestly.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: So sorry about that I will fix it 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Alex Merrifield
reviews.text: Felt very rushed. Constantly interrupted to try to get new customers in. "Foot massage" was just a leg massage with bad pressure. Kept making calls to try to get more workers for new customers they recruited. One lady who was called over from another place seemed good but sadly neither of us got her. Would never come back and never recommend.

reviews.name: Kirk
reviews.text: Just had the best massage ever! Would highly recommend to anyone in Chiang mai, a great price and was also given some refreshments afterwards.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: “You're most welcome.”Thank you very much for your kind words. Your feedback means a lot to our massage shop and hope to see you again.

reviews.name: Bonnie Lin
reviews.text: Great massage place. Went there three times during our stay in Chiang Mai. The masseuses are always polite and professional. I definitely recommend this place. Family friendly.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you 🙏 It's a pleasure to serve you again.

reviews.name: Kentaro Hara
reviews.text: I like a strong but deep massage and indeed it was strong but not deep at all. And it happened to me a few times but it is recommended not to go at late time every massager is not motivated

reviews.name: Wee Seng Lim
reviews.text: Same experience as previous reviewer. 1.5 hr of having a middle age lady wiping her hands on my body. Did not feel any massage at all. Avoid the oil massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I’m apologize for inconvenience . Thanks for review , please booking for good staff,

title: THYME House Massage Phayathai
ownerDescription: Massage & Spa BTS Phayathai exit 2
address: 55/12 Phaya Thai Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Thung Phayathai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

reviews.name: Chituru Georgette Okoroma
reviews.text: Had a walk in service and was attended to almost immediately. Very lovely staff, clean and nice scented environment. I had the warm oil massage with medium pressure and it was absolutely amazing! The best full body massage I’ve had during my trip. I would definitely recommend. Payment by card available with no service charge for now (T&C may change)

reviews.name: Chloe L
reviews.text: Great massage, professional and calming. Space is clean. There were two of us and we got placed in a room together with a curtain in-between for the 90 minute warm oil massage. The weighted blanket when they turn you around was a pleasant surprise. Would come here again!

reviews.name: Annie
reviews.text: I found this massage place on google and it was easy to locate with good video directions. The 1hr deep tissue was well worth it, my masseuse was strong and hit all the spots. Don't do it if you can't handle pressure! Great service with water, tea and cold towels for you to freshen up.

reviews.name: Kate Cheung
reviews.text:
Very chill night!
We saw this massage shop on IG, and decided to try a foot massage
The staff is very patient to answer my booking questions. And the massage is amazing!
My leg muscles are always sore, after doing the massage, I totally feel much better
If you’re in the holiday in Bangkok, don’t hesitate !

reviews.name: Lydia Li
reviews.text: An incredibly relaxing experience! The masseuse was highly skilled, perfectly adjusting the pressure. The environment was peaceful, clean, and welcoming. I left feeling completely rejuvenated and would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a professional and high-quality massage!

reviews.name: Cristian Guazo
reviews.text: We're staying near this massage place and we booked the last slot for the day (9 pm). Totally loved how accommodating the staff were. My masseuse gave me the best massage I have so far! Would highly recommend. ❤️

reviews.name: Mark Bandte
reviews.text:
Was definitely worth the little extra in price. I’ve never had a massage that made an hour feel like 2.
Very intuitive and customised to what I needed. Will definitely try to come back and recommend stopping by.

reviews.name: awtumn
reviews.text: I had a bad feet sore after walking in a wrong fitted shoes but the masseuse healed that away. My foot massage went well, minimal talking, had a private room too. Had to climbed a few stairs to reach the reception so people with disabilities might need to consider. I haven't made a reservation, but they managed to slot me in and i just had to wait for about 20 mins. Thank you so much for the nice experience.

reviews.name: sky Nuttha
reviews.text: Visited Thyme Massage today with my family from Singapore and we all loved it so much 🤍 We did a neck, shoulder, and foot massage for four people, and everything was just perfect. The staff were so kind, helpful, and extremely polite throughout. The location is also very convenient. Such a lovely and relaxing experience

reviews.name: Lionel Tham
reviews.text:
Great back massage and very skillful staff, much more affordable than 'next door' massage
A bit hidden place, small entrance easily miss it, nearby BTS And Airport Train station

reviews.name: JM
reviews.text: Very nice environment compared to other Thai massage parlours. Feels serene, clean and smells nice. Good service pre and post massage with cold/hot towels. Unfortunately my partner found his hot oil massage to be less than satisfactory due to masseuse technique and strength.

reviews.name: DreamFoodie
reviews.text:
This Thai massage centre offers one of the best massage experiences in Bangkok. The atmosphere is calm and welcoming from the moment you walk in, and the staff are attentive, professional, and genuinely skilled. A special mention goes to Perry, the therapist, whose technique was exceptional and made the entire session deeply relaxing and truly rejuvenating. She maintained the perfect balance of pressure and rhythm, easing tension while still keeping the massage soothing and enjoyable from start to finish.

The aroma massage with medium pressure was an excellent choice. The experience begins with selecting your preferred oils and scrubs, allowing you to personalise the treatment to your liking.

The thoughtfulness continue after the session. Guests are offered a refreshing green tea and a small cookie, adding a comforting finish to the experience. The centre is impressively clean, hygienic, and well-maintained, which enhances the overall sense of comfort and professionalism.

Overall, this place delivers outstanding service, skilled therapists, and a peaceful environment. With therapists like Perry providing such high-quality care, it truly stands out. A full five-star experience and highly recommended for anyone looking for a top-tier massage in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Coralie Barthas
reviews.text:
A wonderful massage salon. Very clean and pleasant. The welcome was excellent, and the massage therapists were absolutely amazing. Discreet, friendly, and very attentive.

We highly recommend this place without hesitation. Thank you for this truly relaxing moment before catching our flight back to France.

reviews.name: Nanzy Warali
reviews.text: One hidden gem in the middle of Bangkok city. I had one of the best Aromatic massage with Tee. She has excellent hand movements techniques that make the knots melted away with the right pressure. The music and ambient is peaceful and clean, the cold tower in the beginning and the hot towel in the end is very sensational! I highly recommended this place.

reviews.name: Nemo
reviews.text: We came here because of the high reviews, but the actual experience was quite disappointing. Both of us agreed that the massage techniques were rather unpolished, and the pressure wasn't well-controlled—it just didn't feel comfortable. Throughout the session, the therapist seemed to be in a real hurry, almost as if rushing through each area just to move on to the next. Given the quality of service and the high price, it really didn't feel worth it. We probably won't be coming back.

reviews.name: Nicole Somerville
reviews.text: Booked a Thai Balm massage 90 minutes, wow amazing ladies. Beautiful and professional massage palour, great price. Worth a visit if staying at The Unicorn building, Eastern Grand hotel or Phaya Thai area (BTS). 2 min from the hotel

reviews.name: Cole Lin
reviews.text: I had the most incredible essential oil massage here today! The therapist had expert hands that melted away weeks of tension. She carefully selected a calming lavender blend and adjusted the pressure perfectly. The room was beautifully serene with soft music and warm lighting. I left feeling completely rejuvenated, both in body and mind. The entire experience was worth every penny. This is my new go-to spot for self-care. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Emy Kart
reviews.text: LOVED my foot massage so much! They also did my legs and at the end shoulders/neck. My first time I did a massage and it definitely won’t be my laste one here. The salon also looks very nice, modern en clean. I recommend! :)

reviews.name: Eight Zero
reviews.text: The service is very good. My 5 year old daughter do love the foot massage. She did twice in three days.

reviews.name: 777 Lot
reviews.text:
I just had a 1-hour Thai massage here and it was absolutely amazing.
The therapist was very professional, attentive, and made sure the pressure was comfortable throughout the session. I mentioned a past back surgery, and they were extremely careful and considerate, which I really appreciated.

The place is clean, calm, and relaxing — perfect after a long day in Bangkok.
Highly recommended if you’re looking for a quality Thai massage near THYME House Massage Phayathai.
I would definitely come back again!

title: F.A.GROUP MUAYTHAI BANGKOK
subTitle: เอฟ.เอ.กรุ๊ป มวยไทย
address: 270 Vibhavadi Rangsit Rd, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

reviews.name: DJ Fuzz
reviews.text:
FA Group Muay Thai Gym in Bangkok is an absolute must-visit for anyone serious about Muay Thai - and even for those who just want a great workout. This gym carries a legendary reputation in the Bangkok Muay Thai scene, and training here makes it immediately clear why.
FA Group is particularly renowned for their Muay Khao style and superior clinching skills. If you want to develop world-class clinch work and knee fighting - one of the most devastating and technical aspects of Muay Thai - this is the place to learn it. Their expertise in this area is unmatched and widely respected throughout the Muay Thai community.
The gym's track record of producing world-level stadium fighters speaks for itself. Fighters like Yothin and many more have come out of FA Group to compete and dominate at the highest levels. When a gym consistently produces champions of that caliber, you know the training system is elite.
I personally attended their Fit and Fun class, which was an absolute blast. The class focuses on cardio and Muay Thai skills, making it perfect for those who want the authentic experience and a great workout without the pressure of fighter training. It was engaging, challenging, and thoroughly enjoyable.
The gym is open to all levels from complete beginners right through to professional fighters, ensuring everyone gets the right training experience tailored to their goals.
One of the must-go-to gyms in Bangkok without question. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for joining us. Been our pleasure. Very appreciate your feedback and your time writing this wonderful review for us. Hopefully getting to train together again inn the future.

reviews.name: Khoa Nguyen
reviews.text:
I had an amazing private session with Kru. Riw at FA Group Gym. From the moment we started, it was clear how knowledgeable and detail-oriented he is as a coach. I learned a lot during the session, especially when it came to refining my clinch game—something Kru. Riw clearly specializes in. He broke things down in a way that was easy to understand, while still pushing me to improve every round.

One of the highlights was when he brought in his young fighter, Neung, to clinch with me. That experience alone was incredibly valuable. Watching Neung demonstrate technique and then feeling it firsthand gave me a much deeper understanding of timing, balance, and control in the clinch.

The whole session had a great balance of intensity and enjoyment. Kru. Riw created a positive, focused environment, and both he and Neung made the experience fun while still being highly productive.

To top it all off, the gym-made smoothie after the session hit different—it was the perfect way to recover after such a solid workout.

Overall, it was a memorable and rewarding training experience, and I’d highly recommend a private session with Kru. Riw at FA Group Gym for anyone looking to level up their clinch and overall Muay Thai skills.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much :) and hopefully see you again soon! I will read this to Kru Riw :)

reviews.name: Collin Yang-Wong
reviews.text:
I have had the pleasure of training at FA group for ~1 week each year for the past 4 years. I could not recommend this gym more. If you are only in Bangkok for a short duration, I highly recommend 1-1 training with Kru Riw or Kru Tom.

Kru Riw: Extremely detailed breakdowns of techniques in a way even a less naturally athletic fighter can understand. Despite training Muay Thai for a decent amount of years, Kru Riw still found holes in certain fundamentals and worked with me to fix these issues (for jiu jitsu practitioners: think “advanced basics”). Most coaches don’t have the patience or put in the effort to fix your fundamentals, especially if you can’t quickly fix a certain movement after a few corrections. Kru Riw provided specific drills to work through my issues. I found this extremely valuable.

Kru Tom: It’s always a pleasure training with Kru Tom - he will push you to the limit during each session while showing you ~3-4 new techniques in both the clinch and on the pads. Clinching with Tom is both fun and exhausting - you learn through doing while he corrects your mistakes. Tom will not only refine your fundamentals but quickly ramp up your clinch game. I have written down a whole list of clinch techniques that I have picked up with Kru Tom over the years and apply them regularly.

I look forward to returning to FA group next year to train with Kru Riw and Tom.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for this amazing review. Your review is not just positive, it’s also very helpful for the gym and for people who is looking to train but dont know who to go with. Thanks so much for your time. And looking forward to see you again 🙏.

reviews.name: André Mello
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing experience. I trained at FA for 30 days and people are amazing, all the krus, the training is really great I appreciate all the krus and the gym!

I did a private session with Yothin! Highly recommend you really learn a lot
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much :)

reviews.name: Günce Akpınar
reviews.text:
I have been here for 3 months so far and have had a great experience. If you want to focus on improving your clinch game, this is the best gym. Every clinch training dedicates 45 minutes to live clinch rounds and on-the-spot feedback from the coaches. A lot of people come and go, but I was lucky to always have great female partners. Coaches pay a lot of attention to match you with someone at your level/intensity.

As coaches get to know you, they start to personalize your training more. I am fighting soon and asked Kru Riw to help me get ready for the fight. Kru Riw is a very detail-oriented coach and won't let you get away with bad habits - like ever. Even from watching outside, you can observe that he truly cares and puts in extra effort for his fighters.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for this positive feedback, and hopefully seeing u again soon.

reviews.name: 貝蒂Betty
reviews.text: Best Muay Thai gym with the bestest people here! Teaches with passion and great hospitality to all ❤️❤️❤️ Had a chance to fight FA Fight Night in Krabi this time, and had the time of our lives!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for coming! We love having your crew at the gym! A lot of sweat and laugh at the same time. Thanks again for coming, and hopefully we get to train together again soon.

reviews.name: Kate Quick
reviews.text: Really welcoming gym with high level coaching. Our Twin Tigers students had the best time training with Tom,  Yothin and the team whilst preparing for the WBC world games. Thank you for your support and knowledge 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, was our pleasure to train your team. And looking forward to see you guys again soon.

reviews.name: Ian V.
reviews.text: 'Fit and fun' training, sunday 1st march, 4PM. A young guy came late, no hello, no excuse, not a word. He 'called me' only with his hands, like a doggo, for hand strapping. In an other context, I'd leave instantly but I needed that sweat, this day. An other young person came afterwards ; the two young 'trainers' continued to be nonchalant or moking in thai, all the way of the 'training'. The supervision of an experienced fighter or owner would have been necessary, in my opinion, to change the attitude of the 'fit and fun' guys. Installation / material were old and the unique shower, filthy. I bought water from a 'fridge' that came to room temperature, hence hot. I honestly can't recommend this structure for beginners or people looking for a positive and enjoyable moment
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm so sorry for you your experience. As a manager of F.A.GROUP FIGHTER CAMP, I will convey this message to the "F.A.GROUP MAUYTHAI FIT & FUN" team and I will try to make sure we fix these issues and no one have to face the same issues as you do.

reviews.name: ligsy
reviews.text: The training is neither good nor bad, you will get your 3 rounds on the pads (there was a time when 5 was the norm). Clinching and lots of drills. Good for conditioning and very structured training, but very little in the way of feedback. Its good to see that FA group is still open after all these years, when lots of the other old school gyms have closed down, but dont be confused, its not the FA group of old. All foreigners with no thai's training is never a good sign of a gym on the up.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your comment. And thanks for coming back after all these years. We will take your feedback and keep improving.

reviews.name: baqieux
reviews.text:
Great training:
It was hard, lots of people my age and weight (79 kg ish).
Most importantly the trainers make it fun by 'bullying' fighters and attendees in a fun and loving way. They seemed to care about you because the trainer corrected my technique and tried to make it fun. Also for himself. So that is alot of fun and makes you feel welcome.
It was really challenging, but I loved it.

I hope they keep this style of training.

reviews.name: Eliya Golan
reviews.text:
If you want to learn the style of Muay Kao, and more specifically,  how to clinch, THIS IS THE GYM!

This is my second time in Thailand and throughout my trips in Koh Samui,  Koh Pangan, Koh Tao and Phuket I have trained at quite a few gyms (fighters/intermediate sessions). The gyms were great, but my issue with them was the lack of clinching (some weren't even allowing knees to the body in light sparring)

That was until I started training at FA Group. The fighters have 2 sessions a day (2.5 hours each) and the afternoon session is dedicated to the clinch (includes 40 minutes of clinching!!) They have a lot of trainers and fighters on the mat to give you feedback and hold pads for you, and the conditioning at the end of the session will make you into a killer!!

So in short, this is the BEST gym that I trained at in Thailand!

reviews.name: Manuel De Luca
reviews.text:
Training with *Khamwong* is a unique experience. A trainer with incredible energy, sharp technique, and a true passion for Muay Thai that you can feel in every strike and every correction. Precise, patient, and motivating—he brings out the best in you, even when you think you’ve got nothing left.

His dedication and teaching style make all the difference: you learn, improve, and enjoy yourself at the same time. A true master, inside and outside the ring.
If you're in Bangkok and want to take your Muay Thai to the next level, *Khamwong is the one.*
Grateful to train with him every day. 🙏🥊🔥

reviews.name: Rob
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

FA Group Gym is amazing! I came all the way from California to train here and focus on my clinch game. The trainers are extremely technical, patient, and share so many small details that make a huge difference. After training at different gyms, I can honestly say this has been the best experience by far. Highly recommend FA to anyone serious about learning real Muay Thai. The manger she was amazing pair me up with the right trainers

reviews.name: Jeandre Joubert
reviews.text:
Old school classical Muay Thai gym. Trainers are all killers and extremely helpful. Members are all friendly and they have a great gym culture! They have a reputation for the clinch and knees for a reason!

Location is easy to find and close to Chatuchak. Make sure you contact them in advance. We accidently pitched up during their competition training - our mistake. But they accomodated and included myself and my wife in the training session.

Best place in Bangkok to train Muay Thai! If you are looking for an authentic Muay Thai experience this is the place to be. Can't wait to visit again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much! your comment means a lot! appreciate your time writing for us. 
hopefully see you again soon :)

reviews.name: Mustafa Vallen
reviews.text: Used to train there 3-4 times per week between mid-2022 and mid-2023. Here is the most clinching-focused gym I have seen in Thailand. Clinching (45 minutes with your training partner) is trained in nearly every training day. I was happy to train there since I could always find a clinching partner with the similar height and body shape ☺️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your comment! Hopefully see u again soon 😊🙏

reviews.name: Pro gressive
reviews.text:
Very nice and friendly. Dropped in today late evening (01.01.26), asked for a PT session and the few people (of a family?) "hanging" around at the gym fetched me a very good coach (Ali). Soon after lots of people had dinner on the street, looked very family and cozy while we worked out. Corrected so many fundamentals/details. (Much) more than in a quite big gym I had been weeks to right before on PPhuket.
Great details, very warm people. Had only time for one session, if I can manage to come back to Thailand, I'll come here again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for coming! Appreciate your time to write us this good review. Hopefully we see you again :)

reviews.name: Jake Walsh
reviews.text: Loved the training. Pushed to a high level all training and got great direction during training. All trainers and fighters here are beasts push you to your limits. Highly recommend to any fighters looking to push themselves to the next level
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks so much for your comment!
It means a lot for all of us.

reviews.name: itay rachmani
reviews.text:
This is by far the best gym I’ve trained in my time here in Thailand and I even changed my plans in Thailand to come back and train more in this gym.
Coaches here are very professional and brutally honest about how your technique and they will focus on improving your technique and cardio.
Very easy and comfortable communication with the gym on WhatsApp, and the gym is located in a great spot where there is everything you need.
High level of techniques, clinch and conditioning.

reviews.name: Vancouver
reviews.text: I had a private session with Kong and he was great! He took time to correct and improve my form much more than any other gym I visited in Thailand. Khob khun khrab!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your time writing a good review for him, I will let him know :) Hopefully seeing you again!

reviews.name: M K
reviews.text: Had a great private and group class sessions! Kru Kong is super friendly and knowledgeable. He helped fixed some fundamentals and taught me new techniques. Can’t wait to come back, thank you.  🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for coming and for your time to write us such a good review :) hopefully we see you again!

title: GENTLE Head Spa by Treasure
ownerDescription:
Gentle Head Spa by Treasure - Bangkok's head spa above the city noise, Floor 6 Siam Square One, two minutes from Siam Paragon. Part of Treasure Spa, recognized by guests with TripAdvisor Travelers' Choice 2026.
Most people are holding more tension in the head and neck than they know. Head spa is a new way to release that tension.

Forest Calm - 60 minutes, a relaxing introduction to head spa.
Gentle Scalp Care - 90 minutes, deep clean and care for scalp and hair.
OWAY Premium - 90 minutes, organic luxury matched to your scalp condition.

Try it once. Return for how it feels.
Exit 4, BTS Siam. Book on WhatsApp - same phone number as listed.
address: Fl 6, Siam Square One, Room SS6009, 388 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
street: Fl 6, Siam Square One, Room SS6009, 388 Rama I Rd

reviews.name: Sumol
reviews.text:
I recently visited Gentle Hair Spa with premium service , but unfortunately, the experience did not live up to the "premium" branding or the price point. There are several areas that need improvement:

1. Reception & Atmosphere
It lacked the relaxing, serene atmosphere you would expect. Instead of feeling pampered from the moment I walked in, I felt the environment was quite "stiff" and not at all premium.

2. The Wash
The actual service was quite disappointing. During the hair wash, the staff was not gentle. I frequently had water splashing onto my face, which is quite bothersome when you are trying to relax. The movements were rough rather than soothing, making the "spa" element feel more like a rushed chore than a premium treatment.

3. The partition: instead of having the room, they use curtain to separate between each customers.

It may be good for tourist but for local people it is not that premium.

reviews.name: Ab
reviews.text:
Had a really enjoyable experience at Gentle Head Spa by Treasure… managed to walk in on a Friday night without any issues, which was a great start.

I went for the one hour Forest something session, and it was incredibly relaxing from start to finish. The head spa itself was the highlight, gentle water flowing and trickling over your scalp while they thoroughly cleanse your hair with what felt like multiple rounds of shampoo. The head massage was excellent, and I appreciated that they also included a proper shoulder massage.

The setup is very comfortable with curtains partitioning each customer, the chair, the ambiance, everything just helps you unwind. After the treatment, they dry your hair and even include a short hand and shoulder massage, which was a nice touch. To top it off, you’re served some mango and a drink, which made the whole experience feel a bit more premium.

If I had one small gripe, it would be that after blow drying, they don’t really style your hair back to how it was before. So you might walk out looking a bit more “freshly dried” than polished.

Overall, though, it’s a great, relaxing experience and definitely worth trying if you’re in Bangkok.

reviews.name: iamsherryen
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at Gentle Heas Spa. The staff were friendly and explained each step of the treatment clearly. The atmosphere was calm and relaxing, perfect for unwinding. The hair spa left my scalp refreshed and my hair noticeably softer and shinier. Prices were reasonable for the quality of service. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a rejuvenating hair treatment.

reviews.name: Tay ME
reviews.text: Did the hair spa , 1.5hr. Super shiok. Hair became very soft and clean scalp. Appointment is easily booked via whatapps. Served nice mango after the treatment too.

reviews.name: LargeCrowd
reviews.text:
Got to experience the Forest Calm (60 min) head spa and it was very good.
The staff were professional and the spa itself was really relaxing. I booked the spa for 8:30pm after a long day and it knocked me out. Loved it, i would do this again

reviews.name: Marta Rodriguez
reviews.text: One of the best things I did today. The place is just so relaxing and the hair after was so soft and nice. I did the 90 min experience and I would highly recommend it.

reviews.name: travelogsay
reviews.text: Amazing hair treatment — I almost fell asleep! The place was clean, comfortable, and very relaxing. The staff was kind as well. It will definitely be on my list the next time I’m in Bangkok for a hair spa

reviews.name: Joelle Chen
reviews.text: Tried the 90mins Gentle Headspa and totally in love with it. Very comfortable head massage that began with a shoulder massage and ended with arms massage. Therapist was gentle but massage with good strength. Headspa was so comfortable I took a good nap. Will definitely be back again!

reviews.name: Hock Huat
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of experiencing a head spa treatment at Gentle head Spa, and it was truly exceptional.

The team was welcoming and made the check-in process smooth and peaceful.

The treatment itself was pure bliss. The therapist was incredibly skilled and attentive. The treatment was firm, deeply therapeutic, with perfert pressure and completely melted away all the tension I was holding. The products used smelled amazing, leaving a refreshing floral scent.

The entire experience was comfortable and after the head spa, my scalp felt deeply cleansed. This isn't just a hair treatment; it's a full mind and body reset.

I highly recommend the Gentle head spa to anyone needing an hour of luxurious escape. I’m already looking forward to my next visit.

reviews.name: María Mancheño Mena
reviews.text: I had one of the best head spa and massages in my life. I’ve discovered this place and I have to say it’s really a hidden gem in the heart of Bangkok. Very conveniently located next to the BTS Siam. I went for the detox Scalp Massage and my hair became healthier, less itchy and beautiful. I’ll definitely come back, the experience was amazing

reviews.name: Julianne Marie Albano
reviews.text: I love the overall service. They are very accommodating and nice. I had a head spa and it is very very relaxing. And the best part, free mango in the end and amazing tea. Would love to come back.

reviews.name: Luca Fleischli
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at this head spa. The treatment was incredibly relaxing and made me feel comfortable from start to finish. The staff were very friendly, professional, and attentive throughout the session. I left feeling refreshed and well taken care of. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing and high-quality head spa experience.

reviews.name: Bena Goh
reviews.text: Good environment and good service. I was serve by Lek and she is very thoughtful and strong . Love it

reviews.name: Suze Kwakman
reviews.text: We thought it was great! Super relaxing, well priced, service was amazing, they were super friendly. We even got tea and mango. Our hair looks and feels amazing, we didn’t even have to make an appointment. Would recommend!

reviews.name: Jewels Butler
reviews.text: Most relaxing massage I've had so far in Thailand! They also served me a little waffle and tea after. Loved it!

reviews.name: TK Ang
reviews.text: It was a great experience, clean and quiet environment. The head spa is very comfortable and I feel totally relaxed! A very comfortable and money worth it experience!

reviews.name: Amanda Poh
reviews.text: Service was very good. Pressure points were applied at all the right places. You will feel rejuvenated and they even serve you mango ans tea at the end.

reviews.name: Fajer B
reviews.text:

reviews.name: Ryker Bukowski
reviews.text:
First ever time attempting Muay Thai!

My wife and I showed up for a group class on Friday at 10 AM. We had no prior experience with Muay Thai. So we were unsure what to expect. Turns out we were the only ones to show up that morning and got the full attention of the coaches for an hour and a half. They were able to walk us through an introduction to Muay Thai.

The schedule looked like the following:

1/stretching
2/ shadowboxing (learning basics)
3/ punching bag work
4/ pad training
5/ simple sparring
6/ cool down and stretching

The coaches were very friendly and helpful. This is my first and only experience, but I would recommend it to anyone interested in an introduction to Muay Thai. I’m sure they do amazing work with more advanced training.

10/10 would recommend.

reviews.name: Brian Kim
reviews.text: Amazing instructors, facilities, and owner! Commited to making sure you’re getting technique down and a good workout. Have top-quality training/lifting/running equipment that allows for all training modalities

reviews.name: Brendan ROBERT

I had many private coaching sessions here.

The instructors are not only skilled teachers, they are also super welcoming and nice persons.

reviews.name: Roger Kirschner
reviews.text: Great Gym, lots of nations training together. Feel absolutely free to walk in and have a chat to the folks. Focused on martial arts, free weights are there, some machines... and a lot of friendly people.

reviews.name: Wendy Garcia
reviews.text: Had the best experience here for a private coaching session! I’ve taken Muay Thai classes back home but it’s still not the same. I highly recommend a private session as you get one on one training, more focused on proper form = better workout. Definitely a good workout & great time!

reviews.name: Skeet Link
reviews.text:
My experience at N-ONE Gym has been nothing short of phenomenal. While I like to stay active and fit, I've never really considered myself a "gym person", but I was looking for a place to workout indoors while I've been living in Thailand.

I popped into N-ONE just to check it out and was greeted by Non, the owner and one of the trainers. His professionalism and friendly personality sealed the deal for me. I look forward to working out and pushing myself every time I go in. It's been a real motivating and educational experience, and everyone I've met there has been super cool and helpful.

I highly recommend anyone who's in Bangkok to come to N-ONE for personalized Muay Thai and other combat training from an expert, or just simply for fitness, fun and community. Whether you live in Bangkok or you're on a short visit and need a place to train and workout, N-ONE is an excellent choice.

reviews.name: Lucas Holmes
reviews.text: Amazing gym for all combat sports. Non and the trainers are very experienced and welcoming. N-ONE GYM is a community gym but also an advanced fighting gym :)

reviews.name: Tee
reviews.text: The best Muay Thai gym in Thonglor, with over 30 years of Muay Thai fighting/training . Pee Non will take good care of you 👍

reviews.name: angie lee
reviews.text:
Non and team are excellent! They tailor every training session to the individual which was highly beneficial in my short time there. Having fought professionally (and winning) and studied sports science, Non aspires to let his students get better with a combination of skill and science.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a Muay Thai trainer in the Thong Lor area.

reviews.name: RJ
reviews.text: N-ONE is a hidden gem among the Muay Thai gyms in the city. 100% authentic with a community vibe, the trainers are highly skilled and technique focused. Observation and analytical feedback is a big part of their approach to teaching which makes a massive difference in accelerated learning. The instructors are quick to analyse your level and will adjust accordingly. Throughout training both Non & Pan shared their thoughts with me on what I could do better and how to adapt my movements to improve. If it’s your first time the environment is welcoming and very friendly the instructors are also very patient. I made several mistakes... they smiled understandingly, and advised me on what to do. Egos don't exist here just a friendly community that encompasses the true Muay Thai spirit. If your experienced... they will 100% up your game, instructors are top tier with impressive experience and fight IQ especially.

title: CrossFit Naga
ownerDescription:
Welcome to CrossFit Naga, the perfect place for anyone who wants to get fit! Located in the heart of Bangkok, our gym is friendly and supportive, making it ideal for all fitness levels.

At CrossFit Naga, we focus on functional fitness. Our experienced coaches create fun and varied workouts that combine strength training, cardio, and mobility to help you reach your goals. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced athlete, we have something for everyone.

Join our welcoming community for group classes, personal training, and special workshops. Our gym is equipped with the latest gear, and we prioritise safety and proper technique so you can feel confident while working out.

Come visit us for a workout and a coffee/smoothie!
address: 19 Torsak 1 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Chanidapha Narakornpaijit
reviews.text: I was there for hyrox class, the staff and coach were really friendly and it’s such a nice community. The workout class and the program was fun and easy to follow with coach’s instructions. Everyone there was very encouraging and fun to workout with. I really like the vibe there plus they have their own coffee shop. The gym also provides shower but it was small. The gym and facilities are clean :)

reviews.name: Edouard Bellin
reviews.text: This has been my go-to CrossFit gym since I first started CrossFit in May 2025. I love their open air setup, they have a little cafe at reception to get your caffeine in or smoothies, but the biggest love I have for it is how amazing the community is. Super down to earth, inclusive, welcoming, everyone supports each other in big numbers. Whether it’s your first time or you’re athlete level, everyone’s in it together. It’s not the biggest gym but that’s also what I love about it. Coaching staff is also amazing, will push you to your limits while being genuine and fun. All the love for Naga!

reviews.name: Rick de Jong
reviews.text: One of the best, if not the best, CrossFit boxes I’ve come across during my travels. High-level training, a very friendly and welcoming community, and excellent coaches. Special thanks to Anna, whose sharp tips make you instantly better.

reviews.name: Hwan Hee Im
reviews.text:
Tried CrossFit for the first time at CrossFit Naga — totally random decision thanks to ClassPass —

The place is super comfy, with both indoor and semi-outdoor zones, so you never feel stuffy. The airflow is chef’s kiss.

The coaches? Experienced, helpful, and ridiculously friendly — like, they’ll hype you up but also fix your form before you break yourself. Easy to talk to, warm vibes all around.
Highly recommend if you want a gym that feels good and people who actually care.

reviews.name: Nic
reviews.text:
was looking for a gym for my short solo weekend getaway in BKK and xfit naga did not disappoint!

i reached out to them over instagram a few days before my trip and the staff were SUPER sweet. they recommended the beginner friendly classes that i could attend and assured me that crossfit newbies like myself were welcome to join. they helped to book me into the classes over instagram without even asking for prepayment T_T i love thai hospitality so much!

i was still apprehensive to attend the classes solo but my fears were unfounded. the community (which consists of a large proportion of expats and tourists) was very welcoming and friendly. the experienced coaches also provided detailed explanations and demonstrations of the WODs (with exercise variations scaled down for beginners).

both classes that i attended over 2 days were very enjoyable and a suitably good push!

i also enjoyed cafe naga's offerings - coffee, matcha and my personal fave, PROTEIN SHAKES with the option to add creatine and electrolytes! full service gym <3 i tried both the vanilla and the choco dream and both were 10/10 delicious

will definitely be back for my next BKK holiday

reviews.text: The gym has an open and welcoming atmosphere with friendly and approachable coaches. The facilities are top-notch, including a storage room, ample parking, showers, and changing rooms. There's even a café where you can grab a protein shake right after your workout. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Best CrossFit box in Bangkok, in my opinion. I’ve been doing CrossFit ~15 years. Open-air, safe, and with a community that truly pushes you. If Hyrox is your thing, they’ve got that covered too — Naga is certified and integrates it very well. And the best thing no matter your background (nationality/fitness level etc) everyone is welcomed!
