reviews.name: Seb John
reviews.text: It's a little bit outside the centre of Bangkok but easily worth the visit for Bookee's exceptional skill in sound therapy and yoga. Some of the sounds and vibration that she creates borders on witchcraft (in a good way!) A unique journey and story through sound, sometimes intense, sometimes ethereal, otherworldly and haunting, but always captivating. The range and scope is truly impressive. Bookee also gives excellent verbal guidance and space holding throughout the session. Try a group session first and if you enjoy and connect with it, definitely try a personal session after!

reviews.name: Delphine Berger
reviews.text: Bookee’s classes are truly special. Her presence and voice are enough to carry you to places within and outside of you. When combined with her wonderful sound music instruments, it goes to an entire other level. She is soft, gentle, precise and so loving. I cannot recommend her enough. Book in advance as her beautiful studio had limited space and also is in the middle of nature. Must must do at least once when in Bangkok

reviews.name: Natalie Glebova
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible to experience Astra the massive gong and her power that transports you beyond this realm. I felt light and more open after the sound bath with Bookee. Highly recommend this experience to anyone seeking sound healing and alignment.

reviews.name: Angie L-S
reviews.text: Bookee is a very professional and dedicated Yoga and Pilates instructor with a calm, happy and kind personality. Her creative lessons often include breathing techniques, strength training and also meditation. Each class is unique and the routines are never the same. I am always impressed how much variate Bookee can pack into one class. Her voice is calm and her instructions are very clear.  Bookee is also trained in Singing Bowls and Reiki. Since I joined her firs class two years ago, I try not to miss any. She is amazing in every way.

reviews.name: Ann Tongbaiyai
reviews.text:
Private yoga and sound healing with Bookee has been an amazing experience. She’s knowledgeable, fun, and incredibly supportive, always tailoring each session to my needs.

Her positive energy makes every session something I truly look forward to, and I always leave feeling better in both body and mind.

reviews.name: Matt Lim
reviews.text:
Whether I’ve come for sound healing or light therapy, I’ve always left feeling deep gratitude after spending time with Bookee.

I highly recommend attending any classes, sessions, or experiences Bookee is cooking up.

reviews.name: Htwe Htwe Nyein
reviews.text: I really enjoy this yoga class. The teacher is very kind and teaches in both English and Thai which makes it easy to follow. The atmosphere is calm and relaxing and I always feel refreshed after the class. It is a great place for both beginners and people with experience.Highly recommended!!!

reviews.name: kyla chipchura
reviews.text:
My experience with Bookee at her studio has been such a beautiful opportunity! She gave me an introduction to sound bath instruments class, and it was so incredibly inspiring.  She is such a light, and I truly couldn’t have learned from a more lovely person! I will forever remember this trip to Thailand because I discovered a new passion of mine thanks to this beautiful soul.

Also, if you have the opportunity- you MUST get a Tibetan bowl massage from her!!! She is so intuitive and I know my body really gained ALOT from it.   Thanks Bookee! Looking forward to connecting again next time I am in Bangkok:)

reviews.name: Agnieszka Ragazzini
reviews.text: I had a great pleasure to meet Bookee in Krabi during a yoga retreat organized by her and highly recommended by my friend. The entire experience from being hosted in a wonderful and peaceful resort immersed in a jungle to carefully designed yoga classes was truly inspiring and restorative. Bookee’s personality and professionalism made every point of our program an enjoyable, reflective and meaningful experience both on the mats and off the mat. She is a dedicated and a very creative teacher with an amazingly calm voice which makes her classes very unique and I wish I will live closer to be able to attend them all.

reviews.name: Nhi Nguyenn
reviews.text:
Im Vietnamese and i really enjoyed here. She has truly healed and helped me a lot. The room and the materials are all very clean and carry extremely good energy. I really felt lighter and mentally healthy after just one practice session and talking with her.
Hello, I hope you still remember the Vietnamese girl who confided and cried with you. I love you very much and will see you again when I have the opportunity to come to Thailand. Sorry for the late review, but you deserve 100 stars <3

reviews.name: Naha Cooper
reviews.text:
I was instantly drawn to Bookee and her skills from the very first sound bath healing session I took with her. Since then I’ve been joining her sessions regularly, and through her I’ve been exposed to so many new experiences and knowledge. It’s not only physical — I’ve been able to enjoy inner awareness, clarity and a genuine sense of joy in my everyday life.

As an instructor she is truly professional. She offers a wide range of sessions including yoga, meditation, singing bowls and Reiki. What I appreciate the most is how she adapts to my physical and emotional condition each time, allowing me to progress naturally and comfortably without forcing anything. I genuinely feel like I’m getting closer to the results I’m seeking in a healthy way.

On top of all that, Bookee herself radiates health, warmth and positivity. I always leave feeling lighter — not just in my body but in my mood and energy as well.
Thank you, Bookee!

reviews.name: P
reviews.text:
A truly relaxing and calming yoga place. This yoga studio is housed within the instructor Bookee’s private residence. The venue is quiet and surrounded by lush green. She always makes me feel right at home, with her open personality and positive energy.

I enjoy private yoga and mat pilates classes with Bookee as she customizes the movements according to my strength and constraints. Her voice is exceptionally calming, so the session is a real treat and a boost for my mind and body.

Now she also offers sound therapy. I can’t wait to try her singing bowls session!

reviews.name: Sam Cho
reviews.text:
Most amazing experience with Bookee. Yoga + sound bath. Bookee graciously unlocked parts of my body and mind through her sessions. Another segment with her, my family was visiting town so I booked a private class. My brother and parents were first timers, they absolutely loved it.

Her studio/home garden has the most lush greenery I have ever seen in Bangkok, a beautiful and tranquil view to compliment the whole experience. Bookee is an amazing teacher and instructor, I highly recommend you go see for yourself!

reviews.name: vari thee
reviews.text: Just came back from Bookie’s sound healing private session today. From the very first session, I felt a sense of calm wash over me, lifting the heaviness I didn’t even realize I was carrying. The soothing sounds and personalized approach truly resonated with my mind and body, leaving me feeling lighter, more centered, and deeply refreshed. It’s more than just a class – it’s a healing journey, and I’m so grateful for the positive impact it’s had on my well-being 🙏🏽

reviews.name: Joe TheBananas
reviews.text: Even though I have joined a few classes with Bookee, every classes I learned something and gained homework for self lessons to improve my muscles and my mind later on and it helps me lots. She is so professional trainer who trains me for not only in classes, but in your daily activities. Of course, I would recommend you to join some of her classes

reviews.name: Angel Allison
reviews.text: I had an incredible experience at this yoga studio with Bookee. The environment is serene and welcoming, creating the perfect atmosphere for yoga practice. The studio’s location is easy to find, and once you're there, it’s a peaceful escape from the world. Bookee is outstanding as a professional teacher, offering perfect personalized adjustments and guidance that really helped me progress. I especially loved the yoga philosophy teachings integrated into the sessions—they provided valuable insight into the practice beyond just the physical postures. The personalized yoga teacher training was top-notch, helping me grow both on and off the mat. I highly recommend this place to anyone seeking a truly nurturing and holistic yoga experience!

reviews.name: Nicho Peterson
reviews.text: Bookee offers an immersive sound experience in an intimate comfortable setting, perfect for deep relaxation and integration

reviews.name: Daniel Torres
reviews.text: What a great session we had! The sound session was very well executed, relaxing and guided. Additionally, the place has lots of green and very peaceful.

reviews.name: Sm K
reviews.text: I was visiting Bangkok and dropped in Bookee's studio for a sound bath. Her studio is set in a tranquil setting, away from the hustle and bustle yet close to the city centre. I zoned out during the sound bath and left feeling contented and well rested.

reviews.name: Poom Sathaworawong
reviews.text:
I’ve been taking private yoga lessons with Bookee for several years, and it’s been amazing!

Her personalized approach has really helped me get stronger and more flexible, while also helping me find a sense of calm. She gives clear instructions and makes personal adjustments, so I always feel both comfortable and challenged. Her teaching style is gentle but effective, ensuring every pose is done right. Her deep knowledge and ability to tailor classes to individual needs make her an outstanding instructor, and her attention to detail is impeccable!

Besides the physical benefits, her classes have given me a much-needed mental break from my busy schedule, lowering my stress levels and boosting my overall health. Bookee’s dedication to her students' well-being and growth is truly inspiring, and her passion and professionalism make every session rewarding. Plus, she’s super nice and friendly, creating a relaxed and welcoming environment.

The studio is inviting, calm, clean, and perfectly set up for a great yoga experience.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for a high-quality yoga experience!

reviews.name: Prashant Tamang
reviews.text: "I recently visited this new Muay Thai gym near the victory Monument (BTS )and had an incredible experience. The instructor has over 40 years of experience in Muay Thai, which really shows in their teaching. The gym itself is clean and well-maintained, with nice and clean bathrooms. They even provide Muay Thai gloves and shorts for borrowing, which is super convenient. The gym is located on the fourth floor, offering a beautiful view of the park. reviews.name: David Nguyen
reviews.text:
On my last day in Thailand, I went to Fight Arena Gym. It looks more like a crunch gym than a Muay Thai gym, but I only had a few hours before my flight and FA group was half an hour away and Samart's gym was even further. I walked 10 minutes after reading positive reviews, albeit entirely from begginners.

I was not disappointed in my lesson. The pad rounds were great. We did some sparring and I learned a few incremental things:

Cross teeps and same side teeps to block kicks, question mark kick via tkd roundhouse snap kick into a teep, throwing a back or side kick if my head kick misses, catching a kick and pulling into a vertical elbow or throwing it by for a headkick, Plum snap down via widening my stance and jumping back with small shaking motions, pushing off of the hips when in the club to throw a knee and then immediately walking my hips back in, and when swimming under for the plum clinch I can throw an elbow to the portion of the jaw closest to the ear

I was expecting a cardio kickboxing workout after the trainer had me running up and down the AC cooled room with mats so clean you could grapple on them. I'm glad this was not the case. The session was honestly better than my private lessons at Fairtex by a large margin and comparable to some privates I've done with Golden Age lumpinee Champs in terms of actually getting incremental techniques. I don't know much about my trainer other than that he majored in Sports Science at a local University.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much David for your kind and details feedback and comments. We are very please and glad to hear you have a great training session. We hope to welcome you again in the future and improve the service for your next training session. We appreciate your kind comments and glad we had surpass your expectation. Please continue training and we hope to see you again!

title: Common Ground Ploenchit
ownerDescription:
Common Ground Ploenchit is a coworking space situated within the heart of Bangkok CBD, positioned within Lumphini, and with easy access to Ploenchit BTS and Chit Lom MRT stations.

Set to open its doors in Q2 2024, Common Ground Ploenchit captures what modern professionals need in a workspace. The space features flexible office solutions such as Private Offices, Meeting Rooms, and Fixed and Hot Desks.
address: Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

reviews.name: Julie Nichavarin
reviews.text:
I’ve been working from Common Ground Ploenchit for a while now and really enjoy the space. The location is super convenient, right between Ploenchit and Chidlom BTS, and the workspace has lots of natural light, which makes such a difference when you’re spending the whole day here.

I also love the community vibe. It’s professional but doesn’t feel too corporate or boring and there are often activities and events that make it easy to meet new people. The team is lovely and always helpful too. Definitely a great place if you’re looking for a bright, comfortable coworking space in central Bangkok!

The complimentary coffee was a nice bonus, the internet was fast, and finding a quiet corner to focus wasn’t a problem. Big thanks to Najah as well! She checked in to make sure I was comfortable and made me feel genuinely looked after. I’ll definitely be back!

Thank you Khun Naja’s team for excellent service and hospitality.

Here, you will find a vibrant community perfect for networking, all within a bright and airy environment flooded with natural light.

The atmosphere is also pretty nice. It’s quiet enough to get work done without feeling too isolated. The staff are friendly and helpful as well.

Overall, it’s a solid co-working space and I’d definitely come back.

reviews.name: Piyaporn J
reviews.text:
Easy Access
Reach the office effortlessly via BTS Ploenchit and BTS Chidlom.

Prime CBD Location
Located in one of Bangkok’s most sought-after business districts.

Work-Life Convenience
Stay productive while enjoying on-site fitness facilities and a wide selection of food and beverage options within the building.

Refreshing Atmosphere
Large windows, abundant natural light, and lush greenery create a pleasant environment that makes every workday more enjoyable.

reviews.name: Pinq K.
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my time at Common Ground. The space is clean, modern, and has a really nice, relaxed atmosphere. The staff are super friendly and always happy to help. The location is also a big plus (right in the heart of the city and conveniently close to both Ploenchit and Chidlom BTS sky train). Definitely a great spot to get some work done!

reviews.name: moran goder
reviews.text:
The Best Co-Working Space in Central Bangkok!
Located right on Sukhumvit Road, next to Ploenchit BTS station and just a 3-minute walk from Chidlom BTS, this is truly one of the best locations in Bangkok.

The space is directly across from Central Embassy, Central Chidlom, and One City Centre Building, surrounded by excellent restaurants, bakeries, and coffee shops.

The co-working space itself is convenient, well-equipped, beautifully designed, and exceptionally clean.
But the best part is the amazing team—especially Ms. Najah, the Branch Manager at Common Ground Ploenchit. She is incredibly professional, friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help with anything you need.

I also really enjoy the mix of international and Thai professionals, with many people working in the tech industry. It creates a great environment for networking, working quietly and productively, and building a community with new people in Bangkok.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great place to work, network, and connect with an international community in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Noppadol Deewan
reviews.text:
Really enjoyed working from here. The space is clean, comfortable, and has a nice atmosphere that makes it easy to stay focused. The facilities are well maintained, and there are plenty of seats and areas to work without feeling too crowded.

The location is another big plus - it’s only about an 8-minute walk from BTS Phloenchit, with lots of cafes and restaurants nearby, which makes grabbing lunch or coffee really convenient.

The staff are friendly, the internet is reliable, and overall it’s a great place if you’re looking for a productive workspace.

la.mun Onsen & Spa @ TRIBE Living Bangkok Sukhumvit 39 สัมผัสประสบการณ์การพักผ่อนอย่างเหนือระดับใจกลางสุขุมวิท 39 เราให้บริการออนเซ็นส่วนตัวและแบบรวม (Japanese Onsen) ที่สะอาด ทันสมัย พร้อมบริการนวดสปาครบวงจร อาทิ นวดไทย นวดน้ำมันอโรม่า และทรีทเมนท์ดูแลผิวพรรณโดยเทอราปิสผู้เชี่ยวชาญ

ผ่อนคลายร่างกายและจิตใจในบรรยากาศที่เงียบสงบ เป็นส่วนตัว เดินทางสะดวกตั้งอยู่ชั้น 4 โรงแรม TRIBE Living Bangkok เหมาะสำหรับผู้ที่มองหาที่พักผ่อนหลังเลิกงานหรือในวันหยุดสุดสัปดาห์

ออนเซ็นสไตล์ญี่ปุ่น (Private & Public Onsen)

นวดแผนไทยและนวดน้ำมัน

บริการระดับพรีเมียมใจกลางเมือง
address: 122 ซ. สุขุมวิท 39 แขวงคลองตันเหนือ เขตวัฒนา Khlong Tan Nuea, วัฒนา Bangkok 10110, Thailand
street: 122 ซ. สุขุมวิท 39 แขวงคลองตันเหนือ เขตวัฒนา

reviews.name: Nariokung
reviews.text:
First impression was honestly not great, but the massage itself helped recover the experience. Overall I’d rate it around 7/10.

The reception staff spoke politely but did not feel particularly service minded. On the other hand, the therapist’s massage technique was genuinely very good with strong and adjustable pressure, but her manner felt rushed throughout the session. Movements were quite rough, items were placed down loudly, and the overall atmosphere did not feel as calm or refined as expected from a spa environment.

There was also no consultation form and nobody asked about focus areas, areas to avoid, or preferred pressure beforehand. I was even asked to walk to the counter myself to select the aroma oil. In addition, there was no foot wash or even a warm towel to clean the feet before the massage.

On the positive side, the therapist did check the room temperature and offered an electric blanket. The massage bed was also very comfortable, especially the face opening which was larger than usual.

Overall, the massage quality itself was strong, but the service flow and hospitality details still need improvement.

reviews.name: Yaifaifah
reviews.text: Clean, quiet, and very relaxing. The onsen and sauna are great, and the facilities are well prepared. A nice place to unwind.

reviews.name: Ivan Barkar
reviews.text: Amazing place, very friendly staff. I went here before my flight back home to unwind and could not recommend this spot enough. Left feeling very refreshed and ready to tackle the journey. Cold and hot tub combination was lovely, and the facility was very clean and upscale.

reviews.name: Noelle
reviews.text: Everyone was so nice! and it was very relaxing, definitely will come back again next year for our yearly Thailand trip with my husband

reviews.name: Pari K.
reviews.text: Everything was great, from the staff to the venue. Everyone was friendly and willing to serve. I would definitely come back if I had the chance. Most importantly, the price was not expensive at all for a place in the heart of Bangkok like this.

reviews.name: Chris
reviews.text:
had an incredible experience at Lamun Onsen & Spa (located in TRIBE Living Bangkok Sukhumvit 39). We booked the Couple’s Package, which included a private Japanese onsen, sauna, and essential oil massage.
• Ultimate Privacy: The private onsen area is surprisingly spacious. Unlike other spas, the entire facility (including the hot spring, cold plunge, and sauna) was exclusively for the two of us. Having that private space for an hour was pure bliss.
• Professional Massage: The essential oil massage was top-notch. The therapists were highly skilled and hit all the right pressure points.
• Highly Recommended: The overall atmosphere is modern and relaxing. We felt completely refreshed afterward.
This is definitely a hidden gem in Bangkok. We will be coming back for sure!

reviews.name: Brandon Skinner
reviews.text: How lucky that the hotel my family and I stayed for 5 months also has a lovely spa for massage (for me) and body scrubs (for my wife). The atmosphere is great and the staff are very skilled and friendly.

reviews.name: Simran Keyz
reviews.text: I loved the experience here with the Onsen and massage. The staff and the place was absolutely amazing! Definitely worth coming again!

reviews.name: Julian
reviews.text:
So i booked the sauna for an hour.
Didn't realise it would be private
just me in the sauna and cold and hot pools.
It was brilliant. I felt like a king.
I then had a 90minute massage with Rayya who was amazing, the best massage I have had bar none.
Very skilled and professional.
Such a lovely woman as well.
Place was very clean and organised.
Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Av W
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the massage here.  Ah Ta was very professional, cheerful and did an amazing job to relax my muscles.  The receptionist is also very polite, and the overall experience is very relaxing.  The atmosphere gives me a chance to unwind after a long day out in the city.  Would highly recommend the hot press massage. 👍🏻

reviews.name: Lanna B.
reviews.text: Amazing moment, the place is cosy, yet spotless. Really enjoyed the office syndrome massage, the masseuse was very skilled and the room comfortable. Definitely coming back!

reviews.name: María Mancheño Mena
reviews.text: We had an amazing private onsen and massage experience today at lamun. Our massage ladies Reya and Saa were so gentle, kind and very polite. I’ve been to many massage places in Bangkok, and so far this is the best one I’ve found. We will definitely come back!

reviews.name: Tuomas Pirskanen
reviews.text:
Very nice facility with super friendly and skilled staff. Excellent back massage and after session tea and cookies :)
Recommended!

reviews.name: Mario Gonzalez
reviews.text: Very delighted on the way i was treated at Iamun Onsen & Spa. Staff was very sweet. I got a body scrub aroma massage highly recommend to anyone. All products are very high-end and I received the best service. I will be coming back. Thank you 🙏🏼

reviews.name: Poo Thaiii
reviews.text:
Overall Rating: 6/10

The onsen and sauna facilities are quite nice, and the massage was average. However, the service level was highly disappointing for a private establishment. While the staff used polite words, their behavior felt unprofessional and disrespectful they kept giggling while answering my questions, which made me feel uncomfortable. Furthermore, for a place that handles personal privacy, the lack of proper instructions made it very unwelcoming for a first-time visitor. A nice venue completely held back by an unprofessional front of house team.

reviews.name: Siddhant Ghosh
reviews.text: Had a great experience @ the partner’s onsen. It was a unique experience. The place was well looked after, clean and placed right at the heart of Sukhumvit. Would highly recommend for couples!

reviews.name: Kasey Cooper
reviews.text: The best full body massage ever! We got the aroma therapy and hot compress massage. It felt and smelled amazing. The staff was friendly and the facility was very clean. We were served water at the beginning and warm tea with crackers at the end. We are a family of four with two boys 9 and 11. They were great with the kids and opened a room so we could all be together. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: PT
reviews.text: Lovely service from start to finish. I booked a private onsen for a couple along with an aroma massage. The atmosphere was so relaxing that I fell asleep during the session. The delicious treats served afterward were a wonderful bonus.

reviews.name: Jessica Stirling
reviews.text: Beautiful spa the facilities were so clean. The big jacuzzi pool was super warm and also loved the large ice bath. The massage was probably the best I’ve had in Thailand for my whole 3 weeks stay. Staff very friendly and take good care of you. And super affordable too! Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Ovidia Wang
reviews.text:
I discovered this onsen through a promotion on Gowabi and decided to give it a try since it’s close to where I live. Unfortunately, the overall experience was disappointing.

Although the place is quite new, the design feels a bit tacky and lacks the calm, refined atmosphere you’d usually expect from an onsen. The front desk experience was also strange, the staff seemed disorganized and kept mixing up bookings. At one point, the manager appeared to be speaking to the staff in a rather condescending way, which made the whole environment feel uncomfortable and unprofessional.

The onsen itself was not up to par. I also tried the aroma massage, which was unfortunately quite mediocre and didn’t stand out in any way. Combined with the inconsistent service, the overall experience didn’t feel worth it.

It’s a new place, so perhaps there’s room for improvement, I will not return.

reviews.name: Nicole Scarano

The space is clean, relaxing.  Price is great for what you’re getting. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Michael Tan
reviews.text: Oil massage by therapist Nong C was awesome! Great skills and attention to all the sore muscles. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: arver
reviews.text: Giving 3 stars because I fell coming down their stairs. PLEASE BE CAREFUL using their stairs. When I went upstairs, I did notice that they had old cloth type stair threads on each steps. They were LOOSE and looked dangerous. But it was too late to leave the business (wash feet downstairs, then you are led to upstairs bare feet.) Coming down 1 hour later, one of those threads moved and I slipped. Never noticed elbow abrasion or shoulder pain much later because my tailbone area hurt so badly.  I lay there until I could be moved to a seat with help of Justin and other staff (thank you!) Hoping to be better in weeks to come but I am not able to sleep on my back or sit normally yet. An MRI when I get home maybe. From now on, I will avoid getting a massage upstairs. Or stick with Massage Envy lol.

reviews.name: Shannon Knutson
reviews.text:

We got hour long leg and foot massages. They have amazing techniques and worked our achey muscles to the bone. Tenderness the next day but worth it for the ease we walked with!
I was massages by a male named C, he also massages at Wat Pho and teaches techniques to new massage therapists, and my partner loved D (Nida) who was so lovely and had the most friendly smile!

reviews.text: Bro what a good massage here, good elbow pressure, good placement ! I wil come back before we leave Bbk , thank too Mr C. Lomny who was my massage therapist, you did excellent 🙏🙏🙏

title: Cooking with Kit
ownerDescription: 👩‍🍳👨‍🍳Join Cooking with Kit in Chiang Mai for a Thai cooking class.🍜🇹🇭 Learn authentic recipes in a relaxed, friendly atmosphere and take home tips to recreate Thai dishes anywhere in the world. Fun, delicious, and unforgettable!✨️
address: 65/2 ซอย 7 อรัญญิการ์ Tambon Su Thep, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
street: 65/2 ซอย 7 อรัญญิการ์
plusCode: QW8R+RX Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Tanja N
reviews.text:
It has been the perfect ending for the year 2025!

We booked a private cooking clas on new year's morning with Lek. Annika and I could choose 3 main dishes we wanted to cook a few days in advance.

Lek and her family were very kind and welcoming us with open arms and hearts.

The cooking class started with a trip to a local market, where we bought the fresh ingredients for our meals. Leks son in law shared a lot of insights into the Thai way of eating and cooking (and what we are able to eat).

Back home in Leks front yard, we started by picking fresh herbs and flowers from her garden.
While cooking, Lek took her time to explain everything and gave us tips on how to source certain ingredients back home or which alternatives we could use.

The best part of the class: eating our home-cooked meals! Aroy Mak - delicious!

We came home with a wealth of knowledge and a newfound love for cooking Thai food.

Thank you Lek, her daughter and her son in law for making such great memories for our first trip to Thailand! Khop Khun Ka! Love Annika & Tanja
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Tanja and Annika,

Thank you so much for your very kind review. I was also very happy to cook and talk with you both. It was a wonderful time.

If you both have any questions while making the dishes, please feel free to send me a message on WhatsApp.

Lek.

reviews.name: karen mak
reviews.text:
Great time!!!

We found cooking with Lek via google map.  I reached out for availability and fee & got a response immediately.  Group cooking class is 999 THB per person.  This includes 3 dishes of your choice plus pad thai plus dessert (choice of mango sticky rice or banana in coconut milk).  For an additional 300 THB, you can go to the market and shop for ingredient.  This spot is 5 min. drive from my Airbnb and no need to go into old town (crazy traffic), we signed up immediately.

The day of we arrived at 3pm as per address provided.  Kit the son-in-law drove us to a nearby wet market and did grocery shopping together.  Then we head back to their place.  The cooking class started with us collecting herb from the herb garden.  Then we made a pandan & butterfly pea tea.  The blue tea turns into purple once you add lime juice…so magical 🪄🪄🪄.  Next we cooked our first dish aka pad thai.  Follow by 3 of my and my hubby dishes = 6 dishes in total.  The portion is super generous and we’ve invited Mama Lek and Kit to join us for dinner.  The meal was super delish.  Afterward we prep the banana in coconut milk as dessert.  Kit even show my hubby how to prep Thai milk tea and sent him to the heaven ☺️☺️☺️.

Kit told us this is a young venture of 5 mths.  It is well run and we’ve made memorable experience.  We are big fan of Thai food and now with a greater appreciation of it knowing the labour goes into it.

Fun and educational.  This is a must-do!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Karen and Jacson,

Thank you very much for your very kind review. I

am so happy that you enjoyed it and hope that you will make the dishes at home as well.

Take care and hope to see you again in the future for some more cooking fun.

Lek.

Many ingredients she has prepared herself and will tell you all the secrets. This is not your average Thai cooking class, this one exceeds all expectations. Local, cozy, and a lot of fun!

BYOB we brought mimosas, WOOHOO! Great times were had, thank you!

 If you have any questions while making the dishes, please feel free to send me a message on WhatsApp.

reviews.text:
We want to say a big thank you to Cooking with Lek for such a wonderful evening. It was a truly genuine and warm experience — not commercial, not staged, and not the usual Instagram-style setup you often see. Just real people, real cooking, and a lot of heart.

Learning and cooking together with the family — mother-in-law, daughter and son-in-law — made it feel special and personal. We enjoyed every minute and had a lot of fun.

Thank you again for welcoming us like this. We’ll remember this evening for a long time. ❤️🇹🇭

Lek.

The yard has an authentic Thai atmosphere, and you can even hear chickens and birds, which makes the experience feel very local and peaceful.
When it came to the dishes, Lek was incredibly patient. She taught me how to identify different spices and explained every step of the cooking process clearly. Overall, it was a wonderful and memorable experience.

Thank you so much for your wonderful review! I'm so happy you enjoyed the class and the food. It means a lot of my. I hope you'll have fun recreating the dishes at home, and I'd love to welcome you back anytime in Chiang Mai!

Warm regards,
Lek.

reviews.name: Lillian Blaylock
reviews.text: My husband and I had the perfect afternoon cooking with Lek and Kit! This is a must do on your trip to chiang mai! We each got to choose three dishes to make, on top of Pad Thai and dessert- You get to make SO much delicious food, so come hungry! It’s an incredible value for your money but more than anything, Lek and Kit are wonderful people to spend time with. If you are looking for a unique cultural experience and you love Thai food- look no further! Book a class with Lek, you won’t regret it!

We three took a one-day Thai cuisine here. The course is called Master Thai Chicken dishes. This is our first time here.

The place is well decorated. It is on floor 17th-19th of Central Tower at CentralWorld. Easy access.

We have to be there by 7:45am. The kitchen is large enough to take 12 students atvthe same time.

All staff are kind, friendly and helpful. Chef Lek (Wichian) is a nice and knowledgeable chef. His teaching is practical and easy to follow.

We learn how to deal with the whole chicken and we use almost every part of it.

The course is separated into 2 parts. 8-11:30 and an one hour of lunch break and the. 12:30-16:00.

For our lunch break, we go out and have lunch by ourselves. Easy to find food because it is at CentralWorld.

We all get the certificates from the chef at the end. It is a very fun activity. We will definitely come back for some other courses.

Thank you Chef Wichian. Also thank you P’Kaew, Fai, Touch, Firm and Beer for taking care of us.

We have 3 dishes to cook. Very enjoyable day.

reviews.text: International-standard cooking school with extensive curricula and naturally high price tags. Convenient central location near both BTS and MRT stations.

reviews.name: Phuong Thao Huynh Ngoc
reviews.text:
I studied at this school for 9 months, and I believe not only myself but many other students—both current and former—have had similarly disappointing experiences at this so-called “prestigious” institution in Thailand.

First of all, the tuition fees. As an international student, I understand there might be a price difference. I’m not here to argue about the tuition itself. But I paid over half a billion (more 700,000 THB) for a 9-month course—why was I studying in a facility with such poor infrastructure? Broken stand mixers, malfunctioning induction cookers with damaged plugs, chillers with cockroaches(?)… The number of bad—and I mean extremely bad—experiences I had is beyond words. This school is simply not worth the money I spent!

Secondly, visa extension. The person in charge of visas is absolutely terrible. They are unclear in their communication, fail to properly do their job, and when things go wrong, they blame the country’s policies instead of taking any responsibility. Ridiculous! Before enrollment, everyone is all smiles and helpful, but once you’ve paid the tuition, their attitude completely changes. Specifically, I studied for just 9 months but had to extend my visa 5 times, each costing 2,000 baht? That’s outrageously expensive and unnecessary! Even when I had only 3 weeks left in the program, the male staff member named Mr. K still insisted I extend my visa for another 3 months!

The only good thing about this school is the chefs and the lessons themselves. Other than that, the school’s overall service is a huge disappointment. I will not hesitate to share my honest experience with others, especially about how unprofessional and careless the visa support team was.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We highly value the perspectives of our students and alumni, as they help us continually improve. Please note that we have reached out to you several times in an effort to clarify and address your concerns, but have not received a response. We sincerely hope you will contact us at your earliest convenience, so we may review your comments together and provide the necessary clarifications.

reviews.text: Rinn Muay Thai was an incredible experience. It's a very tight knit group of trainers, fighters, and beginners (like me). I got treated like a part of the family immediately. Even though I dont speak thai, everyone did what they could to communicate with me, which I really appreciated. All of the coaches are great and enthusiastic. the price was good, the vibes were good, the food was amazing, and the people there really look out for you> im in Chiang Mai now and I am trying out new gyms while im here and I realize that RInn Muay Thai is a special place. dont wait! drop in and train!

reviews.name: Alex Webb
reviews.text: Nice people! The price is reasonable and the meals are absolutely wonderful! Kru Rin (the head coach) is very friendly and professional. The training part is intense but not too pushy. This gym absolutely gives the family vibes. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Malick Sylva
reviews.text:
I've been going to Rinn Muay Thai every year since 2018 and i never experienced anything bad. The gym is clean and the food wonderful. Since then, their gym location changed twice and kept going to all of their location every year and everything remained the same to this day. I began sending fighters and friends there and they all gave me the same feedback, "it feels like we are part of the family".
Rooms at gym are clean with all the accommodations needed for a fight camp, showers were clean and the food was exceptional!
I really recommend this gym, whether it is for  simple fitness day to day training or for a fight preparation!

จากที่ได้ไปสัมผัส รินมวยไทยคือครอบครัวไม่ใช่แค่สถานที่ฝึกซ้อมมวย เพราะทุกครั้งที่ได้กลับไปเมืองไทย ทุกๆคนที่รินดูแลดีมากๆ ทั้งอาหารและการฝึกซ้อม และมีนักมวยที่มาจากสวิส ชื้นชอบและอยากกลับไปซ้อมอีกในทุกๆปี

reviews.textTranslated:
From my experience, Rin Muay Thai is like a family, not just a training ground. Every time I return to Thailand, everyone at Rin takes such good care of me, from the food to the training. There's even a boxer from Switzerland who loves it and wants to go back to train there every year.
You can find boxing training places anywhere, but a place that feels like family isn't everywhere. 🥰🙏🏼🇨🇭🇹🇭

reviews.name: 向羽
reviews.text:
宝藏拳馆rinn！非常优秀的泰拳馆，这里不是那种商业拳馆，教练团队水平很高，胡林 阿东主教练负责尽职，拳馆团结友爱，一群逗比，老板娘更是做得一手好菜，训练完吃起来格外香！无论你来职业还是业余，都是不二选择！价格也很公道！如果你不喜欢一大堆人在一起练，不喜欢各种推销，不喜欢花里胡哨，那么这里是你最佳的选择。
来这里两个多月，打了四场比赛，每一场都收获很多，现在准备长驻泰国，进行职业泰拳比赛。朝着one lumpini进发！
reviews.textTranslated:
Rinn is a hidden gem of a Muay Thai gym! It's an excellent gym, not your typical commercial one. The coaching team is top-notch; head coaches Hu Lin and A Dong are responsible and dedicated. The gym is friendly and supportive, full of fun-loving guys, and the owner is an amazing cook – the food tastes especially delicious after training! Whether you're a professional or amateur, it's the perfect choice! The prices are also very reasonable! If you don't like training in large groups, don't like pushy sales tactics, and don't like flashy presentations, then this is the place for you.

I've been here for over two months, fought four matches, and learned a lot from each one. Now I'm preparing to stay in Thailand long-term and compete professionally in Muay Thai. My goal is to become a one-lumpini!

plusCode: QXVX+4V Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Desirae Johnson
reviews.text:
We had the most amazing experience last night at Basil Cooking School with Tom! From start to finish, the class was engaging, well-organized, and so much fun. We started at the local market to purchase the produce.

Tom was an incredible instructor — patient, knowledgeable, and full of personality. He explained each step clearly, shared helpful cooking tips we can actually use at home (we also received a digital cookbook), and gave us great insight into Thai ingredients and flavors. You can tell he truly loves what he does, and that energy made the entire experience even more special.

The food we prepared was absolutely delicious (and surprisingly doable!), and the atmosphere felt welcoming and relaxed the whole time.

If you’re visiting Chiang Mai and want an authentic, hands-on Thai cooking experience, I can’t recommend Basil Cooking School enough — and definitely ask for Tom! 🌿✨

reviews.name: Olivia Boeker
reviews.text:
What an amazing experience! The food was delicious, the chef was so helpful and kind. The entire Basil Cookery School was amazing! The groups are pretty small, which is great! We were 6 and there are only about 8 woks.
The team makes everything so simple and easy to follow.
My gluten free boyfriend was able to make everything with gluten free soya sauce and mushroom sauce they have on hand.

reviews.name: Joyce Sjoberg
reviews.text: Tom and his team were so professional. Pick up from hotel was on time. Our options chosen en route to outdoor market, the learning started the minute he began picking up vegetables and spices. I appreciated the diverse options to create (6 total in half day experience.) The team presented the ingredients with simplicity and visually popped on the preparation plate. Each and every item our group made was delicious. Only concern was no soap in bathroom ( instead hand sanitizer outside). I watched as other groups in the market had 12-15 participants, each trying to grasp what the chef/teacher was illustrating while our group had the attention of Tom at all times. I've already made a few of the dishes at home to the accolades of others. Thank you Tom and team!

reviews.name: Richard Portman Smith
reviews.text: What an amazing experience. Tom and his helpers were so friendly and accommodating. We were taken to a food market first to learn about ingredients then back to the kitchen where we made some delicious dishes. Only 4 of us so it felt extra special. Small amount of help given where needed so you really are cooking yourself. We took back what we couldn’t eat there so will enjoy later. 100% recommend Basil Cookery School. Thanks again.

reviews.name: lisa
reviews.text:
We did a cooking class with Tom a few weeks ago. Both of us had six different recipes so we tried twelve unique dishes that night.
Since it was only the two of us we got a chance to chat with Tom in between dishes and had wonderful conversations.
Before cooking we visited a local market for a lesson on local ingredients. Tom also drove us from and to our hotel. We really enjoyed the experience and are hoping to create similar dishes at home for family and friends with the help of the recipes we got at the end.

reviews.name: Carmel Cohen
reviews.text: Wow, what an experience we had. Tom picked us up from the hotel and we went straight to the market, we took a tour of the market and Tom explained to us all the spices used in Thai cuisine and the different ingredients. At first we thought we would be a big group and in the end it was just the two of us, really a private workshop. We made so many dishes that we didn't have room to eat everything and Tom packed up what was left for us so we could enjoy what was left after. At the end Tom took us back to the hotel. I highly recommend this place, everything was exceptionally clean and aesthetically pleasing, you have to come here!

reviews.name: S FC
reviews.text:
Outstanding experience! If you want an authentic thai food experience with the satisfaction and pride of knowing you made it yourself - book this now!

You get taken to the food market to be shown all the ingredients and then you spend the evening cooking, chatting away to Tom. Its geniunely such a blast! You will be stuffed so do not eat before you come, trust me youll appreciate it more!

reviews.name: Richard Wilkins
reviews.text: Excellent. We were collected from our hotel to go to the market to buy ingredients for the dishes we chose. Just the two of us, whereas at the market we saw large groups from other cookery schools. The food we made under Tom’s guidance was delicious and we learned a lot. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Anand Shelat
reviews.text: One of the best cooking experiences we’ve ever had. 7 people, 5 adults and 2 children. 2 gluten free and 2 vegetarian. Tom was simply amazing coordinating all the dishes and navigating between story telling and directing. Simply phenomenal experience that I recommend to everyone!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you guy and enjoy your Thai cooking at home

reviews.name: graham holmes
reviews.text:
Tom did a your of the fresh market from the vegetables to Thai sauces used. There were other large cooking classes there as well - so glad we picked Tom’s BASIL  Cookery school. Was taught to cook 6 different meals that you chose and ate them as you went along
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED 😀😀😀😀🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Olivia
reviews.text: My friend and I had such a great time with Basil Cookery School! Chef Tom was very kind and informative and sent us home with a very detailed virtual recipe book. We had a small group of 5 and after the 4.5 hour class ended up leaving as friends! We made 6 amazing dishes and even took home what we couldn’t finish. Tom also easily accommodated 2 vegetarians in our class. I would absolutely recommend this cooking course for anyone in Chiang Mai!😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you

reviews.name: Erika Kollár
reviews.text: This is the best cooking class experience we ever had! The staff is the best, super kind, friendly and attentive, and due to the small sized groups you can see, hear and taste everything. You can choose from 3 options for each of the 6 dishes individually which I think is really great! The dishes are tasty and the whole class is so much fun, everything went smooth and hassle free and you even get a nice recipe book to take home with you. If you are considering a cooking class in CM, don’t hesitate just book with them.

reviews.name: Meng “Lemon” H
reviews.text:
Amazing experience in Thailand even though I have been in Thailand for several times. known several common spice from half day cooking. The chef is super attentive and dedicated while teaching, explains everything with great care, and always answers any questions I have. Everthing is perfect.
Then the last step: when is the time to really make thai food alone after learning before totally forget it😂

reviews.name: Sam Sanchez
reviews.text: This was the best experience we had visiting Chiang Mai. Tom was the most excellent guide we’ve had - he was so attentive with all communication. Tom will pick you up from your hotel and start with a morning stroll to a local market, where he introduces all of the Thai ingredients you will be using for your dishes, going into depth explaining each ingredients’ flavor & use. Afterwards, you arrive at the school where the studio is very clean and well prepared for the whole class. There was such a variety of dishes to choose from, and after Tom will email a full recipe cookbook of everything. We couldn’t recommend this class more such a great and interactive experience…still the best mango sticky rice we’ve had!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for comment and support us !!!

reviews.name: Tyler M
reviews.text: This cooking class was so good! The food was amazing, we had so much left over to takeaway too. Toms recipes are 10/10, so excited to get home and cook them for my family. The cooking book provided at the end of class is top notch. Thank you Tom, would recommend to absolutely anyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Tomas Fernandez Cuervo
reviews.text:
What a memorable experience will never forget this.
100% recommend.
The highlight had to be when Ainsley Harriott joined us.

reviews.name: 814joseph Hennessy
reviews.text: This was a great option! We were collected from the hotel & returned. Tom was a great Instructor and tour guide through the food markets of Chiang Mai. The experience was fantastic, our freshly cooked food was incredible. Best food we have eaten so far. Tom was great and created a great atmosphere. Thanks Basil Cookery school, it was a true Thai experience. Highly recommend !!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Yarden
reviews.text: What a lovely experience! Started out day at the market with Wan, she explained to ours about all the ingredients we are going to cook with. Wan was super knowledgable which was really nice. After a nice stroll in the market we had to the school. My husband is vegetarian and I don’t eat fish, everything was custom to our liking. We made ALOT of food, so delicious and easy. Must experience in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Kathryn Rincavage
reviews.text: Highly recommend taking a Thai cooking class while in Chiang Mai, and especially taking it with Tom and his team (including Game) at Basil Cookery School! My fiancé and are fairly beginner cooks but learned so much about the basic ingredients used in Thai classic dishes as well as the cooking techniques used to prepare several different types of meals. The class is a bit of a whirlwind since you learn to make and taste so many different things, but you have the opportunity to focus on the preparing and cooking of the food while the team does clean up. The market visit prior to cooking as well as the provided recipe book after class are excellent touches. In our experience, Basil Cookery School was less crowded than other classes and more personalized. We just returned home and already bought a wok! Thanks again Tom for sharing your knowledge and kindness!

reviews.name: Nicole Richard
reviews.text: Today our family of 5, plus our two friends attended the morning class at Basil Cookery.  We were picked up at our hotels and stopped at the local market to learn about the ingredients used in Thai cooking.  We had 20 minutes to walk around, grab a coffee and then we headed to the class in their van.  We chose our 6 dishes before going to the market, and other than the noodle dish which they recommended to be the same, we could all choose different dishes.  What an amazing experience for both the adults and children (aged 9 to 13).  Each person had their own workstation and wok, some food was prepared ahead, but we still got to work hard to prepare our own dishes.  The kids did their own cooking, and had a wonderful time.  The teacher and her assistant were funny, patient, so helpful and great at explaining all the steps.  We highly recommend taking a class with Basil Cookery. The only suggestion that I would add is to NOT eat before going. There is so much food, and no one could finish it all!  Such a wonderful experience!! Thank you so much to Huan and Piu (not sure of the spelling!) for the beautiful morning spent with you!

title: Training Ground Gym & Wellness Hub
ownerDescription:
Training Ground is located at Sukhumvit 69, just 200 meters from BTS Phra Khanong. Our gym is filled with a wide range of modern, clean, and state-of-the-art equipment.

We are the largest strength and conditioning, and CrossFit gym in all of Asia. With 1200 square meters of beautifully equipped space, passionate and experienced coaches, and a supportive community of like minded positive people, Training Ground is a fitness haven. Come try us out and start your journey to becoming the best version of yourself.
address: 36, 2 Sukhumvit 69 Alley, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

After my class, she asked for an update on my class, as well as, informed of current promotions! Overall, the hyrox class I attended was amazing! Had a great workout with instructor Ron! He too was great! Highly recommend checking out this location!

reviews.name: jitraporn santalunai
reviews.text: A hidden fitness community near BTS Phra Khanong. The open-air gym has a great vibe, with friendly coaches and people from all over the world. There are plenty of classes for all fitness levels. A great place to work out and meet new people!

reviews.name: Siriwan P.
reviews.text: The staff here were incredibly kind, Zin was really helpful. So gently and patiently, even though I had so many questions. Lovely!

reviews.name: Souzana
reviews.text: What an awesome place! ✨Great instructors, inspirational wods and the community rocks it! The place is so neat and clean! Their smoothies and the lunches they offer are so tasty and healthy! 💯

reviews.name: Stefan Shilgalis
reviews.text: My new gym and I love it.  It’s got top of the line equipment, friendly staff and month to month unlimited use pricing for open gym.   Showers and bathrooms and delicious coffee shop are extra bonuses!

reviews.name: Momo
reviews.text:
I've tried all the CrossFit gyms in Bangkok as a complete fitness beginner, and Training Ground is by far the best! From the facility to the community, coaches, people, and equipment—everything here is top-notch. I was initially nervous about joining the classes since everyone here is super fit, but the warm and patient atmosphere made me feel welcomed right away.

The owner, Ron, is a true visionary as a coach and gym owner. Him and his team created a space focused on long-term body and mind growth and sustainable health, unlike many gyms with the "get fit fast" trends.

The coaches—Simon, Babs, Liz, Watchi, Scott—are all incredible. They're all highly trained and pay close attention to detail, ensuring you use the right form to prevent injuries. Their motivation and encouragement keep you going throughout the workout, and they're genuinely invested in your growth, both in and out of class.

The front desk staff, like Darius, are super sweet, they remember your names even if you don’t come often and always greet you with a big smile, which is a nice touch, especially during those early morning workouts when you’re so dead.

Training Ground isn't just a gym; it's a community. Everyone here is incredibly nice, and they make you feel right at home—even if you're not a seasoned CrossFitter like me. Plus, it doesn’t hurt that it’s probably the gym with the most good-looking people around! It’s also dog friendly so I love seeing cute dogs coming in.

If you're looking for the best CrossFit or any kind of fitness experience in Bangkok, definitely try Training Ground!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We’re glad that you had a great experience at Training Ground and are pleased to be part of your journey in improving your health and strength. We believe in the importance of building a warm and caring community, and ensuring everyone uses correct and safe form. We’ll pass your compliments on to Ron, Simon, Babs, Liz, Watchi, Scott, and the entire team, including Darius, who always welcomes you with a smile.

We hope to see you back at Training Ground soon, and don’t forget to bring your adorable dog to say hello!

Thank you again for being part of the Training Ground family!😊

reviews.name: Brandon Bateman
reviews.text: Great box. Did a drop in during a business trip. Fun team workout on Saturday morning. You’ll work, you’ll sweat and you’ll meet good people like you do in most CrossFit gyms. Great t shirt too. Gym was clean, well organized and spacious for a lot of people.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much

reviews.name: Lizzie May
reviews.text:
TrainingGround (TG) is not just your average CrossFit gym; it's an exceptional community that offers so much more. Before walking into TG for the first time, I was filled with apprehension and nerves about diving into a new sport. However, all my worries disappeared the moment I stepped inside. The atmosphere at TG is unparalleled - it's welcoming, encouraging, and incredibly supportive. As an active member, TG has become my home away from home in Bangkok. Whether you're interested in exploring CrossFit or simply searching for a place to break a sweat, I can't recommend TG enough. You'll find more than just a workout here; you'll become part of a family. It may sound like a cliché, but in just a few months, I've truly come to feel like a valued member of the TG community.
And there is always a furry friend around for puppy cuddles <3

But I was just here for one day and wanted a quick workout for an hour. That is not worth 750 baht in my opinion.

description: Polished restaurant in a printing house offering French-inspired dishes, set menus & a chef's table.
address: Charoen Rat 7 Yeak 7-6-1 Alley, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

reviews.name: Thanapong Niyomkar
reviews.text:
MAGNIFICENT!!!

This is one of the best chief-table experience I had!
The food is simply superb, from the ingredients to the cooking. Every dish taste amazing that I sent them back empty plates!
With how good the food is compare to the price, I'll say you get more that what you pay for.
The chief and his team are amazing with great service.

The only downside here would be the parking space is limited in front of the store. But they do have a reserved parking lot that is a little bit far out (~500 meters)

Please note that you need to book for a table beforehand on the LINE Shop platform.

reviews.name: Nayos T.
reviews.text:
My wife booked this restaurant when she saw a post of the soup with tiger prawn on Facebook.

The food delicious! The beef Wellington was perfectly cooked. Even my wife finished her plate. She usually don’t eat much beef cuz she finds it chewy. The tiger prawn cauliflower soup didn’t disappoint either.

Totally of 6 courses, but the portion was quite filling. I highly recommend you checking it out. You’ll walk always full and satisfied with the food.

A few things that could’ve made the experience better:

Our reservation was for the 12pm round serving (set menu). We arrive on time and had to wait almost 30 minutes until our first course was served. So I recommend you show up 15-20 minutes late.

During our wait, there wasn’t  a whole lot of interaction with the staff and kinda felt like dead time. If a staff member would’ve just came and tell us what was being prepared and explain the dish just a little it would’ve helped with the dead time.

Since I had no idea what was in the menu for the day, and unfortunately, they don’t have printed menus in the restaurant. It would not be the worse idea to have a physical menu printed so you can refer back to it when you’re eating each course.

They also didn’t have cloth napkins, which was surprising for me for a restaurant that serves multi course set menus.

Otherwise I’d given this restaurant a 5 star rating.

reviews.name: Preeyakorn Palm
reviews.text: It's something to experience! The delivery during the lockdown wasn't as good. It's totally different menu and taste. In-house dining is more of French taste. They put in quality ingredients. Booking is way too much of an effort and wait. Location (and the place) isn't as pleasant to enjoy as a fine dining though.

reviews.name: Karin Buddharuksa
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at the chef's table and was blown away by the experience. The six-course meal was expertly crafted and each dish was more impressive than the last.

The first course was a delicate appetizer of a fresh tomato and fishes

Next up was a thick Foie gras serve with berry sauce. The foie gras was tender and delicate.

For the third course, we were served a perfectly cooked prawn on a creamy cauliflower soup. The richness of the dish is superb

The fourth course was a deep fried fish with skin. Served with lemon foam. Not my type

The fifth course was a Beef Wellington. The contrast between the tender, juicy beef and the flaky, buttery puff pastry. The pâté and duxelles add even more flavor and texture to the dish.

The final course was a refreshing dessert to clear out excessive food we had earlier. Ending this course with sour-sweet dish

Overall, the chef's table experience was a culinary masterpiece. The attention to detail and creativity in each dish was evident, and the service was impeccable. I highly recommend giving it a try if you have the opportunity.

reviews.name: Lola L
reviews.text: The crab dish, river prawn dish were great. The freshly baked pretzel and brioche loaf was delicious with the truffle butter and chowder. We requested for a non-beef dish and was served one with fish and foie gras which was a very rich dish but the flavours were well-balanced. Frankly, the duck breast dish was very mediocre but the mashed potatoes that was served with it was the star of the show. Hands down the smoothest and tastiest mashed potatoes ever! Serving size is quite large, left feeling satiated! If you’re into fusion omakase, you can consider making a reservation.

reviews.name: Vipavee Tiva (Tam)
reviews.text:
Overall taste is ok. The restaurant is not that clean since it’s in someone house. Expect to be cleaner with this price. Chef loves taking photos and using his phone then touch/cook the food. The chef should be more hygiene!! Wine is overcharged! One glass cost almost 1k.

Foie gras dish is my favorite. They cook it super well. Soup was slightly too salty.

reviews.name: Janphong Chitwasinkul
