reviews.name: Petcher Love
reviews.text: This is affordable price luxurious French cuisine with high quality ingredients for everyone. Chef Paul Bocuse puff soup is the star for me. My advice is empty your stomach as much as possible because the portions of food are not small!

reviews.name: Sumeet Gurbani
reviews.text: Hidden gem in the deep sois of Chan road. Chefs also catered to vegetarians. Chefs table experience with passion for food expressed the minute you walk through into the kitchen

reviews.name: Ann Tan
reviews.text: An unusual place to find this dining experience- an old print shop with an old apple computer (wonder if it’s still working) on the ground floor. Go upstairs and it’s an open kitchen where u can sit and watch the chef and his crew prepare your yummy dinner. This is a 6-course dining omakase style. First dish- blue fin tuna tartare. 2nd dish foie gra with strawberry sauce. 3rd dish- parsnip soup with buttery puff pastry and prawn. 4th dish- grouper with cauliflower purée. 5th dish- beef Wellington.  Last dish- apple everything!

reviews.name: Karen Ho
reviews.text:
Eclectic and grunge ambience mixed hearty honest classic french style food. I am impressed with the cookery and amount of soul that went into the food. Chef Big came across as someone who truly wanted to feed you with his food, given that the restaurant name is an echo of so many home cooks I came by, who want to cook but not eat as the true fulfilment came from cooking and feeding the guests.

In todays speak, we must protect Chef Big at all cost.

I enjoyed almost every morsel, to elevate, will mean engaging a serious chef patessier, and maybe a less grungy setting, outside of his parents’ printing business. But that would take away the soul and the fun wouldn’t it?

What a successful night.

reviews.name: Pavipis
reviews.text:
Great food at affordable price for French.
In love their crab menus. Only that I’m not a fan of Foei Gras. You can ask for substitute with Hotate.

reviews.name: Pansiri Chanprasit
reviews.text:
Price a bit expensive compare to the material they cooked, but the taste way more than any other restaurant.
The best beef wellington I've er tried

reviews.name: ch s
reviews.text: French fine dining. The foie gras was well paired with beetroot and raspberry sauce

reviews.name: Joshua Syn
reviews.text: Amazing food,you definitely need to try once if you ever visit to Thailand.

reviews.name: Kingsley Foo
reviews.text: The food quality is good. The chef is there to introduce each dish you.

title: Ninja School Sathorn (NSS)
ownerDescription: Welcome to Ninja School Sathorn, home to the Ninja Academy program for kids as well as a training center for BJJ (Brazilian Jiu Jitsu), Boxing, Muay Thai, and MMA.
address: 182/1 Nang Linchi 6 Alley, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

reviews.name: Chatty P
reviews.text: It maybe convenient to get to and have vairety of trainings to offer but not suitable for kids under 6 years old. I witness a child (must be firsr timer, approx 6 ys old) who was not ready to participate being shouted at, carried out and sent out of the class. I understand that instructor doesnt want interuption to the resr of class but this treatment while is acceptable for older kids. In my opinion not necessary and cam be done in different ways by teacher.assistance perhaps. My personal opinion. Positive, the instructor is very energetic during session and other kids seem to be enjoying it
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback and for sharing your perspective.
For very young children, first classes can sometimes be overwhelming, and we understand that every child adapts differently to group activities and structured environments.
In this particular situation, the child repeatedly refused to participate, disrupted the class several times, and became upset when asked to step aside. To avoid further disruption for the rest of the group and to ensure a safe learning environment, the coach calmly brought the child back to the parent, who was standing nearby.
Our coaches always aim to balance patience, encouragement, discipline, and the overall experience of the entire class. We appreciate your positive comments about the energy of the sessions and the experience of the other children, and we will continue working to create the best environment possible for all age groups.

reviews.name: Anya Oxley
reviews.text: Recommend ninja classes for kids! Sathorn location includes outdoor and indoor space with aircon so no Bangkok heat🔥. Clean and welcoming environment. Very good training for adults, includes various classes such as BJJ, MMA, Muay Thai and conditioning. Friendly and professional coaches.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your great review and recommendation! 🙏😊
We’re very happy that you enjoy both our kids’ Ninja classes and adult training at Ninja School Sathorn. We’ve worked hard to create a clean, welcoming space where children and adults can train comfortably, indoors and outdoors.
Thank you also for your kind words about our coaches. We really appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again soon! 🥷🔥🙏

reviews.name: Loretta Chin
reviews.text: Ninja Academy’s new center is the best indoor and outdoor kids sport venue we’ve ever seen. It's well-organized, clean, safe and fun environment for kids and my son absolutely loves it. Patrick and his team of coaches make each session highly enjoyable for the kids. Highly recommended for families looking for a great place to keep their kids active and entertained! They have half day camps during school holidays, and kids earn point to win some freebies (ninja tees and ski masks).
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your fantastic review! We're thrilled to hear you consider our new center the best indoor and outdoor venue for kids. It's great to know your son loves the sessions with Patrick and our team. We appreciate your kind words about our clean, safe, and fun environment. Looking forward to seeing your family again soon!

reviews.name: Emilio Brimblecombe
reviews.text:
Ninja School Sathorn (NSS)  is a fantastic muay Thai gym  in Thailand, especially for foreigners. The trainers speak good English and focus on teaching the basics, not just pad work like other gyms. They mix in technical drills, sparring, and conditioning too.

The trainers are friendly and patient, making it easy to learn and improve. If you're looking for great Muay Thai training in Thailand, I highly recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're thrilled to hear that you had a great experience at Ninja School Sathorn (NSS). Our team takes pride in providing a comprehensive training experience, focusing on both fundamentals and advanced techniques. It's fantastic to know that our trainers' friendliness and patience made your learning journey enjoyable and effective. We appreciate your recommendation and hope to see you back at NSS for more Muay Thai training soon!

reviews.name: Sira Sirapracha
reviews.text: This gym is in a very convenient location, making it easy to get to. The facilities are spacious with a wide variety of equipment that can suit any training style. What really sets it apart from normal gyms is the atmosphere and the people especially the coaches. They are very friendly, approachable, and give great support whether you’re just starting out as a beginner or already more advanced 💪💪💪. The environment feels welcoming and motivating, which makes training here an enjoyable experience. I would definitely recommend this gym to anyone looking for a place to train seriously while still feeling supported. 😊💕💕🙏🏻🙏🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this wonderful review and for recommending us! 🙏😊
We’re especially happy to hear your comments about our coaches and the atmosphere. Our goal at Ninja Team Thailand is to create a place where everyone—from complete beginners to experienced athletes—can train seriously, improve, and still feel welcome and supported by the team. 💪🥋🔥
Thank you for being part of our community, and we look forward to many more training sessions together! 🙏❤️

reviews.name: Anders Bangkok
reviews.text:
Beautiful training new center in Sathorn, with a nice garden for outdoor training and huge indoor space fully air-coned, with classes for both kids and adults.
I tried the Yoga session, that I really enjoyed. They also offer Ninja kids training (American ninja warrior style), Western boxing, Muay Thai, Brazilian Jiu Jitsu…
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the Yoga session and appreciate your kind words about our facilities. It’s great to know that our variety of classes, from Ninja kids training to Brazilian Jiu Jitsu, are being noticed and enjoyed.

We look forward to welcoming you back soon for more sessions!

reviews.name: Glutenhaus bkk
reviews.text: Highly recommended for all kids who have high energy. My kid takes Ninja class, coaches really patience with her.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your recommendation! 🙏😊 We definitely love our high-energy little Ninjas! 🥷🔥
Every child is different, so our coaches do their best to be patient, understand each child’s personality and help them learn and progress at their own pace while having fun.
We’re very happy to have your daughter training with us, and we look forward to seeing her continue to grow and enjoy her Ninja classes! ❤️🥷🙏

reviews.name: samuel sebastian huang
reviews.text: I was that close for not coming here because i thought people gonna kill me there because my jiu jitsu is so bad. Turns out its really good and really safe place to train jiu jitsu. I got my favorite place to train now in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your awesome review! 🙌 We're so glad you decided to give us a chance and found Ninja School Sathorn to be a safe and welcoming place to train Jiu-Jitsu. Everyone starts somewhere, and our goal is to create a supportive environment for all levels to improve and enjoy training. We're excited that you've found your favorite place to train in Bangkok and look forward to seeing you on the mats more often! 💪🥋

reviews.name: Tanish Kedia
reviews.text:
Ninja School Sathorn is one of the best training academies in Bangkok for both kids and adults. The children’s ninja programs are incredible, combining parkour, obstacle courses, and fitness in a way that keeps kids engaged, active, and confident. The outdoor area is a huge highlight, giving children a safe and open space to run, jump, and explore while learning new skills.

For adults, the gym offers top-quality training in Muay Thai, BJJ, boxing, and overall strength and conditioning, with programs suitable for every level. The atmosphere is motivating, friendly, and professional.

But what really makes Ninja School stand out are the coaches. The ninja instructors for kids are simply fantastic — they balance discipline with fun, and bring out the best in every child. Their energy and encouragement make training both exciting and effective.

A truly outstanding place for fitness, confidence, and growth.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a thoughtful and detailed review! 🙏❤️
You’ve really captured what we’re trying to build at Ninja School Sathorn: a place where children and adults can train, challenge themselves, learn new skills and enjoy being part of a positive community. 🥷🥋🥊
Your words about our coaches mean especially a lot to us. Finding the right balance between discipline, encouragement and fun with the kids is something our team works hard on every day. We want every child to feel supported while also being challenged to grow in confidence, independence and ability. 💪
We’re also very happy that you appreciate the variety of adult training and our indoor and outdoor facilities. Bringing all these programs and people together is what gives NSS its special atmosphere.
A huge thank you from all of us for your trust, support and recommendation! 🙏🔥

reviews.name: Asahiko Sugawara
reviews.text:
The coaches are really skilled and take the time to help you improve, whether it’s Muay Thai, MMA, or BJJ. The classes are well-structured and the atmosphere is super friendly.

Besides, everyone is supportive and welcoming. The gym is clean, well-equipped, and feels like a great place to train no matter your level. Highly recommend this place if you’re in Bangkok and want quality training.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the great review and recommendation! 🙏🥊🥋
We’re really happy that you appreciate both the quality of the coaching and the friendly atmosphere. That balance is exactly what we want at Ninja Team Thailand: serious, structured training where everyone can improve, but also a place where beginners, experienced athletes, and competitors can all feel welcome and supported. 💪🔥
A big thank you from all our coaches and the whole team. We really appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you back on the mats soon! 😊🙏

reviews.name: Patrick Salter Townshend
reviews.text: It is an amazing place to train whether it is for BJJ, MMA, Muaythai, Boxing and more it offers many different classes allowing me  as a person to get better in each of the classes I think plus the schedule is very flexible as theres morning and afternoon sessions. I absolutely enjoy the Coaches here they are very good and pushes me individually to get better, furthermore I would also recommend bringing your kids here as they also offer Ninja and other classes for kids which involve fun parkour, bjj classes for the next generation and more.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this amazing and detailed review! 🙏🔥
We’re really happy that you’re taking advantage of the different training options at NSS. Having BJJ, MMA, Muay Thai, Boxing and more under one roof gives everyone the opportunity to develop different skills, and our morning and afternoon/evening sessions are there to make training easier to fit into everyday life. 💪🥋🥊
It’s especially great to hear that our coaches are pushing you individually and helping you improve—that personal attention is very important to us.
And thank you for mentioning our kids’ programs too! 🥷❤️ We love seeing the next generation learning Parkour, BJJ and other skills while building confidence, discipline and having fun.
Thank you for being part of the Ninja community! See you at training! 🔥🙏

reviews.name: Alex Chobsuk
reviews.text:
I’ve been training MMA, Muay Thai, and boxing here and the instructors are top-notch. Workouts are challenging but fun, and the energy in the gym is great.

Watching the kids in the Ninja program is also super entertaining it adds a fun vibe to the place, it shows that they are building young warriors into the world🔥
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the awesome review! 🙏🔥🥊
We’re really happy you’re enjoying the MMA, Muay Thai and Boxing training with us. Challenging training, good energy and having fun while improving is exactly the atmosphere we want to create. 💪
And we love your comment about our little Ninjas! 🥷❤️ The kids definitely bring a special energy to the gym. We’re not just teaching them physical skills—we want to help them grow in confidence, discipline, resilience and respect as they become the next generation of young warriors. 🔥
Thanks for being part of the Ninja Team! See you at training! 🙏

reviews.name: Sila Sirapracha
reviews.text:
NSS is an awesome spot in Bangkok to train 🥊 Muay Thai,  BJJ, boxing, and MMA — all under one roof. The gym is clean, air-conditioned , and well-maintained, which makes a big difference in the Bangkok heat.

The trainers are professional, approachable, and really friendly. Whether you’re a total beginner or someone with experience, they make the classes safe and enjoyable. Weekend sessions are especially fun 🔥, with a lively mix of Muay Thai, boxing, MMA, and BJJ that bring the community together.

This is a great choice for anyone who wants variety, good coaching, and a supportive vibe.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a detailed review! 🙏🥊🥋
We’re really happy that you enjoy not only the variety of training at NSS, but also the atmosphere and community we’re trying to build. Having Muay Thai, Boxing, BJJ and MMA together under one roof gives everyone the opportunity to try different disciplines, train with different coaches, and meet people from all backgrounds and experience levels.
Your comments about our coaches mean a lot to us. We want serious training, but always in a friendly, safe and supportive environment where beginners feel just as welcome as experienced athletes. 💪🔥
And yes, weekends at NSS definitely have a special energy! 😅🔥
Thank you for being part of our community and for your support. See you on the mats! 🙏🥷

reviews.name: Margin (Teetouch) Vilaiwatanakorn
reviews.text:
I’ve had such an amazing time at NSS! I learned so much and had so much fun while training. The Ninja program is super engaging and really well structured—it makes training exciting while also pushing me to improve.

The adult programs are equally impressive, especially BJJ, MMA, Muay Thai, and conditioning. The coaches are very knowledgeable and supportive, and the atmosphere is always positive and motivating.

Highly recommend NSS to anyone looking to learn new skills, get fitter, and be part of a great community!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for such a wonderful review! 🙏🔥
It makes us very happy to hear that you’ve enjoyed both the training and the atmosphere at NSS. Whether it’s Ninja, BJJ, MMA, Muay Thai or conditioning, we want every session to be a place where people can learn, challenge themselves, have fun and keep progressing. 💪🥋🥊
But what matters most to us is the community we’re building around the training. Thank you for being part of it and for recommending NSS to others. ❤️🙏
See you at the next session! 🔥🥷

reviews.name: Nucharin Wangphongsawasd
reviews.text: It's a great and fun place for kids' functional training run by the best team of coaches. The training facility is fantastic, and their Ninja program is unique. Plus, BJJ, Boxing, and Muay Thai for adults are all in one place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review! We're delighted that you find Ninja School Sathorn a great and fun place for kids' functional training. Our team of coaches takes pride in providing top-notch sessions. We're thrilled you appreciate our fantastic training facility and unique Ninja program. With BJJ, Boxing, and Muay Thai all under one roof, we offer something for everyone. Looking forward to seeing you again soon!

reviews.name: Jeandre Joubert
reviews.text: The best place to train in Bangkok! Very warm and welcoming atmosphere with great facilities, training partners and professional staff. Coach Adams BJJ classes are incredible. My wife and I will definitely be back for more and this will be our go-to anytime we visit Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the amazing review! 🙏🥋❤️
We’re really happy that you and your wife enjoyed training with us and felt welcomed by the team. Creating a friendly community where visitors can immediately feel at home on the mats is very important to us.
And we completely agree about Professor Adam! His BJJ classes and the knowledge he shares are something very special, and we’re glad you had the opportunity to train with him. 🔥🥋
It means a lot to hear that NSS will be your go-to place whenever you’re in Bangkok. You’re both always welcome, and we look forward to training together again on your next visit! 🙏😊

reviews.name: Bos Chayut
reviews.text:
As an adult who trains and athlete. Ninja School Sathorn was a fantastic for me.
This brand new training center offers something for everyone. The outdoor space is one of the most beautiful I trained in. The indoor facilities are top-notch high quality mats for adults training.
I love the variety of classes available, including many combat sports boxing muaythai bjj and yoga.
The lighting and atmosphere is welcoming and motivating, making it a great place to train.
Highly recommended!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review! We're thrilled to hear that Ninja School Sathorn has been fantastic for your training as an athlete. It's great to know you appreciate our beautiful outdoor space, top-notch indoor facilities, and the variety of classes we offer. We're also glad you enjoy the welcoming and motivating atmosphere. We look forward to seeing you train with us again soon!

reviews.name: Kiki Dju
reviews.text:
Great club, great teachers, great people!
May you be a beginner who only wants to shake things up and get some physical exercise, or an athlete looking for a serious training to prepare for fights, the NSS will provide!
This new venue is very neat, with spacious locker rooms and showers.
They also host great, non violent activities for kids of all ages.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our club, our teachers, and our community. We strive to create an inclusive environment for everyone, whether you're here for a fun workout or serious training. We're glad you appreciate our new venue and facilities, and we're especially happy that the activities for kids have made a positive impact. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

reviews.name: Bodhi Davidson
reviews.text: Ninja School Sathorn is a fantastic new training center for both kids and adults. The Ninja program for children is amazing, with a beautiful outdoor space and a well-designed indoor area. The kids absolutely love it! For adults, there's an excellent range of classes, including Boxing, Muay Thai, MMA, Yoga, and BJJ. Highly recommend for anyone looking to get fit and have fun.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review! We're thrilled to hear that you find Ninja School Sathorn fantastic for both kids and adults. It's great to know the children love our Ninja program and that you appreciate our beautiful outdoor and well-designed indoor spaces. We're also glad you enjoy the variety of adult classes we offer. Your recommendation means a lot to us! Looking forward to seeing you again soon!

reviews.name: Sango Ikeme
reviews.text:
This is the best place to train martial arts! You can pick any classes on the schedule and you can come early morning or after work. NSS have a huge training room with beautiful daylight, the mat is comfy for training jiujitsu and very clean. They also have many equipments if you want to train boxing or Muay Thai and all the coaches are very good!
They also offer Ninja training for kids where they can train indoor and outdoor.
I highly recommend this place if you are a martial arts lover like me 🥰
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your amazing review! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoy training at Ninja School Sathorn and appreciate our flexible schedule, spacious training room, and clean, comfortable mats. It's great to know you find our equipment and coaches top-notch for Boxing, Muay Thai, and Jiu-Jitsu. We're also glad to hear your kids love the Ninja training. Your recommendation means a lot to us! 
Looking forward to seeing you back soon!

reviews.name: Maren Malmstrom
reviews.text:
I had two massages here and they were wildly different. The first one was a body scrub and oil massage. It was lovely, my masseuse was so kind and her massage techniques seemed intricate and knowledgeable with the way she targeted muscle groups and areas of the body. Afterwards the woman who checked me out asked how the massage was.

The second time I just had an oil massage. It was genuinely awful. Tam, who was massaging me was using very light with the pressure, which is okay, but she never increased the pressure or switched up the massage technique. So I asked for more pressure and she put more pressure on my arms where she was working. She asked if it was okay, it was at this point, and finished my arms and moved to my legs. After awhile on very light forearm rubbing up and down my leg, I gently asked for more pressure. I legitimately felt her get angry here. From this point on she went over the same spots with very intense pressure over and over and over again. She started muttering to herself and as she moved to my other leg she immediately started putting what I felt was just pointedly painful pressure, not therapeutic pressure, and immediately began with hard pressure, focusing there before she had felt the entirety of my leg.

I understand I don’t know what she was thinking, and I didn’t understand the words she kept muttering to herself, but i genuinely felt like she hated me and I almost stopped the massage twice, but was in a vulnerable position and felt so awkward and uncomfortable already. I had tears streaming down my face. Not even from the pain, but from the energy I felt from Tam. I of course tried to hide my crying, but at some points I think it was fairly obvious and she never asked if I was okay or if the pressure on other parts of my body was okay. She almost exclusively just rubbed her forearm as hard as she could up and down my limbs. She spent so much time on my right calf that upon leaving is  now knotted up and really sore. She did not massage my back. When she had me flip to my back, stomach up, she slapped the pillow down next to me.

It was such a weird and bad experience. I understand maybe there was misunderstanding or miscommunication, but I have never felt this negative, spiteful energy before. When I checked out, the man at the register did not ask how the massage was, which I am almost glad he didn’t because I was still holding back tears and would not have known what to say.
Even though my first experience here was amazing, I do not think I will return as I do not want to chance having another experience like I did with Tam again.

reviews.text:
The 1.5-hour boxing class was really fun! It starts with a warm-up, followed by cardio, boxing techniques, weight training, pad work with the coach, and finishes with a cool-down. It’s a very complete workout in one class 💪🥊

The class size is small (maximum around 8 people), so the coach can give everyone proper attention. Coach Mee is great—he explains well and helps correct your form throughout the session.

By the end of the class I was completely drenched in sweat, but it felt amazing and super satisfying.

Highly recommended for beginners who want to try boxing!

Note: There’s no parking at the gym. It’s best to park at The Platform Wongwian Yai and walk over. 🚶‍♀️

reviews.name: Yiğit Çuhadar
reviews.text:
Hey guys,
I’m so lucky to have met the instructors at “Go Diving.” Especially Colo… He’s become both an instructor and a friend. He excels at both. He’s knowledgeable, fun, and a cool guy.
I took the SSI1 Freediver course, participated in training sessions, and went on fun dives. I thoroughly enjoyed every single day. The theoretical and practical training was very professional. Safety is a top priority.
In short, I definitely recommend it. Please say hi to my friend Colo from me.

reviews.name: Emma
reviews.text: My family and I got our scuba divers certification at Go Diving and we couldn’t be happier. Juanchi was an amazing instructor and made us all feel safe and comfortable during our first dive. The school is very professional and well organized thanks to Pili, Juan, Mia and the rest of the amazing team. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Alicia Robles Vivar
reviews.text:
I got my Open Water certification 15 years ago, so I was really looking forward to getting back in the water , so I decided to take a refresher course.

Nacho gave us an excellent theory session for both beginners and refresher divers. He explained everything so clearly that it felt just like riding a bike; I was transported right back to where I left off 15 years ago.

After that, we went diving with Juana. She was incredibly kind, patient, and made us feel comfortable from the very beginning. I couldn’t recommend more diving with her.

When she suggested doing a night dive. At first, I was going to say no because I was terrified of not being able to see what was beneath me. My respect for the ocean definitely grows after dark. But believe me when I say that Juana made me feel so safe and confident that I decided to face that fear.

It turned out to be one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. We had so much fun! Once you’re on the bottom with your torch, your buddy beside you, and Juana guiding the dive, everything just falls into place. The ocean has so much to offer during the day, but at night it becomes a completely different world, truly magical.

Thank you, Juana, for helping me fall in love with diving all over again and for reminding me how beautiful, powerful, and deserving of our respect the ocean truly is.

reviews.name: 悠悠
reviews.text:
A wonderful experience with Go Diving.

My deepest thanks to the whole team, especially Juana, my instructor, and also Tommy and Hugo. At all times I felt completely safe, both in and out of the water, thanks to the instructors’ very high level of professionalism.

One thing that really stood out to me was that, even though the school was full of people taking courses, the teaching still felt almost one to one and very personalized. Beyond their technical skills, everyone creates an atmosphere of calm, peace, and trust.

I’m going home not only with my Open Water certification, but also with the memory of a beautiful and very positive experience in the water.

I also want to thank the captain and Mao for their professionalism on the boat, always making safety a priority.

I’m leaving with a lot of gratitude and already hoping to come back next year to do my Advanced course.

Thank you so much, Go Diving.

reviews.name: Romina Bozikovich
reviews.text:
I did fun dives with Go Diving and had an amazing experience from start to finish.
The front desk team - Pili and Juanchi - was excellent - welcoming, professional, and super helpful. But the highlight was diving with my instructor Nacho, who was absolutely outstanding both above and below the water. You can tell he truly loves what he does — his dedication, professionalism, and passion for diving make every dive an unforgettable experience. Highly recommend booking fun dives or any diving course with him. 10/10!

reviews.name: Julien Brunner
reviews.text:
We did our Open Water course here and had a really great experience. A special thank you to Colo, who was an amazing instructor throughout the whole course. He was patient, professional and always made us feel safe and comfortable underwater. His explanations were clear and he created a relaxed atmosphere while still taking safety very seriously.

Thanks to Colo, we were able to enjoy every dive and gain confidence quickly. We can highly recommend this dive school to anyone who wants to learn diving or continue their diving journey.

reviews.name: Adam Aluma
reviews.text: Had the best experience with Go diving! Completed my open water and advanced certification in just 4 days, and had so much fun! My instructor was Alvaro, he explained everything very clearly and slowly. I started with a group of 4 divers including me, and although I was the only one continuing to advanced, I stayed with Alvaro one on one and didn’t get transferred to another group. Good vibes and music on the boat, and loads of fruits! Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Mickaël
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing scuba company!! The teachers are extremely kind and accommodating (thank you Federico!!). Along with the four necessary dives for open water license, you get an additional two “recreational” dives. They take you around some of the most beautiful spots I’ve ever seen! So many fish and coral! I definitely recommend if you want to get certified or just have a single dive day.  They also speak Spanish, French, and English and german, so very international friendly. Plus a free shirt!!

reviews.name: S C
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience with Go Diving! During my short stay, I completed both a freediving course and some scuba fun dives. Since my schedule was quite tight, the team really listened to my needs and did everything they could to fit everything into my limited time. The communication before I arrived was excellent, making the whole experience smooth and stress-free.
A special thank you to my instructors, T2 and Josefina. They were incredibly patient, supportive, and always willing to think along with me. Most importantly, they were super chill, creating a relaxed atmosphere that made learning and diving even more enjoyable.
I couldn't have asked for a better dive center. Highly recommended, and definitely a well-deserved five-star rating! I'll be back!

reviews.name: J
reviews.text:
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
It was our first time on the island and our first family diving experience, and we can only say that it was more than an unforgettable experience!!!
Juanchi was our amazing instructor ! The school is very professional and well organized thanks to Juanchi, Pili, Mia and the rest of the amazing team 💙
At GO DIVING, you can trust the instructors, who are professionals and make you feel safe and confident at all times.
- On the boat, you can take a break, enjoy the views, eat fruit, and always find friendly people.
- After your day of diving, you can relax in the shop, look at photos, and share your experience with other travelers.
I would definitely choose this diving school again to continue my learning under the sea 🌊 🐳

reviews.name: Sofiia Nadiivska
reviews.text: We did the Open Water course and it was an incredibly good experience. Our instructor, Federico, was amazing! We loved how much we learned during the first two days, it really helped us understand what we were doing underwater and what was happening overall. That, combined with an amazing instructor, made it a safe and enjoyable experience, which was our main goal. Thanks a lot!!!

reviews.name: Lola Fiona MARTINEZ
reviews.text: I did my advanced open water with Juana and it was truly amazing. Juana doesn’t only teach, she spreads her passion for diving and for the ocean. Patient, professional, vigilant, and skilled, Juana made me feel calm and comfortable all along the adventure. And I think that is very special! The night dive to finish the experience was incredible! I highly recommend her, she’s the best hands down! Thank you Juanita

reviews.name: Elliot Tomczak
reviews.text:
This might sound like a paid review, but I promise it’s not — my experience was genuinely amazing.

I had a fantastic experience with Go Diving. The school was recommended to me by a dive master friend, and it absolutely lived up to the expectations.

Koh Tao is often described as a “diving factory,” but that wasn’t my experience at all. The boats were not overcrowded, and for my Open Water course, we were only three students per instructor, which made the training feel personal and comfortable.

For my Advanced Open Water course, I was even lucky enough to be one-on-one with my instructor, Nacho.

Nacho was an incredible instructor throughout the five days I trained with him. He is a very skilled teacher who makes sure you fully understand every concept before moving on. He took the time to explain everything clearly and made me feel confident and safe at all times.

The courses at Go Diving covered all the essential knowledge and were very well structured and thoughtfully designed.

Overall, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience and would highly recommend this diving center.

(Bonus point for the two t shirts and High quality diving mask offered as goodies at the end of the SSI Advanced open water diver)

reviews.name: karan mehta
reviews.text:
Finally could take out some time to pursue my open water certification. I decided to dive with Go diving at Koh Tao. The place truly lived upto my expectations. Their entire team had a great vibe. Very friendly and chill people but at the same time extremely professional in their teaching diving skills.
Alvaro was my dive instructor and he was just simply an awesome teacher to have. Very calm and a fun diver buddy to have around.
Overall Go Diving I dont wonder why this place has a perfect 5 star ratings with a couple thousand reviews, I genuinely stands up to the expected standards.

reviews.name: Pavol Caban
reviews.text:
What can I say? My plan was to stay on the island few nights and do one fun dive somewhere. But I’ve stumbled upon this diving school, started talking to people, and somehow I ended up staying for 3 weeks, did an Advanced Open Water course with Jeri and bunch of fun dives with Jakub, all of those dives were pretty awesome (especially Chumphon Pinnacle and night dive). But most importantly I’ve met the most amazing people here, who became my friends.
So yes, I would totally recommend stopping by this diving school, have a little chat and just go with the flow 😉

reviews.name: Shmuel
reviews.text:
I had my first diving experience ever here, and it was absolutely amazing.
My instructor, Marina, was incredibly professional, patient, and kind. She explained everything slowly and clearly and made me feel safe and confident throughout the whole dive.
I have a real fear of deep water and was honestly very nervous, I never thought I would be able to dive, but Marina gave me the calm and reassurance I needed to actually enjoy it.
Even underwater she was constantly checking that everyone was OK, and whenever I needed help she immediately swam over to me and assisted me, which made me feel safe the entire time.
Thanks to her, this became one of the best experiences of my life.
Highly recommended, especially for beginners or anyone who feels anxious about diving!

תודה מרינה! ❤️

reviews.name: Philip Connolly
reviews.text:
I should state here truthfully, that my association with Go Diving was a very brief one indeed, lasting but 20 minutes or so, this whilst I availed myself of their facilities.

However, during that time, I was able to witness a number of interactions, all of which were conducted with an ease of being, that only knowledge & confidence can bring. Had I been staying on Koh Tao for longer than the one day (25 April 2026), I would surely have invested my presence into 'Go Diving' for longer.

As always, happy and safe travelling.

Philip

reviews.name: carla m
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience with Go Diving Koh Tao and can honestly recommend this dive school to anyone.

My first fun dive was with Franco, and it couldn’t have started better — we were lucky enough to see a whale shark, which was absolutely unforgettable. After that, I completed my Advanced Open Water course with Nacho, and also did an additional course as preparation for the Divemaster.  Nacho did an outstanding job — he explains things clearly, is very attentive, and I learned an incredible amount during my courses with him. On top of that, I joined several fun dives with different instructors and every single experience was great.

The school is extremely professional, well organized, and has such a welcoming atmosphere. I felt comfortable and safe at all times. Overall, everyone made me feel well taken care of and supported.

If you’re looking for a dive school where you can learn a lot, feel safe, and truly enjoy diving, Go Diving Koh Tao is the place to go. I would definitely dive with them again!

See you soon guys!🤙🏼🐠✨

reviews.name: James Mason
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic time completing my AIDA 2 freediving qualification with Titou at Go Diving. The instructor was awesome, I felt safe and supported the whole time and even managed to dive to 18 meters, which I would’ve never thought possible beforehand.

100% recommend and an unforgettable experience!

reviews.name: Edvard Kerans
reviews.text:
When I first came to Koh Tao I wasn’t even planning to go scuba diving, as I have a history of not enjoying it. But since I had some friends that had done their Advanced Open Water, I thought I might as well try at least one day of diving. And here I am, an Advanced Open Water Diver itching to go dive again.

Thanks to my amazing and friendly Instructor Nacho (Ignacio) and the rest of the crew on the ship, I got over the things that made me uncomfortable under water, and went from someone who found it daunting to do a shallow 5 meter dive to someone who comfortably dives through sites as far as 30 meters underwater.

If you want to do scuba diving and are looking for amazing, supportive and friendly instructors to learn diving with, this is the place you should go to. 5/5!

title: Chen Empire Yaowarat Massage 陈家将 曼谷唐人街按摩
ownerDescription:
Chen Empire Massage is located in a Yaowarat “Plaeng Nam Road”. We offer traditional Thai massage, aroma oil body massage and foot reflexology with herbal foot bath.

With skilled therapists trained in traditional and modern massage techniques, every session is tailored to meet individual needs—whether you’re seeking deep relaxation after a long day, relief from body aches, or simply a peaceful escape from your busy routine.

Our shop is beside ‘BTS Wat Mangkon’
Our opening hours is 10am to 12am midnight.

We offer 10 min, 30 min quick massage too.
#chenempiremassage
address: 3 Plaeng Nam Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

reviews.name: Zelia
reviews.text:
Good massage! Clean, affordable and they were very friendly.

Have to walk in this little alley to get to the shop, missed it a few times so just keep your eyes peeled haha

reviews.name: Wilfred Loy Yong Kang
reviews.text: Very good Thai massage! I did an hour and then masseuse was really good. After the massage my body felt relax and more loosen up and not stiff anymore. Thank you to the masseuse and the great communication from the lady at the counter! Recommend this place if you need a place that provides good massage!

reviews.name: People Partners
reviews.text:
The best Thai massage I've ever had! Every pressure point was spot on, the pressure was perfect, and the stretching technique was amazing. I ended up extending with foot massage for another hour. 😂👍🏻

The place is very hidden, but surprisingly easy to find. The prices are also very reasonable. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Mike Burghout
reviews.text: One of the best foot massages I've had! Highly recommend this place. The oil massage was also very nice. Masseuse gave attention to the correct areas and did not just simply follow a routine. Feel very relaxed after!

reviews.name: Wildrose Muggleton
reviews.text: Amazing experience! Lovely ladies and a good relaxing ambiance. The location is off the main road, so it is very quiet. I would definitely recommend this place! ❤️💪
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We appreciate  your kind feedback and we are glad we could serve you, we look forward to your upcoming visit with us soon.

reviews.name: Bruna Souza
reviews.text: I super recommend the place.. it is kind of hidden but it worths the effort! It also worths every single cent! Naresh made a foot massage that I will remember forever!!

reviews.name: YK Tan
reviews.text: very nice massage and masseuse is very professional. I will come again when for sure

reviews.name: Wan Shi
reviews.text: Super relax massage👍 nice environment

reviews.name: Maggie Becker
reviews.text: Best foot massage I’ve ever had! The place is also very clean and very relaxing. Staff were super friendly and we got a complementary tea with the massage. Would definitely come back.

reviews.name: Omar Bouthouri
reviews.text: Extremely nice massage, would recommend. Very cozy bed and had my favourite massage in Thailand!

reviews.name: Rebecca Tan
reviews.text: Dropped in for a spontaneous 30min neck and shoulder massage and was very pleasantly surprised by how good it was. Taow did a wonderful job! Will be back!

reviews.name: Martina Holčíková
reviews.text: 10/10, the massage was fantastic and the staff were very friendly—you should definitely go. And it smells really nice here!

reviews.name: Zachary Schaad
reviews.text: Fantastic experience. Went everyday that I was staying in Bangkok and these were the best massages I had in all of Thailand. 5 stars all around. Go get a full body rub down from Chen Empire Massage!

reviews.name: Jenny Jane
reviews.text: Very friendly and very good massage. Recommend

reviews.name: Lerone Yogev
reviews.text:
Its in a borderline sketchy alley with a massage hawker out front but its 1000% legit and extremely good.

Smells great inside. Very hospitable. Extremely cheap especially for how good the service was.

300 baht was an hour long thai massage (or foot massage) and came with tea.

reviews.name: Tiger Chu
reviews.text: Chinese massge is great.  I really like getting massages here.  After 90 minutes massge, my body felt great.  Highly recommend excellent massage services.  I will go back again.

reviews.name: Eduard Slootweg
reviews.text: After long flight I went to this massage. In one word it was great. Naresh is a very professional masseur. All my fatigue was gone. I highly recommend and personally I will return for sire during my stay in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Laura Gundermann
reviews.text: Very well done massage! Got a lot of my blockages out and in general a super nice service. I just recommend it!

reviews.name: Roope Kallinen
reviews.text: Such a welcoming and calm experience. They are so strong too! I got the royal massage and strongly recommend it

reviews.name: William
reviews.text: Super good massage, we got the foot massage and I gotta say it was one of the best that we ever have. Definitely gonna go here again. Love it!! One of the technicians is also fluent in english so you guys should check it out!!

title: Chanya Massage Traditional Thai
ownerDescription: At, Chanya Massage, rejuvenate with our authentic Thai Traditional massage which uses an ancient natural healing therapy that has been around for centuries. With our wide selection of Aroma oil for deep tissue massage, to promote relaxation and wellbeing!
address: 12, 10 Nimmana Haeminda Rd Lane 13 Nimmanhaemin Tambon Su Thep, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXW9+C8 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: VMN
reviews.text:
First time here and they provided an amazing experience. They were very skilled and respectful of how much pressure to apply, by checking in with you every few minutes. The host was very welcoming and the atmosphere within the place was very calming. We will definitely come back soon for more massages.

Update 1: Came back for a 2nd massage (foot + neck and shoulder). Still the same level of attention to details. Had a different masseuse today, but she was equally as skilled as my first masseuse.

Update 2: Came back for a full body massage this time. I asked for soft today, and they toned down the massage strength for me. Felt great after the massage, as it involved some stretching at the end.

Update 3: Came back just for a foot massage today. Yet another different masseuse this time, and she might be the best yet. Legs felt great afterwards.

Update 4: Came during the 1 day of Songkran, and the ladies at Chanya know how to have fun during the water festival. Got a Thai massage today with another different masseuse. I think each one specializes I n a certain type of massage? Because she knew exactly how much pressure to use for my legs, back, shoulders and arms.

reviews.name: Ziyin L.
reviews.text: I experienced a one-hour head, shoulder, neck, and back massage here. Before the massage, they had me fill out a brief form to understand my needs. Thanks to my masseur—it was a great experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing wonderfully exprience with us! We'll look forward to welcoming you again soon :)

reviews.name: Katy Rene
reviews.text: A wonderfully relaxing massage. Very clean, calm, comfortable and aromatic environment. The therapist helped me move a lot of stuck energy in neck, head and shoulders. Very good work!

reviews.name: Bel
reviews.text:
This will be my massage go to place whenever I come back again to Chiang Mai One Nimman area.

On my 1st visit here I went for the 3 hr package for 999baht. It included a foot massage and then a neck/back/head massage with aroma oil. I requested medium pressure. It was an excellent 3 hr session. I was well massaged and oiled. The masseuse was excellent, attentive and skilled.

I went back 2 days later for 1 hr of foot massage and 1 hr of neck/back/head massage. The total came to 650baht. This time it was performed by a male, a masseur. He is younger than most of the female masseuses. I was very impressed by him. His massage movements were steady, firm, precise, smooth and disciplined. He was also caring and accommodating, making my session completely stress free.

I am very impressed with this massage parlor.  Please keep up the excellent work!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the lovely review!  We glad you enjoyed your massage and hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Ray Lesel
reviews.text: My friend and I came at the end of the night and the women took care of us with so much devotion. Incredible and sweet place. Highly recommend- especially before bed!

reviews.name: Lea Vogelwedde
reviews.text:
100% you get a questionnaire for specific problems, question if you don't want to be touched in some areas, how much pressure etc.

The owner was kind, spoke perfect English, atmosphere was relaxing. Me and my partner been there 3 times. Always different people one time even master. Highly recommend. It became our go to place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your lovely review. We happy to hear that you have such a great experience here. Hope we could take care of you again soon.

reviews.name: Rob
reviews.text:
Having lived in Thailand for several years, my girlfriend and I have experienced many Thai massages and are always on the lookout for new places to try. We decided to visit Chanya based on its glowing reviews, and overall, it was a great experience.

The service is well-organized, with a clear menu and a thoughtful form to fill out beforehand, where you can specify problem areas, preferred firmness, and focus points. This attention to detail is always a reassuring sign.

We opted for the tiger balm massage and chose the warming (yellow) balm over the cooling (green) option.

The massage itself was very good, the masseuse responded well to the form I had filled out. The staff were polite, helpful, and friendly throughout. The massage rooms are semi-private, separated by curtains, and there’s a toilet available for convenience. While the beds and pillows were a bit firm for our liking, it didn’t detract much from the overall experience.

A bonus is that they accept credit cards, which adds to the convenience. We’d happily return and recommend it to others.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are very grateful for this sincere review. We promise to improve our staff’s potential and skills even further. We all hope to see you both again
Thank you😊

reviews.name: Raweewan Mangsungnern
reviews.text: Very good massage in Chiangmai. The staff very kind and helpful. Will come back again next time.

reviews.name: Chan Lai Man
reviews.text: Very professional local massage, good price and staff are friendly

reviews.name: Patrick Rütimann
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting this massage center for a deep tissue massage and was blown away by the experience. As someone who experiences back pain, I was excited to try out this massage center and see if it could help alleviate some of my discomfort.

I'm happy to report that I left feeling significantly better than when I arrived!
The massage therapist who worked with me, Toy, was absolutely amazing. It was my first time getting a deep tissue massage, and she made sure to explain the process to me beforehand and answer any questions I had. She was extremely professional and clearly had many years of experience in her craft. The strength of her massage was impressive, and I could tell that she was really working to target the areas where I was experiencing pain and tension.
Despite the intensity of the massage, I never felt uncomfortable or like she was going too hard.

Beyond the actual massage itself, I was really impressed with the overall atmosphere of the massage center. The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, making me feel right at home from the moment I walked in the door. They were attentive to my needs and made sure that I had everything I needed to be comfortable during my massage. The facility itself was clean, well-maintained, and had a peaceful ambiance that made it easy to relax and unwind.

Overall, I would highly recommend this massage center to anyone in search of a top-notch massage experience. Toy was exceptional, and the entire staff went above and beyond to ensure that I had a positive experience. I left feeling better both physically and mentally, and I can't wait to return for another visit. Five stars!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your review and we hope that we could serve you again. Have a nice trip!

reviews.name: Cheryl Mah
reviews.text: Great massage and customer service. Would come back again! Thank you! Spoke English.

reviews.name: Elana Chee
reviews.text: Very nice massage place that I will definitely visit again and recommend my friends to come. The shop manager, Tanya is very friendly and explain every details of all treatments. The masseuse also very good on my foot, hand and neck massage.

reviews.name: Petra da Lua
reviews.text: I came here a couple of years ago when I was adjust passing through and the massage I got was amazing. The ladies here are so lovely and kind and they know what they're doing. My fav massage was Thai, but I also tried deep tissue, oil and Thai with tiger balm - all great. They give you a form where you can specify what you'd like - from different focus areas, to pressure etc. They also accept card payments or you can book through GoWabi. It's very quiet and they have relaxing music and you get tea and cookies at the end. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review. We're so happy to hear that you enjoyed your experience with us. We truly appreciate your support and hope to welcome you again on your next visit to Chiang Mai :)

reviews.name: Phillip Park
reviews.text: Therapists were amazing! I would definitely come back when I come to Chiang Mai again. You’d better book in advance since most of the time was fully booked already.

reviews.name: Jen Kong
reviews.text: Excellent Thai massage, friendly staffs. Will come again! ♡

reviews.name: Dominique S
reviews.text:
My experience at Chanya Traditional Thai Massage was okay. I opted for a deep tissue massage priced at 590 baht. The masseuse was friendly but didn't quite hit the mark in terms of providing a deep tissue massage. I left feeling a bit disappointed as I was still quite tight and didn't feel as relaxed as I had hoped.

On the positive side, they did serve a nice tea and cookies after the massage, which was a nice touch. The ambiance of the place was decent, but overall, my expectations were not fully met during my visit.

Overall, Chanya Traditional Thai Massage was not bad, but it also wasn't great. It was an average experience that left me feeling somewhat underwhelmed.

reviews.name: Big Ox Little Bird
reviews.text:
Tanya at the front desk is so incredibly nice and has amazing English. She is very kind and will help you get the right massage for you. Also very accommodating making sure I got the right lady for the job. Even calling in someone that wasn’t working at the time.

Then finally an amazing massage. I’ve been to several in the area with some serious tennis elbow pain. Nobody did anything about it or even seemed to pay any attention to the pain spots. Alita was the best. Ask for her. Very strong and will find the spots and work on them relentlessly. She was just perfect. My forearms are still tingling hours later. I know I’ll feel better tomorrow.

Thank you again for the care, attention and pride in what you do there.

Already planning to come back this week.

reviews.name: Louis
reviews.text:
Would highly recommend Chanya Massage, every member of staff is extremely polite, professional, and attentive.

K.Jessica was very professional and provided great massage. Would definitely go again!

reviews.name: Sandy Chai
reviews.text: Very nice and cozy massage place in Chiang Mai, Nimman area 👍 The staff are all very friendly and provide excellent service. Their massage skillset is superb too! Felt very relaxed after the massage session. Will definitely come for massage again 😊❤️

reviews.name: Sébastien Aurillon
reviews.text: 5 stars massage! I did a body scrub and a deep tissue - very pro, the staff is very nice and the prices are very reasonable - I even got some tea and a clementine in the end - will definitely come back next time I’m in Chiang Mai 🙏🏼

reviews.name: mellow z
reviews.text:
The owner was incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the massage therapists were all extremely professional! The environment was very quiet, clean, and comfortable 👍👍👍 During our chat, I learned that the massage therapists all had ten years of experience, no wonder their massages were so thorough!! 💆🏻👍👍👍
How comfortable was it? I stayed at a nearby hotel and had four massages in five days, each time with a different therapist, but all were incredibly comfortable 🥹💖

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณ คุณลูกค้านะค่ะทางร้านจะพยายามหาหมอนวดที่ดีและเป็นมืออาชีพให้สำหรับลูกค้าทุกคนนะค่ะ

reviews.name: Jeramia Valentine
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of living right next door to Sai Smile Massage in Chiang Mai for almost a month, and the owner quickly became one of the kindest neighbors I’ve ever had. She would often bring me fruit, and I would return the favor with fruit and chocolate. Beyond being such a sweet and genuine person, she is also an absolutely incredible masseuse.

I’ve had nearly ten massages across Thailand—in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, and Krabi—and hers was by far the best. She understands Thai massage on a deeper level: how to balance pressure so it’s never too soft or too intense, how to hold the exact pressure points just long enough to melt away built-up stress and tension, and how to leave you feeling restored both in your muscles and your whole body. I’ve had hundreds of massages in my life, and I would honestly put her in my top two or three ever!

If you’re visiting Chiang Mai, it’s worth venturing off the main road just to find her. She has an amazing smile, a warm personality, and hands that heal. I will truly miss her. 🙏

P.S. - The orange cat in the picture would approach me to pet her, and would often walk inside my apartment, it was a “neighborhood cat” and Sai and I would talk and laugh about how cute the orange cat was 🤭 🐈 🥹
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมาก คุณลูกค้าก็ใจดีและใจกว้าเช่นกัน และหวังว่าถ้าคุณลูกค้ามาเชียงใหม่จะมานวดร้านฉันก็ยินดีเสมอ ฉันพยายามนวดให้ดีที่สุดกับลูกค้าทุกคน

reviews.name: Akatsuki Kiara
reviews.text:
I had the BEST massage in my life here, being someone who has done many massages everywhere. Wan was beyond amazing, everything was on point and it provided me with so much relief. After telling her my sore points, she targeted them so well, you could tell she was sincere and present.

It's a small comfy place that makes you feel at home, and it's filled with so much technique and love. Owner was really lovely and does massages herself as well. I just felt so happy coming here. Came here two days in a row, and if I discovered this earlier, I would be here every day. A massage I'll remember for life.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you🥰🥰

reviews.name: Kristi L
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I were in desperate need of a massage, as his left calf and my left arm were extremely limited in mobility from how tight they’ve gotten from our travels. I walked in hardly able to do arm circles from how tight my arms were, but a 90 minute Thai massage from Sai was magic and I was back in business. In fact, Sai was able to help me relieve pain that I didn’t even know existed in my body. We both asked for more pressure on our massages and they certainly delivered on that. We’ve gotten about several Thai massages throughout Thailand and this one here at Sai Smile Massage was our absolute favorite. Thank you Sai for your great energy and healing, kop khun ka! 🙏🏼

10/10 Dee mak mak.My wife and I had massages Thai and coconut oil.These Ladies were excellent in their craft of Massage.

reviews.name: Stefan Loå
reviews.text:
Edited review: I’m adjusting my original 5-star rating to 4 stars due to a significant communication issue. It would greatly improve the experience if at least one staff member had strong English skills.

Six months ago, we agreed that I would maintain a 'passive membership' while I was away from Bangkok. Upon returning, I was told I must now retroactively pay the full 'active membership' rate for all those months — which is roughly 5 to 10 times more expensive.

Despite my attempts to explain the original agreement, the staff didn't understand and insisted on back-charging me the full active rate. No customer can reasonably accept such a charge, and I was left with no choice but to end my membership.

It’s unfortunate, as the facilities themselves are excellent.

...

Original 5 star review (a year ago):
I had so much fun during my first visit, so I stayed for several hours. Very easy and quick service at the desk, and easy lockers and fresh shower area. Very spacious and big areas for cardio, muay thai, stretching, free weights, machines, and all kinds of extra fitness equipment. And they got group classes like zumba and Body Combat every day. Free water, coffee, and tea in the adjoining cafeteria. It is very much space to move around and have fun while keeping in shape. One of the top 10, or even top 5, gyms I have visited all around the world.

reviews.name: TP TP
reviews.text:
Pros:
The gym boasts a commendable array of machines and cardio equipment, well-suited for general fitness enthusiasts. Its 24/7 operating hours offer unparalleled flexibility for various schedules, complemented by the convenience of three hours of complimentary parking. Additionally, the provision of free hot beverages and water reflects a thoughtful approach to member satisfaction.

Cons:
However, this facility is not tailored for individuals pursuing serious strength training or those with more advanced fitness goals. The atmosphere aligns more with a “Planet Fitness” ethos, emphasizing general health and wellness rather than pushing the boundaries of physical performance. For dedicated lifters, the limited availability of only one squat rack and a noticeable absence of focus on lower-body training can be significant drawbacks. Leg day, in particular, appears to be undervalued, while the gym culture skews heavily toward upper-body workouts.

During peak hours (6-7 PM), issues such as machine monopolization and excessive phone use become commonplace, detracting from the overall gym experience. In addition, a number of trainers regularly occupy machines for extended supersets with their clients, further limiting access to equipment. Some trainers also encourage suboptimal practices, including half-reps and ego lifting, which may foster poor training habits. The locker room, frequently cramped and overcrowded, exacerbates the inconvenience. Furthermore, most trainers at the gym don’t appear to have the ability to bench 225 lbs, squat 315 lbs, or deadlift 405 lbs, raising questions about their qualifications to guide others through serious strength training. For serious lifters or those seeking a more focused, efficient training environment, alternative facilities may be more appropriate.

As for June 2022 male bathroom is not working. 3 out of 3 urinals are leaking, 1 out of 3 toilets are not usable, bathroom dispensers, scale and trash canes are broken. Machines in general need better maintenance as well, the cables are broken often and bolts and screws are missing. Floor in the yoga studio is not stable, half of the bikes in cycling studio are not usable. I will still come here because of location but if you have a choice better look elsewhere

reviews.name: Jordy Pdk
reviews.text:
The experience I had at the massage shop was very disappointing and upsetting for me.

I called the shop to ask if there was an available slot for a facial massage. A male staff member checked the schedule for me and said there would be an available slot in 30 minutes. He also asked how long it would take me to get to the shop, and I told him it would take about 30 minutes. So I made the booking and went there as planned.

However, when I arrived at the shop, I had a very bad experience. I did not see the male staff member who spoke to me on the phone. Instead, I saw two female massage staff who were busy serving other customers. I told them that I had booked a facial massage, but they replied that if I wanted a facial massage, I would have to wait another 30 minutes, and the facial cream was already out of stock.

They then offered me a neck and shoulder massage instead. I had just traveled there because I had already made a booking for a facial massage. I was fully prepared and looking forward to having the facial massage, but when I arrived, it seemed that the male staff member had not coordinated with the female staff at all. I also could not find the male staff member who made my booking.

One of the female staff then said to me, “So what do you want to do?” With a displeased tone of voice. I was stunned for a moment because I did not know how to respond. I have rarely experienced something this unpleasant in my life.

I asked them again about the male staff member, but their answer shocked me even more. They said, “I don’t know. He is not here. If you want to know, you should call him yourself.”

I felt shocked and very upset. I felt lost and helpless in that situation. I felt sorry for myself for putting myself in a place like this. Thank you for making me feel so bad and hurting my feelings deeply. Thank you very much for this “wonderful” experience.

reviews.name: GREY MOUSE
reviews.text:
Don’t take male master — the worst massage ever. The same moves without any massage technology like he’s doing massage for first time in his life
Muscles in my neck and shoulders are clamped and I came to work on them but instead of pressing on the pain points and working on the clamps “master” just barely kneaded my neck and shoulders in those places where they did not hurt. I asked him five times to knead in those places where there was pain but he did not care. So after “massage” I left with the same pain as if I had not gone to massage
I regret that I wasted money and time and now I should  go to another salon

If u re going here — pick only women. At least they know how to do massage

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Dave, do visit again 😊

reviews.name: Dan Gough
reviews.text:
500THB for day pass. 50THB for towel. 10THB for water.

There is no water fountain which I feel is absolutely wild for the price of the day pass. I’ve never been to another day pass gym in Thailand that didn’t have a water fountain.

Gym is super clean, quiet and the equipment is in good condition. It doesn’t feel like the sort of gym you can smash out some deadlifts - I reckon you would get stares.

Staff are really friendly when I went twice, compared to what I read in reviews.

It is a 5 star gym but it loses a star for the water, as I think that is so fundamental.

reviews.name: Fern K.
reviews.text:
Overall, I find the gym to be nice, clean, and compact, yet surprisingly spacious given its size. The gym is well-equipped with all the necessary machines for weight training and cardio, and it's great to have amenities like a swimming pool, functional zone, and sauna. The music selection is okay and not overly loud, and I appreciate the reasonable pricing for the facilities. While I understand the decision to only sell water bottles, it would be convenient to have a water fountain available. I appreciate the effort put into maintaining the gym.

Downsides:

1. I noticed that the gym was locked at 6:30 am, despite the lights being on and it being time to open according to the stated schedule.
2. The gym closes on every public holiday, which I was okay at first, but now I find it inconvenient especially when I have schedules for my workouts and if the weather and air quality are bad I need a place to run indoors. I paid to use the gym but I can't use it when I need or want to defeats the purpose of signing up to begin with.

reviews.name: User Not Found
reviews.text: Feel free to check my profile and see that I have reviewed quite a few gyms all around the world. Wellfit is small but has everything you need for a good workout. This is more of a fitness/health and PT 1:1 gym than a commercial body building gym. There is a decent combination of free weights, plate loaded, machine weights, and cables for strength training. There is a Smith and squat rack. AC is good. Skyline view is fair. There is a pool, sauna and restrooms. Locker rooms and showers are very clean. Staff does excellent job of keeping machines and gym floor clean and new. All the times I’ve been it’s never been too busy and had no wait for equipment. If you have been working out for awhile, there should be no wait anyways because you know the alternative exercises for the same group of muscles. Plenty of treadmills. Pricing for monthly is unbeatable compared others at 1700 flat fee. No other pricing gimmicks. There is a cafe and some eateries on basement floor and next door for post workout meals.

reviews.name: Lucas Kasper
reviews.text:
I had a very bad experience at this gym and honestly can’t recommend it to anyone. First of all, the equipment is poor and extremely limited. The dumbbells only go up to 25 kg, and then there is just one single set of 30 kg dumbbells. That’s completely inadequate for a serious workout.

Second, you have to pay extra just to get a towel, which is ridiculous for a gym membership. Third, there isn’t even shower gel provided in the showers. Basic hygiene essentials should be standard, not something you have to bring yourself.

Overall, this gym is badly equipped, overpriced for what it offers, and not customer-friendly at all. I really do not recommend this fitness studio to anyone.

reviews.name: Wellington Chen
reviews.text:
I would give this gym less than 1 star if I could. As a person who travels a lot during the summer and likes to stay in shape while on vacation, I saw that this gym had good reviews and the day pass was also a good price so I decided to give it a visit. The day price was increased from 250 baht to 350 baht which was no big deal for me. I was not disappointed with what they had at the gym the machines and everything seemed to be pretty well kept. What made me write this horrible review was the trainers that worked there. They all gave me dirty stares while I exercised and when I was doing a set on the smith machine to failure one of the trainers gave me a long dirty look after I made a bit of noise doing a quick lock. The smith machine is a metal on metal machine so there is nothing to suppress the noise. Then while I was on the fly machine after my set the arm on the machine hit itself because it is loose and one of the trainers came over to ask if I was a member of the gym or if I even paid to use it. This was such a disgusting remark to me. Then he had told me to lighten the weight as I was making “too much noise” and bothering the people around me. No one around me had a problem with me and there were other people making more noise than I was. When I had told him I had no problem doing the weight he laughed at me. So please if you are not a Thai citizen do not come to this gym as they are very rude to foreigners and do not treat you with the same respect.

EDIT In response to owner: I appreciate you trying to defend your business, but let’s stop the act of making things up. There were rubber stoppers at the end of the weights and machines I used, making it virtually impossible to make loud noises. I slowed my movements and tried with utmost caution to be quiet on the smith machine. There were others throwing weights on the ground and being way louder than I was. Not to mention I got dirty looks from trainers and staff the MOMENT I walked in. Thanks.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: เกิดเหตุมาจาก ได้มีลูกค้ามาจากพนักงานว่าคุณได้วางทุกอย่างเสียงดังมากเป็นเวลานาน. โดยมีลูกค้ามาแจ้งประมาน 6-7 คน. และอยากให้พนักงานเข้าไปเตือน. เมื่อพนักงานเข้าไปเตือนกลับโดยคุณแสดงสีหน้าไม่พอใจ ชักสีหน้าใส่. อันนี้คือสาเหตุครับ. และถ้าคุณแค่ในพื้นที่ส่วนรวมบ้างคงไม่เกิดเหตุการณ์แบบนี้

reviews.name: jacek kopiniak
reviews.text: I used this fitness center for about 1.5 years. At first it was nice, the service tried. Now there are some new people who unfortunately spoil the atmosphere, it looks like they don't care about the service. And what has been very negative for a long time. Every 3 months they increase the price for the monthly fee without any information in advance. 3 months ago I found out that it is more expensive. Now again, wanting to pay for a month, they increase the price. I am giving up on such a company where you are not even sure how many times a year they will increase the price. And the person at the reception behaves as if she was proud that the company increases prices. Complete embarrassment. There are many different fitness centers in the area, it is better to choose another place where they do not make jokes about the price but respect the customer.And many times when is some national days they close gym, what make suprise because other gyms are open almost all the time, some 24 hours too. Here you cant be sure, some days when come they close or not.

reviews.name: Nazar Sopkiv
reviews.text:
I’ve been a member of this gym for 2 weeks, and unfortunately, the staff here is quite unfriendly. They don’t greet you when you come in or say goodbye when you leave. In fact, they barely even look at you, whether you’re arriving, leaving, or just moving around the gym. It feels like you’re invisible to them. Most of the time, they’re just sitting around, playing on their phones, and that’s probably why they don’t pay attention to the members.

Another downside is the music. It’s really not suited for a gym environment—often it’s just random songs that feel more appropriate for a party or some other event, but definitely not for a workout session.

On the positive side, the gym itself is well-equipped with brand-new machines, the pricing is very reasonable, and the changing rooms are excellent. Despite the drawbacks, I do recommend this gym because of the great facilities.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We're sorry to hear that your experience with the staff and the music hasn’t met your expectations. Your comments about the staff's behavior and the music selection are important, and we will make sure to pass this feedback along to our staff.

On a positive note, We are glad to hear that you’re satisfied with the gym’s equipment, pricing, and changing room. Your recommendation is appreciated, and we hope that your experience continues to improve. If you have any further concerns or suggestions, please don’t hesitate to reach out.

reviews.name: Wale
reviews.text: The gym is brand new, affordable, and well-equipped with all the necessary machines for weight training and cardio. However, the staff is unpleasant, rarely smiles, and doesn’t seem to care about giving advice to customers. Some personal trainers often use and occupy the machines for their own exercise while customers are waiting, which I've never seen in other fitness clubs. Additionally, they play music loudly in the afternoon, as if they own the fitness center 😅

reviews.name: Polina
reviews.text: Well equipped and affordable gym with nice 25m swimming pool. I love the stuff and lack of crowds here.

reviews.name: Andre Matarazzo

One thing that is good is they have one-day pass that you can pay only day you go.

reviews.text:

The annoying thing about this gym is the staff using all the equipment at a very leisurely pace.

It may be difficult for people with no exercise experience, but once it’s over, you’ll feel an incredible sense of accomplishment.
I highly recommend trying it at least

reviews.name: Xiao Mu
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at this boxing gym for the past two months and I absolutely love it. The facility is clean, well-ventilated, and equipped with high-quality heavy bags, speed bags, and plenty of open space for pad work and sparring. The trainers are knowledgeable, motivating, and genuinely care about your technique and progress — they correct your form without making you feel intimidated.
The atmosphere is energetic but welcoming, with a great mix of serious fighters and beginners. Morning and evening classes fit perfectly into my schedule, and the group sessions push me to work harder than I ever would alone. Whether you’re looking to get in shape, learn proper boxing technique, or relieve stress, this gym delivers. Highly recommended — best boxing gym I’ve trained at in a long time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Xiao Mu

We sincerely appreciate your wonderful review.

We are very pleased to know that you are satisfied and to receive your compliments regarding our facility and trainers. Maintaining a clean and well-organized environment is one of our top priorities to ensure that everyone can train comfortably.

It brings us the greatest joy to hear that our trainers have contributed to your skill improvement and progress. We strive to create an atmosphere where everyone can relax and learn, so knowing that you felt this way is truly encouraging for us.

We are also glad that the class times suit your schedule. We will continue to make dedicated efforts to provide training that is rewarding for everyone.

We remain fully committed to supporting you as you strive toward your goals, and all of our staff look forward to welcoming you again. Please continue to enjoy your experience with us.

We are very encouraged to hear that, even without air conditioning, you felt there was sufficient ventilation. We will continue to do our best to maintain an environment where you can train comfortably.

We sincerely look forward to your next visit. We appreciate your continued support.
