title: Let's Relax Spa Sukhumvit 39
subTitle: Let's Relax Spa - Sukhumvit 39
ownerDescription: Let’s Relax Spa Sukhumvit 39 (Phromphong) has been fully renovated after 12 years serving customers. The new look integrates the Colonial Style with the use of perforated design derived from Rama X and XI’s era and the use of light and pastel coloring to create a warm ambiance Day Spa. Full-Service Spa Menu of Let’s Relax is available here including Thai Massage, Aromatherapy Oil Massage, Foot Massage along with our signature Hot Stone Massage.
address: Sukhumvit 39, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Roxy Caballero
reviews.text: I needed an aloe body wrap after I spent a week in Arizona desert and summer sun. This part of my travel included some work and some relaxation. The provider I had was super sweet. They let you choose you aroma scents and give you your own slippers and room to shower after services are complete. I could've stayed for hours just for the reflexology part. Definitely worth a visit. You even get a free dessert when you finish. SO GOOD!

reviews.name: Louie
reviews.text: Came back to Let’s Relax Spa after a while and it was still amazing. The place is always clean, cool, and super comfortable. Staff are friendly and make you feel at ease right away. My shoulders were really tight, and the therapist did a great job loosening everything up. Definitely a spot I keep coming back to when I need to relax.

reviews.name: Bubble_BB S
reviews.text: The atmosphere at the spa was incredibly relaxing and peaceful. From the moment I walked in, I felt calm and welcomed. The soothing music, gentle lighting, and pleasant aroma created the perfect environment to unwind. It truly felt like a retreat from the outside world.

reviews.name: Sweet Pim
reviews.text: The pandan drink was really good, and the mango sticky rice was even better than what you get at many five star hotels in Thailand. Everything clean and smell good. The massage was a bit painful, but that was because my back was so tight. The therapist helped loosen it up, and afterward I felt so relaxed it was really amazing.

reviews.name: Ten Yi Ting
reviews.text: I had a great experience at the spa today, and I was assisted by a lovely therapist named Trongchit. She was incredibly kind, professional, and attentive throughout the session. Her hands were soft and comforting, and her gentle pressure made the massage deeply relaxing. Her natural warmth and presence added a cozy touch that made me feel truly cared for. It was one of the most soothing massages I’ve had. Highly recommend asking for her if you visit!

reviews.text:

reviews.name: Matthew Lee
reviews.text:
Conveniently located and easy to fit into the schedule if visiting Bangkok or just dropping in for a workout session. The krus were engaging, approachable and kept the energy of the class up throughout while still paying attention to technique corrections.

Comfortable training environment with clean facilities and a more polished feel compared to the usual no-frills Muay Thai camps. An atmosphere that is welcoming for all experience levels.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Matthew Lee
We appreciate your feedback. Thank you for taking the time to share your experience.

reviews.name: Douglas Hay
reviews.text:
This is an absolutely excellent gym, with friendly, knowledgable trainers, and great facilities. I was only able to attend two group classes and a private session with Kru Gap, but I feel that I learned a huge amount in just that short period of time with them.

The group classes are quite fitness orientated, so expect plenty of skipping and body weight exercises in the warmup. You’ll then have a few rounds of pads with the trainers, each one offering unique insights on your technique and how to push it to the next level. I was very impressed with how much attention to detail the trainers gave me even within the group setting, and I felt that I was improving technically even while being pushed physically. All the trainers are really friendly, so you’ll be tired but always having fun.

My private session with Kru Gap was possibly some of the most fun I’ve had doing Muay Thai since I started training a few years ago. I asked him to help me with certain techniques that I struggle with, which he did graciously and enthusiastically. He gave me so many tips and insights and he has such a wealth of knowledge in the sport, and I was really grateful to spend that time training with him. I’m inclined to say that the private sessions do not follow a “one size fits all” format, as I very much felt that the session was tailored towards what I wanted to work on. I have the utmost respect and gratitude for Kru Gap for spending this time with me, it was WELL worth the money.

As a final note, this gym is very clean and well maintained. The air conditioning makes a huge difference, and you can happily train without the staph paranoia that comes with other facilities.
My girlfriend unfortunately rolled her ankle during one of the sessions, and the trainers were very attentive and helpful, giving her a bucket of ice water and an ankle support to help her recover. Coincidentally, I was dealing with a hurt ankle at the time and the trainers did the same for me any time it flared up. They won’t try to force you to “push through” and ignore injuries, and they’ll do everything they can to help if you do end up getting hurt during training.

I’d give this gym 6 stars if I could, and I can’t wait to be back training here again the next time I’m in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Jun Tu.
reviews.text:
This is the most enjoyable Muay Thai gym I have experienced since I began my training last year.

First, let’s talk about the coaches. Most of them previously worked at another gym last year. Since I found them both interesting and responsible, I decided to follow them when they opened this new gym. There are five coaches in total, each with unique characters, specialties, and training focuses. They are generally strict with trainees who have basic skills and perform well, pushing them to new limits. Some coaches are less strict, allowing more recovery time during training, while others emphasize teaching combat skills. Some are more inclined to push trainees’ limits, resulting in more intense calorie-burning workouts. Additionally, some coaches have a funnier approach, “teasing” trainees to make the strenuous process more enjoyable.

Next, the conditions. Unlike many other gyms with just a shed, this gym is housed in a room with air conditioning. This makes it a comfortable place for those who are sensitive to the sizzling heat of Bangkok, especially during hot afternoons. However, the room is not as spacious as other gyms. They do have well-equipped shower rooms, which are especially convenient for female trainees, allowing everyone to freshen up after training.

In addition to weight loss exercises, the gym offers a sparring course that provides trainees with ample opportunities to practice combat skills, which is a more effective approach to enhance boxing performance in real-life scenarios.

Overall, this gym is an excellent place for weight loss through Muay Thai boxing. You will have a lot of fun with every coach during the training sessions, just like many others have.

title: Coral Grand Divers - Koh Tao PADI Career Development Center

All courses, from Open Water to IDC, are offered with 5-star standards on the beautiful beachfront premises of Coral Grand Resort. reviews.name: Ketan Gakushu
reviews.text:
When I decided to finally experience scuba diving I spent some time searching for the right location and Dive Centre. After a lot of research and conversations I decided on Koh Tao and was initially spoilt for choice because Koh Tao is a popular dive destination for people from all over the world, plus it’s a lot cheaper to learn diving here compared to other islands like Koh Phagnan or Koh Samui.

While looking for places here I chanced upon Coral Grand Divers and dropped them a message. I was instantly contacted by Cris who was super nice and patiently answered all my questions, explained the process and made me feel more comfortable about the whole experience! So before I knew it, I had signed up for the Open Water Diver Course and was now anxious and excited about leaving for Koh Tao,Thailand. Over the course of the next two months before I had to leave India, Cris was constantly in touch with me over email or chat and was always there when I had any questions or needed any more information. I was now sure I’ve signed up with a good Dive Centre.

Upon reaching Coral Grand Divers, I met with Lin who had also been involved in my bookings and course planning, etc. She was also super helpful and did her best to make my experience in Koh Tao comfortable and positive.

The first day of the course which was the pool training, I was assigned an instructor and  had another student like me in the batch who would be my dive buddy. Tan was simply superb and did his best to train me, but being my first time with scuba gear I was a bit slow, scared and had some issues with the techniques. After the first few hours, I decided to give up and drop out of the course entirely.

Now here’s where things started to turn around. Tan and Lin were more than happy to let me go with the boat on the first day of the dive and just observe. Tan also offered to take me for some swimming and let me snorkel to get more acquainted with the ocean. Of course I accepted and had a blast! My confidence was restored and I decided to give it another shot.

Because Tan had to continue with my dive buddy who had already moved way ahead in the course, I was offered another instructor by the name of Joy Abedin who came highly recommended by another group of Indians I met the day before and who had trained with him. This was very kind of Coral Grand Divers who could have easily allowed me to drop out and go home, but instead they pushed me to learn and overcome my fears.

Joy was simply amazing! Other than the fact that he was Indian and spoke my language, which was really helpful, he is an extremely experienced Dive Instructor and had me going underwater with my scuba gear in less than 2 hours! We completed a full day of pool training and I learnt all the skills necessary thanks to his patience and ability to make even the most difficult skills look and feel easy. Thanks to him (and of course the rest of the team at Coral Grand Divers) I completed the whole course, had a lot of fun under the ocean  & am now a PADI certified Open Water Diver!

The whole team at CGD is filled with amazing people from across the globe who are passionate about diving and are great fun to hang out with. They all made me feel right at home and I am leaving Koh Tao with some beautiful memories
and some new friends as well.!

For anyone who wants to dive and is not sure about what to do, or even if you are experienced but want to learn more, have a life changing experience while having loads of fun, I highly recommend Coral Grand Divers - Koh Tao!

Our greatest reward is seeing how you overcame your initial fears and uncertainties to become a certified PADI Open Water Diver (no small feat!) and pushed yourself out of your comfort zone with determination. We’re thrilled to have been part of your journey into the underwater world. Watching you conquer your fears, master the skills, and earn your certification in style was truly inspiring! Joy is one of those rare instructors who combines deep technical knowledge with a fun, approachable teaching style. From the very beginning, he went above and beyond to make sure I felt confident and prepared. During our deep dives, he brought toys and props for scientific pressure experiments, turning each dive into both an adventure and a learning experience.

Becareful when you play tic tac toe with him underwater! He always wins because he has first movers advantage.

For the wreck specialty, Joy carefully walked me through rope tying techniques, taking the time to ensure I truly understood the procedures. He’s incredibly detail- oriented but also cheerful, bubbly, and always full of positive energy. Every session with him was filled with laughter and learning.

What stood out most was his genuine passion for teaching. Joy constantly checked in on my progress, patiently taught me new finning techniques, and always found little ways to help me improve. You can tell he really cares about his students and loves what he does.

If you're looking for an instructor who’s knowledgeable, fun, and truly dedicated to your growth as a diver, Joy is the one. I can’t recommend him and Coral Grand Divers enough. Thanks for an unforgettable experience!

Oh, and another thing that i loved was the handmade aquatic themed comic book they have on the boat.

reviews.text:
Amazing experience, Yohan went at an easy speed to teach us the skills on the Padi Open Water course. It was a privilege to learn with him and discover a new addiction at Coral Grand Divers.

The staff are very knowledgable and nothing is a problem to them. The dive boat crew; also very good. Everything was exactly as it was advertised. Already booked for more tomorrow with CGD!

Update: had some amazing dives with CGD since qualifying. Shark Island with the Trigger Fish claiming the mooring line and White Rock, on the way to which a pod of Dolphins came to say hi. Loki led these dives and made them really fun. Chumphon Pinnacle with its jet streams of fish and Green Rock with the tunnels to explore; both led by Frank who is super calm and very helpful.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hey Daniel! Thanks for your kind words and shout-out to Yohan :) Great job on your Open Water Diver certification! The ocean is yours to explore now:) Enjoy every bubble ahead!

reviews.name: John L
reviews.text:
Brutally honest review PADI OW + AOW: 11/10.

Instructor Liam (IG:xukun_liu), absolutely top tier. Chinese expert cave diver and an excellent teacher, objective. If you are looking for someone who is super thorough and will make you feel absolutely dialled in for open water, look no further. We had a small group of 4 OW students and a dive master trainee (on the right). Many other dive company boats were rammed packed, we had max 9 divers total at any given time on board. They don't really run theory classes, did all elearning the night before (would recommend starting weeks before that lol). You will learn everything in the pool anyways, Liam is just that dialled in.

Price was standard 11000 + 10000B, can do combo package as well for less (which I went with).

Boat crew on the boat were super helpful with getting suited up and checking through some of the gear with you. Even had fresh fruit cut up between dives. First class service.

Dive location at CGD pool, Twins, white rock, Chumphon Pinnacle (one of the best diving spots on this island, Liam's fav).

Located down the end of sairee beach, pretty much only accessed by walking down the beach - otherwise google maps 'coral grand divers resort' and walk to the back of it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hey John!

Thanks for the epic review and for giving us a straight-up 11/10! We’re thrilled Liam shared his passion for diving with you and that you felt confident and well-prepped throughout your OW journey! Glad you appreciated the small group vibes, pool sessions, smooth boat ops, and those juicy fruit breaks! Also love that you got to explore some of Koh Tao’s finest sites, especially Chumphon Pinnacle, a firm favourite for a reason!!Thanks again for trusting us with your diving adventure and for spreading the good word! Enjoy the rest of your AOW course, no doubt you’ll have an absolute blast!

reviews.name: Mikimiki Wish
reviews.text:
As someone who is genuinely passionate about Japanese cuisine and seriously considering enrolling in a culinary program, I was excited to learn about the opening of a new Japanese cooking college in Bangkok. I came across their online announcement for an “Opening Reception,” which made it sound like a welcoming event for prospective students, the public, or anyone interested in the school.

Wanting to make an informed decision, I reached out via LINE to ask if it was okay to stop by and explore the campus. The college replied kindly, encouraging me to “feel free to come and walk around to check out the place.” With that message, I felt reassured that my visit was welcome.

However, when I showed up, I was met with confusion and disappointment. Instead of a warm reception or an open house-style event, it turned out to be a full-on press conference with media and cameras everywhere. As a potential student, I felt completely out of place and ignored. There was no one designated to assist visitors like me, no guidance, no clear signage, and surprisingly—at a food school—not a single sample of food offered.

The administrative staff briefly acknowledged me and said they would send me a PDF with details about the course via LINE. But why send that after I had already come all the way to visit in person—especially after we had already confirmed the visit through LINE in the first place?

With tuition fees of 270,000 THB for just three months, I expected at the very least a proper greeting or some effort to engage with someone who is potentially investing that much money. The school’s focus that day seemed to be entirely on impressing the media, not the actual customers or future students. It left me with a bad taste—figuratively and literally, since there was no food.

What’s worse is the misleading nature of their online announcement. If the event was meant to be press-only, that should have been stated clearly. Instead, I wasted time, energy, and transportation costs traveling across town for what turned out to be an exclusive media event that made no room for serious prospective students.

This experience made me feel unwelcome and undervalued. First impressions matter, especially when it comes to education and hospitality. Unfortunately, I will not be going back, and I wouldn’t recommend this place to others based on how poorly they handled their opening day for anyone outside the media spotlight.

— A disappointed (and now uninterested) potential student.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We have acknowledged your intention to visit our school, and we sincerely apologize for the miscommunication that caused you inconvenience this time. Please accept our heartfelt apologies once again. If possible, we would greatly appreciate another opportunity to welcome you and have you visit our school in the future.

Should there be a date and time that is convenient for you, we would be truly grateful if we may contact you to arrange a meeting and discuss further details. Once again, we offer our deepest apologies and thank you for your kind understanding. 😔🙏🙇‍♀️🙇‍♂️

reviews.textTranslated:
Today, I had the opportunity to be a taste tester for a sushi school, and I was impressed from the moment I stepped in. The school is clean, organized, and pays great attention to detail.

The teaching is one-on-one, with the sensei (teacher) providing close supervision. They patiently explain each step in detail, making it easy to understand. Even highly precise techniques are explained with patience.

The ingredients are high-quality, fresh, clean, and hygiene is a top priority. This made me feel confident both in the learning process and the food tasting.

Overall, it's a sushi school where you can truly feel the dedication, meticulousness, and professionalism. I highly recommend it for anyone interested in learning sushi. They currently offer short courses that can be completed in just one month, which is great. If you want to try, I highly recommend this school. They truly pay attention to every detail.

The old techniques emphasize—steady pressure, precise rhythm, and genuine effort.

turn the stress of an entire month into just one sigh.
That kind of power that pushes from your feet straight to the depths of your soul—
it's not just service, it's redemption.
What makes Thai massage so amazing is that
it doesn't just help you relax, it actually resets you completely.
You think you're just here for a massage,

reviews.name: Annie Wacky
reviews.text:
I’ve known the head coach since his time teaching at another well-known gym in Chiang Mai, so I was really glad when he finally opened his own gym. He has many years of experience teaching Muay Thai, both in Chiang Mai and abroad, and he communicates well in both English and Chinese. His teaching style is very clear, comfortable, and easy to understand, which makes training here enjoyable and effective.

I usually join the group classes, which cost 350 THB per session. The coach adjusts his teaching based on each student’s level, whether beginner or advanced. He is very patient, always encouraging, and makes sure training is safe by correcting your technique when needed.

The community atmosphere here is very friendly and welcoming. If you just want to learn Muay Thai for fun and fitness, this is a great place. But if you’re interested in preparing for competition, they can also support you in that journey.

The gym is located in a quiet neighborhood with a very relaxed vibe. There are shower facilities available, and right next to the gym there’s even a longan tree where everyone can pick fresh fruit. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for authentic Muay Thai training in a peaceful setting.

reviews.text:
I’m training here and I chose this gym as it didn’t seem as busy as others. I had a couple of private lessons to get me started and really enjoyed it and moved onto the group sessions which they have at 8am and 4.30pm. I love this place, the guys all working there are great, friendly and funny. They have a few of the main trainers and then when sparring or pairing they have their regular guys to practice on. I’m not sure if they work there or they train there but then help out.. so your always the one who is practising your moves and some of these guys are really good so it great having them to practise on. They have a ring, about 7/8 boxing bags, tyres, gloves, wraps, shin guards for all to use so you don’t need to bring any equipment ie gloves etc. there is lots of parking spaces too for cars or bikes and a 7-11 a minute away in case your forgot to buy drinks. Classes are 350 but cheaper if you buy a bundle and 1 on 1 class is 600 so really good value and the classes say they last for 2 hours but add on the cool down & stretching it can go on for 2.5 hours.
The classes are a mix of regulars (Thai) and foreigners, male & female and different ages but they cater to all levels as like I said there are a few of em to practise on

reviews.text: I enjoyed coming to this gym. They have nice gear and good teachers. I got a good discount and got 20+10 for 9000bht. It will be better when they finish the shower, but the toilets are just behind the corner. The coaches can be strict but dont force you when u can't catch your breath. Highly recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your 5-star review. We are delighted to know that you had a satisfying experience with us.

reviews.name: patty cookie
reviews.text: Love this gym! All the trainers are super nice and friendly. every session is fun and never boring.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your 5-star review. We are delighted to know that you had a satisfying experience with us.

reviews.text: Good service

reviews.name: Star Star
reviews.text:
Unprofessional
Not recommened !

reviews.name: Iam Nadia
reviews.text: บรรยากาศดี รู้สึกผ่อนคลาย / สครับผิวดีมากกก / ชอบ Spa AHA ค่ะ รู้สึกผิวสดชื่นน ซื้อแบบคอร์สจะถูกกว่าแบบรายครั้งค่ะ ห้องสปา อาบน้ำ สะอาด สะดวกมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The atmosphere is great and relaxing. The body scrub is amazing! I love the AHA spa treatment; my skin feels so refreshed. Buying a course is cheaper than buying individual sessions. The spa rooms and showers are clean and convenient.

reviews.name: Napapa K
reviews.text: แย่มาก ตั้งแต่หน้าเค้าเตอร์จนถึงคนนวด 1990 นวดเหมือนร้านนวดทั่วไปไม่ได้รู้สึกว่าเป็นการขัดขี้ไคลเลย พนง.นวดขัดไปก็เชียร์ขายไปปฏิเสธแล้วก็ยังไม่หยุด ขัดจริงแปบเดียวไม่ถึงชั่วโมง ที่เหลือให้อาบน้ำ+อบในตู้  ที่แย่สุดคือพนง.เค้าเตอเชียร์ขายจนน่าเกลียดปฏิเสธสามสี่รอบก็ยังหยุด จนมีพนง.อีกคนเดินเข้ามาน่าจะเป็นหัวหน้านึกว่าสถานการณ์จะดีขึ้น สรุปเชียร์ขายคอสที่ราคาแพงกว่าเดิมอีก ลำคารมาก บอกไม่มีตังยังให้เราไปยืมบัตรแฟนมารูด น่าเกลียดเกิน ลาขาดไม่ไปอีกแล้ว จะไม่แนะนำใครไปด้วย
reviews.textTranslated: Terrible experience from the front counter to the masseuse. The massage was like any other typical massage parlor; it didn't feel like a real scrub at all. The masseuse kept trying to sell me more things while scrubbing, even after I refused. The actual scrubbing only lasted a short time, less than an hour. The rest of the time was spent showering and using the sauna. The worst part was the counter staff's blatant sales pitch; I refused three or four times, but they wouldn't stop. Then another staff member, probably a supervisor, came over, and I thought the situation would improve. In the end, they just tried to sell me an even more expensive package. It was so annoying. When I said I didn't have any money, they even asked me to borrow my boyfriend's credit card. Absolutely outrageous. Never going back again, and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.

reviews.name: lm so
reviews.text: ร้านสะอาด บริการดี พนักงานชื่อพี่ปู น้ำหนักมือดีมาก ดูแลเอาใจตลอดเวลา นวดสบายจนหลับเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The shop is clean, the service is good. The staff member named Pu had excellent pressure and was very attentive throughout the massage. It was so relaxing I fell asleep.

reviews.name: Worldwild Travel
reviews.text: พี่ๆพนักงานบริการเป็นกันเอง พูดจาน่ารัก มืออาชีพเรื่องสปาต้องยกให้ที่นี่เลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The staff are friendly and lovely, and they are very professional. This place is definitely the best for spa treatments.

reviews.name: Patsorn Smithnan
reviews.text: พนักงานนวดบริการดีอยู่ แต่พนักงานหน้าเคาน์เตอร์เชียร์ขายคอร์สจนอึดอัด ปฏิเสธก็ยังไม่หยุด คอร์สที่ซื้อไป ยังใช้ไม่หมด เชียร์ขายให้ซื้อเพิ่มอีก จะใช้ที่เหลือให้หมด และไม่ทำต่อแล้ว เพื่อนถามว่าทำดีมั้ย  บอกว่าทำดี แต่ไม่แนะนำให้ไปทำ เพราะเชียร์ขายจนน่าเกลียด
reviews.textTranslated: The massage therapist provided good service, but the counter staff were overly pushy about selling massage courses, which was very uncomfortable. They wouldn't stop even after I refused. I hadn't even used up my previous course, and they were trying to sell me more. I told them I wanted to use up the remaining sessions but wouldn't continue the service. My friend asked if it was good, and I said yes, but I wouldn't recommend it because the sales pitch was so rude.

reviews.name: Zheza Kaa
reviews.text: เพิ่งไปทำมาค่ะ พนักงานดูแลดี ขัดผิวดี ว่าด้วยเรื่องขายครอส ส่วนตัวไม่ได้ซีเรียสถ้าทำดีแล้วซื้อครอสถูกกว่าการทำเป็นรายครั้งอีก เซลล์ก็ใจดีแถมให้ตั้งหลายรายการ แต่ถ้าใครไม่สะดวกซื้อครอสก็ทำเปนรายครั้งก็ได้นะคะ ส่วนตัวเราตอนแรกว่าไม่มีเวลาแต่พอลองทำได้รู้สึกชอบก็ซื้อครอสไปเลย 🤣 ถูกกกว่ารายครั้งแถมมีครอสแถมให้ด้วย
reviews.textTranslated: I just went there recently. The staff were attentive and the exfoliation was great. Regarding the package deals, personally, I'm not bothered if the service is good; buying a package is cheaper than doing individual sessions. The salesperson was also very kind and gave me several freebies. However, if you're not comfortable buying a package, you can still do individual sessions. Personally, I initially thought I didn't have time, but after trying it and liking it, I bought a package! 🤣 It was cheaper than individual sessions and included freebies.

reviews.name: ปอปลาLadiiplar
reviews.text:
‎ช่วงนี้ปอปลาอยากผ่อนคลายผิว และ ให้หุ่นดูกระชับขึ้น เลยเลือกโปรแกรม Aura Spa Treatment สูตรเฉพาะโบนิต้า+ โปรแกรม Slim ช่วยชับสัดส่วน เอว S 🥰ปอปลามาใช้บริการ Bonita spa สาขา สามย่าน เดินทางสะดวก ทางร้านมีที่จอดรถให้ค่ะ
‎
‎
reviews.textTranslated: Lately, I've been wanting to relax my skin and get a more toned figure, so I chose the Aura Spa Treatment, a Bonita exclusive formula, plus the Slim program to help sculpt my body and get an S-shaped waist. 🥰 I visited Bonita Spa at the Samyan branch; it's conveniently located and has parking available.

reviews.name: ปภัสรินทร์ ทวีสินไกรภัทร์
reviews.text: พนักงานหน้าเคาน์้เตอร์ ไม่ค่อยยิ้มแย้ม ไม่บริการด้วยใจไม่เข้าใจลูกค้า 2590 บาทใช้เวลาขัดไม่ถึง 2 ชั่วโมง โดยรวมคิดว่าปานกลางเพราะว่าไม่ค่อยได้ขัดขี้ใครในร้านสปาแบบนี้ แต่คิดว่าครั้งเดียวพอค่ะ ดูในเน็ตมาโปร 1990 พอไปหน้างานบอกว่าจะไม่ได้ขั้นตอนนี้ ถ้าไม่อยากขาดขั้นตอนใดขั้นตอนหนึ่งไป ให้ซื้อเป็นโปร 2590 แล้วมันโปรโมชั่นตรงไหนหรอคะ
reviews.textTranslated: The counter staff weren't very cheerful, didn't provide heartfelt service, and didn't understand customers. The 2590 baht package took less than 2 hours for the scrub. Overall, I'd say it's average because I don't often get scrubs done at spas like this, but I think one time is enough. I saw a promotion online for 1990 baht, but when I got there, they said this step wouldn't be included. If I didn't want to miss any steps, I should buy the 2590 baht package. Where's the promotion in that?

reviews.name: Marisa Pimpaka
reviews.text: แย่โครตแย่ 2 ชั่วโมงกับเรท2 พันบาท ขัดก็ไม่ใช่ว่าจะดี วิธีการก็เหมือนการขัดสปา ทั่วไป ที่เคยทำ แต่ บริการหลังทำของพนักงาน เชียร์ขายจนลูกค้า อึดอัด !!  ถ้าเขาปฏิเสธครั้งแรกคืออาจจะขอคิดก่อน อาจตะกลับมา แต่นี้คือขายลืมหูลืมตา แบบนี้ไม่เอาค่ะ  แต่ยัง ยัดเหยียดโน่นนี้ แบบนี้เขาเรียกว่า(  ไล่ลูกค้าค่ะ ) ตอนแรกจะเป็นลูกค้าประจำและบอกเพื่อนต่อ แต่เจอแบบนี้เข้าไป ใครจะมาคิดๆนะ อยากเป็นมือโปรในการขาย บอกสิ่งที่ดีค่ะ ไม่ใช่ยัดเหยียดลูกค้าค่ะ  ขอบายค่ะ 🙄
reviews.textTranslated: Terrible experience. Two hours for 2,000 baht. The scrubbing wasn't even that good; the method was just like any other spa scrub I've had before. But the after-service service from the staff was awful – they were so pushy with sales that it made me uncomfortable! If they had refused the first time, I might have thought about it and maybe come back, but they were relentlessly trying to sell me things. This is called (chasing customers away!). I was going to be a regular customer and recommend them to friends, but after this experience, who would want to be one again? If you want to be a professional salesperson, tell customers what's good, don't push your products on them. Goodbye! 🙄

reviews.name: lana ps
reviews.text: พี่ยิ้มนวดดีมากกกกก สปาผิวครั้งใสขึ้นเลย 🥹💖
reviews.textTranslated: The massage by P'Yim was amazing! My skin looks so much brighter after this spa treatment! 🥹💖

reviews.name: Nawaporn N.
reviews.text: พี่มุกบริการดีมากค่ะ ชวนคุยแบบเป็นกันเองดีมากๆเลยค่ะ หลังทำสปารู้สึกผิวนุ่มลื่นดีค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: Mook provided excellent service. She was very friendly and chatty. After the spa treatment, my skin felt soft and smooth.

reviews.name: Kunlasatree Sand
reviews.text: มาทำสปาครั้งแรกที่นี้ดีมากๆเลยค่ะ ผ่อนคลาย สบายแล้วก็โล่งผิวมากๆ ดูแลดีมากๆค่ะ สถานที่ก็สะอาด
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time at this spa and it was amazing! So relaxing, comfortable, and my skin felt so much better. The care was excellent and the place was very clean.

reviews.name: jomkwan chosantuie
reviews.text: ร้านนวดสวยและสะอาดมากค่ะ บีทีทำสปาระเบิดขี้ไคร์เริด มากเลยค่ะเเนะนำสาขาสามย่านเลยค่ะเยี่ยมมาก
reviews.textTranslated: The massage shop is very beautiful and clean. BT's exfoliating spa treatment is amazing! I highly recommend the Samyan branch; it's excellent.

reviews.name: Bm Nnp
reviews.text: สปาผิวดีค่า ทำกับพี่ทิพค่ะพี่ทิพดูแลดีมากเลยค่ะแนะนำค่ะทำเสร็จผิวเนียนลื่นเลยย🤍🥹
reviews.textTranslated: Great skin spa! I had it done by Tip. Tip took great care of me. I highly recommend it. My skin was so smooth and soft after the treatment! 🤍🥹

reviews.name: Pantila Chopanya
reviews.text: ร้านอบอุ่นมากค่ะ สปาขี้ไคลดีสมชื่อ ขัดครั้งแรกผิวใสจริง
reviews.textTranslated: The shop is very cozy. The exfoliating spa lives up to its name; my skin is noticeably brighter after the first scrub.

reviews.name: เยาวลักษณ์ ถนอมแสนดี
reviews.text: ดีค่ะ ต้องมาลอง มีที่จอดรถ พี่ๆแนะนำดี พนักงานน่ารัก ไม่กดดัน
reviews.textTranslated: Great! Definitely worth a try. There's parking available. The staff were helpful and friendly, not pushy at all.

reviews.name: nayah 2850
reviews.text: พึ่งไปใช้บริการมาเมื่อวาน  ดีมากเลยค่ะ รู้สึกว่าขี้ไคลออกเยอะ   ผิวสว่างขึ้น
reviews.textTranslated: I just used their service yesterday and it was great! I feel like a lot of dead skin came off and my skin looks brighter.

reviews.name: พรทิพย์ มาลามิ่ง
reviews.text: มาทำสปาระเบิดขี้ไคลที่สามย่านพนักงานบริการดีมากเลยค่ะพี่ๆบริการเป็นกันเองมากเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I came for a body scrub spa treatment at Samyan. The staff were excellent and very friendly.

title: Flash Fitness Bangkok Personal Training & Group Classes Gym Studio
subTitle: Flash Fitness Gym Bangkok
ownerDescription:

-Jeff & Ritah
address: 78 N Sathon Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: Chantal Gagnon
reviews.text:
I signed up for a one-month membership with Flash Fitness from Canada, and I started seeing results after just a few sessions. During my stay in Thailand, I also had the chance to visit the gym in person and meet Jeff and Ritah—both are incredibly attentive, motivating, and supportive coaches.

I am currently continuing my training online because the benefits have been so significant for me. As we age, muscle loss can lead to a general loss of tone and firmness, but thanks to their workouts, I feel stronger, more toned, and I have much more energy.

They also provided valuable nutrition guidance that made a real difference in my results and overall well-being. The training is very flexible and efficient, and it doesn’t require a lot of time, which makes it easy to stay consistent.

I am very grateful for their support and very happy to have met them. Thank you both so much!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the kind words Chantal. We absolutely love training with you…with the online program and while here in Bangkok. It’s such a pleasure to have you here and be part of the Flash community and can’t wait for your next BKK visit. You’ve done incredible…you’ve gotten so fit and we are very proud of you! Keep up the great work and thank you! 🙏

reviews.name: Angel
reviews.text:
So, I am not a gym person, but this place definitely converted me! I am amazed at how I now feel healthier and stronger after only being with Flash Fitness over a few months! This for me, is the best space in town when you want not only a fit and joyful exercise regime, but aiming also for longevity! I would recommend you to try it, and then see if it works for you- which I think it would! Many people keep coming back to this gym. Why?  Because the coach/trainers know what they're doing! They have been in this industry of fitness and health for so many years!

In this gym, I met so many wonderful, genuine, and humble people. I also met people who have been with this gym for over 10 years!  This is a testament to how good the trainers are and how amazing the community is.  I hope you will give this gym a try. It could change your life and help you find access to an amazing joy that comes when one feels healthy and alive! :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Ayngil…We LOVE this review! Thank you so much for taking the time to write us a review. We love having you at Flash! I remember you telling us “I don’t like gym!” Hahaha. Look at you now! You are addicted and LOVE it! You have done amazing..so fit! So strong! So consistent! So…applause to YOU! I leave YOU 5-stars right back…for your effort..and for always bringing so many smiles to Flash! You make our little gym better by being a part of it! We are blessed to have you here! Thank you

reviews.name: Adisorn Hatairatana
reviews.text: Others have said plenty about the workout and results.  But Ritah & Jeff are much more than just fitness trainers.  They have created atmosphere that nurtures incredible community full of amazing people.  They are great human beings.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Add! This means so much to us. It isn’t;’t just Ritah and I…the wonderful community and atmosphere is honestly because it’s full of people just like you. Truly, Ritah and I are the ones who are blessed to have YOU GUYS here. Thank you!! See you soon!

reviews.name: Kate Yotponrasit
reviews.text:
Unfortunately I can't attend Flash anymore as I have moved too far away 😭 But I miss Jeff, Rita, the community and their amazing workouts every time I exercise by myself! I am a person who is a little apprehensive about working out and joining large group fitness classes, especially those where it seems everyone is an 'influencer'! Flash Fitness is a wonderful community full of kind, supportive, down-to-earth people - this attitude is led by the coaches Jeff and Rita, who model meeting everyone where they are in terms of fitness and pushing you (gently, if necessary) to your personal next level.
The workouts seem simple but really work, and the personalised nutrition/supplements advice is also invaluable. Highly recommend Flash Fitness... I just wish it was around the corner again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Kate! Thank you so much for sharing this review. We miss you in this side of town!! You were always such a pleasure to have in our class. Thank you for all of the positive energy. You brought every day whenever you’re back in our area please come by and see us. We have a whole community who’d love to see you.

reviews.name: Tasara Taksinapan
reviews.text:
Joining Flash Fitness Bangkok was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made for my health. I’ve spent years trying different workout programs but never saw the kind of results I wanted, until now.

In just 6 weeks, I saw a complete transformation. The training is smart, efficient, and designed to push you past your limits without wasting time. Jeff is a wonderful trainer, his fitness knowledge is unbeatable, and he knows exactly how to guide, motivate, and adjust workouts to get the best out of you.

What surprised me most wasn’t just the physical changes, but also the confidence and discipline I’ve gained. I look forward to every session because I know I’m going to walk out feeling stronger, leaner, and more energized.

If you’re serious about making a change, Flash Fitness Bangkok is the place that will get you there.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Ket! Thank you sooo much for…well, everything! Not just for this review. You have been an integral part of the Flash community and have had a greater impact than you could ever possibly imagine. You’ve been a walking, talking billboard for Flash…not just because you got such amazing results…but because you are such a motivating, positive person that is constantly impacting lives. You make Flash a better place…just by having been a part of it. Thank YOU for all the years of being wonderful! 🙏

reviews.name: Rick Bennett
reviews.text: Flash Fitness is a fantastic personal training gym that really stands out. The trainers, Ritha and Jeff are knowledgeable and supportive, creating a welcoming atmosphere for everyone, whether you're a beginner or a seasoned athlete. The variety of workout programs keeps things fresh and exciting, ensuring that you stay motivated and engaged, making it easier to achieve your fitness goals. Overall, if you're looking for a place to get fit and have fun, Flash Fitness is definitely worth checking out.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Rick! We really appreciate you taking the time to write a review for us! Looking forward to seeing you soon! Promise to add some extra sled for ya! I know you love it! :)

reviews.name: Dream Schnauer
reviews.text: Jeff and Rita have created such a welcoming and inspiring fitness club! The space is clean, well-equipped, and has a friendly atmosphere that makes every workout enjoyable. Jeff and Rita always offers encouragement, guidance, and support no matter your fitness level. It feels more like a community than just a gym. I’m so grateful to have found this hidden gem and couldn’t recommend it more highly!

reviews.name: Aldo Coley
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Flash Fitness Bangkok – A Life-Changing Community Since 2014

I’ve been a proud member of Flash Fitness Bangkok since 2014, and I can honestly say it has transformed my life in every way—physically, mentally, and professionally.

This isn’t just a gym. It’s a powerful fitness community built on support, motivation, and excellence. The instructors are phenomenal—knowledgeable, passionate, and genuinely invested in your progress. Their guidance has helped me stay fit for competitive sports, maintain peak performance, and feel confident in both body and mind.

But what truly sets Flash Fitness apart is the community. The members here are inspiring, driven, and incredibly supportive. Whether you're pushing through a tough workout or celebrating a personal milestone, you're never alone. That energy has kept me going for over a decade and has played a huge role in my professional success—helping me lead with strength, clarity, and confidence.

Flash Fitness Bangkok is more than a gym—it’s a lifestyle, a family, and a place where transformation happens every day.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Aldo…thank you soooo much! For the review, yes…but moreso, for being such a positive, wonderful and supportive part of the Flash community for over 10 years. Ritah and I are lucky to know you and appreciate you letting us be a part of your fitness journey for all of these years! Scale of 1-10 on the awesome scale…you are a 12!

reviews.name: Plern Piam
reviews.text: I have been working out at Flash Fitness for more than two years. It changed my both body and mental health get better. Jeff and Ritah (trainer and gym's owner) are very nice. They train and help me a lot to have a correct posture. Flash Fitness is not only gym but it is also good community. Thanks a lot to make me have a better shape.

reviews.name: Shams S
reviews.text: I hate gym workouts. I have no motivation for it. So who can help me get the body and fitness I want? Flash Fitness! Fast and focused with results. You only have to turn up. Members have been there for over 10+ years and I can see why. Finally a place that understands me. Dad jokes by Jeff are an added bonus.

reviews.name: T A
reviews.text:
I’ve never been a gym person in my life - even when I did go, I never had the confidence that I could achieve significant results. Last year my health declined and it became apparent that I needed to invest time to improve my health. That’s when I took up the 8 week challenge at Flash. There were times when I struggled but Jeff was able to suggest alternative exercises so I could continue my workouts. Jeff and Ritah put a lot of effort to make the workouts fun and challenging and after just 8 weeks I had leg muscles which looked and felt incredible. I could now move and be a lot more explosive when playing sports. The community who are here may be small but there is a lot of camaraderie and encouragement to do the same workouts and be part of the collective.
Come here to Flash Fitness if you want results and achieve your fitness goals!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Trev!! “Never been a gym person in my life.” Now…GYM RAT STATUS ACHIEVED! Hehe. 
You have done amazing! We are so proud of how much you’ve accomplished! You’ve really got yourself strong and super fit. So…big applause to you and thank you for being such a wonderful part of the community. You make Flash better just by being here.

reviews.name: Sine Taugwalder
reviews.text: I’ve been with Flash Fitness on and off for the past 10 years, and every time I come back, I’m reminded why it’s the best place to train. Don’t expect fancy luxury, but expect what truly matters — results. Here, you’ll get fitter, stronger, and healthier with the guidance of trainers who genuinely care. The atmosphere is like a close-knit community where everyone motivates each other, making training both effective and enjoyable. 💪🏋️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for this review Sine! Ritah and I are the lucky ones to have you and Adam as such a wonderful part of the community for 10 years! We can’t thank you guys enough for always bringing so much fun, energy and positivity to Flash. The “close knit community where everyone motivates each other” you mention…is exactly because of people like you! Thank you for 10 years of being a Flash-a-Maniac! We appreciate you more than we can say! 🙏

reviews.name: C J
reviews.text:
Flash Fitness is best community in Bangkok that I’ve been extremely fortunate to be a part of. Jeff and Ritah’s care and support in my overall health, wellbeing and fitness have made such impacts on my life that a Google review simply cannot explain. If you want a gym experience where you feel a strong sense of belonging and encouragement, look no further.
Their training has helped me gain 12kg in muscle in my first 8 weeks and changed the way I think about fitness. Now onto my third year! Thank you both for everything you do!! 💪

reviews.name: Cholsin Vadanathorn
reviews.text: Flash Fitness is such a good and unique fitness. I’ve been knowing the lovely owners, Jeff and Ritah for nearly 10 years. Lots of my friends and family members had use their services and they are totally agree that Flash Fitness is the best and cozy love place. Worthwhile to join the fitness.

reviews.name: Tatjana D
reviews.text: If you are looking for the best fitness studio in Bangkok with a fantastic community, you should immediately schedule your first session at Flash Fitness. Jeff and Rita are highly knowledgeable and supportive, and the training atmosphere is super motivating. I can highly recommend Flash!

reviews.name: Riya Dudhatra
reviews.text:
I’ve been training with Jeff and Ritah for 2months and the progress I’ve made has been incredible. Not only have I seen significant improvements in my physical health, weight and strength, but my overall well-being has also improved dramatically.

Every session is well-structured, pushing me just the right amount while always focusing on proper form and safety.
I truly appreciate the support, encouragement, and consistency.

I am not a gym person and used to avoid it but now i’m looking forward to the sessions.

Thank you Jeff and Ritah 🙏🏻 for the great gym experience!
I am so glad that I found Flash Fitness!🤗

Best fitness in Bangkok, I highly recommend to anyone serious about making a positive change in their fitness journey!

reviews.name: Minoy Jose (Jo)
reviews.text: Working out at Flash Fitness has been one of my favourite fitness related experiences. Jeff and Ritah are knowledgeable and helpful. The sessions are short, intense, fun and ever-changing. It is a nice little community as well. Jeff, takes the time to explain the science and reasoning behind the different workouts. While, I am not longer working out at Flash Fitness, I still use the tips Jeff gave me for weight training. And, I would be glad to go back to Flash Fitness to train more 🙂
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Jo! We truly appreciate this! These words mean a lot to us. 🙏

reviews.name: Pallavi Baruah
reviews.text:
As someone who had no idea what to do in the gym, Flash Fitness has been an absolute game-changer! Jeff & Ritah take care of everything — from planning curated workouts for each day to helping with proper form and even guiding you on nutrition. All you have to do is show up!

The space is small, which I love because it feels personal and like a community 🫶

Highly recommend it to anyone looking to get into fitness and build a consistent habit. Thank you Jeff & Ritah!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you sooo much for this Pallavi. We LOVE having you at Flash. You have got so fit and you are always such a positive person. We give you 5stars right back for being awesome as can be! Thank YOU! 🙏

reviews.name: Jonathan Hull
reviews.text: I have a much greater sense of wellbeing along with an improvement in my physical health and strength (despite my advanced age!). Moreover, I'm amazed that working out, albeit remotely, with Jeff at Flash Fitness could be such fun. Once you're in the routine of going to the gym three times a week, you won't want to miss a single session! If you're thinking about it, you must be wanting to feel better. So, don't hestitate, take the plunge -- you won't look back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you sooo much, Jonathan! It is such a pleasure to get to train you. You’ve done a great job.  You are appreciated. Thank you!🙏

reviews.name: apanchanit bunnag
reviews.text: Let me introduce myself first. I'm 57 years old and have never exercised before. However, since my child went to study abroad, I have a lot of free time. So, I looked for a gym near home. There are many places, but I decided to choose the smallest gym. After talking to Ritah, the first day I arrived, I felt very nervous because I didn't know anyone. I asked other people if they had worked out here before. It turns out that everyone had been working out here for at least 5 years. Oh my god! How long is that? From that day until today, I have received the answer that if you are looking for a warm workout, not too strenuous, doing what you can, taking breaks whenever you want, trainers who don't pressure you and encourage you, and friends who work out with you are lovely, kind, don't bully you, and are ready to help you. Come and try this place. Just like me, I have fallen in love with exercising. Thank you very much, Jeff and Rita.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you sooo much for taking the time to write this review, Nueng! We love having you as part of the Flash community. Thank you for all the effort and positivity you give every day! 🙏

reviews.name: Jason Dunn
reviews.text:

reviews.name: Nick Koscianski
reviews.text:
Good location and convenient, but constant problems with internet, a rude manager, and terrible move-out process.  Don't expect to get any of your deposit back.  They will tell you that your contract says they get to keep your entire deposit for refurbishment (it doesn't) and then try to charge you ongoing monthly for a virtual office that you don't need.  On top of that, if you do manage to convince them to give you some of your deposit back, expect to wait up to 90 days for them to transfer it, and expect to make numerous phone calls before it happens.

I also referred several business associates to servcorp during my stay there, who had the same experience with the deposit.  They were also supposed to give me a monthly % referral fee for the referral, which they came up with an excuse to not do after 1 month, even though my referrals were still renting offices there.

Do yourself a favor and look elsewhere.  There is plenty available with better quality for cheaper.

reviews.text: It's a nice office that you can get a warm welcome from the staff and a convenient transportation system from around Bangkok. I'm sure that you can have the best working environment here.

Please google "Servecorp litigation". It seems that they do this scam all over the world.  利用して心の底から後悔しました。他の被害者が出ないように口コミを投稿します。

We offer authentic Muay Thai, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ), Boxing, MMA, and Children’s martial arts classes led by a World Champion Instructor Team. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced practitioner, Evolve MMA (EmSphere) provides a safe, professional, and motivating environment to train, get fit, and build confidence.

reviews.name: Mike G
reviews.text:
I attend this gym for Muay Thai because I found the overall experience very welcoming especially for a beginner like myself. The Krus are very knowledgeable, encouraging and motivating. Facilities themselves are new and always clean. They offer training for all experience levels. I signed up for a year membership and look forward to attending more classes! The views aren’t bad either!

Thank you for everything!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Mike! Thanks for taking the time to leave a review about your experience at Evolve MMA (EmSphere)! All of our staff and World Champion instructors do their best to provide our students with a friendly environment to train in, so it's great to hear you enjoy it here!

reviews.name: Daniel Appleby
reviews.text:
This is an exceptional, brand new martial arts gym right in the centre of Bangkok. The trainers are extremely friendly, hard working, and are themselves world champions - Kru Sagetdao, Kru Sam-A, Kru Bas, plus more.

The sessions are varied, intense and extremely fun. I have learned so much from both my private sessions with Kru Sagetdao in only one month, and I have made many friends through the group classes too. Evolve's level system ensures that you are progressing at your own pace depending upon your starting level, so it is suitable for beginners all the way to advanced fighters. The variety of martial arts on offer, including Muay Thai, Boxing, BJJ, MMA etc. also means that you can try different disciplines.

The facilities are extremely clean, with nice showers and full amenities. This is a must try and I am very happy to have joined!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Daniel, thanks for taking the time to leave a review about your experience at Evolve MMA (EmSphere)! All of our staff and World Champion instructors do their best to provide our students with a friendly environment to train in, so it's great to hear you enjoy it here! Hope to see you again!

What kind of place is this such a waste of time in a personality less environment with rude and uninterested staff and trainers. Plenty of great Muay Thai and BJJ gyms in Bangkok, so you can avoid this one.

Staff was also very helpful! They leave around 6pm and so does the A/C but it does not get too warm inside in the evening so it was completely fine when I had to stay beyond 6pm.

Pricing: 750baht for 1 day, 5500baht for 1 month (excl VAT 7%)
Perks: gives access to all other JustCo offices (but I think you can only stay 24/7 for the one you registered for)

reviews.name: Thijmen de Jong
reviews.text:
I tried this office for a month and while it ultimately wasn't the right fit for me, I genuinely appreciated the level of service they provided throughout my time there.

The communication was top-notch, always spot on and responsive. Everything is cleaned regularly, the facilities work well, and they even provide snacks and some free drinks as a nice bonus. There's also a pretty cool community of people working there, which adds to the atmosphere.

The location is honestly one of the biggest selling points. You're right next to the BTS, close to the MRT, next to the park, and in the middle of the main business district of Bangkok. It really doesn't get much more convenient than that.

Even though it didn't end up being for me, if you're looking for a co-working space in Bangkok, this is still a really solid option, especially compared to the other choices out there, and it's quite reasonably priced.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: That means a lot — especially coming from someone who's tried others around BKK. We'll pass the kind words to the whole team, cleaning staff included. See you around.

reviews.name: Chi Hang Li
reviews.text: Favourite co-working in BKK hands down. Very relaxing and chilled, run by a great group of staff that makes the place feel like home.

reviews.name: Zax Vax
reviews.text: Used this place for a meeting once. It's a bit pricey, but I think it's worth it. Very quiet and clean. Kitchens are available, internet, and printing. Toilets are cool.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the review. Glad the meeting room and amenities delivered. And yes — we're proud of the toilets.

reviews.name: Duncan Matthews
reviews.text: This was a great space to work in for the day. I liked the big windows onto the street
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Khun Duncan, glad you enjoyed our space. Look forward to hosting you again in the near future.

reviews.name: Daniel Austin
reviews.text: Very spacious and quiet co-working space in the city center, great place to get work done!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks! Glad the space worked well for you. See you again.

reviews.name: Fumiaki Tanaka
reviews.text:
Free Water, Free coffee machine. or you can order 60B real coffee.
Many kinds of furniture, which fits to your work style.

reviews.name: jerry
reviews.text: Best co-working space out of the three I have tried in Bangkok. The interior design is tasteful with comfortable chairs and desks suitable for working. The common working areas are quiet, with sufficient private booths for calls. Easy to reach as it close to BTS Asok. Price / quality is good and the staff is very kind and helpful!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Jerry! It means a lot to hear we're your favorite among the coworking spaces you've tried in Bangkok. We put a lot of thought into the interior design and seating, and we're glad the quiet working areas and private phone booths are giving you the focus you need for calls.

Since your visit, we've actually upgraded to Steelcase ergonomic chairs across the space — so it's even more comfortable to settle in for a full day of work now.

Being a short walk from BTS Asok makes it easy for members to drop in, and we're proud of how our team looks after everyone who walks through the door. Thanks again for the kind words — see you at the desk!

— Atlas Workspace Asoke team

reviews.name: John Say
reviews.text: Staff here are the nicest folks always working hard to address all issues and concerns. Very open space, family atmosphere and very impressive events with complimentary pizza and beer are frequently held. I've been a happy tenant here almost a year and encourage you to swing by and check it out!

reviews.name: Viktor Shataev
reviews.text: Perfect place for work. It has silent rooms for phone calls, coffee machine, lots of comfy chairs. Personal is super friendly. Also, it locates near the park.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Viktor! We're glad the phone booths are giving you the quiet you need for calls, and that the coffee and comfy seating are helping you settle in for a full day of work.

Being right next to Benjakiti Park is one of our favorite things about this location too — great for a breather between meetings. Thanks for the kind words, and see you again soon at Atlas Workspace!

— Atlas Workspace Asoke team

reviews.name: Lisnaree Vichitsorasatra
reviews.text: The place is quiet and and only minute away from BTS Asoke. Bathrooms are clean and with the Japanese remote control system. They have private areas like telephone booths and conference rooms. I find that the drop-in price is a bit expensive to come everyday.

reviews.name: Salvatore Labarbera
reviews.text: Excellent office service and very good price
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Khun Salvatore!

reviews.name: Joe Halliday
reviews.text: Very friendly and helpful staff, spacious interior with lots of seating areas and charging points, fast WiFi, convenient location close to the BTS. Excellent coworking place all-round!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Appreciate the kind words — glad everything hit the mark. Welcome back anytime.

reviews.name: Ema Nai
reviews.text: Beautiful space, clean and bright, but a lot of steps - not suitable for anyone with mobility issues (dangerous for pregnant ladies with a big belly! Or nearsighted people prone to tripping, like me 😂). Meeting room has no shades so can be hot in the sun. No parking but very close to BTS.

reviews.name: Dennis Schneider
reviews.text:
Amazing Coworking - relaxed atmosphere, great staff, nice interior with good chairs and tables, but also couches.

I spend only a few days in BKK, but will make Monstar Hub my place to work from.

The only downside is, that it's close to a main road, so it can get a bit noisy due to the high traffic.

title: Tiger Massage Thonglor 6
subTitle: Tiger Massage
ownerDescription: นวดแผนไทย ประสบการณ์กว่า 14 ปี

reviews.name: ZU
reviews.text: A big thank you to the Tiger Massage team and especially to Khun Oh (โอ้) for today’s amazing 2 hour aroma oil massage, which was highly skillful and wonderfully relaxing.  ขอบคุณมากครับ.  The shop is clean, tidy, and well run, with a mis of fully private rooms, semi-private / curtained rooms, and foot massage stations; bathrooms / showers are nice and modern. I will be back.

reviews.name: Tom Deprins
reviews.text: My third Thai massage in Thailand so not an expert but this one sticks out to me in terms of quality. I find it fascinating how every place seems to do these massages slightly differently. This one felt like the most professional of all 3. Two of them including this one were very firm - felt the effect in my shoulders still the next day.

reviews.name: Mano Recto
reviews.text: Massage was excellent. Simple massage area and not comparable to the high end massage places in BKK. Thus, price points are relatively quite reasonable. Tried the traditional and also the aroma (oil) - and not were so good. Must try!

reviews.name: Alba O'Neill
reviews.text: I’ve come here twice already and feel safe to say it’s an amazing spot. Massages are super affordable - average 320 baht for 1 hour. I got a massage by both male and female masseuses and they were very professional and respectful. There is a communal effort to make both private and public massage rooms quiet so don’t feel intimidated by the sometimes crowded appearance!

reviews.name: st gangi
reviews.text:
I visited on March 7 and March 9 and chose the oil massage both times. Both sessions were very relaxing.

The therapist on March 9 was especially amazing 👍👍. He relieved the soreness throughout my whole body and helped me completely relax.

Unfortunately, I didn’t know his name, but I will definitely come back next time I visit Thailand and hope to have him as my therapist again!

reviews.name: Jo
reviews.text: Walked in for a massage and everyone there was so nice and friendly. The place is clean and smells lovely. The massage was so good and price was great. I wish I had time to come back more often. Highly recommended .

reviews.name: Blue Aquamarine
reviews.text: The best massage ever! I go there all the time, and every visit is absolutely worth the money. The place is clean and quiet, creating a very relaxing atmosphere. The therapists are always professional and highly skilled in massage therapy.

reviews.name: Mayo Mingo
reviews.text: Definitely one of my favourite massage shops in town, been visiting here over 3 times back and forth, they always provide an excellent service when it comes to Thai massage! On top of that, the price is affordable as well! I’ll surely go back again when I come to BKK the next time :)

reviews.name: J M
reviews.text: I’ve been to tiger massage about 8 times and every single time no matter which staff member you get a super quality Thai massage. They have a few unique movements and processes different to others I’ve tried and it’s super relaxing in there. Not just the best in thong lor but could be the best in Bangkok!

reviews.name: MAREN GABRI-ELE HECHLER
reviews.text: I had one of the best massages here with a high quality. Jin is an expert and she has a great technique. My back pain has been relieved. I will definitely come back! Thank you :)

reviews.name: ooo
reviews.text:
Really great strong massage! I really enjoyed the feeling. The masseuse responded exactly to my reactions and hit the pressure points I needed. Walked out of the massage feeling I was floating in a cloud.

Will ask for Koh again next time!

reviews.name: Marco Yu
reviews.text:
Definitely the best massage experience I ever had!!!!!
Every single time of rubbing is precisely right to the pain point.
I will definitely come back again!

reviews.name: Ybby
reviews.text: Great massage place. Friendly staff and very welcoming atmosphere. We went for a 60 minute neck and shoulder massage. Very proficient massage therapist. Can really recommend going here. They gave us a complementary tea afterwards.

reviews.name: Eliana Park
reviews.text:
They’re always booked! Make sure to make a reservation thru LINE. In general, the therapists are above average and they work really hard! I’ve been visiting here everyday with my dad while we’re staying in Bangkok.

FYI: Credit card available (3% fee excluded).

reviews.name: Jenni Browne
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful massage from Sport. I wasn’t sure as the place is busy and everyone is packed in but once you are in place (and they insist on silence , creating a very peaceful atmosphere) it’s perfect. I felt so safe. I’ve always requested a female masseuse in the past but felt so safe with Sport. The massage itself was 1.5 hours and did me so much good. Some pain and cracking but much needed! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Abdulla H
reviews.text:
This is probably the worst massage I’ve probably had. The lady deliberately ignored areas you want worked on. And the. On the back massage she will ball up her toes to Intentionally cause pain.

I do not recommend.

reviews.name: Alex Cheney
reviews.text:
This is a very good authentic Thai spa ! The therapist I had was skilled and delivered an amazing massage. The price is good too and reception staff is friendly.

Now my only negative comment is that it wasn’t very private. It’s a small and busy spa. There are curtains isolating you from other guests but they are very close to you and during my massage all curtains were actually open, which didn’t make me feel very comfortable.

Still think it’s a good affordable spa.

reviews.name: ZT Lu
reviews.text: I visited this place several times but my last visit was a disaster. I booked Sports (the name of masseur), whom I had booked 2 times before. This time, Sports screwed up the whole thing. First, he left for several mins during the massage without saying anything to me. However, when he finished, I noticed it was barely 90 mins when I finished payment becasue I had notice of card payment (Here customers paid in advance of massage). That means, even without regard to the several mins he left, the whole massage is still less than 90 mins. Second, I asked Sports to use more strength for several times, but he said this is the most he can do. However, this is clearly not what a male can do. He is only touching rather than massaging. Further, from my last 2 times experince with Sports, I clearly know whether he is capable of doing so.  Finally, Sports was clearly very unhappy when I asked him to use more strength. Until I walked out of the shop, he said nothing to me (The practice of this shop is your masseur will give you the tea and say goodbye to you). I don't think Sports has such professional ethics as commonly required.

reviews.name: zeppe linz
reviews.text: Good massage place, foot massage are done on massage table instead of the lazy couch so the whole leg will be well massaged.

reviews.name: Dawn Satumbaga
reviews.text:
We went here because it was the higher rated place compared to surrounding massage places, and they accept card. The masseuse was good in looking for knots, but would sometimes knead bones. Pressure was okay.

I got the back neck shoulder massage but it felt like a normal thai massage (200 baht cheaper than the back massage rate) with extra focus on back. I actually don't like the stretching so I didn't get a thai massage.

Also, it would have been okay but the masseuse pulled a muscle and I got injured from it. Now it's difficult to turn my head to the left. I told the receptionist about it and they just looked at me and laughed. There was no apology or asking about the injury.

Massage okay (3 star maybe for the rate) if they didn't injure me and laughed.

title: Fairtex Pro Shop MBK Center
ownerDescription: Fairtex offers equipment for Muay Thai, Boxing, MMA, and BJJ, as well as sports and lifestyle apparel.
address: G floor, MBK Center, 444 Phaya Thai Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
street: G floor, MBK Center, 444 Phaya Thai Rd

reviews.name: mui
reviews.text: good service beautiful place and just overall a muay thai fan’s dream and yes its at ground floor tucked at the very end of MBK

reviews.name: shafath akter
reviews.text: I spent over 30k baht in this store to find out that I was scammed at the last moment. I bought so many different clothes and 3 special edition Fairtex gloves which I contacted the company and they told me that all special edition gloves comes in a set with their respective boxes. However this store charged me 550 extra for just one box by itself (other two gloves weren’t given no boxes even though they were special edition as well). Not to mention the employees when asked about Muay Thai training for glove sizes were completely lost and gave false information as well for what’s meant for sparring vs pad work vs bag work. Not to mention they thought we didn’t speak Thai because we were from New York but we did understand them as they were mocking us during the purchase packaging our items. I’d recommend staying away from this store and to look for a local Fairtex shop elsewhere to get your Muay Thai or fighting gear in general. I only came here because I was short on time and picking up customized clothing/items I had ordered the day prior where I also had purchases items from this store unfortunately. I hope whoever the owner is as someone who works in finance and with several different businesses, that you learn to hire your employees more wisely and discipline your current ones accordingly. This is a bad look for such an awesome brand as Fairtex is the heart of Thailand and respected by many.

reviews.name: Denise Ong
reviews.text:
I like the variety of shirts sold here, it has a larger collection for sale than the one at central world (also because the shop is much larger)

There’s no mirror though 😅 had to ask the staff to help me see the fit - which they were very nice and helpful about it!

In case you get lost like me - the shop is located within/near to don don donki section. From the upper floor(s) of don don donki, take the escalator down. You will see a souvenirs shop. The Fairtex shop is to the left of the souvenirs shop.

reviews.name: Jas Lee
reviews.text: Only posting a review because we got so lost trying to find this place! Head towards the information desk and then turn into the section with the lower ceiling and pop up stalls. It's located at the back there. Not far from the ground floor exit.

reviews.name: Lindy Lwin
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Fairtex Pro Shop MBK Center. The product quality is excellent, and the staff were very friendly and helpful. The service was smooth, and I felt well taken care of. I’m very satisfied and would definitely recommend this shop to others.

title: FOUNDRYS CREATIVE HUB
ownerDescription: Coworking space
address: 1/8 Sukhumvit 49, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Lily lilac white
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a chic and aesthetically pleasing place to sit and work, this café is a decent option. They do offer drinks, though the selection isn’t very extensive, and there are only a few dessert items available. Matcha lovers will probably enjoy this place the most.

Parking is limited and comes with an additional fee. Seating is comfortable, but there aren’t many power outlets around, so make sure to charge your devices beforehand if you plan to stay for a long work session.

The drinks are pretty standard — nothing extraordinary, but not disappointing either. The atmosphere is quiet and peaceful, with no loud or disruptive crowd. There are also 3–4 nice photo spots if you enjoy taking pictures.

Overall, it’s a pleasant café to work at, especially if you appreciate calm surroundings and minimal distractions.

reviews.name: m k
reviews.text:
This spot is the new it place to hangout in Thonglor — super spacious, chic, and cozy all at once. ✨ First step inside I feel like I’m not in bangkok anymore. Love the design in each corner everywhere. The matcha and donuts are also so good.
Plus, they’ve got meeting and broadcast rooms if you wanna get some work done too. Perfect mix of chill and creative. 💡☕🍩✨

reviews.name: Bene Mookie
reviews.text: Very good atmosphere. Recommend for Matcha lover who’s looking for quiet and peaceful cafe. Good for work and read.

reviews.name: Isaree U
reviews.text: Love u so matcha located in Foundrys, such a great place to just take a break or work on your own labtop, the music taste is so good and the staff are so nice and lively, and of course, there are variety of matcha menu to select

reviews.text: Great atmosphere & great vibes! I feel calm. There's a space that we can chill and enjoy uour leisure time!

reviews.name: Vincent Hosman
reviews.text:
The place looks amazing, the staff is friendly, and it definitely has a lot of potential.

I came here to get some work done, but it doesn’t seem very well set up for that. This might be intentional if it is meant more as a coworking bar than a workspace.

The music is quite loud, the lighting is too dark and not ideal for working, and there is no coffee, which was surprising. The lunch options are also fairly limited, so you need to step out if you want a proper meal.

With a few adjustments, this place could be really great. I am curious to see what direction they plan to take it in.
