title: Lotus Wellness
ownerDescription:
Holistic wellness in the heart of downtown Bangkok. Relax & recharge through Kundalini Yoga, Reiki, Sound Healing, Meditation & Water Therapy. All are welcome to our group Weekly Classes & Monthly Events, Workshops & Trainings. Private sessions also available. Advance booking essential.

**No Kids under 12 years old or Pets allowed to join our public classes. Private Session might be offered**
address: House 30, Pitak Court (House, 30), 43 Soi Atthakan Prasit, Tungmahamaek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand
street: House 30, Pitak Court (House, 30), 43 Soi Atthakan Prasit

reviews.name: S Marie
reviews.text:
I had an incredible water sound bath experience with Peggy-Jane. From the moment I arrived, she made me feel completely at ease. Her warmth, knowledge, and skill as a sound practitioner created a safe and relaxing environment where I could fully unwind.

The session was deeply calming and restorative. The combination of sound and water helped me reach a level of relaxation that I rarely experience. By the end of the session, I felt refreshed, grounded, and mentally reset for the week ahead.

I highly recommend this experience to anyone looking to reduce stress, reconnect with themselves, and experience deep relaxation. You can truly feel the difference immediately.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Marie,

Thank you for this lovely review I will be sure to share it with PJ who is truly an angel in the water!

We  are grateful for your review that will help others receive deep relaxation and calm at our oasis in our warm, saltwater therapy pool.

Blessings,

Melanie 🙏🪷⭐️😍

reviews.name: Ada Fang
reviews.text:
10/10 — A truly healing, profound and magical experience everyone should have at least once in their lifetime!

I was gifted the Water Wellness Therapy + Floating Sound Bath package by my brother while visiting Thailand, and it was truly amazing from start to finish.

Finding the property was easy thanks to Lotus Wellness's clear, detailed instructions with photos. Walking onto the property itself felt like stepping into another world - serene, green, surrounded by trees, immediately calming. Needless to say, it’s a spiritual oasis in the midst of bustling Bangkok.

I was welcomed into a beautiful living room/kitchen space filled with bookshelves of spiritual and personal growth books, given tea and water, and allowed to just settle in before anything began. Melanie, the owner, came in and we talked for a while - she was genuinely curious about me and my spiritual journey, and that exchange, getting to know each other before the session even started, ended up being such a powerful part of the whole experience.

Then came the floating sound bath itself. Being immersed in the warm water, completely supported, combined with the Tibetan bowls, chimes, and gongs - it was healing and majestic in a way that's hard to put into words. I felt completely safe and present the entire time, never once exposed or ungrounded. Melanie even took photos throughout, which I loved having afterward.

Afterward there was no rush at all - a shower, then back to the house for local treats, more tea, journaling, reading. The whole morning was unhurried and intentional. I will never forget this experience.

I wanted to book the same package for my brother but he couldn't make the timing work on his trip. I'm already planning to bring my mom and siblings here next time they're in Bangkok. I cannot recommend Melanie and her team enough. This is an incredible gift for someone else or, honestly, for yourself.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ada, 

W💗W it is such a gift to serve someone as open to experiencing and sharing so vulnerably, courageously as you did and to receive such a heartfelt, honest review. 

I hope to welcome your brother another time and I’m sure our paths will cross again, you know where we are when you’re back in Thailand and need a sacred space to unfold!

Blessings and love,

Melanie 🙏🪷💗⭐️🥰

reviews.name: นิธินันท์ เลื่อนไธสง
reviews.text:
I joined Peggy-Jane’s Gong Relaxation class today, and it was such a beautiful experience. The sound bath created powerful vibrations that felt both grounding and calming at the same time. The atmosphere was peaceful, and I found myself completely relaxed—so much so that I even drifted off for a moment.

I’m pretty sure I’ll have a great night’s sleep after this. It was the perfect way to slow down, recharge, and end the week on a positive note. Thank you, Peggy-Jane, for such a wonderful session.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear K. Nittinan, 

thank you so much for this beautiful review. We are so happy you enjoyed PJ’s presence and gifts of holding space, sound healing & singing. 

She is an angel we agree & we will share your review with her. I look forward to welcoming you, your friends & family back soon anytime kha!

Blessings,

Melanie 🙏🪷
Studio Founder

reviews.name: Jessica
reviews.text:
Still buzzing from today’s floating sound bath! ✨ This was easily one of the best sessions I’ve ever attended. The organizers are incredibly thoughtful, ensuring that the end-to-end experience from the pre-session preparation to the final post-session integration was seamless and deeply restorative.

Melanie and Jodie, thank you for holding such a beautiful, safe space today. Melanie’s explanation was clear and insightful, making the session profound. I truly felt the immense care put into every detail of the environment and the flow. I personally found the floating sound bath session to be the perfect way to recharge, and I’m already looking forward to coming back for future sessions.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Ah thank you dear Jessica…

I’m so happy you enjoyed your experience. We deeply appreciate your sincere feedback and look forward to welcoming you back soon again soon. Wishing you happy and safe travels! 

Blessings,

Melanie 🙏🪷

reviews.name: Yee Siang Wong
reviews.text: The only to do list whenever I come to Bangkok. A very friendly founder Melaine that willing to share her stories and knowledges. This is definitely I call it as HOME for my heart. It's give me inner peace and I just had a wonderful "journey" when experienced their water sound bath. Highly recommend everyone to experience it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Yee Siang, 

I am very touched by your heartfelt message. Thank you for sharing your experience and recommendation so others may also find peace & recalibration while in busy Bangkok.

Safe travels and I’m sure we will see you again soon!

Blessings,

Melanie 🙏🪷💗

reviews.name: Sarah Savidge
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of taking a gong course at Lotus Wellbeing and was blown away with the level of content and expertise offered. Lotus Wellbeing hosted gong master, Martha Collard, the owner of The Red Door studio in Hong Kong.   For me being a Thailand resident it was more convenient to take the course in Bangkok versus traveling to HK.   Melanie, the owner of Lotus Wellbeing is such a beam of sunshine!  She had everything and more that we needed to have a successful week with over twenty five gongs present for us to use.   Her gorgeous studio is a hidden peaceful gem in the center of Bangkok with a retreat vibe.

I have been a practitioner of sound for five years now and I am always looking for ways to keep refining my offerings and deepening my own practice.  I previously completed an intro level gong course and was ready to go deeper into the world of all things gong.  Martha has trained and worked with original gong masters and makers and has a HUGE wealth of knowledge and experience spanning over a multiple decades.

Martha is an amazing trainer with the ability to articulate details, science, technique and more.  She makes the content approachable and teaches us how to apply what we're learning right into real life situations based on our individual needs.  I still have lots of reading content post course to dive into that she provided and now I have a curiosity to learn more about Kundalini yoga as well.  The hands on practice and receiving we experienced all week left me feeling a renewed sense of lightness, inspiration and hope.

Thank you Melanie for collaborating with skilled masters from around the globe and bringing such unique opportunities to us in heart of Bangkok!  I only wished I lived closer so I could be a regular client of this special community you created, xx
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sarah, 

thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your deeply detailed feedback and generous review. 

It has been and remains an immense honour to host my sound healing mentors annually in Bangkok over the last decade.

 I’m so glad to hear you truly benefited from and enjoyed the training with Martha so much!

I wish you all the best for your new adventures back home in the USA and hope to visit and receive a soundbath from you one day too!

Blessings and love,

Mel 🙏🪷😇🤍

reviews.name: Cm
reviews.text:
I absolutely loved my experience here. The atmosphere is so peaceful and relaxing, and being surrounded by beautiful nature made me feel completely at ease. Everyone is warm and welcoming, and there's no pressure at all to sign up for more courses—it's entirely your own decision. Just come with an open mind, and you might fall in love with this place, just as I did.🥰

Risa❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Risa,

Thank you so much for your beautiful review. We're so happy to hear that you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere and felt welcomed during your time with us. Creating a safe, supportive space where everyone can explore their own wellness journey is at the heart of what we do. 

We truly appreciate your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back to Lotus Wellness soon. 🌿

Jubjib

reviews.name: Anne-Claude Toral
reviews.text: I had a wonderful water therapy treatment with Melanie who is the founder of Lotus Wellness. It was the first time I have done such a water treatment and really loved it. To be surrounded by warm water surrounded by huge trees in the back of her garden in the middle of Bangkok is such a special experience. After coming home, I slept for two hours which is a sign how deep the relaxation was. I highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to experience unique and authentic healing experiences in Bangkok! Thank You Melanie!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Merci Annie! 

What a touching review from the heart. I’m happy you loved my home space & garden, & that you experienced such a deep relaxation that continued after your private water therapy session with me. 

See you again soon! 

Blessings & love, 

Melanie 🙏💕🫶🪷

reviews.name: Carolyn Peh
reviews.text:
I spent three days studying the finer points of gong playing with Melanie at Lotus Wellness Bangkok. She was generous in sharing her knowledge, experience and home. There were several ‘Aha!’ moments, lots of laughter and just so much love in her teaching. It has been an honour to learn from Melanie.
The vibrations of her being are now with me in my gong practice, in my home, in Kuala Lumpur.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Oh bless you dear Carolyn for this heartfelt, genuine review! It was a blessing and honour to share my deep, decade long passion of the gongs with such a gifted intuitive of your caliber! I envision myself lying down to receive your divine magical Gong & Bowl playing in KL soon…blessings and so much love,

Mel 🙏🏻🪷💕🥰💝

reviews.name: L L
reviews.text: The setting is beautiful—it’s hard to believe you’re in Bangkok. The whole place exudes a sense of peace and feels refreshingly non-commercial. I attended a sound therapy session, and it was unlike anything I’ve experienced before—you can truly feel the vibrations! I also had a Reiki session with Melanin, which felt like a psychoanalysis session but focusing on how trauma leaves its marks.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your generous review L L. Happy you found your peace here with us. It is my real home, I live here! So yes, it will never be commercial. I only share what truly works for me on a personal level. My Reiki sessions always include a deep & reflective sharing talk, Transformational Self-Love Therapy (which places emphasis on somatics and breath) plus sound healing. A holistic session! Blessings on your journey home, Melanie 🙏🪷

reviews.name: Anastasi A.
reviews.text:
I have completed one-week Sound Healing training at Lotus Wellness studio.
Mel, Santi and Roni are amazing teachers! Passionate about their instruments and extremely knowledgeable.
The learning process is very hands-on and practical, which is exactly what I was looking for. We also learned how to use our voices as a healing tool, which was very empowering.
Highly recommend this training to anyone who is interested in learning how to play gongs, Tibetan and crystal bowls, and also to those who are looking for personal transformation.
The beauty of this course is that you learn to play a lot of instruments, get a lot of practice and during this process you understand what instruments you connect and resonate with better. It’s a beautiful journey. Plus, all additional amazing activities! Cacao Ceremony and Ecstatic Dancing were such a fun way to celebrate graduation!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your heartfelt review dear Anastasi - it was pure bliss to share healing techniques and vibrations with you, and even more touching to witness your blooming and growth on this journey with our group. Thank you also for your constant support and positive, calm energy here in studio. You’re our family! See you again soon! Love and blessings to you and Kate, Mel 🙏🏻🪷💕

reviews.name: May Leethanachai
reviews.text:
A great place for water therapy, sounds healing, yoga, and all sort of mind and mental healing. All instructors are lovely people and they can speak many languages..English, Thai, Cantonese, Spanish, French, and Indian.

There are toilets and showers.
There is also a cafe and library!

The location is a bit hard to find. It’s better to pin to Pipat court and then turn in from there as if you set the location directly there, you won’t be able to get in as the back gate is closed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you dear May for attending our Open House! It was an honour to meet and serve a professional free diver of your caliber! gratitude for your generous review and support, hope to see you again soon! Blessings, Melanie 🙏🏻🪷

reviews.name: dawn natalie whiteside
reviews.text:
I'm not a city girl whatsoever, so when I had to nip to Bangkok for a couple of days I surprised myself by deciding to stay for a week. My life needed a shake up and I was desperately craving some time just for me.

Kundalini is always so special to me, and brings me back into full alignment with source when I've been neglecting myself.

So I booked a hotel within 3 minutes walking distance from Lotus Wellness, and booked on to every class I could fit in to my schedule.

I didn't just find an oasis of peace in the madness of central Bangkok, I found a home from home.

I found such beautiful loving souls. Mel, Kat, Amora, and Satya. I found not only joy peace and connection, but throughout the different classes I also realigned with my soul's purpose.

Lotus and the beautiful ladies there,
ThAnK YoU !!!!
You gave me so much more than I was looking for and I'm incredibly grateful for you all 🥰
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Sat Nam Natalie, we touched by your gratitude. A reminder for us stay in touch with our soul and to connect sincerely with other beings. Good luck for your journey and the plan for KYTT in Rishikesh. Hope we can meet you again soon! Blessings and lots of love from us.

reviews.name: Gloria Mok
reviews.text:
A 5-star experience, atmosphere, and all the people✨

I already liked Lotus when I saw the big tree at the first entrance. Here's truly an urban oasis! Many say the address is hard to find, but don't worry. They provide clear instructions and even have a video tutorial. Katt, who contacted me, is lovely. I can call them anytime or help and talk to the taxi driver if I get lost. I suggest coming by BTS/MRT, because of the busy traffic jam in Bangkok, it only takes ten minutes to walk from the MRT station.

I visited here twice on this trip and tried kundalini yoga, gong bath, and private floating sound bath class. I have practiced vinyasa yoga; it was my first experience with kundalini yoga. Jodie was friendly and introduced kundalini to me in every detail, happy to answer any questions.
The second time went to the private floating sound bath with my friends, Melanie greeted us warmly. She is also from Hong Kong, speaks fluent Cantonese, and is very friendly. Well-prepared tea for us to relax. The atmosphere is also perfect. You will not be in a hurry to start the session immediately. The floating sound bath is an exceptional experience; I highly recommend it! Sis and I were a little scared initially because we were unfamiliar with water. Melanie was gentle and took good care of us so that we could relax. Also, water was prepared to keep us hydrated after finishing; so comforting! If you're lucky, maybe you can try Mel's bake too. The banana cake is an unforgettable 5-star deliciousness!! Better than a restaurant!

Love this place so much! It's more like a homestay. The team will take good care of you. It's a place that makes people feel relaxed and happy. Missed it very much when I backed to Hong Kong, hope to come back again soon :) Warmly recommend everyone try a class or two. It might give you new inspiration!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Bless you dear Gloria for this honest and warm review. It was such a joy to meet and serve you all at our home studio! Big love & ‘joy geen’ see you again soon! 🙏🏻🥰

reviews.name: VP
reviews.text:
Lovely place with such a good vibe, calm, and peaceful. Highly recommend <3 :)

They offer a good variety of classes, from gong relaxation, yoga, Qi gong Tai Chi, and more. I love to come here often.

They play many kinds of gongs, crystal bowls, Tibetan bowls, and other instruments. The sounds are beautiful and relaxing. Qi gong is really good practice for being mindful, feel refresh and good for health.

The teachers are experts in this subject and pay good attention to guide the students. There aren't many people per class yet, so it feels private and exclusive.

However, the location is a bit hard to find. It's inside the "Pitak Court". If you come by car/Google Map, please pin "Pitak Court" as it's the correct entrance. Then walk in and follow the whiteboard sign for "Lotus Wellness". There are free parking spaces inside. Restrooms are available.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you dear Visuta for your warm & generous review. 

Yes we are a hidden gem located inside Pitak Court and we do provide instructions for clients who book directly through us with a helpful video how to find us! 

We only work with teachers who come from a place of deep experience, integrity  and authenticity. 

We are the first & longest serving sound healing studio here in Bangkok . We love to keep it cosy and personal, so every client feels right at home and meaningfully connected. Looking forward to welcoming you back soon again! 

Blessings, Melanie 🙏🏻🪷💕🥰

reviews.name: Plai Rinrapat
reviews.text:
I joined the Yin Yoga & Sound Healing class with Hnin Su, and even though I had never experienced this type of yoga before, it turned out to be a truly wonderful experience. The sound and atmosphere deeply healed my inner soul. Hnin Su was excellent at guiding the breathwork and meditation, creating a calming and transformative session. Thank you for such a unique and meaningful experience!

P.S. Getting to the place was a little bit tricky, and while there is some car parking available, the spaces are limited. The session was conducted in English.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you K. Plai for your warm review of Hnin Su’s class she is an amazing teacher indeed. We’re happy to hear you found us and a space to park your car. If you contact us ahead, we will always provide very clear instructions with a helpful short video - we are located in a stand alone house and garden deep inside of Pitak Court on Sathorn soi1. 

We recommend you park directly inside our gates in our garden as we have plenty of space for up to 8 cars along our private driveway for our small & intimate classes as we are a private home studio not a commercial space. Perhaps you parked in the apartment block’s parking which isn’t belonging to us…? Please park inside on your next visit.thank you! 

Blessings, 

Melanie 
Studio Founder🙏🪷

reviews.name: Nurten A
reviews.text: You’ll have the best wellness treatments at Lotus Wellness , every time I get a sound bath, a yoga class or a water therapy  I feel like I’ve gifted myself something truly nourishing. The space is peaceful, the teachers are caring, and every visit leaves me calmer, lighter, and more grounded. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to reset, heal, and reconnect with themselves. Melanie created a safe haven where you instantly feel welcomed, supported, and deeply cared for. The atmosphere is peaceful, the sessions are thoughtfully guided, and I always leave feeling lighter, calmer, and more connected. Truly a place for healing and renewal. Thank you 🙏🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you beautiful Nurten for this heartfelt review! We are happy that you’ve been our client for over 7 years and that you always come back to visit when you travel to Thailand and recommend friends too. Looking forward to seeing you again soon. 

Infinite Blessings & happy new year,

Mel 🙏🪷

reviews.name: Jello Candles
reviews.text: Highly recommend! An exceptional experience. Different from traditional singing bowls therapy. Truly refreshing. Thank you Alyssa!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re so happy you loved Alyssa/Katt’s class! She is an angel. Thank you for your lovely review kha 🙏🪷

reviews.name: Fiona Koh
reviews.text:
No words to fully capture the amazing experience of the floating sound bath! It was as though I was in a cocoon of warmth. My arms, body and legs felt weightless in the water and the muted sounds of Melanie’s and PJ’s gongs, singing bowls, chimes and flutes transported me into a dreamy state of relaxation!

I really loved how these 2 amazing practitioners put so much love and care into every single step of the experience, from explaining what to expect in the beginning all the way to the end, where we had time to ground ourselves, before leaving the pool. The light touches of massage of the feet, hands and body were the icing on the cake.

I felt so safe, relaxed and looked after. I would definitely return the next time I’m in Bangkok. This experience made my trip so memorable! Thank you! 🌹
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Satnam dear Fiona, 

thank you for your warm review! It was a joy to hold space for you and your husband. I’m deeply honored that a fellow gong player / yoga teacher / studio owner from Singapore has shared such a glowing review. 

I look forward to welcoming you both back in the near future and hope to come enjoy your offerings  in Singapore soon too! 

Blessings,

Melanie 🙏🪷

reviews.name: Brianne Tolp
reviews.text:
WOW ✨
My friend and I did the Floating Sound Bath experience on Airbnb and I’ll say….if you’re feeling called to Melanie, trust the call and book it.

I’ve experienced many types of floating meditations and water therapies, but this was truly unique. From the moment you enter Melanie’s property, you feel as though you’ve stepped into a peaceful sanctuary filled with love and intention. The soft sounds of birds singing in the background only deepen the sense of calm and connection.

Feeling the vibration of the sound bowls through the water, noticing how each instrument and movement stirs something within you, and being so fully held and seen by Melanie, it’s all beyond words.

I don’t want to give too much away, but I will say that water therapies have been deeply healing for me. To find such an intimate, quiet, sacred space in the heart of a bustling city, surrounded by nature’s harmony, is a rare gift.

I will absolutely go back if I return to Bangkok, and I’ll be recommending it to everyone I know.
Thank you Melanie ✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
W🫶W thank you dear Brianne 🙏🪷 what a meaningful and heartfelt review. It was an honour to host you and your friend at my home studio  for our AirBnB Experience- to share some local Thai culture about Spirit Houses, the significance of Water and the mantra for Phra Mae Khongkha. I loved hearing your water therapy healing journey. 

Sending you infinite blessings and love, Melanie 🥰💜

title: Combat Studios
ownerDescription: MMA and Jiu Jitsu training academy. Open for drop ins and new members. Free trial session.
address: Ambassador Hotel, Sukhumvit 11 Aly, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: H T
reviews.text:
I have checked out and trained in many gyms in Bangkok, and I’d say, nothing comes close to Combat Studios in terms of professionalism, fair pricing and high-level coaching.

If you are a dude wanting to learn to fight and/or up the ante in your martial arts / fight skills, this is your gym. I saw a 14-year old young man perform with great form and ended his debut fight in less than 40 seconds last weekend. A product of Combat Studios.

If you are a parent wanting to find a caring space for your kids - boys and girls - to learn discipline, focus and be mobile, this is your gym.

If you are a woman who just loves martial arts and wanting to find a welcoming space to train where you will be challenged and also enjoy your training, this is your gym.

Head Coach Dante is the GOAT of a martial arts practitioner, fighter and coach. All his students will attest to that. And all coaches at Combat Studios are high-level mentors.

I am one satisfied student. And believe me, the search for the right fit of a community of focused trainers has not been easy. And, we all have such great fun! We don’t wanna forget that.

reviews.name: Jen Len
reviews.text:
Great Place to learn. Patient and detailed coaches. All the coaches and students made the class enjoyable and easy to understand.
I'm a beginner and still learnt a lot during my visit.

I'll be back next time for sure!

reviews.name: Toby McNerlin
reviews.text: I’ve been training all of this gym for several months now consistently, coaches are incredibly Friendly and classes are engaging and educational, for professional fighters and or people who have never trained in their life, I would highly recommend combat studios.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Toby, thank you for the glowing review.  This is exactly the environment we want to foster.  Your tenacity and attitude drive the gym forward.  We appreciate you.

reviews.name: Ahren
reviews.text: This place is just absolutely amazing, I started training here a few weeks ago but despite that I’ve already learned so much in my time here. The coaches are patient, and teach you not only textbook things but logical things to do in certain situations (critical thinking).The community is also very humble and I’ve just loved it so much so far.

reviews.name: dharma nualsakul
reviews.text: excellent coaches and teammates. I walked into in the gym with no mma background till now I have competed in competitions.

reviews.name: Agrim Somani
reviews.text: Great gym, Dante is top g. Competed while training just for a month with the team, but Dante treated it like I have been training with him for years. Definitely recommend for everyone.

reviews.name: Jared Chaney
reviews.text: I’m a BJJ brown belt, I have rolled a lot of places. This was one of the best. Dante was amazing and gave me individualized experience even though I just dropped in for a class. I really can’t say enough good things about this place. I have tried another gym in Bangkok and combat studios is so much better.

reviews.name: Brice Lee
reviews.text: This gym is amazing. I have been here since its very beginning and have learned so much from Dante. This gym has been great for me as a fighter: he helped me prepare for my first MMA fight and both the BJJ and MMA classes were instrumental for me winning it. This gym is also great for casuals too and he does a great job of making every class beneficial to everyone, even young kids too. Highly recommended to everyone of all ages and experience levels!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Brice!  Thank you for the  wonderful review.  On behalf of Coach Dante and the entire gym, congratulations on your victory.  You executed your game plan flawlessly.  You inspire the entire crew, looking forward to seeing you in action again soon.

reviews.name: Łukasz
reviews.text: I'm in Bangkok for a week and this gym was nearby. I've been training for years and can tell you that Dante (the coach) knows his stuff, is really friendly and a great teacher. I will definitely be back. Give this gym a try.

reviews.name: Nicolas Vallat
reviews.text:
I’ve been going for about a month for Wrestling and BJJ as a beginner. Everyone is very nice. And, it’s great to be able to constantly roll with different people from every level, background or size while having fun and learning some new techniques
I recommend 100%

reviews.name: Moses Sharp
reviews.text: Great gym, great coach, great experience and learned a lot of new techniques. 👌

reviews.name: Discrete Loner
reviews.text: Awesome experience. Friendly coaches and gym members.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It was a pleasure to have you visit!  Looking forward to having you again.  Thank you for the wonderful review.  It was awesome for us too.😊

reviews.name: Yury Lubchevskiy
reviews.text: The best BJJ Place! 💪💪
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Yuri, we are happy you think so!  Thank you for contributing to making it "the best!"  We appreciate you training with us.

reviews.name: William Chen-Sue
reviews.text: High level teaching and great vibes

reviews.name: Piri Piri Piri
reviews.text: Awsome, fun training, good vibe.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Pi,
You make the vibe sir!  We love having you.  Your positivity, passion for learning are infectious.  Thank you!

reviews.name: Kamolpan Pansri
reviews.text: Good coach good place
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Kamolpan, thank you for your review.  It was great having you.  Come roll with us anytime!

reviews.name: N
reviews.text: The best gym for anyone who wants to learn MMA, kickboxing, wrestling, and jiu-jitsu. The coach is very good and humble.

reviews.name: Tianze Liang
reviews.text: 教练很友善 第一次去也不会尴尬  教练的技术很好 很乐于助人 我去过很多体育馆 这个是我见过最干净的 每天都有消毒 包括拳套 护腿 地面等等 最后收费也很合理 如果你在找一个gym 这家不容错过哦
reviews.textTranslated: The coaches are very friendly, so there was no awkwardness even on my first visit. The coaches are highly skilled and very helpful. I've been to many gyms, and this is the cleanest I've ever seen. They disinfect everything daily, including the gloves, shin guards, and the floor. The price is also very reasonable. If you're looking for a gym, this is a must-visit!

reviews.name: Daisuke Yoshioka
reviews.text: BJJ （No-Gi グラップリング）のクラスを２回、MMAのクラスを1回受講したことがございます。インストラクターは優しくて丁寧、フレンドリーで心地よかったです。中上級はもちろん、初心者の方もぜひ参加してみてください。とはいえ、ヒップエスケープと受け身の取り方くらい知らないと超初心者には最初辛いかもです。まあこのジムに限ったことではありませんがね。YouTubeで軽く学んでからの方がよりスムーズに練習に入れるかと個人的には思います。それでは良い1日を！＾＾
reviews.textTranslated: I have taken two BJJ (No-Gi Grappling) classes and one MMA class. The instructor was kind, polite, friendly and comfortable. Beginners as well as intermediate and advanced students are encouraged to join. That said, if you are a complete beginner, it may be difficult at first unless you know how to do hip escapes and defensive moves. Although this is not limited to this gym. Personally, I think it will be easier to start practicing if you learn a little on YouTube first. Have a nice day! ^^
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Yoshi, thank you for the honest review.  We will definitely take your feedback into consideration.  It was really great having you.  Please take care of your health!

reviews.name: 택블 Takble
reviews.text: 잘 배웠습니다.
reviews.textTranslated: I learned a lot.

reviews.name: RolandSz23
reviews.text:
Really friendly, welcoming place. If you want to train muay thai and you are a begginner don't be afraid to give this place a try. They have classes going on all day, and I promise you you will get a killer workout in. They also have a really good coffee shop so you can fuel yourself before/after training.

Special thanks to the owners of this place. This amazing family treats you like you belong to them.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review and kind words! We’re very happy to hear that you felt welcomed and comfortable at BAAN FIVE.

Your message about our family truly means a lot to us. At BAAN FIVE, we want every person who walks through our doors to feel like part of the family.

reviews.name: Shu-Han, P Yang
reviews.text: I buy 20 private training here with reasonable price. Couch Champmak is very professional. He refined my left kick skill within 5 classes. There will be warmups session: rope jumping, stretching exercises and jogging. Then, shadow, sand bag training and pad training. Everything go smoothly here. Baan Five is the most friendly and professional gym in Bkk I tried so far. Maybe you are a junior Muay Thai player, you can still feel ease and keep reshape your technique here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your detailed review and for choosing BAAN FIVE for your training 🙏🥊

We’re delighted to hear that Coach Champmak helped improve your technique and that you enjoyed the structure of the sessions, from warm-up to pad work.

Your kind words about our gym, coaches, and atmosphere mean a lot to us. Whether beginner or experienced, our goal is always to help every student progress and feel welcome.

We look forward to seeing you again soon at BAAN FIVE! 👊

reviews.name: Hadrien Denoyelle
reviews.text: Great team,  dedicated to beginners and experts! If you want to learn, that’s the place to go. Will come back soon.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your support 🙏
It truly means a lot to our team.

We’re committed to providing a high-quality and welcoming training experience for everyone 🥊

See you again soon!

reviews.name: Flavie canino
reviews.text:
My first Muay Thai experience in Bangkok and I absolutely loved it!

The class was women-only, which made it very welcoming and comfortable for a beginner. The training was both fun and very comprehensive, with a great balance of technique, fitness, and learning.

The owners were incredibly friendly and made us feel at home from the moment we arrived.

I will definitely come back during my next stay in Thailand. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind review 🙏🥊

We’re so happy you enjoyed your first Muay Thai experience with us and felt comfortable in our women-only class.

It was a pleasure to welcome you to BAAN FIVE, and we can’t wait to see you again on your next trip to Thailand ☕️😊

Safe travels and see you soon!

reviews.name: Audrey SUTTHAKAN
reviews.text:
The gym is very spacious and comfortable to train. The coaches really take the time to explain the correct techniques and movements, which makes the experience both effective and beginner-friendly.

The owners are also incredibly kind and welcoming, creating such a great atmosphere in the gym.

There is also a café inside (and the Thai tea is absolutely delicious)

I highly recommend this place if you want to discover Muay Thai in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your kind review and recommendation 🙏🥊

We’re so happy to hear that you enjoyed the training, the atmosphere, and the experience with our coaches. Making Muay Thai accessible, enjoyable, and authentic for everyone is exactly what we strive for at BAAN FIVE.

Your support truly means a lot to us ❤️

We hope to welcome you back soon for another session… and another Thai tea ☕️

reviews.name: Thet Htoo Wai
reviews.text: Been training here for more than a month. The place is spacious, well ventilated and the trainers are superb. Best!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind review and for choosing to train with us again! 🙏🥊

We’re especially happy to see you renew your unlimited membership for a second month. Your trust means a lot to our team.

It’s great to hear that you enjoy the gym, the atmosphere, and the work of our coaches. Seeing your progress and commitment over the past weeks has been a real pleasure.

Thank you for being part of the BAAN FIVE family, and we look forward to many more training sessions together! 👊😊

reviews.name: Marina Salamon
reviews.text: I have been wanting to try Muay Thai for a long time, but was always too intimidated to join a class. I saw that Baan Five offered a women only session, and decided to take the leap. It was fantastic! It was my first time trying Muay Thai, and everyone at Baan Five was super supportive and helpful. I felt like I really learned the basics, as well as got a killer workout in. Would absolutely recommend this gym to beginners or anyone who wants a supportive environment for their Muay Thai journey. I will definitely be back to try again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for sharing your experience! We’re really happy that our women-only session helped you feel comfortable taking your first step into Muay Thai.

Starting something new can feel intimidating, so it means a lot to hear that you felt supported, welcomed and able to learn the basics while still getting a great workout.

Thank you for recommending BAAN FIVE. We’re looking forward to seeing you again and continuing your Muay Thai journey with us! 🥊💛

reviews.name: NICHOLAS BOUSSEMART
reviews.text:
I had my first Muay Thai session here on Sunday morning and I couldn’t have chosen a better place. The atmosphere is fantastic, the gym is beautifully set up and perfectly located in On Nut. The staff is incredibly friendly, welcoming, and highly professional. Whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced fighter, they make you feel comfortable and motivated from the very first minute.
The training was intense in the best possible way, and everything was perfectly organized. I’m already excited to come back and try the ice bath next time! 😉
They’ve also just opened a small café on site, which is perfect for relaxing and recovering after a tough workout.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Nicholas 🙏

This really means a lot to us! We’re very happy you enjoyed the atmosphere, the muay thaï training in Bangkok and the team 🥊

We do our best to make everyone feel welcome — from beginners to fighters — so your feedback is truly appreciated.

We’re looking forward to seeing you again soon… and yes, you definitely need to try the ice bath next time! 🧊😉

See you soon in On Nut !

reviews.text: Very good gym!! My first ever time training muay thai. Everyone here is very friendly including coaches, fighters and the owners. reviews.name: TeamChoukTV
reviews.text:
Super expérience

Une ambiance incroyable, de la souffrance… mais toujours dans la bonne humeur 😂💪 ! Les entraînements sont sérieux, intenses et de qualité, tout en gardant cet esprit familial qui fait vraiment la différence.

Les coachs sont au top : compétents, disponibles, motivants et toujours prêts à donner de bons conseils, quel que soit votre niveau.

Un grand merci également aux propriétaires pour leur accueil, leur gentillesse et l'ambiance qu'ils ont réussi à créer dans ce camp. On se sent rapidement à l'aise et intégré.

Le lieu est vraiment sympa et tout est réuni pour s'entraîner, progresser et passer un excellent moment.

Bref, beaucoup de transpiration, quelques douleurs 😂, mais surtout beaucoup de plaisir et de bons souvenirs !

Je recommande à 100 % et je reviendrai avec grand plaisir. 🙏🥊
reviews.textTranslated:
Amazing experience!

An incredible atmosphere, some real suffering… but always in good spirits 😂💪! The training sessions are serious, intense, and high-quality, all while maintaining that family atmosphere that truly makes all the difference.

The coaches are top-notch: competent, available, motivating, and always ready to give great advice, whatever your level.

A huge thank you also to the owners for their warm welcome, their kindness, and the atmosphere they've created at this camp. You quickly feel comfortable and included.

The location is really nice, and everything is there to train, progress, and have a great time.

In short, lots of sweat, a few aches and pains 😂, but above all, lots of fun and great memories!

I 100% recommend it and I'll definitely be back. 🙏🥊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Merci beaucoup 😊 
Vous êtes les bienvenus quand vous le souhaitez. C’est un plaisir de vous accueillir. 
À très bientôt !

reviews.name: KENAN KENAN
reviews.text:
Une excellente expérience chez BaanFive Muay Thaï à On Nut !
L’accueil se fait dans une ambiance familiale, bienveillante et très motivante. Les coachs sont passionnés, attentifs et savent s’adapter à tous les niveaux, ce qui permet de progresser rapidement tout en prenant beaucoup de plaisir à l’entraînement.
Les installations sont impeccables, toujours très propres et bien entretenues. Un vrai plus : l’ice bath après les séances, idéal pour récupérer et se sentir bien.
On ressent une véritable passion du Muay Thaï et un excellent esprit d’équipe. Une mention spéciale au propriétaire, dont la passion, le dévouement et l’investissement quotidien contribuent grandement à l’atmosphère unique du club. Son engagement envers ses élèves et la qualité de l’enseignement se ressent à chaque instant.
Que vous soyez débutant ou confirmé, je recommande BaanFive les yeux fermés. Merci à toute l’équipe pour votre accueil et votre professionnalisme ! 🥊🙏🔥
reviews.textTranslated:
An excellent experience at BaanFive Muay Thai in On Nut!

The welcome is warm, friendly, and very motivating. The coaches are passionate, attentive, and adaptable to all levels, allowing for rapid progress while thoroughly enjoying the training.
The facilities are impeccable, always spotless and well-maintained. A real bonus: the ice bath after sessions, ideal for recovery and feeling great.
You can feel a genuine passion for Muay Thai and an excellent team spirit. A special mention goes to the owner, whose passion, dedication, and daily commitment greatly contribute to the club's unique atmosphere. His dedication to his students and the quality of the instruction is evident at every moment.
Whether you're a beginner or an experienced fighter, I wholeheartedly recommend BaanFive. Thank you to the entire team for your warm welcome and professionalism! 🥊🙏🔥
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave such a detailed and thoughtful review! 🙏🥊

We are truly delighted that you enjoyed the welcoming atmosphere, the quality of our coaching, and our facilities. Creating a friendly, supportive, and motivating environment for all levels is exactly what we strive for every day.

It means a lot to hear that you appreciated not only the training but also the recovery experience with our ice bath and the overall spirit of the gym. We are passionate about sharing authentic Muay Thai and helping every member progress while enjoying their journey.

A special thank you as well for your kind words about the owner. The dedication and energy invested in the gym come from a genuine love for Muay Thai and for the community we are building together.

Your support and recommendation mean the world to us. We look forward to welcoming you back to BAAN FIVE Muay Thai Gym very soon! 👊🔥

Thank you for being part of our journey.

The BAAN FIVE Team

reviews.name: Nisha Uttam
reviews.text: Amazing class!  My 14 yr old daughter and I took a Mommy and me baking class at this school and loved it.  We each made our own fruit tart and macarons side by side.  The instructors were very friendly and accommodating and helped us through every step of the recipe.  We loved our creations and would highly recommend this school to others.  We will be back :)

reviews.name: SooYun Kim
reviews.text:
My two kids really enjoyed the baking, cooking, and slime-making activities.

It was unfortunate that they could only attend the camp for one day because we had to go back to our country, but we’re very grateful that they were able to experience it even for a day.

(The photos show the food that my kids made during the activities)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! We are happy to hear that the kids had a great time :) Look forward to welcoming you back next time!

reviews.name: Thanida Lueangpigultong
reviews.text:
A Little Something Cooking School has been such a special part of our journey. ❤️

My son started coming here before he was even 3 years old, long before he started school. Now he’s 6, and he still loves it just as much.

We don’t get to come as often as we used to because of his school schedule, but he still talks about the classes and always asks if we can come back whenever we have some free time.

Watching him grow up here has been so heartwarming. Thank you for creating a place where children can learn, explore, build confidence, and make such happy memories. We’re so grateful to have been part of this wonderful community over the years. ❤️

reviews.name: Lin
reviews.text: I think this is a great way to bond with your kids. I went with my 6yo and we chose to bake macarons and strawberry shortcake. Teacher Ning was very friendly and patient. The macaron and shortcake turned out wonderful and were both delicious! I would return again for sure.

reviews.name: Ellina Love
reviews.text: Loved our private cooking class with the little one! All the girls working at this amazing cooking school are sweet, fun and very helpful. It’s a perfect place for some new experience for a family bond or for your child connecting with other children while cooking in the group cooking class. The cooking school got several studio rooms with full set up for a comfy cooking time. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Grandpa HC
reviews.text: Nice and accommodating.  They have a rotating menu.  It looked like the kids in the teen class did the same thing but with a fancier twist.  There were only 3 teen kids yet they were given two rooms to do their class.  There were 8 younger kids, and they were all placed in a single room.  I think they combined the kinder and junior classes because there were 3 year olds in my kid’s junior class (I asked the parent how old their kids were).  My kid was a month away from being 9 years old, but actually taller than any of the teens in the older class.  Yet she was placed with the younger kids and of course she didn’t like it.  I think it’s because of that.  I think if she could go to the older class she would’ve liked it more though.

reviews.name: Sarina

title: Iron Hive Gym
ownerDescription: Iron Hive is a strength & performance training facility with a vision to provide you with the best training and fitness experience possible.
address: 1022 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Nora Vale
reviews.text:
I recently tried a class at Iron Hive while visiting the area. Booking was a bit confusing- the website didn’t seem to work, so I had to arrange everything through Instagram.

At reception, the process felt quite strict. I wanted to try one class before deciding on a package, and while we eventually found a solution, the communication could have been more flexible and welcoming.

The class itself was 45 minutes and included a mix of running, rowing, ski machine, and basic strength exercises. A significant part of the session involved running laps around the gym. With the door open, the temperature changed a lot between inside (air-conditioned) and outside, which affected the overall comfort.

The facility is relatively small. Some of the equipment appears worn, and overall cleanliness could be improved. The changing area is very basic (open shelves), and there are no towels provided. Drinking water is not available unless purchased.

The price for a single class (800 THB) felt high compared to the overall experience and facilities.

That said, the coach was fine, and the workout itself may suit people who enjoy a simple, cardio-focused format.

For me personally, it didn’t match my expectations, so I won’t be returning.

reviews.name: G S
reviews.text:
‼️I’ve been to 104 countries and Iron Hive Gym is the worst gym I’ve ever been to‼️

Poor standards, messy and dirty, bad customer service, too hot and even dogs and small kids running around inside! And they charge 600 baht for drop in. It was so bad that I had to leave after 20 minutes.

The prices are insane. 3400 baht per month. That’s more than double the price of a normal gym in Europe and the US. And 3x - 5x the price of a normal gym in Thailand. Iron Hive Gym price themselves a high-end premium gym but the whole gym is a disaster and a complete rip off.

Save your valuable time and money and stay away from this horrible gym. There are many better options in town with normal and fair prices, and that are clean and tidy, have AC, no dogs and kids running around inside and friendly staff.

Don’t trust all their fake reviews. Read the bad reviews and stay away from this gym. Don’t waste your time and money there like I did.

reviews.name: Joel Armando
reviews.text:
Proper strength gym for serious lifters
Walked in wearing my SBD shirt and the staff immediately said "you're a powerlifter." I was travelling for work in Bangkok so only trained here once, but it looks like a great community.
Three dedicated training zones: powerlifting, Olympic weightlifting, and HYROX.
Trained Friday 9pm and found three lifters on the Olympic platforms moving serious weight, plus a few others training solo. Small groups training together, very focused atmosphere.
Air-conditioned throughout. Adequate changing rooms and showers.
ClassPass accepted at 3 credits which is exceptional value.
Best for: Powerlifting, Olympic weightlifting, serious strength training

reviews.name: BangkokBoy2001
reviews.text: I’ve come here a number of times for strength and conditioning classes. The instructors — especially Porpor — are solid. I feel the gym is really loud compared to other gyms in Bangkok, and the facilities feel worn out. I’ll still happily continue to take classes here, but. with a refresh, this would be a top gym for me.

reviews.name: Philipp Kühn
reviews.text:
Booked an Open Gym slot through ClassPass with my girlfriend — the whole experience was chaotic.
The Open Gym ran at the same time as two other classes (Olympic Weightlifting/Powerlifting and HYROX), 6–8 PM, in a tiny shared space. To their credit, the reception staff and the HYROX coach were great — friendly, communicative, and they made the best of a messy setup, even letting us move a rowing machine, ski erg, and wall balls into the Open Gym area.

Then at 7 PM a new trainer, Coach Petch, took over — and the whole atmosphere changed. He cleared our equipment away without saying a word, laid barbells down right where we were training, and just took whatever space he needed, always exactly where we were. The last straw: my girlfriend was set up for her final wall ball set in the spot we’d been told to use, when a barbell got loaded onto the rack right behind her, leaving no room. I had to lift it back out so she could finish her set. Then he came over and said they needed the bench now — so I put the barbell down to the ground, dropped our ball, and we left.

Bottom line: the real problem is management — you shouldn’t offer a bookable Open Gym while that many classes run at once; there’s no space and it’s a mess from the start. The reception staff and HYROX coach handled it well. But Coach Petch showed zero customer awareness — he just prioritized his class and pushed us out instead of even asking how long we needed to finish. Not acceptable customer service. We will never return to that place again, thanks to Coach Petch 🙏

reviews.name: Damien
reviews.text:
What a wonderful experience! We were picked up at our hotel and taken to a local market, where our instructor, Balloon, let us choose what we wanted to cook. We had 15 minutes of free time at the market, which was great — we even bought some spices.

After that, we headed to the cooking school. Our group had 10 people, and the whole experience was amazing. Balloon helped us a lot with the equipment and gave great advice. Everything was so delicious. We each cooked a soup and two dishes, and then we made mango sticky rice together for dessert.

reviews.name: Shahla Barrett
reviews.text: Such an amazing experience! Som was an incredible guide and instructor for the day and had most amazing energy. You can really tell she loves her job! She taught us all about local produce at the market and then took us through how to cook each dish step by step.  You got to pick which dishes you wanted to make, and they adapted everything for me to be vegan really easily! The whole day was super well organised and the cooking school grounds itself were stunning! Really enjoyed just wandering around the gardens. 10/10 would highly reccomend.  Thanks so much for a great day Som!

reviews.name: Liz Mensah
reviews.text:
I had a great experience at the Zabb E Lee Cooking school. The venue is stunning and the vibe is nature with a slight edge of modern cool.

Our instructor Bo had a great sense of humour and explained the ingredients we were using clearly.  She was great at supporting us whilst cooking and her adeptness at ensuring we all cooked our individual dishes perfectly was masterful. The pace is quick but not so much that you can't follow. I was solo and chose something that others didn't want to cook and this wasn't a problem at all. Lots of the food is prepped before hand so if you want to cut and prepare every single ingredient then this may not be the course for you. However, for a crash course in Thai cooking, this is perfect. Every dish came out so well. Definitely come hungry because there is a lot of food. I took some back to the hotel with me because I was beyond stuffed. I would definitely recommend this for anyone to do.

reviews.name: Ella Martin
reviews.text: We had Cho as our Chef and she was great! She spoke English well and was fun and kind. The venue is beautiful and the food was delicious! We had a great time learning how to cook the dishes. We left stuffed, but you can also take home the food you make if you don’t want to eat it right then. We did the AM class, it worked great and was not too hot in August!

reviews.name: Emma Beard
reviews.text:
One of the best experiences we did whilst in Thailand. Amy was our instructor and was fantastic. Explained the process, the dish, and ingredients in such details. Tailored the class and the music to the group which made the experience.

Food was amazing, high quality ingredients, and very tasty. Beautiful grounds to walk around during the breaks, and if you do the later session catch amazing sunsets.

Thank you Amy and Zabb E Lee cooking school!

reviews.name: Ali Soper
reviews.text: Bo was a great instructor and we had an awesome time with our group! The cooking school is beautiful and well organized. It was easy to follow and so delicious, definitely a must-try experience when in Chiang Mai. I can’t wait to try the recipes again at home!

reviews.name: Mariah Hansen
reviews.text: This class was a great experience. We had so much fun learning to make classic Thai dishes and everything we prepared was delicious. Our instructor was Luna, and she was phenomenal. I was amazed by how engaging she was. On top of leading us through the preparation and cooking of each dish, she DJ’d so we had great music, entertained us with stories and jokes, and managed to take amazing photos that she sent to us after the course. I cannot wait to go back home and cook these meals for friends!

reviews.name: Victoria Clarke
reviews.text: This is an absolutely amazing experience I would definitely recommend!! We were in Irene’s group and she was so fun and knowledgeable of all the dishes. We were picked up from and returned to our hostel by mini van, had a tour of the markets to see which ingredients we needed and guided through making 5 delicious thai dishes. It was in such a gorgeous location and definitely brilliant value for money!

reviews.name: Klaudia Strzelec
reviews.text:
had a great time at Zabi Li Cooking School in Chiang Mai. The class was relaxed, fun, and very well organized. Everything was explained clearly and the food we cooked was absolutely delicious.

The best part of the experience was the instructor Patty. She was kind, patient, and made the whole class feel easy and enjoyable. You can really tell she loves what she does, and she made everyone feel comfortable, even if it was their first time cooking Thai food.

I would definitely recommend this cooking school to anyone visiting Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Bettie Annable
reviews.text: Wow!!! I want to first applaud our teacher, AMY. She made the entire experience absolutely unforgettable with such enthusiasm and passion!! The steps were super easy to follow and the structure of the class was very simple and convenient. The atmosphere is unbeatable and so was the food !!! The learning experience regarding what types of ingredients and where to get them was very pleasant. The cooking experience itself was phenomenal and AMY was helpful every step of the way with kindness, humor and clear knowledge beyondy expectations!!! 11/10 !!! It was a blast!!!

reviews.name: Nicola Jordaan
reviews.text: Loved loved loved this experience. We got to make 5 dishes and I went with my parents so they picked 5 different ones to me which allowed us to taste different dishes. Our cooking master Bo was funny and showed us step by step how to do it. She took it slow that we didn’t miss anything. The day didn’t feel rushed and we were finished by 14:00 with a start at 8:40 walking through the morning markets. The property you go to do the cooking is breathtaking. It is only 1200 baht with a well organised company. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Tierney D
reviews.text:
I had such an amazing day at Zabb E Lee Cooking School! The whole experience was fun, welcoming, and incredibly well organised from start to finish.

A special shoutout to Orange, who led our group. She was absolutely lovely, hilarious, and made the entire class so interactive and engaging. Her energy was infectious, and she created such a fun atmosphere for everyone. She also had the best music playing throughout the class, which made the experience even more enjoyable!

Not only did we learn how to make some delicious dishes, but we also had so many laughs along the way. I would highly recommend Zabb E Lee to anyone visiting Thailand or anyone looking for a memorable cooking experience. Thank you, Orange, for making it such a fantastic day!

reviews.name: Or Barak
reviews.text: Hands down the best experience we had in Chiang Mai. We had an amazing time with Nana our instructor. Everything was so smooth from the pickup to the market tour and the cooking itself. Nana explained everything from beginning to end with great sense of humor and was very helpful. We cooked so much and learned a lot. Everything was very fresh and super tasty. If you are looking for more special way to eat your lunch or dinner this is for you. It was the best cooking class we ever took and our favorite part in our trip to Ching Mai. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Tenzin Yakra
reviews.text:
Amy’s cooking class was much fun! 🥘✨ Amy is lively, funny, and made the whole experience feel so relaxed and enjoyable. Everything we cooked was absolutely delicious, and the space itself is sooo beautiful.

The food was the very best, the music even better. Such a fun atmosphere from start to finish. I would 100% recommend taking Amy’s class if you’re in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Maria Rogers
reviews.text:
A MUST DO!! This was such a fun and delicious experience. Cho made our class so easy and fun, from the beginning to the end.  I was so surprised and at how easy she made it for us to learn and cook these dishes. She taught us all so well!! The music, the vibes and the dishes were all amazing.

If you have the time while visiting Chiang Mai, please fit this into your schedule!

reviews.name: Simone Fernandes
reviews.text:
This was the most incredible cooking class I have been too. We had Alice as our chef/guide who was beyond fantastic. They picked us up from our hotel (plus a small group of others) and then we started off with a market tour where Alice explained a lot about specific ingredients and we go to roam around and explore for a bit.

We then went to the cooking class location which was extremely gorgeous and felt like such a calming environment.

The cooking experience was fantastic. Alice was supper helpful the whole time, someone across everyone and making sure we were all going okay as we cooked. There were some fun songs playing in the background that brought the energy. In between cooking each dish we got to sit down and enjoy with the group.

The dishes I made were: spring rolls, pad thai, panang curry, tom yum soup and mango sticky rice. I’m not a great cook myself but can say they came out AMAZING. Also had extra food left over which I got to take home and enjoy the next day!!

100000/10 would recommend!!

reviews.name: Erin Kelly
reviews.text: Amazing first night in Chiang Mai with Bo! She was absolutely excellent from start to finish. We got picked up on time from our hotel and taken to a local market which was a really unusual experience and learned lots about the different ingredients. We then headed over to the cooking school which is stunning and Bo went through each dish step by step with us to make it really easy to follow. She was very helpful and all of the dishes were extremely tasty. It was also made fun by having music on. I would highly recommend this to anyone!

reviews.name: Tamara Drabløs
reviews.text:
Did an evening cooking class here with Luna and it was such an amazing experience! The classes are relatively small, around 12 people total, and you choose the meals you want from a menu and prepare them in groups. The instructions are simple and easy to follow, so honestly anyone could join in. They also play upbeat music throughout, which made the whole experience feel way more immersive and fun.

So happy I got Luna as our guiding chef, she was warm and bubbly and made everyone feel at ease the entire time. Would highly recommend visiting this place, it went above and beyond my expectations! ❤️😊

reviews.name: ana luísa brito
reviews.text: We took the Thai Cooking Class and absolutely loved it! It was such a fun experience, and we managed to make really delicious dishes. M was the best guide we could have asked for—super attentive, funny, and with an amazing vibe. We definitely enjoyed it even more thanks to the great way she led the class. So grateful for this experience!! #🔥⚽️

reviews.name: Hafsa ereg
reviews.text:
Amazing experience! My friend group and I LOOOVEEEEED it. Our cooking teacher Pim was fantastic!! She was friendly, knowledgeable, and incredibly engaging. She explained everything so clearly, made sure no one was left behind, and created such a fun and relaxed atmosphere. Her enthusiasm was contagious, and she made the entire experience feel special. We couldn’t have asked for a better teacher!

Every part of the experience  was incredible , from the delicious food to the cooking to the beautiful surrounding! We ended up taking so many photos because the place was absolutely stunning. I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting!

reviews.name: Annamaria Maruotti
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful half-day cooking class in Chiang Mai and absolutely loved the experience. The setting is beautiful and welcoming, and we had such a pleasant and interesting time learning how to prepare some delicious local dishes.
A special thank you to Bo, our lovely cooking teacher, who was friendly, patient and made the whole experience fun and enjoyable. It was a great way to discover Thai cuisine and spend a memorable half-day immersed in the local culture.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Joey Gean
reviews.text: Don’t know what to make of this place. The price is great for 250baht all day use. Even greater value if you book a one week or one month deal as stated on the website. However, it looks nothing like the pictures here on google. As I arrived at the counter, paid for a day’s fee though i only need it for a couple of hours, I looked around and asked if the section/room on the ground floor with the sign ‘co working space’ is where i go. But the staff pointed to the glassed room on the first floor which is way less spacious. So i proceeded to that room with 2 rectangular table and probably about 10 chairs around them and a wall mounted TV. However the front of the room says ‘theatre room’. Which i assume was originally a movie room for the hotel guest? I wasn’t told what other facilities comes with the co working space price. I had to find out where the toilet is, where to get water (all that on the ground floor), and there was no free flow of coffee as stated on website (i’ve crossed checked with the counter. i was asked to go to 7-11 next door). As i came at about 5:30 and stayed till 9, the bar downstairs started to come alive. The music was loud enough to make it feel like you’re working in the cafe, which is nice for doing work alone. But if you are having team meetings or meetings with clients, it’s a bit distracting. I was on zoom calls and could hear chatters from below me and music pumping away, though on the other end of my call couldn’t hear it with a bit of noise suppression. The internet was ok, 50mbps

reviews.name: Diana Sharonova
reviews.text:
This salon is my absolute favorite for Thai massage in Phuket. After trying over ten others locally over the past two years, I consistently return here for the quality.

The team of therapists is outstanding. For anyone needing intense pressure, my top recommendations are Bee or Tang —just ask for a deep tissue session. They are masters at targeting deep muscle tension.

Our entire family are regulars, including our children. The kids love their choice of a gentle oil or foot massage and the staff is wonderful with them.

If you prefer a relaxing or medium-pressure experience, you will adore their oil treatment. It's perfectly balanced for soothing relief.

The place is impeccably clean, fresh, and tidy. Their customer service is exceptional, with staff checking on your comfort both during and after the session. A complimentary tea at the end is a lovely final touch.

I give this place my highest recommendation. It’s a flawless 10/10 experience

reviews.name: Natthakant Bergdahl
reviews.text:
I used to consider this one of the best massage shops in the area. The therapists were skilled, and the staff always paid close attention to customers, making every visit a pleasant experience.

Unfortunately, my recent experiences have been very different. The overall service quality has noticeably declined compared to what it used to be. During my latest visit, the massage session ended more than 15 minutes earlier than the time I had paid for.

I raised the issue with the staff, but there was no meaningful response or effort to address the situation. What disappointed me most was not only the shortened session, but also the lack of concern shown afterward.

It’s unfortunate because this used to be a place I genuinely enjoyed and recommended to others. I hope management takes customer feedback seriously and works to improve the service standard.

reviews.text:
A Lifesaver for Sleepless Nights - Highly Recommended!
I stumbled upon CHADA Thai Massage Phuket during a bout of insomnia, and I'm so glad I did! Their responsiveness on Line was impressive, and they quickly suggested the Deep Tissue Massage (600 baht for 1 hour). The service itself was absolutely perfect. One of the best massages I've had in Phuket.
After the massage, I was treated to a lovely tea and snacks. What truly set this place apart, however, was the incredible kindness of the lady at the front desk (I'm not sure if she's the owner or receptionist). Hearing about my sleep troubles, she generously gave me a complimentary lavender spray to help me sleep. That level of thoughtfulness and generosity is rare and so appreciated!
I've already recommended CHADA Thai Massage Phuket to my friends, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for an exceptional massage experience in Phuket. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.name: Jing Yuan
reviews.text:
The first visit was good, I did thai massage, enough pressure points and masseur knows exactly where to press on to unknot. I was worried because i had read many reviews from other massage places where the pressure is weak. It was a pleasant surprise and we decide to comeback the next day.

However the next day i went back for a neck shoulder and back massage ended up me being lathered in oil and unsatisfied with the pressure. In fact i told the masseur twice to press harder because the pressure was not enough to release the knots. Not sure why also i got a leg massage instead of focusing on the back and shoulder. i do wanna give credit to the masseur who tried her best... So the experience is very dependent on the masseur skills and ability to know where to put pressure on.

title: GAB Gymnastics Academy of Bangkok
ownerDescription: GAB is the leading gymnastics ground in the heart of Bangkok, built for competitive gymnastics training all the way to beginner classes, kids gym and mom + tot programs. GAB works with some of Thailand's best coaches (former Thai National Team coaches & gymnasts) and is dedicate to crafting more great gymnasts for Thailand to compete on international level – while at the same time GAB makes fun and recreational gymnastics accessible for all those who always wanted to join gymnastics, but had no place to train. GAB is more than a gym – it's a community of gymnastics enthusiasts, friends and families.
address: 120 Sukhumvit 26 Alley Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110 Located in: Rockademy, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
street: 120 Sukhumvit 26 Alley Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110 Located in: Rockademy

reviews.name: Coach Han
reviews.text: My daughter had a 1-to-1 session with Coach Mew and it was an awesome experience and fulfilling session. It was a 3-hour class and she learned a lot. Will come back again.

reviews.name: Isra Sunthornvut
reviews.text:
Gab Gymnastics Academy of Bangkok provides a world-class experience, combining top-notch international standards with a nurturing touch. The coaches are encouraging and skilled, creating a safe space where children can build resilience and confidence, all while making great friends along the way. It’s a premier facility that gives parents total peace of mind.

Highly highly recommended, khrup.

reviews.name: patt tan
reviews.text: Good atmosphere!  Teachers are professional . My kid love to go to class every week and very enjoy after class.  Place is clean and easy to park.

reviews.name: Caifeng Chen
reviews.text: Our kid takes a gymnastics class at GAB as an after-school hobby. All the coaches are extremely kind, patient and professional. The training environment is clean, tidy and well-equipped. While attending classes here, our child has built up physical strength, greatly improved body coordination and balance, and always leaves class full of joy and excitement. We are really satisfied with the experience here.

reviews.name: Prangya Paramita Gupta Sarkar
reviews.text: When I first noticed my daughter’s super energy and a knack for jumps and vaults I was looking for a gymnastics school whom I could trust my daughter with. And I can say with 100% confidence that GAB is and was the right place. I loved all about GAB - their coaches, infrastructure, training methods and friendly ambience. My daughter always enjoyed and looked forward to the classes. If you are looking for a gymnastics school where your child will be trained with immense love and care GAB is the right place.

reviews.name: Pimchan Charoenyingwattana
reviews.text: We always have a wonderful time at GAB during Toddler and Mum class. It helps build strength, skill, focus and confidence for our girl while she has lots of fun. The coach team is friendly, yet professional. The place and equipment are great, clean and well designed. My daughter loves the zip line and foam pit. It’s the brilliant way to help release her energy and build self confidence. It’s more than just a gymnastics class but a good foundation for future sport.

reviews.name: Anna King
reviews.text: We have been coming to GAB for almost 2 years now. It’s a very professional and organised environment. Whenever newcomers to Bangkok see recommendations for gymnastics, GAB usually comes up. The flexibility of the classes is also super convenient.

reviews.name: Briana Price
reviews.text: My five year old always loves her classes at GAB! She has gained so much strength and fundamental gymnastics skills in a fun and engaging way, and truly enjoys coming every week!

reviews.name: Mark S
reviews.text: You really have your child  try out to see what makes them apart from other gyms. Usually quite popular and crowded except during school holidays. Air-conditioned. Great coaches. You can watch your kids on a tv monitor. Whether it's for recreational exercise or competition. 2 hours free parking. Hi speed wifi. Only minor issue is the area where parents sit has really uncomfortable steep benches and there is only one unisex restroom. You will also have to pay a yearly membership fee that must be active during your courses. Daily courses are usually 1.5 to 2 hours long

reviews.name: Ella Rose
reviews.text: GAB is top notch!  Everything we had hoped for, for our daughter.  Their level of professionalism, care, coaching skills, and guidance for true advancement, along with the nurture to grow confidence is the best!  Look no further!

reviews.name: Kati
reviews.text:
A professional gymnastics academy in the heart of Bangkok. Founded by a gymnast’s mom who truly understands what both kids and parents need.
GAB offers more than just fun activities — it’s a real gymnastics academy with proper structure, experienced coaches, and a focus on foundational skills. You can see how the kids grow in confidence, discipline, and strength over time. The atmosphere is warm and encouraging, making it a place where kids genuinely look forward to their classes. Whether you're looking for recreational fun or a more serious path in gymnastics, this place has the heart and  the expertise.

reviews.name: D David
reviews.text: Nice teachers! It is a good place for kids. Exercise more, more healthier and happier. My daughter love it a lot.

reviews.name: Simi Singhsachthep
reviews.text: My girls have just started gymnastics at GAB and we absolutely love it! The classes have built their confidence, focus, flexibility and balance. They very much look forward to their weekly GAB sessions!

reviews.name: Bakedinsyd
reviews.text:
Great experience with GAB. My daughter had so much fun flipping at the school. The timing and schedule is very flexible which works great for us. My daughter has gain so much core strength from attending classes there.
Recommended!

reviews.name: Sarocha Barkan
reviews.text: My daughter just turned 4 and has been attending a few gymnastics classes now — she absolutely loves it! The teacher is so lovely, patient, and great with the kids, which really makes a difference. My daughter always looks forward to coming to class each week. It’s wonderful to see her gaining confidence, learning new skills, and having so much fun at the same time. Highly recommend this class for little ones!

reviews.name: Catarina Callison
reviews.text:
The best Gymnastics facility in Thailand! If you are looking for a fun way to exercise please visit this gym. Whether you are a beginner or an ex gymnast, GAB has amazing and professional coaches to help you advance your skills.

As a former gymnastics athlete, I am extremely grateful that this gym offers adult classes. I truly appreciate the coaches approach to making the class fun while providing encouragement to push for new skills. Their instruction on how to better your form will help any athlete level up. A big thank you to the entire staff for being a highlight of my travels!

reviews.name: Natthaya MOT
reviews.text: Very nice good price clean place my kid enjoy a lot

reviews.name: Cindy t
reviews.text:
LOVE GAB!!! all the staff are super nice and all the coaches are amazing!!! For some perspective, I started at 30 with them, with no prior gymnastics experience as a kid and now i can do a backflip 🙂 (shout out to Coach Rung!)

During my classes, there are sometimes camps for the kids, and I am always so impressed by their performance. They learn so much, but also have fun at the same time! If I had kids, I would send them there too!

reviews.name: Apinut Palarit
reviews.text: Great gym with professional coaches and a friendly atmosphere. My child loves the classes, and I can see real progress in her skills and confidence. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Diana Madan
reviews.text: My daughter has been coming here since she was 5 years old. The coaches are incredibly professional, and they always make the training sessions fun and engaging. She absolutely loves it!

title: JustCo – Silom Edge | Coworking & Office Space
ownerDescription:
JustCo at Silom Edge, Bangkok is a modern coworking space and serviced office provider in the heart of Bangrak CBD. With direct access to Silom MRT and Sala Daeng BTS stations, it is well located within Bangkok’s financial district, surrounded by dining, retail, attractions, and entertainment options. Occupying four floors, the space overlooks Lumpini Park and offers breakout areas, collaboration zones, hot desks, booth seating, and cosy nooks for focused work and conversations.

For on-demand access, download the JustCo App to find, book, and unlock coworking spaces, hot desks, and meeting rooms across Asia. No membership needed.
address: Edge, No. 2 Silom Road, 10th -14th Floor, Si Lom Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
street: Edge, No. 2 Silom Road, 10th -14th Floor, Si Lom Rd

ownerUpdates.text:
Unlock workspace on-demand. No Membership Required.

Now available across Bangkok.
