Reserve in minutes without long-term commitment.

1. Find: Browse live availability nearby.
2. Book: Reserve a desk or meeting room in minutes.
3. Unlock: Open the door with the App.

reviews.name: Alicia Wong
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to join an event today at Jusco Silom Edge, and I was truly impressed. The venue is modern, beautifully designed, which created a pleasant and welcoming atmosphere throughout the event. The staff are also very friendly and attentive. Everything was organized seamlessly, with all the necessary facilities and equipment provided to support both the event and the guests.  Overall, it was a wonderful event in an excellent venue, and I would be happy to come back again for future occasions. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review, Alicia! We’re pumped to hear that you’re enjoying our space. It’s incredibly rewarding for us to know that our efforts are making a positive impact and that we’re achieving our goal of being “The place that works for you.” Your feedback is invaluable and truly appreciated. We look forward to continuing to provide a space that supports your needs and hope to see you around again soon. Thanks once again for your support!

reviews.name: Ratikarn Yongtassanakul
reviews.text: A perfect co-working space with easy & save to access in Bangkok.  Perfect location at Silom road which is easy to walk to BTS sky train and MRT subway. Have food 24 hours at down stairs. A lot of delicious & nice restaurant. Friendly staff with a willing to help. Great working atmosphere. Plenty of plug for charge at a hot desk area. Have a nice canteen. It’s great to relax at the sofa in front of a park view after a long or tough meeting. Convenience to go down to jogging/running at Lumpini park either before or after work. Having a bathroom for cleaning yourself before working. A member can access 24 hours.

reviews.name: johannes oppewal (TravelTelly)
reviews.text: For day pass you first need to scan your face to enter the building to enter the 10th floor. If you like your privacy this co-working spot is not yours.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review Jonannes! We truly appreciate your feedback and understand that there was area where your experience could have been better. We are required to follow building regulations that all visitors must register before accessing the building to ensure safety and security. In addition, we provide alternative access methods for members (eg. QR code access, Kiosk) to make entry more convenient. If you need any further information or assistance, please don’t hesitate to let us know—we would be happy to contact you directly.

reviews.name: Hong Sin Kwek

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Pavel Popov! We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed your experience with us. We look forward to welcoming you again soon!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for 5 stars review K.Mam! We’re pumped to hear that you’re enjoying our space. Thanks once again for your support!

reviews.text:
700 bath for drop-in is way too high for what you get. The place is clean and the view is stunning but there is no real office chair and that makes the experience very different.
On top of it if you want an okay coffee you need to pay 40 bath in addition

reviews.text: Nice work place,good facilities,have safe with key card and face scan   and thank you for service from JustCo team Khun Ton Khun Yok and Khun Yui

reviews.name: Abder Dara
reviews.text: I had a mixed experience at this co-working space. On the plus side, the atmosphere is great for productivity, and the staff are exceptionally polite and helpful. However, I was disappointed with the limited air conditioning and lighting hours. The space doesn't offer air conditioning past regular working hours or on weekends, and most lights are off on Saturday nights and weekends. As someone who works at different times, including weekends, this made my experience less comfortable and efficient. It would be great to see these facilities available for longer hours.

reviews.name: PomPam Vacharasinthu
reviews.text: Good service and the staff (Ms.Ploy ,Ms.Yok,Ms Taew) are friendly
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review K.Pompam! We’re pumped to hear that you’re enjoying our space and team. Thanks once again for your support!

reviews.name: George Penney
reviews.text:
Beautiful space, great location and a fun and social place. And the staff are lovely too.

Unfortunately the only co-working desk is in the common area that's shared with all the private office units. This means that dozens of people are constantly filtering through, having breakout meetings, chatting over lunch or having photo and video shoots. Personally I find it quite distracting and not viable as a co-working space, although others might enjoy the hustle and bustle.

Also if you want a flexible co-working contract JustCo is not for you. Membership is monthly with an extra month's deposit paid up-front. Terminating the contract must be done at least a month in advance. On top of this they don't switch on the AC on Thai public holidays, rendering the space unusable up to 19 working days per year.

reviews.name: lalalom official
reviews.text: Nice nice park view fromthe desk
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your 5-star review K.Lalalom! We are truly happy to hear that you enjoy our spaces. We look forward to welcoming you again soon!

reviews.name: Abdullah Feruhio
reviews.text: There are no comfortable adjustable office chairs with headrests here - at least not at the daily rate. The common room that I was shown is big in size, but there are not a lot of workplaces in it. The air in the room is moderately cold: it is difficult to find a place where the air conditioner will not blow on you. At some point, after several hours of work, I wanted to go outside to warm up. As a result: they charge 800 baht per day probably just because of the view from the window.

reviews.name: Seri Sirisayan

title: Silathong Muaythai Lifestyle
subTitle: Silathong Muaythai Lifestyle - ศิลาทองมวยไทย

reviews.name: Jason Chin
reviews.text: This gym is very conveniently located along Sukhumvit 77 (Soi On Nut), and was formerly the Power Boxing Gym. I have been training here regularly for the past year and a half. The trainer, Kru Silathong, is very experienced and has a variety of training techniques to adjust training tempo and showcase a variety of skills. Highly recommended. Given that the gym is located within a sports club with a public swimming pool, one can also go for a cool-down dip following training.

reviews.name: Te Harrington
reviews.text:
Great gym, coaches and staff! Located above the swimming pool.

Had a mixup with packages that was sorted promptly and professionally.

There isn’t a ring yet, but the personal attention  from coaches is plenty, even in group settings, fit for casual and more serious MT members.

Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Amanda B
reviews.text: After going to many muay thai gyms around my condo, I have finally settled on this one as the training is rigorous, with a variety of drills to hone fitness and fight IQ. The trainer is very experienced and includes fun ways to build stamina. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Jock Khan Goh (Simon)
reviews.text: Love this Muay Thai gym. Very good coach and every session very productive

reviews.name: Kristof
reviews.text: There are very good teachers there that corrected mine technique, watched me and patiently taught right movements. Very friendly staff. I definitly recommend this gym.

reviews.name: Kitti Kraisaengkulcha
reviews.text: ตอนนี้ เปลี่ยนเจ้าของใหม่ เปลี่ยนชื่อเป็น Power Boxing Gym คุณภาพดีกว่าเดิมมากๆ
reviews.textTranslated: It now has new ownership and a new name, Power Boxing Gym, and the quality is much better than before.

reviews.name: Jacques D
reviews.text:
Les entraîneurs sont tops, toujours avec le sourire et marrants.  Ils s’adaptent facilement aux débutants comme moi. La salle est bien équipée, grande plage horaire (des cours qui durent 1h30 à partir de 12:30 jusqu’à 21:30) et une grande piscine juste à côté (à payer séparément).

On s’entraîne depuis plus d’un mois avec mon amie et c’est vraiment génial, on s’amuse beaucoup tout en faisant du sport.

La salle est bien située (prendre songthaew 1-4-5-7 depuis sukhumvit 77 qui se trouve à 5 min à pieds d’On-Nut BTS)
reviews.textTranslated:
The trainers are great, always smiling and funny. They easily adapt to beginners like me. The gym is well-equipped, with long opening hours (classes last 1.5 hours from 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM) and a large swimming pool right next door (for a separate fee).

My friend and I have been training there for over a month now, and it's really great. We have a lot of fun while exercising.

The gym is well-located (take songthaew 1-4-5-7 from Sukhumvit 77, which is a 5-minute walk from On-Nut BTS).

reviews.text: สอนดี สนุก ได้เปิดประสบการณ์ใหม่ใหม่ค่ะ แถมราคาเป็นมิตรมาก ไอเลิฟสุดสุดไว้ใช้บริการใหม่ค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The teaching was great, fun, and provided new experiences. Plus, the price was very reasonable. I loved it and will definitely use their services again.

reviews.textTranslated: Great place to start Muay Thai boxing. The instructors are really friendly, and it's very affordable: 4000 baht for 10 lessons. I highly recommend it.

Even though there were two staffs working here but they didn’t even ask him to keep his voice down.

title: Ping Chiang Mai Thai Cookery School 平清迈烹饪学校
ownerDescription:
At Ping Chiang Mai Thai Cookery School, guests enjoy cooking in a pleasant and clean environment surrounded by Ping Farm Learning Center. The school is located in the countryside and farming areas, approximately a 30-minute drive from Chiang Mai downtown. You can also take a trip with train transportation. We will also make a stop at a local market on the way for a brief market tour.
During your time with us, you will learn how to prepare and cook Thai food on the farm with our friendly Thai cooking instructor team, following the recipes of a chef who is rich in experience. At Ping Chiang Mai Thai Cookery School, you will have the opportunity to see a wide variety of vegetables that we grow ourselves. Each guest will have their own coo
address: 374 Umong, Mueang Lamphun District, Lamphun 51150, Thailand
plusCode: J2FW+WF Umong, Mueang Lamphun District, Lamphun, Thailand

reviews.name: 廖崧淵
reviews.text: I had such a wonderful class with an energetic 21 years old teacher, Lily! The entire trip is full of talks and laughters, and the class is really informative. The dinner I learnt tasted AMAZING too!

reviews.name: Clare Coyle
reviews.text:
Just finished our cookery class and eaten our food! Thought I'd write about our experience.
We had an amazing time! This experience wasn't just about cooking. We went to a local produce market, and learned about Thai food and ingredients, how they differ from European.
Picked herbs and produce from their own garden, guaranteed fresh! Their uses explained so we knew why we were using them.
Our chef was knowledgeable and patient with us, very respectful.
Very professional.  A wonderful experience and highly recommend you try for yourself.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are delighted to have met you and even more so that you enjoy being with us, including our food. Thank you for the wonderful time we have had together.

reviewContext.Dietary restrictions: I have a shellfish allergy.  All necessary precautions were taken to ensure I was safe and substitute ingredients used in all the dishes.

reviews.name: siiriiphattt
reviews.text: Is have a good experience and a good food and you have so much like some hens it’s so cute. I love it.

reviews.name: Yen-Chen Chiang (江彥辰)
reviews.text: Very friendly staff in a lovely farm space.

reviews.name: KWY H
reviews.text: Nice cooking school!

reviewContext.Vegetarian options: every menu can cook for vegetarian

reviews.name: 羅雅眉
reviews.text: 我在這邊精進了我的廚藝，老師很有耐心，帶我們逛市場，介紹泰國的食材，這邊的食材都是老闆自種的，我覺得這次的經驗讓我感到非常滿足！
reviews.textTranslated: I honed my culinary skills here. The instructor was very patient, taking us to the market and introducing us to Thai ingredients. All the ingredients here are grown by the owners themselves. I feel very satisfied with this experience!

reviews.name: Ariel Chiu
reviews.text: 整個課程非常豐富，體驗從清邁搭火車、逛市場認識泰國特殊的食材，老師非常細心又有耐心帶領廚藝小白的我們一步一步完成料理，吃了自己煮的食物，還有芒果糯米飯當飯後甜點，讓女兒說直呼這個行程她最喜歡！謝謝老師的教導～
reviews.textTranslated: The entire course was incredibly enriching, taking us on a train journey through Chiang Mai, exploring markets, and learning about unique Thai ingredients. The instructor was incredibly attentive and patient, guiding us, cooking novices, step-by-step through the process. We enjoyed the food we cooked ourselves, and even had mango sticky rice for dessert! My daughter said it was her favorite part of the trip! Thank you so much for the instructor's guidance!

reviews.name: 陳美喬
reviews.text:
親切的老師、寬廣的農場、豐富的蔬菜、健康的雞群….
我們在這裡學習泰式料理並享受著自己學習的成品，真是快樂的一堂課
reviews.textTranslated: Friendly teachers, a spacious farm, abundant vegetables, healthy chickens… We learned Thai cooking here and enjoyed the results of our learning; it was truly a joyful lesson.

reviews.name: Yu-Hsuan Wang
reviews.text:
一直很猶豫不知道要參加雙K平台的哪一個烹飪課，結果在臉書社團偶然看到有人分享Pin Cooking School，可以體驗搭火車到南奔來上課瞬間吸引了我，整個過程都很舒服也很有趣（逛傳統市場、超市調味料介紹等），而上課環境非常貼近生活大自然，並非單純在建築物內，一月來時氣候十分涼爽舒適，就算煮飯過程中也都不熱，超棒超滿意👍🏻！

這次還體驗了自己做泰奶真的太好喝了🥰，絕對分享給朋友讓他們十一月天燈節來清邁時順道來體驗。
reviews.textTranslated:
I was hesitant about which cooking class on the Double K platform to join, but then I stumbled upon a post on a Facebook group about Pin Cooking School. The idea of ​​taking the train to Lamphun for the class immediately appealed to me. The whole experience was comfortable and fun (browsing traditional markets, supermarket seasoning introductions, etc.), and the classroom environment was very close to nature, not just confined to buildings. The weather was perfectly cool and comfortable when I visited in January, so even while cooking, it wasn't hot at all – super awesome and I was very satisfied! 👍🏻

I also tried making my own Thai milk tea – it was so delicious! 🥰 I'll definitely share it with my friends so they can try it when they come to Chiang Mai for the Lantern Festival in November.

reviews.name: 建麟葉
reviews.text: 初次在清邁學習做泰國菜，安排教學的年輕老師非常親切也非常熱情，教學的菜色都非常美味，整體而言非常棒。
reviews.textTranslated: It was my first time learning to cook Thai food in Chiang Mai. The young teacher who taught me was very kind and enthusiastic, and the dishes were all delicious. Overall, it was a great experience.

reviews.name: carcarfung
reviews.text: 第一次在清邁乘坐火車就是去上烹飪班😊老師親切又細心, 耐心教導,每人也可做出美味菜式.幸運遇上漂亮又和靄的同學, 開心過了一個愉快的一個上午☺️
reviews.textTranslated: My first train ride in Chiang Mai was to my cooking class 😊 The teacher was kind and attentive, patiently teaching us, and everyone was able to make delicious dishes. I was lucky to meet beautiful and friendly classmates, and had a wonderful morning ☺️

reviews.name: 楊子晴
reviews.text: 很美好的體驗！有坐火車體驗、市場清楚講解，做泰餐也很耐心指導～
reviews.textTranslated: It was a wonderful experience! There was a train ride, a clear explanation of the market, and they patiently guided us through making Thai food.

reviews.name: cenlin zhang
reviews.text: 很好，非常好，环境很好，小姐姐很有耐心，做饭很好吃，还坐了小火车，体验很棒
reviews.textTranslated: Excellent, very good. The environment was great, the staff was very patient, the food was delicious, and we even rode the little train. It was a fantastic experience.

reviews.name: mi-chi Tsai
reviews.text: 可以煮出符合自己口味的泰式料理，老師會說中文，過程很有趣，推薦大家來體驗
reviews.textTranslated: You can cook Thai dishes to your liking, the instructor speaks Chinese, and the process is very fun. I recommend everyone to try it.

reviews.name: jung su
reviews.text: 泰式料理教學 好玩 不會很難 又真的能學到東西  中文也可
reviews.textTranslated: Thai cooking tutorial: Fun, not too difficult, and you'll really learn something. Chinese is also available.

reviews.name: Jane
reviews.text: 非常有趣的體驗，而且老師很親切，會講中文，全程都會陪同，做出來的料理非常好吃
reviews.textTranslated: It was a very fun experience, and the teacher was very friendly, spoke Chinese, and accompanied us throughout the entire process. The food they made was delicious.

reviews.name: Ruru Chuang
reviews.text:
不僅是料理教室還能體驗泰國火車
全程安排順暢有趣 好吃又好玩非常推薦！
reviews.textTranslated: Not only is it a cooking class, but you can also experience a Thai train journey! The entire trip is smoothly planned and fun, delicious food and exciting activities – highly recommended!

reviews.name: 陳雯玲
reviews.text: 非常有趣的廚藝課程，協助人員十分友善，而且耐心回答我們所有的提問。還準備了幼兒的點心跟餐點！推薦來這裡！
reviews.textTranslated: A very fun cooking class! The staff were incredibly friendly and patiently answered all our questions. They even provided snacks and meals for children! Highly recommend this place!

title: Hom Cooking Hostel
subTitle: หอม คุกกิ้ง โฮสเทล
description: Bright dorms & rooms with free Thai breakfast, plus a cookery school & a rooftop garden.
address: 49 Nana Square 4th Floor, Sukhumvit 3,, klongtoei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
hotelDescription:
On a bustling downtown street, this relaxed hostel and cookery school is a 4-minute walk from Nana Skytrain station and 12 minutes on foot from Terminal 21, an airline-themed shopping mall. The Jim Thompson House museum is 3 km away.
 Airy dorms sleeping 4 to 10 people have bunk beds and shared bathrooms. Brightly colored private rooms with en suite bathrooms add flat-screen TVs and desks; some have sofas and garden views.
 Traditional Thai breakfast is included. An on-site cookery school offers free daily cookery demonstrations and classes (fee). There's also a rooftop garden, a coin-operated laundry and a communal kitchen.

similarHotelsNearby.name: Grand Inn Hotel
similarHotelsNearby.description: Modern downtown hotel with a cafe

reviews.name: Jareeyaphan Prasroethsuwan
reviews.text: First time joining a Thai cooking class, it was impressive. The place was clean and well prepared. Staffs were nice and helpful. Thai dishes tasted amazing. You will experience authentic Thai foods here;)

reviews.name: 584naomid
reviews.text: This hostel had amazing vibes all around. I thought it would be strange that it was in a mall, but turned out it didn’t matter and it was great to be so close to the Sky Train. The staff especially Pin was so friendly. My friend and I had an early checkout and they made sure to have breakfast out for us and even specially made sure it was vegan for us. I loved that they had free postcards and I bought a few stamps from their front desk and wrote to my family! The garden, kitchen, and hangout areas were all awesome. The room we had was extremely clean and the bed was quite cozy. I would 100% recommend this place!

reviews.name: smiley 93
reviews.text: I had so bad experience in this hostel, the worst experience in Bangkok ever. I'll not speak about my all bad experience in this hostel but I'll speak about last condition happened with me, I prepared my things to left the room and cleaning up the room before I leaved and suddenly Someone opened the door and she said you have to leave it's time to check out without knock the door and she said it with bad behaviour without any respect or professional way, we are not in animals zoo to open the door like that!!! She opened the door even before 12 o'clock and she said you have 15 minutes to leave with bad way,even I was naked in the room 😏 I find it really rude behaviour and not respect and not professional way specially from women in reception, she deal with me like I'm not welcoming and she all time speak with me with mad face, If you don't like Foreigners and tourists why you work in reception?! I stayed for 6 nights there and I paid it cash all and she come for me to tell me you have 15 minutes to leave?! I don't recommend anyone to stay here because  they Distinguish between guests. I'll never forget this bad experience.

reviews.name: Jean Lau-Lundquist
reviews.text: Stayed there from 20-23 Apr 2019. Excellent service. Comfy beds. Beautiful and clean. Yummy free breakfast. Fast wifi. Lovely garden. Lockers are a bit small but they were alright for my needs. The only thing I would change is how far the toilets are from the rooms. They are used by other people in Nana Square (not just hostel guests) also so, in that respect, your experience will not be very private. I got a lot of alone time in the toilets during earlier/later hours though so it's not that bad.

reviews.name: Lydia Creevy
reviews.text: I slept her for a day. It’s a lovely guesthouse with both dormitories and rooms. The reception lady was lovely and very helpful. Prices are fair and the place is clean. I stayed in the e bedroom and got to saw the fresh food growing out back. At night you have to take the basement parking lot by Burger king to get to the top floorboard

reviews.name: 8fivetwo
reviews.text: Located a short walk from Nana Station - Hom's location is very convenient for accessing local transport and exploring the city. There's lots of nightlife, restaurants (including numerous 24-hour ones) and shopping close by.||There's a big fully equipped kitchen to cook in with various free snacks, a massive herb garden balcony and the common area features a record player with a range of vinyl to enjoy. ||The dorms are big clean and comfortable with good aircon and have their own showers (water pressure is pretty good) and lockers. The toilets are shared with the shopping mall but are regularly cleaned.||The free breakfast offers a filling start to the day.||Wifi is solid. Towels for rent||Hom also offers Thai cooking classes.||I stayed there for 2 nights. The environment is relaxed, the staff helpful and friendly. ||Is Hom worth paying double the price - as of August 2019, many hostels along Sukhumvit offer clean dorm rooms at 250Baht or lower - that's a difficult question to answer...

reviews.name: Just 4 World (Just4Fun)
reviews.text: Lovely guesthouse with both dormitories and private rooms. Staff was lovely and very helpful. Prices are fair and the place clean. Special hands up for the rooftop terrace. Ideally located on Sukhumvit Soi 3. Entrance by Nana Mall 4th floor and by B2 basement next to Burger King after 9.30pm.

reviews.name: Kelli Kappler
reviews.text: There are a few key things to look for while booking a hostel in Bangkok. AC, cleanliness, comfortable beds, good security, and an individual outlet socket for your bed. Hom Cooking Hostel has all of those! I spent my first few nights in Bangkok near Khao San and wanted to check out another part of the city. There's plenty of neat shops and bars nearby, so the location is still good. It's on the subway line and a close walk to the ferry port if you wanted to head towards the center. The staff member I engaged with spoke little English but was extremely friendly and helpful. The only odd part is that it's in a shopping center, so the bathrooms don't seem to be part of the hostel themselves (though the room did have its own shower). But that also means food and any little gadget you need is at your fingertips, so I think it's a trade off worth having. The rooms are also incredibly spacious, as in you can sit straight up in the bottom bunk and still have a foot or two between you and the top bed! For the price and quality I definitely recommend this place.

reviews.name: Abby Fico Nambiar
reviews.text: I’ve stayed here so many times here and there over the last 7 years and the quality is always excellent.  The hostel is quite peaceful and clean. Great location, amazing staff especially J at the front desk

reviews.name: Robin Lenogue
reviews.text: Hom Cooking hostel is simply awesome. I'm glad that they now added a suggestion box and that they plan on making efforts with food waste, composting and recycling. Staff is honest and straightforward but also very sweet and helpful, and the location of the hostel inside a mall makes it very convenient for food or other daily needs. Bathrooms are NOT unisex, and not necessarily close to the dorms, but cleaned fairly often by the Mall maintenance staff. I highly recommend Him Hostel!!

reviews.name: derbyt2018
reviews.text: Hom is simply the best and most unique hostel in Bangkok!! We spent a week staying at Hom, the place has a very different concept and a nice atmosphere! Every day they have cooking class in which we can participate and learn about the Thai cuisine and in the end still taste the dish. Rachel and Meigh present the class and are wonderful girls! It is an incredible way to unite the guests. The exterior area has a huge garden and even a pool to take a sunbath and cool down, especially if you are traveling with children, there are many games for the littles... It is relaxing and funny, Hom surprised us and we already know where to stay when back to Bangkok! :D

reviews.name: Michael Wood
reviews.text: This place is awesome! HIGHLY recommend. I originally planned to stay only 2 nights but have extended m stay because of how great this place is. The common room is immaculate. The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. Cooking lessons daily, breakfast every morning, and a rooftop garden. Couldn’t get a better bang for your buck!

reviews.name: Tawney Craig
reviews.text: I cannot praise this place highly enough. It was clean, safe, beautifully decorated, the staff was wonderful and the breakfasts in the mornings are out of this world! Grab your breakfast and coffee and head out onto the patio for a great way to start the day. The beds are huge and comfy and the en suite shower was small but very clean and adequate! The toilets are not en suite which is fine and not too bothersome (just dont drink too much water before bed). The location is great, walking distance to terminal 21,the train station is near by and many taxis in the area to take you anywhere in Bangkok that you wish to go! I would recommend this place to anyone. Great for solo travelers, couples, and even whole families.

reviews.name: MarkoN484
reviews.text: Hom hostel is exceptional in many ways: in contrast to most of the hostels it is located on top of a shopping centre and has an amazing view on Bangkok (the terasse looks cosier than the Marriott over the street), it is very clean and the beds are great. |But what really makes the difference are the people working in the hostel always smiling and happy to help. Hom's concept is to bring together people who share the same passion for cooking that you can share with others by using the kitchen yourself, or you just participate in the cooking class in the evening. Therefore it is not a party hostel, but a bostel where you feel being home.|I am glad that I have discovered this place and I am already looking forward to returning here soon.

reviews.name: daniyal ali
reviews.text: Hom Hostel was an epic experience for us during our stay in Bangkok. Located right across Nana Plaza, the hostel was very cosy and comfortable. The staff was super accommodating and helpful. It has great views and a very lovely outdoor roof where you can sit and chill. The rooms are very clean and cosy and the washrooms are also very appropriate. Definitely staying again on my next trip. Near BTS stations, Nana and Phloen Chit.

reviews.name: Gabriela
reviews.text: The hostel is on the top floor of a mall, it has an incredible common area and common kitchen. The owner is lovely and the atmospher is super chilled. It's a few minutes walk to the sky train, close to many restaurants and shops. I'd say the neighborhood is not my favorite, but the hostel itself is really good!

reviews.name: ktcarrot
reviews.text: The bunk beds in the dorm room are comfy and super sturdy so you don't feel the person on the lower bunk. Two showers and sinks and lockers are located inside the room, which was very convenient. Remember to bring your own lock if you want to lock a locker! The plants on the roof are all much bigger now than in the pictures on Trip Advisor, and I loved relaxing here after my long days. Location: Friends who stayed in Khao San said that many scammers approached them as they walked around their hostel, but here in Sukhumvit I didn't experience anything like that, no one really seemed to care that I was a lone foreigner. You can't beat how close it is to the Nana BTS station! Can't wait to come back :)

reviews.name: Mei Shan Wu
reviews.text: Perfect location. its convenient and comfortable to stay. staff are very friendly and helpful. I do like their self laundry service, only drawback is the bathroom drainage is too slow. overall, good hostel good price .👍

reviews.name: Daniel Gush
reviews.text:
Had a great time staying here that we came back at the end of our time in Thailand. The hosts organised local food to be cooked and shared with guests every evening and we could help cook and eat the food.

The rooms were large and had 10beds to the dorm with to showers in the room. The living/dining room was a large shared space with a huge communal kitchen where a great English and Thai breakfast are served

The rooftop garden was beautiful, right above the Nana Mall great place to have breakfast or an evening drink when is a bit cooler.

Would recommend and stay there again next time we visit BKK

reviews.name: Shishir Jairam
reviews.text:
I must say I am really upset with this hostel!
1. There are two female care takers If I am right and it is really sad that they treat their guests as third rated People!Very rude!  I was questioned twice as to who I was, So there is no communication between the two ladies in the front Desk! So its me with a valid booking being treated as an Outsider!
2. I had to check out at 4 am in the morning(My flight was at 7 am)! So when I asked where should I drop/give back the access cards at that unearthly time she simply told me to check out in the night! When I told her I had a booking for the next day too and check out time is 12 pm she started shouting at me saying we cannot Refund! I clearly told her that I do not want a refund and I just want to drop/give back the access cards and I am clueless regarding this!
3. If you are a vegetarian then you must tell it to them 24 hours before! This information was only TOLD ( no info anywhere) I asked her I could not see vegetarian options laid on the table!
4. This hostel is in the center of the city! But its right on the top floor of a plaza! So the whole floor be it Hostel or the surrounding Vendors/Shops use the Toilets! There are no own toilets for Hostel guests!
5.  AC's are a mess too! It's either super hot or super cold no temperature regulators! And one of the bunk lights wasn't working!
6. It is situated in an excellent location! Bustling Sukhumvit Street, bustling night life around but if you happen to come late night you should face the ordeal of walking to the basement ( Car Park ) and then take an elevator from the car park! This info too isn't given!
Overall it was a poor experience in this hostel for me though Bangkok city made up for this bad experience!

title: Eden The Ultimate Spa and Massage Experience (Sukhumvit11 , Nana)
ownerDescription:
Eden The Ultimate Spa and Massage Experience located Sukhumvit soi 11, is a luxury spa in the heart of Bangkok. We strive to provide you with the atmosphere and ambience to resemble that of “The Garden of Eden” with complete services with massage therapies and luxurious spa facilities to provide an escape from the chaos that is the fun-filled energetic city of Bangkok with several special treatment options to present you with the ultimate relaxation.
We are located about 900 meters from the entrance of Sukhumvit soi 11 just 5 minutes from the Nana BTS station and we offer pick-up and drop-off from Nana and Asoke BTS stations with prior reservations.
address: 43 15 Sukhumvit 11 Aly, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Thipsukhon Yat
reviews.text: Wonderful spa experience. The staff were professional and friendly. The massage was deeply relaxing with perfect pressure. I also loved the complimentary tea and snacks after the massage. I left feeling refreshed and recharged. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely come back. 😊✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your fantastic review! We look forward to serving you again in the future.

reviews.name: Mariam Dashti
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved this place! The massage was amazing, and the whole place was spotless and so relaxing. It was exactly the kind of massage my body needed.

After the session, they took us to a cozy corner with complimentary snacks, tea, and coffee, which was such a nice touch.

I highly recommend this place. Great experience, excellent service, and the prices are very reasonable. I’ll definitely be coming back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share such a thoughtful review! 💚

We're so happy to hear that you found exactly what you were looking for—a relaxing atmosphere, a revitalizing massage, and a peaceful escape from the busy city. Creating an experience that leaves our guests feeling refreshed is what we strive for every day.

We're also delighted that you enjoyed our post-treatment refreshments. We believe that a memorable spa journey doesn't end when the massage does, and we're glad those little extras added to your visit.

Your recommendation truly means the world to us. We sincerely appreciate your support and can't wait to welcome you back to Eden for another well-deserved moment of relaxation. Until next time!

reviews.name: Evolve With Mary
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely incredible four-hour massage experience, and I can honestly say it exceeded every expectation I had. From the moment I arrived, the service was warm, professional, and deeply attentive. I immediately felt welcomed and cared for.

The massage itself was exceptional—unhurried, intentional, and truly restorative. Every detail was handled with such skill and thoughtfulness that I was able to fully relax and let go. It was one of those rare experiences where you can feel how much pride and care goes into the work.

After the massage, I used the sauna and jacuzzi, which elevated the entire experience even more. The facilities were clean, calming, and perfectly designed for relaxation. Spending time there afterward allowed my body to fully absorb the benefits of the treatment, and I left feeling completely refreshed—physically and mentally.

This was more than just a massage; it was a full wellness experience. If you’re looking for a place that offers exceptional service, a peaceful atmosphere, and true attention to detail, this is it. I already know I’ll be coming back the next time I’m in Thailand. Highly, highly recommended.

reviews.name: Jeremy Devar
reviews.text:
What an amazing experience! Eden Spa is absolutely beautiful, spotlessly clean and genuinely feels five-star.

From the welcome drink, snacks and cold fragranced towels, to choosing your massage oil and preferred pressure — the attention to detail is exceptional. The massage itself was fantastic!

Afterwards there’s a complimentary refreshment bar with Twinings teas, coffee, biscuits, sweets and snacks. Such a nice touch.

Honestly, one of the best spa experiences we’ve had in Bangkok. Exceptional value too. Highly recommend! 👌
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your 5 star review! we look forward to welcoming you again 🥰

reviews.name: nermine fadhlaoui
reviews.text: Amazing experience! Professional staff, relaxing atmosphere, and one of the best massages I’ve ever had. Everything was perfect from start to finish. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We truly appreciate your five-star review. Thank you for choosing our spa, and we look forward to seeing you on your next visit.

reviews.name: Bernie
reviews.text:
Mate, if you have a stiff back, drop whatever you're doing and come to Eden Ultimate spa on Sukhumvit 11. It was close to my hotel, so I wandered in and asked for the "Eden Heavenly Aromatherapy Rejuvenating Massage." Best Spa decision ever.

They give you a bunch of great choices for oil, but I went with the premium lavender oil. Let me tell you, this was a proper Thai massage. It was easily the hardest and nicest massage I’ve had in the world. The therapist used some seriously innovative techniques that completely softened my stiff Shoulder back and genuinely rejuvenated my mind, body, and spirit.

The facilities are spotless and super premium, they even have this epic little snack and tea station. The crazy part? The whole thing only cost me around $26.49 AUD. Absolute bargain for this level of quality. I will absolutely never forget it. Thank you so much to the Eden Ultimate Spa team!.

Luv Bernie
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful 5-star review ⭐️ It was our pleasure to take care of you. We’re delighted that you had a relaxing and memorable experience with us. We look forward to welcoming you back for another indulgent escape soon ✨

reviews.name: Hidelisa Bondoc
reviews.text: I had the Thai massage and chose the hard-pressure option... definitely not the typical “relaxing” massage, but incredibly relieving and therapeutic for me. There were moments of intense pressure, yet it felt like the therapist was able to reach deep muscles and tension points that had never been worked on before. Oddly satisfying in the best way possible. I walked out feeling lighter, looser, and surprisingly refreshed. Highly commendable service, skilled therapists, and an experience I would absolutely recommend if you prefer a more authentic and deep-pressure Thai massage. Plus complimentary tea/coffee, and pastries after!👍🏽👍🏽👍🏽
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We’re truly happy that you had a great experience with us.

reviews.name: Sariya SS
reviews.text:
We had a very relaxing time at this spa. It was the perfect place to take a break from the chaos of Bangkok city.

The massage staff were all highly experienced, and their service was top-notch.

Overall, I couldn’t recommend it more. I will definitely come back again soon!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your feedback! We’re glad you enjoyed the strong pressure and found it satisfying. It’s also great to hear that you liked the environment. We hope to welcome you again soon.

reviews.name: Karolina Casa Rosa Pinoso
reviews.text:
💆‍♀️✨ Eden Massage
We had the Couple Heavenly Aromatherapy Rejuvenating Massage, followed by a foot massage, and it was honestly one of the most relaxing experiences we’ve had in Bangkok.
From the moment we arrived, everything felt calm and well taken care of.
The massage was perfectly balanced — deep enough to release tension, but still gentle and soothing.
My husband had pain in his shoulder blade, and the therapist noticed it immediately and focused on that area with real care and skill. You could tell they truly listen to your body, not just follow a routine.
We left feeling lighter, calmer, and completely relaxed.
Such a beautiful experience, and absolutely worth a visit if you’re in Bangkok.
Highly recommended 🤍

reviews.name: Bray Monde
reviews.text: The lobby, rooms and toilets were nice and clean. Receptionists were kind and welcoming. My massage therapist was very skillful and knows where to put pressure where it is needed. Highly recommended for a quick relaxing getaway.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We’re truly happy that you had a great experience with us.

reviews.name: Gen R
reviews.text:
Sensational!! The level of service and attention to details and guest requirements are astonishing. From entering you are greeted with warmth and hospitality. We did a walk in and has spots available, we went with a couples reflexology in a theatre room with TV and headphones.
The service was exceptional, from prep to the massage we were attended to with such care.
The massage it self was incredible the masseuse was checking in with the pressure and my comfort levels, guided me gently when I had to reposition.
If there was a possibility to give Eden more stars I would.
Will be returning in the future and hopefully they provide such exquisite hospitality when we return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We’re truly happy that you had a great experience with us.

reviews.name: Sean Huang
reviews.text: I had an incredible massage session today. Nana is truly a professional and knows exactly how to work on those stubborn knots. Her technique is firm yet relaxing, and she was very attentive to my needs throughout the session. I left feeling completely rejuvenated. Five stars all the way!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for choosing us and for your wonderful feedback. We are committed to making every visit special, and we’re so happy we could do that for you.

reviews.name: Tracy Zuopin Soo
reviews.text: Truly one of the best Thai massages I’ve had in Bangkok. The therapists here really know what they are doing—they found all the tension in my shoulders and worked it out professionally. The facility is well-maintained and has a very soothing, natural vibe. It’s professional, peaceful, and great value for the quality of service you get. I’ll definitely be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind and thoughtful review. We’re truly grateful for your support and are delighted to hear that you had a great experience with us. Your feedback means a lot to our team, and we look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

reviews.name: Christine Okinawa
reviews.text: I really really wanted to like this place. The atmosphere was lovely and welcoming, the snacks afterwards were nice (watermelon was wonderful), rooms were nice, and staff were friendly. The only downside was that the massage was the worst massage I’ve had in Thailand. On top of that it was the most expensive massage I had here. It’s too bad since it’s right next to the place I’m staying so was planning to come back daily but will now find somewhere else. My issues were that I specifically marked the areas I did not want massaged on the diagram they gave me (with X over the spots to avoid) and again in the room with my masseuse confirmed I did not want my calves massaged. Halfway through she went right ahead and massaged my calves full strength. Even if she’d avoided my calves the massage was a 2 out of 5. It just didn’t feel good most of the time she was massaging me. My masseuse didn’t seem to have a sense for what areas needed a lighter vs stronger touch. I got the oil massage so maybe just stick with the Thai massage if you go. I hate leaving bad reviews but for this kind of money it’s important to make sure you are getting the quality you are hoping for.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear ,Christine Okinawa
We are extremely sorry for your bad experience at Eden spa . We are normally known for our exceptional attention to detail. As you can see on other reviews, we really set high standard for ourselves and are known for taking our service and care deeply with our customers.

     We regret that we missed the mark. we are so sorry to hear this was not met in your interaction with our service. These kinds of behavior from our therapists are unprofessional and rarely happened. We will take immediate and necessary actions to prevent this to never happen again.  
     Sorry to hear you had a disappointing experience that’s definitely not what we aim for. We really appreciate the feedback and will take it seriously to improve. If you’d be open to chatting more about what went wrong, feel free to message us directly.

Hope the rest of your trip in Thailand treats you better. 🙏


We really appreciate you taking time to bring this issue to our attention. Please accept our sincerest apologies on behalf of everyone on our team.

Looking forward for another chance to earn your trust and reconcile our mistakes with you.

Thank you so much on behalf of Eden the Ultimate Spa Team

Sincerely,
Airinlada K. 
Spa Manager

reviews.name: miriam goitom
reviews.text: Amazing experience at Eden Spa! We chose the 240-minute Ultimate Ecstasy package, and it turned out to be one of the best days we’ve had in Bangkok. The hospitality was exceptional, the staff were incredibly attentive, and the atmosphere was beautiful and relaxing from start to finish. Truly wonderful all around! ✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your 5-star review ⭐️ We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed your experience with us. Our team is dedicated to providing the best service, and your kind words mean a lot. We look forward to welcoming you again soon! 🙏✨

reviews.name: wesartina sear
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my time at this spa. The place is beautiful, clean, and very relaxing. The therapist was kind and skilled, and the massage made me feel completely refreshed. I will definitely come back again and recommend this spa to my friends.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely appreciate your 5-star review ⭐️ Your feedback encourages us to continue delivering high-quality service. We look forward to serving you again in the near future.

reviews.name: Absolutepurple
reviews.text: Other massage shops would bring the snacks to you after service, EDEN brings you to the snacks! I was very satisfied with my massage. My masseur was really good. What ended this visit beautifully was their snacks lounge. Lol It was a nice touch ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your generous feedback. We’re happy to know that you found the experience relaxing and enjoyable, and we look forward to welcoming you back again.

reviews.name: Jorge Lin
reviews.text:
If you are looking for the Thai massage, this is definitely the right place you should come.
The service, environment, treatment even the after-service dessert bar are 10 out of 10 without no doubt.
Especially big thanks to P’Pat, her message skill is talent and outstanding which makes me feel refreshed and Sabai Jing jing.
The best massage experience ever!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We’re truly happy that you had a great experience with us.

reviews.name: stephanie min
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience here in Bangkok! The massage was incredible and so relaxing. The interior was absolutely gorgeous and super cute, making the whole experience feel even more luxurious. They also provided a lovely snack station and tea, which was such a thoughtful touch. The staff were welcoming and attentive throughout. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a great massage experience in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We truly appreciate your five-star review. Thank you for choosing our spa, and we look forward to seeing you on your next visit.

reviews.name: Barbaros
reviews.text:
Wow! I wish there were a way to leave 10 positive stars for this experience.

There are plenty of massage salons and spas in Thailand. But I can assure you that your experience in Eden will be far superior to anywhere else you can try.

The experience was exceptional from beginning to end. When they say “Ultimate Spa Experience,” they truly mean it.

Also, special thanks to Nana. She made the experience incredibly comfortable and is probably among the most skilled professionals you will ever meet.

I can’t wait to be back! Bangkok is worth visiting for this experience alone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind words and for taking the time to share your experience! 
We’re so happy to hear that you felt relaxed and well taken care of. Your satisfaction means the world to us.
Looking forward to welcoming you back to Eden The Ultimate Spa and Massage Experience soon!

title: UnionSPACE
subTitle: Union Space
ownerDescription: Bangkok #1 Business Hub. We offer Virtual Office, Serviced Office, Company Incorporation Service, Accounting & Tax Service, Photo Studio Rental, Marketing Service, Work Permit & Visa service and more.
address: 30 Sukhumvit 61, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Dominic Eldred-Earl
reviews.text:
A fabulous space to work and sleep!
The capsules, the reason for me going, were clean and comfortable (be warned it is a very firm mattress and soft pillow) and the toilet facilities and washing machine were brilliant!

The co-working space is also over a very high standard, in the shared space there is an area to buy really nice food and also a coffee bar, which does really nice coffee - I can recommend the iced coffee and orange juice!  That is one I will be having again.

The internet is brilliant and there are social events too if you are there at the right time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Dominic, thanks for your very kind feedback. We are glad that you enjoyed the space. We wish you the best on your onwards adventure.

Stay safe and enjoy!

reviews.name: Divya Singh
reviews.text: Such a great place to be working and having fun at the same time. So much greenery and comfortable environment. Friendly and warm staff. The best part is getting free access to community events for the members. I enjoyed yoga and barbecue dinner post my working hours. Indeed a highly recommendable place for those who wants a balance in life.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Divya, thank you for your kind review of our space. We look forward to host you once again soon.

reviews.name: SupermanGo
reviews.text: Coworking space is unexpected closed but you can work at the cafe. No food, only drinks are available at the cafe. Staff were very helpful.

reviews.name: K Chong
reviews.text: Good service. We just visit their paw cafe. There were many lovely kittens. Watch out your kids. Some kittens may not know how to play with kids softly.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback. Hope no one is harm during this time. We look forward to have you again.

reviews.name: Win Wisanipphit
reviews.text:
Our experience here was very disappointing. We booked the meeting room a month in advance for two full days, but when the dates came, there were problems on both days. The booking admin had only reserved the room for one day, even though we had paid over 8,000 baht for two days.

Did she not even stop to consider what kind of room at your venue would cost 8,000 baht for just a one day? It makes absolutely no sense. To make matters worse, we never even received an apology.

reviews.name: FizzyButhcer B
reviews.text: Nice,large and clean co working space.But they didn't have barista yet.Barista will come to make coffe for you soon.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review Lich! We look forward to seeing you again! Our coffee shop opens next week! :)

reviews.name: Pavan Khimesra
reviews.text: Amazing place for either spending time alone or with friends. Its a warm and cozy place. Friendly barista and staff. They also have a Cat Cafe on Sundays.

reviews.name: Bianca Cruz
reviews.text: If you're looking for a place to work and stay in BKK, I recommend UnionSPACE! They have a co-living set up with capsule rooms and complete basic amenities, an open work space, private offices and meeting rooms rentable per day or per hour. It's nearby a BTS station which makes it very convenient to move around, situated in a pleasant neighborhood too. Ask for a free day trial, they'd be more than happy to have you :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review Ms Bianca, it was our pleasure hosting you

reviews.name: Admin TH
reviews.text:
We made a reservation for the large room on the ground floor for September 18 and 19, 2025. The booking was made via LINE chat, and we clearly specified that we required the large ground-floor room. The reservation was made on August 13.

However, on September 18, when we arrived to use the room, they informed us that our booking was only for September 19. This was an unacceptable mistake, especially since we had booked one month in advance. Nevertheless, they arranged for us to use an upstairs room instead, which was large enough to serve as a substitute, and everything went smoothly that day.

On September 19, when we returned for our second day of booking, they told us that the room was only reserved for us from 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m., and that another group would use it from 2:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. However, our booking made on August 13 clearly stated that the reservation was for both September 18 and 19 from 11:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

This was an extremely unacceptable mistake, as it occurred on both days.

reviews.name: Netanel Malachi
reviews.text:
Very strange place. The receptionist barely speak any English, no info on any of their services, I asked to check on business registration and she said that she has no info on the matter.
They have Capibaras for kids though. So if your a child it will suit you, not so much for business unfortunately.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Netanel,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We're sorry to hear about your experience and appreciate your comments, as they help us improve.

We apologize for any language barrier you may have encountered—our team is working to improve communication and ensure clear information is available to all our visitors. Regarding business-related inquiries, we kindly ask that such questions be directed to our management team via email or phone, as our front desk staff may not have access to that level of detail.

We're glad you noticed our capybaras—they are a unique and beloved part of our space, especially enjoyed by families and children. That said, we aim to provide an experience that’s welcoming and informative for all types of visitors, including those with business interests.

If you’re open to it, we’d appreciate the opportunity to speak with you further and assist with any outstanding questions.

reviews.name: attawee kaewnopparat
reviews.text: The serviced offices at UnionSPACE Ekkamai are fantastic! The office space is modern, fully furnished, and offers high-speed internet and 24/7 access. I loved the convenience of having administrative support and access to meeting rooms whenever I needed. Perfect for businesses that require a professional and comfortable working environment.

reviews.name: deepak singh
reviews.text:
Nice place, I came here for an event. The place looks well designed and beautiful only downside it's quite a bit of a walk from the BTS, better to take a bike if you are arriving using public transport.

Overall this place seems like a good coffee working space.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Deepak,

Thank you for your kind review. Our place is 5-mins walk from the BTS Ekkamai (make sure to take exit towards Major Ekkamai). There are win bikes which can also get you here for around 15 baht, or people usually just walk as it's only 400 meters away.

reviews.name: denny sutomo
reviews.text: I have a very bad experience using service from unionspace thailand especially in DTV application, DTV process was failed due to many bad organizing from UnionSPACE, I paid very high price around 180K bath where the normal price is just about 13k bath, but still the service was terrible, finally I ask for some refund but they only provide 6,5k bath refund, its not even 10%, but until I write this review they don't even put effort for the rest refund amount, its been 2 months, even on the way I paid my own hotel charge because their company credit card fail to pay (this reimbursement haven't paid too from their side) , they keep delaying the conversation and keep promise for phone calls that never happen. I have applied through normal procedure and its approved, only need 1 week. I hope this review can help other who willing to use unionspace service for visa application, better not use their service.

reviews.name: Kyoshi De Guzman
reviews.text: UnionSPACE made my Thai visa process smooth and easy. From start to finish, their team was on point with every detail, guiding me step by step and making sure everything was handled perfectly. The professionalism they showed gave me peace of mind, and their quick turnaround saved me a lot of stress. If you’re looking for a hassle-free visa experience, this is the place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your wonderful experience!  We're delighted to hear that our team could make your Thai visa process smooth and stress-free. Your kind words about our professionalism and attention to detail mean a lot to us. We're always here to help make the process as seamless as possible. If you ever need assistance in the future, don’t hesitate to reach out. 🙏😊

reviews.name: Glen Norris
reviews.text: Not too loud. Not too quiet. Great natural light. Excellent invested staff. Very reasonable prices. Clean. And clean honest upbeat non-denominational design. There's also activities on the calendar. One gets the feeling that if they met the owner he'd be open minded but with great taste.

reviews.name: Wiiwee Apple
reviews.text: If i had a choice for not give a star, i would definitely choose not to give this one star. Applying visa process was not very smooth, and its like union space team, really not well prepared. Imagine that on the day, their credit card couldnt be used to pay for the hotel the were supposed tp cover. And to this day, there has been no firther confirmation of this. Always promised to be contact me and finding solution, but until now, it has been months, and no one ever really care for solving my problem. For me, im never will use union space service again for applying a visa. Really really bad experience👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻

reviews.name: Drongo Drongo
reviews.text:
I like the check in service,  very easy and convenient.  Very friendly staff who are quick to help you with any problems.
The rest of the building has a coworking space which is free for guests to the hostel.  Also there is a cafe and nice food to be had.  Apperently there is a podcast and a photography studio that you can hire.   Really cool place that could be especially good for digital nomads

reviews.name: Stephen
reviews.text: Very bad experiences using service from UnionSPACE Thailand, they keep asking to extend the time saying needed more time, up to three times. Service cost is very expensive, wasted 3 weeks time and still fail to deliver Destination Thailand Visa (DTV). Communication with them is also a problem here. Better to apply visa through official procedure. Hope this helps others for future references.

reviews.name: Konstantinos Karakolidis
reviews.text: Certainly a cozy space that also has office space availability. Decent selection for some small dishes and overall an acceptable coffee. It definitely needs  improvement in the quality of the beverages. For those seeking a nice place to do some remote working or simply unwind peacefully it's a great choice.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Konstantinos. Thanks for your feedback and your honest pointers about our beverages. We'll look into it and make improvements asap.

reviews.name: Johan Heikensten
reviews.text:
Stayed there for a couple of nights. The pods are nice and clean. The bed is firm and nice, but the doors are not very well designed and makes a lot of noise when you open and close them. There's a small chill area for people whom stay in the dorm where you can watch Netflix and eat.
When it comes to the co-working space there isn't that much place to sit, but the internet is good.
They also had a 'get to know each other' thing, for all the people that worked there (last Friday of every month), which was nice. If you need to combine working and traveling is a good place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your feedback Mr. Johan. We will continue to improve even further.

title: Asana Yoga
subTitle: Asana Yoga - Eight Thonglor
ownerDescription: Yoga Studio , Pilates Studio ,Private Pilates
address: 88/1 Eight Thonglor ,LG Floor Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Mucho Gracias
reviews.text: Six classes in and Asana Yoga is easily the best studio in Thong Lo. Luna was incredible today — attentive, encouraging, and really dialed into the flow. If you want to be pushed, Praveen’s classes are next level. The instruction quality here is consistently sharp across the board. Highly recommend for anyone serious about their practice.

reviews.name: allboutreviews
reviews.text:
I’ve been coming to this yoga studio regularly, and it’s honestly one of my favorite places to unwind. The environment is so nice and relaxing from the moment you walk in.

Everyone there is incredibly kind, and the instructors are especially wonderful. They always, always, always make an effort to help you, guide you through the poses, and ensure you feel safe and comfortable throughout the class. It never feels intimidating.  just supportive and welcoming.

The studio is also consistently clean and well-maintained, which makes the whole experience even better. I truly enjoy coming here and always leave feeling refreshed and at peace. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Ann Annika
reviews.text: The place was nice and clean and the instructor was very good and experienced. Only minor comment was that the room felt a little stuffy as we were quite closely placed to each other but it could also be due to popularity of the time we took the class.

reviews.name: Yusnita Jalal
reviews.text: Recommended, we searched through social media and this popular name appears!! Muslim friendly masseur available ☺️👍

reviews.name: Mera Humaira
reviews.text: I took the onsen + thai oil massage. I must give it a 5 star because they prioritize your comfort from the moment you step in. I suggest you take the onsen first 1 hr, then massage for 2 hrs, possibly with a partner. They have their Valentine’s Day promo now :)

reviews.name: Anubhuti Purohit
reviews.text: I go there regularly. It's super nice,cozy studio. Offering good number of classes. Receptionist is polite. They do have shower rooms for women

reviews.name: Tenna Fong
reviews.text: The receptionist is very nice and helpful!! She helps me a lot for the class registration. Greatly appreciated for her kindness.

reviews.name: Marikha Cabel
reviews.text: This is my favourite yoga studio in Bangkok hands down. Love the teachers and the variety of classes. It's located super conveniently in thonglor, and they have great clean amenities! The studio is well designed and spacious, I always come here for evening classes after work 😊

reviews.name: Elizabeth May
reviews.text: Best yoga place in Thong Lo. Very professional teachers. Also high standard of cleaning, all mats and the whole area is always spotless. Great vibes and energy.

reviews.name: Q SUN
reviews.text:
Good place for Yoga. Teachers are good. Staffs are very kind and try to help you on any matters. Vibe is good, have some members practicing Yogi for long time - you can tell.
Signed up for a membership after one drop in class 😊

reviews.name: Pnsr T
reviews.text:
Best place to practice! Great location and Teachers so kind and technique ,highly experienced and explains step to step always assists all students. I got beautiful pictures yoga pose  from studio after class. (Staff always ask permission before take a photo)
Really Good! 👍

reviews.name: K Wongwatanyu
reviews.text: Great place for all levels - basic to advance. Yogi will just love it for sure! 👍🏻💪🏻💛

reviews.name: Kanyth B.

Really nice place in the nice location.
Urban atmosphere.

reviews.text:
Every time i have a class here, I get good vibes from Asana yoga!
There are many different types of yoga
So enjoyable lessons
Staffs are kind
Rooms are clean
I highly recommend Asana yoga studio!

reviews.name: Isabelle Jarnot
reviews.text: Noi was amazing! She showed great attention to detail and the stretch yoga class was very helpful for my back and hip pain. Thanks so much Noi, I’ll be back for more!!!

reviews.name: Nora Vale
reviews.text:
This is good studio with professional instructors, indian as well.
But when I got membership for 20 days, coast 5500 baht and was sick one week, they didn’t was accepted to apply for few days.
It’s not friendly thai style, in other gyms and sports clubs they always went for such services.
