Extension membership policy in case of sickness, package will be extend following period that doctor declare in medical certificate.
In case of no medical certificate, we are so sorry to not able to extend membership.

reviews.name: Kristine Vik Andresen
reviews.text: I cannot rave enough about the yoga class here. Amazing and fun teacher and really good vibes! Best place I've found in bangkok
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm grateful for your review.

reviews.name: Sai Thanawutthikorn
reviews.text: Amazing location, in the heart of Thong lo road. The 8 building. The studio is on the ground floor and has amazing yoga teachers.   Have to stop by if your in Bangkok
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much!

reviews.name: charrisma charoensawat
reviews.text: Excellent yoga studio in the middle of Thong lo. Various classes to attend. Experienced teachers, lovely staffs and nice atmosphere!

reviews.name: Pattamavadee Rakvanij
reviews.text: Lovely ambience and excellent instructor! Strongly recommended!

title: Lion's Head Boxing Academy Rama IV
ownerDescription: A premier boxing gym in Bangkok offering professional boxing training for all levels, from complete beginners to experienced fighters. Train with expert boxing coaches through group boxing classes, private boxing training, fitness boxing, boxing fundamentals, technical training, padwork, sparring,and fight preparation. Our personalized training programs are designed to improve boxing skills, fitness, strength, conditioning, confidence, and overall performance. We also offer executive training, home boxing training, and specialized strength & conditioning for athletes. Whether you want to learn boxing, get fit, develop real boxing skills, prepare for a fight, or take your training to the next level. provides structured, high-quality coaching
address: 1399 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Kenneth Wong
reviews.text:
Had an amazing experience training at Lion’s Head Boxing. From the moment I reached out, Coach J and the entire team were incredibly professional, welcoming, and passionate about helping their students improve.

A special shoutout to Coach Rush — the attention to detail in mechanics, form, and fundamentals has already helped improve my boxing game noticeably in a short time. The coaching is structured, technical, and tailored to your level, which makes every session very valuable.

What really stood out to me was the gym culture and professionalism of the whole team. You can tell there’s genuine care behind every client’s progress. Whether you’re a beginner or experienced boxer, this is definitely a gym worth training at. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Ryan Tan
reviews.text:
This would probably be the best option for you if you are in Bangkok looking for some good session in Western Boxing.
Good environment, good coaching, good location.

reviews.name: Louis
reviews.text: I’m so glad with my decision to join this gym. The gym is clean, and I always feel like I am improving, but most importantly, the community here is awesome. Coach J was incredibly approachable, so I had no problem integrating into the class. He is also very attentive, giving advice even after the classes finished. Coach Rush was extremely detailed and helpful. He always make sure to check up with me before and after sessions. I will highly recommend.

reviews.name: Supakorn Yinhirun
reviews.text: I’m the owner of a Muay Thai gym, and taking the MittMaster program at Lion's Head Boxing has made a huge difference for me. My coaching skills have improved a lot, especially in pad holding and structuring sessions, and I’ve seen a noticeable increase in clients since applying what I learned. The coach explains everything in a very clear and simple way, is easy to talk to, and teaches with solid principles you can actually use in real training. Highly recommended for any coach or gym owner who wants real, practical improvement.

reviews.name: Vibram Viet Nam
reviews.text:
I travel to bankok for 5 days. Falling in love with this boxing club. The coach is very knowledgeable, i join the sparring class (i had not done any sparing for the last 2 year), but the coach did really good job. He guide all clients do the right mindset in sparring session
The receptionist is friendly, the bathroom is clean. Don't l hesitate to join this gym. Im guarantee you will love it

Only 1 cons is they have no sign outside, it's little confused me to find out where the gym are. If you read me review, highly recommend you put a sign outside to guide people
Thank you very much. I will see you again

reviews.name: li zhang
reviews.text: I've been trying to find a boxing gym in Bangkok and finally found this place! They have two gyms with a nice professional coach crew. The gym is well organized and clean and the most important thing is the coaches here they know what and how to teach. So beginners will understand why instead of just throwing punches.

reviews.name: fart
reviews.text:
Lion Head Boxing is a really solid place to train. The coaches know what they’re doing and push you without making it feel intimidating, and the vibe is serious but still friendly so you feel comfortable even if you’re new.

For me, it ended up being more than just training showing up and putting in the work actually helped me deal with some of the stuff I was going through and gave me a way to clear my head. Overall, it’s a great environment to improve, stay consistent, and feel better both physically and mentally.

reviews.name: Ling WL Law
reviews.text:
I am a visitor and just looking for a gym for boxing.
The location is convenient, and the coaching team is very dedicated.
from warm-up, basic workout  to pad works the arrangement is good.
If you looking for boxing training in BKK,  just come here and join the course

reviews.name: Sutee Davy
reviews.text:
Impressive gym and facilities, experienced instructors made you enjoy boxing more.
Highly recommends.

There are 2 branches you can go to, Rama 4 and Ramkhamhaeng.

reviews.name: bendegen mah
reviews.text: The gym has a friendly and safe environment with great coaches. The effort to customise drills to suit both beginner and advanced levels shows deep knowledge of boxing. Thank you Lions Head Boxing Team

reviews.name: Troy Berman
reviews.text:
Lions Head Boxing Academy offers clean and great facilities and even better coaches and staff. I trained with Tomo over a 2 weeks period and I left BKK with a new set of tools to take back to Australia and implement into my training. I look forward to training again with the team in October. Anyone looking for a pure boxing gym in BKK this is the spot!
Thanks again team 💪 🥊

reviews.name: Danny Pedroni
reviews.text: Never have I elevated both my ability and love for a sport quite as much as I have with coach JR and coach Jean at the Lions Head Boxing academy. Their approach to training is grounded both in enjoyment and a technical excellence in the sport of boxing. I recommend anyone looking to take their boxing game to the next level, or just looking to get fit in a welcoming setting to try this gym immediately.

reviews.name: Shotaro Koyama
reviews.text: I trained for 3 days and I got so many technical skills! Coach J is the best coach ever I have ever had!

reviews.name: Ryan Covey
reviews.text: Awesome gym for boxing. I've trained at muay thai gyms & enjoy Lion's Head much more. Coaches actually correct form & drill situational striking & develop footwork, no matter your experience level.  Classes are small so you get great feedback from the coaches & better directed training so you'll improve after each class. They have a lot of equipment to train with, for striking & fitness, so you can get great workouts in.

reviews.name: cream ice
reviews.text: Learning boxing from scratch made me feel the joy of boxing. The gym is very clean and the coaches are patient and have excellent skills. I highly recommend it.

reviews.name: Jakavellian
reviews.text: The best decision I ever made for my son hitmanjakrin. The team is so supportive, full of positive vibes and energy. I dont want to say too much but this academy has changed my 16 year old son forever with discipline,skills,techniques, conditioning. Coach Jay, gorn, toy, guy, fend and the rest of the team. All they want to see you when you walk in the gym is you go back home a winner. definitely a high level selfesteem booster. Highly recommend. You just need to check in with these great team. Lion's head boxing academy has been my son second home since day one. Brothers in leather gloves🥊 10/10

reviews.name: Official FOS
reviews.text:
Took a pit stop in bangko* for a few days and found this little gem of a gym. Very cool guys in there, good session too. I  found ma pad trainer to be real helpful and clear in helping me progress my fighting. Rush 👌 enjoyed it so much i stayed behimg for another session 😜 sparring! Some good lads im there sparring was good too, the right challenge for my stop in BangKo*.
Ty Lions 🦁 💪
Bk in dec 🫡

reviews.name: Cat Cunningham
reviews.text:
Really solid boxing gym, will be coming back for sure, Coach J was very welcoming from the start and clearly passionate about what he does which makes all the difference.

The pads class was fun with plenty of time with the trainer to fine tune any mistakes.

The community within people casually coming to the gym or regulars is great. The sparring class was my favourite, well-run and controlled, and it gave me a good chance to see what needed to be worked on and get specific feedback.

The facility is veryyyy nice, lots of equipment, clean and all for a great price!

reviews.name: Yurii Slepko
reviews.text:
Why I 100% recommend Lion’s Academy?

The space itself is very well designed and high quality. Great equipment, a ring, lots of bags — everything you need.

If you don’t have your own gloves or headgear, it’s all available at the gym, which is a big plus.

But what really sets this place apart is the training process.

It’s extremely well thought out and very personalized, no matter how many people are in the group. This honestly surprised me.

Even during group sessions, there are multiple coaches working with small groups, so you still get a lot of attention and real feedback.

That level of coaching makes a huge difference. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Phuvich .p
reviews.text: I've been training here since December and absolutely love it! Everyone at the gym is super friendly and welcoming. The facilities are great — clean, well-equipped, and comfortable. The training itself is top-notch; every coach is professional, knowledgeable, and makes each session both effective and enjoyable. I always feel at ease and motivated when I come to train. Definitely planning to continue training here for the long term! Highly recommended.

title: Jao Muaythai
ownerDescription:
open from Monday to Saturday morning class 9AM afternoon class 4:30PM

Walkins welcome no booking required
address: 183 2, Nong Phueng, Amphoe Saraphi, Chiang Mai 50140, Thailand
plusCode: P2HF+VG Nong Phueng, Saraphi District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Alexandre Madeline
reviews.text: Came to train and take photos. This gym is great, the coaches are great, vibes immaculate.

reviews.name: Jack Thompson
reviews.text: Amazing Muay Thai gym, from the experience coaches, fun atmosphere and great facilities. If you want to start or improve your skills this is the place to be.

reviews.name: Benjamin Glemme
reviews.text:
Awesome brand new gym with experienced trainers! Newbies to high levels of experience will have a blast training here. Very nice equipment and a perfectly set up roof top ring and training area.
Highly recommend! I will definitely revisit when I’m back in Chang Mai!🥊🤩

reviews.name: T Wu
reviews.text:
Trained for a month at Central.
New gym, so clean and modern equipment.
The coaches and the staff are awesome, they make you feel at home!
I enjoyed the emphasis on clinching, which is too often neglected in other gyms.

reviews.name: Lincoln McCardle
reviews.text: Finished up my 3 month long trip to Chiang mai with a month training at central and I’m so happy this place opened in time for me to try it out. All the krus were extremely friendly and I seen my self improve drastically while training there, will be my #1 gym when I come back. The view from the rooftop boxing ring is worth the price in itself

reviews.name: Nutthaya Dilokpatanamongkol
reviews.text: This boxing gym offers a clean facility, well-equipped training areas, and a friendly atmosphere. It provides a variety of training programs led by professional trainers who offer personalized guidance. Perfect for all levels, from beginners to those aiming to refine their skills.

reviews.name: Riane Moffitt
reviews.text:
10/10 Muay Thai gym you must visit if your in Chiang Mai
All the coaches are active professional fighters and you will learn so much from them
Highly recommend ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.name: Chonnipa Thanakiatsakul
reviews.text: Hands down the most beautiful Muaythai gym in Chiang Mai. Training with the sunset was absolutely fascinating. The gym is really clean and well organized, we were having such a great time there.🩵

reviews.name: isac gunnarsson
reviews.text: Wonderful new gym in Chiang mai with state of the art equipment! Lovely little crew with the best vibe I’ve found in a gym in Thailand! Definitely Will revisit!👊

reviews.name: Cam
reviews.text: Highly recommend this gym. The people there are great, very friendly and family like. The group sizes are very small and the coaches give very precise technical advice. I also enjoyed that there was sparing almost everyday. I loved mine time there and felt welcomed 5/5

reviews.name: Carol Federico
reviews.text: Spent 1 month training Muay Thai at this incredible gym. Central MT is clean, personal, and so much fun. It’s like a community that you don’t find at other gyms. Watching Kru Paithong fight was a highlight. The owner and all the coaches are so skilled and made training so much fun. It was so nice to have a female trainer and one as amazing as Parichat. I would definitely go back and train here again.

reviews.name: Hristo Stoev
reviews.text: Clean and professional Muay Thai gym, suitable for all levels. I would 100% recommend it for anyone coming to Chiang Mai 👏

reviews.name: Christian Raemy
reviews.text:
I joined Central Muaythai as a complete beginner and have been genuinely impressed by the progress I’ve made in such a short period of time. The trainers are highly skilled, patient, and focused on ensuring proper technique, which allows you to see noticeable improvements quickly if you stay consistent!

The facility is impeccably maintained, with top-quality equipment that caters to all levels of training. The atmosphere strikes a perfect balance between being motivating and inclusive, making it an ideal space for anyone looking to push themselves and grow.

Whether you’re new to the sport or have prior experience, I highly recommend Central Muaythai for its professionalism and dedication to helping members achieve their goals and Beyond!

Special Thanks to the Central Muaythai Team!

reviews.name: Thomas Swindell
reviews.text: I Highly recommend this gym. I trained here for 2 weeks and you get a lot more time with the trainers which you don’t get in other gyms. There is a great community and they cater for all skill  levels.

reviews.name: Frank Donkers
reviews.text: I walked in from the street while they were doing a group lesson. I was completely inexperienced so I decided to book some private muay thai session with kru Mark. He made me work hard, but kept it fun. I felt improving each session and getting fitter. The gym is new, clean and has the most friendly people with a very personal touch. It is really nice when all the people in the gym greet you with your name. A special thanks to kru Mark for the sessions. If i ever find myself back in Chiang Mai, I will definitely come back here.

reviews.name: Giulia Melchiorre
reviews.text: I went to a morning group class and it was fantastic. They take a maximum of 8 students and there were 5 of us and 3 coaches. Really high quality training in a nice and modern gym! I also loved that there were two female coaches.

reviews.name: Caleb Slaterkinghorn
reviews.text:
Came to chiang mai only for a week and had two sessions at Central Muaythai. Both times the coaches and manager going out of their way to make it a challenging but enjoyable session.

If you’re ever wanting to train in Chiang Mai here is the place. No matter your experience beforehand. The fight knowledge and experience is unmatched. 10/10 👍🏼

reviews.name: Cristina Tesoro
reviews.text:
Had a FANTASTIC time learning Muay Thai at this gym. The Krus are amazing and are very knowledgeable about fighting technique (shout out to Kru Jitti, Kru Parichat, and Kru Raeng!). The classes are well structured and very engaging. I signed up for group classes and also took a private class to work more on some of my weaker points. They are great at doing drills (as Bruce Lee once said, “I fear not the man who has practiced 10,000 kicks once, but I fear the man who has practiced one kick 10,000 times.”) and teach efficient combo techniques! They made me want to postpone my flight out just to learn more from them!

All in all, I have definitely learned and improved with this gym and cannot wait to go back! Until then, chikkipai!

reviews.name: Reece Brewer
reviews.text: I spent the month in chiang mai, finding central muay thai was the best thing to happen on my trip. All the trainers were amazing and pushed me hard. I feel like I have improved a lot and am ready to go back to England and put it all into practice. Thank you everyone at centralmuaythai, I will make sure to attribute my improvement to your gym wherever I may go next 💪

reviews.name: Vik Mani
reviews.text: The training here is good and the trainers are helpful. I like the atmosphere at this gym. It's a great place to learn Mauy Thai.

title: Spaces Chamchuri Square
ownerDescription: สร้างความประทับใจแรกให้ธุรกิจของคุณด้วยสำนักงานให้เช่าที่จามจุรีสแควร์ เขตปทุมวัน กรุงเทพมหานครชั้น 24 ของอาคารสำนักงานจามจุรีสแควร์ เขตปทุมวัน กรุงเทพมหานคร เป็นที่ตั้งของพื้นที่ Co-working สำนักงานให้เช่า และห้องสัมมนาให้เช่าที่น่าประทับใจ ศูนย์กลางด้านธุรกิจแห่งนี้มีทำเลที่ตั้งอันดีเยี่ยมบนพื้นที่ของจุฬาลงกรณ์มหาวิทยาลัยบริเวณแยกสามย่าน ซึ่งเป็นอาคารเพียงแห่งเดียวที่เชื่อมต่อโดยตรงกับสถานีรถไฟฟ้า MRT สามย่าน (และศูนย์การค้า).

reviews.name: Jira Lapus
reviews.text:
Nice place for working,  meeting and study.
Location is in center of Bangkok , can go by mrt or bus.
They are very good decorations as co-working space should be,  comfy chair and table,  have enough space for each groups,  use earth tone that make people feel  relax. They also have mini meeting rooms and private room for only 1people!
And the view is very cool,  you can get the light from outside,  not only from neon , coz there are many big windows along a wall

reviews.name: C C
reviews.text: The best co-working office space in Bangkok! Spaces is more than just many offices in central Bangkok of various shapes and sizes with fantastic views from the 24th floor and brand new, attractive furnishings plus a clean, spacious cafe, enormous reception/common areas, meetings rooms, etc. It is the Spaces team who deserve a special mention...everyone at the Reception Desk, behind the counter in the cafe, the cleaning staff and the management (who are always close by and available) are more than friendly and helpful! They make Spaces the great working environment it is!!

reviews.name: Alexa
reviews.text: I’m not sure why there were some negative reviews about this coworking space, but I really enjoyed it. Everything was very clean and tidy. There’s a nice café inside with tasty and varied coffee options. The receptionist was super friendly and welcoming. The space itself is large, comfortable, and on a Friday it wasn’t crowded
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Alexa, we are pleased you had a positive experience with us and thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review score. We hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Supapat W
reviews.text: Very spacious and nicely decorated. Good atmosphere. Not being overdramatic, I gave two stars thanks to the woman in the front desk who yelled at me for the very first impression; she needs heavy training on how to be service mind if she wants to still be in this business. Whenever I walk, she would stare at my like if I was going to steal her things. Casa Lapin coffee is reasonable price.

reviews.name: Antonio Oattono
reviews.text: Great and convenience location. Great view toward Chulalongkorn University. Nice furniture set and decoration.

reviews.name: Frederik Dhooge
reviews.text: Great Coworking offices, ideal for events, centrally located

reviews.name: Crayfisher
reviews.text:
The location is great! It offers a lovely view and is located centrally right next to Samyan MRT station.
I genuinely love spaces and frequently use the one in my hometown Zurich, Switzerland as well as others when I am travelling for business.
Unfortunately, this one does not yet live up to the high standards set by the other branches.
The gentleman at the reception is as unwelcoming as they come and highly demotivated and answers questions only reluctantly.

Unfortunately, in an estimated 80% of spots there is no possibility for charging your electronic devices so you will have to recharge your device while taking breaks. This does not help productivity.
Generally the facilities are not up to date as the toilets lack cleanliness and are sometimes malfunctioning. In two of the toilets was no paper
The wifi speed is simply inadequate, nothing more to say about that.

The little café is lovely and the service very friendly. The venue has a lot of potential which is currently not used to the maximum.

I hope my review will be taken to heart and the next time I visit I will find an inviting atmosphere that will enable me to concentrate and work efficiently.

reviews.name: Ahmed Yasser
reviews.text: I tried to go there at 10pm but security told me that it’s closed. Can you update the working hours please!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Ahmed, thank you for your feedback and we’re sorry for the inconvenience you experienced when trying to access the location at 10:00 PM. Access hours can vary based on membership type and building security rules, and we understand how confusing this can be if the information isn’t clear. Please raise a support ticket through your account so the team can review your access and update the details accordingly.

reviews.name: eN. Z.
reviews.text:
Nice location, if you can live with slow internet and janky toilets.

Location is quite nice, just a few more steps from MRT Sam Yan station, the overall facility is considerably good.

For months, the staff could not mitigate the internet issues (low bandwidth and high latency). Moreover, they promised to improved but it's never been delivered.

Toilet could be a problem especially for the ladies. Since they could not afford more cleaners to do their job frequently, expect the filth lying around the restrooms.

reviews.name: Olga Sa
reviews.text: Does not allow walk-ins, members only. Can work for 2 hours from the café with a purchase of a drink, but no wifi.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Olga, thank you for your feedback. Memberships are available from 5, 10 or unlimited days a month with no booking required on the day. You can also book day offices or meeting rooms. For further information please head to spacesworks.com/products-services/ or contact our sales team. Thanks.

reviews.name: Suwit Khemsap
reviews.text: Greatest co-working space ever

reviews.name: Faadzil Osman
reviews.text: The best co-working experience you can ever get!! Great staff, great facilities, superb location!!

reviews.name: Adam D
reviews.text: The BEST place to work and study! With a nice view over Bangkok City.

reviews.name: Rita Chang
reviews.text: Nice place! Great environment for working.

reviews.name: Bangkok Nightlife Tours
reviews.text: Awesome co-working space to work from!

reviews.name: Suparat Sukpradit
reviews.text: Convenient and great staff service!

reviews.name: Shanu Mandot
reviews.text: Not open!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Shanu, thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We've investigated this with the centre team and have found no reason to believe that the centre was closed on this date, but we apologise if there was some confusion. Should you wish to confirm the opening times directly or arrange an appointment, please contact the centre directly at +66 2 026 0635. Thank you.

reviews.name: Malatee “Eve” Prasopdee
reviews.text: Beautiful place and great service.

reviews.name: Tantasorn Sonbalee
reviews.text: Great location and modern!

reviews.name: Naru Nakrong
reviews.text:
I would suggest either changing or providing better training for the receptionist. It would be better to have someone who is friendly, willing to answer questions, and happy to help. The receptionist looked annoyed when I asked questions, which made me feel uncomfortable.

I hope this can be improved, as it would make the overall experience much better.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Naru, thank you for your feedback. I'm sorry to hear about your experience with our receptionist; that's certainly not the level of service we aim to provide. Please raise a ticket through the Help section of your online account so our team can review and assist you directly.

title: Forever Young Lifestyle (Ekamai) Co.Ltd
ownerDescription: Welcome to Forever Young Lifestyle, the premier martial arts gym with two locations in Bangkok: Ekamai and Nanglinchi. Our adult program offers boxing, Muay Thai, MMA, and BJJ, while for kids, we offer our unique program: Ninja Academy. Our facilities are state-of-the-art, equipped with AC units and technical mat flooring ideal for all martial arts. We pride ourselves on our small group classes, allowing our coaches to provide personalized attention to each student. Our coaches are fluent in English, making it easy for students from all over the world to feel comfortable and welcome. We aim to help you become the best version of yourself, in and out of the gym. Come visit us at Forever Young Lifestyle
address: 1347 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Im Rey
reviews.text: I highly recommend Trying this gym! I had loads of fun. In just a day You can already learn a lot from the coaches, They are very Kind, Passionate and Very Humble. Beginner or not You will be Taken care of. Coaches Give very good advices and techniques. Even the students welcome you with wholesome smiles and also guide you throughout the sessions. If I only knew of this place sooner I wouldn’t have spent just a day inside it. I hope to roll with them again soon! Maraming Salamat! From the Philippines! 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're thrilled to hear that you share our passion for martial arts. It truly feels like we're all part of one big family, united by our love for training. We can't wait to welcome you back again someday soon! 🥋👊

reviews.name: Pons Ponce
reviews.text:
Forever Young Lifestyle is a one stop place for the active person. Muay Thai, BJJ, Movement Training, Functional Training - you name it, they have it. The coaching staff are experts in their fields: high level Muay Thai competitors, MMA champions, Grappling champions.

The best part is the Ninja Academy where if one enrolls their kids in this program: they learn to use mind and body at the same time during the workouts that could feel like play and fun.

5 stars ⭐️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your glowing review! We're thrilled to hear that you've had such a positive experience at Forever Young Lifestyle. Our diverse range of activities and expert coaching staff are dedicated to providing top-notch training experiences. We're especially delighted that you appreciate our Ninja Academy program for kids, where we strive to make learning both enjoyable and enriching. We look forward to continuing to serve you and your family in the future!

reviews.name: Mael Beru
reviews.text:
Martial arts: I trained Muaythai in many gym's in Bangkok and I couldn't find a place where the trainers "cared" until I found this place.
The coaches are very competent, they are extremely good at teaching at any level. (Being a good fighter doesn't mean you are good at teaching).
Good communication, good technic, good listeners, I highly recommend.
The airpurifier is very welcome during pollution peak too. :)

Ninja academy: This is such an amazing activity for children. I could see the progress and development at so many levels after only a few sessions. Children love it, the team of coach is great, I also highly recommend Ninja Academy for children.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your experience with us! We're honored to hear that our martial arts training exceeded your expectations, especially coming from someone who has trained in various gyms in Bangkok. Our coaches are dedicated to providing quality instruction and fostering a supportive environment for all levels of practitioners. We're thrilled that you've noticed the care and competence of our team. Additionally, we're glad to hear that your children are enjoying and benefiting from our Ninja Academy program—it's fantastic to see their progress and development firsthand. We appreciate your recommendation and look forward to continuing to serve you and your family!

reviews.name: Anders Bangkok
reviews.text: Great little gym just next to the Ekamai BTS station (1 min walk). Real friendly instructors that made me feel welcome. With a wide range of classes from Ninja kids camps to Boxing, Muay Thai, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and more.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the great review! 😊 We're happy to hear that you enjoyed your experience at our Ekamai location and felt welcomed by our instructors. We take pride in offering a wide range of classes for all ages and interests, from Ninja kids camps to boxing, Muay Thai, and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. We look forward to seeing you again soon and helping you continue your training journey! 🥷🥊🥋

reviews.name: Tony Cao
reviews.text: confused - thought there was jiujitsu here - but they told me it was in the other branch.

reviews.name: lior hen
reviews.text:
Came for a beginners jiu jitsu session and loved it!
patrick is a great trainer who also
emphasize thinking when doing
martial arts and not only using power :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed your beginners jiu-jitsu session with us! Coach Pat is indeed a fantastic trainer who emphasizes the importance of strategy and thoughtfulness in martial arts practice, alongside physical technique. We believe in cultivating a well-rounded approach to training, and we're thrilled that you appreciated this aspect of our sessions. Looking forward to seeing you again soon on the mats!

reviews.name: trisha karla Pili
reviews.text: Love how alex and coach Chris do Muay Thai. It’s very interactive and friendly to beginners and advance. You get the kick of what real Muay Thai here!

reviews.name: Anders Hanami Marketing
reviews.text: Such a great activity for the kids!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review! 😊 We're so happy to hear that you enjoyed the activities for the kids. Helping them learn, grow, and have fun is what we’re all about! We hope to see you and your little ninjas back again soon! 🥷🎉

reviews.name: Andy Agouridis
reviews.text: Great place to train with a nice group of ppl. Also, loads of options for all major combat
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the great feedback! 😊 We're glad you’re enjoying the training environment and the variety of combat sports we offer. It’s fantastic to have such a great community of people to train with, and we’re thrilled you’re a part of it. Looking forward to seeing you in more sessions! 💪🥊🥋

reviews.name: Anders Rosendal
reviews.text: Super good vibes in this gym. Recommend it 👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're thrilled to hear you're feeling the positive vibes at our gym! Thank you for recommending us, and we look forward to seeing you again soon! 👍

reviews.name: Marie-Claude Masson
reviews.text: Best place for Ninja Class for children.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're so glad to hear that you found our Ninja Class to be the best for children! Thank you for your kind words and recommendation. We're dedicated to providing a fun and enriching experience for young ninjas, and we look forward to continuing to serve your family!

reviews.name: Ayaz Gazizov
reviews.text: Крутое место! Открытые позитивные тренеры. Мои дети были голодными и злыми перед занятием, но во время занятия стали активными и позитивными! Офигенная тренировка!
reviews.textTranslated: Great place! Open, positive trainers. My kids were hungry and cranky before class, but during it they became active and positive! Awesome workout!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks 🙏 hope to see you again next time.

reviews.name: Danica

Well we came due to a certain trainer called Jack. He is an amazing person and a great Muay Thai trainer. Today he trained my daughter and she had a great time. Thank you Jack. reviews.name: Thailand Quest by WadaBUSHI
reviews.text:
[WadaBUSHI's memo]

reviews.textTranslated: The club is very local and family-oriented, hence the fact that I'm giving it two stars, and for Mama (the one who cooks for us, a wonderful woman 👌), however, having spent two months there, I don't recommend it at all. I didn't learn anything about clinch techniques; the coaches would throw you around for 25 minutes without looking at you (they would go off to smoke their cigarettes and scroll on their phones). Not to mention that in the mornings they reeked of alcohol and were therefore unsuitable for training. I have a friend who had his power bank stolen by one of the coaches... They send you to fight alone. I fought with a Frenchman from the camp, the only one in my corner, while the guy opposite had three coaches... In short, the old level of Jocky Gym is gone. It's completely corrupt, and the progression curve is practically nonexistent. You can find much better quality for the same price. Besides, of the six Farang fights I saw, including my own, none of them won, so I'm just saying.

reviews.name: N
reviews.text:
The coaches are nice and push you adequately. But there are only 3 coaches for quite a few students. The class doesn’t feel too regimented. Every has to get their pad work in and once you’ve finished I guess you just kinda vibe or do your own thing til you spar. The sparring is where I had the biggest gripes.

Definitely not technical or sabai sabai. So depends on your preference. But to put it this way - there are essentially no Thai fighters training. Only foreigners. As a result, the sparring is much more ego driven and unnecessarily dangerous than your standard Thai gym. My partner threw hard shots as well as spinning back kicks and ignored my request to go technical, despite him saying sorry after every hard hit (he said it 5+ times).

I personally did not enjoy the culture of this gym. I don’t think it had much to do with the coaches so much as the students. I don’t necessarily put the blame on the coaches as it can be difficult to control who walks into the door, though they could have moderated the sparring better.

My understanding is this gym used to have many professional Thai fighters who have all relocated somewhere else as it become more commercial and popular with tourists.

However to each their own, if you enjoy a culture similar to boxing in western or European nations, you might not mind this at all. But if you are wanting a Thai culture, with controlled ego, strategic hard sparring when necessary - then this probably is not the best spot for you.

reviews.name: Luc-Frédéric Langis
reviews.text:
I trained at Eminent Air for one month after the recommendation from my coach.

First of all, the place is clean. They cleaned after each session, so twice a day to prevent any staph infection.

A typical training is like the following, you warm up by doing jumping rope or running 3 to 5km.

When it's done, you do some shadow boxing. After a few minutes, your coach will call you up for the padwork. Usually it's 4 rounds of 3m, 3 in Muay Thai and one in boxing. They can be technical or more focus on power or conditioning. The coach use those moment to correct you.

After the round, you will some rounds on the bags until everyone has finished his padwork. After that, light sparring time (no helmet, big gloves and shin guards). Between 3-5 rounds. Sometimes, you will only do boxing or only clinching.

When it's done, jumping knee on the bags and sit-up and that it.

I trained twiste a day, 6 days a week. It's was hard but I enjoyed every session. The coach were all lovely and they really want you to improve.

If you are willing to fight (and have enough skills) they will try to find you an opponent with the same experience and skillset. Just be sure to stay long enough to get a match. In my case, despite the effort of the coachs, they weren't able to find an opponent with the same weight and experience. They won't match you with the first person they find, they want you to have a fair fight.

If I come back to Thailand, I will definitely re-train there again without a doubt.

reviews.textTranslated: I wanted to get the battery in my Suunto D6 dive computer replaced between Saturday and Sunday so I could go diving in Koh Tao. title: Sangmorakot Muay Thai Academy
subTitle: แสงมรกต มวยไทย
address: 21 Damrong Rak Rd, Khlong Maha Nak, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

reviews.name: Allan Dowell
reviews.text:
Got in touch with the gym via Facebook, they gave me the necessary details for training. The trainers were very good and pitched things at your level. I could see a beginner being given a lot of advice on technique etc. I have been training a while, the Thai trainer changed halfway through the pad rounds, his expression etc and he started hitting me back with the pads. If you're a fighter you'll understand this is totally normal and they are helping you stay switched on and with your defence. I was happy that I was being pushed and getting a harder session. I didn't see him doing that with the lesser experienced people so I would recommend coming regardless of what level you are at. They were very friendly and respectful too. Defintely going again.

The morning training was:

About 10 mins skipping
Wrap hands, they'll help if you don't know how.
Shadow boxing for two rounds
Four pad rounds
Light sparring, mixing partners. I went with a young Thai and then another foreigner. This was about 4 or 5 rounds.

1.5 hrs in total

reviews.name: Julie Maheut
reviews.text: Perfect for all levels ! In this gym are trained very good fighters !  The coach speak enough english to understand what they want. They adapt to our level . I definitely recommend this place for an authentic experience, not like a gym full of foreigners. We even recognised one of the guy we saw during our lesson,  fighting for the ONE league (live YouTube) !

reviews.name: Omar Elouers
reviews.text: I've training here for 3 years and I can say only it's is my second home . great environment and great coaches and the best manager , definitely recommend it for anyone wants to learn real Muay Thai

reviews.name: Daniel Richards
reviews.text:
Myself and my wife stopped in here for a few lessons whilst visiting Bangkok.
Whilst my wife is a boxer I am a total novice, and neither of us had done Muai Thai before, but the guys were so accommodating and such great coaches.
Would highly recommend this gym and anyone who hasn't given Muay Thai a go before to have a go at it!

reviews.name: Cedric Magic
reviews.text:
Got to train here for a week while in Bangkok and had an amazing experience. The coaches were very knowledgeable and know how to work around the language barrier. Never felt unwelcome by them at any point quite the contrary you feel instantly part of the flow of the gym. They even invited us to join them supporting some of their fighters during an event while we were there, got to be with the team during the fighters preparations “back stage”.

We both had different levels of experience and they are quick to know your level and work with you and get the best coaching, the level they train at to is amazing and brought our level up even in the short time we got to train with them.

Can’t wait for our next trip and to train there longer.

reviews.name: Harry M
reviews.text:
Very knowledgeable Muay Thai academy. I texted the owner for more information on WhatsApp at 9am and received replies. We were two travelers, one mma practitioner and one Muay Thai practitioner looking for authentic Thai clinch lessons. The coaches were attentive and willing to work with us in English.

My friend was less experienced in Muay Thai so they worked on his basic stance and roundhouse kick. I have trained Muay Thai two years and they improved my form. They improved my right shin block, my clinch frame, my knees higher and they taught me to throw 4 punch combinations. The workout was at 3pm 10 mins jump rope with heavy jump ropes. Then they wrap your hands for you. Then 6 mins shadow boxing. 4 rounds of padwork. 4 rounds of bag work drills. After an hour they asked if I was tired. I said yes but asked for clinch. They said okay work on kick drills and then they’ll do 15 mins of clinch. All in all it was a 2 hour workout.

I could see how some visitors only get one hour. You have to demonstrate you can keep going and ask for specifically what you want to work on. I think we could have worked out for the full 4 hours 3pm-7pm if we had the stamina! 🙌🙌🙌🙏

reviews.name: Takahiro Sugaya
reviews.text: Nice gym. Trainers are trying to help you for improving. Many nationality come to train Muay Thai . When I was there there no first time people. Every one has experience and I enjoyed sparring with them.

reviews.name: Dylan Kelly
reviews.text: Great authentic gym in the heart of Bangkok. The trainers put you through your paces with pads and also rounds on the heavy bag. The owner speaks great English and is very communicative and welcoming, as are all of the trainers there. Definitely recommend for any level of Muay Thai practitioner to train here.

reviews.name: Mattia Martinelli
reviews.text: Been at the gym 2 times during our stay in BKK. Great experience and great time. The gym is located in a temple and has a very nice local vibe. Plenty of young locals training. The boss speaks English and is very welcoming; the instructors you train with don’t really speak English but can make themselves understood and improve your technique. The training consists in warm up, 4 rounds of pad works with the instructor and 4 rounds at the bag. I will definitely go back the next time in BKK. Thanks!

reviews.name: Miha Vidmar
reviews.text: Cannot recommend it. There are some great professional fighters and coaches are knowledgeble but they don't really do group classes even though they told me they do. Our session was all together 50 min long and very low effort. For 500 definitely not worth it.

reviews.name: Just Terry
reviews.text:
Best local Muay Thai gym , all the coaches are so friendly and skillful , for one lesson would be 500 THB with 4 rounds hard Thai pad training ! Morning starts at 7:30am / afternoon class starts at 3 pm
The owner Top speaks English !

reviews.name: Donatas S.
reviews.text: very good muay thai gym, very authentic, good quality training. Tried both - private and group trainings. The trainers will adapt to either you’re a total newby or an experienced fighter.

reviews.name: Rob
reviews.text:
Sangmorakot Muay Thai
I had a private lesson here and it was an amazing experience. After training at about six gyms in Bangkok, I can confidently say this is one of the top gyms. The trainers truly care and focus on teaching real technique, not just running you through drills. What makes it even more unique is that the gym is located on temple grounds, which gives the whole place a special atmosphere. Highly recommend, I will recommend this gym back here in California

reviews.name: Nick
reviews.text:
I’ve been travelling in Thailand for the past 3 weeks and have done about 8 Muay Thai sessions across various gyms in Phuket, Koh Samui and now Bangkok. I had a great session this morning at Sangmorakot. One thing that I can say definitively is the way the trainers hold the pads at this gym is far better than any gym I’ve trained at. I’m not experienced enough to know what the secret is to holding pads but there’s something about the ways these guys do it that made my rounds on the pads far better than any other place I’ve been.

Highly recommend dropping in for a session whether you’re a beginner or a serious fighter. They have some guys who fight  and also a few beginners like me so it was a great mix. For any sparring they pair the new guys with the new guys so there’s no worries there. I’ll be back tomorrow for sure.

reviews.name: Taha Tuzuner
reviews.text: I had 2 classes before coming here in different places (Chaing Mai and Krabi) but Sangmorakot is the best experience so far. (My class was mixed with different levels). Really good coaches. They answer all questions smoothly. I wish I had more time to come here again. I paid 500 bath for a session.

reviews.name: David Burns
reviews.text: Best Muay Thai Gym I’ve trained at, and I trained in Chiang Mai, Krabi, Phuket and Bangkok. This is the best one. Great coach, super friendly and solid trainers, old school gym and a strong focus on technique. Go here!!!

reviews.name: ligsy
reviews.text: Mixed feelings about this gym. First impressions were not good, lots of tourists that look like they have just walked off the street for a muay thai experience. Structure of training was a bit chaotic. But the thais were super cool, the pad holding was attentive and responsive. They have a good stable of thais that have a good attitube and train alongside the foreigners which is what you want when you fly half way across the world to train in Thailand. This is a gym that i have wanted to train at because of its history, and while it may not be the same gym as it was 20 years ago, it still shows signs of the Thai spirit. With a bit more structure to training, then i think it could be a great gym to train at long term.

reviews.name: N
reviews.text: Good friendly and polite trainers. A good fight gym, they have many good fighters here. There is no ac however.

reviews.name: Ambre M
reviews.text: It was very nice. The instructors are so nice and kind ! Perfect even for beginners and not too much expensive. Wish you the best !

reviews.name: Nacha Summart
reviews.text: I took private classes at Sangmorakot Muay Thai and had a great experience. The trainers (Kru in Thai) are professional, patient, and teach techniques clearly. The gym has a friendly, authentic fighter-camp vibe and they teach you step-by-step at your own level, so it’s great even for beginners with no background.

title: Homies Thai Cooking School
ownerDescription:
Located on Sutthisan Winitchai Road, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang—just steps from MRT Sutthisan Station.
At Homies, we offer a fun, authentic Thai cooking experience starting with a guided market tour to select the freshest ingredients.
Then, join our hands-on classes led by traditional cook in a cozy, homey setting. We provide all ingredients, equipment, and a detailed recipe book, with small group sessions for personalized learning.
Enjoy complimentary drinks during class and enjoy the dishes you create. Discover Thai culture through stories and flavors, and be part of Bangkok’s Most Popular Experience on Airbnb.

Join us for an unforgettable culinary adventure!
address: 47 Sutthisan Winitchai Rd, Khwaeng Samsen Nok, Khet Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

reviews.name: Kenny Smith
reviews.text:
Had a fantastic evening learning to cook authentic Thai food. Over 4 course our host Ray explained to us each dish, helped us prepare it and cook it. Then we had the pleasure of eating it all.
A great experience whether as a tourist or a team building exercise.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for joining us! We’re delighted to hear you had a fantastic evening cooking with Ray and enjoyed the four-course Thai menu. We look forward to welcoming you back for more delicious dishes in the future!

reviews.name: Catherine Sambula
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time cooking Thai food today! Ray and Nat were great instructors and incredibly kind and patient with our group, especially our 2 youngest chefs (7 and 8). I loved how they involved them and made sure they were safe throughout the process from prepping to cooking. We made delicious Tom Yum Goong, Pad Thai, Papaya Salad, and Mango Sticky Rice! Enjoyed everything from market to tuktuk ride to cooking and eating! Thank you Homies!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for joining our class! We're so happy you enjoyed cooking with us and hope to see you again with another class.

reviews.name: 蔡志豪
reviews.text: it’s more than perfect! we not only made 4 courses from Tom Yum soup, Pat Tai, papaya salad to mango sticky rice, each one is fun and perfect! the market shopping, Tul tuk car ride… everything is so interesting. Our teacher Nut is really nice and helpful, my wife and I had a great time with lots of photos. Definitely recommend for all my friends!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for joining our class! We're so happy you enjoyed cooking with us and hope to see you again with another class.

reviews.name: Wendy Tran
reviews.text: Booked this with my friend as we visited Bangkok for the first time. The entire experience was so lovely. Nut was our guide and he was so knowledgeable and a patient teacher! Everything we ate was delicious and we were a small group so it was nice. 100% recommend if you love to eat and to learn!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for joining our class! We're so happy you enjoyed cooking with us and hope to see you again with another class.

reviews.name: Alyssa Holmes
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible experience!! We made pad Thai, mango sticky rice, Tom yum soup, and papaya salad and every course was incredible. Highly recommend in Bangkok :) RAY YOU ROCK

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for joining our class! We're so happy you enjoyed cooking with us and hope to see you again with another class.

Shopping at the market is a great experience in combination with the tuk tub ride. A must do.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for joining our class! We're so happy you enjoyed cooking with us and hope to see you again with another class.

reviews.name: Eva A
reviews.text: Don't miss this experience! Going to the food market to get groceries,  getting a tuk tuk to the school and learning how to cook authentic Thai dishes was great! Nut did such a great job! He is really nice and professional and explained everything perfectly, we actually cook our own dishes and was easy to follow. Food was delicious and the group was also ver nice! It is a great experience for solo travellers food lovers !

reviews.name: Trenton Sobolewski
reviews.text: My fiancée and I had an amazing time at Homies! The food was amazing and our chef Nut was very friendly and knowledgeable. I would highly recommend stopping by for good food and a fun time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for choosing our class! We’re delighted you enjoyed the experience and the dishes you made. It means a lot to us. hope to see you again!

reviews.name: Ben
reviews.text:
Such a fun and lovely Thai cooking class! 🌶️
Host Nutt was super nice, patient, and shared so many useful techniques and tips about each dish. The two support members  were also kind and lovely, always smiling and helping. I learned a lot and had the best time — highly recommend! 💚
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for joining our class! We're so happy you enjoyed cooking with us and hope to see you again with another class.

reviews.name: Frances Chiong
reviews.text: Had such a great time at Homies Cooking School! They took their time teaching us each of the dishes. Josh was also very accommodating and friendly!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for joining our class! We're so happy you enjoyed cooking with us and hope to see you again with another class.

reviews.name: Abiola Adeleke
reviews.text: Instructors were sooo nice and knowledgeable. The instructions were so easy to follow. I recommend attending this. A nice way to educate yourself about Thai culture ☺️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for joining our class! We're so happy you enjoyed cooking with us and hope to see you again with another class.

reviews.name: james neroza
reviews.text: I’ve visited Bangkok many times, but joining a genuine Thai cooking class was a first for me and a top decision, sparked by an intriguing Airbnb ad. The experience was wonderful, from meeting new people to simply enjoying the learning process. The venue was ideal—perfectly sized for our group of eight—and the staff worked seamlessly together. Nat was a blessing, explaining details clearly in English, while the ladies were incredibly friendly and supportive. The food we made tasted incredible; I was amazed I had cooked it myself (with the Homies team's guidance). I loved the tuk-tuk ride, though the market visit was a bit warm for me—still, I’d recommend it, especially if you’re new to Asian wet markets. The whole experience was absolutely fantastic
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for joining our class! We're so happy you enjoyed cooking with us and hope to see you again.

reviews.name: Lidia Ameljan-Kowalska
reviews.text: Instructor Ray is the best guy ever!! We cooked so much, he was teaching us about ingredients and really letting us do everything on our own. Food? Delicious, simply OUTSTANDING. Atmosphere? SO WARM AND LOVELY. Knowledge we got? INFINITEEEE. Really the times there was so lovely 🥹🫶 if you want to learn how to pick ingredients, how to cook, step by step and learn in practice, this is the place for you. After you got all of the recipes so you can really enjoy and not worry about writing everything down on your phone. I'm from Poland, my group had people from all over the world so we were talking all the time about our experience and funny stories. Ray is speaking VERY good english and he is genuinely so funny and lovely. I recommend this place with all my heart.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for lovely review. We're so happy to happy to have you here hope to see you again with another fun class.
Koch & Team Homies.

reviews.name: Nicole Kang
reviews.text: Amazing class! All was so simple to make and tastes fabulous. Great instructors and assistant. Highly recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for joining our class! We're so happy you enjoyed cooking with us and hope to see you again with another class.

reviews.name: C M
reviews.text: Such a great and authentic experience. We really enjoyed the walk through the market, and Nut was so lovely, showing us all the local produce. He is a such a great host and good instructor. All the dishes were delicious and all the ingredients provided in the cooking session were so fresh. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're thrilled to hear you had such an authentic and enjoyable experience. Exploring the market and cooking with fresh, local ingredients is what we love most so glad you enjoyed every bite! We truly appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you back again

reviews.name: Jesus Garcia
reviews.text: Fantastic experience. We walked through the food market and we're explained numerous ingredients and foods. Then we did the hands on work and made these delicious items. Our instructor, Nut, was so patient and thorough. Highly recommends cooking with your favorite Homies.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for sharing your experience! We're thrilled you enjoyed the market tour and hands-on cooking it's all about diving deep into Thai flavors and having fun while doing it. hope to see you again with another class.
Koch & Team Homies

reviews.name: NAGRAJ VERNEKAR
reviews.text: This Thai cooking class was an absolute highlight of my trip. Everything was very well organized, and the kitchen setup was both beautiful and comfortable to work in. The instructor explained each step clearly, which made the whole experience enjoyable even for beginners. We prepared a four-course meal, and every dish turned out amazing. Overall, it was a wonderful, satisfying, and truly delightful experience. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for sharing your experience! We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the class and found the kitchen setup welcoming and easy to work in. It’s wonderful that the instructor’s guidance made the cooking process clear and fun, and we’re thrilled your four-course meal turned out amazing. Knowing the class was a highlight of your trip truly means a lot to us. We look forward to welcoming you back for more delicious adventures! 
Koch & Team Homies

reviews.name: 박한강
reviews.text: The restaurant recently moved. It is now across from Naka Weekend Market. The food is still delicious, fancy, and excellent.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much.

reviews.name: Julia Olech
reviews.text: Best Thai restaurant around! Crispy mango rolls with coconut sauce were amazing. Pineapple fried rice with shrimp – delicious! Perfectly fried seafood and fresh salad. Great flavors, beautiful presentation – I’ll be back!

reviews.name: Оксана Испанова
reviews.text:
After 3 years in Thailand, I could not believe that I had found the perfect place for me with local Thai cuisine. 😍

The doctor doesn’t let me eat spicy but at this place they know the best way to cook Thai food without chili 🌶 if you need.

The portions are large and the prices are +-150 baht per one.  Really delicious. 😋 A lot of vegetables make this food really healthy for me. 🥰

The place is located in a quiet area on a mountain surrounded by 🌳 There is a hiking track to the Big Buddha in 500 meters from the restaurant.  🫰

Very polite staff.  They speak good English, they organize cooking classes.  I would definitely love to send my mother for a master class here.

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Chicken with Cashew, Fried Vegetables with Chicken

reviews.name: Yuliya Kudryavtseva
reviews.text: 10 out of 10 find! It's an absolutely amazing restaurant with not only delicious Thai food but also a delightful atmosphere. My family and I were so warmly welcomed and served in no time. We left "the Jungle" full and absolutely happy (not to mention a couple of cheeky gin & tonics that is a must when you are on holidays). Thank you, Jungle, we will definitely come back next time we are in Phuket! 🙏

reviews.name: Gail Rimeika
reviews.text: In one word... Stunning! The best place we've eaten in in Thailand (that's at the end of our 2 weeks' holiday!). From the moment we got in we felt at home:) everyone there is so sweet, funny and friendly, very informal, just our kind of place. The owner saw me watch her making our papaya salad and invited me to watch her from up close and went through all the steps with me. Amazing experience and that was even before we got our food:) and the food was amazing, we got steamed fish, seafood pad Thai and papaya salad. The portions were very generous and the food tasted simply glorious. Everything prepared fresh and you can definitely feel it! Really felt like eating at a friend/family rather than a restaurant. Go there, now!!! 👌❤️

reviews.name: M P
reviews.text: This family run restaurant is a hidden gem. 💎 High quality Thai food. Chicken was cooked to perfection. Lovely atmosphere and view. Also you get a nice breeze through the restaurant that feels great! Worth going off the main areas to eat here. The owner also offers cooking classes here !

reviews.name: Dean Tan
reviews.text:
My favourite thai restaurant in phuket. The food's really delicious and Chel's hospitality makes it feel just like home. If you have time, definitely do a cooking class, its so much fun!

p.s. fish was outrageously good
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much.

reviews.name: Leah Jasmine Amis
reviews.text:
Really good food & quiet atmosphere away from the busyness of the Main Street.
We came here 2 nights in a row and would visit again!
Recommend: Spring rolls / Pad Thai / pad see ew / Coconut soup / banana pancakes / banana samosas / mango shake / banana shake.

reviews.name: Minna Pyykönen
reviews.text:
Loved, loved, LOVED this place! Best restaurant in Karon on our 2 week trip. Had lunch once and dinner twice.

All the dishes were pretty as a picture and tasted amazing. The staff were super friendly and entertained our one year old daughter 🥰 they have a baby chair as well.

Totally worth the climb or a tuk tuk ride! Highly recommend 👍🏻

reviews.name: Kostas Taptas
reviews.text:
A fine little restaurant away from the hustle and bustle of Kata beach. We went there by scooter and the way is like a rollercoaster, but it was definitely worth it. Every dish we tried was delicious, the prices are quite reasonable and the staff is super friendly and funny. We enjoyed it so much we came again the next day. Don't miss the cute chicken roaming freely between the tables :)
Highly, highly recommended!

reviews.name: Đình Tài Nguyễn
reviews.text: very nice authentic Thai food indeed. There are also cooking class for Thai food, the staffs are nice and professional. The road to go in the restaurant is very sloppy so make sure you wear good slippers or drive well. I went in at night time, it’s a bit buggy so for those who are sensitive, maybe you should bring some mosquitoes spray.

reviews.name: Jenny Wiscombe
reviews.text: A hidden gem!!! We discovered this amazing place by accident while walking up to the big Buddha. The food is all so fresh and the presentation is beautiful! Anything can be made vegetarian. We loved it so much we came back for the owners cookery course which was brilliant! Highly recommend this place tucked away up the hill in the peaceful jungle.

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Mango Sticky Rice, Tom Yum Soup, Spring Roll

reviews.name: Riot Arms
reviews.text:
Everything screams traditional Thailand.

Great food at great prices.

Everything authentic and nicely prepared.

Highly recommend coming here during sunset; not because you can see the sunset but see the shift in colours as the sun goes down.

We witnessed a rainstorm go over us and the lightning show was amazing.

They even gave a small fruit dish for free!

Word of warning - there are some steep hills and dirt parts. Make sure you go slow especially during the dark!

reviewContext.Parking: Number of spots for motorbikes along side.
reviewContext.Kid-friendliness: Good kids menu. Fried food options and classic Thai dishes

reviews.name: Aimee Rogers
reviews.text: This is an amazing restaurant and the best dinner we had whilst staying in Kata. The food and the service are both brilliant. We came for a friends birthday meal and the owner Chel and her team made it such a special night. Would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Yuki A
reviews.text:
Food, service and view were fantastic! Especially the pineapple fried rice, it’s probably the best one I have had so far compared with the last 9 times of traveling in Thailand.
The staffs were very friendly and warm.
It’s located on the top of a hill. We used BOLT to grab a taxi here which was 200 baht.  But still worth coming here, because the tastes of dish ordered were amazing! Btw, the portions were bigger than most restaurants we have been to.
The only thing not convenient was it’s cash-only. ( Actually we didn’t have enough cash to pay the bill, but the staff gave us a discount.)

reviews.name: Steven De Moortel
reviews.text:
This place is worth the ride!

The food is stunning and well served. BUT the hospitality makes you fall in love.

They made us feel like home, so thankful.

reviews.name: Almir Zupcic
reviews.text:
An amazing experience well worth it!

Genuine Thai food prepared by the most sweetest women. This is the one you don’t want to miss. We had to come back here again on the second day, and kids already now wish to come back again tomorrow for our third lunch.

The food is simply amazing…..Masaman, Phaneng, chicken wings, Mango shake (OMG!!!)

reviews.name: RollingAlong
reviews.text: Had a terrific meal here. It's way up on the slope in karon and a fun challenging ride to get to but very much worth the effort. Food is great, inexpensive and cooked and served by some very charming ladies. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Thomas Widemann
reviews.text:
This is hands down the best food around Karon. Hard to reach by foot so take a taxi or scooter. But it’s worth every meter.

The food is absolutely fresh, tasty and for free you get the most amazing sunset if you come at the right time. 100/5 stars if I could.

reviews.name: Ekkehard Riegler
reviews.text: It was definitely worth taking the journey! We were the only guests in this restaurant but it was beautiful and very authentic! The food was top and very nicely prepared. Super nice service and very attentive. Thank you for everything! Would love to come back.

I would like to commend and thank Instructors Rin, Roy, and Uey, as well as all the assistant staff for their great care and attention to the students. I highly recommend this program; you won't be disappointed.

reviews.text: ดีมาก เริสเวอร์ Enjoy เวอร์ อาจารย์ บุคลากรคือมืออาชีพ เป็นกันเอง จากทำอะไรไม่เป็นเลย ตอนนี้เปิดโลกเรื่องอาหารขั้นสุด สรุปจบได้3 ใบบบบบบบบ ค่าาา

reviews.textTranslated:
The management is terrible. Anyone thinking of studying here should think again. Read the reviews carefully.
The schedule is unreliable; they postpone it whenever they feel like it, wasting the time of people who take time off work to attend.
There are no teaching materials provided; they just give you individual sheets of paper.
The staff are focused on sales; when problems arise, they pass the buck to the instructors.
In short, if you have the money, do your research thoroughly before deciding to study here, because it's not just the money you're losing, but also your time.

title: Roctopus™ | Koh Tao Diving Center
ownerDescription: Roctopus Dive started life on July 8th 2011 when a group of Dive Pro friends got together and began to build a dive family. Our mission was to pioneer new and improved ways of teaching Scuba. Our aim was to re-energise the dive industry and allow our passion and professionalism to guide our team development! Roctopus Dive continues to inspire and train the highest quality of scuba dive courses from beginners to pro level & divemaster internships. We do this within a fun and professional environment with an awesome team and a beachfront location. Come join the sub culture!
address: 17, Sairee Beach, Tambon Ko Tao, Koh Tao, Surat Thani 84360, Thailand
plusCode: 3RXH+VP Ko Tao, Ko Pha-ngan District, Surat Thani, Thailand

reviews.name: Ho Ching Kong
reviews.text: Really nice OW course experience with our superb instructor- Anna! She taught us the theories and skills clearly (which is very important for a beginner:)!) and allow us to take our own time. The staffs at Roctopus were very professional and friendly too. Recommend all to take scuba diving courses in Roctopus with Anna!

reviews.name: Ploy Pittayathanakul
reviews.text: I had the best time doing my Open Water and Advanced courses with Beth, Sergi, and Nina! They were all so patient, friendly, and made learning scuba diving so much fun. I was pretty nervous at first, but they always made me feel safe, encouraged, and never pressured me. Thanks to them, I finished the course feeling so much more confident and excited to keep diving. Couldn’t have asked for a better team—thank you all for making my first scuba experience so memorable! Highly recommend!

reviews.text: I recently completed my Advanced Open Water course with Roctopus Dive and had an excellent experience. Having dived with several dive centres in Koh Tao, this one truly stood out. From the moment I was welcomed by Beks, the atmosphere was friendly, professional, and reassuring. A special thanks to Calvin, who was an outstanding instructor and made me feel comfortable throughout the course. Even when I was feeling unwell on the boat, both Calvin and Beks went above and beyond to ensure I was well looked after. The diving was fantastic, the team was highly professional, and I’m already looking forward to completing more courses with Roctopus in the future. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Awesome!

reviews.name: Rebecca Thompson
reviews.text: 5 stars is simply not enough! Completing the OW20 with Roctopus was hands down one of my best life/travel experiences! Diving unlocks a completely new world, full of discovery and awe. Our instructor Keli was truely a scuba angel, guiding us through the course with ease, helping with personal equipment fittings, calming nervous minds (mine) and educating us in a way that reinforced our safety at every turn. The course is incredibly well structured with theory, swim tests, pool sessions and 4 dives. Roctopus do a fantastic job creating an inclusive environment, hosting theory at local cafes and inviting participants to social gatherings, rubbish clean ups and other environmentally focused initiatives. The entire Team was so so friendly and collectively had such a wealth of knowledge and years upon years of diving experience. I truely had the best adventure and couldn't recommend Roctopus more highly! Special thanks to those who made it incredible! Jay, Jess, Chelsey, Ale, Sofi, P'Nam and our #1 Keli you guys are amazing! Join the subculture..you wont regret it 🤙🏼
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Stella review rebecca thanks for taking the time. We are extremely proud of our team and super happy you had such a great time. Hope to see you back real

reviews.name: Brisa Mann
reviews.text: Our experience with Roctopus was better than we could have imagined! We had an exciting week completing our open water and advanced courses. Our instructor for open water, Chelsey York, is a gifted teacher. She explains everything thoroughly and cares deeply about your knowledge retention and safety. By the end of the four open water dives, we had improved so much and felt very comfortable conducting all the emergency procedure skills. Our advanced instructor, Beth Guirr, brings the energy and fun to each dive. She had great advice for how we could grow as divers and even included games underwater that advanced our skills. These two ladies were a wealth of knowledge and we feel so fortunate to have learned from them. All the staff we interacted with at Roctopus were friendly and professional. The captain and his crew were wonderful and super helpful when we were exiting and returning to the boat. We would recommend Roctopus to anybody and everybody!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Aw lovely words. Thank you

reviews.name: Allie Dotson
reviews.text:
I had never scuba dived before — I had never even snorkeled — but Roctopus and our dive instructor, Adrian, made the entire experience feel effortless and exciting from the very beginning. He made sure I had the proper training and understood everything thoroughly before we even got into the pool to practice, and only then moved on to diving in the ocean.

My best friend and I enjoyed the experience so much that we immediately signed up for the Advanced 30 after completing the Open Water course. Diving truly is addictive in the best way possible. Adrian was patient, encouraging, and incredibly kind throughout the entire process. He genuinely cared about us not just as students, but as people. He even made sure we had eaten before dives and would sometimes hold classes at a local restaurant so we were fueled and prepared for later dives. Safety was always his top priority, and he took extra precautions to ensure everyone felt comfortable, confident, and protected in the water.

One of the locals on the island even told us, “You can always tell who the Roctopus divers are because of how skilled they are underwater.” After our experience, I completely understand why.

We feel incredibly lucky to have had such an amazing instructor and such an outstanding company for our first diving experience. I cannot recommend Roctopus enough — Roctopus all the way!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: So much love for the Shop💙💙. We thank you from the bottom of our heart.

reviews.name: Nikki
reviews.text:
I had the best open water diving course with Beth and her assistant Heemz. I felt comfortable, learned amazing tools for me to dive well in the ocean. I used to be afraid of deep water but they helped me get over that fear. What I loved most about them as instructors is that they don’t just teach you by the book, they actually take the time to understand each student, personalize the experience, and give you the tools and confidence you need to become a better diver. I never felt rushed or judged, and I always felt like I was in the best hands.

Beth is an amazing instructor, and Heemz was such a great assistant throughout the entire course. You can truly tell that they care about their students and want you to succeed, not just pass the course.

If you’re thinking about getting your Open Water certification, I HIGHLY recommend Roctopus, especially Beth and Heemz. They made this experience unforgettable and gave me a new confidence in the ocean that I’ll carry with me into every dive. Couldn’t have asked for better instructors! 🐠🌊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We wish you many happy days in the

reviews.name: Rach
reviews.text:
We had the best experience with Roctopus and honestly can’t recommend them enough. We completed both our Open Water and Advanced courses with Chelsey, and she was absolutely incredible from start to finish.

We originally had no intention of doing our Advanced course, but after how much we enjoyed Open Water with her, it was an easy decision to continue. Chelsey made everything feel relaxed, fun, and really confidence-building — we always felt completely safe and supported in the water.

What really stood out about Roctopus was the quality of the training. There was a strong focus on the key skills like buoyancy and trim positioning, which made a huge difference. By the end of our Open Water, we already felt more capable and in control than we expected — and honestly more advanced than what we’ve seen from other schools.

On top of that, the vibe at the school is just great. Super friendly, professional, and passionate about diving without ever feeling too rigid or overwhelming.

If you’re considering diving in Koh Tao, do yourself a favour and go with Roctopus — and if you can, request Chelsey. You won’t regret it.

reviews.name: שובל כהן
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this diving school in Koh Tao! 🤿🌊

I did my Open Water certification here with a friend, and the whole experience was absolutely amazing. One of the things I really loved is that the groups are very small, with a maximum of 4 people. In our case, it was just the two of us with our instructor, Liam, which made the experience feel very personal and comfortable.
I especially want to recommend Liam. We were both really nervous and stressed at the beginning, but Liam was incredibly patient, supportive, and attentive. He took the time to explain everything to us step by step, making sure we understood exactly what we needed to do before and during the dive.
He constantly checked on us, encouraged us, and knew exactly how to calm us down whenever we felt nervous. His patience and support gave us so much confidence and made us feel safe throughout the entire experience.
Liam was honestly the best instructor we could have asked for, and he made what started as a very stressful experience into an amazing and unforgettable one.

If you’re planning to dive in Koh Tao, I highly recommend asking for Liam as your instructor! 🐠💙
Thank you for an incredible experience! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: Sagar Khatri
reviews.text:
Had an absolutely amazing experience diving with Roctopus in Koh Tao. I have done quite a bit of diving, and this was genuinely one of the best experiences I have had.
The team at Roctopus is incredibly professional. Everything was perfectly organized, from the boat briefings and dive planning to the punctuality, customer service, and attention to safety. They make safety a top priority while keeping the atmosphere fun, relaxed, and welcoming.
A huge thank you to Arthur, who I was lucky enough to dive with for five dives. He was calm, knowledgeable, observant, and always looking out for everyone in the group. Diving with him gave me complete confidence underwater and made every dive truly enjoyable.
Special thanks also to Bex, who led our final dive. She was fantastic and managed to find my favourite marine creature, a Moray Eel, which made the dive unforgettable. Her enthusiasm, confidence, and incredible eye for spotting marine life added so much to the experience.
I also want to thank Westy, the main boss of the dive center, for being so kind and accommodating. You can really feel that the whole team is passionate about diving and creating a welcoming environment. They even organize beach cleanups, which shows how much they care about the local environment and community.
By the end of the trip, the team truly felt like family. They are friendly, professional, and genuinely awesome people. If you are considering diving in Koh Tao, I cannot recommend Roctopus highly enough. I cannot wait to dive with them again.

reviews.text:
Can’t recommend Roctopus Dive center enough! We had an amazing experience from start to finish, and the dive sites were absolutely incredible.

A special thank you to our instructor, Katie, who made the whole experience unforgettable. She was patient, kind, and incredibly fun to be around. Her enthusiasm and positive energy made every dive even more enjoyable. My friend and I went to Roctopus because of an acquaintance that has been diving there and without any real diving experience.

We had the pleasure that Kyle 'The Legend' (as they call him) was our instructor and we had an absolute blast! We started with our open Water 20 and really focused on buoyancy and feeling confident underwater. Kyle really focused on individuals and his tips were always spot on.

After the Open Water 20 we were hooked and went immediately for the Advanced 30 where the 5 extra dives and especially the Deep dive were a huge bonus and gave a lot more confidence underwater.

We can't thank Kyle enough for his incredible approach and his chill vibes, no-nonsense, all laughs!

It was a truly unforgettable experience of our Travel days!!

Thanks a lot and looking forward to being back!

THIS IS THAILAND!!
