reviews.name: Kayla Reifel
reviews.text:
Diving with Roctopus was an incredible experience; I can’t sing its praises enough!!! I came to Koh Tao with a friend and everyone seemed to be scuba diving so we figured we had to try it too. We booked a Try Dive with Rocto and the experience was so so awesome. It completely exceeded our expectations and we were totally hooked. Beth was our try dive instructor and we could immediately tell she was a really talented diver and teacher and just all around great person. We learned a lot, felt super safe, and had so much fun in just a single day thanks to her.

I changed my travel plans pretty much right after that to come back to Koh Tao a couple weeks later to do the open water course and had Jay as my instructor who was also a really fantastic, professional, and thorough teacher who gave me a super strong foundation of knowledge and confidence. I immediately signed up for the advanced course and was super excited to have Beth again. She was an even better instructor than I remembered which I didn’t think was possible. I had so much fun and learned a ton in a whirlwind of five awesome dives during the advanced course. Topped it all off with two lovely dives with Andrew at Sail Rock; perfect way to spend my last day in Koh Tao.

It was such a pleasure to learn from people that possess the rare triple threat of loving what they do, being great at what they do, and being great at teaching others to do what they do. I loved learning how to dive at Roctopus and am so grateful I stumbled in, it is 1000% the Koh Tao dive shop to choose whether you’re thinking of learning or have been diving for years.

I’m already plotting my return… see you again soon, thanks guys!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much!

title: Rinny's Kitchen
ownerDescription:
Rinny's Kitchen is a Korean Restaurant which is based in Chalong Soi Soi Ta-iad. One and only Fried Chicken which is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.
The best taste that you won't regret.
We also have bibimbab.
address: 14, 26 Soi Ta-iad, Chalong, Amphoe Mueang Phuket, Phuket 83130, Thailand
plusCode: V922+2J Chalong, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Sarah Song
reviews.text:
Best Korean food you’ll find in Thailand! The service is so good and attentive.
The food is made by Korean mom and made with love!
The kimchi stew is sweet and savory, perfect for my taste. It comes with pork, firm tofu and rice. I can’t wait to come back to try the other stews which are harder to find in the area like seolungtang!
The owner Rinny speaks fluent English, Korean and Thai! Shes super sweet and friendly, even gave me cute stickers.

Lastly the coffee is great! I’ve had many americanos but theirs was smooth yet still strong!

The inside vibe is cozy and cutely decorated too.
They end your meal with watermelon.
I definitely plan to be back often!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this beautiful review, Sarah 🥹💖 Reading this truly made our day! We’re so happy you enjoyed the food, coffee, and cozy atmosphere at Rinny’s Kitchen. Our Korean mom always cooks with lots of love and care, so hearing that you could feel it means so much to us 🫶
We’re especially glad you loved the kimchi stew and americano ☕️✨ We can’t wait for you to try the seolleongtang and our other homemade dishes next time too!
Thank you for mentioning the service and little details like the stickers and watermelon 🍉 It was such a pleasure meeting you, and we’ll always be happy to welcome you back again soon 💕

reviewContext.Vegetarian options: Bibimbap and kimbap! Just make sure to request so they don’t accidentally use ingredients like fish sauce.

reviews.name: Mila tris
reviews.text: It was incredibly delicious!! What an amazing place! The staff was so friendly, and everything was served quickly and with a smile. The fruit salad was unbelievably tasty, the sweet-and-sour chicken was out of this world, and the glass noodles with beef were simply amazing!! Thank you so much! I highly recommend it to everyone. We’ve been there twice already, and we’ll definitely be back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🥹💛 We’re truly happy to hear that you enjoyed everything — especially the fruit salad, sweet-and-sour chicken, and glass noodles with beef! Your kind words about our staff and service mean a lot to us.
It makes us so happy to know you’ve already visited us twice and plan to come back again. Thank you for recommending us to everyone! We can’t wait to welcome you back again soon!

reviews.name: vitriana jessica
reviews.text: All the food are so delicious. We really enjoyed the bibimbap, the kimchi is so good, tuk bulgogi is also very savory, and lastly the korean fried chicken was so tasty and spicy! Love all the food and we finished everything :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words! 😊 We’re so happy you enjoyed the bibimbap, kimchi, tteok bulgogi, and our spicy Korean fried chicken 🔥 It means a lot to us that you loved everything and finished it all! Hope to see you again soon for another delicious meal at Rinny’s 💛

reviews.name: Heather Rasameetham
reviews.text: Rinny’s Cafe is ADORABLE and just what I was hoping to find here in Phuket! If you love Korean food but aren’t feeling committed to an entire bbq setup, Rinny’s is a great alternative with an extensive menu including breakfast, lunch, and dinner options for sharing or dining solo. There are so many dishes I want to try so I’ll definitely be back. I had bibimbap and a mango milkshake, and Rinny gave me the rest of the most delicious mango for dessert. They also have homemade kimchi which I’ll be returning for specifically. Conveniently located as you turn onto Fitness Street. You can’t and shouldn’t miss it 🥢
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Wow, you found us — now there’s no escape from the kimchi cravings 😆 Thank you so much for your sweet review! We’re so happy you enjoyed the bibimbap, mango milkshake, and our little mango surprise 🥭✨
Our menu is always here for your next Korean food adventure (and yes, the homemade kimchi will be waiting for you too 😉). Can’t wait to have you back for round two… or three! 🥢

reviews.name: Sheldon Wong
reviews.text: Happy to have Korean food here in Thailand. We love Thai food, but we craved Korean tonight, and luckily this place was nearby. Food was delicious and reasonably priced. Rinny was very friendly and offered us complimentary mango for dessert. Thanks, Rinny!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Aww thank you so much! 🥹💖 When the Korean food craving hits, we’re so happy you found us! Masaya kami na nag-enjoy kayo sa food at sa presyo too 😉
And of course, free mango because you’re awesome 🍋✨ Salamat po and hope to see you again soon—balik po kayo ha!

reviews.name: Nina Schroeder
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my visit here. The owner was very nice and friendly, which made the experience even better. The food came out quickly and was super fresh and tasty. Definitely a place I’d come back to again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words, Phanita. We truly appreciate your support and are delighted you enjoyed the food and your experience with us. Looking forward to seeing you again soon.

reviews.name: Mia Kim
reviews.text:
Beautiful atmosphere, very warm welcoming!!
No doubt you will be enjoying their food, guaranteed from koreans!!
Now I need Gaviscon due to indigestion!! Had them a lotttt, can’t help but stop!!
You wouldn’t regret to drop by here before leaving Phuket!! 🤞🤞🤞🤞
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Mia. We’re grateful you felt warm and welcomed here. Sorry our food made you eat a little too much today 😅 Your recommendation means a lot to us. Wishing you a smooth trip from Phuket!

reviews.name: Daniel Bohlen
reviews.text: This is very delicious Korean food, made with love by a Korean family. I'm so happy that I have a place to get my Korean food fix. I'm staying here for the next 30 days so I'll be eating here often. Can't wait to try everything!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Daniel! 😊 Careful… 30 days of Korean food here might turn you into part of the family 😂 See you again very soon!

reviews.name: Carl Castro
reviews.text: How do I put this? At first I didn’t expect much of this place but man, it exceeded my expectations. Their food was great. I got the kimchi jiggae and that’s one of the best one I’ve had. Their kimchi was so good too that I ended up buying some to take home. The food feels very homey! Highly recommend this place 😎
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your thoughtful review. 😊 We're truly grateful that you gave our little place a try and even happier to hear that you enjoyed the food. It means a lot to us that our homemade kimchi and kimchi jjigae were to your liking, and we're so thankful you chose to take some kimchi home as well. Your kind words and recommendation are a great encouragement to us. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you again. Thank you so much for your support. ❤️

reviews.name: Katherine Corogenes
reviews.text:
Super cute cafe on the Soi serving homemade Korean comfort food as well as poke bowls, pasta, and breakfast.

I so enjoyed meeting Rinny and her family, who helped me pick the perfect dish and made me an awesome white chocolate latte.

I will 💯 be back again soon!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Aww thank you so much for this lovely review 🥹🤍
We’re really happy you enjoyed the cozy vibes and our homemade Korean comfort food (plus the poke bowls, pasta, and breakfast too 😉). It was such a pleasure meeting you, and we loved chatting with you about MMA fights—especially hearing your fight stories! 💪🥊 That made the visit even more fun.
So glad you enjoyed the white chocolate latte ☕✨
Can’t wait to welcome you back again very soon! 💯💛

reviews.name: Rachel Lee
reviews.text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is comfortable. I especially love their homemade jam, it’s so yummy!. We went back the next day again before heading off Phuket. Hope to visit you again, Rinny!

It was wonderful to have you visit not just once but twice—safe travels to Phuket, and we can’t wait to welcome you back again someday! 🌟

reviews.name: Deon
reviews.text:
Delicious authentic Korean food! As a Korean that’s been living in this island for over a year, I’ve tried many different korean restaurants and this place definitely ranks among the top.
Everything I tried today was on point! I’ll definitely be back to try their other dishes.

Edit: I’ve came back a couple more times and I can confirm that each dish is delicious! This place has quickly become my favorite spot to come to when I crave my country’s food. The owners are super friendly as well
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review and hope you will come to phuket till then good luck in training in Argentina. Stay safe and healthy 🙏

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Absolutely the best Korean food I’ve had! Every dish was full of flavor, fresh, and beautifully presented. The menu has so many great options, from classics to unique specialties, and everything we tried was delicious. The service was just as impressive friendly, attentive, and made us feel so welcome the entire time. You can really tell they care about their customers.

The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, perfect for enjoying a meal with friends or family. I left feeling so satisfied and already can’t wait to come back again. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for authentic Korean food and an amazing dining experience✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Melissa, you made our kimchi blush with this review 🥰💖 Thank you so much for noticing the love we put into every dish (and every smile)! We’re so happy you enjoyed the flavors, the vibes, and our little cozy spot 💕 Can’t wait to welcome you back again for another round of deliciousness — maybe we’ll even surprise you with something new next time 😋✨

reviews.text: I got a 60 minute oil massage and it was absolutely amazing. The masseuse was great and catered to my specific needs. The prices were great too and came with complementary tea before and after the massage. The spa itself was very ambient and relaxing. 100% recommend.

reviews.name: Gregory Czerwinski
reviews.text: I had a really great experience here. The place was super clean and well taken care of, which I always appreciate. The staff were friendly and made everything easy and comfortable. The massage itself was amazing—really skilled and exactly what I needed. I left feeling totally relaxed and refreshed. Definitely recommend if you’re in Bangkok and looking for a good massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: So glad you found exactly what you needed in Bangkok! 😊 We’re happy our team made you feel comfortable and that the massage left you feeling refreshed. We truly appreciate the recommendation!

reviews.name: xiulan Tsukita
reviews.text: Around 5 PM this afternoon, I experienced lower back pain that caused muscle soreness in my left leg, limiting my leg movement. I searched online for several highly-rated massage parlors and decided to give it a try. When I entered, the place wasn't crowded. I looked at the menu and chose a service that suited my needs. The only downside was that they only accepted cash. The masseuse, named Phat, wasn't particularly muscular, but her technique was good. A 90-minute session cost 600 baht, and they offered hot tea and snacks afterward. Next time, I might try the herbal hot compress; it felt quite nice.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re glad Phat could help relieve your lower back and leg discomfort! 😊 It’s great to hear you enjoyed your session, tea, and snacks. The herbal hot compress sounds like a perfect choice for next time—can’t wait to see you again! Khob khun ka 🙏

Au provided me a Neck, foot and leg message. It was absolutely amazing. She is very strong and her fingers hit all the right spots. She is amazing

Nam provided a Thai massage for my wife. She said, and I quote "That was the best massage of my entire life. My body feels better than it ever has. At the end, Nam asked me if I was still alive. I was more alive than ever before" She loves Nam and thinks she's the best masseuse ever

reviews.text: This is the best massage  I ever had so far! The place is extremely clean, inviting and peaceful. She is gentle, attentive and extremely professional. Don’t hesitate to make a stop and try it for yourself.

reviews.name: Ashley Gonzalez
reviews.text:
Bangkok is not short of massage places, you can practically find one on any corner. Why I chose this massage shop out of many that I’ve walked past and felt pressured to walk in. CCare Massage Bangkok is slightly tucked away from a busy street. It provided more privacy and with comparable prices and possibly better quality services in a relaxing environment compared to others around. We came before 3PM which they offer a 15% discount on all services. My husband and I both got the Aroma Massage. Once booked we received a cold towel and water. Then followed my a quick foot wash before entering the massage room. We both had the room to ourselves to privately undress and get ready for the massage. Following the massage staff lets you shower to wash off any excess oil. Lastly, you end your time with a complementary tea and water. My husband already wants to return and we just left.

Only note is that the women here hardly speak any English.

Overall, for the quality of service, privacy, and everything you get included with the price is pretty unbeatable. If you have a chance or wondering if you should get a massage. I would recommend to come here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind and detailed review. We are truly delighted to hear that you and your husband enjoyed your experience at CCare Massage Bangkok. It means a lot to us that you chose our shop among the many options in the city, and we’re glad our peaceful setting and quality of service made a positive impression.

We’re happy to know you appreciated the little touches — from the cold towel and welcome drink to the foot wash, private room, and post-massage tea. Providing a relaxing and comfortable experience for our guests is always our top priority.

Thank you also for your understanding regarding the language barrier. We are continuously working to improve our communication and service for international guests.

We hope to welcome you both back again soon. Until then, we wish you safe and happy travels!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! So glad you and your partner had a great experience during your 60min massage. We love keeping things relaxing and welcoming, and our staff is thrilled to hear you found them very professional. Can't wait until you come again! 🙌✨

reviews.name: Dionis Quek
reviews.text:
I honestly wonder where the 4.9-star rating comes from.

I booked a 2-hour relaxing oil massage for 1,300 baht, which is more expensive than many other massage places in Bangkok. Unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing. The massage felt more like light touching than an actual massage.

I asked the therapist twice to apply more pressure. Instead of adjusting her technique, she proceeded to step on me with her full body weight, which was extremely uncomfortable and left me struggling to breathe at one point.

The massage was also very inconsistent. The left and right sides of my body were treated differently, with no clear routine or technique. It felt as though the therapist was simply doing whatever she felt like rather than following a professional massage sequence.

What concerned me even more was the lack of privacy. I was assigned a room on the first floor facing the entrance, and the therapist left the curtain partially open during the session. Considering that I was completely naked under the towel, this made me feel extremely uncomfortable and exposed, as people outside could potentially see into the room.

I’ve visited Bangkok many times and had massages at countless establishments, but this was by far the worst massage experience I’ve ever had. Considering the price and the high rating, I expected much better. Instead of coming here I rather book from GoWabi for outcall at the comfort of my own hotel room and so much cheaper and provides good massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are truly sorry to hear that your experience fell so short of your expectations, especially given our high rating and the price you paid. Your comfort, privacy, and satisfaction are incredibly important to us, and it is clear we failed to deliver on all fronts during your visit.

We have taken your review very seriously and are addressing your concerns with our team immediately:

Technique and Pressure: We apologize that the pressure was inconsistent and shifted drastically from too light to uncomfortably heavy. Our therapists are trained to adjust pressure safely and professionally, and we are retraining the staff to ensure feedback is handled correctly without resorting to unsafe or uncomfortable techniques.

Privacy Concerns: Keeping the curtain open is completely unacceptable. We understand how uncomfortable and exposed this must have made you feel. We have strictly reinforced our privacy protocols with all staff members to ensure curtains are fully closed and guest privacy is strictly maintained at all times.

Routine Consistency: A professional massage should always be balanced and consistent. Your feedback regarding the lack of structure has been shared with our manager to review our therapist training standards.

We completely understand your frustration, and we know we cannot undo the negative experience you had. We would appreciate the opportunity to make this right. If you are willing, please contact us directly so we can discuss how to resolve this for you. Your feedback is vital in helping us improve, and we hope to earn back your trust in the future.

reviews.name: Liugi
reviews.text: We had an absolutely incredible experience at the spa today, as Nan and Nong provided one of the best massage experiences we have ever had. Their technique was flawless, but what truly set the session apart was the incredible attention to detail. From the perfect temperature of the room and the subtle use of aromatherapy to the way they intuitively adjusted their pressure and ensured our comfort at every transition, every small touch felt intentional and deeply restorative.

reviews.name: Trent Melsheimer
reviews.text: My wife and I did a 3 hour spa package at Ayurah during our honeymoon with Nan and Nong. The experience was nothing short of incredible and was a major highlight of our honeymoon. So much so that my wife booked another session for the next morning. I’ve had many massages in the past but this one was one of the best, if not THE best. Hope to come back next time we’re in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Jitraporn Boonjuang
reviews.text:
I just returned from Thailand and had the most amazing time at Ayurah Spa during their Rejuvenate Wellness Retreat. From start to finish, it was peaceful, luxurious, and deeply healing.

The spa itself is absolutely beautiful—calm, relaxing, and surrounded by nature. I was warmly welcomed with a delicious herbal drink (no sugar, which I loved!) and then had a wellness consultation with Miss Waew. She was so kind and professional, guiding me through a private yoga session where she patiently helped me with poses and breathing techniques.

Next, I experienced a deeply relaxing oil massage and traditional Tok Sen therapy with Miss Na, a skilled and caring therapist. Her touch melted away all my tension—I felt completely renewed. I also had a Tibetan Bowls sound healing session with Miss Nan, which was truly incredible. The vibrations and sounds brought me into such a deep state of calm that words can’t fully describe the benefits.

The day continued with a nourishing organic lunch from their wellness menu—healthy, clean, and absolutely delicious. I ended the retreat with breathwork, meditation with Tibetan bowls, a detoxifying body wrap, and a facial massage. Every step of the experience was thoughtfully designed and delivered with so much care.

I can confidently say this was one of the best spa experiences of my life. If you are looking for a true wellness escape—one that heals your body, mind, and spirit—I highly recommend Ayurah Spa. I will definitely return again.

reviews.name: Emma Klaßen
reviews.text: I did the 3 Day Open water Diving course with two friends and it was the best decision ever! We had Robert as our instructor, who explained everything really well! We saw a lot of colorful corals and fish. But my highlight was the seaturtle we saw on our last dive. I am really sad that it is over and can deeply recommend doing the diving course if you visit the island. We had so much fun in the water but also on the boot and with our instructor Robert. So just try it, it will definitely be worth it!!!🤿

I did my course with Robert, and I couldn’t have asked for a better instructor. Calm, professional, and clearly passionate, he made the entire training feel easy and enjoyable from start to finish. I felt safe and supported the whole way through.

The whole team contributes to a relaxed yet professional vibe, and there’s a real sense of good energy in the air. Everything runs smoothly, and it’s clear they care about giving you the best possible experience.

Thanks again Mojo — highly recommended. Don’t think twice, just go dive with them 🙏🌊

I would highly recommend diving with Mojo and especially with Teresa.

I had an incredible experience with Mojo, and I’m really glad I got my hotel recommendation and chose a truly local dive center for my training. From the first contact to the last dive, the team was attentive, organized, and genuinely cared about creating a safe and enjoyable atmosphere.

A special highlight goes to my instructor, Win.
His attention to detail, calm approach, and fun, non-boring teaching style made the whole course flow naturally. He explained everything clearly, made sure I felt comfortable at every step, and still kept the vibe light and engaging underwater. He also knows the local restaurants.

I managed to combine my Advanced Open Water, Nitrox, and Deep Dive into 7 dives over just 3 days, and everything was perfectly scheduled without feeling rushed. The structure, the briefings, and the overall professionalism were top-notch.

If you’re looking for a dive center in Koh Tao that’s local, welcoming, and truly focused on quality, Mojo is an amazing choice. Highly recommend!

We truly appreciate your support and hope to see you back on Koh Tao soon!

The MOJO DIVER Team

reviews.text:
My experience with Mojo Divers in Koh Tao was absolutely incredible. My friend and I completed our scuba diving certification there, and it was one of the best decisions we’ve ever made.

The dive sites around Koh Tao were stunning — crystal clear water, beautiful coral reefs, and incredible marine life. Completing our certification here made the whole experience even more memorable.

We had White as our instructor, and she was absolutely fantastic. She was incredibly patient, calm, and very knowledgeable. She explained everything clearly and made sure we fully understood both the theory and the practical skills before going into the water. Underwater, she made us feel completely safe and confident at all times. Her positive energy and supportive attitude really made a difference and helped turn the experience into something truly special.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this amazing review 💙🌊

We’re absolutely thrilled that you and your friend chose Mojo Divers for your certification and that it became such a special memory for you both. Completing your scuba certification is a huge milestone, and doing it here in Koh Tao definitely makes it even more magical with our beautiful reefs and marine life 🐠✨

A big thank you as well for your kind words about White. She truly cares about her students, and it means so much to hear that you felt safe, confident, and fully supported throughout both the theory and in-water sessions. That positive energy and patience are exactly what we strive to provide.

We’re so happy we could be part of one of your best decisions ever 😉💙

Wishing you many more incredible dives around the world and we hope to see you back underwater with us someday! 🌊🐢

reviews.text:
I recently visited Calm Spa Ari and had an outstanding experience. We booked three massages in total: one solo session and one couples massage. Each of us enjoyed a full two-hour personalized treatment that combined Rebalance Massage (Swedish style) with the Indian Head Oil Massage.

The spa itself is wonderfully clean, calming, and relaxing. The space is filled with plants, and the modern showers and massage rooms feel fresh and serene. It is the perfect environment to unwind.

At first, we felt a bit intimidated by the wide array of customizable treatment options, but Mimi was fantastic. She took the time to explain everything clearly and gave excellent recommendations based on our goals and focus areas.

The therapists, Lampai, Tom, and Pat, were incredibly talented. They located pressure points in places we didn’t even realize were sore. The Indian Head Oil Massage was pure magic. It felt and smelled so good that it literally put us to sleep. We didn’t want the sessions to end. Afterward, we both felt like completely new people, refreshed, and re-energized.

The spa also provided delicious snacks and drinks for us to enjoy together while we were still marveling at the amazing experience.

This was my partner’s first-ever massage, and it set the bar incredibly high for any future ones.

We will absolutely be back and will be recommending Calm Spa Ari to all our friends visiting Bangkok looking for something special. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
I’ve been coming to Calm Spa Ari every time I visit Bangkok since 2021, and one of the biggest reasons I keep coming back is Newton.

Before every trip, I always book my appointments in advance because I know I’ll be visiting almost every day. Newton is, without a doubt, one of the best massage therapists I’ve ever met.

What truly sets him apart is not only his excellent technique, but also his genuine care for his clients. During one visit, I developed a bad cough after constantly going between Bangkok’s heat and strong air conditioning. Newton immediately paused the massage, went out to prepare a cup of hot tea for me, and made sure I was feeling better before continuing. That level of kindness is something I’ll never forget.

On another trip, I injured my lower back after using a massage chair elsewhere. Before the session, I explained what had happened, and Newton carefully adjusted the treatment by combining aromatherapy oil massage with Thai massage techniques to target the tight muscles. By the end of the session, my back felt significantly better, and I was honestly amazed by his experience and intuition.

Every visit has been consistently outstanding. Newton always listens to what my body needs and adjusts the pressure and techniques accordingly. The entire team at Calm Spa Ari is also incredibly friendly, welcoming, and professional, making every visit relaxing from beginning to end.

One more recommendation—don’t miss the café downstairs. They serve excellent coffee using a professional La Marzocco espresso machine, and it’s the perfect way to end a wonderful spa experience.

I’ve visited many massage places over the years, but Newton and the team at Calm Spa Ari continue to be my favorite. Thank you for taking such great care of me every year. I can’t wait to come back again!

reviews.name: WhereToNYC (and beyond)
reviews.text:
I’ve been in Thailand for almost two months, getting massages pretty much every day. So at this point I have a really good sense of what proper technique and good elbow work should feel like.

My first visit to M Massage was amazing. The female therapist I had, delivered one of the best massages I’ve had in Thailand. Super skilled, great pressure, really intuitive. If my review were based only on that session, it would have been an easy 5 stars.

The second visit was a completely different story. This time I had a male therapist, and the technique was just not there at all. Instead of controlled elbow pressure, it felt like he was literally stabbing me with his elbow the whole time. No modulation, no awareness, zero finesse. It got uncomfortable and tedious enough that I stopped the 1-hour massage after only 30 minutes.

Pricing-wise, there is something worth noting for other customers. They promote a 250 baht one-hour massage which I confirmed before the start of the massage. When I stopped at 30 minutes, they told me they were only charging me for 30 minutes, but the price was 180 baht, which is clearly more than half of the promo rate. That was their decision, even after I had already mentioned that the massage was not good. I didn't argue the price, but it just doesn’t feel great from a trust and customer care perspective.

Bottom line: M Massage can be fantastic if you get the right therapist, because my first session was genuinely excellent. But the quality is very inconsistent, and my second experience was one of the worst I’ve had in Thailand. If you go, I’d definitely recommend requesting your therapist instead of leaving it to chance.

reviews.text:
Fantastic coaching and place to learn BJJ. Greg is not just great at BJJ but is a highly qualified educator who knows how to teach and inspire his students, both children and adults.

My whole family started training here and it has been positive for us all. Coach Rae is also caring, very knowledgeable, and a positive  example for the girls and women at the gym.

Lazy Leopard's location is great at World Club Sports Complex, so parents can do other activities, like pickleball, badminton, tennis, weight room, swimming, ext while their children are in class.

There is also a locker room with showers if needed which is nice and a snack shop in the complex as well.

Whether starting BJJ for the first time, moving to Chiang Mai and needing to find a gym, or traveling through on vacation, Lazy Leopard is a great place to train! All are welcome.

The quality of the product is very tight, fits snug and well-made, including the stitching. The design is awesome, even with my T-shirt, they insured the pattern on the side matches up.

I’ve had other products from Thailand which are more expensive but I can say it’s on the same level.

I went to the other shop near here but those brands wasn’t up to standard. When I say this is because you can tell from the wrist wrap on the glove which should be very strong like the SKS Empire!

The ladies and gentlemen who work here are very nice and you can try on the items who have very good English.

Will definitely shop here again based on quality and bang for your buck!

reviews.text: I recently had a full-body massage at this center, and it was an absolutely incredible experience. From the moment the session began, I felt my stress and muscle tension melt away. The therapist was highly professional, using the perfect amount of pressure to target all my knots and sore spots. It was so relaxing that I almost drifted off to sleep! The atmosphere was calming and the service was top-notch. I left feeling completely rejuvenated and light as a feather. This was easily a 10/10 experience, and I highly recommend it to anyone needing deep relaxation!

reviews.name: Minna Chiu
reviews.text:
Made a reservation via KakaoTalk about an hour before I wanted to get my massage. Their response was prompt and the reservation was easily made. There was a bit of a hiccup when I arrived for my appointment as their credit card machine was not working but they were able to fix it by the end of my massage. Do note that there is a 3% fee added on to your bill if you do decide to pay with card.

I got an hour long oil massage and an hour long Thai massage. You’re able to choose the areas you want them to focus on and avoid. You are taken to individual rooms once you have chosen your service and targeted areas. Overall solid service and you leave feeling relaxed. The facilities are clean and it’s a quiet area.

reviews.name: David Shectman
reviews.text:
World-class Thai massage.
Not expensive.
Upscale.
Expert, attentive, excellent.
Kuhn Nat is remarkably strong and knew exactly how to work out some issues I was having.
Highly recommended.

Update : this was my fourth or fifth visit, and the level has always been extremely, extremely high. Although I have had massages from a number of different people here, every single treatment has been truly excellent, and this is the mark of a top massage salon.

I have to give a particular shout out, though, to Khun Nam who is a little bit crazy, extremely lovely, and very, very funny. Not only that, she gave me one of the most spectacular massages of my life and really worked out a ton of buildup in my shoulders and shoulder blades.

Recommended without reservation. Just book here. And request Khun Nam!

reviews.text: Can't judge the group sessions as I didn't do them, but I had 2 excellent 7am PTs with Fasai on back to back days. Excellent highly personalised PTs. Would definitely do it again if I'm staying nearby.

Thank you again for your support. We'd be delighted to welcome you back the next time you're in Bangkok for more early morning training!
YOKKAO Team

reviews.name: Abdulla Ali Singel
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience training at Yokkao Muay Thai in Bangkok. From the moment I arrived, everyone was welcoming, professional, and genuinely passionate about helping you improve. The trainers are world-class and give each student personal attention, no matter your experience level.

The training sessions were intense, technical, and incredibly well-structured. Every session pushed me to become better while still being enjoyable. The atmosphere in the gym is motivating, with people from all over the world training together and supporting one another.

The facilities were excellent, the staff were friendly and organized, and the overall experience exceeded my expectations. If you’re looking to improve your Muay Thai—whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced fighter—I couldn’t recommend Yokkao enough. I’ll definitely be coming back the next time I’m in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Jianhong Ye
reviews.text: Had a very good experience at Yokkao Bangkok. Trainers welcomed us warmly even when we brought our kid along, and the training session was structured and plenty of guidance was given. Would like to thank all trainers (Q?) for their detailed instructions and explanation for Muay Thai techniques. I would recommend this gym to any one coming to Bangkok for training, whether for leisure or for improvement. Will definitely come back again.

reviews.name: AYE-1 DV
reviews.text:
I did a Drop In Class from 10-11:30 A.M on a Monday. I was able to pay at the location without booking in advanced, so that was a plus! Although, I may have been lucky. There were quite a few people there so booking in advance might be a better choice next time around! The price was 700 baht for the class, Which I feel is a bit pricey but well worth it!

The class went really well! It was as described on the website.

Mobility exercises
10 Min warm-up workout
10 Min jump rope
10 Min tecnique
30 Min Padwork & Bagwork
Sparring
Abs, Knee, Cool Down

I really feel they do a great job on time management. They fit A LOT in the training session. I feel they did an outstanding job of introducing all the coaches and making everyone feel welcome! The coaches also all seem to be very fluent in English, which is often hard to find in Thailand! I really liked the way they alternate coaches during the pad work and take the time to correct your technique during bag work! I also really appreciate the pre and post work out stretching!

The only dislike I had may be a more  personal gripe, I didn't like some of the music playing in the background as we trained. I love the Hip Hop appeal of the gym! I love Hip Hop music, I just feel instrumentals are more appropriate to train to  than some of the songs featured on the playlist. It's often hard to concentrate on the training when you're hearing a song you don't like. But I also feel the same way when I hear pop music I don't like at restaurants etc. I just don't want to get lyrics stuck in my head! What I do want, on the other hand.. is proper training instruction and again, the coaches did an outstanding job on that!

reviews.name: A A
reviews.text:
Such an amazing training facility with some of the kindest and most hospitable people you’ll ever meet.

I’ve been training at YOKKAO Gym for the past week and, despite having some experience in Muay Thai and visiting a handful of gyms before, I can confidently say this is the best gym I’ve ever trained at.

The people here, as well as the facility itself, are truly world-class. I’ve been doing 1-to-1 sessions with the legend himself, Kru Q, and I can’t praise him enough. His expertise, attention to detail, and deep understanding of Muay Thai are second to none. In such a short space of time, I feel like I’ve improved massively. The way he breaks down even the smallest details and supports you through every challenge is incredible.

I’ll be continuing to train here for the rest of my stay in Bangkok and will definitely return whenever I’m back in the city.

From the lovely staff at reception to the world-class fighters and trainers, everyone at this gym is amazing. Places like this can sometimes feel intimidating, but this gym is the complete opposite — everyone welcomes you with a smile, and the warm, friendly Thai culture really shines through.

A huge thank you to everyone at the gym, and especially to the amazing Kru Q.

The memories I’ve made here will be cherished and remembered for life.

reviews.name: Sensei Meli
reviews.text:
An incredible experience at YOKKAO Training Center in Thailand. The coaching was next level, especially with Jojo and Fasai. We did one-on-one sessions and the attention to detail was amazing—they broke down our technique, helped improve our skills, and pushed us to our absolute limits every session.

The whole facility is fantastic. The reception staff are friendly and welcoming, the healthy café has a great range of delicious meals and drinks, and the merch selection is huge with so many quality items to choose from.

Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced fighter, I couldn’t recommend YOKKAO enough. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Rich Youth
reviews.text:
By far the best Muay Thai store in Bangkok and around the world

The training center is impressive. The facilities are modern, spotless, and thoughtfully designed. There’s a great range of equipment, personal training, and specialized programs.

The trainers here are true professionals motivating, supportive, and always willing to go the extra mile to tailor workouts to your abilities.

I had an excellent experience thanks to Jom’s courteous and very helpful service. From start to finish, Jom was incredibly supportive and showed genuine caring attention to every detail, making sure I felt comfortable and well taken care of. It’s rare to find someone so dedicated and attentive — I truly appreciate it and highly recommend their service to anyone looking for top-notch hospitality!

reviews.name: Amanda Logan
reviews.text:
I've only been doing Muay Thai for 5 months, so I wasn't sure what I was walking into at Yokkao. Kru Krarok was amazing and corrected my form to help me improve. He was also very patient and motivating. It was 35°C outside, but he made sure to keep me cool with frequent water breaks. The class was intense, but it was so much fun. I will definitely come back to train with Kru Krarok again!
I also took time to shop at the store they have on-site and walked away with some one of a kind gear!

Show less

reviews.name: Matthew DS
reviews.text:
Had a private session with Kru Kev and he was super friendly whilst teaching me some technique.

There are group classes here as well as private/1:1  classes. You can book private classes on Yokkao's website or call this gym directly. Recommend booking on the website as you can choose your trainer.

Gym itself was clean with shower facilities and change rooms available. Bring a towel as they charge 50 baht to hire one. Most of the equipment here looks quite new and flashy.

There is also a Yokkao gear store here with a good range of products that are cheaper than buying online and having them shipped to your home country.

They sell protein smoothies at the front desk (including mango) which is a great wind down after an intense session.

reviews.name: Tom
reviews.text: We stopped by at the YOKKAO store during the Amazing Muay Thai World Festival 2026 to grab some stuff. Absolutely fantastic place, from the outside you hear the crazy screams: "More powerrrrr!" - then you spot the poor sweat dripping guy working the pads and feel like home instantly:) The store goes by the good "less is more" motto, the store staff is very helpful and super friendly, I came back the next day to change a shirt I picked up in a wrong size and they did it without discussion. YOKKAO sells a superior quality that lasts very long and at their training center they also seem to provide the super crazy training that you can expect from thai trainers when they think that you are fit to endure it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Tom,
Thank you for taking the time to share such an amazing review! We loved reading your description of the atmosphere at YOKKAO Training Center Bangkok—the sound of pads, the coaches pushing everyone to give their best, and the energy that makes so many people feel at home.
We're also delighted to hear that our store team was able to assist you with your exchange and that you appreciate the quality of our products. Providing outstanding service both inside the gym and in our store is something we take great pride in.
We hope to welcome you back soon, whether it's for another visit to the store or, even better, for a Muay Thai training session with our coaches!
YOKKAO Team

reviews.name: Danny 009
reviews.text:
By far one of the best Muay Thai gyms I’ve been to. They have great coaches, technical & fun private classes, an amazing selection of Yokkao gear, friendly & welcoming staff, phenomenal espresso, and the best designed gym.

Highly recommend anyone living and visiting Bangkok to come and experience everything they have to offer.

Booking 2 hour straight private classes was the sweet spot for me trying to improve. You’ll get enough time to shadow box, drill techniques and combos on heavy bag, work on small pads, putting it all together on Thai pads, and still have enough time to clinch and spar at the end.

This training center will become my regular spot when traveling through Bangkok from now on.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Your recommendation means a lot to our entire team, and we are proud to know that YOKKAO Training Center Bangkok will be your regular spot when traveling through the city.

We look forward to welcoming you back very soon.
YOKKAO Team

reviews.name: Gheslaine Waters
reviews.text:
Trained at Yokkao Bangkok Training Center for a few days and it felt like home from the moment we walked in. The trainers are welcoming, attentive, and make an effort to connect with everyone, regardless of experience level. It was easy to book a spot for their drop in class online, you just need to check in once you arrive.

The group classes are a great workout and well-structured to cater to all levels. They place a strong emphasis on safety during sparring, and will assign your partners according to size and oversee the rounds to make sure people remain controlled and playful.

The facility itself is super clean, organised, and professionally run. The gym and store are both well set up, and every staff member we interacted with was friendly and helpful.

Special shoutout to Kru Q and Yodseanchai for the great hospitality.

Highly recommend for anyone looking to train in Bangkok, even if you’re only there for a short time.

Class format: 90 minutes
- Warm up: stretching, bodyweight exercises, guided shadowboxing
- Padwork & bag work
- Couple of sparring rounds
- Stretch

title: Thai Farm Cooking School Class
address: V3XG+G6H, Mueang Len, San Sai District, Chiang Mai 50210, Thailand

reviews.name: Shane Deringer
reviews.text:
One of the best highlights and choices we made while visiting Chiang Mai was taking this cooking class.

We were picked up at the hotel and made our way to the farm. Our guide and chef was Sky and she was the sweetest. She gave us a good tour of the property and explained all the plants, fruits and vegetables we were going to use (and sample). We cooked more food than we could eat and I still think it's some of the best we've had. Also trying some of her Thai spicy was 🔥😍

Highly recommend

reviews.name: Martina Frank
reviews.text: It is difficult to find the words to describe this amazing experience. I think the fact that there are only positive reviews speaks for itself, and I can only confirm that this cooking school provides a unique, aesthetic, professional, well-organized, fun, natural cooking experience. It starts with a short visit to the market, where I would strongly recommend to buy the ingedients needed for the recipes so that you can recreate them at home (they are much cheapier here than in Europe). If you are vegetarian like me, ask the instructor which products you need. Upon arrival at the farm, there is a little tour of the peaceful farm where you can learn about the different herbs and plants used in Thai cuisine - very interesting. After that, you alternate between cooking and eating (at least for the full-day experience, which I would strongly recommend, trust me, it is worth every Baht). We cooked 5 different dishes and it was super easy to cook them vegetarian. Ingredients were prepared on trays and dirty dishes were washed by two lovely ladies, thanks to whom participants were able to have a very relaxing and easy cooking experience. Our teacher, Mod, was very kind, knowledgeable, professional and funny. The food was truly amazing and unexpectedly simple to prepare, probably because Mod explained everything so perfectly, so that it was very easy to follow. Bags were provided for the leftovers to be eaten in the evening without wasting any delicious, home-cooked, organic food. The size of the course with 12 participants was also perfect in my opinion, and was a great opportunity to meet friendly people. At the end I was brought back to my hostel, where I had been picked up in the morning, with a full tummy and a happy smile. So, all in all, I recommend everyone who likes cooking or just wants to experience a cooking class, since it's very easy and no advanced cooking skills are needed, because it is so well-organized, to take the course with this school! ❤️

reviews.name: Sophia Malone
reviews.text: If you’re in Chiang Mai, you have to do this cooking class! From when we first booked this experience, we were surprised with how great, and speedy the communication was. We were lucky enough to have Wass as our guide, who gave us an in depth overview of the ingredients used for the meals and a farm tour. The farm its self is so peaceful, making it the perfect setting for cooking! You get to choose 3 meals, 1 desert and 1 curry powder as part of the course. The thing I liked about it was having the choice to pick your own meals, as some classes I’ve been to in the past have meant all the participants have had to come to a unanimous decision of what we made as part of the class. When it came to preparing and cooking the meals, Wass made it super easy, with simple instructions and great humour! Also a shout out to the lovely ladies helping to clear up in between each meal! Thank you so much Thai Farm Cooking Class, we will definitely be making some of these recipes when we come home!

reviews.name: Thomas de Silva
reviews.text:
I had an amazing half day evening course. The transport time first to pick up other customers and then go to the market was quite long, so would recommend to just take a Grab and meet up at the market so avoid sitting in a car for over an hour.

Aside from that Mod who was our teacher spoke good English and guided us expertly through produce in the market, all the crops and herbs at the farm and cooking 4 dishes. The rest of the staff at the farm prepared all the ingredients and took care of all the cleaning up as well.
Just remember to bring mosquito repellent and put it on immediately when you step out at the farm.

reviews.name: Debbie Manuel
reviews.text: Wonderful full day cooking. Picked us up from our hostel, took us to the market and explained all the ingredients and what to use if things aren’t available in our country. Easy lesson, lovely staff and very passionate about teaching you about Thai cooking. Left with a full stomach and wonderful memories. Thank you so much for having us.

reviews.name: Kayla K
reviews.text:
Thai Farm Cooking School was such a great experience made even better by our incredible guide, P’Faa. She was so knowledgeable, funny, and engaging throughout our half day course.

For a very reasonable 1200 B a person we made and ate four Thai dishes which were customizable to each person in the group accommodating for vegetarians too ☺️

Everything was clean, well-paced and delicious. I couldn’t say enough about how great this experience was. Highly recommend for anyone visiting or living in Thailand looking for a fun way to spend part of or a whole day 💖

Update!

Went back with family and had another great experience with P’Wass as our guide and P’Pat and Bpaa Noie assisting with prep and clean-up.

The atmosphere was so welcoming, fun, and enjoyable. You really get to know the other 8-10 people in your group, this would be a great activity for a solo traveler, family, or group! Of course the best part is that you get to make delicious Thai food step-by-step in such a reasonable time at such a reasonable price (less than 40 USD!) And at the end you get to take all the recipes back home with you. I will be back again with more visitors next time เจ้า ☺️

reviews.name: Anna Vahey
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed the evening cooking class at Thai Farm Cooking School. As coeliacs, we were super impressed by how our gluten-free requirements were handled. At the market and the class, our guide, Wass, clearly explained which ingredients we could and couldn’t have. Not only was Wass aware of what wasn’t gluten free, but very happy to make adjustments where required, for example using rice noodles in the Khao Soi. We really appreciated this!!

The food itself was delicious, the instructions were clear and easy to follow and the class was relaxed and fun. Also, the farm setting was incredibly beautiful, particularly as the sun was setting.

We had a great time at Thai Farm Cooking School and would highly recommend it, especially for people with dietary requirements.

reviews.name: Miriam Schachtman
reviews.text: Great experience! Smooth transport and very cool to see and learn about the market before cooking. Wass was the best master chef!! She kept it interesting and tasty and each dish was top notch flavorful.

reviews.name: Alessandra Ardissino
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience!! An amazing farm with such peaceful vibes, great explanations and tips while letting us do it for ourself. Cant recommend it enough!!

reviews.name: Derrick Koh
reviews.text: It was a wholesome experience to be able to learn and understand Thai-cuisine from the scratch to the final product. The class starts from visiting their local wet market where the locals purchased their raw ingredients, followed by an introduction of various crops/herbs in their farm. Our instructor, Ratta, was very enthusiastic in her teaching throughout. We felt very delighted taking her class! I would recommend it to anyone that is intrigued to learn more about Thai cuisine!

reviews.name: Scott Shumaker
reviews.text: Highly recommend. We made our own selected meals and each had our own cooking station. The farm is an added plus and is a beautiful place to do the cooking class.

reviews.name: Freya Edwards
reviews.text: We had the most amazing time with our teacher Raatta at the beautiful farm that grew the fresh ingredients for our cooking! Raatta was amazing, so happy and knowledgable and brought an amazing vibe to the day! You visit the market in the morning and you get to choose what you make. I made Tom yum soup with prawns, pad Thai, and khao soi, and mango sticky rice coloured with butterfly pea and pandan. Best cooking class I have done - so much fun and so delicious!

reviews.name: Roland Weinreich
reviews.text: What a great experience! Our guide Mod was lovely, picking us up and kindly letting us choose our dishes. Then strolling in the market, simple guidance on rice and sauces turns out to be very valuable, even for experienced cooks like us. Finally we had a lovely tour through the bio garden with warm sunset light, with Mod providing explanations on different spices and veggies. Then we cooked all together, while Mod is supporting with each step, with great humor and fun. The food was definitely the best of everything we tried here, thanks to the freshness of the bio products, and the great balance of tastes. Mod goes over each recipe, breaking down the dish into protein, herbs, spices and garnish. You really learn a lot about the fundamentals of Asian kitchen. We had so much fun and came back to our hotel with a full and happy belly. This is a must experience for everyone visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Jennifer vanGaalen
reviews.text: Very professional and guides took you step by step through each recipe. There was lots of options of what individuals could make. We couldn't eat everything that we made because there was so much food. My 10 year old thought it was a delightful experience and coped perfectly well. Interesting farm tour. Overall, great experience and would recommend it to other people.

reviews.name: Simon Schneider
reviews.text: We had a spectacular day there, cooking, frying, joking, learning about the culture. Our instructor Fah was very organized and friendly so that everyone could enjoy the course. We first went to a local market to learn about some of the ingredients and then continued to the farm. After a tour through their garden (take an insect repellent with you) to learn more about the herbs and veggies we started pounding our own curry paste. There are lots of dishes to chose from and you can add as many spices as you want (and dare ;). The food was delicious, maybe because of the great ingredients or because we cooked it ourselves. 100% recommend!

The whole experience was well organised from start to finish, with excellent service, a spotless and hygienic kitchen, and great value for money. The instructors made everyone feel welcome and kept the class fun and easy to follow.

The food we made was absolutely delicious, with the standout dishes being the tom yum soup, Penang curry, chicken with cashew nuts, and the mango sticky rice, which was the perfect way to finish. It was a fantastic activity for the whole family—we had plenty of laughs, learnt some authentic Thai cooking techniques, and got to enjoy an incredible meal together. A real highlight of our trip!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommended! One of the highlights of our trip to Phuket.
We had an absolutely wonderful experience at Pum Thai Cooking School in Phuket. We chose the Pum Little Shoes class, a 3-hour cooking experience where we learned about the essential herbs, vegetables, spices, and sauces that form the foundation of Thai cuisine.
During the class, we learned to cook three delicious Thai dishes and gained so much more than just recipes. We loved learning about the unique ingredients used in Thai cooking, as well as the stories, traditions, and culture behind the food. The hands-on experience was fun, informative, and suitable for all skill levels.
What made the experience truly special was being taught by Pum herself. It was such an honour to meet her and learn from someone so passionate about sharing Thai food and culture. Her warmth, knowledge, and enthusiasm made the class unforgettable.
We left with full stomachs, Pum's first recipe book, and a much deeper appreciation and understanding of Thai cuisine. I would highly recommend this class to anyone visiting Phuket who wants an authentic and memorable cultural experience.

reviews.name: Dawn Yanagihara
reviews.text: I've taken many cooking classes in Thailand and Vietnam and I can wholeheartedly say the private class at NaiBaan Cooking Studio was one of the best experiences I've had. Pam was communicative and accommodating, which made booking and customizing the recipe lineup a breeze. The class itself was a joy—both Pam and Rainy were so warm and welcoming that my husband and I immediately felt right at home. So much thoughtfulness and preparation went into the instruction, and the dishes we cooked tasted fresh and honest and fantastic. What I appreciated most was that our four hours(!) at NaiBaan were not solely focused on executing recipes—Pam and Rainy explained each dish and answered my many questions. The time spent was a wonderful cultural exchange, and we left feeling as though we made new friends. Oh, and the physical space is really special, too.

reviews.name: Yousun Jung
reviews.text:
Perfect experience! Every staff is so nice and the massage is perfect.
The price is reasonable and the experience will be more than awesome!
I've traveled Bangkok many times and tried all different kind of massages, but this is one of the most memorable experiences in my life. 🥰🥰 You will love it.

*I recommend you to prepare the cash before you visit here. The price is approximately 250-350 baht for an hour (thai massage or thai balm massage).

reviews.name: Pibbe _
reviews.text: Its either the best or worst experience depending on the massage therapist. First time we loved it and tipped generously. The women were extremely talented and well versed in massage techniques. Came back for more and were coupled with different artists who spent 30 min petting my legs rather than massaging. I left without finishing the massage and went to a different place

reviews.name: LOW KAI LIN
reviews.text: Icon Thai Massage is amazing! Clean, calming space with highly skilled therapists who know exactly what they’re doing. The massage was relaxing, therapeutic, and left me feeling completely refreshed. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: O Varlamov
reviews.text:
My very first thai massage experience. I hope it is not representative of the thai massage in general. The experience is pleasant and relaxing, so I would say positive in general, if not for the expectations 🤷

I opted for "deep massage" - it was light and relaxing. Only on the right calf I was gently reminded that my muscles are stiff with milk accid and.... need a deep massage 😄
One objective downside is that the treat was unbalanced right-left side. Also echoed by my partner who opted for "full-body Thai massage".

The masseuses are polite and welcoming, venue neat and relaxing.

reviews.name: felix connoisseur officiant
reviews.text: Cheapest and best massage you’ll get in bangkok. I am typing this from the toilet in the establishment 10/10, i couldn’t wait to write a review. I’ve had subpar massages all of my thailand trip, but the foot, back and shoulder massage just saved my life. lee massaged me 10/10

reviews.name: Devon Suggs
reviews.text: Ikon Thai Massage was hands down the best massage I’ve ever received. Pon and Ping were wonderful to work with! I’ll definitely be coming back :)

reviews.name: Sean Goh
reviews.text: worst massage in bangkok. very unhygienic, didnt wash my feet at all before massaging instead used a bucket with some water on it and wipe it with the cloth. seen the woman coughing on her mouth and continue massaging me. Quite rude poor service.

reviews.name: Michael Mordaunt
reviews.text: I initially did a 90 minute oil massage with Ying, who helped to free up my tense muscles, after my lower back started to flare up. Ying spoke great english and made the experience so worthwhile I came back for a second massage that night. See you next year Ying!

reviews.name: Andre Guarnori
reviews.text: I went for a massage at Icon Thai Massage and went back the very next day. The staff there—Porn, Tui, and Leeleo—were kind and helpful, and they gave excellent massages. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Rona Riza Delima
reviews.text:
Me and my partner had the worst massage we’ve had in Thailand or even our lives. I wish I was exaggerating or lying, but I am not. We went here to spend our last few baht and time in Bangkok before we fly back to our country, we were expecting a time of relaxation but instead, we got a massage that was (for a lack of better word) half-assed.

When we arrived at their store, The receptionist who I think was also the owner called someone on her phone (in Thai, so we didn’t understand what she was saying). And a few minutes, a Thai man arrived. So this man and the owner were the ones who massaged me and my partner because apparently they were full and had to do the massaging themselves instead of an actual massage therapist.

It was strange but went along with it. Another weird thing was they made us pay first before they did the massage. Mind you, I’ve had the best massage experiences in my life in Thailand and this one felt like she’s pretending she knows what she’s doing. I had the foot massage but I could barely feel any force from her, she did some slapping on my legs that felt unnecessary.

My partner who was massaged by the man that the owner called also had a bad experience. The man was hard on him, throwing him around to move and the massage was just as bad as mine.

I did not expect to have this kind of service from a place that has good reviews on Google and especially knowing how Thailand is known for the best massage service worldwide.

I think their other massage therapists were great because the customers who left while we got the massage look satisfied. But the owner accommodated us despite them being full, she could’ve just let us wait for an actual therapist or told the truth that there wasn’t an availability.

I wouldn’t recommend this massage shop at all.

reviews.name: ins pflg
reviews.text: I highly recommend coming here if you want to experience a truly relaxing and timeless moment with very friendly and skilled masseuses! We had a wonderful time, enjoying a one-hour couples massage with oils. The masseuse is very professional and pleasant. I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Nicole Philips
reviews.text: Massage was wonderful just what we needed after a lot of walking.

reviews.name: Laura Vassileff
reviews.text: We went to this place with my boyfriend after traveling. We choose the foot, neck and shoulder massage, that we really liked! The professionals Ying and On, make us feel really relaxing. We really enjoy the massage and recomend 100% this experience !

reviews.name: Honorata Helon
reviews.text:
Pleasant and professional massage! Clean and relaxing place
For foot + while body oil massage I paid 550B which is fair price in Bangkok

reviews.name: Anita
reviews.text: Really amazing massage place - I’ve been to a few of these and this is genuinely the nicest foot massage (and actually the cheapest!) I received in all of Bangkok. Looks a bit sketch from the outside, but inside is lovely, very quiet and nicely decorated, and the ladies are super lovely.

reviews.name: Julia
reviews.text:
We got 1 hour Oil Massages and they were good, but not the best we have received in Thailand. We felt the hour was a bit rushed, and the massage a little uneven - my partner said they missed one of their arms entirely. It felt like each primary area was given 1-2 minutes of attention and the remaining time was spent rubbing oil into the skin and removing it with a towel. This may be the standard at this location for an Oil Massage but it was not what we experienced elsewhere. We may have opted for a deep tissue massage had we known minimal pressure and very light massaging was what we signed up for.
Overall the location is good, staff is welcoming and friendly and the back room for full body massages is sectioned off nicely to give ample privacy during your session.

reviews.name: Magdalena Stachowicz
reviews.text: I had a really amaizng thai massage in this place! I feel like i got a new body. Highly recommened if you like a strong massage. I will come back there for sure!

reviews.name: Samantha Moffitt
reviews.text: If I could give 10 stars I would!! I loved my massage. The staff are soo lovely and attentive. Really nice salon, very clean! I will be back ❤️

reviews.name: Dimitris Kalapodas
reviews.text: Excellent deep tissue massage 1h and 1h neck, shoulder, back! I will come back.

reviews.name: Jonny Spa
reviews.text: I can highly recommend the one hour foot massage, ask for Yint, she is amazing.

title: Punspace Wiang Kaew
address: 10 Wiang Kaew Rd Old City Tambon Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXVP+7M Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: ChiangMaiCafeMap
reviews.text: This is PUNSPACE, a well-established coworking space in Chiang Mai, highly popular among digital nomads and remote workers. It features two main areas: the outdoor café zone and the indoor workspace. The outdoor café area operates like a regular casual café, where you can order drinks and work or study at open-air tables shaded by large trees and umbrellas, offering a relaxed, laid-back vibe. The indoor workspace, meanwhile, provides professional amenities including air conditioning, abundant power outlets, ergonomic desks and chairs, high-speed internet, lockers, and private call booths. It also offers flexible membership plans, ranging from daily hot desk passes (289 THB, including free coffee and tea) to monthly and quarterly reserved desk memberships, catering to both short-term visitors and long-term residents. With 24/7 access and multi-location privileges, it has become a go-to hub for digital nomads in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Michael
reviews.text:
I consider this place the gold standard for coworking spaces in Chiang Mai. They have all the amenities that matter to me personally — lumbar-support chair availability, true 24-hour access, including holidays, which is a huge plus if you work odd hours, and a location where I can navigate in/out easily during the day. The staff are extremely accommodating and friendly, and they speak English very well, which makes everything easy.

The workspace itself is quiet and well-designed, and I consistently get a lot of work done during the day. Parking is also surprisingly easy, with plenty of spots available even during peak season. Overall, it’s a very comfortable, professional, and reliable place to work. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Devin Grayman
reviews.text:
Punspace is an excellent coworking space that offers a fantastic environment for productivity. The staff is friendly and helpful, making the sign-up process smooth and straightforward. They offer a range of passes—daily, weekly, and monthly—so you can choose the option that best fits your needs.

The amenities at Punspace are impressive. They provide free coffee and tea, which is a nice perk for a long day of work. There are lockers available for storing personal items, as well as conference rooms and private rooms for meetings or focused work sessions. The green space is a lovely addition, offering a refreshing break area.

Most importantly, the internet service is fast and reliable, a crucial factor for any coworking space. Despite the place being larger than expected and hosting many people, it remains quite peaceful, allowing for a productive work atmosphere. Overall, Punspace comes highly recommended for anyone needing a dependable and well-equipped coworking space.

reviews.name: Kotchaphan Bowonchaiyarit
reviews.text:
If you're an entrepreneur looking for an incubator to help you grow your firm, I highly recommend Punspace. The vibrant community of creative, bright and motivated people at Punspace has become a place where I can build a network of talents to help me develop my fresh start in Thailand! Punspace is a great place to meet eager people with all kinds of skills and interests with a  positive attitude and get great advice on how to achieve your goals.

The staffs are very helpful and friendly to set up and run Punspace as a great place to network  with people from different backgrounds and activities.

However, the music at night from the Barking Jac are too loud, so I would recommend bringing earplugs or a good active noise-cancelling headphones/earbuds in order to  be able to concentrate and focus, even those you might want to check out the "after party" after work :)

reviews.name: Max R
reviews.text: Like it here a lot. Has everything you need, and the surrounding area is really calm / peaceful. Recommend!

reviews.name: Julie
reviews.text:
What a beautiful and peaceful place....🥹 absolutely amazing for work or just chill, very large parc, with wifi, and sockets everywhere ! Surrounded by vegetation, a space out of time where we easily spend the day ! 🫶🏾🌿
Thanks u !!

reviews.name: Emma Atitaya KH
reviews.text: Nice place for chilling outside area and they also  have working spaces inside with Air-con, Good coffee&tea. I love here ❤️❤️ (the toilet is cool!)

reviews.name: Malgi Hanušová
reviews.text: Love this place. Both for work or just meeting people. Working outside on my laptop was so relaxing with all the trees and plants (and squirrels) around. Or just enjoying iced cocoa or smoothie.

reviews.name: Jeng
reviews.text:
I’m running a remote tech company selling SMS with strong API and competitive price, apitel.co. I pay a visit to this 1 out of 3 Punspace branches. As you know being an entrepreneur can be very lonely sometimes, so being in a working space alongside people in same position as you is great.

Staff
- helpful, good service-mind, and friendly indeed.

Price
- worth to get the member from week pack above because it’s be better to feed internet for 2 devices and get access to the space 24/7.

Atmosphere
- many kinda big trees around the place LOVE IT! and some outside ground covered with grass helps my eyes relax.
- there’s 2 connecting buildings currently, sometime I like working quietly (b) building would suit me best and another building has a small pantry which I can take a break and talk with other like-mind people.

Community
- seems they have few knowledge events every week that allowed the member access for free this is a plus, and some lunch together for everyone who would like to get to know other coworkers this a good call.
- member would be added to the slack app and you can give feedback to them easily or ask for help (they’re very responsive) or again connect with other coworkers

Have a good time in Chiang Mai ^__^

reviews.name: Mikołaj Paczkowski
reviews.text:
Good place to work - I spent a month there.

Large desks, in the "private workplace" version, super comfortable chairs.

Stable WIFI, possibility of connecting to LAN

Large, peaceful garden next door giving the possibility of working outside. In the immediate vicinity there is a nice cafe, perfect for breakfast or coffee.

I recommend

reviews.name: meredith nash taylor
reviews.text: Fantastic work space that is super quiet and professional. I was able to take late Zoom calls using the phonebooth rooms, and even when busy, everyone wears their headphones and is respectful of the shared spaces and designated quiet areas. Lockers, nice bathrooms, and neighboring coffee shops are a bonus!

reviews.name: Bianca D
reviews.text: This has to be one of the best coworking places I’ve been to - they’ve thought of everything! There are food vendors on the premises selling everything from vegan breakfast dishes and coffee to fresh juices and dinner. The work space is comfortable, bright and spacious; the staff is super pleasant and the wifi is great! I also got an incredible 20 minute massage (by donation) by a really lovely practitioner named Mino. Will definitely be back.

reviews.name: The Honest Local
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had the absolute best experience training at Nana Muay Thai and Western Boxing Gym in Nana, Bangkok. As a complete female beginner, I did a lot of research beforehand because I really wanted to find somewhere I’d feel confident, supported, and taken seriously and this gym exceeded my expectations.

I did five private sessions with Tum, and I truly couldn’t recommend him enough. His English is very, very good I understood him clearly the entire time, which made such a difference as a beginner. He was incredibly patient and never let me move on until my technique was correct, which I really appreciated. You can tell he genuinely cares about your training and your improvement. I never once felt dismissed or overlooked, he gave me his full attention every session.

Beyond being a great coach, Tum is also just a really great person. I’m so glad I got to learn from him and hear more about his story. Thanks to him, I completely fell in love with Muay Thai.

I’ll 100% be coming back to train with him next time I’m in Thailand, and I’ll be recommending him to any friends who visit Bangkok. Five-star experience all the way. 🥊✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: My pleasure. Thank you so much and hope to see you next time soon. 🙏😊

reviews.name: Charlie Fuller
reviews.text:
What an absolutely incredible man Tum is. Humble, authentic and truly a master at what he does. I just wanted a one-on-one training experience in Bangkok with the Trainer who took the time to help me with my technique and also focused on cardio and having a bit of fun. I highly recommend coming here if you are in Bangkok and want an authentic experience. Thank you Tum! I’ll be back for sure - regards,
Charlie
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much. 🙏😊 hope to see you again.

reviews.name: Bwoody W
reviews.text: Great place for learning proper Muay thai technique. This is the first gym out of many where I wasn’t just “banging away” at pads and a heavy bag while learning a little technique. Instead, I learned valuable info on proper technique, undoing my bad habits from less technical MT gyms, fight IQ and relaxing. The main instructor also knows English well which has been a challenge with other gyms. Highly recommended and looking forward to training there again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you ao much. Hope to see you next time soon.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much. Hope to see you next time.
