reviews.name: Di Naryshchenko
reviews.text:
I booked a 2-day course for my friend as a birthday present. First of all, the manager was very unhelpful. After I had already paid for the course, she told me that I also had to pay extra for the boat. Her replies were very short and she didn’t explain anything properly.

The first day in the swimming pool was good. However, during the open water session, the instructor couldn’t organize the group well and didn’t seem very interested in helping everyone complete the course successfully.

As a result, my friend didn’t have enough time to finish the course, and he was really upset. It was his third time trying freediving, and unfortunately it was the worst experience he has had.

I’m very disappointed that my birthday present ended up being ruined 😠
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are genuinely sorry to hear that your friend did not have the experience you were hoping for. However, we would like to clarify several points for accuracy and transparency.
Regarding the boat fee, the statement that this was only disclosed after payment is not accurate. The brochure you received and used to enquire about and book the course on 21 April clearly stated that the 8,900 THB course fee excluded boat fees. Payment for the course was then completed at our shop on 22 April.
On 6 May, when you enquired about the open water session, we explained that the boat fee was separate from the course fee and provided a cost breakdown. The boat fee was discussed again when the open water session was arranged and confirmed. We have reviewed the message history and can confirm that this info was communicated on multiple occasions before the course took place. As students may choose to complete their open water training at different locations, including Samaesarn, Phuket, or liveaboard trips, boat fees vary depending on the destination and are therefore charged separately.
We would also like to clarify that detailed course info was provided before the course commenced, including schedules, preparation requirements, pricing info and supporting materials, to ensure students clearly understood the course structure and requirements.
After reviewing the message history, we can confirm that questions were answered promptly, detailed info was provided when requested, and clarification regarding the separate boat fee was given multiple times. For this reason, we do not believe any information was withheld during the booking process.
Regarding the open water training, safety is our highest priority. We maintain a maximum ratio of 3 students per instructor and group students according to their experience and skill level.
Our instructors are there to teach, guide, and provide constructive feedback throughout the course. However, they must operate within internationally recognised training standards. Instructors cannot push students beyond their comfort level, complete skills on their behalf, or certify students who have not yet demonstrated the required competencies.
On the day of the open water session, students were on a private boat from approximately 9AM until 4PM. Open water sessions are conducted within strict operational and safety limits, including the requirement to return to shore before dark.
We understand it can be disappointing not to complete all requirements within a single training day. However, freediving performance varies significantly between individuals and even from day to day. While other students in the same group met the certification requirements during that session, some students may require additional practice before they are ready to do so safely. Certification is based on successfully meeting the required standards, not simply attendance.
Following your review, we discussed the session with the instructor and reviewed feedback from the other students who attended that day. The feedback received was positive and did not reflect the concerns described in your review. As a result, we are genuinely interested in understanding your friend’s specific experience and would welcome the opportunity to hear directly from them. If a student requires additional time to complete the required skills or certification standards, they are welcome to join a future training session.
Our goal has always been to provide high-quality instruction while maintaining the highest safety standards for all students. We appreciate constructive feedback and are always willing to review concerns fairly and objectively.
For transparency, we have included a link to the relevant conversation history,:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kx-H_gVRem1f24DQhhXuoUCnSALo-kmS?usp=sharing
We wish both you and your friend all the best.
Kind regards,
Bangkok Freedivers

reviews.name: Simon Baranov
reviews.text:
The swimming pool session was excellent, and the instructor was fantastic. Unfortunately, I cannot say the same about the open water part of the course.

The open water session near Samae San felt poorly organized from start to finish. The schedule was clearly inadequate, and I objectively did not have enough time to complete the last skill. For a certification course, this is a significant issue in my opinion.

The location itself was also rather underwhelming. There are much more impressive and inspiring sites available in the area.

What disappointed me the most, however, was the overall attitude. The session felt like a box-ticking exercise rather than an experience led by someone passionate about freediving and invested in the students' progress. I never got the feeling that anyone particularly cared whether participants enjoyed the sport or wanted to continue freediving after the course.

Communication throughout the course was also below expectations. The reception staff were not especially friendly or helpful, and despite the course being over, I still have not received any photos or videos from any of the sessions.

Considering the premium pricing, I expected a much higher level of organization, communication, and overall customer experience. While the pool session was excellent, the open water part left me disappointed and did not meet the standards I have experienced at other freediving schools.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback.
We’re pleased to hear that you enjoyed the pool session and found the instructor fantastic. However, we’re sorry that the open water experience did not meet your expectations.
The open water session included a full day on a privately chartered boat from 9am–5pm and was conducted with a ratio of 1 instructor to 3 students. As with all freediving certifications, instructors can only certify students who successfully meet the required performance and safety standards. Students have up to one year to complete certification requirements, and it is common for additional training to be required before all skills are successfully completed.
We respectfully disagree with the suggestion that the session was merely a “box-ticking exercise.” As a certification course, the instructor’s role is to help students successfully complete the required skills while maintaining internationally recognised safety and performance standards.
Regarding the dive site, locations are selected based on recommendations from local captains who advise on the most suitable conditions for training on the day, taking into account currents, tides, and boat traffic.
We also apologise that you have not yet received the course photos. We would be happy to arrange for them to be resent.
While we respect your right to share your experience, we believe portions of this review do not accurately reflect the events described.
Supporting students throughout their freediving journey has always been important to us, and we are disappointed that this was not your experience.
Safety, professionalism, and student care will always remain our top priorities. We wish you all the best on your freediving journey.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback.

We would like to provide some context regarding the course structure and progression. Free Immersion (FIM) and Constant Weight (CWT) are open water skills taught and assessed during the open water portion of the course in accordance with internationally recognized freediving training standards. (See attached link below) Equalization is also covered throughout the course during theory sessions, including Boyle’s Law and pressure, as well as during pool training (duck dive) and open water briefings. In addition, all PADI students have access to PADI eLearning as an additional detailed resource. 

Our records indicate that you attended the pool session only and did not participate in the open water portion of the course. As a result, some of the skills and training experiences referenced in your review would not yet have formed part of your course progression. 

We are also concerned by your comments regarding student support. Student experience, safety, and care are our highest priorities, and students receive guidance, feedback, and debriefing throughout their training. Based on the experience described in your review, it does not reflect our normal processes or standards. If your experience differed from the standards we uphold, we would welcome the opportunity to discuss it directly, review the matter further, and identify any areas where we may improve. We can also discuss additional training for you if required. 

Thank you again for your feedback.

reviews.name: Gabby
reviews.text: My favourite gym in Thailand. I learned so much. The trainers are incredibly friendly and helpful. I really felt like part of the family during my time at this gym. It’s also kept very clean which is a nice bonus.

reviews.name: Kamelot Manna
reviews.text:
Best gym ever. Awesome kind funny instructors for ALL levels. They are quieter than other gyms so you get a lot more attention. The facility looks like it’s brand new, showers and all. I can’t say enough good things about this place :). I trained here for my whole time in Chiang Mai and I’m sad to be leaving! I will be back!
Xox Kam and Gabby

reviews.name: Michael Strobel
reviews.text: Great muay thai gym! I had a group session for 90 min. For group just come and train according to plan, for privat session needs to booking first. Sweat a lot, hard enough and everyone has there own trainer. It's a new gym... but I like that very much. Not too big, has shower and locker room with key. Water and towel for rent. Gloves including. everything at all... good price for group training. Absolutely recommendation!!!

reviews.name: Fra Roma
reviews.text: I've trained in many gyms in Chiang Mai and this is by far the one with the best infrastructure. Absolutely not overcrowded like others. And the trainers seemed super attentive and focused. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: huang Jojo
reviews.text:
The gym itself is nice and the coach was friendly, but my experience was affected by the class duration and how it was handled.

I booked a 90-minute private session, but the class actually ended after about 60 minutes. That included warm-up, some conditioning, and a few rounds of training, so the real practice time was quite limited.

What was a bit frustrating is that the missing 30 minutes wasn’t noticed until I brought it up, which suggests there was some miscommunication or lack of tracking internally. Either way, I don’t think this kind of issue should fall on the customer.

After I mentioned it, the staff did admit the mistake and offered for me to come back and finish the remaining time. I didn’t take that option, because it wasn’t my mistake, and honestly I didn’t feel like coming back for an extra session after everything that had already happened. Communication was also quite difficult during the class and afterwards, which made the whole situation more frustrating than it needed to be.

In the end, they did refund me after some discussion, which I appreciate. But the whole process wasn’t very smooth.

Overall, good place and good coach, just make sure to double-check the session length before starting.

reviews.name: J Aves
reviews.text:
Krudam gym is full of talented and knowledgeable trainers. I have been back two years now and cannot express how clean, fun, laidback, and personable the gym is. Very affordable for the 1.5hour private sessions. My girlfriend was very comfortable with the team. They have separate bathrooms that are regularly cleaned and useable equipment kept in great care. They take great pride in respecting their space. I am sure various champions have been and will come out of the gym.

Please consider long term training here if you plan on staying in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended as this is the best gym in the area.

reviews.name: Enrique Garmendia
reviews.text:
I came to train at Krudam Gym during my stay in Chiang Mai and it was the right choice. The gym is very beautiful and clean, and the people are friendly and attentive. The training sessions are always well planned, and the trainers are extremely skilled—they correct you constantly and really pay attention to you.
I’ve trained at several gyms in Thailand, and most of the time the feeling is that, as a foreigner, trainers know you’re just passing through and don’t value you as much. At Krudam it was completely different. They correct you, they’re attentive, and it doesn’t matter whether you paid for one session or a full month. If you give more, they value your effort and give more back while also demanding more from you.
I loved training here. I’ll be back in Chiang Mai soon and I will definitely train here again. Special thanks to Bee and Noi for their dedication in teaching me 🙏🏼
100% recommended.

reviews.name: Andy
reviews.text: Great experience! The gym is very big and spacious, not only that the trainers really take their time with you to ensure technique and basics are on point. Would highly recommend for any new starters or anyone who has prior experience in Muay Thai.

reviews.name: Deyvid Ivanov
reviews.text: Got my first experience Muay Thai with coach Kru Kiew. I highly recommend, he is a very nice and dedicated person to his sport. Thank you 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Alvin
reviews.text:
Booked a group training session, but due to small class, mostly the training are 1 to 1.
All coach and staff are friendly and nice
And this gym is less crowded compare to the other
The gym is clean with good organization

reviews.name: krikri eiei
reviews.text:
Recommended!!

It was my first time to learn Muay Thai at Kru Dam gym.
There is a new gym that has already opened in Chiang Mai.
It’s clean and full of facilities.

Trainers and staffs are kind and helpful .
For everyone who is interested to learn Muay Thai, must visit!!

reviews.name: Viktoria Huegel
reviews.text:
A really wonderful gym! I was here for just over two weeks and trained everyday in the morning. The trainers welcomed me and dedicated a lot of time, effort, and patience to help me improve my technique. They’re all extremely professional and knew exactly when to push me and when to allow me to rest.

The training is well structured, effective and fun. It was never too busy, which surprised me, but it also meant that I always had a trainer for myself and never had to wait for pad work. That’s a very different experience to other gyms, where you can spend a great part of the training just waiting around.

The place itself is very clean and well equipped. Overall, it’s just a really nice and productive atmosphere. I can’t wait to come back.

reviews.name: Konrad Radliński
reviews.text: Super friendly staff and teachers, affordable prices, clean bathrooms and changing rooms. Inside you can also find ice bath and shop with all fighting equipment. If you don't have your own gloves or shin pads, teachers will be happy to provide you with them with no charge. Would strongly recommend! Thank you!

reviews.name: Yi Quan
reviews.text: The best Muay Thai facility I have ever been to - clean, spacious, well equipped, excellent skilled and attentive coaching - what more could you ask for. Super easy booking after messaging them on instagram.

reviews.name: Alvin Huynh
reviews.text:
Absolute hidden gem in Chiang Mai. This gym is easily better than many of the more well-known gyms nearby. The facilities are excellent, spacious, clean, and well set up with a proper ring, quality pads, and plenty of room to train without feeling overcrowded.

The coaches are highly experienced, very attentive, and genuinely focused on correct technique rather than just rushing through rounds. They take the time to give individual feedback, whether you’re a beginner or someone with solid experience.

reviews.name: Elise Cater
reviews.text: The gym has great facilities and was very clean. The trainers are friendly with small class sizes. It was our first time trying muay thai. I would highly recommend it.

reviews.name: Eunjoo
reviews.text:
Great price for group class and includes all the equipment without extra costs. Very convenient for tourists and beginners. Lots of space. The teachers are very technical. If you’re intermediate, you’ll get a lot of individual attention. The training here is authentic. The instructors instruct the right way of sparring. And not have people spar without any experience.

I’ve been practicing at a very popular place near this place, but I think I’ve out grown it.

title: Olivia massage bts Saladaeng
address: 28 Si Lom Rd, Khwaeng Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: G Gigi
reviews.text:
Massage Experience – 5-Star Review 28th July 2026

I had a fantastic massage experience from start to finish. The atmosphere was calm, relaxing, and beautifully presented, creating the perfect environment to unwind. The staff were warm, welcoming, and highly professional, taking the time to ensure I was comfortable throughout the session.

The therapist was skilled and attentive, applying the right amount of pressure while focusing on areas that needed the most attention. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and noticeably less tense.

The pricing was also very reasonable for the quality of service provided, making it excellent value for money. I would happily return and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a professional massage in a peaceful setting.

reviews.name: Justin L
reviews.text:
Diosa! What an experience. This place was phenomenal. Nice guy (#18-Beau) welcomed me outside, and I just went with a one hour foot massage. But he was so skilled and strong that half way through I asked to add on a one hour Thai massage as well.

All of it was perfect! Excellent skill and strength. He really paid attention to my tension areas. The Thai massage was on the floor upstairs, and he didn’t hold back. Think he liked watching me squirm a bit but it was necessary. He was also just very sweet and honestly very cute as well. But the entire thing was all very professional - no funny business here.

And honestly, 2 hours of amazing massage for 700 baht (plus generous tip), this place should be way more popular and busy. If you visit (which you should), go with Beau!

reviews.name: Konrad Dobrzyński
reviews.text:
Best massage in Bangkok!

I can feel my legs again and walk another 17,972 steps around the city. Olivia and her team made me feel relaxed. Thank you and we recommend them.

reviews.name: Natchaya Tiraphu
reviews.text: Absolutely the worst massage I’ve ever had. The therapist felt like a complete beginner with zero technique or effort. I paid 400 baht expecting a massage, but all I got was someone casually stroking my skin. Calling this a massage is honestly an insult to real massage services.

reviews.name: Chris
reviews.text:
Not a good 1st experience doing foot massage here. Despite there is no crowd, and most of the masseurs are sitting outside the shop waiting for customer, it took them a while to find me a masseur. I asked for a male masseur with strengthen, ended up, the person is just caressing my skin. I requested twice to have more strength, but didn’t help. After 10 mins, I asked to change a masseur. The replacement is much better, at least doing a decent massage for my leg muscles.

My second visit to try the body massage, and it was quite a disappointment too. I book for 90 mins body massage, and the room has shower facilities. 90 mins was counted the moment I enter the room, took my shower and masseur only come in 10 mins later. In between, masseur asked for 5 mins toilet break. In all, actual massage is only 75 mins.

reviews.name: Cristian Garcia
reviews.text: I had an amazing oil massage with Number 1 KENG he is a strong therapist and for me that I work out in the gym the balance between strength and strokes is very important, he was perfect at it! The massage was both deep and relaxing, an amazing and very skilled therapist! Congratulations to KENG!

reviews.name: Karen Chan
reviews.text: Worst foot massage ever. Luckily I booked 1hr. Couldn’t stand it after 45min and cut short. The young male masseur with curly hair had absolutely no interest in doing a good job. Totally distracted. Didn’t get the right points & refused to add pressure despite being asked to. Just stroked my feet & ruffled my hair at head massage. Waste of time & money

reviews.name: Dylan Greer
reviews.text:
Had a full body oil massage from Mik (No. 32). He gives an AMAZING massage. Firm, with good pressure and he really knows what he's doing!
Give it a go if you get the chance

reviews.name: James Mark (FilCanCook)
reviews.text:
400 baht for a supposedly foot massage but it did not happen.

98% painful leg massage (this is their main focus not the foot)

2% foot massage which is very soft also.

Such a waste of money and disappointment,
I was expecting a foot massage not a leg painful massage. Go somewhere else if you are looking for a relaxing foot massage, this place will not give you that.

The owner should train everyone on what real foot massage is all about where it should be 90% focus will be on the foot not on the legs.

reviews.name: Clare FYR
reviews.text: Did an oil body massage for 550thb. #73 was great, put in a lot of effort and felt great. Good pressure, proper strokes. They do ask for a tip right after but I thjnk it’s well deserved. No disposable undergarments but done in a private room with option for you to shower before/after if you like. Will return!

reviews.name: Mark Harjes
reviews.text: My first time to this branch of Olivia Massage and had a wonderful 90min foot massage.  The care and pressure used was perfect ~ thank you #44! 👍🏻

reviews.name: Benny Neo
reviews.text: Worse oil massage ever by the old masseur guy, who keep rubbing oil on my legs and groin area for 90mins, despite me asking for strong massage press. End up giving him THB 200 he not happy.. avoid them, they have a few along the Silom street.

reviews.name: Super Lirios
reviews.text:
I went to this place almost two weeks ago !
I wanted to have an oil massage, but instead I had a very unpleasant experience as the masseur had the audacity to spend 70% percent of the massage just stroking my calves and through this nonsense I told him to move to other areas of my body and to do it harder , but he completely ignored and then I didn’t have 60 minutes, but instead just 50 . I went to complain to the lady at the reception desk and she got very mad and told me it was not her business whether the massage was good or bad she just said he was a new worker .

reviews.name: Isaac Soler Gómez
reviews.text:
5% foot massage
95% shin splint/leg massage
Painfull, boring, repetitive...

I have been in Thailand for 10 years getting foot massages 1 or 2 times a week, this is among the 3 worst!

Really bad experience!! I've had more than 500 foot massages in my life!!!!!!! And this one make me feel scammed

Ofcourse It always depends on who give you the massage more than the spa!

I finish feeling I won't want never again a massage

reviews.name: Angkana Ngamteerapornkul
reviews.text:
Honestly, I had a bad experience from massage shop in Silom area. But P'App (No.103) completely changed my attitude. She is one of the best masseuses I have ever experienced!
Thanks for her kind effort on relief my muscle pain, especially my terrible stiff neck and hips! For those who don't prefer the heavy massage, she is also great at a smooth and relaxing massage.
Do note that she is available at BTS Saladang branch where is located opposite to Silom Complex. Hope you guys enjoy her massage skill as I do ;)

reviews.name: Jonathan Doe
reviews.text: I’m not familiar with massages but here I had a great experience, liked it a lot and will come again next time I’m in Bangkok !

reviews.name: Алёна
reviews.text:
Great place, super massage after the flight!🙏🏻
number 45👍🏼

reviews.name: David Dogon
reviews.text:
2h massage, 1h Thai massage and 1h oil massage
Thai massage was really painful, weird moves I never had and I did dozen of Thai massages.
Oil massage was ok but felt uncomfortable to be totally naked and being touched constantly down there
My parter had head massage, the worst you can imagine.. keep doing the same spot for so long it ripped the skin off on his hair and side of the head…
Showed the lady at the front desk, didn’t care whatsoever. Avoid here

reviews.name: Jeffrey Lim
reviews.text: Very professional massage for my neck, leg, body! Strongly recommend Masseur No. 35 Ton.

reviews.name: Minh Hoang
reviews.text: The first time , my family come here! Everything good, good service, good skill! Staff very friendly and funny! Staff numver 104,29,22 very nice, foot massage wonderfull! Đi bộ cả ngày, masage rất thích và dễ chịu.

reviews.name: Eva Koutna
reviews.text: Ping is an amazing yoga teacher! I have done 3 yoga classes during my stay in Chiang Mai and I did enjoy all of them. Ping is super friendly, helpful and has such a good energy. She and her mum even took me for a lunch to their favourite restaurant and I spent couple of hours with them. I did eat delicious Thai food and learnt more about Thai history. What a great experience,thank you Ping! I am planning to come back to Chiang Mai and do yoga week in Ping's studio.

reviews.name: 冯冯
reviews.text: Such a warm and welcoming yoga studio! I’ve absolutely fallen in love with Ping’s classes—they are incredibly healing and full of energy. To anyone visiting Chiang Mai, this is a must-try experience you shouldn't miss!

reviews.name: Cristina Lucha
reviews.text:
I took my first yoga class ever with Ping and it was amazing! She knew the whole group was new to yoga, so she guided us with patience and care. The class was challenging but very manageable — it was a great way to unwind and release tension after a long day. My body felt noticeably more relaxed by the end.
The space was wonderful — very clean and cozy.

reviews.name: Courtney McCarthy
reviews.text: I’ve been coming to Ping since before she opened her studio and she has completely healed my back pain. Very beginner friendly, the chair yoga is awesome. She speaks perfect English and will make you feel comfortable and right at home. My favorite place to go Wednesdays

reviews.name: Jo S.
reviews.text:
I have attended wonderful two day yoga retreat with teacher Ping.  Thank you 🙏
Every detail—from the practices to the setting and the overall flow—was so thoughtfully put together, and it truly created a space to rest, reconnect, and be present.
Your care, calm guidance, and intention were felt throughout the entire retreat. I’m leaving with a full heart, a clearer mind, and a deep sense of gratitude for the experience you created for us.
Thank you for sharing your energy, time, and passion. It was really special time.
Joanna

reviews.name: Pare
reviews.text: My first time trying Chair Yoga, and it exceeded my expectations. I was able to stretch many areas of my body, including my back, shoulders, hips, and legs. After the class, I felt lighter, more relaxed, and much less tense than before. The atmosphere was welcoming, and the instructor was attentive and supportive throughout the session. I highly recommend!! 🫶🏻🧘🏻🪷🪬

reviews.name: Heidi Chan
reviews.text: It’s my first time experience Yoga, and Ping makes me to learn more! The environment is comfy and Ping is professional. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Lisa Lucas
reviews.text: I loved every minute of my gentle flow class with Ping. Every single detail was so well thought out, from the essential oils, the pranayama and chanting of opening and closing mantras. Ping has a beautiful energy that really shines throughout her practice and her guidance. She truly embodies and honours the concept of yoga as a moving meditation. So excited for my next class 🪷🙏🏽

reviews.name: Charlotte Farrer
reviews.text: Ping is a wonderful yoga teacher! As a beginner, the class was very well instructed and I didn't get lost at all. She is super knowledgeable and the space is really nice and relaxing. I would definitely recommend her classes to anyone staying in Chiang Mai. I hope to come back!

reviews.name: Alice Hill
reviews.text: I went here after seeing a poster up and this has by far been the best yoga class I’ve been to during my whole travels. Ping was so friendly and the class was challenging but accessible to all levels. Definitely worth your time and money

reviews.name: ariii
reviews.text: I had such a wonderful experience with Ping at the yoga studio in Chiang Mai! Even though there wasn’t a scheduled class that day, she kindly opened a special session just for me and my friends. Her energy was so uplifting and positive—it made the whole practice feel light and joyful. I’m so grateful for her generosity and the beautiful class she led. It was truly one of the highlights of our trip!

reviews.name: Daniel King
reviews.text:
I had such a fantastic experience with Ping's yoga classes while I was in Chiang Mai! Ping is extremely knowledgable, attentive, down to earth and has created a beautiful space to practice.
It'd been a few years since I had done regular yoga classes and I contend with lower disc issues so naturally I was apprehensive to jump back into it. Ping went above and beyond by taking the time to understand these factors beforehand, as well as reguarily checking in with me during the class and ensuring I was following her movements precisely while helping however she could. I feel like I've walked away with a lot more insight and tips than I previously possessed (and physically I feel great!). Will definitely be a regular whenever I'm in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: 최병람
reviews.text: It was a valuable time to learn yoga from a very passionate teacher. Especially, it was a special time to learn yoga using chairs. I want to recommend it to everyone

reviews.name: Sky JIN (Jin Sky)
reviews.text: Yoga at Karma Gallery—an incredible space. Top-quality equipment, and flawless instruction! Ping’s personalized and meticulous guidance is truly among the best in Chiang Mai. Her deep understanding of yoga and tailored approach will inspire every yogi. After an hour of sweating it out, you’ll find plenty to enjoy nearby, making the location just perfect. If you’re looking for a unique yoga experience in Chiang Mai, I highly recommend it👍

reviews.name: Johanna Bauer
reviews.text: I joined Ping for the Power Yoga class and it was one of the best sessions I‘ve ever had. Love that way Ping teaches, she‘s extremely attentive and present and joyfull, she seemed to know exactly what was needed and made us laugh. She has a very clear way of guiding, so beginners can understand what to do, and gives enough „challenges“ for advanced students. Also really loved the way she helps to correct each and every one individually with a lot of care. Thank you Ping! Hope to be back soon <3

reviews.name: Peter
reviews.text: Wow, what an incredible experience. Ping is extremely attentive and built a flow that really pushed my limits. I cannot say enough good things about this class (please try the chair yoga if you haven’t), and cannot wait to go back. The space and equipment are beautiful and Ping created a wonderful environment with sounds and smells.

reviews.name: Monifah Kiani
reviews.text: Amazing experience doing shoulder & hip focused yoga. It was my first time using a chair but Ping guided us through the flow expertly. She has great knowledge and explains very well. Everything is prepared for you so you just need to show up. The session was the perfect level of challenging but also she provided hands-on support or adjustments if anything was too difficult. I also love the use of balms and scents to enhance the experience. Will be back again - thank you so much!

reviews.name: Jialing Lim
reviews.text: Absolutely my preferred yoga space in Chiang Mai, not least because of Ping the teacher who not only teaches the physiology of yoga movement, but also incorporates yoga philosophy and embodies the calmness and attentiveness you would seek in a teacher. She provides great detail on how to feel into your poses, helping to adjust while helping me to be mindful of how it feels for me, never forcing into a shape just because it looks good on a photo. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Pontip Vibulsiriwong
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this place! Instructor Ping is incredibly attentive and knowledgeable, always taking the time to explain each pose and offer gentle corrections. You can really tell she cares about her students’ progress and comfort. Every class feels balanced, challenging, and grounding at the same time. And the studio omg! Absolutely BEAUTIFUL! It radiates such calm, peaceful energy. Easily my favorite yoga studio in town

reviews.name: Eli Han
reviews.text: "Really enjoyed the drop in class with Ping! She brings such wonderful positive energy and is very attentive throughout. I  didn’t even realize we went well over the scheduled 75 minutes. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Sam Padua
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve had. Great service from reception to the actual massage to after massage. Really happy I went to Let’s Relax vs. a random massage service during my trip to Bangkok

reviews.name: osteo sophie
reviews.text: Very skillful massage by Kenika today, so grateful they could accommodate me when other Let's relax places were fully booked. Lovely and peaceful outlet, with very kind staff. 100% recommended, I feel rejuvenated :)))

reviews.name: Moël Mölbert
reviews.text:
Great way to end my trip in Bangkok!
I spent three hours at Let’s Relax Spa in the Asia Hotel and had a wonderful experience.

Even without a reservation (which is highly recommended), everything was arranged last minute thanks to the very kind and helpful receptionist Nattarika.

A special thank you to my therapist Nareeumon – the “Blossoming” package (including body scrub, massage, and facial) was excellent from start to finish. She was very attentive and focused on my shoulder issue with great care.

Overall a relaxing and high-quality experience.
Highly recommended – I’ll definitely come back!

reviews.name: Pui Wai Fung
reviews.text: Very quiet and relaxing. Soft spoken staff. My technician has made me learn I could stretch that far. After the 1 hour oil massage, she have me a mini Thai massage session and I heard all the cracking sounds. My hands and feet were able to stay warm, blood circulation was better. I felt the heaviness in my head has lifted. Very calm and energetic after the massage. It is located at the 4th floor of Asia Hotel. Kindly ask the lobby staff to show you the elevator going up to the spa.

reviews.name: Linda Santana
reviews.text:
I booked a last-minute spa experience package online and was able to get an appointment easily. The service was excellent. I was a bit nervous going in, not knowing what to expect, but the entire experience exceeded my expectations.
I left feeling relaxed and rejuvenated, exactly what I needed. I believe my therapist was named Wajee, she was wonderful, took her time, and made sure I was comfortable throughout. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Indra Graber
reviews.text: I had a wonderful time. All the staff are very caring and I have the best massage after a very long flight. Thank you!

reviews.name: Chattharika Ray
reviews.text: It’s very relax and comfortable. This spa is so clean and beautiful decoration.😍 So good!!!!

reviews.name: Seok Bin Quek
reviews.text: Environment is good, super clean which means you’re paying for the price also. Did aroma massage. Massage therapist so so, hope for more relief to the aches but more to smooth the skin.

reviews.name: SOUMYA ARUN
reviews.text: Very relaxing and the best service I have experienced till date !!! Highly recommend the Spa!!

reviews.name: Hana Park
reviews.text:
tried other spa places as well, but lets relax was the best imo.
it was first recommended by a friend.
onsen also available at certain locations

reviews.name: Wei CZ
reviews.text: Enjoy whole massage treatment and environment. Will come back again for massage ❤️

reviews.name: Marc F
reviews.text:
On the strength of the reviews I visited Let’s Relax in the Hotel Asia. It was terrible. And it has good reviews because of unethical tactics.

I had a massage there on a bed. The bed is a slab with hole in it so it’s hard on the neck. The massage was terrible. The bed sounded like I was on a diaper.

Immediately when the massage is done, while you are unclothed and on the bed, you are presented with their survey. I’ve never seen such flagrant coercion when someone was vulnerable.

I was happy when it was done and I’d discourage anyone thinking of attending Let’s Relax to heed the truth and go somewhere else.

K Ek was totally awesome

Prerequisites - None, Bangkok Scuba Academy provided all equipment,  along with personal pickup/drop off.

Training - Excellent, and thorough.  I started off quite nervous; Ek was very patient with me. Joel guided me with underwater navigation, we had a great time with Fish ID too.

Service - First Class, very comfortable journeys, great local cuisine too. Excellent for local and international prospective divers.

Additional - We released baby bamboo sharks back to the sea, which was great to experience. Ek also helped me with general requests in Thailand. When diving you always make new friends along the way!

Thoroughly recommend, and I will plan future dives with Bangkok Scuba Academy.

reviews.name: young Kim
reviews.text:
감히 최고의 마사지샵이었다 평하고싶습니다.
세련된느낌은 아니지만 마사지는 손맛입니다.
메인으로 계신 마사지사 두분이 정말 잘합니다.
몸컨디션이 안좋다하시면 꼭 가세요 ...
그냥 세서 시원한게 아닌
아프지않은데 묵직하게 눌러주며 마사지해주시는 스킬이 남다릅니다.
이틀동안 가봤고 두분다 잘하심 타이마사지만 받아도 다풀려요
와 진짜 6시간 숙면취하고 나온듯한 개운함임..
첫날은 가서 발마사지 어깨받고 그 어깨짧게받은걸로 등이 다풀려서 와... 미쳤다 했고 두번째 타이마사지에서는 등이 와 진짜 ㅠㅠㅠ너무좋아
외져서 접근성이아쉽다했는데 2호점도 큰도로변에있다고함
2호점은 작지만 깔끔한스타일이라는데 1호점오셈 그냥 여기오셈 미쳤음
reviews.textTranslated:
I dare say this was the best massage shop I've ever been to.

It doesn't have a sophisticated vibe, but the real touch of a massage comes from the hands.

The two main masseurs there are truly skilled.

If you're not feeling well, you absolutely must go...

It's not just about being strong and refreshing;

Their skill is exceptional; they massage with deep, heavy pressure that doesn't hurt.

I've been there for two days, and both of them are excellent. Even just getting a Thai massage is enough to fully relax.

Wow, it feels as refreshing as if I'd just woken up from a deep sleep for six hours...

On the first day, I went for a foot and shoulder massage, and that brief shoulder session completely loosened up my back. I thought, "Wow... this is insane." And for the second Thai massage, my back... wow, seriously ㅠㅠㅠ it was so good.

People said accessibility was a bit lacking because it's out of the way, but I heard there's a second branch right on a main road.

They say the second branch is small but clean, but come to the first one? Just come here. It's insane.

ownerDescription: N&P Muay Thai & P.Pao-In Muay Thai Camp offers Muay Thai training and Stay & Train in Rama 2, Bangkok, Thailand. Beginners are welcome, and sparring is optional. Our Stay & Train packages include a private air-conditioned room, Wi-Fi, breakfast and dinner, with two training sessions Monday–Saturday. We also offer group classes and private lessons. Reception can communicate in English; trainers speak Thai and a little English. Contact us to confirm your dates, room availability and airport pickup arrangements.

reviews.name: Boivin Mathis
reviews.text:
An incredible place! The coaches are fantastic.

Back in France, I practiced kickboxing, but I was a bit rusty and had never tried Muay Thai before. I asked the coaches to teach me proper technique and really push me, and they did exactly that. Their instruction was excellent, and I improved a lot.

I also brought some friends who were trying Muay Thai for the very first time. The coaches adapted perfectly to their level, took things slowly, and taught them a great deal. Whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced fighter, this gym is suitable for everyone.

One of the best parts is that you get to train alongside professional Muay Thai athletes, which makes the experience even more special.

The gym has everything you need for Muay Thai training, as well as a fully equipped fitness area. The prices are similar to other gyms in the area, but the quality of the coaching, the facilities, and the people you train with are on another level.

I honestly can’t recommend this place enough.

title: Passionfood Thai Cooking School Chiang Mai
ownerDescription: At Passionfood School we teach our clients to cook a range of Thai dishes, as chosen by them. Our most popular courses are the half day courses. We are situated in the centre of the old town of Chiang Mai in the square. We enjoy what we do and we try to make sure our clients have a wonderful experience. We speak excellent English and other languages. Cooking has always been my passion and my career, and before establishing my own school, for several years I was an instructor at the best schools in Chiang Mai, when Covid struck I moved to Bangkok where I tutored clients in their homes. Opening my own school is so exciting, I have so many ideas about how to make the Passionfood experience truly memorable.

reviews.name: Martina Colombo Bassi
reviews.text:
joined the Passion Food Cooking Class with good expectations, and overall it was a pleasant experience — but with some mixed feelings.

First of all, a big plus for their flexibility: they were extremely kind in allowing us to change our booking to a day later because we were exhausted from jet lag. That was really appreciated and says a lot about their hospitality.

During the class, the ladies were very friendly, welcoming, and clearly experienced. The atmosphere was relaxed and enjoyable, and the food we prepared was honestly very good — and also a lot! You definitely won’t leave hungry.

That said, something felt a bit “off.” The class itself is quite basic and very structured. You are guided step-by-step to the point where even plating is directed, which makes it feel less like a cooking experience and more like following instructions. If you’re looking to really learn techniques or have some creative freedom, this might feel a bit limited.

It’s not a bad experience at all — especially for beginners or those just wanting a fun activity — but depending on what you’re looking for, it may not fully meet expectations.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed feedback. We’re really glad to hear that you had an overall pleasant experience, enjoyed the food, and appreciated our flexibility with your booking — that truly means a lot to us.

We’d also like to share a bit of context regarding your experience in class. The instructors you attended are relatively new to our team, having been with us for about 1–2 months. Because of this, they may follow a more structured and guided teaching style to ensure that all participants — especially those with different cooking backgrounds — can comfortably follow along.

Our classes are designed to be accessible for beginners and enjoyable as a hands-on experience rather than a professional-level training course. That said, we absolutely understand your point about wanting more creativity and deeper technique, and it’s something we are continuously working to improve.

We also want to clarify that while we provide guidance, guests are always welcome to adjust, explore, and be creative with their dishes — we never intend to restrict personal expression.

Your feedback is incredibly valuable, and we will definitely take it into account as we continue to develop our teaching approach and train our team.

Thank you again for joining us, and we hope to have the chance to welcome you back in the future. 🙏🏻🩵😊

reviews.name: Luc Pastoor
reviews.text:
Last week, my girlfriend and I took this amazing cooking class.
We found Passion Food through a recommendation from a friend, and everything she said turned out to be absolutely true! We started at the local market, where we got a great explanation about various typical Thai ingredients, including the ones we would be using ourselves.

Afterwards, we were taken to the cooking location, and that’s where the fun really began. We had a lovely small group of five people in total, including ourselves, which meant there was plenty of time for personal guidance and lots of useful tips and tricks.

We prepared several delicious Thai dishes, which we could choose in advance. Pro tip: make sure you come hungry! Whatever you can’t finish, you can take home in a doggy bag. You really get to learn the finer details of Thai cooking, and you’re guided through the entire process from start to finish.

At the end, you even receive a recipe booklet so you can recreate the dishes at home.
A big thank you to Boom for teaching the class, her enthusiasm and energy made it a huge success. We highly recommend this experience to anyone looking for a great cooking class in Chiang Mai!

reviews.text:
That was such a fun experience for me! Even though I went alone, I felt very comfortable and met so many cool people. The food we cooked was absolutely amazing (and the amount of it was more than what we could finish, so the staff kindly put in a to-go container). The instructions were clear and we also received a very detailed cook book after the master class.
Huge thank you to Sandy for being so sweet and funny!!

(also I’m glad that everyone in my group was on the same page and we shared the food we made with each other, this way I was able to try more dishes than I cooked)

reviews.name: Bex Frew
reviews.text:
Really enjoyed the Passion food cooking class, Great Value! Nhoi & Sandy were both really lovely, helpful and welcoming.

The class picks you up ( great communication) you go to the market first where they show the ingredients you will be cooking with.

You get to pick an appetizer,stir-fry, soup, curry/the curry paste, mango sticky rice & Thai Iced Tea.

Tasty Lychee welcome drink
You eat after each course.
So much food, clean spare.
Highly Recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your time to leave a lovely feedback to us

reviews.name: Amiya Ahmed
reviews.text: Great class led by Boom. Started with market visit. Made an appetizer, soup, noodle, curry, dessert, and Thai tea. We got to select what we wanted to learn (and eat!) and price included group transportation. Great value and teaching, oh and includes little cook book. !!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re happy to have you in the class , please enjoy cooking at home 🏠

reviews.name: Zhaodong Li
reviews.text:
Me and my friend’s ever first Thai cooking experience was wonderful with our lovely teacher MUSIC🫶🧑‍🍳in Passionfood.

The place was close to the old town, small group gave us more tutoring. Clear cooking steps gets you more indulge in the cooking  process.👍👍
If you want to try Thai cooking course in Chiangmai, Passionfood is a must-try😁
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing such positive feedback! We’re happy that you enjoyed the dishes and service. Your support means so much to us.💖

reviews.name: Aretha Peethamparam
reviews.text:
A great afternoon!

I love Thai food, so it was great to learn about the ingredients and techniques involved in making my favourite dishes, and bring home new cooking skills.

Sandy was patient and explained everything clearly. Everything was paced well, never felt rushed even though we cooked 7 things in 3 hours! The space was clean and it was nice to be outside in nature.

We went as a group of three and it was nice to meet other travellers with the same interests as us from all over the world.

We were given a recipe book to take home to cook yummy Thai food at home.

Would definitely recommend Passion for anyone who’s considering it or wants a unique activity to do in Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for a wonderful review! Our team loved hearing this🙏🏼👩🏻‍🍳🥰

reviews.name: Daisy NONG
reviews.text:
I have taken a very interesting Thai food cooking course, tutored by Music. He is very considerate, detail-oriented, and cares about every student in the lessons.

To my surprise, the food I cooked is so delicious! I cannot imagine that I could make so many amazing dishes.

Thank you for Music's instructions, and thank you,Passion fool school . I'm grateful for everything.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: So glad you came!🔥🇹🇭

reviews.name: Matty N
reviews.text: Highly recommend. It was a pleasure to meet the staff at the market and learn some interesting things about the thai kitchen and the ingredients. Its the coolest way to speak about the spices while your on such a cool market. Afterwards we got pucked up by a taxi and brought to the location nearby. Very great experience, extremly delicious dishes and a lot to talk and learn about it. The staff is very kind and helpfull for any questions you have. Thank you so much Boom 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review, we glad that you enjoyed our cooking class!

reviews.name: Tyler Hall
reviews.text: Amazing experience with our teacher Nhoi. We made 7 different dishes including an appetizer, stir fry, soup, curry paste, curry, dessert, and drink. We were picked up from our hotel and brought to the market where we were throughly informed about everything we’d be cooking with today along with extra time to look around and buy stuff for ourselves. The groups are a great size which created an immersive experience. I would definitely recommend Passionfood cooking school!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the lovely review! Glad to hear that you had amazing experience with our cooking class, always welcome to have you back again! 🙏🏼😁

reviews.name: Jan Kubíček
reviews.text:
We joined a cooking class at Passionfood Thai Cooking School in Chiang Mai, and it was an absolutely amazing experience. The class started with a visit to a local market, where a lovely lady explained in detail which herbs, spices, and other ingredients are commonly used in Thai cuisine. It was great to see everything firsthand and learn so many interesting things about local food.

After that, we went to the cooking school and jumped straight into cooking. For each dish, there was a choice, so everyone could pick according to their taste. In total, we prepared five dishes and a dessert, finishing the experience with a pleasant tea break. The food was absolutely delicious, and the portions were more than generous.

A big thank you goes to NHOI and SANDYI, who were incredibly friendly, patient, and fun. Thanks to them, the atmosphere was fantastic throughout the whole class, and we truly enjoyed every moment.

If you are in Chiang Mai and love good food—or want to learn how to cook Thai cuisine—this cooking class is highly recommended. Definitely a must-do experience! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review! It was pleasure having you. We look forward to welcoming you back for another culinary adventure! 🙏🏼😁

reviews.name: Francesca L. M. Celano
reviews.text:
One of the best experiences we had in Chiang Mai! This cooking class was absolutely amazing. The teacher was funny, energetic, and made everything easy to understand, even for beginners.
It’s also a perfect activity to do alone because you naturally meet new people, cook together, and end up chatting and laughing the whole time. Such a great social experience.
We learned how to make spring rolls, Pad Thai, green curry paste from scratch, Tom Yum, green curry, and mango sticky rice. Everything was delicious — and be prepared to eat A LOT by the end!
If you’re in Chiang Mai, don’t miss this. Totally worth it. 🍜🥭
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Next time if you’re in Chiang Mai please visit us to cook others again 💖😀

title: GYMkruoor
ownerDescription: Basic gymnastics ,GR gym, flip and Fitness center
address: bronco kids and sports club 76 Si Phum, เมือง Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXVM+82 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Beatriz Vasconcelos
reviews.text: The gym is great, there’s all machines needed for a full workout and the owner is super friendly. The price is super fair

reviews.name: Zhang Dizot
reviews.text:
Equipment poorly maintained, handlebars rusty, and many equipment way too big for Asian female. I’m 155cm and I cannot even reach the hook when I try to do high pull down. Seated rowing is also a disaster I think I hurt my back even I did a lighter weight than usual.
It’s a gym for tall people, white, black, or Asian men. I regretted coming here

reviews.name: chentt ryan
reviews.text: When I wasn't sure how to use the new equipment, the coach was very, proactive and patient, demonstrating the usage for me. Despite the simple equipment, I would still highly recommend this place—it's very cozy and full of goodwill.

reviews.name: Alex Funke
reviews.text:
Five stars and I’d give it six if I could.

Location: perfect if you’re staying in the old city and want something walking distance

Equipment: good to very good in terms of condition and variety

The space: amazingly open with 10m high ceilings and good air flow, thanks to open walls and lots of fans. Which also means no funky gym smell 👌🏼

Staff: incredibly lovely and kind. Plus, there’s a cat.

Price: unbeatable at 100 baht for a day pass
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for coming to my gym and I hope you will come back again and we will meet again next time.

reviews.name: BackpackingAndy
reviews.text:
This is a nice gym, has everything you need for a workout. There’s a Muy Thai gym next door.

Some of the equipment, particularly the belt machines, could be updated. Otherwise, would definitely recommend the gym for training.

reviews.name: Josh Simons
reviews.text:
Amazing gym for only 100 baht daily entry. Has all the equipment I need to get a good workout in. Bench press, squat rack, smith machine, cable station, cardio equipment, lots of machines.

Just know it is not air conditioned so be prepared to sweat! There are quite a few fans, but I noticed a few of them were off (not sure if broken?). I had to knock 1 star because of this. If they invested in one of those big overhead fans it would be perfect. Other than that, it’s wonderful!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Josh Simons, my fans all work fine.  Did you just not press open?  Let's take a look again.  Thank you for using my gym.

reviews.name: Tobias Thaisen
reviews.text: Super cool center for only 100 baht per day. Everything is there for a good training and there are enough fans for you to survive the heat.

reviews.name: Arroyo Spero
reviews.text: Great gym with a lot of equipment.  Had some of my favourite machines and plenty of benches.  There’s also a gymnastics gym on the same floor and a pool below.  In the corner of the gym there’s an aviary which was always something to look at and listen to between sets.  The cat that lives there is also very sweet and mischievous.  It came over to see me and was my workout partner that day as the gym was empty.  They sell pocari sweat which is the go to electrolyte sports drink in Thailand IMO,  the rest don’t do it for me.  Bottles of pocari are 35 Baht and entry to the gym is 100 Baht.  They request you sign in after payment.  Overall the gym is superb but it’s tightly packed and reorganizing some of the equipment would bode very well.  I encourage you to watch your footing closely in here (the same goes for almost anywhere in Thailand) but there was a few tripping hazards that can get you.

reviews.name: Jerrick Lim
reviews.text:
The best gym that fits into my liking. However, i would not advise anyone that wana patronize this outlet if you are looking for the following

1. Air Conditioning
2. Water cooler system
3. Proper toilets

Free Parking. Limited for cars though.

For a 100baht entry fee (Daily), this gym beats nearly all of the gyms around. Love it! Been there daily ever since i step foot into Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: juicywatermelon2
reviews.text:
I really like this gym. It's clean, spacious and airy. High ceiling with open windows, lots of fresh air and fans. Doesn't get hot at all. No aircon for me, I can't stand working out in aircon gyms breathing in recycled air.
Well equipped with lots of free weights, olympic bars and squat racks - perfect for a bodybuilding workout with compound exercises. Many machines too if that's your thing. All well maintained and in good condition.
Staff is very friendly and helpful. Entry 100 baht and monthly membership 900 baht.
Gym is not crowded at all. I went on a Saturday afternoon and there were only 3-4 of us. Went again on a weekday afternoon and had the whole gym to myself.
Best thing is that working out topless is allowed. Remember to use a towel and clean the machines after use. There are spray bottles and towels for cleaning.
The gym occupies the right half of the hall. Left half is used for gymnastic classes for girls. Opposite is a muay thai school.
It's located on the 2nd floor of a building. On the ground floor there's a kids swimming pool, art classes, chess club and toilets.

reviews.name: lim may sally
reviews.text: Ok workout place, friendly staff and clean enviromment but 100b for a day pass is too expensive. No aircon, too few gym equipment for the fee, no free towel provide. Will not come back as there are other better gym around and also 100b or cheaper.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for the review.  We now have more equipment at the gym.  We look forward to serving you again.

reviews.name: Nicholas White
reviews.text: It’s a good gym, lots of fans, 100thb a day, lots of equipment. Lots of weights, dumbbells up to 30 kg. Very clean and the staff are friendly

reviews.name: Jonathan Taaffe
reviews.text: It's a good gym (100 baht day pass) and has everything you need. It has no air con so is a little hot (hence the 4 stars). You can also buy protein there. It's really quiet though. I went at peak hours twice and there was barely anyone in there. It's also a gymnasium hall and Thai boxing training area so I think those parts are the busier sestions.

reviews.name: Arthur Duarte
reviews.text:
This gym is a good place for regular workout, has a lot of space and equipments, and it's not crowded.
Some of the equipments are a little old, but for the price and location, I think it is a great cost and benefit gym.
A daily use is just around 100BHT

reviews.name: Armin Kalidado
reviews.text: Very good gym. You find everything you need for your workout. Some of the machines are old but everything is working. No aircon, only fans. 1 day ist only 100 THB.

reviews.name: Stijn van Willigen
reviews.text: Great, great gym. Friendly staff and a ton of equipment including power cage. Only things missing is leg curl as far as I could see. 100 baht (3 usd or so) for a one day pass.

reviews.name: Jay Connelly
reviews.text: Nice gym with good equipment in the old city. 100 baht per day. The staff are very helpful and friendly. There is a good amount of space and the gym itself is very clean. Muay Thai classes are available next door.

reviews.name: Angelo
reviews.text: Fantastic gym, had everything we needed (squat rack, free weights, machines..). Very clean, friendly owners and a day pass is only 100 baht! Plus, if you collect 5 day passes you get the 6th one for free! We might make use of that :)

reviews.name: Lino Thaesler
reviews.text: great gym with good equipment! It has everything you need for a good workout. Payed 100 Baht for a daypass.

reviews.name: Li Qi
reviews.text: If you’d like to work out in a spacious and well equipped open floor with high ceiling, chill vibe, and among bird chirping (you’ll see), this gym is for you!!! Easily my favourite in town!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏

reviews.name: Вероника Кучина
reviews.text: Som was very good. After a long flight and a lot of tension massage with her felt so relaxing. Especially hips and arms feel so much better now

I believe my massage was $750 BAHT for the 2 hour Thai Balm full body. They gave me some pants and buttoned down shirt to cover myself. At the end they offered me tea but i respectfully declined. I would recommend this place to others for sure. Thank you again.

Back, neck and shoulder masseuse really got stuck in and massaged out a bunch of knots. Good level of pressure with some short moments of discomfort (for the greater good!). title: Pinsinchai Muay Thai Gym
ownerDescription:
🏡 Bangkok | book in advance
Where Tradition Meets Excellence.
Train, Stay & fight in thailand 🇹🇭
Dive into the Heart of Muay Thai : Join us at our local Muay Thai gym. Train with expert instructors who bring the techniques to life while sharing tips and techniques behind each move. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned fighter, our gym offers a friendly environment to refine your skills, push your limits, and bond. Embrace the strength, discipline, and tradition of Muay Thai with us, and leave with more than just improved fitness – leave with unforgettable memories
Please book your training session in advance.
address: 41/137 Sukhonthasawat Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

reviews.name: Taresa Lee
reviews.text: Super friendly coaches & admin team! All levels welcome here. Super warm atmosphere and they treat their students like family - even remembering their names after 1-2 sessions.

reviews.name: Natthakan Phon-in
reviews.text: I had the chance to visit Pinsinchai Muay Thai Gym. Unfortunately, I could only train there once before moving away. Even so, it was a wonderful experience. The trainers were professional, friendly, and made learning Muay Thai both fun and enjoyable. A place that left a lasting impression on me. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Maja Lynn Bacareza
reviews.text:
Amazing experience at Pinsinchai Muay Thai Gym — highly recommended 1000000 out of 5 stars!

We booked a private session followed by a group class on the same day, which was intense but perfect for complete beginners and any levels. The gym has an authentic, traditional Muay Thai atmosphere with a strong focus on proper technique. Coaches Nikky, Nickname, and Bon/Phettapee were very patient and highly technical, clearly breaking down fundamentals like stance, punches, kicks, and elbows with hands-on corrections. There were other champions/coaches in the gym who also helped in checking our form and guided us. ❤️ We were also fortunate to learn footwork fundamentals from Mr. Asawindum, emphasizing its importance as the foundation of Muay Thai. The private session gave focused one-on-one learning, while the group class added energy and real training dynamics.

Exhausting, rewarding, and genuinely authentic — perfect for all levels. Would absolutely return soon! We couldn’t think of checking other gyms as this is perfect for us!  Wish we had a lot of time in Thailand to train here! 🥊🇹🇭

reviews.name: Daryl Ong
reviews.text: I've made this gym my base whenever I'm visiting Bangkok for training. I've visited several gyms prior to this and the level of attention, comfort and friendliness at Pinsinchai is the best. I've joined both group and private lessons and I've learnt so much from the kind Krus. Well-run, professional and enjoyable, I'd highly recommend this gym for both beginners and seasoned fighters! Special shout out to  K Aim and Kru Somdet for always taking care of me 😊

reviews.name: Kenneth Tan
reviews.text:
Went to Pinsinchai recently. The instructions were communicated clearly after I contacted them on instagram.

The gym is clean, trainers and fellow trainee were all very friendly. The session is suitable for both advanced and beginner.

Special thanks to trainer Somdet for providing many tips to improve my bad habits.

Thank you!

reviews.name: Kelvin Kaung Set Hein
reviews.text:
Absolutely legendary experience at Pinsinchai Muay Thai Gym. Visiting a place with this much history was surreal. The gym has been closed to the public for over 50 years and carries a deep legacy in the sport.

What made it even more special was how welcoming Aim was. She took the time to share stories, answer questions, and made the whole experience feel personal and respectful. She even helped us record our training, capturing moments we’ll never forget. You can feel the soul of Muay Thai in every corner of this place.

5 stars isn’t enough. If you love the art, this is sacred ground.

reviews.name: Vanessa H
reviews.text:
I booked an 1 on 1 private session with Somdet and it was wonderful.

The gym is a non touristy place to learn real Muay Thai, and the instructor Somdet got down to the basics to fix my posture and pointed out my mistakes, instead of just holding pads.

As a traveler I didn’t bring my own gears, so I borrowed the gears on site.

The training environment is quiet and toilet is clean, and there are accommodations available that looks real comfy.

The place is a bit remote, but still accessible by public transport. If you are a visiting here by public transportation, I would recommend hopping off the BTS Kaesart University station and switch to Grab. It is easy to catch a Grab there.

On a nutshell, this is a wonderful place to train and to improve yourself.

reviews.name: sunny toucan
reviews.text: Pinsinchai Gym is the best Muay Thai gym in Bangkok. The trainers are top-level, many of them legendary fighters with years of experience. They pay close attention to technique and help everyone improve step by step. The gym is spacious, clean, and full of positive energy. Sparring sessions are controlled and respectful…everyone helps each other learn, and nobody goes too hard unless a newcomer gets a bit carried away. The staff are friendly, and the owners truly care about their fighters. Pinsinchai is the perfect place for serious training in a supportive, traditional Muay Thai environment.

reviews.name: กัณหา เชื้อรอด
reviews.text: Feel very homey, everyone is so friendly. The coaches are excellent. Recommend to come try, the coach also do sparring with you. If you looking for a authentic muaythai, this is you place

reviews.name: meiqi Nick
reviews.text: This is my first time to learn muay thai, pinsinchai muay thai gym is so amazing. I learned from the basic and the trainers are so kind 😊😊. Absolutely, i will come again!!

reviews.name: Nilu
reviews.text:
The best private I have ever had. They are very technical and correct basics in the way that you can actually use it in a fight or sparring. I trained with Somdet, one of the brothers, and he and everyone was very welcome and attentive in the session. The gym itself is in a very beautiful quiet and nature area and open.
It is outside of central bangkok and close to other gyms like Khongsittha.

reviews.name: A. Signature
reviews.text: Im beginner for Muaythai, the trainers taught me really well, very precise.  สนุกมากenjoy sessionมากๆค่า good environment recommend every one to come try!! Nice and clean they just renovated the place🥊

reviews.name: Gies Vandenberghe
reviews.text: Awesome place, skilled trainers! Pinsinchai is a must visit gym in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Benjamin Hennigan
reviews.text: Everyone at Pinsinchai was so friendly and helpful during my PT sessions there. I will continue to recommend them to anyone looking at coming to Thailand to train. Thank you for the amazing experience.

reviews.name: Sarkis Doueihi
reviews.text: One of my favourite gyms to train at in Bangkok. Love learning from the twins. They bring together enthusiasm and playfulness, making the classes so much fun and engaging. Will definitely be back ❤️

reviews.name: peeraya
reviews.text: The trainers are so good 🥹 , we learned from the basic of muay thai 🥊. This gym is the best that I’ve been 👍🏻 Recommendddd!!!!

reviews.name: Kenneth Interiano
reviews.text:
Pinsinchai Muay Thai Gym is an oasis for those seeking authentic Muay Thai training in Bangkok. The attention to detail by coaches Somdet, Samart, and Nicname is unparalleled (sorry if I misspelled your names 🙏🏼). Each session is infused with a dedication to balance, a relaxed 'sabai' approach, and precise technique, embodying the true essence of the sport. What sets Pinsinchai apart is not just the skill of the coaches, but the genuine passion they have for coaching and helping others improve.

This gym isn't about flashy rings or Instagram-worthy equipment; it's about honing your skills and mastering the art of Muay Thai. The culture of the gym is ingrained in every aspect of practice, fostering an environment where every member becomes part of a tight-knit community.

Located away from the bustling streets of Bangkok, the neighborhood offers a friendly atmosphere conducive to focused training. At Pinsinchai, you don't just train like a Nak Muay, you live like one. If you're serious about refining your game and learning from skilled professionals who are committed to their craft, look no further than Pinsinchai Muay Thai Gym.

reviews.name: Daanish Faisal
reviews.text: This gym’s fire Coaches actually know their stuff, training hits hard but it’s fun, and the place is clean. If you’re in Thailand and wanna get some real Muay Thai in, definitely check it out. This is a real Muay Thai gym reminds me of old Muay Thai you can feel it in the air 😂 legendary gym will definitely come back when I go to Thailand again! Everyone is really welcoming and nice as well.

reviews.name: Elsić “Elzoulafrench” 974
reviews.text:
This gym has some positive aspects but also significant shortcomings, depending on what you're looking for.

Positives:
The owner is lovely and welcoming. One coach, known as Nickname, stands out for their professionalism and attention to everyone. If you're looking for a casual introduction to Muay Thai, this gym might work for you.

Challenges:
The head coach's approach can sometimes feel intrusive, as they tend to direct client behavior while overlooking disrespectful conduct from others. There also seems to be arbitrary favoritism toward certain clients, regardless of skill level, which can feel unbalanced considering the cost.

The training format lacks proper structure, particularly in fitness and cardio preparation. Clients are expected to run alone, and sessions often resemble private lessons for select individuals, leaving others unsure of their role or progression. Without a clear hierarchy or communication, those serious about improving may struggle to find value here.

From my personal experience—having had 14 fights in Thailand—I found it confusing and discouraging to watch some participants who were irregular in practice, smoking weed, and yet taking up significant space and attention during sessions. While building friendly relationships is great, the coaches often seemed to prioritize this over maintaining professionalism.

Overall:
For beginners or those seeking a relaxed and casual experience, this gym might suffice. However, if you're looking for rigorous training, a professional atmosphere, or a structured environment conducive to growth, you might want to explore other gyms with a stronger focus on consistent training and exposure to professional fighters.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
After discussing with the coach, we agreed that there were certain issues with your behavior that made it necessary to decline your participation in training. We apologize, but we must consider all perspectives and prioritize the collective satisfaction and opinions of the group.

Thank you for sharing your perspective. We value feedback from all our students, but it’s important to recognize that the gym provides equal opportunities for everyone. Individual behavior, commitment, and attitude are key factors that shape each person’s experience here. We believe it’s crucial to consider the broader context rather than focusing on a single point of view.

Our coaches and staff work diligently to maintain a supportive and inclusive environment, while also encouraging clients to push toward their personal goals. We welcome anyone who is serious about improvement to take initiative, communicate openly, and fully engage with the opportunities and guidance we offer.

If you have time, we’d be happy to discuss this matter further in person at the gym.

reviews.name: DanAGo
reviews.text: Staying nearby just across at Centerpoint Plus Hotel and this foot massage strip is my favorite go-to at night. Of all the foot massage shops here... MB seems to getting all the action. Don't wait around and schedule for a session when you get here cause the line could sometimes get long in a matter of minutes. Once you're settled in... the massage is very relaxing. Massage sequence and pressure is good overall. For relaxation go for light strokes (effleurage). But after a long day walking, you prefer targeting specific muscle knots and  I recommend the Medium or hard Pressure. Depending on the therapist assigned to you, technique and hand pressure varies but they do know how to do a proper foot massage. Just tell the therapist after a few minutes  of massage on how strong the pressure you prefer and they will adjust accordingly. That's why I kept coming back here every chance I got. I do a lot of walking around Bangkok so this is the best spot to take care of all the aches and pains. Great service from start to end. The second floor is for the body massage and go for the well known Thai Massage instead of the Swedish. Its an active massage focused on stretching, deep tissue massage to improve movement, energy and mobility.  Where better to experience this but in Bangkok and in this spot. Have a good night... Enjoy your massage friends and Khop khun khap (ขอบคุณครับ).

reviews.name: Will
reviews.text:
Started well but ended unpleasant.

First session I had a nice lady masseur, the foot area was ok. My friend's masseur seems to be saving energy but after asking for stronger massage, she only accomodated to more pressure after some time at her own timing.

My elder lady masseur was professional. Although the foot and calves were not strong presses but the neck and shoulder area was quite good and lady was able to find one of my hidden sore spots. Appreciated it.

Came back to massage again, waited and waited. It seems that the other masseurs were more keen to lure in more customers other than to tell us to go in and wait or just proceed. Told us my masseur was upstairs, coming down. Asked us to enter the premises,  but it is quite awkward as I do not want to be accidentally served by another as I only wanted my requested masseur.

Waited for approximately 20mins or more, left disappointed.

It was not an out of the world massage the first time but as one sore spot was found , I was willing to give a good tip on the first round as well as to wait for the second session, which never came.

Went some while along the Main Street. Guy was strong, strokes were firm. No need to wait. Some later blessings.

reviews.text: I used to come here every BKK visit but the standard have dropped this time round not sure is it because we went for aromatherapy massage. But do not go for their oil massages!! Maybe the foot and Thai massage will be okay but worst massage i have here. Proof that I did pay for a massage here… and I feel worst then when I went in

reviews.name: Yi Zhuo
reviews.text:
I came to this shop with sincere expectations. When I left feedback, the owner responded very promptly and politely in the public comment section.

Unfortunately, my further attempts to connect via phone and Line went unanswered. I completely understand that everyone can be busy at times, yet it feels disappointing when public replies are timely, while private concerns are left unaddressed.

I recognize that it is challenging for a small massage shop to manage every staff member perfectly. Even so, great service always comes from understanding and valuing the customer’s experience.

Surface-level communication cannot build long-term trust. Due to this unsatisfactory follow-up experience, I will not be returning for future visits.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Yi Zhuo
Thank you for your honest feedback. I am truly sorry that our private communication didn’t match the promptness of our public reply. Please accept my sincere apologies for the frustration this caused; it was never our intention to make you feel unheard or undervalued.

As a small business, we are still refining our systems, and your experience highlights exactly where we need to improve. We genuinely value your trust and would love the chance to make this right personally.

I have double-checked our lines, and I will be personally monitoring our direct numbers at 093-027-2737 and 02-653-6294, as well as our Line account, to ensure your message reaches me. If you are open to it, please reach out one more time so I can offer a solution that reflects how much we truly care about our guests.
Warm regards,

reviews.name: Chan Sow Hwa
reviews.text:
I absolutely love the massages here! I've been here so many times that almost every time I visit Bangkok, this is one of my must-visit places.

The therapists are always excellent—their techniques, pressure, and service are consistently amazing. What touches me the most is how thoughtful they are. Whenever they notice I'm feeling cold or have fallen asleep, they'll quietly bring me an extra blanket and cover me up. It's such a small gesture, but it always makes me feel so cared for 🥰

Every trip, I tell myself I should try a different massage place for a change. But somehow, every time I do, I end up regretting it and wondering why I didn't just come back here instead! 😂
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.text:
I had a really good experience here. The massage therapist clearly knew what they were doing and provided a professional and relaxing Thai massage.

The price is also great — 300 baht for a 1-hour Thai massage, or 350 baht if you choose the balm option. Honestly, there’s no need to spend 1000+ baht at more expensive places. For Thai massage, the techniques are quite similar across most places, and this spot delivers great value for the price.

The place is clean and has nice vibe. The lady who did my massage was very
