reviews.name: Jenna Magallanes
reviews.text:
Thai Lanta was a great experience for our group and honestly one of the best values we found in the area. Prices were cheaper than many of the other options nearby — for example, a 30-minute foot massage was only 180 baht.

My first Thai massage was with Ped, who was older and had a very gentle approach. It left me wanting a bit more pressure, but for someone who prefers a softer touch it would be absolutely perfect—and it was still very effective and relaxing.

I’m usually a firm believer that 60 minutes isn’t enough for a massage, but I later booked a 60-minute deep tissue with Naan and it was exactly what I needed. She worked through so much tension in my body that I was talking about how great it was for the rest of the day.

We came with friends and everyone got foot massages together, and then full body Thai massages. Every person left very pleased. The staff also tried hard to keep my husband and me in the same room even though we booked different services, which we really appreciated.

Solid AC, relaxing atmosphere, and definitely worth the short walk over from the main street.

reviews.text: I did my first thai message here and it was amazing! Very kind staff who speak good english and the masseuse was also really kind and had good pressure and variety. Would definitely recommend a thai massage here, also if its your first one and dont really know what to expect!

I understand that my appointment was late in the evening and that staff may be tired after a long day. I wasn’t expecting anything extraordinary, but I did expect a foot massage to feel like an actual massage. Unfortunately, the overall experience fell short of even that basic expectation.

title: Crystal Dive Koh Tao
ownerDescription: Crystal Dive, Thailand's Premier Dive Centre. Your gateway to the excitement and adventure of the underwater world. Offering diving courses for all levels from beginner to professional level.
address: 7 1 Koh Phangan - Koh Tao, Tambon Ko Tao, Ko Pha-ngan District, Surat Thani 84360, Thailand
plusCode: 3RPF+7W Ko Tao, Ko Pha-ngan District, Surat Thani, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
There are plenty of things to do on Koh Tao, whether you want to spend your days diving beneath the waves, hiking through the jungle, relaxing on one of Koh Tao’s many beaches, or simply enjoying the island at your own pace. While Koh Tao is famous for its incredible diving, there’s so much more to discover once you step off the ferry.

From scenic viewpoints and hidden beaches to local food, wellness experiences, lively evenings, and unique Koh Tao activities, this little island offers plenty of ways to fill your days. Whether you're planning your first trip or looking for a reason to visit Koh Tao again, you'll quickly find out that some of the best things to do in Koh Tao are simply taking the time to explore, slow down, and see where the island takes you.

The SSI Advanced Specialty Diver recognition is often the moment when diving truly clicks. You’ve finished your Open Water course, logged a few fun dives, and started feeling comfortable underwater, and maybe even managed to climb back onto the boat without losing a fin (most of the time). Nice work.

At this stage, many divers ask the same question: what’s next after Open Water?
That’s exactly where the SSI Advanced Specialty Diver comes in.

Rather than being a single course, this recognition is built through SSI advanced diving courses that focus on specific skills and environments. It’s designed to develop real-world ability through advanced scuba training, allowing you to improve buoyancy, navigation, depth awareness, and overall dive confidence at your own pace.

For divers looking to progress with purpose, the SSI Advanced Specialty Diver is one of the most flexible and rewarding forms of advanced scuba diving certification available today.

At Crystal Dive, we love introducing people to the ocean. The thrill of breathing underwater for the first time, spotting a curious clownfish, or gliding over coral gardens never gets old. But behind every smile and high five after a dive, there is a simple truth we take seriously.

Responsible diving in Thailand is not optional. It is who we are.

We are lucky to call Koh Tao home. It is one of the most biodiverse and beautiful diving destinations in the world. But it is also a fragile environment, one that depends on every diver, instructor, and eco-friendly dive centre doing their part to protect it.

That is why we are committed to ethical diving and promoting sustainable diving practices in everything we do, from training new divers to guiding experienced ones.

Pufferfish around Koh Tao are some of our most fascinating creatures. With their adorable round bodies, curious personalities, and impressive self-defence skills, it’s no wonder divers and marine enthusiasts adore them. Whether you’re spotting them on a dive or hanging out with Steve, our resident puffer at Junkyard, these quirky little fish always bring a smile to your face. 

If you’re wondering where to see pufferfish, Koh Tao has plenty of incredible dive sites to explore. Let’s jump into why we love them so much and where you can find them in the wild!

If you’ve been researching scuba diving courses or Open Water courses on Koh Tao, you’ve probably realised something: there’s no shortage of choice on the island. Koh Tao is filled with dive shops, all offering “the best experience,” “the best instructors,” and “the best prices.”

The thing is, choosing the best dive school on Koh Tao isn’t just about passing a course. It’s about becoming a confident, capable diver who genuinely loves being underwater.

And that’s where the Crystal Dive Difference comes in.

It’s not uncommon for people to think that scuba diving insurance is wasted money or that their travel insurance covers scuba diving. And unfortunately, this means that a lot of scuba divers go diving without any insurance, or with insurance that won’t actually cover diving emergencies, especially abroad and in remote locations.

Dive accident insurance can be a very confusing topic. There are many types of scuba diving insurance available, so how do you choose the right one for you? What does diving insurance cover, and what does it not cover? Can you get travel insurance that covers scuba diving as well?

Let’s make it simpler. In this blog, we’ll look at the different types of cover, what they’re likely to include, and how to work out what makes the most sense for your next dive trip.

Scuba diving for beginners is definitely exciting, but it can also feel like jumping into the complete unknown. What does breathing underwater actually feel like? Is scuba diving safe? Will your ears hurt? Is it normal to feel nervous before diving? 

If you’re looking for honest advice about your first time scuba diving, here are 10 things nobody tells you about what scuba diving is like.

And he’s slimy and green,
That’s a Moray! 

Spotted lurking in the reef, looking like he’s got a serious attitude problem.

Don’t worry though... he’s probably more scared of you than you are of him.

That’s a Moray! 💙🌊

The Basic Diver Program 🤿🌊

Want to experience the underwater world without committing to a full certification just yet?

The SSI Basic Diver Program at Crystal Dive is the perfect way to discover what scuba diving is all about. You’ll learn the essentials, get comfortable with the equipment and experience the incredible feeling of breathing underwater, all under the guidance of our experienced instructors.

And this isn’t just a quick dip in the pool. At Crystal, we make the experience fun, relaxed and unforgettable, while never compromising on safety or training standards.

From your first breath underwater to exploring Koh Tao’s colourful reefs, you’ll get a real taste of why so many people become completely hooked on diving. 

Curious about diving? Come try it. You might just find your new obsession.

Meet Kelvin 🤿😎

Awesome instructor. Absolute legend. And a TON of fun!

Kelvin brings the perfect mix of knowledge, experience and good vibes to every dive. Whether he’s teaching a course, guiding a group or just getting everyone laughing on the boat, he knows how to make diving feel relaxed, enjoyable and memorable.

But when it comes to safety and standards, Kelvin means business. 💪

He’s all about making sure his students feel confident, comfortable and well trained, while still having a seriously good time along the way.

Basically... if you’re diving with Kelvin, expect plenty of laughs, some great diving and probably a few questionable jokes. 😂

reviews.text:
I did the open water course at Crystal last week, on something of a whim while travelling in Thailand. I was a bit anxious about the idea of breathing 18m underwater so I chose a school that looked reputable and a bit more expensive than some of the others, although the free accommodation during the course may offset that. I couldn’t have been happier with that choice as it was one of the best experiences of my life.

My instructor Koray and assistant Michele combined serious, dedicated instruction with fun and humour and I felt the course stretched me but is doable for anyone who can swim. If I hadn’t felt ready to go into the ocean on day two, I know I could have said and had some more pool time first. Koray and Michele really care and bring so much of the energy on the dive boat.

I liked it so much I extended my stay in Koh Tao to do the deep diving speciality certification with Kelvin. I was worried about going to 35m in my first week of diving but Kelvin was the most calm and reassuring presence that it ended up feeling easy. He taught me a lot of techniques to improve my diving and really helped me understand the next steps to improve in the future. He’s an excellent educator as I could see he was tailoring his style to the different needs in our group, and a good man.

What Crystal does really well is create a community - despite being solo I met lots of other divers and instructors in the Crystal bar and on the always-sociable dive boat. If I hadn’t come down with a cold, I’d have stayed a few more days to keep going out on the boat for fun dives. Kelvin, Koray and Michele all had careers in software engineering, finance and corporate events but they made a lifestyle change because they want to be here - I’m sure it’s the same for other instructors, and it really shows in the spirit here. I’ll definitely be back!

But the instructors have a wealth of experience, and I learned far more than just how to pass the requirements. The course pushed me to improve my skills, think like a professional, and build confidence underwater.

Seeing whale sharks during the program was an unforgettable experience and something I’ll always remember. Another great benefit is the lifetime free fun dives for DMT, which adds tremendous long-term value and is honestly one of the most attractive perks of training here.

Overall, this wasn’t an easy journey, but it was a rewarding one. If you’re looking for a program that emphasizes real diving skills and professional development, and you’re prepared to work hard, you’ll learn a great deal. I’m grateful for everything I gained during my time here, and I’m proud to now be a Divemaster.

reviews.name: William Curtis
reviews.text:
Cannot recommend this place enough!

If you are serious about getting some diving qualifications, or even just a nervous first timer, you could not be in safer hands. Great onsite accommodation for those early boats, and an easy walk from all the top spots on the island.  Massive shout out to Dennis (and to Todd who trained him 😂). An absolute pro who was the main reason I went on to do course after course. I went from zero experience to a confident diver in mere days, and I plan to do a lot more.

Special mention to Zoe, the on site underwater photographer.  Absolutely worth the extra for the memories she provided.

I hope to return to Koh Tao and I won't look anywhere else for my diving needs!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this amazing review! We’re thrilled to hear how much you enjoyed your experience with us and that you felt so safe and supported from day one.

Dennis will be especially happy to read this—he’s a fantastic instructor and it’s great to hear he inspired you to keep progressing through multiple courses (and we’ll be sure to pass the credit on to Todd too! 😂).

It’s awesome that you went from zero experience to a confident diver in such a short time—that’s a huge achievement.

And we couldn’t agree more about Zoe—those underwater memories are something really special to take home.

Thank you again for your kind words. We’d love to welcome you back to Koh Tao anytime, and we’ll be right here when you’re ready for the next step in your diving journey!

reviews.name: Илья Зыскунов
reviews.text:
Fun dives with Crystal Dive Koh Tao!

I just finished my Open Water Diver course two days ago and stayed for some fun dives with Crystal Dive. It was a great experience.

Special thanks to our guide, Aman. He is very experienced and clearly knows his job well. Since I’m a new diver, I really appreciated all the tips and pointers he gave me along the way. He was very helpful to everyone in the group and kept showing us interesting things underwater.

I also enjoyed diving with the rest of the group—it was a cool atmosphere. I’m especially grateful to the guys Lexa and Jeroen who were filming and taking photos; it was awesome to get those shots. Thanks to Aman and the whole team for a great time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the awesome review

Freshly certified and straight into fun dives… that’s how the story should go! We’re really happy you stuck around with Crystal Dive to keep the momentum going.

A big shoutout to Aman — experienced, observant, and always spotting the cool stuff others swim straight past. It’s great to hear he helped build your confidence with tips along the way while keeping things fun for the whole group.

We’re glad you enjoyed the vibe with the group too — that’s a big part of what makes diving here special.

Now that you’ve got the bug… we’ll be ready when you come back for more bubbles

reviews.name: Julia K
reviews.text:
I did my Open Water Diver course at Crystal Dive and had an amazing experience from start to finish! My instructor, Koray, was fantastic. Experienced, funny, and someone I felt completely safe with from the very beginning. He created a relaxed atmosphere while making sure we learned everything thoroughly. The free accommodation during the course was a great bonus.

After completing my Open Water certificate, I stayed with Crystal Dive for my first fun dive and it really showed how much I'd learned during the course. My divemaster, Liv, was also amazing. She made sure I remembered the important skills before we entered the water, helped me when I struggled to clear my mask underwater and pointed out so many fish that I would have completely missed on my own.

Already looking forward to my next dive!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're delighted to hear you had such an amazing experience with us from start to finish.

We'll be sure to pass your kind words on to Koray. It's great to know he made you feel safe, relaxed, and confident while helping you build a strong foundation as a new diver. We're also glad you enjoyed the included accommodation—it’s always a nice bonus while you're learning!

It's fantastic to hear that your first fun dive was such a positive experience too. Liv will be thrilled to know she helped you feel comfortable, refreshed your skills, and introduced you to the incredible marine life around Koh Tao. Those first dives after certification are always special!

Congratulations on earning your Open Water certification, and thank you for choosing Crystal Dive. We can't wait to welcome you back for your next underwater adventure—there's still so much to discover beneath the surface!

title: Rithirit Gym Academy
ownerDescription:
Formally Jitti Gym Academy

Rithirit Gym Academy is open for Foreigners and Thai’s, of any gender age or level.

It's located in the Rachadapisek area of Bangkok right next to Rachadapisek MRT station.
address: 5 S. Vibhavadi Rangsit 16, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

reviews.name: Martin kwong
reviews.text:
My favourite gym
In Bangkok. One of the best located gym in Bangkok, just 10 walk from MRT Ratchadaphisek. Price is reasonable and especially affordable for foreign fighter living in the gym. Welcoming atmosphere with less competitive environment compared to other professional fight gyms but still having a strong team of professional fighters. The trainers putting in their work for both professional and fitness customers. If u want serious fighter training come 6:30am morning session and 3pm afternoon session ( starts with the run around Ladprao area ) for just recreational / less intense training u can come anytime within their opening hours. Evening 6pm onwards are mostly local thai white collar coming to training after work.

reviews.name: balto supreme
reviews.text: Fell in love with the place at the first punch. Great people...staff and students alike. A great place to train. They made my trip to Thailand a wonderful journey.

reviews.name: Nelson KaungMinKhant
reviews.text:
My girlfriend attended the 9 AM session today and had a very terrible expefience. She felt uncomfortable due to the way one of the trainers spoke to her, and she overheard inappropriate sexual comments about her in Thai. After they realized she understood the language, one trainer apologized, but others continued joking. Feeling disrespected and uncomfortable she told the trainers she had a stomachache and left early.

She was also concerned that some of the trainers appeared intoxicated or hungover during the session. After seeing similar concerns mentioned in other reviews, this raised serious questions about the this gym.

This kind of behavior is unacceptable, and I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and makes changes to ensure a safe and respectful atmosphere for all clients, especially women.

reviews.name: Alex
reviews.text: I have been going here for more than a year now and every training have been great in its own unique way. All the trainers are skilled, hardworking and fun - they will do what is in their power to make you a better version of yourself from each training. I haven’t been at any other gym where I’ve felt better treated and I feel proud to be a student of Jitti Gym. People have told me that since I started training Muay Thai there I have both begun to look a lot better, but also I have begun to be more peaceful in the way I carry myself through life. I think it’s a subtle lesson of humility that you can both be strong in your body but also strong in your soul. Life is hard, and so is Muay Thai - so it goes hand in hand.

reviews.name: Peter Le
reviews.text:
A gym that caters to multiple types of clientele: fighters, casuals, and apparently Thai celebs. The gym is open all day with some breaks for meals. Once you get a pad session in with a trainer, you can just hang out at the gym and hit the bag, ask to spar others, use some of the exercise equipment, etc. Daily washed handwraps and gear is available and seems clean enough.

Trainers are friendly though sometimes a bit crass - communication is not a strong suit. There's an AC'd lobby area with some gear and drinks for sale.

I recommend getting a private with Ton, he's technical and knows a bit of English. A bit brash but he will review techniques he shows you at the end of a private.

reviews.name: Em Gee
reviews.text: Great gym to train and do some pad work at. Recommended to me by my trainer from my hometown in Canada. Very chill vibes from all the guys and gals at the gym. It was not at all intimidating walking into the gym on my own. Would come back next time I’m in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Garretty Hm
reviews.text:
Disclaimer: I'm only a weekend warrior when it comes to Muay Thai - my leg blocks are horrible! - and I only visited Jitygym once.

The rounds itself were enjoyable and while my trainer couldn't speak English, he was very professional and patient when handling my amateur errors. Use of gym equipment and showers was free, and I feel like I had a pretty good workout by the end of the session.

However, there was some confusion and pushiness when it came to the sales side of the experience. On their Facebook page, the "1 session = 2 hours" is not actually 2 hours, but rather their best estimate of how long it takes someone to complete a warm-up and 4 rounds of pads with a trainer, but I wasn't told this until after so I kept my breaks to a minimum to make the most of the two hours and was a bit surprised when, after 1 hour, the gym began closing up! I guess if the gym is busy, then you'll be rotating on the pads with a few partners, so it would take closer to 2 hours.

Also, despite saying that I already had a place to stay that was already paid for, the staff repeatedly offered local accommodations affiliated with the gym for that same evening, and most of the time after the session was spent dodging further purchase suggestions, whereas I was hoping to relax and talk casually with the staff (a sense of community at a combatives gym is important to me). I guess they're just doing their job...

Would go again because the training was quite good, but as a one-time visitor I felt kind of like a walk-in wallet which left a bittersweet taste in my mouth.

reviews.name: Ville K
reviews.text: Jitti is no longer a place to to learn muay thai. It has become a gym for fitness type of muay thai training for beginners. And I don't think it was good even for that. The session started with a warm-up, everyone did what they wanted for about 10 minutes. Then we hit 4 rounds of pads which was ok. After that I asked what's next they said the training is over. That was like 30 minutes total. It was possible to stay and continue by myself but any teaching after pads was considered extra and only for private sessions.

reviews.text: Nice place to practice muaythai from beginner. I can recommend not only for muaythai beginner but also kid and female. The instructors will adjust for your level and purpose such as dieting.

Feel like home Gym with Friendly trainer.
Newly open Gym in Ratchada 19 which is the academy for both novice and professional boxers. The gyms offer both muaythai and MMAs with the local thai and imported trainer from brazil.

The owner are young and friendly who understand the needs and help you to achieve the target. The training fee is cheap and you can stay as long as you want in one sessions.

Don’t Miss out this place if have a chance to come to Bangkok to exercise.

reviews.name: Caro P.
reviews.text:
So I  had arranged a private session via email  with Yen, tuesday 27th september at t 8 am. When I arrive at the gym I find two people sleeping right at the entrante clearly hungover, because there was a bottle of whisky right there with some other open cans, who tell me class is at nine.
I insist politely and in Tahi  it's at eight but again they say, without even looking at me or standing up, that it's at nine.
So I came all the way to the gym (30 min commute) to be here at 7.45 am with all my gear and all my expectations, to be treated like this.

This behaviour is VERY disappointing, not profesional at allí and very unpolite.

title: HIDE by Bangkok Massage & Spa
ownerDescription: HIDE by Bangkok Massage & Spa offers premium Thai massage in Bangkok in a quiet, private, boutique setting. Our professional Thai therapists tailor pressure and technique to your needs—choose from authentic Thai massage, heritage Thai massage, deep muscle massage, foot relief massage, luxe exfoliating body polish, aroma therapy massage, body scrub and aroma massage. The space is meticulously designed for cleanliness, comfort, and a sense of luxury. Each treatment relieves muscle tension, restores energy balance, reduces stress, and helps you feel refreshed. Book easily on Google Maps: HIDE by Bangkok Massage & Spa.
address: Next to Maru Condominium 70/2 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Phra Khanong, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
street: Next to Maru Condominium 70/2 Soi Sukhumvit 63

ownerUpdates.text: A facial that begins at the face begins halfway through. We start lower: the neck, the shoulders, the scalp. It is the same tightness a screen leaves you with by evening, and it does not stop politely at the jawline. Whether that changes how skin looks is a longer and more honest answer, and it is in the new guide.

The best hour of the day here is the one nobody books. Ten at night, the city still going, the room dark and quiet, someone working the week out of your shoulders. We are open until 1:00 AM, every day. If your calendar has no room before dinner, take the hour after it.

Every session here starts with a question, not a technique. Where it hurts, how long it has been there, what your day actually looks like. The room is the same for everyone; the hour inside it should not be. Tell us what you are carrying, and we will build the session around it.

Skin at thirty and skin at fifty are not asking for the same hour. In your thirties the work is upkeep: barrier, hydration, the early marks a city leaves. Past forty it shifts towards firmness and definition. Most menus still offer one facial to everyone from 25 to 65. Our new guide breaks down what actually changes, decade by decade.

There's a door in the middle of Bangkok most people walk straight past. Behind it: low light, quiet, and an hour that belongs entirely to you. That's HIDE — not a place to be seen, a place to vanish for a while. Come find the quiet.

Your shoulders don't need a heroic stretch at six o'clock. They need you to stop holding one position for four hours. Stand every twenty minutes or so. Roll the shoulders back, let the ears drift away from them. Small, unglamorous, effective — and it makes the work we do in the room last longer. The full desk-recovery guide is on our blog.

Rest isn't a reward for finishing everything. It never gets finished. Book the hour before you need it badly — that's the whole trick. An hour in the dark, phone away, someone else deciding what your shoulders need. Then back out into Bangkok, lighter than you came in.

A thousand-plus reviews, and still 5.0. We don't take that lightly — it isn't one great session, it's the same session, every time, for years. Guests come back because nothing is left to chance: the room, the pressure, the quiet. Come see what they keep coming back for.

The city empties out slowly. By ten the traffic thins, the lights soften, and Ekkamai finally exhales. That's our favourite hour to work — unhurried, quiet, the room yours alone. We stay open until 1:00 AM, every night. Late isn't an exception here. It's the plan.

One hour of massage against forty at the desk — that's the arithmetic most people miss, and why the ease fades by Wednesday. Relief that lasts is a rhythm, not a rescue: sessions close together while the tension is loud, further apart once it quiets. We wrote the whole approach down for you.

reviews.name: Amara Davis
reviews.text:
I absolutely LOVED my experience at Hide in Ekkamai! This was honestly one of the best spa experiences I’ve had in Bangkok, and I already can’t wait to come back.

I booked the 90-minute Therapeutic Aroma & Body Scrub along with a 30-minute Foot Massage, and every minute was incredible. The body scrub left my skin feeling unbelievably soft, and afterward you’re able to take a shower before they begin the aroma oil massage. Being able to choose your massage oil was such a nice touch, and my massage therapist, Mint, was AMAZING! She was so thorough, attentive, and knew exactly where to focus. Every part of the massage felt intentional, relaxing, and she made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire experience.

The foot massage at the end was exactly what I needed after walking all over Bangkok for days 😂. My feet had been so sore, and Mint worked through every area so well that I left feeling like I was walking on clouds.

One of my favorite surprises was that they even treated me to a complimentary face mask along with a relaxing mini face massage! It was such a thoughtful extra that made the entire experience feel even more luxurious.

And the best part? The entire 2-hour experience was only 2,780 baht, which is an incredible value for the quality of service you receive.

To top everything off, after your treatment they bring you a cute little dessert (I received a delicious slice of cake) along with a warm cup of tea, which was the perfect way to end such a relaxing visit.

Beyond the treatments themselves, what truly made Hide stand out was the staff. Every single person was so kind, welcoming, and genuinely friendly. You can tell they truly care about making sure every guest has the best possible experience from the moment you walk in until the moment you leave. Their hospitality felt sincere, not forced, and it made the entire visit even more memorable.

A special thank you again to Mint for such an incredible massage. She is truly talented, incredibly thorough, and made this one of the most relaxing spa experiences I’ve ever had. I left feeling refreshed, pampered, and completely rejuvenated.

This was easily a 5-star experience for me. If you’re looking for an amazing spa in Ekkamai, I cannot recommend Hide enough. I’ll definitely be back many more times and fully plan on becoming a regular!

We also understand your note about the pricing — we’re grateful you felt it was well worth the value, and we’ll continue focusing on premium products, strong hygiene standards, and consistent service quality.

Thank you again for recommending us. We’d love to welcome you back soon for another professional massage in Bangkok, Ekkamai. 
For your next visit, you can book easily by phone or directly via Google Maps, and walk-ins are welcome. :)

— The HIDE by Bangkok Massage & Spa Team

Our sessions are suitable for complete beginners, travelers, and fitness enthusiasts with no experience required. Training is led by experienced Thai coaches and focuses on basic techniques, pad work, conditioning, and confidence building in a safe and supportive environment. Small group sessions allow personal guidance at a comfortable pace. Walk-ins are welcome, equipment is provided, and training is available daily. Learn Muay Thai in Chiang Mai where real Muay Thai happens.
address: 96 98 Loi Kroh Rd Lane 3, Chang Khlan Sub-district, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand

reviews.name: Filip Rihak
reviews.text:
My first experience with Thai boxing, I don't remember the price, I think it was 600-800 baht.

The matches are sometimes uneven, but I enjoy the amateur ones the most, where Europeans who have had a month of training battle it out. It's sometimes fun to watch.
There was even a women's match against men, which the women won.
Overall, it was good fun, and after the event, you can go to a club to continue the fun.

reviews.name: Mark Tarquini
reviews.text: Right in the middle of a great spot for nightlife, hust outside of old city. Easily walkable. Easy to enter, find seats, friendly service. The fights were incredible! Skilled fighters of multiple weight classes and an amazing break dance intermission. Suggested the arena to several people staying at our hotel. 10/10 would go see fights there again.

reviews.name: Kyrio Azure
reviews.text: An amazing fight night for around half a thousand baht, located down the party street. Can book at the door and the fights were great and quick.

reviews.name: R.
reviews.text: Great experience, highly recommend. Keep In Mind that you’re paying 600 to watch at least 6 fights which is a lot of fights comparing to the money. Appreciate the art, appreciate the people. Don’t cheap out and enjoy one of the best nights I’ve had in Thailand and I was alone and highly enjoyed it and highly recommend it.  I enjoyed watching both women and men compete.  Talented fighters 🙏❤️

reviews.name: Beverley Hurren
reviews.text:
First experience of Thai boxing and quite enjoyed it.
Bought my ticket from the stand by First Bar the day before (600 for a standard seat), arrived about quarter to 9, was shown to a seating area - you get a piece of paper to put your name on to keep your seat reserved if you need to get up. (Although I saw several tourists ignore these and get told off when the seat claimant returned.)
Pretty good view - I would consider the ringside seats next time - less mobile phones to try to see past when people predictably raise them as soon as the fights start.
Plenty of bars surrounding the ring to get drinks from - there was also a food menu (basic but very good - chips, nuggets, gyozas etc)
In response to older reviews saying the fights are rigged - I saw nothing to indicate anything they did was an act. All looked real enough, plenty of punches and kicks landing hard and the contenders that were knocked out looked genuinely dazed, cutting some fights short of the full 5 rounds.
I would recommend giving it a chance for an evening out (runs 9pm to midnight), grab a few beers, some food and enjoy.

reviews.name: Ben Theis
reviews.text:
Didn’t know what to expect but was such a fun time. We got upgraded to ringside and the fights were awesome. Little lower level fighting but fun for my wife and I who don’t follow the sport closely it really know.

The bookies around the ring are fun to gamble with and servers for drinks are quick. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Thibault Beyer
reviews.text: It is fun as an entertainment venue but it is not to be taken seriously. Out of the 6 matches only 3 seemed genuine amateur fights. Especially the Thai women vs women. Everything else was fake, especially the foreigner vs Thai fights where extremely obviously staged. I think it's pay to win. So 3/5 stars because 3 matches seemed genuine. I'll not go again ✌️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience.
Loi Kroh Boxing Stadium operates as a live Muay Thai entertainment venue, and our fight cards often include a mix of amateur, development, and entertainment bouts, which can vary in intensity and experience level.

All matches are conducted under supervision, and outcomes are not predetermined nor “pay to win.” Perceptions can differ, especially when fighters have different backgrounds or experience levels.

We appreciate your honest feedback and are glad you found part of the event enjoyable. Your comments will be reviewed as we continue working to improve the overall experience for all guests.

- Loi Kroh Boxing Stadium Management

reviews.name: Zachery Davis
reviews.text: Loh Kroi Boxing Stadium offers an authentic and thrilling Muay Thai experience in Chiang Mai. The atmosphere is electric, with passionate crowds and skilled fighters showcasing true Thai martial arts. It’s an exciting, up-close experience, perfect for those looking to witness real Muay Thai action.

reviews.name: Thomas Bacquet
reviews.text: Good way to see boxe thaï fight ! Nice atmosphere and several fights, between 8 and 10 ! 600baht for classic seats and 1000baht for VIP seats, but that’s almost the same view. The price of the foods and drinks are expensive.

reviews.name: Victor Hayes
reviews.text: Starts approximately at 21:30 , not every day, during peak holidays more often. Many open seated bars surround the ring, not free you have to pay to watch. Very loud muay Thai music

reviews.name: Anastasiia Anokhina
reviews.text: This is a magic shop, many interesting boxing staff. We come to see the boxing thing and found Agura oil and nice real stone.

reviews.name: Ece Morali
reviews.text: Amazing stadium however, the lady at the door was a disaster. This place is free for thai nationality, however she thought my Thai friend is half Thai so she charged her full price. Why? Because they put a lady who can not communicate with people at the door. Even at her own language. She is not smiling. Very disrespectful. Arrogant. Rest was amazing but there are other stadiums with great and friendly hosts. Door lady kills the vibe.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ece,

Thank you for sharing your feedback and for your kind words about our stadium and event. We’re very sorry to hear about your experience at the entrance.

We sincerely apologize for any misunderstanding or poor communication from our staff. Our policy allows free entry for Thai nationals, and we will ensure our team better understands and follows this policy clearly and respectfully in the future.

We appreciate your comments — they help us improve our service and guest experience. We hope to welcome you and your friend back for a smoother and more enjoyable visit next time. 

– Loi Kroh Boxing Stadium Management

reviews.name: Zachary Jennings
reviews.text: Got ring side seats. Good price 1000baht. The fights did vary in quality and skill level, but overall, they were very exciting. Saw some competitive fights and a few KOs. Also, 8 fights were advertised, and we only got 7, so maybe a fight got canceled. Still a great experience

reviews.name: J G
reviews.text: My first experience of Muay Thai so I can't speak as to the quality of the fights and reliability of the outcomes but I really enjoyed it, 600 Baht seat had a good view, 1000 Baht for ringside,drink service straight to your seat , very enjoyable couple of hours

reviews.name: Benjamin Du
reviews.text: I cannot speak for people who came on a bad night but I came when they had a promoted fight. It was a great experience! Awesome fights with real hitting and some knockouts. It’s a shady strip of town with lots of pretty boy freelancers so avoid if that offends you too much. But it was a great place for beer and fights. Paid 400 bhat. Go on a Friday night for the best fights.

reviews.name: Rudolf PETERS
reviews.text:
Recently been to this Thai Boxing Event.
It is amzing to see this much of fervent boxing and the ability to give and receive punches, kicks etc.
How do they survice this much, I would have gone down in a lot less than a minute. That is why I am watching and not participating.
It is nice that the ring has an open airflow, so smokers do not bother non-smokers too much.
People can before or after the match have a drink in one of the many bars and/or shoot poole if they like.
All and all a very nice evening and I will surely come again.
Of course I recommend a visit to this place, especially for people who want something different.

reviews.name: Saqib Altaf
reviews.text: An absolutely unforgettable night! The energy at Loi Kroh is insane. It's so intimate that you're right on top of the heart-pounding action, feeling the raw power from both the fighters and the roaring crowd. This is authentic Muay Thai at its best—not a tourist show. The passion and respect on display are truly awe-inspiring. It was the absolute highlight of our trip to Chiang Mai. A thrilling, genuine, can't-miss experience!

reviews.name: Jorgen Frohlich
reviews.text:
I’ve watched several fights in Loi Kroh
boxing arena. The Arena is inside a bar area.

Some of the fights in this place are very suspicious at times.

The fights with Thai boxer vs Thai boxer seem fair.

But when thai boxer fight US boxer they often dont have a chance against the professional american who come here to have an easy fight, gain self confidence and ring time without getting injuried.

I saw a guy who noticed what was going on and when he was booing he was assaulted by an American (the coward in the pictures below assaulted and sucker punched an old guy sitting down in his chair 🤔 disgraceful)

It’s a scam, definitely not worth 600,- Bath there are other boxing arenas in Chiang Mai that have better fair fights and a better reputation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jorgen,

Thank you for sharing your feedback and concerns. We’re very sorry to hear about your experience and take these matters seriously.

Our stadium is committed to maintaining fair, respectful, and authentic Muay Thai competitions. All fighters — local and international — are matched according to their training level and experience to ensure safety and fairness.

We do not condone or tolerate any form of violence or misconduct by fighters or guests, and we encourage anyone who witnesses such incidents to report them directly to our management or local authorities so we can take proper action.

We appreciate you bringing this to our attention. Our goal is always to promote Muay Thai with respect, fairness, and integrity.

– Loi Kroh Boxing Stadium Management

reviews.name: MeatMar
reviews.text: Recently went to this place by chance. Have seen it for years and heard that it wasn’t much chop. Let’s just say it was the opposite, had a great time out. Seen up close action and the drinks kept flowing. You can choose which bar ringside is your vibe and sit back and enjoy the night.

reviews.text: Cool experience. Of course there are a lot of tourists but i did not care. We saw 5 KO‘s during the fights. So i cant agree that the fights are staged as other people reviewed.

title: Thaikung massage
subTitle: ไท่คัง-นวดกดจุดฝ่าเท้า

reviews.name: Виктория Боня
reviews.text:
Highly recommend this authentic Thai massage salon! 🇹🇭✨
If you want a real traditional Thai atmosphere without unnecessary luxury, but with truly professional massage therapists - this is the perfect place.

My massage therapist was Nang, and she was amazing. I had a lot of muscle tension, especially in my back, and after the massage I felt so much better and deeply relaxed. The massage costs only 300 baht, which is an excellent price for such quality.

The whole staff was friendly, kind, and welcoming. I sincerely wish your business prosperity, many happy clients, happiness, and good luck.

I am from Ukraine, and I also want to thank Thailand for the kindness and warmth. During the difficult time of war in my country, I can stay in this beautiful country surrounded by such kind people. Thank you again very much. 🇺🇦❤️🇹🇭

reviews.name: Chandni Brown
reviews.text: My whole family and I had fantastic reflexology foot massages here! They knew exactly how to respond to each of our ailments, including my mum who has knee and hip problems, and were incredibly friendly throughout. Great service and a great way to reset yourself after many days of exploring Bangkok on foot!

reviews.name: Mackenzie Nargiz
reviews.text: Offer body, foot or face massage for 30, 60, 90 minutes. Really firm and professional. Incredibly knowledgeable and felt better every time. The best!

reviews.name: Hina Patel
reviews.text: The best massages I have had, my aches and pains I have had just melted away and I felt like a new woman with a freedom I hae not felt in years.  I first went for the foot massage and knew I had to get a body massage.  Thaikung Massage Bangkok is the place you will want to return again and again

reviews.name: Sofi
reviews.text: Unassuming and unatmospheric setting, but what it lacks in material aesthetic it makes up for in impeccable care and skill, all at an incredibly reasonably price. Transformative and transcendental despite a car alarm going off just outside. Truly the Thaikung is a metaphor for the chaos and peace of metropolitan Bangkok!

reviews.name: LARA MOCELLIN
reviews.text: This massage place is always a guarantee. Any time l am in Bangkok this is where l come for foot massage or body massage. Friendly staff, clean environment and honest prices. They haven't changed a bit since my first time l visited them ten years ago. See you next year!😀

reviews.name: Renu C
reviews.text: Was looking for a reflexology massage place. It was really good that I did foot massage on day 1 and full body on day 2. The elderly person who attended to me was kind, compassionate and helped with my muscle aches. Have been to several places in Bangkok but this is by far the best.

Was unexpectedly good though the therapist didn't use any balm/ oil at all. Just lying there with your full clothes on and he knows where are the right points to massage on. Not to mention, only 250baht 1 hour body massage, it comes with chiropractic too! Bones cracking moment 🤣 but it's definitely worth it! Will be my goto massage place from onwards! 😊

title: WeWork T-One Building
ownerDescription: WeWork is a global network of workspaces where companies grow together. At this convenient address, discover floors of coworking and private offices that cater to needs you didn’t even know you had. Our spaces are designed to promote productivity whether you’re a team of one or 100, and month-to-month flexibility means your space is just as agile as you are. Plus, one all-inclusive rate makes things easy. Any workspace can have a lounge, but ours are decorated with custom murals. Your old office might have had a coffee pot, but ours has a micro-roasted coffee bar and fresh fruit water. We’ve considered every detail so you can focus on your business. Beyond desks, staff, and amenities, find a community of forward-thinking companies and in...
address: 15-17, 20, 25-27Fl, T-One Building, 8 Soi Sukhumvit 40, Khwaeng Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Peter Jackson
reviews.text:
Avoid this place.

After 6pm there's no air conditioning, and you're not allowed to leave and come back in. It's just a badly managed space and poor value for money. Don't go there.

I was a member for three months, and I've used WeWork spaces in the UK before. This is by far the worst one on multiple dimensions.

You simply can't work properly because it gets so hot. I also travel regularly to Singapore, Vietnam and Malaysia, and this place feels like a joke compared to Wework coworking spaces managed there.

Not being open after 6pm is unbelievable. In almost every other country, WeWork locations are open 24/7. Like only people from abroad with clients in Europe and the US but no option to work there lol.

I asked the staff several times whether anything could be done, but they don't seem to have the authority to make any decisions, kind of they have given up.

I'd genuinely recommend avoiding this place OR only use it at a last resort if you visit Bangkok for a few weeks.

Thank you for reading this.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Peter, We're sorry to see we're not getting it right - please email us at feedback@wework.com, and we can discuss your concerns.

reviews.name: Mr R
reviews.text:
A beautiful work space, ideal for little meetings, concentrated working, or collaborative work.

Drinks are a bit price, but it had to be paid for some way.

There are great views across Bangkok, accessed through floor to ceiling glass panels, allowing your mind to fly off and fuel itself.

Tobacco product consumers have a balcony to escape to for a fix.

The lifts can be confusing, but you just press the button and wait. Ignore the request to scan your card. If the lift takes longer than expected, it will apologise.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello, it's great to hear you're enjoying your WeWork experience, and we look forward to continuing to improve!

reviews.name: Baizura Yusof
reviews.text: Near BTS station. Can't recall which station. Went to 20th & 26th floor to work. Nice ambience, easy registration at lobby, easy registration at we work.

reviews.name: Gift L.
reviews.text:
Location is really convenience since you can walk from BTS Thonglor. However traffic is too jam around there all day and night, so not recommend to go by car.
Wework is the great place to work for me. All facilities and atmosphere support me to enjoy working. You can enjoy unlimited free coffee from barista, free tea, snacks sometimes and free flow beer tap after 5pm everyday in common area.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're pleased to hear you're taking full advantage of the WeWork benefits!

reviews.name: Karsten Eigler
reviews.text:
If you plan to work outside of regular hours (9 AM – 6 PM), this place is absolutely useless. The air-conditioning is off, it’s unbearably hot, and the staff couldn’t care less. We even had an issue today with a meeting room we booked from 4 PM to 5 PM — a staff member insisted we pay for an extra half-hour “coin” even though I hadn’t even entered the room yet. Completely ridiculous.

We’re paying around 35,000 Baht per month for a tiny office that feels like a rabbit cage, while the 25th floor and several others are completely empty. For that price, you can easily rent your own small studio in Bangkok and set up a proper air-conditioned office with full freedom.

No A/C after 6 PM, no coffee service, no support on weekends – nothing. For anyone who works flexibly or outside normal office hours: stay away from this WeWork.
This location (T1 Building, Bangkok) is a total disappointment and doesn’t deserve to carry the WeWork name.

reviews.name: Humanizer
reviews.text: Its not only a great place to work, but they have funny tabke games, and also interesting events with great speakers amd activities. I visited the one last time with foodpanda, and also a great and funny BrewYoga event! Thank you We Work people!

reviews.name: Miguel Elías Márquez
reviews.text: Of all the wework I have been to, it is the worst so far. The girls who work upstairs speak almost no English, and are very rude and impolite. They look at you badly and more than solving your problems, they seem to be the police controlling everything you do. Terrible experience in Bamgkok.

reviews.name: Alessandro Conti
reviews.text: I disapprove the spirit and the attitude of the management (the 3 receptionists) who attempted to sell me extra subscriptions for having had a guest in visit who overstayed beyond the meeting room booking time. Worth mentioning that I use wework space only when I have guests in visit or delicate conference calls. In total I have used wework all access membership 3 days last month and for no longer than 8 cumulative hours. Nonetheless the management thought my guest and I would be their good opportunity to expand their membership base in disregard of the actual use of my membership (which they have visibility on). Following an unnecessary, unreasonable and unpleasant conversation, I immediately cancelled the membership.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your recent experience with us. We're sorry to hear we're not quite getting it right, and would appreciate the opportunity to hear more about your experience to ensure we’re constantly improving. Please reach out to us at feedback@wework.com and we can address your concerns.

reviews.name: Jonathan Willington
reviews.text:
It's unclear why building access to WeWorks in Thailand is so poorly managed. Nice space but having to register and surrender ID upon each visit is crazy. Before the auto generated response replies to this - I have already emailed you and you did not respond.

Update: New access management system even worse than before, it takes about 10 minutes to register each time on the new system, with a buggy Face ID system to access the floor. Terrible.

Third, the common area is like Starbucks where a group of young professionals (putting it in a good way) will make a lot of noise throughout the day.

最高でした！息子と沈船ダイブしてきました！ダイビングアドバンス免許を持ってるけど、54歳になった老体には不安ばかりで、、、でも、日本人インストラクターのKさんが、本当に親切で、そして、安全に、大事な事を簡潔に教えて下さり、海底では、行方不明にならないよう私の背中に紐を繋げてくれて、ヘリコプター状態で、私は呼吸とマスクだけ注意してただけで、手足を動かす事なく、海底散歩させて頂きました。大きな亀や、面白いものがあれば、すぐに、棒で知らせてくれて、Kさんは、本当によくパタヤの海底、亀の住処などを知りつくしている
素晴らしいインストラクターさんでした！また、めちゃオモロイ話をしてくれるし＼(^o^)／とにかく、素晴らしいダイビングSHOPで、何より安全第一で不安なく潜れました！沈船の中も安心でした！
本当にありがとうございました！
reviews.textTranslated: It was amazing! I went on a wreck dive with my son! I have an advanced diving license, but at 54, I was still nervous... But our Japanese instructor, Mr. K, was incredibly kind and explained the important things concisely and safely. He even attached a string to my back so I wouldn't get lost on the ocean floor. He was like a helicopter, and I was able to walk around the bottom without moving my arms or legs, just focusing on my breathing and wearing my mask. If we spotted any big turtles or anything interesting, he would immediately let us know with a stick. Mr. K was an incredible instructor, truly knowledgeable about the Pattaya seabed and the turtle habitats! He also shared some fascinating stories! ＼(^o^)／Anyway, the dive shop was fantastic, and safety was their number one priority, so we were able to dive without any worries! We felt safe even inside the wreck! Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Joyce Chen
reviews.text:
這篇我幫你潤飾成自然、真誠，而且符合 Google Review 的英文表達，同時保留你對細節的專業觀察。

What makes a truly wonderful spa experience? To me, it’s a beautiful experience for all the senses.

I first visited Oasis Spa in February 2024, and it left an unforgettable impression on me. The surroundings were beautiful, the atmosphere was peaceful, the room temperature was perfect, the fragrance was soothing, and every member of the staff was genuinely polite and professional.

One of the most memorable experiences was the four-hand massage. It is rare to find two therapists who can synchronize their pressure, rhythm, and movements so perfectly. It was an incredible experience.

Over the past few years, I have visited Chiang Mai three times, and every single trip includes a visit to Oasis Spa. I’ve experienced four different treatments here, and every one of them has become a wonderful memory.

Among all the therapists, Bow at the Nimman branch is truly exceptional. Her technique is outstanding. Her palms and fingers are strong, yet every movement is controlled, smooth, and thoughtful.

What impressed me most was her attention to the smallest details. When she lifted and lowered the towel, it was so gentle that I couldn’t even feel a breeze. When applying warm oil, she didn’t simply pour it onto my body—she combined the application with flowing massage strokes, making the transition feel completely natural and relaxing.

Another detail that amazed me was the shoulder massage. She used the strength of her fingers to gently glide from the front of my shoulders toward my upper back with perfect control. It is such a subtle technique, yet many therapists overlook it. Bow did it beautifully.

These small details are what truly distinguish an excellent therapist from an ordinary one.

The consistency of service at Oasis Spa is what keeps bringing me back. Every visit has been relaxing, professional, and memorable.

Thank you, Bow, for your wonderful care, and thank you to the entire Oasis Spa team. I’ll definitely be back the next time I visit Chiang Mai. ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review of your experiences with us. We are truly delighted to know that you have consistently enjoyed the serene atmosphere and professional service at our spas.

It is especially rewarding to hear that our Four-Hand Massage and the attentive care provided by Bow at Oasis Spa Nimman have made each visit memorable. Your appreciation for these thoughtful details is the greatest encouragement to our team.

Thank you for your continued trust and support during your visits to Chiang Mai. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing and rejuvenating spa experience on your next trip.

She also has good system, highly professional.
I went for the warm oil massage, however the oil was room temperature, so that didn’t work out well. Not worth the extra investment. But everything else made up for it. I would definitely go back.
