Your positive feedback, particularly about the warmth and professionalism you experienced during your treatment, is greatly appreciated.

We also sincerely appreciate your valuable feedback regarding the welcome experience and the temperature of the oil for your massage. We are always striving to improve, and your comments are incredibly helpful. Please be assured that we have passed your notes to our branch manager to ensure our service is not only professional but also embodies a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Additionally, we will look into the temperature of the oil used for treatments to ensure that every detail is just right.

We’re thrilled to hear that, despite the minor issues you encountered, you still had a great experience overall and plan to return. We look forward to welcoming you back for another, even better, relaxing spa journey. Thank you once again for your thoughtful review!

reviews.name: Stuart March
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I visited Oasis Spa Chiang Mai on a Wednesday during Songkran, and from the moment you arrive it feels like stepping into a completely different world.

You are greeted by beautifully landscaped gardens and traditional Thai buildings that create an immediate sense of calm. The reception area is peaceful and well designed, and the staff are warm, friendly and professional. I had not pre-booked and simply walked in, but was still able to get a treatment shortly after making my selection.

I chose the 60 minute Ayurvedic head massage, which included a shower. The consultation was detailed and reassuring, with a questionnaire that made it clear the treatment would be tailored to your needs rather than generic.

The treatment room was spacious and private, combining natural elements with traditional Thai design. The bathroom area was a highlight, partially open to the sky and surrounded by greenery, which brought a real sense of nature into the space.

The smaller details were also well thought through. A welcome tea and cold scented towel on arrival, and after the treatment, quality touches like conditioner and lip balm that added to the overall experience.

The massage itself was excellent. Relaxing, well paced and delivered with real care.

Overall, this felt like a genuinely high quality experience from start to finish. I will definitely return for another treatment.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for leaving such a thoughtful and positive review of your visit to Oasis Spa. We are thrilled that you enjoyed the serene environment and the attentive care our team provides, even as a walk-in guest.

It is heartening to know that the Ayurvedic head massage was a highlight and that our commitment to a tailored, high-quality experience resonated with you. Your kind words are a great encouragement to our entire team.

We eagerly await the opportunity to welcome you back for another relaxing treatment.

reviews.name: vic chen
reviews.text:
We had visited Oasis Spa in Chiang Mai more than ten years ago and wanted to come back, so we came here together this time.

It was a wonderful experience. The environment was beautiful and peaceful, the staff were warm and professional, and the treatment was very relaxing. It was a special and memorable part of our Chiang Mai trip.

Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Reading your review has been an absolute pleasure. We are truly honored that you chose to revisit us after a decade and delighted to know that we could once again provide a memorable experience. Your kind words about our tranquil surroundings and the warm hospitality of our team mean a great deal to us. Thank you for your wonderful recommendation and continued support. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing and rejuvenating retreat.

reviews.name: CtheD Style
reviews.text:
I found this place bc I happened to eat brunch nearby and saw their beautiful property as was walking.
I just had a 4 hand massage here. Pardon the pun. It was hands down the best massage I’ve ever had in my entire existence on earth. They worked together so well the whole time. It seemed like all 4 hands dance beautiful choreography all over my body. The price is high, but if you want a luxurious experience with skilled masseuses, you can’t miss this spot.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your fantastic review truly made our day! It brings us great joy to know that you found Oasis Spa Lanna beautiful and that your Oasis Four-Hand Massage was such a memorable experience. Your description of the therapists' work as beautiful choreography is a wonderful compliment and a true testament to their skill and dedication. Thank you for your kind words and support. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another exceptional and relaxing spa journey.

reviews.name: lee yeng
reviews.text:
I really loved the atmosphere, surroundings, reception service, and interior design—such a nice holiday vibe overall.

But unfortunately, they completely missed the point of the massage. It didn’t match the preferences we filled in on the form at all. It honestly felt like we were just paying for someone to touch our bodies for hours 🫠

Recommend for people who was walking all day long and can take a good shower at there, they have private room and bathroom everything at there.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us.

We are sincerely sorry to learn that your recent visit to Oasis Spa Lanna did not meet your expectations. We understand your concern that the massage did not align with the preferences you had provided, and we regret that this detail was not fully attended to.

Please be assured that your feedback has been carefully noted and shared with the branch management team. We will be reviewing our internal processes to reinforce attentiveness to guest preferences, ensuring that each experience is delivered with the level of care and personalization our guests expect.

We truly value your patronage and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a more seamless and tailored experience.

Warm regards,

The Oasis Spa Team

reviews.name: Anne
reviews.text: At Oasis Spa we had a luxurious spa experience. We spent three hours in total, starting with a one hour scrub with Himalayan salt, followed by two hours of the Deep Calm Recovery massage. It is more expensive than many other places, and they also add 7 percent VAT and 10 percent service charge to the total price. That said, you really get a super deluxe experience in beautiful surroundings with very professional staff. Compared to what you would pay for something similar in my home country, it is still very cheap. It was around 6,000 baht per person for three hours, everything included. They also offered promotional discounts on other spa packages, but we wanted the deep tissue massage and chose to pay full price. The massage was very good and firm, and the staff were incredibly sweet and did a great job. I also liked that you get a small private hut for your treatment, with a beautiful bathroom where you can shower before or after. I would definitely recommend this place if you want something a little more luxurious than the usual massages you find everywhere.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed and thoughtful review of your experience at Oasis Spa. We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed your three-hour journey, from the Himalayan salt body scrub to our Deep Calm Recovery massage, and that the treatment delivered the firm, deeply relaxing experience you were seeking.

We sincerely appreciate your understanding regarding our pricing structure and are grateful that you found the experience to be excellent value, especially when compared with similar treatments in your home country. It’s wonderful to know that our tranquil surroundings, private treatment huts, and the care of our professional and attentive team contributed to a truly luxurious and memorable visit.

Thank you as well for highlighting our therapists’ warmth and skill—it means a great deal to us. Your recommendation is deeply appreciated, and we would be honored to welcome you back again whenever you wish to indulge in another refined and rejuvenating Oasis Spa experience.

reviews.name: V Lee
reviews.text:
We booked in advance to avoid disappointment 😀

Prior to our oasis spa appointment we tried another massage. We still prefer oasis and would rate them 9/10😀

The masseuse Nicole and Cindy are attentive. They are very professional and they don’t giggle or whispers or chit chat at work.

Cindy worked on my back using her fingers and lesser of the elbow and I feel that my back is loosen up. As if her fingers has “eyes” and see which part needs more attention.

Nicole is structured and really detailed and paid attention when my husband said his shoulder needs more care.

After finishing the 2-1/2 hours of spa. They treated us with sticky rice mango and it’s so exquisite and so yummy

The front reception two staff are very respectful and polite and I admire them for their patience when I see some patrons came in and has other demand and they stayed calm and patience.

Thank u. Will be back again
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful detailed review!  We're delighted that Nicole and Cindy provided such exceptional service during your 2.5-hour spa treatment. Your kind words about their professionalism and attention to detail truly mean a lot to us. We're equally pleased that you enjoyed our signature mango sticky rice and appreciated our reception team's service. We look forward to welcoming you back to Oasis Spa Lanna for another rejuvenating experience.

reviews.name: Eric Mason
reviews.text: Wonderful experience. They've got all the details down. Booked online, communicated well via whatsapp on any questions. Recommend booking a day in advance. Chose the Siamese Theraputic Wisdom and added a foot massage at the end. The hot compress is simply divine - I asked about it at the end and it contains lemongrass, pandan, and plai - see the picture! It was rolled all over the body. They showed me inside and what it looks like tied up!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your detailed and wonderful feedback. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the Siamese Therapeutic Wisdom massage and the herbal hot compress. It’s a pleasure to know our team could make your experience special. Thank you for choosing Oasis Spa, and we look forward to welcoming you again soon.

reviews.name: hongyang wang
reviews.text:
I accidentally booked the "Aromatherapy Hot Oil Massage" instead of the Ayurvedic treatment. I spent the whole session waiting for the oil dripping (Shirodhara), only to realize at the end that I had picked the wrong one!
Even though it wasn't the treatment I originally had in mind, the therapist was professional and hardworking. Her technique was spot on, and I could feel her sincerity in every movement.
I was in a rush and couldn't add on the Shirodhara this time, but I’m already looking forward to visiting their Bangkok branch to finally try the real Ayurvedic treatment. Highly recommend Oasis Spa.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words and 5-star rating. We were delighted to read your comments. Our team strives to deliver an exceptional experience, and your feedback is a wonderful affirmation of their efforts. We are excited to have you visit our Bangkok branch and look forward to providing you with the authentic Ayurvedic treatment.

reviews.name: Shir Ley
reviews.text: This place is a gem, I booked the 4 hour treatment and it was totally worth it. You get your own little cabin, with a steam sauna, shower and a bath, the massage was amazing and so was the face treatment. The women who work here are kind and very professional. The products they used are of high quality.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a delight to read your review, thank you. We're thrilled that you had such a positive experience during your four-hour treatment and that you appreciated the professionalism of our team. Your feedback regarding the quality of our products and the private cabin experience is invaluable. We are committed to creating a perfect sanctuary for our guests, and we thank you for recognizing our efforts. We look forward to your next visit with us.

reviews.name: 0258Phiang-Amporn Ongwisit
reviews.text: The service is excellent as always. The welcome is warm, and the staff gave very good recommendations for Spa package, K.Natty. The massage therapists, K.Eve and K. Namtarn are  highly skilled. I can never stop loving Oasis❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your feedback has truly made our day. We’re delighted to hear that our team, from the welcoming hospitality of Khun Natty to the skilled care provided by Khun Eve and Khun Namtarn, made your visit so special. Knowing that you felt so well cared for is the greatest compliment we could receive, and it inspires us to continue creating a sanctuary of relaxation for our guests. Your continued support means a great deal to us, and we look forward to welcoming you again on your next visit.

reviews.name: Donna Lamb
reviews.text: This place is lovely. There is transport from the spa back to where you want to go. The staff is professional and knowledgeable. Place smalls wonderful! I will be back and definitely recommend this spa!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your glowing review has been a highlight for our team! We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the high standards of our team, the tranquil atmosphere at Oasis Spa Lanna, and the convenience of our complimentary transportation service. It is always our pleasure to make every part of your journey with us as relaxing as possible. We truly appreciate your wonderful recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back again very soon.

reviews.name: Lonna Hayward
reviews.text: WOW!  What an amazing experience. My husband & I did the 90 minute massage. It was perfect. We feel very relaxed. Our therapists were able to work out a lot of muscle knots we’ve accumulated while traveling. Very professional. The atmosphere is so beautiful & peaceful. After we were finished they served hot tea & mango sticky rice that was delicious.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
It was an absolute delight to read your glowing 5-star review. We are so happy to know that you and your husband found your 90-minute massage to be a perfect and relaxing experience at Oasis Spa (Lanna, Wat Prasing).

It’s wonderful to hear that our professional therapists were able to relieve the muscle knots from your travels, allowing you to feel more at ease. We're glad you enjoyed the beautiful and peaceful atmosphere of the spa.

We're also thrilled that the hot tea and mango sticky rice served after your treatment provided a delicious finishing touch to your visit! We look forward to welcoming you both back for another rejuvenating spa journey. Thank you once again for your kind words!

reviews.name: Eric Fong
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience at Oasis Spa.

I first visited Oasis Spa in Chiang Mai more than ten years ago, and it left me with a very good memory. This time, I came back and I’m happy to say the experience was still excellent.

The environment was peaceful and beautiful, the staff were warm and professional, and the treatment was very relaxing from beginning to end. It felt special to return after so many years and still find the same calm and comfortable feeling here.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your heartfelt review brought a smile to all of our faces! Thank you for taking the time to share your special journey with us. We are truly honored that you chose to revisit us after more than a decade and delighted to know that we could once again provide a relaxing and memorable experience. Your kind words about our peaceful atmosphere and the warm hospitality of our team mean a great deal to us. Creating a sanctuary of relaxation and genuine care for every guest is at the heart of what we do. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

reviews.name: H L
reviews.text: Wonderful and professional! The best massage we have had so far in Chiang Mai. The first place to have the proper face rest on their massage tables! So comfortable!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wow, what a fantastic review! We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us. It’s wonderful to hear that you considered your massage one of the best you’ve had in Chiang Mai and that you found our facilities, especially the face rests, so comfortable. We look forward to welcoming you back to our Lanna Oasis Spa branch again

reviews.name: Marisa
reviews.text: Wonderful, luxurious spa, truly a calm oasis in the old city. Visited twice in two days. You pay premium for top notch cleanliness, warmth, ambience, service and attention to detail. Bonus: free return transport from and back to your hotel. You get your own treatment chalet that comes with its own toilet/bathroo/steam room (even for a one-hour massage). They adhered to my requests in terms of where to focus and level of pressure. Result: a heavenly experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're absolutely delighted that you enjoyed the luxurious and peaceful ambiance of Oasis Spa Lanna. It’s fantastic to hear that we were able to tailor the massage pressure and focus just the way you like it, and that our team’s service made your visit truly special. We can’t wait to welcome you back for another wonderful session of relaxation!

reviews.name: Tianjiao Qu
reviews.text: Great experience here! Booking process was easy and efficient. Staff are very nice and professional. The architecture itself is artistic too!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a delight to read your fantastic review! It brings us great joy to know that you had such a wonderful experience and that both our team's professionalism and the unique charm of Oasis Spa Lana contributed to your visit. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another relaxing and memorable escape.

reviews.name: Scott Yeh
reviews.text: What a wonderful spa! Beautiful environment, skillful massage service, Oasis Spa deserves the title of the best spa center in Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to post your lovely feedback. We are thrilled that the serene atmosphere and the quality of our massage therapy contributed to a wonderful visit for you. Our team is dedicated to creating a perfect blend of comfort and skill, and your comments affirm their hard work. We value your patronage immensely and are already looking forward to welcoming you back for another session of relaxation and care.

reviews.name: ARIEDNE VICENCIO
reviews.text:
Best massage I’ve ever had — top 1, no exaggeration. Glovie hit every single spot that needed it, plus spots I didn’t even know needed work. The pressure was perfect the entire time.
The space itself is beautiful and peaceful, and the staff are genuinely pleasant and polite I. Everything was spotless, and the bathroom in the room was so nice. Loved that we got to shower after, and the complimentary ride home was a nice surprise.

Ask for Glovie. Cannot recommend enough.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your beautiful feedback truly made our day! We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the massage technique and the beautiful, clean facilities at our Lanna branch. It’s especially wonderful to know that Glorie and our team helped make your visit so memorable. Thank you for your kind words and recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you again in the future.

title: The Track Bangkok
ownerDescription: Introducing The Track Bangkok, the new name and new look of the former Vons 24/7 fitness center. We've revamped the entire atmosphere and upgraded our equipment to provide the best fitness experience possible. Our goal is to help you reach your fitness goals in a welcoming and motivating environment with cutting-edge strength and cardio equipment, expert personal trainers, and group fitness classes. With 24/7 access and a supportive community, you'll have everything you need to stay on track and exceed your limits. Join us at The Track Bangkok and take your fitness journey to the next level!
address: 15 Sukhumvit Residence, 28 Sukhumvit 15, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: PV J
reviews.text:
The gym has plenty of equipment, but the air conditioning breaks down almost every week. Today, three AC units were out while the gym was extremely crowded, making it unbearably hot and causing a strong body odor smell throughout the facility. We are paying full membership price, so conditions like this are unacceptable. Honestly, members should receive at least a 50% discount when the gym environment is this poor.

Update: Sadly, this problem keeps happening. Today, multiple AC units were not working, the gym was packed, and it was extremely hot throughout the facility. It’s disappointing that this issue has still not been properly addressed despite being a recurring problem. Members are paying full price and should expect a comfortable and well-maintained environment.

reviews.name: Barbaros
reviews.text:
The reviews were accurate — it’s an awesome gym!

You have pretty much all you need, from a variety of machines to free weights and even heavy bags.

Kanlaya was also very friendly and helpful with everything! Made the experience more positive.

reviews.name: Stephanie Weber
reviews.text: Amazing gym with lots of free weights!!! Staff are super friendly too! The daily drop in - 400 baht is really worth it! Toilet is clean & spacious too! Will definitely go back there whenever I am in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your amazing review! We're delighted to hear that you appreciated our range of free weights and found our staff friendly. It's great to know that our daily drop-in rate provided good value and that our facilities met your expectations. We look forward to welcoming you back to The Track Bangkok on your next visit to the city!

reviews.name: Nikoletta Gombás
reviews.text:
In general a positive experience.
There are several squat racks, pullup bars, two dipping stations, a high p-bar, good selection of machines, various kettlebells, lots of bars and weights. Loads of mirrors,and also some free space which I could use for handstands.
Air conditioning works fine. Service was very nice.
What I didn't find was rings, plyo boxes (or any kind of box), TRX.
Some weights are labelled in pounds, some in kgs, so watch out for this.
Daily ticket is 350 bath. Protein shake is great, costs 150.
Showers are wonderful, locker is safe (I didn't close mine), but toilet is a bit of walking away in the building and not air conditioned.

reviews.name: Nick Chang
reviews.text: Working out in this gym was a great! The gym is spacious, clean, solid equipment with a good selection for any serious gym goer. It is served by friendly staff and an attentive owner who gives very insightful and practical personal training sessions.  If your in bangkok and need to work out I'd recommend this 24/7 gym.  The best thing is they have day and fortnightly passes, good for visitors. They make it so easy, just turn up and they will help you choose the best pass.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to leave us such a positive review! We are thrilled to hear that you had a great experience working out in our gym. We take pride in providing a spacious and clean environment with solid equipment that caters to the needs of any serious gym-goer. Our staff and owner are dedicated to providing excellent service and offering insightful personal training sessions.

We are delighted to know that you found our day and fortnightly passes to be convenient for visitors to Bangkok. We always strive to make it easy for our customers to access our gym and choose the best pass that suits their needs. Thank you again for recommending our 24/7 gym, and we hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Peter Haywood
reviews.text: An amazing gym, very well equipped and a good atmosphere. Can get busy at peak times but that’s because it’s a great gym. The machines are also high quality, the person who put this gym together is clearly experienced. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Leonard E. Davis
reviews.text:
I was in Bangkok on vacation and ended up stumbling across The Track Gym……honestly, I’m so glad I did. The place is super clean, well-equipped, and the vibe is just right. The staff are professional but also really welcoming, which made a big difference.
After a solid workout, one of the guys there, Rocky, hooked me up with a protein shake that was hands down one of the best I’ve had in a long time. Super refreshing and made just right.   If you’re in Bangkok and looking for a quality gym with great energy, I’d definitely recommend checking this place out.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Leonard for your awesome review. We’re really happy you enjoyed your time at The Track Gym and that Rocky’s protein shake hit the spot. It’s great to hear our atmosphere and team made your visit special. Hope to see you again next time you’re in Bangkok!

reviews.name: It’s Me
reviews.text: Amazing gym! Very clean and organized, and has all the way to commit you could, also had more space than I expected along with meal prep food, protein, powders, and some other supplements. Staff was very friendly and it’s easily located.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words and detailed feedback! We’re glad you enjoyed the gym’s cleanliness, space, and amenities. Our team works hard to make sure everyone feels welcome and supported. We appreciate your support and hope to see you back at The Track Bangkok soon!

reviews.name: Stefan Mano
reviews.text:
This is my first time visiting Bangkok, and I chose to use this fitness center because it’s close to my hotel. Everything here perfectly suits fitness enthusiasts, so I would highly recommend it. The staff take excellent care of customers.
Kanlaya and Rocky were very helpful and friendly, and they make the most delicious protein shakes

reviews.name: Sharel Shamis
reviews.text: Great gym with plenty of space and equipment. There are about 10 cages, more than 10 treadmills, and dumbbells up to 50 kilos. It's open 24/7, and the entry fee is 400 baht, but you can get free entries for 1000 baht. They also provide Wi-Fi, a large area for farm work, and a complete range of kettlebell variations. Highly, highly recommend this gym!

reviews.name: Karl Roberts
reviews.text:
Excellent gym. :)

Seriously well stocked with lots of equipment.

5 squat racks is ace.

Loses a star as it has no gents toilet! (you have to walk a complex route to a public sweat box, no toilet paper job)

Also, could do with some 1.25kg plates.

Note, plates are in lbs, not kg.. But there a few knocking about in here.

Love the staff here, always super helpful.

reviews.name: Tak Sasaki
reviews.text:
Visiting in from Canada. Being a trainer / gym owner, this facility is an impressive space. This is by far the best option for the price provided. Clean and New equipment.
Front desk reception was very helpful, assisted my wife and I to get to a salon while I was able to come and train.
The equipment provided is great for bodybuilding, as well as functional athletic performance. For half the price of other places such as Absolute U / Fitness First offers.

If you are staying in this area. Come check it out !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your positive review of our gym! We're thrilled to hear that you found our facility impressive and that you appreciated the cleanliness and newness of our equipment. It's also great to hear that our front desk reception was able to assist you and your wife in getting to a salon. We strive to provide a great experience for all of our members, and we're glad to hear that we could deliver that for you. Thank you for recommending our gym to others in the area, and we hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: j l
reviews.text:
I was just visiting Bangkok and needed a gym to visit for once or twice. The weekly rate at 2800 b was a little too rich for my blood (as I only train twice per week) and I wasn't sure about 400b for one day, but then the staff just gave me a towel and said "try it. For free." ❤️
There were no strings attached. Didn't take my credit card number or name or anything. So not only did I get a solid workout in, but I'll return the favor and pay the 400b next time because of the nice gesture. (Update: Was back today, 5 days later. Really happy here.)

The gym, itself, is great whether you want free weights or machines. Not crowded at all on a Tuesday afternoon, but good-sized lifters of different nationalities here and there. A Muay Thai class is underway in the back and they invited me to join (though I didn't; those days are long gone for me 😅.)
Really impressed with the no-pressure staff and the more than adequate equipment. Apparently, open 24/7.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the awesome review! We're thrilled you enjoyed your visit to our gym in Bangkok. Our staff's gesture of offering you a free trial and providing a towel shows our commitment to making you feel welcome. We're glad you liked our well-equipped gym, the diverse community, and the no-pressure atmosphere. We appreciate your support and can't wait to welcome you back!

reviews.name: Sonny Santoro
reviews.text: Best gym in the area, great yearly membership prices.  The gym floor is very spacious, loads of equipment with plenty of weights, cardio equipment and even heavy dumbbells too, the equipment is in great condition compared to the other gyms around the area. Facilities are clean, there is parking, shower has its own cubicle to get changed in and there is also a great working space area with good wifi. All in all very happy with this Gym for the price of the membership
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your experience at Vons Gym! We're delighted to hear that you're enjoying the facilities and the equipment. We take great pride in maintaining our gym to the highest standards to ensure a comfortable and clean environment for our members. It's also great to hear that you find our yearly membership prices affordable and reasonable. Our aim is to provide a great value for money without compromising on quality. Thank you for choosing Vons Gym and we look forward to seeing you again soon!

reviews.name: Ellett Vaughan
reviews.text:
The Good, Equipment, Friendly Staff, Lots of people actually lifting.

The Bad, Internet never WORKED, Microwave by the entrance. I don’t think food is supposed to be in the gym tbh.  Personal preference

The negatives aside, great for those who actually lift

reviews.name: Adrian Hawkins
reviews.text: Not the biggest gym but they pack in a ton of equipment from running machines to power lifting. There's alot of testosterone in this gym so sensitive types maybe look elsewhere. Members were polite and I twice stepped in between sets with other lifters without fuss. I noticed plates were removed from machines and returned to the rack. A pet hate of mine and a BIG thumbs up. Pricing was standard for BKK if not slightly below city centre rates.

reviews.name: Jeremy Boyle
reviews.text:
I was staying in an Airbnb around the corner when I found this gym. Typically gyms in Thailand are either too polished or super grungy with no air-conditioning but this gym was the perfect mix of the two. A true weightlifter gym without the intimidation and enough space to comfortably move around.

The day pass was expensive 400b, but that’s how most gyms are in Bangkok. The great thing about it is it’s a 24 hour pass so if you go in the evening one day, you can go back in the morning the following day and get double use out of your pass.

If I was permanently living in the area, I would definitely consider buying a monthly membership for this gym.

reviews.name: Eva Gur
reviews.text: An excellent gym with a personal touch. You can see that the owner loves the field. There’s a selection of well thought hammers and Olympic cages. Only the aerobic facilities are a bit old. Daily admission cost 350 baht. Overall, I enjoyed it

reviews.name: Kevin Ligabue
reviews.text: Really good gym, day pass 400thb or 1000 for 3 days. Lots of machines and squat racks. Dumbbells consistently up to 60lbs after that they have a couple of 85lbs and some unmarked ones. Staff is very friendly and polite nice people 🙏

reviews.name: Florian lindener
reviews.text: One of the best gyms in the area, good equipment full of dumbbells, enough space and the most important great price! Owner which is bodybuilder gives great advise when you perform the exercise!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your positive review of our gym. We're glad to hear that you're happy with the equipment and the advice you received from our owner, who is a knowledgeable bodybuilder. We strive to provide a high-quality experience for all of our members at an affordable price. Thank you for choosing our gym and we hope to continue exceeding your expectations.

title: Loong Muay Thai Camp
ownerDescription:
This is a professional Muay Thai gym that offers accommodation for trainees. It is right next to a rice field, allowing trainees to enjoy the view of the rice paddies while experiencing the unique charm of Muay Thai.
Contact us via Phone number (0646216521) / Line / Instagram / Facebook for more information
address: R4GX+Q9, Sa-nga Ban, Doi Saket District, Chiang Mai 50220, Thailand

reviews.name: timluckit
reviews.text:
This brand-new gym just outside Chiang Mai is an incredible place to train, set in stunning surroundings with rice fields and mountains in the distance. The facilities are excellent, with plenty of punch bags, a small but steadily expanding set of weights, and enough space for up to 30 people, including accommodation. The rooms are high quality, providing a comfortable stay for training. It caters to all levels, from beginners to professional athletes, ensuring a well-rounded experience for everyone. The atmosphere is welcoming, and the staff are genuinely friendly and supportive. Only 25–30 minutes from Chiang Mai center, it’s a fantastic spot for both serious training and enjoying the beautiful setting. Highly recommended!

P.s.
If navigating by Google maps, there's an error. You must use the road directly opposite the temple with the Serpent statue.

reviews.name: Yassine Nassila
reviews.text:
Loong Muay Thai is truly a great Muay Thai gym.
Located in the beautiful countryside of Chiang Mai, the setting is peaceful and ideal for focus and progress. The owners and coaches are passionate, welcoming, and genuinely human in their approach.

The training quality is excellent, with a perfect coach-to-student ratio that allows real improvement in Muay Thai. It’s the ideal place to evolve and train seriously, far from overcrowded and overly touristic gyms. Spent more than a week here and will comeback for sure
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind review! We’re truly happy you enjoyed your time training and staying with us. You’re always welcome back to train, improve, and feel at home here. Hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Barney Wright
reviews.text:
This place is everything you'd want in a Muay Thai gym.

- The ratio of teachers to students was the best I've seen and not like the bigger touristy gyms nearby, meaning you had more meaningful teaching time with the coach correcting your faults. At larger gyms you get paired with another tourist with little experience and you don't gain anything from it

- it was hard work with the coaches genuinely caring about your progression. I found my fitness improve in my time here after going on the optional extra runs before both daily sessions

- It was good value and for 150bht extra a day you got a LOT of good food cooked for you

- There was a great sense of community. Everyone ate and trained together. Loong drove us all to watch a fight in China Mai when someone at the gym fought, getting us heavily discounted tickets

- Get the room with AC and not the fan room or it will get hot at night!

- There were fridges in our room so we stocked up on protein shakes and snacks at the nearby 7/11
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the wonderful review, Barney. We’re so happy you enjoyed the authentic training and the peace of our rice fields. It was a pleasure having you here, and we hope to welcome you back to Loong Muay Thai anytime!

reviews.name: Yonathan Smoak
reviews.text:
I trained at this gym for 23 days and it was one of the most rewarding experiences I’ve had. The trainers are meticulous and dedicated—they break down every technique and make sure you're improving every day.

The gym is slightly removed from the city—about 1km from the nearest store—but they offer bikes for free or just 100 baht per day. That kind of hospitality makes a big difference.

The training facilities are excellent: a spacious ring, plenty of sandbags, and all the gear you need. I stayed in a private room with air conditioning, a bathroom, and a fridge—very comfortable.

Before leaving, I had the chance to fight in a Chiang Mai stadium, and sharing that experience with local fighters was unforgettable.

I think I’ll definitely be back. If you're looking for serious Muay Thai training in Chiang Mai, this place is a gem.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Loong Muay Thai Gym looks forward to seeing you again.

reviews.name: Zeping Zeng
reviews.text:
Loong Muay Thai is one of the best gyms in the ChangMai area! I'd you're looking to focus on working on your technique or just want to chill and learn about Muay Thai this is the place for you!

The coaches are amazing there and very knowledgeable in the sport. The owner Loong and his wife Trinity are extremely helpful and kind. They will make sure you have a comfortable stay while you are there!

In terms of training there are 2 sessions a day one in the morning and one in the afternoon. You can choose to do both if you want to make the most of your time there and really learn as much as possible. Or you can just do one and spend the rest of your day traveling and seeing the local sights. You can do this by renting one of their scooters (100-250 bhat) or if you have your own. They train 6 days a week and have Sunday off.

Next the accommodation, you get an option of an AC room or a Fan room. They come with a mini fridge which is great for snacks and protein drinks. They make sure your rooms are squared away and any issues they deal with quickly. There's also a washing machine but remember to buy washing detergent.

Food here is amazing! It's only 150 bhat a day and it's 2 meals a day. Don't worry as they are huge meals, I am someone who eats a lot and I was worried there wouldn't be enough but it's plenty. The coach cooks after training and it's tasty and authentic Thai food, it's honestly better than most places I've eaten. But if you're not keen on the food you can always go to the shops (12 mins away ) and make your own meals.

That's all, I hope you do attend this gym as it's one of the best!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your incredibly kind and  detailed reviews, Zeeps! We’re so happy you enjoyed the training, room, and food here. It was a true pleasure having you as part of our gym family. Remember, you always have a home in Chiang Mai at Loong Muay Thai. We  Hope to welcome you back anytime!

reviews.text: First of all, I want to point out that the coaching level is very good. The lady at the front desk is also very enthusiastic and cheerful. However, I need to point out that there are about 20 people in the group class here. The floor is covered with sweat. Everyone trains barefoot, and everyone's sweat is stepped on. It is very slippery and uncomfortable. The gloves and bandages are universal, and each one emits a strong stench. I almost fainted after smelling a glove. When I wanted to change a glove, two coaches came and loudly accused me, saying that if you want a non-smelly one, just buy a new one here. I have a full set of winning equipment in my country, so why should I buy a new pair of not-so-good gloves here? Besides, I have been abroad for more than two months. I didn't come to Thailand specifically to learn Muay Thai. This request is very ridiculous. The coach's target, the boxing gym, the bandages and the gloves all smell very bad. The smell will remain on your hands and the stench will continue. If you can accept the strong odor, then this is a good choice because the price is not expensive and the coaching level is high.

reviews.name: Linus
reviews.text:
I managed to do one private session and one group class at this gym, and both were fantastic experiences.

For the private session, I was paired with Coach Ming, who is in his 40s and has over 300 fights. We started with jump rope and stretching before moving into technical work, where Ming consistently adjusted my form whenever needed. We then completed several rounds of pad work—highly technical, challenging, and very engaging. The session wrapped up with conditioning and core exercises. Overall, it was an excellent experience. Ming has a sharp eye for detail and explained techniques in a way that was clear and easy to understand.

The next day, I joined a morning group class. The session began with warm-up routines and stretching, followed by technical drilling and sparring. The sparring was light, technical, and a lot of fun. We finished the class with three rounds of pads, then bagwork and core.

Overall, I had a wonderful experience and really appreciated how welcoming the coaches and members were. I was only in Chiang Mai for a week, but I’d love to return the next time I’m in the area.

As an added bonus, the coaches and the front desk staff are able to communicate in both English and Mandarin.

reviews.name: Kim Nicole
reviews.text:
The beautiful practice of ashtanga, the kind and wise guidance by the teachers, and the warm and compassionate community has been a wondrous experience!   I have been a student at Ashtanga Samasthiti nearing three years.

My strength, flexibility, and ability to do challenging postures with a calm mind and breath have increased.  But beyond the  physicality of the postures, I  continue to experience a deep and natural connection and awareness of self and others.

Ashtanga Samasthiti is truly a gift.  The collective energy of kindness,  joy,  and dedication to the practice  have been magical.

This shala is truly a home away from home.

With Gratitude!

reviews.name: Kaye Pennapa
reviews.text:
Ashtanga Samasthiti is a wonderful Shala that truly embodies the essence of Ashtanga yoga and self-practice. The teacher is incredibly kind and generous, fostering an environment where every student feels valued and understood. Her deep knowledge goes beyond the physical aspects of yoga; she shares wisdom and philosophy that enrich the practice significantly.
The warmth and friendliness of the community make it a safe space to grow and explore both body and mind.
I highly recommend this Shala to anyone looking to deepen their yoga practice in an inclusive and supportive atmosphere.

reviews.name: BulbousBrain
reviews.text:
Ashtanga Samasthiti is supposed to be a world-class studio. It's one of the only studios in the world with certified Ashtanga instructors. It's one of the only studios in the world where VKM is taught. The instruction is great.

I am writing this review because the policy is as inhumane as the yoga instruction is elite. I attached screenshots. Decide for yourself. I cannot in good fortune support a yoga studio that leaves me feeling as if they took advantage of my enthusiasm and faith.

EDIT: As far as the studio's response is concerned: your boundaries were not clear. You never mentioned, "By the way, sometimes our studio is closed if we don't get enough practitioners." Because if you did, I would've asked, "Oh, how often do you get enough practitioners?" And I would've never signed up. It's nowhere on the website, too. That's not an accident. That's by design. Which makes it predatory.

Obviously if you don't regularly get enough practitioners, your studio isn't that busy, which is probably why you needed my money so much.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
It’s interesting how some people perceive clear boundaries as a lack of compassion. In reality, having structured policies endures fairness for everyone. Compassion doesn’t meaning bending rules to accommodate personal preference- it means creating a space that benefit the whole community while maintaining sustainability.

Your package 8 times values for 60 days.
From  February 1st until April 1st. You managed to practice one time on February 1st then… 

Thank you for joining us.

reviews.name: Paul M.
reviews.text:
I have been a student at the Ashtanga Samasthiti for 5 years now and it has truly become my yoga home. The studio has a warm, peaceful, non-competitive and very supporting atmosphere. Kru Naw and the team is incredibly knowledgeable and always offer personalized attention and advice to help me progress in my practice, especially for backbends with laser focus alignment tips. Through these 5 years of practice, I have noticed a significant improvement in my strength, flexibility and easiness in gateway poses.

Kru Naw also taught me the Moon sequence which is now entirely part of my weekly routine as a more restorative practice.

The shala space is huge, with natural light coming out of large windows. This enables a lot of personal space for practice.

I hope the shala can bring us more learnings on Yoga, in addition to asanas.

I highly recommend it to anyone looking to deepen their yoga practice or to start their practice.

reviews.name: Naphalai Trakulphadetkrai Aey
reviews.text:
2年継続にこちらに通っています。
バンコク中心にあるアシュタンガヨガの教室なので、とても便利です。またこちらの先生の皆さんも力を尽くして、私達の体、アライメントなど調整してくださっているので、いつも感謝しています。サマ教室( Ashtanga Samasthitiの略)には(インドにあるKPJAYI)アシュタンガヨガ創始者の道場から(正式指導者資格Authorization Level 2 )を得た先生もいます。
サマ教室ではアシュタンガヨガの初心者の方も長年練習している方も一緒に練習しているので、とても楽しい教室です！
私にとってBackbendばとても難しいですが、先生の方々や一緒に練習している仲間ばいつも静かに応援したり、励ましたりしてくれてますので、諦めいないで、頑張ります！😊
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been attending this class for two years now.
It's an Ashtanga yoga studio in the heart of Bangkok, so it's very convenient. I'm also always grateful to the teachers here, who do their best to adjust our bodies and alignment. At Sama (short for Ashtanga Samasthiti), there's a teacher who has received Authorization Level 2 teaching certification from the dojo of the founder of Ashtanga Yoga (KPJAYI in India).
At Sama, beginners and long-time practitioners of Ashtanga yoga all practice together, so it's a really fun class!
Backbends are very difficult for me, but the teachers and fellow practitioners are always quietly cheering me on and encouraging me, so I won't give up and will keep trying! 😊

reviews.text: I recently had the most incredible foot massage experience at Serenity Foot Spa, and I can’t stop raving about it! From the moment I walked in, the ambiance was calm and inviting—the soft lighting, soothing music, and warm welcome immediately put me at ease. My therapist, Mai, was incredibly attentive—she asked about any areas of tension and tailored the massage to my needs. The pressure was perfect—firm but not painful—and I could feel the stress melt away with every stroke. Afterward, my feet felt so light, and the tension that had built up after weeks of long days just disappeared. I left with a huge smile and will definitely be returning. If you’re looking for a blissful escape for your tired feet, this is the place!

reviews.name: Bryan Rabilas

reviews.name: Alieth Bontuyan
reviews.text:
Im not a fan of foot massages but this place has been popular online when we search things to do in Bangkok,

So we give it a try, we book a grab to the area from google map but when we arrive there they are already close, they have new operating hours different from google schedule.

Anyways we decide to book a slot for the following day, the day has come and then, the pain began.

Reading from google reviews ans videos online I already know how painful it would be, it feels like the therapist is pulling out something from my foot , everytime she press somewhere I have to hold my breathe and lift my butt in pain.

But all these pain I expected already,

Its like a kind of reflexology , the more problems inside your body on different organs the more painful it is.

Anyways the massage shop is pretty small, there are plenty of beds but only 2 therapist , it looks like a couple and they own it.

The toilet is small but it is clean,

There is a second floor for body massage but we didn’t try because after 1 hr foot massage I feel like I’m becoming a jellyfish without feet.

It is in the center of bangkok , easier to find using google.

Highly recommended traditional foot massage.

reviews.name: Ben Taylor
reviews.text: If you are looking for a real foot massage, this is the place to go. It can be booked up a lot of the time so you may want to schedule and appointment. You'll get an amazing (though painful) massage that will leave you walking on clouds. They come highly recommended.

reviews.text: Located at the heart of bangkok. Good massage & relaxing facilities. I feel “90-minute Abyanka” is not enough. Haha

reviews.name: Rayan T
reviews.text:
Was staying at the St Regis so I booked a 90 minute Thai Massage for a pretty hefty price of around AUD$200. The facility is clean, modern and the staff are very attentive, however the quality of the massage was poor. I am of tall and decently muscular build (although a little pudgy thanks to excessive enjoyment of SE Asian cuisine) and am used to a strong pressure from masseuses in Thailand and outside it.

Despite asking for hard pressure a few times there were only sporadic moments where the masseuse really got into me which was disappointing as I felt a little worse off after than before I started. After communicating this to the staff, they were nice enough to offer me a complimentary 30 minutes to remedy the situation, but again, the pressure was more like a soft-medium.

I appreciate the friendly service and they do take good care of you, but when a street massage costs a tenth of the price and actually does a good job of sorting your back out, it still makes you question the value proposition. I'd recommend this place if you like your massages on the softer side, however if like me, you crave for something more, perhaps look elsewhere.

On another note, the clinic maintains a hot/cold jacuzzi along with sauna room which are excellent and well looked after.

The trainers are patient and very easy to understand. They also have a nice shop upstairs where you can buy gloves, shirts, and other gear. I will 100% come back to train here! Hands down the best gym I've been to yet.

reviews.name: Tee Ponsukcharoen
reviews.text: As a Thai peson, it has been a long wish for me to learn Muay Thai. It was an amazing surprise that the Muay Thai gym under the legendary boxer Buakaw was open in the neighborhood. I went there and I was hooked. The class is very small and intense. In 2 hours, we went through stretch, warm up, basic moves, sandbags and sparring with our trainers. As an amateur, I had so much fun and gain confidence in just one session. The trainers and staff are so kind and understanding. I can't judge the level of difficulty since I am so new but I see that my trainer can adjust the intensity for different students (I saw how hard he was after a foreigner who has been training for 3 years lol while he was quite easy for me lol). In any event, I feel welcome and had such a great workout here. I would love to practice Muay Thai here again when I am back to Thailand.

reviews.text: A cake too beautiful to even cut…. Almost. 😆 It just as delicious as it was beautiful. She asked for ideas I had in mind, things my kid loves and the result was insane. Everyone loved how good it tasted too. 🤤 Thank you for creating a magical moment and memory for us all!! 🫶🏼
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏❤️🙏

reviews.name: Dimitri Soen
reviews.text: I ordered a birthday cake with specific requirements, I wanted purple, black, gold, flower, chocolate and macarons. Well, it couldn't have been more perfect!! The cake was just amazing, and delicious. I definitely recommend Freshy's! The order was quick and simple through messenger, and it was personally delivered on time! Wish I could give more than 5 stars!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: Manon Hamann
reviews.text: I ordered there many times for cupcakes, Halloween, Christmas biscuits and for birthday cakes. The cakes were so beautiful,  and so delicious ! The birthday cakes are personalized according to the theme asked and the result is incredible.  I highly recommend this place !!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for always supporting us 🙏❤️🙏

reviews.name: Tintin Power
reviews.text: Just ordered a dozen cupcakes 2 days ago for the first time and not only do they look beautiful, they are absolutely yummy. The cake was light and fluffy and the cream heavenly. Will order again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏❤️🙏🙏

reviews.name: Jen Yoo
reviews.text: Our kids made donuts and had a lot of fun.  Ms.Natta was very friendly and they learn how to make it by talking with her. The donuts were also very delicious.  I would highly recommend here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Phyllis Knight
reviews.text: I had a last minute order , which I’m not encouraging, and this great Bakery helped me out. Cupcakes are beautiful and very tasty.  I highly recommended this very professional shop.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much🙏🙏🙏🙏

title: Mayan Gym
ownerDescription: We are the largest gym in Jed Yod, Chiangmai (10 minutes from Maya Mall) and open 7 days a week from 7-12am. We cater to fitness and bodybuilding enthusiasts looking to lose weight, improve cardio and reshape their body. Besides a wide selection of cardio machines and free weights, we also have a corner for kickboxing and crossfit beginners. Unlike other gyms, our members don't have to wait around all day to use the machines. Our gym is also well-ventilated. Daily entry is 50 baht and yearly membership is only 5,900 baht. Drop by and train with us today.
address: 159 Jed Yod - Yu Yen Soi 6, Tambon Chang Phueak, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50300, Thailand
plusCode: RX58+XW Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Aisyah Gunung
reviews.text:
The gym is inside a hangar-like kind of building, and it looks quite barebone, but it's actually very nice because it feels airy and it's not hot at all. It has no AC, but I think you don't really need that in Chiang Mai.

The equipments are not the newest kind of equipment, they are quite old, but also they're very maintained. And it's very cheap as well (50 THB for day pass). It's one of the most value for money kind of gym I went to in Chiang Mai, love this gym.

reviews.name: Natnaree Dejcha
reviews.text:
Been going here for almost 2 years. Today a walk-in customer accidentally took my bag home and the staff helped check the cctv and they got on their scooter to find my bag from the GPS on my other phone in the bag. I got my bag back within less than 15 mins of it went missing 🥺 💕💕 Such kind people, recommend 10/10

The gym itself is enormous, it got different spaces for different kinds of work out. They also recently got some new machines in as well. Bathroom and toilet are clean and available for both daily and member customers. 😏

reviews.name: Nathan
reviews.text: This is an amazing gym and the day pass is only 50 thai bhat. There is ample place to workout and they have 10 treadmills and 14 cycles. Ample machines to accommodate 35 plus people at a time. They have separate locker rooms with shower facilities. There is a weighing scale at the front. They also provide wifi. Machines are all in good working condition.

reviews.name: yixuan huang
reviews.text: This is not a perfect gym, but it is definitely a great place for fitness. There is only one thing: the old barbell pieces here do not indicate weight, and staff can try directly labeling the weight with paint or correction fluid for user convenience.

reviews.name: Syrristen
reviews.text: Good place to work out. It's an old school gym without AC, but there are plenty of fans blowing cool air. There's a small muay thai corner aswell id you're into that. The staff is 100% helpful, and the cost to train is only 50baht. It's pretty close to Nimman and MAYA too

reviews.name: Julian Thomas
reviews.text:
Awesome gym with everything you need. What more could you want from  50thb drop in gym? Need more places like these in Thailand.
Clean, spacious, well equipped. Couple of heavy bags, a stretch area, and even a ping pong table. Lol. And it stays open late!
Solid place.

It can get a bit humid in there so be ready to sweat.
Bring your own towel and water.
Enjoy.

reviews.name: Jody Utomo
reviews.text:
5 stars for what you get with 50 baht (~US$1.5) daily pass.

Lots of machine and spacious.

Can get pretty hot during the day.

The machines are quite old & rusty but still get the job done.

reviews.name: Taelon Vorster
reviews.text:
Very impressed by the space and equipment of this gym. It is a fan gym, no air conditioning but has sufficient fans. All of the equipment is well kept and lots of choices for various workout styles.

There is also showers and lockers available which are separate for men and women.

It cost 50 THB for one day if you want to do pay as you go. They offer other packages if you want to buy monthly etc.

reviews.name: Alexander
reviews.text:
Old gym but cozy vibe.
Big space, enough equipment, good conditioning and nice location.
The big advantage is the smoothie bar nearby the entrance and a nice local cafe nearby too.
The democratic price and cool staff.
It's my favorite gym in terms of atmosphere.

reviews.name: Preeyaporn Pol-in
reviews.text: Great gym! It has all the equipment I need, a friendly atmosphere, and very affordable prices.

reviews.name: Hector Q
reviews.text: For 50 baht it’s hard to complain. The equipment is a bit older but still works well enough. Heaps of space, clean, and there are fans across the walls. Overall for the price, it’s a pretty good gym.

reviews.name: Dutch Leeuw
reviews.text:
Decent price for the equipment given. Open until midnight which is good for an after work workout. Though it can get hot.
Con: The bathroom is kinda small for the amount of people at some hours and the smell sometimes leaks out.

reviews.name: Jussum Kenobe
reviews.text: Old, dilapidated, rusty machines and weights. I get rust stains and metal on my hands after each set. Benches and other equipment with padding are all torn up and ratty with rips and holes. Half the treadmills are broken down. The general cleanliness of the place is low. Nonetheless there’s enough gear to get a good workout, it’s spacious, and it’s 50 baht per session. If it were anymore than 50 I would not come here.

reviews.name: Michael “M” Foehn
reviews.text:
One of the best gym in town, decent price per day and great monthly packages. Mix between old / new school equipment. Friendliest Staff and Owners too.
Be sure to check this gym out if your in town.

reviews.name: KAMTONG
reviews.text: High ceiling and spacious but dusty and not clean enough , machine old doesn't matter but suggests kept maintenance , few cable machines almost broken . So...50baht day pass is very affordable.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your feedback! 😊 We're thrilled to hear that you appreciate the spaciousness and high ceilings of our gym! We totally understand your concerns about cleanliness and equipment maintenance, and we’re actively working on improvements. Your insights help us get better! 💪 Plus, we're glad you find our 50 baht day pass super affordable! Come back and see how we evolve; we promise it’ll be worth it! 🌟

reviews.name: Pusit Kittiteeranurak
reviews.text: 50thb per visit. Good enough to have a great workout there.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are grateful for your feedback. Thanks! 😍

reviews.name: da sh
reviews.text:
Best gym in CM, hands down.
Large clean space with plenty of interesting machines, squat rack, free weights and more.
Only downside is no AC.
But what it lacks in temperature it makes up for in friendly vibe and atmosphere.
Accept no alternative 🤙🏿

reviews.name: Thomas Black
reviews.text: For 50B a solid gym. All basic equipment and some machines available in a large room. However maintenance of the equipment seems not the highest priority, the cardio bikes are all broken and also the other equipment seems to get worse since a year.

reviews.name: Ducky Travels
reviews.text:
A bit dated but nice gym. The machines are still in a good condition though some equipment is showing age: like yoga mats 😬
It's only 50฿ a pop so it's very affordable! They allow personal trainers too.

The place gets a bit packed and hot because of sheer amount of people are there. Avoid peak hours.

Other than that everyone is friendly and helpful. There's water and electrolyte drinks for sale as well as some chicken steak (maybe?) food outside.

reviews.name: Ton Leelamanit
reviews.text: Love this place. Sufficient equipment, slightly old and dusty but well maintained and totally safe to use. Day pass rate is among the best I’ve seen at 50 Baht.

reviews.name: Randall Fouts
reviews.text:
I went here with my girlfriend for some Muay Thai training/fitness workout and we both loved it. Both of us had taken a long break from training so we were out of shape but the level of training was perfect. The trainers were very friendly and kind but also knew how to push us to our limits so that we had a great workout.

Things that I love about this gym :

- Great location, lots of food stands nearby for post training refuel.
- Staff/trainers are very relaxed, warm and friendly.
- The gym is very clean and all of the equipment is practically brand new.
- The gym has water, air conditioning and the price is fair for both Thai person and foreigner.

Thank you for a great training session. We will be coming back soon once we recover 🙏🏻😌

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for training with us! 🥊 We’re glad you enjoyed the morning Muay Thai class. Hope to welcome you back to TFD in Lat Krabang again!

reviews.name: Draven Zemrock
reviews.text: Thai Fighting Dragon is a clean, top-notch gym with an awesome training environment. The coaches are extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and every single one delivers a solid private session. Plus, the prices are incredibly reasonable. Glad I chose this place!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your amazing review! 😊 We’re glad you enjoyed our Muay Thai gym, private training, and coaching team. Looking forward to training with you again soon! 🥊

reviews.name: 따라주
reviews.text:
아주 오랜만에 글러브를 껴보았습니다. 코치님이 너무 친절하게 잘 가르쳐 주어서 1시간 체험을 할수있었습니다.
초보자도 알기쉽게 가르쳐 주는것 같았어요. 나의 체력이 예전같지 않아 힘들었지만 한번쯤 해볼만하다고 생각합니다.
레슨이 끝나고 약20분정도 마사지를 해주시는데 감동이었습니다. 갑자기 운동한걸 아니까 알아서 다리, 어깨, 팔,등등  잘 풀어주셨어요.

시설 깔끔하고 복합 쇼핑몰 내에 위치해있으니 운동 끝나고 식사, 쇼핑 다 가능합니다.
reviews.textTranslated:
It's been a while since I tried gloves. The coach was so kind and thorough, and I was able to experience it for an hour.
It seemed like the instructions were easy to understand, even for beginners. My stamina isn't what it used to be, so it was a bit challenging, but I think it's worth a try.
The 20-minute massage after the lesson was really impressive. Knowing I had just finished working out, the instructor took the time to really stretch my legs, shoulders, arms, and more.

The facility is clean and located inside a shopping mall, so you can enjoy a meal or some shopping after your workout.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your detailed review! We’re glad you felt comfortable and enjoyed the session.

reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time, and both instructors were excellent. Everything was easy to understand! I was also very lucky to have two beautiful ladies in the class, which made it fun and relaxed. Everyone was very friendly. I highly recommend it! TFD doesn't hard-sell, so you can relax. After training, you can easily grab something to eat because there are so many food options nearby, it's close to the mall, and there's parking. I'll definitely come again! 🙏💗
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณมากครับสำหรับรีวิว 🙏
ดีใจที่ครั้งแรกก็รู้สึกสบายใจและเรียนได้เต็มที่

ครูทั้งสองสอนดีสอนสนุก เด็กๆชอบ Summer นี้ เรา
มาเรียนรู้ศิลปะป้องกันตัว ดีมากๆเลยค่ะ

Both teachers are great and make learning fun. The kids loved this summer.
Learning self-defense was fantastic!

Absolut empfehlenswert! 🥊🙏

reviews.name: Ryan GLOBETROTTER
reviews.text:
Very good massage experience overall. I took a facial massage with various masks and a hot stone massage for 2,100 baht as of December 2025, and both were very good. The masseuse was knowledgeable and professional, which made a real difference in the quality of the treatment.

The place is spread over several floors, and the upper floors have separate rooms, which is great for privacy and a more intimate experience. A shower is also available, which is a nice plus after the massage.

On the downside, the lighting could be slightly improved for a better overall ambiance. Noise isolation is not very good, and the traffic sounds from Sukhumvit Road, especially tuk tuks, can make it harder to fully relax. Despite this, the quality of the massage itself is excellent.

Relax and enjoy 🙏🧘🧘‍♀️😎
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Ryan,

Thank you for sharing this detailed feedback. We are delighted that the facial and hot stone massage provided such excellent recovery. We have noted the comments regarding lighting and noise to improve our ambiance. As a trusted wellness destination since 1997, Lek Massage BTS Asok aims for perfect relaxation. We hope to welcome you back for another premium massage in Bangkok soon.

Regards,
Lek Massage Bangkok - BTS Asok

Overall, the experience was okay. I did leave a small comment regarding the room facilities the bathroom did not have a fan, which made the room feel very humid and slightly uncomfortable to breathe in. Thanks anyway 🙏🏽
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback, ICE.

We are glad you enjoyed the body scrub and our warm hospitality at Lek Massage BTS Asok. We sincerely apologize that the oil massage felt rushed and for the humidity in the room. Your comments help us improve our wellness standards. As a trusted wellness destination since 1997, we hope to provide you better relaxation during your next massage in Bangkok.

Regards,
Lek Massage

reviews.name: Karsten Eigler
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience.

We live nearby and have been regular customers for quite some time, consistently choosing this place for massages. Unfortunately, when we politely asked to use the restroom, we were refused without any flexibility.

For a business that relies on repeat customers, this kind of attitude is hard to understand. Small moments like this define customer experience — and this one was not positive.

We won’t be returning and cannot recommend this place based on how we were treated.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Karsten,

Thank you for sharing your feedback, and we’re truly sorry to hear about your recent experience at Lek Massage Asoke.

As a returning guest who has supported us over time, your experience is especially important to us, and we sincerely apologize for the disappointment caused. What you described does not reflect the level of hospitality and care we aim to provide, especially to our regular customers.

Regarding restroom access, we understand how frustrating this situation must have been. While there may be operational limitations at certain times, our team should always communicate with empathy and offer the best possible assistance. We will address this with our staff to ensure better judgment and flexibility moving forward.

Your feedback is extremely valuable, and we truly regret that this moment affected your trust in us. We hope you might consider giving us another opportunity in the future to provide the warm, professional experience that Lek Massage Asoke is known for.

Warm regards,
Lek Massage Team

สวัสดีครับ พบเห็นรีวิวและดูจากการรีวิวพื้นที่อื่น 
แล้วพบว่าหลาย ๆ ที่แจ้งว่า “พนักงานแย่” ในเวลาใกล้ ๆ กัน

street: 104/50 หมู่บ้านบูรพาวิลล่า 3 ซอย 5 ถนนทุ่งมังกร ซอย 22 แขวงฉิมพลี

reviews.name: Jonathan Proulx
reviews.text: Had an awesome time here at Kaewsamrit gym. The training was very technical. I have decided to come and live on site at the gym and train with the team twice per day for the next couple of weeks and I am incredibly excited you see the growth in my life that will come from my stay. 🥊

reviews.name: Plaire
reviews.text: This gym is perfect for professional fighters, they teach very practical techniques that are truly useful for real fights. At the same time, even if you come in without any basic knowledge, the coaches are still patient and dedicated to teaching you step by step. You never feel out of place here; the atmosphere is very welcoming and supportive.

reviews.name: C K
reviews.text: It's a great place to train! The training is hard, but over time you get used the intensity and the volume (as well as the heat). The coaches are really attentive, whether you're a beginner or an experienced fighter you'll definitely learn something. A really welcoming and friendly atmosphere. And if you end up staying in the dorms the food is really good!

reviews.name: Peach Online
reviews.text: Great experience train me hard and give me the tips I need. Friendly staff!

reviews.name: Patrick Murphy
reviews.text: Intense gym.  You can get some really good work here.  Heavy hands.  And lots of clinching.  Very impressed with instruction.  Thai fighters at the gym in 2015 were younger -- closer to 16 -- so not always lots of bigger Thai dudes to work with.  But instructors would clinch with me and could also spar with other foreigners.

reviews.name: Takashi zp
reviews.text:
one of the best camp in.Bangkok for fighters with a strong passion is here
trainers are always serious even for foreigners,NO same as a usual Thai coaches who holds pads without any
concentration and say
"good,good"
and atmosphere of camps are really friendly
here there are a old,good,professional Muay Thai,so that Top class Muay Thai and kick boxing fighters choose to train and have many repeaters from all over the.world

reviews.name: Jake
reviews.text: Old school Muaythai gym with passionate coaches and very friendly owner. Talk to Madam and she’ll accommodate you with everything you need.

reviews.name: Lyll Cordeno
reviews.text: Toughest training camp i've had to deal with so far. Great coaches and great teammates. Incredibly hot when i went there though. Learned so much from my stay there

reviews.text: best gym for alp levels

reviews.name: Cameron Harrell
reviews.text: My home away from home. I love every second I spend amongst these warriors.

reviews.name: Alessandro Soldano
reviews.text: Great training and great trainer. All

reviews.name: cvT

reviews.name: 박용우
reviews.text: good  kind see you

reviews.name: IFMACanaryIslands
reviews.text: Best Gym Ever.....

reviews.name: Nawat K
reviews.text:
Such a great Muay Thai gym! The fighters are very friendly and welcoming. They teach you everything, from proper techniques to physical conditioning and training.

The staff take great care of everyone, and the owner is incredibly kind, friendly, and genuinely caring. The whole place has a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to train Muay Thai, whether you’re a beginner or experienced! One of the Best muay thai gym

reviews.name: DANIELE Phì bā MARINETTI
reviews.text: Un Camp degno di essere chiamato CAMP DI MUAY THAI. Veramente quello che un appassionato dovrebbe cercare. Si può sia mangiare che dormire....oltre allenarsi. I Trainers sono tutti di livello, e con esperienza da ring. Ti controllano sempre e non lasciano nulla al caso. 2 allenamenti al giorno e perfetto stile Thai in un Camp storico e super blasonato. Consigliatissimo
reviews.textTranslated: A camp worthy of being called a MUAY THAI CAMP. Truly what an enthusiast should look for. You can eat and sleep...in addition to training. The trainers are all top-notch and have ring experience. They always monitor you and leave nothing to chance. Two workouts a day and perfect Thai style in a historic and highly regarded camp. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Michele Mazzali
reviews.text:
Luogo incantevole con allenatori fantastici, ti senti da subito a casa e non vuoi più andartene.
Madame sarà la tua “madre acquisita” e tu dovrai solo pensare ad allenarti niente di meglio.
reviews.textTranslated:
A charming place with fantastic coaches, you'll immediately feel at home and never want to leave.
Madame will be your "stepmother," and all you have to worry about is training.

reviews.name: Vítor Bárcia

title: Spaces Ratchathewi
ownerDescription: จัดหาที่ตั้งให้ธุรกิจของคุณบนถนนพญาไท เขตราชเทวี ใจกลางกรุงเทพมหานคร ซึ่งเป็นย่านที่สามารถเดินทางไปยังจุดอื่นๆ ได้อย่างสะดวกสบาย บริเวณนี้ขึ้นชื่อว่าเป็นศูนย์กลางการคมนาคมที่เจริญก้าวหน้า สามารถพบปะกับพันธมิตรในประเทศและทั่วโลกได้อย่างง่ายดายผ่านทางท่าอากาศยานดอนเมืองและท่าอากาศยานสุวรรณภูมิ ซึ่งสามารถเดินทางไปได้อย่างรวดเร็วโดยทางรถยนต์หรือการคมนาคมระบบรางเข้าใช้งาน Wi-Fi ความเร็วสูง และทำงานอย่างมีประสิทธิภาพทั้งวันในสำนักงานแบบส่วนตัวของคุณเอง หรือแบ่งปันแนวคิดต่างๆ ในพื้นที่ Coworking ที่เอื้อต่อการทำงานร่วมกันของเรา ในช่วงเวลาอาหารกลางวัน ลองสำรวจร้านอาหารที่มีให้เลือกใกล้เคียง หรือแวะไปชมพิพิธภัณฑ์บ้านจิม ทอมป์สันซึ่งอยู่ไม่ไกล

street: Phaya Thai Road. 111, Spaces building, Floors 1-7

reviews.name: FrankGorGor
reviews.text:
Went there yesterday for coffee break.

Coffee just so so, however, the environment is so nicely decorated. The sofa designed for one person is so private, cozy and comfy 😄
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi FrankGorGor, We appreciate your feedback! It looks like this review may not be for our business, but we’re glad you had a positive experience.

reviews.name: Aybel
reviews.text: Great place for all people who wants to focus on their work. Totally recommend this place! The staff is great, they speak enough well in English so you’ll don’t have any problems to communicate. Good place!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Aybel, many thanks for your kind review! We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed the focused environment and found the team helpful and easy to communicate with. We hope to welcome you back again soon!

reviews.name: Cyrill Engelmann
reviews.text:
Rented a desk for one month in the dedicated desk area, which is modern in design and let me work efficiently. Friendly coffee, cleaning and security staff.

However, Spaces is dishonest re hidden fees. I specifically asked for a final price upon signing, yet further cost came up a few weeks after, such as a "restoration fee" (which staff couldn't explain to me what it entails, beyond wiping the desk), "IT-services-fee" (which you are opted-in to, an Internet charge).

Further annoyances in contract details: Cancellation of the service only 1 month in advance. Retainer fee not paid back automatically but has to be requested, then takes one month to process.

I hope the company can take my feedback into account  and improve communication.

EDIT 1:

It took customer service from Malaysia 50 minutes from this posting to call me, but seemingly directionless and not ready to help.

In a further follow-up via email I was explained that transparency is important to the company and the restoration charge covers:
- cleaning carpets
- cleaning drawers
- IT and telecoms disassembly, testing, and cleaning

I have attached a photo of my workspace, where there are no carpets and no IT and telecoms equipment.

Following this customer service interaction I adjust my rating from 2 star to 1 star.

EDIT 2:

Upon Edit 1 I was offered 50% of the restoration fee conditional on the removal of my review.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Cyrill, thank you for your feedback, and we're sorry to hear about your experience. Please rest assured that your concerns were escalated to our global customer services and your centre team to provide further support. Your ticket reference number is C-2279103-X2G9. Thanks.

reviews.name: Niroshan ranapathi
reviews.text: Not worth for price. There is no wifi access for coffee
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Niroshan ranapathi, many thanks for taking the time to leave us a review score. We would love to hear more about your experience with us. We hope you visit us again soon.

reviews.name: alon cohen
reviews.text: Not quite, have no rooms and really small
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi alon cohen, thank you for your feedback. We’re sorry to hear the space didn’t meet your expectations. Please raise a ticket through the Help section of your online account so our team can review this and assist you directly.

reviews.name: Chaiwat Mas
reviews.text:
เหมาะสมกับการมานั่งคุยงานมากครับ กาแฟอร่อยใช้ได้ มีให้เลือกพอสมควรอยู่ เน้นไปทางกาแฟ

ห้องน้ำดีเลยครับ

This place is great for business meetings. The coffee is pretty good, with a decent selection. They focus more on coffee.

The restrooms are nice.

There are quite a few meeting rooms and open areas for discussions, group work, and doing homework.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: สวัสดี ขอขอบคุณที่สละเวลาเขียนรีวิวให้เรา เนื่องจากที่จอดรถแต่ละแห่งมีการจัดการที่แตกต่างกัน เราขอแนะนำให้คุณติดต่อทีมงานศูนย์ในพื้นที่หากมีข้อสงสัยหรือข้อเสนอแนะ เราหวังว่าคุณจะมาเยี่ยมเราอีกครั้งในเร็ว ๆ นี้

There are coffee shops, grocery stores, and food stalls nearby, so there's plenty of food to eat. There seems to be some parking available, but I'm not sure if there's parking inside the building itself.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: สวัสดี Newkie Keemono ขอขอบคุณที่สละเวลาเขียนรีวิวให้เรา เราหวังว่าคุณจะมาเยี่ยมเราอีกครั้งในเร็ว ๆ นี้ ขอบคุณ.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: สวัสดี  ขอบคุณมากที่สละเวลาเขียนรีวิวดีๆ ให้เรา หวังว่าคุณจะกลับมาเยี่ยมชมเราอีกครั้งในเร็วๆ นี้

reviews.textTranslated: The building is clean and has free parking. It's easy to get in and out. There's a coffee shop inside the building, and food is available outside. Very convenient.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: สวัสดี ขอบคุณมากที่สละเวลาเขียนรีวิวนี้ให้เรา และเราจะแบ่งปันความคิดเห็นของคุณเป็นการภายใน คุณยังสามารถแบ่งปันสิ่งนี้ได้โดยการเพิ่มตั๋วผ่านส่วนช่วยเหลือของบัญชีออนไลน์ของคุณ ขอบคุณ

ไม่ค่อยเหมาะกับการมาทำงาน
