The entrance is through a row of shophouses located in a residential area.
It's not very convenient for commuting to work.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณที่แบ่งปันความคิดเห็นของคุณ เราสังเกตเห็นว่าคุณได้โพสต์ความคิดเห็นเดียวกันในหลายที่ เพื่อให้เราสามารถช่วยเหลือคุณได้อย่างถูกต้อง โปรดส่งคำขอความช่วยเหลือผ่านทางส่วนช่วยเหลือในบัญชีออนไลน์ของคุณ และทีมงานของเราจะตรวจสอบข้อกังวลของคุณโดยตรง

reviews.name: natthawat noothong
reviews.text: เป็น co-working spaces เล็กๆ แต่สงบดี ทางเข้าจะเล็กๆ แต่เข้ามาแล้วกว้างขวาง มีที่จอดรถใต้ดิน และมีคาเฟ่ one.one.one. รสชาติใช้ได้ ราคาไม่แรง
reviews.textTranslated: It's a small but quiet co-working space. The entrance is small, but once inside it's spacious. There's underground parking and a cafe called one.one.one. The coffee is decent and the prices are reasonable.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: สวัสดี  ขอบคุณมากที่สละเวลาเขียนรีวิวดีๆ ให้เรา หวังว่าคุณจะกลับมาเยี่ยมเราอีกครั้งในเร็วๆ นี้

reviews.name: Natcha sunthornvatanapong
reviews.text:
ทางลงที่จอดรถ ไม่ชัดเจนค่ะ ลงมาทุกคันจะเลี้ยวซ้าย แล้วมันจะเป็นทางตันค่ะ

แล้วรถทุกคันก็ถอยขึ้นไป แล้วค่อยลงมาใหม่ค่ะ มาเลี้ยวขวาแล้วก็จะ งง ๆ

ส่วน รปภ ยืนมองเฉยๆไม่สนใจ ไม่คิดจะแก้ ปัญหาค่ะ  ไม่โบก ไม่บอก ไม่ทำอะไร แค่มอง

เราขับลงมาก็ งง เหมือนกัน แล้ว เห็นคันอื่น ตามมา2คัน ก็ เป็นเหมือนกันค่ะ จะเลี้ยวซ้าย แล้วก็ถอยขึ้นไป งงๆ ทำไงดี ละก็เลี้ยวขวา เอะ ไปได้มั้ยนะ

-ป้ายไม่ชัดเจนค่ะ ลูกศรที่พื้น มีตัวเลี้ยวซ้ายชัดมาก เลี้ยวขวาจางๆ

-รปภ ควรปรับปรุงอย่างแรง ไม่โบก หรืออะไรทั้งสิ้น หรอว่าไม่ใช่ รปภ ไม่แน่ใจค่ะ ยืนมองเฉยๆ ค่า
reviews.textTranslated:
The parking lot entrance is unclear. Every car coming down turns left, but it's a dead end.

Then all the cars have to back up and then come down again, trying to turn right, which is confusing.

The security guard just stood there watching, uninterested, and didn't try to solve the problem. He didn't wave, didn't tell anyone, didn't do anything, just watched.

I drove down and was confused, and I saw two other cars following me experiencing the same thing. They wanted to turn left, then back up, confused about what to do. Then they tried to turn right, wondering if that was even possible.

-The sign is unclear. The arrows on the ground clearly show the left turn, but the right turn arrow is faint.

-The security guard needs serious improvement. He didn't wave or do anything at all. Or maybe he wasn't a security guard at all, I'm not sure. He just stood there watching.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: สวัสดี  ขอบคุณสำหรับความคิดเห็นของคุณ เนื่องจากที่จอดรถแต่ละแห่งมีการจัดการที่แตกต่างกัน เราขอแนะนำให้คุณติดต่อทีมงานศูนย์ในพื้นที่หากมีข้อสงสัยหรือข้อเสนอแนะ ขอบคุณ

reviews.name: Patra Nakkasem
reviews.text: สถานที่สวยงาม ห้องน้ำสะอาด หัก 1 ดาว ที่จอดรถน้อย หาของกินยาก
reviews.textTranslated: Beautiful place, clean restrooms. Minus one star for limited parking and difficulty finding food nearby.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Patra Nakkasem, ขอบคุณสำหรับรีวิวของคุณค่ะ เราดีใจที่คุณชอบสถานที่และความสะอาดของห้องน้ำ และขอขอบคุณสำหรับข้อเสนอแนะเกี่ยวกับที่จอดรถและร้านอาหารในบริเวณนี้ เราได้ส่งต่อความคิดเห็นของคุณให้ทีมที่เกี่ยวข้องแล้วค่ะ.

reviews.name: Charleepat Hutananda
reviews.text: สถานที่อบรม เปิดใหม่ หนาวมาก ไม่ค่อยมีอะไรขายรอบๆ เวลามาต้อง เตรียมอาหารมาเอง
reviews.textTranslated: The training venue is newly opened, it's very cold, and there aren't many shops around. You'll need to bring your own food.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: สวัสดี ขอขอบคุณที่สละเวลาเขียนรีวิว เราเสียใจที่ทราบว่าคุณรู้สึกเช่นนี้และได้แบ่งปันความคิดเห็นของคุณเป็นการภายใน ขอบคุณ.

reviews.name: 2024xiangbin

reviews.text: This might not look like much of a place, and space is really tiny. Yet ladies do good here. I had the best foot therapy and back massage in Bangkok so far. Scrupulous, not rushed. Surely coming back.

reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic place! Very friendly and the lady who gave me a Thai massage was really good. I was in discomfort a few times as she found some sore spots. I can highly recommended them

reviews.name: Tania Reiher
reviews.text: Finally after living here for 8 months, I have found the best massage place! I am a powerlifter and need a strong massage where they know how to concentrate on the muscles. This woman was the best ever. I believe this is also the cheapest int the area too. It’s clean and the airconditioning is set at the right temperature. Excellent!!

reviews.name: Victor Yee
reviews.text: Got the last available masseuse for a 1-hr Thai massage, who gave me a surprisingly strong massage, the way I like it. Really liked to use her elbows. Focused maybe too much on the shoulders but I'm not complaining. Great technique. Clean place. Better than I expected given the 250 baht per hour price point (area average as of Jan 2025 is 300/hr).

reviews.name: CHI MAN LAU
reviews.text:
I just finished a one-hour foot massage, and I feel significantly more relaxed.

The therapist who attended to me was an older lady whose name I didn’t catch, but her professionalism was truly commendable. At first, the pressure she applied was relatively gentle. I mentioned that I preferred a firmer touch, and she responded attentively by adjusting the intensity accordingly—without hesitation or indifference.

This massage was actually better than the ones I’ve had at some well-known chain establishments. I would definitely recommend this place to others. What’s more, the staff here don’t actively solicit tips, which is quite rare and deserves recognition. Because of the auntie's excellent service, I offered a small tip as a token of appreciation.

I have a suggestion for the shop owner: you could provide a contact method for the public, such as WhatsApp, so that tourists can reach out to you and make service reservations

reviews.name: Yap Yu Chao
reviews.text: Cheap and good value for the wonderful service. 370THB for a 90 mins full body Thai massage

reviews.name: Ashley Oh
reviews.text: Malai Massage is one of those unassuming massage shop that you thought it isn't great (coz of the ambience - just really minimalist but not sleazy) but became surprisingly awesome. My fiancé & I walked out of the shop feeling so refreshed and rejuvenated. We had an hour of foot massage for 250baht. One of the packages were really worth it. 600baht for 2.5hrs which includes thai, foot and head + shoulder. 👍👍👍👍👍

reviews.name: Rauli Virtanen
reviews.text:
I can highly recommend this place, also visited by my friends - all very satisfied.
The staff is very professional, strong ladies but not breaking your bones!😎 The manager is super polite and friendly, speaking good English. For the top quality service they should charge more, after the difficult years of Covid when the whole tourism sector was losing money.

reviews.text: Terrible, I don’t usually walk out but massage was just awful. Kept waiting for it to be better but it was so awkward. I left after 20 minutes and they charged me 200 baht for the privilege (When an hour cost 250). But I had booked 1.5 hours and I’m happy I left and went across the road to Nima. You get what you pay for, don’t go here if you want a good massage, good service or even a hole in the bed for your face.

reviews.name: Duane Marsh
reviews.text: Great foot (& leg) massage. Good range of pressures and even ended with a bit of a head, neck and arm massage. Excellent value. Will be back to try some other massages too.

reviews.name: estevonba
reviews.text: Wonderful massages at a very inexpensive price! I've been to MANY other places that charge DOUBLE (or more) and they aren't as good as this place. Definitely my go to place for massages.

reviews.name: Mike S
reviews.text:
If you're looking for a QUALITY massage, at a fair price, Malai is the place to go.

Air (at the front desk) speaks very good English, so it was easy for me to ask questions. Plus, she was available via the LINE app for scheduling.

Facility is clean, organized, and staff is friendly and welcoming.

Got a 1 hour (very deep) Thai massage the first day, and was so happy with the therapist (Lai), I went back the next day for a 2 hour Thai massage.

If I were staying longer, I'd go back without a doubt.

Overall, incredibly impressed with Malai Massage, and would 100% recommend it for anyone seeking a seriously good massage.

Side note: The day before, I went to another highly rated massage shop just down the street, and wasn't impressed, and wouldn't go back.

Malai is the place for me :)

Though I wish the pressure had been a bit firmer, Copter handled me with the utmost care. I tried to let him know that I preferred a stronger massage, but since his English was limited, I just let it go. It wasn't bad at all—I simply prefer deeper pressure, especially on my back.

The room was spacious and came with a private shower. Everything was clean, well-maintained, and comfortable, which made for a pleasant overall experience.

reviews.text: I had the body scrub and massage with TONYZ, and it was an excellent experience. His technique is very professional, and he paid great attention to detail throughout the session. The pressure was just right, and I felt completely relaxed afterward. He is also very friendly, polite, and easy to communicate with. His English is excellent, which made the whole experience smooth and comfortable. I highly recommend TONYZ if you’re visiting S’sense Massage Suan Phlu. I will definitely come back next time!

reviews.name: Ricky Au
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Kevin. At first, he seemed a bit reserved, but once we started talking, I realized he is actually very friendly and even quite cute in personality.

He can communicate well in English and also speaks a bit of Chinese, so it’s easy to have a conversation and you won’t feel bored during the session.

Most importantly, his massage skills are excellent. The pressure was just right, and he was very attentive throughout. If you need to adjust the strength, you can simply let him know and he will adjust accordingly.

He is also very detailed and precise when working on pressure points, which made the whole experience very comfortable and effective.

Highly recommended choosing Kevin — you definitely won’t regret it!
I will definitely choose him again next time I come back to Bangkok.

reviews.name: Matteo Diwa
reviews.text:
Excellent massage, genuinely one of the best I’ve had in years

I chose this place after reading through reviews carefully (including the lowest ones, which I always check). It’s clearly a mid-level spa, not a luxury destination, and that’s exactly why I decided to give it a try. I specifically booked with a male masseur after mixed experiences elsewhere, nothing against female therapists, but consistency and strength matter to me for deep work.

I was honestly a bit doubtful at first, but the massage exceeded expectations. I booked a 2-hour sport massage session and asked for firm pressure, and the therapist delivered with excellent control and awareness. The work around the hips, lower back, and legs was especially effective, areas that are often rushed or handled superficially in many places.

The massage felt intentional and professional throughout, not routine. Pressure was consistent, transitions were smooth, and the therapist clearly understood how to work the body properly rather than just following a script. I left feeling noticeably looser and more relaxed, and the effects carried into the next day.

For the price point, the quality is outstanding. This may be a mid-range spa, but the massage itself easily competes with much more expensive places I’ve been.

If you’re looking for a serious, well-executed massage after island/ outdoor activities, rather than a flashy spa experience, this place is worth your time. Look for Korn.

reviews.name: monster56
reviews.text:
I just had a wonderful experience with Lord at S’sense tonight. His massage was incredibly relaxing—the pressure was just right to help you unwind. He was very attentive as well; while massaging me, he kept asking if the pressure was okay or if anything hurt. During the two-hour session, I even got to learn about his life because we were chatting the whole time. I highly recommend “Lord.”

I also recommend the place—it’s clean, and each room has its own private shower.

I’ll definitely try to get another massage from him when I return to Bangkok Thailand.

Highly recommend, and I am already looking forward to my next appointment.

Today I had a great massage with “Pat”. This is my second time here. My first time with “Titan” is also enjoyable. Both of them are attentive and friendly, can speak English well and expert in the massage, 5 stars for both of them. I will go there again. 1hr normal oil massage for 550THB, might be higher price than the neighboring shops, but the facilities and room, the skillfulness of the masseurs made it feel worth to pay. Bonus points for the private shower inside the room and the hot tea. You can book online prior or just walk in as there are many masseurs and room.

6/3/26 I recently visited this massage shop and had a truly wonderful experience. The place itself is beautiful, luxurious, and very clean. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with a pleasant fragrance that instantly makes you feel relaxed. Everything inside, including the towels and facilities, is high quality and well maintained, which adds to the overall comfort.

My masseur, Knott, was excellent. He is very sweet, attentive, and professional. His technique is gentle yet effective, and he clearly knows exactly where to apply the right amount of pressure. The massage was so relaxing that I even fell asleep during the session.

If you’re looking for a place to truly relax and unwind, I highly recommend this massage shop. Knott provides an exceptional experience, and I will definitely be going back again. It’s a must-visit if you want a relaxing and high-quality massage. 😊

reviews.textTranslated: This is the most fun dive school, but with high safety standards. You can really go diving with complete peace of mind! The staff are incredibly caring, like family 💖. Since taking my open water course here, I've never gone diving with any other school.

reviews.name: Papawarin Makcharoen
reviews.text: คุณครูสอนสนุกเป็นกันเองสุดๆ ใจเย็นกับนักเรียนมากกก มีสอนทั้งแบบเดี่ยวและกลุ่ม แถมได้มีโอกาสไป liveaboard trip กับทางร้าน สนุกมากก ไปคนเดียว ก็ไปสนุกกับคุณครู สตาฟ และเพื่อนใหม่บนเรือได้ i luv dumdee 🥰😘
reviews.textTranslated: The teacher is super fun and friendly, and very patient with students. They offer both individual and group lessons. Plus, I got the chance to go on a liveaboard trip with the shop, which was so much fun! Even going alone, I had a great time with the teacher, staff, and new friends on the boat. I love Dumdee 🥰😘

reviews.name: Aoraere Praphawarin
reviews.text:
Dumdee is not only a scuba diving center but here, we are FAMILY.
The staffs are taking care me during the trip and after the trip ended. We share memorable moments and knowledges together. I keep coming back to dive with my beloved family again and agian. I dare you to try diving with them and if you don't impress as I said, complain them. LoL 🤣😂

ดำน้ำที่ไหนก็ไม่เหมือนที่นี่ ดำน้ำสนุกควบคู่ความปลอดภัย แถมความบันเทิงหลังไดฟ์แบบกรามค้าง  ขั้นสุดของการพักผ่อนและปล่อยจอย ร้านดำน้ำอันดับต้นๆในใจเรา 💗🤟
reviews.textTranslated:
Dumdee is not only a scuba diving center, but here, we are FAMILY.
The staff took care of me during and after the trip. We shared memorable moments and knowledge together. I keep coming back to dive with my beloved family again and again. I dare you to try diving with them, and if you're not as impressed as I said, complain to them! Lol 🤣😂

Diving anywhere else isn't quite like here. Fun and safe diving, plus post-dive entertainment that will leave you speechless. The ultimate in relaxation and letting loose. One of my top favorite dive shops 💗🤟

reviews.name: Kornchanok Siriopaskul
reviews.text: เรียนดำน้ำที่นี่ ได้ความรู้ที่แน่นแล้ว ความบันเทิงก็แน่นไม่แพ้กัน 5555555 คุณครูและพี่ๆสตาฟ น่ารักและเป็นกันเองมาก ทำให้บรรยากาศการเรียนสนุก คิดไม่ผิดเลยที่มาเรียน Dumdee 😂🤟🏻
reviews.textTranslated: Learning to scuba dive here is not only educational but also incredibly fun! The instructors and staff are lovely and friendly, making the learning atmosphere enjoyable. I definitely made the right decision to learn at Dumdee! 😂🤟🏻

reviews.name: Naruedee S
reviews.text: คุณครูสอนดี เอาใจใส่ ดูแลเริ่ดอย่างเครือญาติ เรียนตั้งแต่ OW ยัน AV จนออกทริปทั้งในประเทศ ต่างประเทศ ทริปเขามีให้เลือกมากมายหลากหลายสุดๆ ใครยังลังเลอยู่อยากให้มาลองค่ะ 😀🤿🤙🏼
reviews.textTranslated: The teachers are excellent, attentive, and provide superb care, treating you like family. They offer courses from Early Bird (OW) to Advanced Bird (AV), and even trips both domestically and internationally. They have a huge variety of trips to choose from. If you're still hesitant, I highly recommend giving it a try! 😀🤿🤙🏼

reviews.name: Prayfah Jitpanich
reviews.text: เรียนแบบสุด relax ดีมากสนุกก เอนจอยการดำน้ำสุดๆ เรียน open มา ตอนไปสอบที่ทะเล นี่เริ่ดมากนะ ของกินฉ่ำมากกก
reviews.textTranslated: Learning was super relaxing and fun! I really enjoyed diving. I took the open level course, and the exam at the sea was amazing. The food was delicious too!

reviews.name: Neighborfoot Family
reviews.text: ไปเรียนกับดัมมีมา คุณครูน่ารักมากครับ จะชวนกินเหล้าอย่างเดียวเลย หยอกก ทฤษฎีปึ๊ก ปฏิบัติเปี๊ยะ Open Water ก็แค่เนี้ยเอง🤙🏻
reviews.textTranslated: I went to a training session with a dummy. The instructor was very nice, but he kept wanting to drink alcohol! Just kidding. Solid theory, perfect practice. Open Water training is that easy! 🤙🏻

reviews.name: Phasit Pasukulpun
reviews.text: ครูโรงเรียนนี้ดูแลเอาใจใส่ดีเว่อ ประหนึ่งเป็นลูกแท้ๆของพี่ๆเค้า ประคบประหงมแทบจะอุ้มลงน้ำ ดำด้วยแล้วสบายใจ ขึ้นสุดลงให้มิด
reviews.textTranslated: The teachers at this school are incredibly attentive, as if they were their own children. They pamper and care for me, almost like they're carrying me underwater. I feel comfortable diving with them, going all the way up and down.

reviews.name: Nuttatida Karunyakorn
reviews.text: ความรู้แน่น ความสนุกก็แน่น เราอยู่กันแบบครอบครัว เป็นกันเองสบายๆ อยู่ใต้น้ำก็ปลอดภัยหายห่วง คุณครูและสต๊าฟดูแลทุกระดับประทับใจ ตกกลางคืนถ้าโชคดีอาจได้ดูโชว์พิเศษอีกด้วย! คุ้มเกิน ไม่เรียนกับที่นี่ไม่ได้ละ DumDeeที่เป็นมากกว่าร้านดำน้ำ
reviews.textTranslated: Solid knowledge, solid fun! We're like a family, friendly and relaxed. Underwater safety is guaranteed; the instructors and staff provide excellent care. If you're lucky, you might even get to see a special show at night! It's more than worth it. You can't miss out on learning here! DumDee – more than just a dive shop.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: อ่ะชัวร์

reviews.name: Cynthia CK
reviews.text: สนุกค่ะ บ้าพลังมาก ทั้งครูทั้งนักเรียน
reviews.textTranslated: It's fun. Very energetic. Both teachers and students.

reviews.name: GE xMH
reviews.text: คุณครูน่ารัก เป็นกันเอง ดูแลดีประดุจญาติ มีทริปให้เลือกมากมายทั้งไทยและต่างประเทศ อุปกรณ์ดำน้ำก็มีให้เลือกให้ลองจับจองมากมาย ครบจบที่ดำดี 😁
reviews.textTranslated: The instructors are lovely, friendly, and take good care of you like family. There are many trips to choose from, both within Thailand and abroad. They also have a wide selection of diving equipment to choose from and try out. Everything you need is here at Ding Dee! 😁
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ชอบตงครูน่ารักนี่แล่ะ

reviews.name: chat tarin
reviews.text: คุณครูใส่ใจนักเรียนมากๆครับ เจอกันครั้งแรกเหมือนญาติผู้ใหญ่ที่รู้จักกันมานานแล้ว เอนจอยมากๆครับ
reviews.textTranslated: The teacher is very attentive to the students. Meeting them for the first time was like meeting old relatives I've known for a long time. I enjoyed it very much.

title: Chokamorn Muay Thai Gym
address: PJ37+VV, Khwaeng Bang Chak, Khet Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

reviews.name: William Robinson
reviews.text:
The gym is fantastic. The trainers are all honest and care a lot about everyone that comes in the gym. They’re a mix of ex professionals as well as current professional fighters who are still actively fighting.

It’s been a joy to train with the a mix of abilities from beginners to professionals. There are people who come to the gym from all around the world and it’s been a great way to meet new friends in Bangkok whilst getting in incredible shape.

It’s also amazing to watch the team that you train with compete and fight in professional events.

reviews.name: shujun wu
reviews.text: I spends deux months here, it’s my best experience in Bangkok! Coach is very professional and hard working. From a beginner, I got lot of progress! ! Thanks for them, I can enjoy good moments here!

reviews.name: bella c
reviews.text: Great gym, staff very friendly, not expensive and not a lot of people even group class. I enjoy training here. Also around Gym have many restaurant and 7-Eleven. Highly recommend

reviews.name: LS Keys
reviews.text: Amazing local Muay Thai gym in On Nut! Local community feel and highly experienced trainers who can cater the session to your personal needs (more fitness focussed or technique focussed - just let them know at the beginning of the class). International customers from thailand, europe, china etc. Affordable prices and great availability of classes 🥊💪🏽

reviews.name: Fabrizio Biagioni
reviews.text: Good gym, love the trainers, very professionals and friendly, been training with them for several Months and I can definitely say this is one of the best Muay Thai gym in Bangkok

reviews.name: Thomas (PETIT-ROUX)
reviews.text: Super coaching session, super team, bon sparring partner

reviews.name: Miguel García Lores
reviews.text: Amazing gym and people. Enjoying real Muay Thai experience 😍

reviews.name: Paul H Park
reviews.text: Today, I was trained by four trainers with distinct strengths and care. I feel truly fortunate to be part of this gym in my rehabilitation journey.

reviews.name: kornwika Sunny
reviews.text: very good Thai boxing gym close to Bang-chak Bts

reviews.name: Stuart Nombluez
reviews.text: Good trainers, reasonably priced and friendly atmosphere. Recommended for beginner - intermediate!

reviews.name: Alex Fettner
reviews.text: Great and friendly gym. real thai gym experience run by champion fighters.

reviews.name: nammon sittibud
reviews.text: Great training place for boxing!

reviews.name: Suthawan PRUKUMPAI
reviews.text: Great place, good trainers :)

reviews.name: Maya Mallinckrodt
reviews.text: Great trainers!

reviews.name: Elijah Halliday
reviews.text:
Great gym with fantastic trainers and excellent pad holding. Ideal for both fighters and beginners. The coaches are extremely knowledgeable, and the overall atmosphere is much warmer and more welcoming than other gyms I’ve visited in Bangkok.

10/10. Thank you for the great training!

reviews.name: LP. C
reviews.text: ยิมสอนมวยไทยที่ได้รับการรับรองมาตราฐานจาก กกท. เจ้าของเป็นอดีตนักชกหญิงทีมชาติไทย ประวัติการสอนมวยมาหลายประเทศ แนะนำใครสนใจการชกมวยหรือต้องการออกกำลังกายโดยการฝึกซ้อมมวยมาได้เลย ราคามิตรภาพ เทรนเนอร์สอนดีทุกคน
reviews.textTranslated: This Muay Thai gym is certified by the Sports Authority of Thailand (SAT). The owner is a former Thai national female boxer with experience teaching Muay Thai in several countries. I recommend it to anyone interested in boxing or wanting to exercise through Muay Thai training. The prices are reasonable, and all the trainers are excellent.

reviews.name: natsucah tapthai
reviews.text:
It’s a warm and family-like gym where coaches and fellow trainees are all very friendly. The instructors teach and give great guidance. There are many programs available, from monthly packages to class bundles. Highly recommended for beginners with no prior experience, as well as for professionals training for competitions.

Personally, I joined for fitness and health. Each session includes stretching, 5–6 rounds of boxing, followed by weight training. It’s an all-in-one workout covering both cardio and strength. Totally recommend! The prices are also very friendly and affordable.

เป็นยิมที่อบอุ่นเหมือนครอบครัว ครูและนักเรียนทุกคนเป็นกันเอง สอนและให้คำแนะนำอย่างดี มีหลายโปรแกรม ทั้งหลายเดือน หลายครั้ง แนะนำสำหรับมือใหม่ ที่ไม่เคยมีประสบการณ์ ตลอดจนมืออาชีพ ที่ตั้งใจฝึกซ้อมลงแข่ง สำหรับเรามาเพื่อออกกำลังกายสุขภาพและฟิตหุ่น มีการยืดเส้น และต่อยมวยเป็นset 5-6set ต่อด้วยการเวทเทรนนิ่ง ทีเดียวครบจบทั้งคาดิโอ และเวท แนะนำนะคะ ราคามิตรภาพจับต้องได้

reviews.name: Selim Lebbady
reviews.text: Si quieres practicar muay thai y conocer a gente genial, este es tu gym. Las clases son divertidas y dinámicas, con buenos profesores y gente de todas partes del mundo.
reviews.textTranslated: If you want to practice Muay Thai and meet great people, this is the gym for you. The classes are fun and dynamic, with excellent instructors and people from all over the world.

reviews.name: Adriana Cortés Jiménez
reviews.text: Mi gimnasio de Muay thai de confianza. Profesores muy majos y muy buenos. Yo empecé desde cero hace unos meses y ahora ya llevo más de 30 clases. Muy buen deporte. Sudas mucho y trabajas duro💪.
reviews.textTranslated: My go-to Muay Thai gym. The instructors are really nice and very good. I started from scratch a few months ago and now I've already had over 30 classes. It's a great sport. You sweat a lot and work hard 💪.

reviews.name: Horizon
reviews.text:
✅ ครูฝึกมืออาชีพ ใส่ใจท่าทาง แก้จุดผิดให้ตลอด
✅ ได้ออกกำลังกายเต็มที่ เหงื่อออกแบบสุดๆ สนุกมาก
✅ สถานที่สะอาด บรรยากาศเป็นกันเอง

ใครกำลังมองหาที่เรียนมวยไทยดี ๆ แนะนำที่นี่เลยครับ! 💯
reviews.textTranslated:
✅ Professional instructors who pay attention to form and correct any mistakes.
✅ Get a full-body workout, sweat profusely, and have a lot of fun.
✅ Clean place with a friendly atmosphere.

If you're looking for a great Muay Thai training place, I highly recommend this one! 💯

title: Thai Homecooking
ownerDescription: Prepare and cook your favorite Thai dishes from a selection of more than 100 family recipes. I have been teaching Thai cooking since 2004 to visitors from all over the world. You will learn how to cook my dishes from scratch using fresh ingredients, with no preservatives and no MSG.
address: 364 Sukhumvit 79 Alley, Khwaeng Phra Khanong Nuea, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

reviews.name: Mark Donnelly
reviews.text:
I had such a great morning with Kruu Angsana, we met at the BTS Station at On Nut and we spoke about the dishes I'd like to learn, then we went to the local market which was my first experience of a Bangkok market and got all the produce and while going around she talked about the market and pointed out differences between herbs and what to use and not use. We went back to her house and got ourselves set up and started prep work, she explained what went with every dish and how to prepare it properly. Making up the curry paste from scratch, it was a fun experience and well worth it! It went beyond following a receipe. She taught me how to cook and engage with the cooking methods.The end product was so good!! Aroi Mak.
Before my partner and I leave Bangkok we're planning on returning once more for another lesson🙂
Duck in Red Curry
Chicken Massaman
Drunken noodles

reviews.name: Melody Fu
reviews.text: Great food, super nice and competent teacher, and nice place! The teacher speaks perfect English and she actually gets all her recipes from her mom ( who was a food vendor) and her grandma. Super attentive, super friendly and even has a cat. And the ingredients she use are all fresh and of good quality. Some of her ingredients like lime and eggs are from her own farm ! She also sends you the recipes after the class. Will 100% go back when I'm back in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the kind review Melody😊 Next time when we do a crab dish I will make sure to get the crab meat for you 😂

reviews.name: Rob McCarter
reviews.text: Fantastic cooking class! Angsana is friendly, welcoming, and a really great teacher. She insists on making everything from scratch (no store bought curry paste here!), and she explained every step of the process, from how to select the best ingredients at the market all the way through to how to plate each dish. I learned a lot and had a ton of fun. I would recommended her class to anyone who is interested in learning how to cook authentic Thai food.

reviews.name: Chris Wright
reviews.text: A wonderful experience as part of our Thailand holiday January 2026. Angsana offers a good selection of authentic Thai recipies to cook from scratch at her home in Bangkok. If you want to, you can even arrange to go to the local market with Angsana to get the ingredients! Angsana has a family history that includes successful street market food. She speaks fluent English and offered invaluable advice on how to vary the recipies we chose. Also on ingredient substitutions with UK availability.

reviews.name: Budi Widjaja
reviews.text: I took cooking class with Angsana based on the reviews from people who have taken her class before. I am very pleased with the experience of learning to cook Thai dish the right way with Angsana. Not only did she teach me the right ingredients that goes into the dishes  I chose , But she also taught me step by step how to cut, slice, pound, fry  the ingredients which in the end will bring out the best flavor in the dishes I chose.  Angsana is also very detail oriented in supervising your work, if your pounding is not granular enough she will ask you to keep pounding until it is perfectly refined, so that the aroma and flavor will come out when you fry them.  I took up 2 sessions with Angsana, and among the dishes I chose were Tod Mun Pla, Tod Mun Kung, Pla sam Rod, Chicken with Basil, Cashew Chicken, Pad See euw, Grilled Beef....All were exceptionally high quality taste, high end fine dining restaurant material, especially the Pla Sam Rod , her 3 flavors fish stands out better than any other restaurants I have been to. I finish up 1 whole grouper fish we made together by myself !!!. Angsana is very generous in passing all her knowledge without reservations.  If you are really serious about Thai cooking, and intend to deliver the best home cook meals for your family/friends I highly recommend taking Angsana class.

reviews.name: Jason Kay
reviews.text: Taking this class is an incredible way to spend an afternoon in Bangkok. There were so many dish options to choose from and my favorite entrees were on the list! The ingredients were super fresh, the kitchen and prep areas were very clean, and I was welcomed into Angsana's home as though I were a family member. More than just learning a recipe, you learn all aspects of the cooking process like how to properly slice the meat and vegetables for the dish, what each ingredient and sauce brings to the overall flavor,  and how to slightly vary a recipe for your liking. I cannot wait to do this again! ! !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I am happy that you enjoyed the lesson and felt at home. Please feel free to ask me any questions. Hope to see you again.

reviews.name: shilpi banerjee
reviews.text: We were looking for a private class to learn the Thai dishes we have come to enjoy and reached out to Angsana. She really took us from the basics and we more or less cooked each dish ourselves. She is an excellent teacher and the dishes really turned out very well and delicious! And they turned out very doable too!

reviews.name: Ed Hendel
reviews.text:
We had such a wonderful time! I have taken multiple private cooking classes in Bangkok and this is by far the best one. Angsana is extremely friendly and I really feel like I learned how to make these dishes well enough that I can do it on my own (in contrast, other private classes pre-prepared most of the ingredients and you basically just put it in the pan and stir, learning nothing).

Angsana started by taking us to the local wet market and buying fresh ingredients for all of the dishes we wanted to make, which was really fun. Then we prepared everything from scratch at a nice pace where there was plenty of time to absorb everything and ask questions (Angsana speaks great English and has lots of interesting cooking-related stories and lessons to share).

Then came the best part--eating what we made! It was unbelievably good. Better than restaurant quality. I've had Thai fried rice from dozens and dozens of restaurants across America and Bangkok, and this was the best I've ever tasted. We also made pad see ew, green curry, peanut sauce, and mango sticky rice, and it was all fantastically delicious--equal or better than what you can get at any Thai restaurant I've tried. Angsana sends you the recipes as a guide and I am so excited to try cooking them on my own back home. (Note: On the website it says you can pick 3 dishes, but she let us add the peanut sauce and mango sticky rice for 500 baht each--totally worth it!)

This was a lovely date activity, a great learning experience, and a delicious meal all in one :) You should definitely try it!

reviews.name: Kelsey Logan
reviews.text: Angsana's cooking class was fantastic! When searching for cooking classes in several cities in Thailand, we were met with disappointment as most seem to only prepare a handful of dishes, like pad Thai and green curry. We wanted an experience where we could learn how to make complex (for us) local recipes, and this was it! Angsana and her mother walked us through their family recipes step by step, and Angsana was so patient with us. We cooked ho mok, gang pet linjee sot sai, and khaotom may and made our own chili paste from scratch.  Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for visiting and attending my class! I hope your family back home will like the dishes you cook and if I come to the U.S I will ask for your restaurant reccomendations in Louisiana 😊

reviews.name: kamala M
reviews.text: Angsana met us at the station and immediately put us at ease with her warm friendly personality. I had asked to be taught specific things and she obliged. The premises were spotlessly clean, the afternoon was fun and educational and the results were excellent. We were able to eat our creations and takeaway the remainder. I would 100 percent recommend and will return again soon to learn more.

reviews.name: Shira Kreizelman
reviews.text: My third time here, what a wonderful experience! Angsana is such a pleasant, smart cook, I can’t recommend a class with her enough, also don’t miss the super interesting and informative market run. Always a pleasure (:

reviews.name: Peter robey
reviews.text:
Awesome day learning to cook Thai food !
Yes the trip around the local market to buy the ingredients is amazing and eye opening! The diversity of the market is jaw dropping!
Angsana is a true professional - as soon as we got back to her house, with ease and guidance we set about our dishes. Clear guidance and instructions with explanations were delivered in lovely friendly environment.
It is a must-do if you are in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Dean Marlow
reviews.text: What a wonderful morning visiting the market and learning to cook with Angsana. From shopping for the ingredients, releasing fish for good luck and ultimately being taught to cook 3 Thai dishes we could not have been in better hands. Angsana was friendly, knowledgeable and just fun to be taught by.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Dean, thank you for coming to visit me 😊 Enjoy cooking Thai food with your friends and family. Hope the boys will cook Thai for you now 😆

reviews.name: Lynne Hempton
reviews.text: Great experience with Angsana, she is a great teacher, really knowledgeable, flexible and fun. We had a great time with her, she catered to our request to cook some less common Isaan dishes, and were lucky enough to meet and cook with her mum as well. Highly recommended for people looking for an authentic cooking experience that goes beyond the usual Pad Thai and Green Curry (although I'm sure she's great at those too!).
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the kind message😊 Hope you enjoy cooking your dishes at home

reviews.name: Allison Louise Yang Murn
reviews.text: This is honestly one of the best cooking classes I've ever taken and it was the best thing that we did in Bangkok!  By visiting the market with Angsana, we saw some of what life is like is for people living in Bangkok.  Then we cooked for a few hours, and we made the best Thai food we've ever tasted.  The private experience made it very hands on, and since we've made a lot of Thai food at home, it allowed us to not have to wait for other students in a typical cooking class.  We'll never forget the experience, and Angsana was an incredible teacher.

reviews.name: Inne Withouck
reviews.text: We had an amazing day with Khun Angsana which started off with gathering the ingredients at Onnut market and then subsequently preparing our dishes, Khun Angsana could give great advice and instruction and we received such a warm welcome and we managed to make amazing food!! Definitely 1000x recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Inne! I was very surprised and glad to see you again, can't believe you're grown now 😊 Happy to see that you still use my recipes. 
Happy cooking and happy life 😁 Hope to see you again in Thailand

reviews.name: Bart Claeys
reviews.text: My friend and I took a private Thai cooking lesson with this lovely lady. We called one day before to make a reservation and met the morning after at On Nut BTS station. After we decided what to cook we visited a local market (On Nut Market) to pick up ingredients and then headed to her house to start cooking. The session took 4 hours, and after we could enjoy our own cooked meals and take left-overs home. She emailed us the recipes of the meals we cooked. The lady lived in USA in the past and thus her English is great. The personal approach, great kitchen area and convenient location (close to BTS) made for a wonderful experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Bart,

Thank you for the nice review. I appreciate it.

Best regards,
Angsana

reviews.name: Jacob Phelps
reviews.text: I loved it. She is a very talented chef and teacher.  The class was very informative, full yet relaxed, and she hyper-flexible to our preferences and interests, even where these deviated from her usual menu.  The food was delicious.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking my class! I appreciate the kind review😊

reviews.name: Ingrid Maurer-Pedarnig
reviews.text: We had other cookingclasses before, but this day at Angsanas house was the best experience ever! We learned and laughed a lot. If you take the morning term, you will start with a walk through a small market.

reviews.name: Charlie Taylor
reviews.text: I went this week (April 2011) for 2 days and the food I learned to cook was delicious. Market trip followed by cooking at Angsana's house, very close to the market. Angsana is very friendly (and speaks fluent English), has all the recipes written up for you to take home afterwards, and the food really is delicious.

title: Rainy’s Garden Thai Cooking Class
ownerDescription:
Sawasdeeka :) Welcome to my school !
I am Rainy! I have been teaching Thai food for many years. Cooking has been my passion for as long as I can remember, and my ultimate goal is to spread joy and create unforgettable experiences for my customers. That’s why I opened this school by myself. I do half day in the morning and evening class. For my class will not make you to be a Master chef, it for people who are enjoy a day cooking and can cook Thai food at home ! SO…Let’s unlock the art of Thai cuisine with heart and leave with a FOOD BABY 😀
address: WWMV+99, Rim Nuea, Mae Rim District, Chiang Mai 50180, Thailand

reviews.name: World Travelers
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time at Rainy's cooking school.  Rainy makes it very fun and engaging.

This is a very well run operation with helpers cleaning up and preparing stuff in the background while remaining unobstrusive.

The lessons were very instructive and fun.  The food was fabulous and we ate way to the much!

The atmosphere is conviviale and Rainy took many pictures which she shared with us at the end of the evening, along with a digital cookbook!

Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for lovely review please 💕💕

reviews.name: Lauren Kellaert
reviews.text:
Rainy’s cooking class was so fun!! She is a little crazy in the best and most fun way😍 we cooked amazing dishes we chose ourselves and also got a tour through the food market.
It was such a fun way to spend the afternoon/evening, we learned a lot and laughed even more🫶🏼 the food tasted amazing.
Pickup and dropoff was also arranged which was so nice of Rainy.
Don’t skip her cooking glass when you are in Chiang Mai!!!!! It was amazing
🫶🏼
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Lauren 💕💕

reviews.name: Zoe Prince
reviews.text:
Rainy’s Garden Thai Cooking Class was the highlight of my Thailand trip so far!

From start to finish, everything was fantastic. The transport service was incredibly convenient, with pick-up from our hotel and transport back afterwards, making the whole experience completely stress-free.

The venue itself is beautiful, with fans and misting systems that kept everyone comfortable despite the Thai heat. The cooking class was very easy to follow, even for beginners, and the food we made was absolutely delicious.

What truly made this experience special was Rainy herself. She is one of the kindest, most energetic, and funniest people I have ever met. Her passion for Thai food and teaching shines through in everything she does, and she creates such a welcoming and fun atmosphere. Her team were also amazing, especially her boyfriend, “Daddy,” who added so much fun and personality to the day.

If you’re visiting Chiang Mai and looking for an authentic, memorable experience, I cannot recommend Rainy’s Garden enough. Thank you, Rainy and team, for such an unforgettable day!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review khaa 💕 Love you guys 😊🥺

reviews.name: Lottie Ball
reviews.text: We had the best time at Rainy’s cooking class. Her energy is infectious, she is just amazing! We got to select five Thai dishes to make and they were all incredible, I learnt so much! Couldn’t recommend her enough!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Kobkunkaaa 💕💕

reviews.name: Anna Summerfield
reviews.text: If you’re looking to do a cooking class in Chiang Mai make sure it is this one. Rainy is amazing, she is so funny and her energy is unmatched. The experience is amazing and has everything you want in a cooking class. I can’t recommend her enough.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Kobkunkaaa 🫶🏼

reviews.name: Simon Chou
reviews.text: Rainy’s cooking class was absolutely incredible; a serious hidden gem. Everything from the quality of food, instruction, and her team’s clean up was fantastic. The market visit was informational and gave a good look into Chiang Mai’s food scene. The energy of the class was awesome. We went with a group of four people, but also were joined by three other couples. Rainy did a great job of keeping everything social and getting the group intermingling. Energy was high and the meals were delicious. If you’re looking for a amazing cooking class experience, book with Rainy!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Simonnnnn 😎😊

reviews.name: Ewan Kilpatrick
reviews.text: We did Rainy's cooking class a couple of weeks and it was probably our highlight of our entire Thailand trip. Rainy's energy is contagious and she had everyone laughing and getting along from the outset. We got picked up on time from near our hotel in Chaing Mai, with great communication, and taken to a local food market where we were talked through much of the local produce we would be using that day. We were then taken out to the gorgeous setting for the class, set among the rice fields, and each got to make several Thai dishes selected from several options, including spring rolls, stir frys, curries, soups, and desserts. The whole setup there is extremely slick, with everything ready to go for us to crack through all the things we make in the day. We also got given a pdf of Rainy's cookbook containing everything we'd made that day and more. We were full to bursting and very happy. Can't recommend this highly enough.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I really appreciate please 🙏💕💕

reviews.name: Sally
reviews.text: This is the best cooking class! Rainy is SO funny and she makes it the best experience! My boyfriend didn’t know whether he would enjoy this experience as much but he came away saying it’s the best thing we’ve done in Charing Mai yet! Incredible, don’t miss out if you love a good laugh!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Sally x love you 💕

reviews.name: Katie Shearer
reviews.text: This has been the highlight of our Thailand trip so far - honestly this was the best fun ever. Rainy is absolutely hilarious and made the whole experience so fun and energetic. Her cooking class set up is incredibly beautiful and made the whole experience even better. I really can’t recommend this enough - please please please go to Rainys class over any other one! You will not regret it😊😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Kobkunkaaa Katie (Kiri) 😊 and Josh 🧡🫶

reviews.name: Tom (Personal)
reviews.text: What an amazing cooking class. If you’re questioning whether to book with Rainy, my partner and I highly recommend. For the price, you’re not only getting a great cooking class, but an amazing host, beautiful location, great insight into the Thai cuisine and also a really funny and joyful few hours. She makes great effort to remember everyone’s names and dietary requirements and her work ethic shows how passionate she is for her craft! Thank you Rainy for a fabulous evening. Keep thriving!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Kobkunkaaa Tommy ❤️

reviews.name: Kees Henniphof
reviews.text: Rainy runs an amazing Thai cooking school. Highly recommend. She is upbeat, funny, flexible and very well prepared. We went grocery shopping in Chiang Mai and cooked an appetizer, 3 courses and a dessert. We devoured it all. Delicious. As a bonus, we received her terrific book of recipes. Awesome!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Kobkunkaaa ~ Daddy 👨🏻

reviews.name: Karim Er-Rachdi
reviews.text:
An absolutely impeccable experience at Rainy’s Garden. Rainy is incredibly kind, passionate, knowledgeable and genuinely constructive throughout the entire class.

The experience is a wonderful way to discover Thai cuisine through high-quality ingredients, beautiful fresh produce and very generous portions. Everything feels carefully thought through, while still remaining warm, relaxed and authentic.

A truly memorable experience and one I would recommend without hesitation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: :) Thank you so so much Karim 🫶🏼

reviews.name: Erin Smith
reviews.text: Rainy’s class is the highlight of our trip so far in Thailand. She is just the best, so funny, such a good teacher and it was so organised! We can’t stop talking about it, you can make so many different kinds of food and it all tasted amazing! You can make it all vegetarian/vegan too! Thank you so much Rainy for making our time with you unforgettable❤️ Highly recommend to book here if you want a good cooking class experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊

reviews.text: This is the second time I’ve done Rainy’s cooking class and it was even better than the last. This time I brought my brother and his girlfriend and they loved everything about it. reviews.name: Ishpal Jandu
reviews.text: Had the best time cooking with Rainy! Her energy is incredible and she shares amazing insights into what can work and the details into specific ingredients. The food tasted incredible and I can't wait to make these when I get back home - this is a must do experience when in Chiang Mai!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Kobkunkaaa 🫶🌈

reviews.name: Callum Sparkes
reviews.text: Had the most fun 5 hours with Rainy and her team! Picked up from the hotel, taken round a local market, made 5 delicious courses (mainly due to the great teacher) but mostly it was so much fun because of Rainy, one of the most fun and happy people I’ve ever met! 100% recommend doing her cooking class in beautiful surroundings
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your support and happy to spend time with you guys 💕💕

reviews.name: Phatthawan Onchang
reviews.text:
Rainy had such a fun and bubbly personality!
The food preparation was well organized.

A real taste of the real Thailand, not just the food but the friendliness and joy of the people and seeing the daily life of locals beyond the typical tourist experience. Lots of laughs and delicious food to try.

All the dishes were delicious! I didn't realize I was such a good chef!
Rainy made us look good! ❤️🙏🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much ☺️

reviews.name: Breanna Vick
reviews.text: If you’re looking at cooking classes near Chang Mai you can end your search here. I did all the research for you! I looked high and low at classes for the best value and that were the most fun and Rainy’s class wins in every category 🤍 We had such a blast cooking with Rainy. The whole process was efficient and seamless and such a blast. The food was incredible. Wouldn’t change a thing!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you 😊 love youuu 🥰

reviews.name: Hannah Dalton
reviews.text:
Not only is Rainy a great chef and teacher but she is hilarious & so much fun to be around. We laughed from start to finish and had the best day with her. She also took photos throughout so it was great to get group photos doing the activity.
Definitely a highlight of our trip around Thailand.
Thank you Rainy❤️❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you 😊 Hannah 👧🏻 Love you xoxo 😘

reviews.name: Sarah Paterson
reviews.text: I cannot recommend Rainy’s cooking class enough!! Not only are the cooking and the food amazing, but Rainy makes the whole experience so much fun. She makes sure everyone in the group is included and enjoying themselves throughout. Rainy is so funny and all of her team and family working behind the scenes make it so special. I wouldn’t go to any other class, thanks Rainy💕
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your review please 🙏

reviews.name: Szilard Danko
reviews.text:
I visited this salon because from the outside it looks luxurious, attractive, and quite expensive.

However, from the very beginning, the experience felt off. Being asked to pay in advance was already a bit uncomfortable. I also clearly mentioned at the reception that I did not want a male therapist, yet my request was not respected.

Unfortunately, the massage itself was extremely disappointing. The therapist seemed completely inexperienced, with no proper technique or control. The pressure was applied in the wrong areas, making the whole experience uncomfortable rather than relaxing.

Additionally, the level of hygiene did not match what you would expect from a place presenting itself as “luxury.”

I have been in Thailand for the past two months and I get massages regularly — at least three times a week — so I am very familiar with what a proper massage should feel like. I have never experienced anything like this before. The technique was so poor that it actually caused discomfort and made parts of my body feel tense rather than relaxed.

I paid for a 2-hour session but could only tolerate around 30 minutes before I had to stop and leave. It was simply too unpleasant to continue.

In my opinion, this place is far from the image it promotes. Do not be misled by the exterior or marketing.

Nowadays, many businesses focus heavily on marketing and online image, and in some cases, positive reviews may not fully reflect the real experience — similar to what happens in the restaurant industry. I would strongly recommend paying close attention to the negative reviews, as they often provide a more realistic perspective.

It was a complete waste of time and money.

At the end of the day, what truly matters is the quality of the massage and hygiene — not appearances.

Reply

Thank you for your response.

I tried contacting you using the phone number you provided, however it does not appear to be available on WhatsApp.

Could you please provide an alternative way to contact you directly so we can resolve this matter in a professional and efficient way?

Thank you.

Lek Massage Bangkok Team

I recently reached out to A Vida on December 14, 2024, inquiring about their spa package and expressing interest in booking a slot. I replied, selecting the 10 AM time slot for December 22, and followed up on December 19 to check if my reservation had been confirmed, but I didn’t receive a response.
On December 20, I called the number listed on their website, and the person who answered was aware of my previous emails. I reiterated my preference for the 10 AM slot, but she offered 11 AM instead, which I agreed to. She mentioned she would call me back within 10 minutes to confirm my booking. Unfortunately, I never received a call or an email, even by the end of the day. I assumed at that point that my reservation wasn’t secured.
I was very disappointed with the lack of follow-up and communication throughout the booking process. Despite reaching out well in advance, I felt as though there was little effort made to accommodate me. As a result, I wasn’t able to experience the spa service, and my overall experience was frustrating due to the booking process.

The clinic was clean, calming, and felt very professional from the moment I walked in. The staff explained the whole process clearly, which really helped ease any nerves since it was my first time. My therapist K.Kate was gentle, respectful, and made sure I was comfortable throughout and also did a little massage on my tummy throughout the process.

The treatment itself wasn’t painful—just a bit unusual at first—but I started to feel lighter and less bloated afterward. Hygiene standards were reassuring, and everything looked well-maintained and sanitized.

Results-wise, I did feel cleaner internally and less sluggish, though I think consistency and diet also play a big role if you’re expecting long-term benefits.

Overall, a positive experience.

Overall I had a pleasant experience here. Highly recommended!!

title: Cookery Koh Samui
ownerDescription: Thai cooking class servicing all of Koh Samui. We can accommodate all different dietary needs. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten free, etc. We will pick you up from your hotel, option 1. We will go to the local market and enjoy learning and shopping about local foods, cook a delicious 4 course Thai meal, and then you enjoy the food you cooked. Option 2 is a cooking class without going to the local market. I am a culinary teacher and teach professional chefs in the industry how to cook Thai food. Come and join us. Message me on WhatsApp, we respond promptly.
address: 149 1, Bo Put, Amphoe Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84320, Thailand
plusCode: G26X+RP Koh Samui, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand

reviews.name: debby ruach mashiah
reviews.text:
What an amazing experience with Pai,  the best chef in Samui !
Pai is an amazing cook , uses fresh ingredients, teaching the real traditional Thai cuisine.
We spent half a day with her,chopping, tasting, cooking and eating 😋
It has been a blast 👌
The service includes transportation fron the hotel and back.
Don't miss out !
Thank you Pai for the delightful and delicious experience.

reviews.name: signe strömblad
reviews.text: I really recommend this cooking class! It is fun and Pai is the best. We got a private session and it was amazing. We got to cook red curry, paneng curry, pad thai, cashew chicken and mango sticky rice. I would do this over and over again. Thank you Pai for a wonderful experience and really good food!!

reviews.name: Matilde Juhl
reviews.text:
We had such a great time at Pai Cookery Samui! We joined the spring roll course, and it was soo educational!☺️

Pai is an amazing teacher – so warm, funny, and really good at explaining everything step by step. She made the whole experience feel relaxed and personal, and I learned so much while having fun.

The food turned out incredibly delicious, and it was so satisfying to make everything from scratch. I’d highly recommend this class to anyone visiting Koh Samui!🙏🏼

reviews.name: Ma'ayan Dagan
reviews.text: We had a cooking class with Pai today, we had a really good time. Pai is very sweet, she explains everything very nicely and the food we cooked was very tasty! We were only our family so she could pay attention to everyone.  Definitely recommended! It was a wonderful experience to wrap up our visit in Koh Samui.

reviews.name: Wendy Sams
reviews.text:
We signed up for the market tour and spring roll class. It was much more than I expected. We made Panang curry, green curry, spring rolls, oyster chicken, morning glory and mango sticky rice. It was all delicious! The market tour gave us a great sense of how locals source their ingredients.
Pro tip- make sure you have cash. She doesn’t take credit card, but she was nice enough to drive us to an ATM to get cash.

reviews.name: Melker Simonsson
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
This was an AMAZING experience and definitely something I would do again. The food tasted very authentic which I liked. It felt like food you would eat at a plastic chair restaurant iykyk. It was great fun and no prior cooking experience was required. Pai was flexible for us because we had to leave the island the day after. She picked us up at our hotel which was really nice. Her English is very good so it is easy to understand. Very sanitary and clean. I would definitely do it again if we had more time.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.name: Michelle Stalimeros
reviews.text:
My husband and I had an amazing experience at Pai's cooking class yesterday!

We opted for the Green course, and Pai was happy to tweak the menu to include our favourite dishes, so we did Pad Thai as well.
Pai picked us up from our hotel and we started the day with a visit to the local food market which was really interesting.
She explained different ingredients and how to check for quality, which will be really helpful when we are back at home looking for ingredients.

We were really pleased to discover we had Pai to ourselves!   Apparently her classes are kept small and intimate which is really great.
Pai explained all the ingredients and preparation, and where substitutes are ok and when they are not, and every step in the process.
She explained that the recipes are traditional family recipes from her family of great cooks!  She cooked her special morning glory dish for us, as well as showing us how to make mango sticky rice.

After all the cooking we ate the food and everything was sooooo delicious. I can honestly say it’s the best meal we have had the entire holiday.

Pai has given us the recipes and now I can’t wait to try them at home!  I’ll definitely be making all of them!

Thank you Pai for a really great experience!

reviews.name: Louisa
reviews.text: We had an excellent cooking school with Pai and a lot of fun. We were a group of 8 people and although it is normally only for a maximum of 7 people, an 8th gas stove was specially organized. There are 4 suggestions for the menu that you can choose from. Since we didn't want to make curry paste, we were able to put together a selection of different dishes. We had 2 vegetarians with us and it wasn't a problem at all. They had tofu instead of meat and they even replaced the oyster sauce with mushroom sauce. The organization was very good and the explanations in English were very understandable. We all had a lot of fun, had very full stomachs after the meal and learned a lot.

reviews.name: Lukas Weitzenegger
reviews.text:
A really great cooking class in Koh Samui. It’s refreshingly simple and without unnecessary extras, focusing on authentic Thai cooking and real techniques.

The class is run by a warm and passionate woman who truly enjoys sharing her knowledge and bringing people closer to genuine Thai cuisine. You feel welcome, learn a lot, and have a great overall experience. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Noam Ben-David
reviews.text:
ממליצה בחום על פאי, הסדנה איתה הייתה אחד הדברים הכי טובים שעשינו בתאילנד!
The cooking class with Pai was one of the best things we’ve done in Thailand! Pai was kind right from the start, and throughout the cooking class she explained everything in perfect English and answered all of our questions. She taught us how to make the best Pad Thai we’ve had in all of our stay in Thailand, as well and how to prepare a curry paste. She also treated us with fried morning glory and showed us how to make mango sticky rice.
All in all, I cannot recommend enough experiencing cooking with Pai!

reviews.name: Sanjana Malewar
reviews.text: Pai’s cooking class was a highlight of our trip! She was very accommodating to my partner’s nut allergy and was so knowledgeable about Thai cooking. The red and green curries were honestly the best curries we’d had all trip! Also the most reasonably priced cooking class we found in Koh Samui. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Maria Tolkacheva
reviews.text:
I went to cookery class with my friend and it was so amazing!

Our host Pai  had  everything prepared, organized and explained in a simple way. At the same time we learned to cook ourselves. And there were good tips all along. We came to cook 3-4 dishes, but ended up with cooking 6, including dessert and one more.

It is my first Thai cooking class, I enjoyed it very much, all dishes turned out to be delicious! I highly recommend Pai and her classes🧡🧡🧡

reviews.name: Renata Young
reviews.text:
We had great time with Pai!
Her recepies are fantastic! We took Massaman Curry Cooking Class & everything was delicious. Pai is very good and considerate teacher, we will be back when in Koh Samui!

reviews.name: Alison Gaynor
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our class with Pai. We went as a couple, one of whom is vegetarian and it was no problem. Everything was adapted for both of us and we learnt a lot. The food we made was delicious and overall it was a great experience.

reviews.name: Josef Struber
reviews.text:
Pai was an amazing host and chef!
She taught us many tricks and at the end we had 6 lovely dishes which we enjoyed a lot. They were all scrumptious 😋
It was just my partner and I doing the afternoon cooking class and the 3hrs went by very quickly.
We would definitely recommend doing a cooking class with Pai 😊

reviews.name: Martyna Noworyta
reviews.text: Pai’s cooking class was one to remember! We learned so much about all the ingredients we were using, she was very patient and kind and most importantly, the food was AMAZING! Pai deserves her own Michelin star ⭐️ Would 1000% recommend this to anyone visiting Ko Samui. Thank you so much Pai for the smiles and full stomachs.

reviews.name: Tal Damti
reviews.text: We had a wonderful Thai cooking class with the lovely Pai. Our group included adults and kids of various ages and dietary preferences, and Pai was simply amazing — attentive, kind, and incredibly thoughtful. She made sure everyone felt comfortable and tailored the experience to each of us. The food we cooked was rich, flavorful, and absolutely delicious. Highly recommended

reviews.name: LetsViewTheWorld LvTw
reviews.text:
Lovely experience! We booked a few weeks ago, teacher Pai came all the way to our hotel to pick us up! She goes over and beyond to make your day special.
We went to the local market, so interesting and so much to explore. Back at her place we cooked and chatted. Amazing and laid back, intimate yet informative. It was a bit stormy in Koh Samui today, this was a perfect activity given the weather was slightly off, but even if it wasn’t still well worth it!

reviews.name: Charles Slater
reviews.text: Fantastic cooking course, would 100% recommend. Pai was extremely knowledge, helpful and friendly. Under her expert guidance me and my wife cooked some amazing Thai tasty dishes and has a fun time doing so. Look forward to cooking some more when we get home!

reviews.name: Genevieve F
reviews.text: You have to book this cooking class if you’re staying on Koh Samui! Pai is an amazing chef and teacher, and we had a great time. We made three courses plus dessert, and got to pick our main courses. It was the most delicious food ever and Pai is lovely! Great value for money.

The advice and service were fantastic, thanks again to the team! Everything is clearly priced, transparent, and fair, so tourists don't have to worry about being overcharged.
Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ulysses
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience purchasing two masks here — one of which required custom prescription lenses. The staff was incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and patient throughout the entire process. They helped us choose the right masks for both scuba diving and snorkeling, and their recommendations were spot on.

What stood out the most was their thoughtful service. Instead of asking us to return to pick up the prescription mask (which took a few hours to prepare), they offered to send it to us complimentary — a gesture we deeply appreciated. That kind of care and follow-through really shows their dedication to customer service.

The pricing was fair, especially considering the quality and level of support. If you’re in Bangkok and looking for dive or snorkel gear, this place is a gem. We’ll definitely return next time we’re in town. Thank you again for taking such good care of us 🙏🏼😊
