reviews.text: One of the best Dive Shop in town. I tailored 9mm wetsuit for my Orcas Expedition trip in Norway. The wetsuit was awesome, perfectly fit. Very nice and helpful staff. A Recommend dive shop for diver.

reviews.name: Alexandre Da Fonseca
reviews.text: Everything except an outlet, great selection of freediving gears: wet suites, fins, mask and accessories. They also have the diving computers: Garmin MK2 series, Sunto. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your kind comment. We will try our best to keep what we are good at and improve what we can do better. Your words are invaluable.

reviews.name: D Z
reviews.text: I had an traumatized experience renting diving gear from this shop. Upon encountering a safety issue with the equipment, their lack of responsiveness was alarming. Despite my efforts to replace the faulty hose myself, they initially refused compensation. Their attempt to shift blame for the seal ring problem onto me was disheartening, especially considering safety should be their priority. I'm still awaiting a refund of my deposit and resolution regarding the defective gear.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are so sorry for what you got from using our malfunctioned rental regulator. You must be frightened seeing those bubbles leaked from the hose during diving. We apologise for our mistake in the maintaining our gear in good shape.

Since the beginning when we got to see the clip from your friend (sent to us during your trip), we have never denied our responsibility or refuse the compensation for it at all. You might misunderstood it when you returned the gear and did not get the refund at once because we need some time to investigate the problem. May the misunderstanding happened from the communication in English of our staff, we apologise for that. We finally refunded all of the rental fee of the whole set and paid for the hose replaced.

Regarding the problem about the seal O-ring at the connection between the pressure gauge and the hose, we knew it later after we bring the returned gear to our technician. Firstly we heard from your friend that there were 2 problems with the regulator; the broken hose and the leaked or flooded pressure gauge. So we investigated them and find that the pressure gauge was not broken at the beginning. The video clip added here showing that there are bubbles along the hose but not at the connection with the pressure gauge which means that it was not leaked or flooded at the first time. This conclusion is agreed to what we discussed with your friend about the situation. However we never mean to blame you about the changing at all because it is a consequence from our malfunctioned regulator. We also do not know who replaced it. We just want to find out what the problems are so we can find the ways to correct our mistake in our process.

What we are still unable to find out is that why the boat did not use the other easier solutions such as using the other spare set instead as liveaboard boats would usually have some on board or replacing the whole pair of hose and pressure gauge, rather than replacing only the broken hose.

Concludingly, all of these are not excuses for our mistake. Our team felt so bad with the case and we are really sad for what happened to you above and under water caused by our mistake. We learned a lot from this case and we will improve our process of maintenance and renting of our gear.

reviews.name: Maleepan Phasupong
reviews.text: Great service and helpful information. There are varieties of supplies for both scuba divers and free divers

title: KOKO MASSAGE & SPA
ownerDescription:
Come to experience professional massage and indulgent spa treatments, in a relaxing environment with luxurious facilities and private treatment rooms.

At Koko Massage & Spa, you will experience the best spa service in Bangkok. Our team will make you feel welcome and comfortable throughout your journey to a more healthy and relaxed state of being.

As well as the best therapists, at Koko Massage & Spa, you will be treated with the finest oils, creams, and scrubs, made from the finest natural ingredients, locally sourced from the best Thai suppliers, to improve your well-being.

Private rooms are available for you to be treated alone, or together with your partner or friends and family.
address: 2F, KOKO Massage & Spa Bizzo Comunity Mall, 58/1 Soi Bang Na-Trat 23, Neua, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand
street: 2F, KOKO Massage & Spa Bizzo Comunity Mall, 58/1 Soi Bang Na-Trat 23

reviews.name: Eunice Kim
reviews.text:
I’ve been wanting to go to this place, and this place doesn’t disappoint you at all.

When you arrived, they’ll let you choose which service you’d like. I chose their Signature Package A. Then, they’ll bring you to the room and make you change your clothes. After that, they’ll start their massage. The masseuse that worked on me was really strong and talented, and the oil/cream they used also smelled really nice.

I’d say, if you’re a beginner or first timer, their Signature Package A would be a good choice. I’d definitely try other packages as well.

After the massage, they’ll also give you some nice tea and mango as well!

Overall, 10/10 experience! Worth the time & money, and would definitely go there again! 🤍

reviews.name: Golanya Sirimuang
reviews.text:
I recently treated myself to a full spa ritual at Koko Massage — and it truly felt like stepping into a private sanctuary. 🤍

The experience started with an intensive body scrub, where every movement was intentional and detailed — not rushed, not superficial, but carefully exfoliating to reveal smoother, brighter skin.

Then came the mineral bath infused with milk essence.
Soaking in the warm, silky water felt incredibly indulgent — soft on the skin, calming to the senses, and deeply relaxing for the body.
The session ended with a slow, aromatic oil massage in a fully private room.

Dim lighting, peaceful atmosphere, and skilled hands that knew exactly how to release tension.
I almost drifted off completely.

For 2.5 hours of pure relaxation, refined ambiance, and attentive service, the value was honestly impressive.

reviews.name: Lydia Wang
reviews.text: Very clean place. Good service. Love the tea and mango after the massage too. The only complaint I have is that the masseur that served me wasn't very skilled in traditional Thai massage. She either put in too little strength or she went all out to use her body weight to step on me. I did 2hrs and I felt she was pretty decent on the first hour but on the second hour, the movement on the back and legs and glutes were very repetitive. She definitely needs to work on her strength control and know that some parts of the body can be pressed a little harder while others near the knee or at the neck should be pressed with less strength

reviews.name: Pawittra Suwannasorn
reviews.text: Just had the most amazing massage at Bangna Area! The staff were incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, and the place was spotlessly clean with private rooms for couples and individuals. There was plenty of parking, and it's conveniently close to the airport. I treated myself to a coconut scrub and an aroma massage, and let me tell you, my skin feels incredibly smooth, and my muscles are so relaxed! It's exactly what I needed after all the sports activities I've been doing.

reviews.name: Xuanyao Yu
reviews.text: I had a 1-hour Thai massage at Koko Massage and Spa for 400 baht, and it was excellent. We were given bottled water when we arrived, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. The therapist was skilled, with just the right pressure and stretching techniques. The spa was clean, peaceful, and relaxing. After the massage, they served fresh mango and herbal tea — a perfect way to end the session. Great value for money — I’ll definitely return

reviews.name: Rachael Mullin
reviews.text:
Just had an exceptional experience at Koko Massage near Novotel Bang Na in Bangkok. The place was clean, calm, and very welcoming. The staff were friendly and professional, and the massage was excellent. 5 star from start to finish! Highly recommend. Bella was my masseuse and she was very skilled at knowing pressure points and supporting muscle areas that needed tension relief . I will be going back in a few days and asking for Bella  as she knew exactly what I needed after a long day of walking around and with sore areas. I shall sleep well tonight! . 10 out of 10 five star treatment. Prices were very reasonable compared to Australia, and the whole experience felt relaxing and so worth it from start to finish. My husband also had a fabulous experience with Gune who was very attentive to his needs. Impressive experience for him too. He is grateful for her fabulous knowledge of the body.

Highly recommend if you’re staying in the Bang Na area or can get in a cab and experience the best Thai massage I have had possibly ever had! Thank you Bella Gune and team.

reviews.name: Kyoung Eui Choi
reviews.text:
Great place to relax reasonable price but great customer service no doubt! My body much lighter and healthier (feels like)
I will definitely be back when I visit Bangkok!
Thank you KOKO

reviews.name: Bubble Srijan
reviews.text: We follow this massage from review and because of close to our hotel where we stay. Overall nice relax and staff was nice service and not talk too much. Enjoy to relax and reasonable price. Strong massage enough,I like here.

reviews.name: Michelle
reviews.text:
Good massage place .
Many korean tourists over the weekend. . You should make reservations before you go.
But weekdays are ok to go walk in.

reviews.name: S R
reviews.text: Wan was great to me, she did a 120 min Thai massage and was strong handed until the very last minute. Thank you for your effort. Great team and ambience. 🥭🍵💆🏽‍♀️I will be back and I recommend highly! I walked out feeling like newborn.🫶

reviews.name: 이니
reviews.text:
It was a really pleasant and lovely massage!

We went there right before we go to the airport. It was so good that we could take a shower before we get on the plane at late night. Everyone was so kind there also.
Reasonable price, clean and good massage skill. Definitely will go again when i visit Bangkok again!

reviews.name: Shioka Okamoto
reviews.text: Less than 30min by taxi from the airport. I hugely recommend to someone who need relaxation after a long trip before going back to your home. I made a reservation days before via Messenger. There are menu and price list on their Facebook page, so you can see your preference. I received total three hours package G; scrub, oil massage and facial hydration massage. It was all great. They offered me cut mango + lotus tea after the treatment. They kindly arranged a taxi dropoff to the airport, which was actually cheaper than Grab… costed 240thb. Overall good hospitality. Note that the place is on 2nd floor of the building, and the entrance is within the courtyard not faced on the street.

reviews.name: dobi
reviews.text: Went here at leat 11-12 times while i was in bangkok for a month. Quality service for a fair price. Nice facility. Definitely one of the best in bangkok

reviews.name: Katarzyna Ziarko
reviews.text:
I really don’t understand why this place has such good reviews. From the start, the experience felt off. My friend and I were the only white customers there, and we were the only ones asked to pay before the massage, which already felt uncomfortable.
The atmosphere inside was strange and unpleasant. I paid for an aroma oil massage, expecting something relaxing, but it was the opposite, the masseuse pressed extremely hard the entire time, and it was simply painful. While massaging my back, she also uncovered my butt for no clear reason, which felt unnecessary and very uncomfortable.

I also didn’t put my hair up at the beginning and didn’t notice the cap. The masseuse never asked me to put it on, so I ended up with oily hair, which shouldn’t happen at a proper spa.

My friend had a similarly bad experience. She wasn’t asked for consent before the employee touched her breast area, which made her feel extremely uneasy.

Overall, this was supposed to be a SPA experience, but it felt more like a random, low-quality massage place. Definitely not worth the price

reviews.name: 앙크미
reviews.text: KOKO Massage & Spa is one of the best spa in Bangkok. Whenever I visit Bangkok, I always come here for a massage. The therapists' skills are very good. "Office Syndrome" massage course is recommended.

reviews.name: Klaudia Piskorowska
reviews.text: I had a body scrub yesterday and unfortunately it was not a pleasant experience. From the very beginning, the atmosphere felt chaotic and unprofessional. Throughout the treatment, I didn’t feel relaxed or properly taken care of. What made the experience even more uncomfortable was that at the end of the session, the masseuse did not leave the room while I was taking a shower. This lack of privacy made me feel very uneasy. On top of that, the price was far too high for the quality of the service. Overall, I left disappointed and would not recommend this place.

reviews.name: Hyung L
reviews.text: I have been living in Bangkok for over 5 years and this place is one of the best. The facility is much nicer then the price reflects. The massage therapist will tailor the massage your pleasure. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.name: Pureum Ryu
reviews.text: We choosed package C. They gave us 2 hrs service and after the massage, they gave us mango and tea. The massage skill was really good. And the people was really kind. Thank you!

reviews.name: Oscar Chee
reviews.text: Regardless of many reviews and a 4.9. This experience is just normal. And the massage is rush, come late and didn't complete a full 2 hours session. If you look details, you will notice majority of the people who leave review might be bot (their account only done less than 10 reviews).

reviews.name: Paul Benjapon
reviews.text:
Here’s a concise and natural review based on your experience:

I had an absolutely wonderful experience with both the aroma massage and facial treatment! The atmosphere was incredibly relaxing, the space was clean, and the staff were polite and highly experienced. The scents used in the aroma massage were soothing, and the facial left my skin feeling refreshed. I felt completely pampered and would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a top-notch massage and facial!

reviews.text: We ordered an expensive cabinet and chair. When I picked up the chair, it was covered in plastic. I didn't know that the plastic covering  was UNDER the frame. When I got home I couldn't remove the plastic without completely taking the chair apart, remove the plastic, and then reassemble it. title: Cooking class by Chef Chiang Mai Small House School 料理 教室 チェンマイ
ownerDescription: Cooking class Chiang Mai by a local Chef. Learn to cook Thai food or Northern Thai with authentic taste & fine ingredients in a very small group not over 4 people per class by Thai Chef. We will visit a morning fresh market together. You will be my guest at my home. Arm (Nitipong) is well trained from Thai culinary school and 5-star hotel in Chiang Mai. 日本語OK の優しく丁寧にチェンマイタイ料理教室を教えるアーム先生は料理トレーニング センターにてタイ料理を学び、５つ星ホテルにてタイ料理の修行を積みました。
address: 159/91 Anusarn Villa Soi 5 Chiangmai Hod road Chiangmai Thailand Pa Deat Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
street: 159/91 Anusarn Villa Soi 5 Chiangmai Hod road Chiangmai Thailand
plusCode: QX6G+4C Pa Daet Sub-district, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Candice Perese
reviews.text:
We had a great cooking experience with Arm (Nitipong) at Small house cooking school. The market was a fantastic discovery and Arm was very generous with his knowledge of local produce and Thai cuisine in general.
We chose Small house for it’s smaller group option and the home setting. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Marco Saliani
reviews.text:
Arm is super kind and a good good cooker. He also have us some advices and were all valid.

The cooking class is fun and you can learn not just the very popular plates, but also particular ones.

Very reccomended!!

reviews.name: Shane shaneshane
reviews.text:
Great if you want an authentic hands on small group Thai cooking class.

Started the day going to a local food market to get the ingredients, we tasted 1 or 2 items there too

Then we went to Arm (the Chef)'s home to cook.
We tried lots of local fruits and herbs 🌿

Cooking began soon after with clear instructions.
We each had our own station to prepare the food and we're shown all the steps.

Everything was effectient and the kitchen setup was professional.

We used lots of local thai ingredients and the food turned out great under the chef Arms guidedance 👨‍🍳

You can spice the food to a level of your choosing

The room is air conditioned too, so its comfortable and not too hot

Questions are encouraged and Chef Arm is very knowledgeable.

Great experience 🍜

reviews.name: Gohar Soghoyan
reviews.text:
Great cooking experience! Very authentic and unique.
The group is max 4 people so it’s very personal and immerse. Arm picked us up in our hotel and we drove to the local market for ingredients shopping. He is very nice explaining everything and answering all of our questions.
The we headed to his house to cook. We cooked 1 salad, 1 soup, 2 main dishes and a dessert.
Highly recommend this course.

reviews.name: Kateřina Marxtová
reviews.text: An absolutely incredible experience! Wherever we go now, we sing Arm's praises and do his PR for him, because this was absolutely the BEST cooking class ever. Arm was kind, patient and with a great sense of humour. He introduced us to Thai fruits, spices and methods of making the key Northern Thai dishes. We particularly enjoyed browsing through the market together, pointing out things and asking questions. It also wasn't one of the classes where you just chop ingredients and other people do the actual cooking - with Arm, we made our food from the beginning to finish, making us feel ever prouder. Just incredible. Thank you to Arm and to his assistant for the superb afternoon that we will remember forever!

reviews.name: Isil Tatlicioglu
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of joining Arm's cooking class during my Chiang Mai visit. Such a lovely experience! I was looking for a more genuine, hands-on class where I can really learn some tips and tricks about Thai cuisine, and I'm happy to have found what I want. Arm is such a nice and kind person, he explained all the dishes and gave us just enough direction during the class, and the small group (we were 4) made it feel really authentic. In total we cooked 5 dishes, the class took around 4 hours. Everything was well planned yet genuine, I can totally recommend if you're interested in joining an authentic Thai cooking class.

reviews.name: Jannika
reviews.text: I can highly recommend this cooking course! It was well thought through and felt really personal (max. of 4 people). Arm picked us up from our hotel and brought us to an authentic food market where we shopped a few items and tried some food. We then headed to his house and cooked some delicious Thai dishes and tasted local fruits and vegetables. At the end, we even got a recipe book to try replicate the meals at home. Arm is a great teacher and we enjoyed every minute of his class! Thank you so much, Arm! 🙃

reviews.name: Terence Poh
reviews.text:
Highly recommend to engage Small House for a private Thai cooking lesson!

Chef name is Arm. He will pick up/drop off from our hotel. Part of the cooking experience is a visit to a local market to buy the basic ingredients to be used for the cooking lesson. Chef will explain to us the different types of fruits, herbs, spices, meat etc at the market, and it was definitely nice interacting and seeing the local’s way of life.

When we arrived at chef's Small House for the cooking class, everything was neat, clean and
efficient. Ingredients were laid out for each session and we just had to follow the simple instructions. A recipe book was given to us at the end of the lesson. Arm was also patient and encouraging along the way.

Truely enjoyed our 3 hours in his house learning to cook simple northern thai food. Do sign up with him!

reviews.name: Laura Agnesina
reviews.text: Amazing cooking class! Arm is a great teacher and lovely person. We went to the market with him, he showed us different ingredients and made us try different types of streetfood. The cooking class then takes place in his home, a warm and welcoming place where we had an amazing time learning 6 different recipes of Thai and Northern Thai cuisine. With his assistant, the class is extremely well organized and goes very smoothly. Arm is very patient and you actually learn a lot. Everything was incredibly tasty and we will surely cook it at home again! We couldn’t recommend this class more, it’s a must-do!

reviews.name: David K
reviews.text: Had an excellent time with Arm learning about Thai food from him! He was a great host and teacher! The market trip was informative, and the selection of recipes for the private class was awesome! Highly recommend taking one of his private classes if you want to learn something more than the standard papaya salad, green curry, and mango sticky rice of the larger group classes. I had an excellent time!

reviews.name: Katrin Ulrike Hofmann
reviews.text: Great cooking experience with Arm. We really learned how to make delicious north Thailand dishes. We could ask any questions and Arm explained a lot about the food and many more interesting information. Thank you!

reviews.name: Aicha Trehet
reviews.text: A wonderful Thai cooking class with Mai, who is such an adorable and passionate person. It was a truly lovely experience, both friendly and enriching. The icing on the cake was tasting the dishes we had prepared at the end — a real moment of enjoyment! A great success from start to finish. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Mr AmiralM
reviews.text:
Amazing cooking class experience in Chiang Mai! Everything was very well organized and Arm was extremely friendly and welcoming. He explained each step clearly and made the class fun and easy to follow, even for beginners.

We learned how to cook several authentic Thai dishes using fresh ingredients, and the result was absolutely delicious. It was also a great opportunity to learn more about Thai culture and cuisine.

I highly recommend this cooking class to anyone visiting Chiang Mai. It was one of the highlights of our trip!

reviews.name: Alan Kerr
reviews.text: had a northern Thai cooking class today. I learned so much in the three hours. I was in the kitchen. We made individual courses and then sat down to eat straight away. I was stuffed, but couldn't resist finishing every dish. Arm, The instructor, is very talented and certainly knows his way around the kitchen. He was very patient and showed me lots of different techniques. Probably one of the best cooking classes I've ever done

reviews.name: Anaïs Kania
reviews.text: A huge thank you to Alice for this wonderful cooking class with friends! We learned how to make five delicious Thai dishes in a warm, fun atmosphere with great music. It was a fantastic experience, and I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Wiola Czerwinski
reviews.text: We had an amazing time! Arm took us to the market and explained all intricacies of thai ingredients, then we went to his house to cook. Very intimate experience as it’s max for 4 people, we learnt a lot and loved our time! Arm even gave us a cook book afterwards and shared many recommendations of places to see around

reviews.name: mikaela alloune
reviews.text: We had such a good time. Arm picked us up on time , we then visited a super local market and had a snack there too. Then we went to Arm’s house and he showed us all his plants and told us what is typically used in thai cuisine. We cooked a salad, pad thai, green curry, khao soi, soup and mango sticky rice. One of us was vegetarian and he was able to adapt easily. 10/10 experience!!

reviews.name: Shaun Robson
reviews.text: We were keen to do a cookery course whilst in Chiang Mai. After looking at reviews we chose Arm's Small House. This was a great choice. Arm picked us up from our hotel and we picked up another couple before visiting the city's food market. Once our shopping of fresh ingredients was done we headed back to Arm's place where we were gently guided through 5 dishes, each preparing and cooking our own food. A wonderful experience. Thank you Arm.

reviews.name: Shalini Kunahlan
reviews.text: My friends and I wanted something a little different from a cooking class in Chiang Mai and we got an amazing experience cooking traditional Lanna (northern Thai)  food with Arm, our chef teacher, for our small group of 4. The market experience in the old quarter was authentic and generous. Also loved that Arm was very environmentally conscious. 100% recommend.

reviews.name: Cédric Fromenton
reviews.text:
A perfect experience ! Delicious dishes, tasty, varied. A lot of explain to this class room.
Thanks for this good moment. I highly recommend it

title: Phuket Easy Thai Cooking
ownerDescription: Learn to cook famous Thai dishes in a relaxed and friendly kitchen for an approximately 3-4 hours. You will be taught to cook a traditional delicious Thai food and will ensure you leave prepared to create the dishes when you get home.
address: 106 25 Soi Madsayid, Tambon Rawai, เมือง Phuket 83130, Thailand
plusCode: R87P+57 Rawai, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Abz
reviews.text: I had a wonderful day here! We prepared several courses of Thai food - my favourite was the spring rolls - and had a lot of fun whilst doing it. The staff were welcoming and the AC inside was a much needed bonus!

reviews.name: Natasa Mihajlovic
reviews.text:
What a great cooking class!

We started off at the local market, picking up ingredients and learning about spices. Our cooking class consisted of four dishes. It was a lot of chopping and a fun environment. The food was so much more than what I was hoping for. My favorite dish was a green curry!

Thank you, Tick, for all the laughter and tips on how to make the best Thai food!

reviews.name: Reagan
reviews.text:
Great cooking class. We were father away than usual so Tik (the host) organised a grab for us. We cooked Green Curry, Pad Thai, Tom Yum (prawn), and mango
Sticky rice. Went on a Sunday morning and there was only another 2 people on our trip. All staff were incredible kind, welcoming and helpful. Highly recommend Tik’s tour!

reviews.name: Zombie TV
reviews.text:
Our class was on a Saturday evening and the pick-up procesw was very smooth. The ride was comfortable and  the driver was very good. we felt really safe on the ride and was very relaxed.

We met Chef Tik at the market and we were introduced to the ingredients. We enjoyed the market visit very much and managed to buy a bottle of coconut flower nectar. These are delicious!!! What we didnt buy, and later regretted was granulated coconut sugar. We thought we could find it at Big C when doing our last minute shopping but we had no such luck. Now we're back in our country and try to buy coconut sugar that suspiciously looks like palm sugar.. so 😰😰😰😰😰

Chef Tik was great at explaining the recipes to us, and i have found a new appreciation for these dishes. She also showed us a few variations to the dishes we made eg: Tom Yum Goong - how it was traditionally made, vs. how it was modified for the tourist pallete.

Our classmates were awesome and we had a lot of laughs. And one person got distracted and added a whole bowl of coconut milk to their recipe. 🤣🤣🤣🤣🤣

It was a lot of food and we couldnt finish it, so one of Chef Tik's assistant helped to pack it for us to bring back to our hotel- AMAZING SUPPER ❤️

I definitely recommend this cooking class for everyone! It is also perfect for any MICE and Teambuilding (Meetings, Incentive, Convention, Exhibition) itinerary. ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: Nour A
reviews.text:
This cooking class was a highlight in my honeymoon for my husband and I. It was a fun environment with a great, kind and humorous chef (Chef Nusret or Tiktok as she likes to be called). I loved every bit of it and appreciated that transportation, a market tour and generous portions are all part of the experience you pay for.

We made 4 dishes and we were too full by dish 2!!!! First was green curry, followed by pad Thai, Tom yum soup and finally ended with the best mango sticky rice we’ve ever had (even better than the Michelin one we had in Bangkok). Personally, the pad Thai was also my favorite I’ve ever had.

The chef is very knowledgeable and teaches you her family’s cooking tips and tricks, and you can tell all the employees love what they do and are proud of their culture.

I highly highly highly recommend this class! We got our ticket from GetYourGuide

reviews.name: Arda Yazgan
reviews.text: Amazing. Me and my mom had great time learning how to cook, learn about ingredients, herbs, vegetables. Also our cook is extremely knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Kim Potočnik
reviews.text: Very nice activity! We did a local market tour first, picked the ingredients and then the driver took us to the kitchen where we made 4 dishes from scratch. There were only 6 people so it was nice and not crowded. Our guide was very knowledgable and spoke English fluently. We got the left over food for take away. I liked mango sticky rice the best!

reviews.name: Phil Gray
reviews.text: We had a fabulous time with our Chef, Tik at Phuket Easy Thai Cooking. We started off by being picked from our hotel and meeting the chef, Tik at a local market. She showed us what to look out for and pick out the freshest ingredients for our recipes. We then go back to the kitchen and chef shows you how to prepare the dishes and cook them. Afterwards you eat what you cook. We were on a set menu of Pad Thai, Tom Yum, Chicken Green Curry and Mango Sticky Rice. What you don't eat, you take home. A fantastic half day with lots of learning, cooking and eating.

reviews.name: Luca Vitali
reviews.text:
Amaizing experience and great memories of Thai cuisine and especially of Tik.
My partner and I were curious to try a Thai cooking class and Phuket Easy Thay Cooking was the most recommended.
BEST choice ever, they sent a bolt to pick us up even if we were quite far away from the place of the cooking class and since the first moment Tik (our teacher) was friendly, funny and kind. We had a great time with her and the team and with a big surprise we cooked and ate 4 amazing Thai dishes (it was a lot of food that we took home for dinner)
ABSOLUTELY RECOMMENDED!
BELLISSIMO 🤌🏼🇮🇹
Luca and Sara

reviews.name: Ventseslava Uzunova
reviews.text: Cooking with Tik was a great experience. Not only did we have fun with her excellent sense of humour, but we cooked delicious food which we could taste right away and take home. Everything was organized professionally and even the small kids loved it. The walk around the market is a must.

reviews.name: Anouk van de Kerkhof
reviews.text: Nice experience! Together you go to the market to get fresh ingredients and step by step you cook a couple of typical Thai dishes. It all tasted really good, especially the mango sticky rice was the best I’ve ever tasted. Will definitely try to make this at home :)

reviews.name: Chloe Einchcomb
reviews.text:
We had a really good time at this traditional Thai cooking class! It was really informative and you got to see all the ingredients etc! The best mango sticky rice I’ve ever had!
They also got candles for my Mums birthday which was such a lovely touch.

reviews.name: Luis Guardia
reviews.text: Everything is far, but transportation was included and it was good. Had the oopportunity to go to the market with Mrs. Tik  and watched her selects the ingredients we wwould use on the class. She has a great sense of humor and iimpressive knowledge of English. Cooking was easy to follow even for a person with no experience.  She was patiently coaching the 10 students, and the fact that we achieved almost identical results is a testament to her abilities. Highly recommended introduction to Thai cooking. Also, we received easy to follow recipes to try at home.

reviews.name: Marcos Caceres
reviews.text:
Amazing chef, full of knowledge, and a great way to spend an afternoon.

Had a wonderful afternoon cooking with Karn. Going to the market to pick out the ingredients for the dishes was a great experience. Cooked three wonderful dishes, including possibly the best green curry I’ve ever had!

Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Anthony Gibney
reviews.text: I learned so much and can't wait to make these recipes for my family back home. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Kim Shepherd
reviews.text: We had such a fun time. Perfect set up for our group of nine. The menu was varied and we cooked 3 wonderful dishes followed by a delicious dessert that we took home because we were so full! Karn and her helpers were so efficient and patient and everything went so smoothly! Best chicken pad Thai any of us had ever eaten. A big thumbs up from us and a wonderful way to experience a taste of Phuket.

reviews.name: C Y
reviews.text:
My wife and I took this class while on our honeymoon. We both do quite a bit of cooking at home, but this was our first formal cooking class.

We arranged for pick up at a fee below the Grab/taxi rates. All of the supplies were included with the tuition. The class started with a tour of a local open air market. The class was quite small (3), so we had ample one-on-one instructions. Our instructor was immediately available whenever we needed her. She provided great insights in to finding the ingredients, substitutes, and of course the prep/cooking process. We prepared a 3 course meal that was easy, delicious and authentic.

As with many human services in Thailand the value was so tremendous that you feel a bit guilty for how inexpensive it is. We have a large debt of gratitude for Phuket Easy Thai Cooking, and recommend it to anyone looking to keep their Thai vacation going back at home.

reviews.name: Dalton G
reviews.text: This class is amazing! Karn, the chef, catered our menu so it would be vegetarian. To start, she picked us up from our hotel and took us to a local market where we bought fresh produce. Then we picked up some fresh coconut milk for her local source who showed us how it was made. After that, we went back to her kitchen where we learned to cook Pad Thai, Massamun Curry, Thom Kha Soup and Mango Sticky Rice. She even gave us the recipes. Karen’s English is solid and she is obviously a very skilled chef. It was a real pleasure to learn from her. I highly recommend this class if you want an intimate course in classic Thai cooking.

reviews.name: Laura
reviews.text:
We enjoyed the cooking class that much…. On top we learned how to cook the best pad thai ever ❤️
So tasty ….  Gan is very nice and funny, she speaks very well English and you will learn a lot. The pick up and transport from our hotel worked very well.
I will come back and learn all the other dishes

reviews.name: Koen van der List
reviews.text:
I had an amazing morning with karn. At the moment it is a bit more quiet with the cooking classes, so I had a private class! First, we went to the local market to buy some veggies and meat which is a nice experience. After, we cooked the food and karn explained passionately her way of cooking and the ingredients (of which she is growing some in her own garden)

It was a lot of fun and we laughed a lot together.

Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Addison Chung

reviews.name: Chris Chin
reviews.text:
TT Paradise Thai Ari is an absolute gem. The massage was outstanding—one of the best I’ve had—and offered at a very reasonable price. The spa itself is beautifully decorated, creating a comfortable and relaxing atmosphere from the moment you walk in.

A special touch was the delicious coconut pudding served at the end of the treatment, which was the perfect way to finish an already wonderful experience.

The customer service was exceptional from both my therapist and the owner. Everyone was warm, attentive, and genuinely focused on making sure I had a great experience.

I highly recommend TT Paradise Thai Ari to anyone looking for a quality massage in Bangkok. I will definitely be returning every time I’m in Bangkok.

I felt incredible and relaxed after the massage. I do want to provide a pro tip and that is to communicate with your masseuse on your comfort level beforehand, please don’t be shy or passive about anything because it would a disservice to the masseuses when you are uncomfortable about something, but afraid to speak up! I will definitely come back! reviews.name: TRVL_888
reviews.text:
At Ekkamai BTS station

.:.Chat.G.P.T.:.

Wat That Thong (วัดธาตุทอง) is one of the most well-known temples in the Ekkamai area of Bangkok, right next to Ekkamai BTS Station (Sukhumvit Line).

Here are some key details about it:
•	Location: Sukhumvit Road, directly across from Gateway Ekkamai mall. Extremely convenient to reach by BTS (Ekkamai Station, Exit 2).
•	History: The temple was built in 1930s by merging two older temples from the area. It has served as an important religious site for locals living along Sukhumvit Road.
•	Architecture: Classic Thai Buddhist style with a golden stupa and large ordination hall.
•	Role in the community:
•	Popular for funeral ceremonies and memorial services, especially for middle-class Bangkokians.
•	Hosts merit-making ceremonies on Buddhist holidays.
•	Often visited by locals rather than tourists, so it feels more authentic compared to heavily touristic temples like Wat Pho or Wat Arun.
•	Atmosphere: Despite being right in the busy Sukhumvit/Ekkamai area, the temple grounds are calm and peaceful, offering a quiet escape from the city noise.

reviews.name: kruboo chan
reviews.text:
Wat That Thong [ pronounced as Wat Tard Thong ] is open every day and allow locals and tourists alike to pray, light incense sticks, and give donations. You are free to walk around the grounds and go inside the temple, but you will be required to wear appropriate clothing (no vests, skirts, or shorts).
The best time to visit this temple is during major Buddhist holidays such as Songkran, where they hold fun fares for as long as two weeks which involves carnival style games for the children, shows, and lots of delicious Thai food.

How to get there
(BTS), get off at Ekkamai BTS and take exit 3.

reviews.name: Joseph O'Connor
reviews.text:
Beautiful property, but the service falls far short of what you expect from Park Hyatt.

The hotel itself is very well designed and visually impressive, and the room layout is nice. Unfortunately, that is where the positives end. From check in onward, the overall experience was disappointing.

There was no introduction to the hotel, no explanation of restaurants, amenities, or even basic room features. That lack of communication created confusion throughout the stay.

The room had multiple comfort issues. The pillows were extremely thin, and the replacements were uncomfortably hard. The bed is very firm. The air conditioning takes hours to cool the room, and the bathroom has no ventilation, so heat and humidity build up quickly. After a terrible night of sleep in a hot room, I tried to take an afternoon nap, and even with do not disturb on, the front desk decided to call my room for no clear reason. On my first night, the hot water in the shower also ran out completely.

Food and beverage experiences were also poor. Room service quality was low, with poorly prepared fruit and pricing that did not match the quality. At the Thai restaurant, service timing was completely off. The main course was served immediately after the appetizer was delivered, before I had even started eating it. At the same time, the atmosphere was disruptive, with children running around the restaurant and no staff addressing it.

This lack of oversight continued in other areas like the gym, where children were playing on equipment without any intervention. At the pool, I was completely ignored for an hour with no offer of service, not even water or a towel.

Overall, it felt less like a luxury hotel and more like a very expensive daycare with inconsistent service and little attention to detail. For the price point, the experience was nowhere near acceptable and ended up being the worst service I have had in Bangkok
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Joseph O'Connor,

Thank you for your feedback regarding your recent stay at Park Hyatt Bangkok. We regret that your experience did not meet the standards expected of our brand, particularly in relation to service consistency, room comfort, and food and beverage execution.

Please accept our sincere apologies for the shortcomings you encountered. Your comments have been escalated to the relevant department heads for immediate review and corrective action.

We appreciate your time in bringing these matters to our attention.

Sincerely,

Park Hyatt Bangkok

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: The room was nice and clean. We love the pool of the hotel. It has lots of green and trees by the pool area which makes it likes an urban oasis. Also, I caught a cold and I was sick during my stay. Front Office Manager was very helpful and helped me to make doctor appointment at a nearby international hospital. Nadia was also very kind to send to our room some cookies and tea. We also had dinner at the hotel’s Italian restaurant. The food and the service was good.

reviews.name: ARTYOS
reviews.text:
I honestly lost count of how many times I’ve stayed at Park Hyatt Bangkok already because I never really wrote Google reviews before. But this time I decided to do one properly since I booked to a suite and wanted to share some photos for people thinking about staying here.

The room was beautiful, spacious, and very comfortable. The atmosphere throughout the hotel still feels calm and luxurious every time I come back. Service was excellent from the moment I checked in — staff were welcoming, professional, and very attentive.

The gym was also surprisingly good with modern equipment and a great city view while working out. I also really liked the spa and wellness area available for in-house guests. It made the stay even more relaxing.

Overall, still one of my favorite hotels in Bangkok and definitely a place I keep coming back to.

reviews.name: AzzzK
reviews.text: 2 Nights Deluxe Room||I was aware there was a planned electrical test on the day I arrived but it was managed professionally and dutifully.||The hotel aesthetics are well documented and made for an enjoyable time. Not flash or garish just beautiful. Grateful to Boost for her care and attention when checking me in. Wonderful room : clean, well-spaced and luxurious ( as expected )||In-room dining fell short of expectations : the mutton masala was okay but the naan was stodgy and like it was prepackaged and microwaved. The Basmati rice was sticky, yellow and short grain. No poppadoms or chutney. ||The Pool is very comfortable and great to relax. Entry via the restaurant which was strange.

reviews.name: Elan Adler
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, very modern and in a great location. The suite had all electronic controls to close window shades and adjust lighting and more. Separate from the quality, the hospitality is super immature… first upon arrival they told me I would not be able to get my room until 5-6pm (check in is 3pm the latest) and had to fight with them to get the regular check in time. They treated me as a novice tourist traveler that they could take advantage of before showing teeth with explanation that it was unacceptable for a 2 Michelin key hotel. After ordering room service, they removed the food from our room when we stepped out and didn’t get the chance to finish it. They entered the room to deliver stuff at one point without knocking which could have been bad but luckily no one was changing. So great facilities, pretty below average service even though they’re trying. I can’t fault them too much. Would recommend staying here still.

reviews.name: Jaime Lee
reviews.text:
We came to Thailand to celebrate my fiancés 30th birthday. Having stayed at Hyatt regency koh samui the week before, we had really high expectations for Park Hyatt being in a higher category.

When we arrived, we were greeted warmly by the staff, check in process was easy and quick with Pauline. She was absolutely amazing, wishing my fiance a happy birthday. We arrived really early around 10am so our room wasn’t ready yet, but we chilled by the pool while waited. Pauline then personally came to the pool to let us know our room is ready around noon and gave us the key cards. Throughout our stay, everytime we see Pauline she greeted us warmly and have had friendly conversations - really made an impact on our experience and happy to have someone speaking Cantonese with me - great to see the staff is so diverse here. (If GM is reading this, please give her a raise 😂)

We stayed in a suite and the space and design were great. Soundproofing was good so we had a lot of privacy. There’s a construction site across from the hotel, but it’s not built up yet so not really obstructing the views. The bed was so comfortable, we slept extremely well. The Le Labo amenities were a nice touch!

The breakfast was amazing, I loved that we can order à la carte options so food is made to order for us. The buffet options are great too, it felt like quality over quantity. We also ordered room service and the service was fabulous, food was good, I don’t think it was crazy overpriced.

We were supposed to do the johnnie walker blue label masterclass but sadly couldn’t due to fiancé not feeling well. However, I’m happy to say that we will do this next time becuase we will definitely come back to Park Hyatt whenever we’re in Bangkok again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jaime Lee,

Thank you for taking the time to share your wonderful feedback following your recent stay with us at Park Hyatt Bangkok.

We are delighted to hear that you chose to celebrate such a special occasion with us and that your overall experience was memorable. Your kind comments regarding our accommodations, breakfast offerings, room service, and overall hospitality are truly appreciated. We are very proud to have team members like Pauline who consistently create genuine and personalized experiences for our guests. We will be sure to share your compliments with her and the rest of the team.

It was our pleasure to host you both, and we are thrilled to know you plan to return on your future visits to Bangkok. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

Warm regards,

Park Hyatt Bangkok

reviews.name: HarryC208
reviews.text: Park Hyatt done it again with a near flawless hotel, located next to a very handy luxury mall (try Eathai for great local food), in a beautiful modern building. Rooms are great with an awesome bath. Gym us first class, an iconic pool, delicious food for breakfast/room service and I had an amazing steak in the penthouse. Recommended for Bangkok!

reviews.name: B3735ACrl
reviews.text: The staff was absolutely fantastic at this hotel.  I found the restaurant staff to be EXCEPTIONAL!  I noticed that the room was fading a little for maintenance.  However, I believe that service tended to overshadow the mildly aged look of the room.  I would recommend this hotel for those who want to stay close to the airport (<1-kilometer), and who want to work or get smoothly to their next flights.  When you arrive in Bangkok, Exit thru door 4 on the street level and the Hyatt Shuttles are immediately outside ready for use.

reviews.name: Alex De Bruyne
reviews.text:
It's a beautiful design hotel that really shines with the public spaces. The lobby and stairs that flow into the main restaurant with pools, fountains, and statues are all gorgeous and refined. There was frequent live music and crafts.

The rooms actually felt quite standard to me. Perhaps I've stayed in too many other Park Hyatts but I would say the rooms are probably the least interesting or impressive in the region. The design is nice but similar to other places I've stayed in Bangkok. The only notable quirk was that the toilet was completely separate from the rest of the bathroom which kept confusing me.

The service was imperfect. The globalist treatment fell under the bare minimum of "acceptable" with almost zero points of additional note. There was a weird situation at breakfast where they gave me the wrong menu... I also have to call out that I experienced a couple minor issues with the concierge service. I had two very finite requests for restaurant reservations that both experienced some degree of issue which I had to go about resolving myself.

Overall, it was a generally good stay but I am honestly confused how this property managed to get 2 Michelin keys. It certainly wasn't my favorite stay in Bangkok nor anywhere close to my favorite Park Hyatt property.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We are pleased to hear that you generally enjoyed your stay and appreciated the hotel’s atmosphere and design. At the same time, we sincerely regret that several aspects of your experience did not fully meet your expectations, particularly regarding service and certain arrangements during your stay. Your comments have been shared with the relevant teams as we continuously work to improve the guest experience. We truly value your feedback and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future for a more seamless and memorable stay at Park Hyatt Bangkok.

Regards,

Park Hyatt Bangkok

reviews.text: Great hotel. I loved the room, the amenities and the people who work here and who did everything in their power to make our stay perfect. A special shoutout to Balloon, he was amazing and took great care of my spouse and I every time we went downstairs for breakfast!

reviews.name: Jerry Chang (Proxman)
reviews.text:
This time, I finally experienced why this hotel is often recommended by various inferencer as one of the top three excellent hotels in Bangkok.

This is really a great hotel. Whether it's a leisure vacation or a business activity, crazy luxury goods procurement is perfect.

Front desk receptionist ，Mr.SPRITZ, is very friendly ,helpful and polite.He personally took us to the elevator which touched us very much, and the cleanliness and beauty of the room also amazed us. Be sure to arrange time to go to the swimming pool. The facilities and scenery are really great.

The hotel is in an excellent location, right in the city center, and you can walk to the shopping mall next door to buy food and drinks. The location of the hotel is good. There is embassy downstairs, and there is direct access to the public space on the sixth floor. It integrates dining and reading, and it is very convenient to eat. The shopping mall is connected to bts, which is very convenient to go to the siam business circle, and it is also very convenient to transfer to mrt. The day of check-in was the wedding anniversary, and a beautiful bouquet and chocolate cake were sent. And the service team prepared a handwritten greeting card, which feels great!

The view of the room is good. At the breakfast place on the 9th floor, the English of the front desk is quite fluent. The breakfast is semi-buffet, and the dishes are diverse, which is worthy of being respected as a Michelin level.

The room cleaning and night service are very meticulous every day. Small items such as charging cables will be stored neatly. The service, environment and location all match the price. Satisfactory check-in experience.

The bathroom in the room is well designed, separated from the shower, and the shower area is also very spacious. We are in a hurry to make arrangements, and we will visit this hotel again soon.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jerry Chang (Proxman),

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We are delighted to hear that your overall experience was so positive and that various aspects of your stay from the service and facilities to the location and amenities met your expectations. It is especially wonderful to know that the thoughtful touches and hospitality made your visit feel memorable.

We truly appreciate your kind words and recommendation. Your feedback is invaluable, and we are glad your stay was a satisfying one. We look forward to the opportunity to welcome you back again in the future.

Regards,

Park Hyatt Bangkok

Park Hyatt Bangkok

reviews.name: Thomas Wong
reviews.text:
Sophisticated Luxury and Unrivaled Generosity in the Heart of Bangkok

​My partner and I recently stayed at the Park Hyatt Bangkok to continue our birthday celebrations, and the experience was exemplary from start to finish.  The hotel embodies modern luxury, but it is the genuinely warm, professional, and gracious staff that make it truly world-class.

​Our arrival set a wonderful tone for the stay.  The front desk team member who handled our check-in was incredibly bright and cheerful.  We were then escorted to our room by Mr. Kahong, whose hospitality was remarkably generous.  He kindly surprised us with two complimentary welcome drink vouchers to enjoy at the Penthouse Bar, which was a fantastic touch.

​The hotel went above and beyond to make my birthday unforgettable.  Upon entering our room, we were greeted by a stunning, wholeheartedly arranged bouquet of fragrant lilies.  To add to the celebration, the team surprised us with an incredibly thoughtful spread: two fresh coconuts, exquisite artisanal pastries, and a beautiful box of macarons.

​We opted for the Executive Retreat Stay and Savour Package, which proved to be an exceptional value. The culinary offerings on the 9th floor are a masterclass in culinary excellence.  I want to extend a special note of gratitude to the entire team at The Living Room and Embassy Room. Everyone we encountered was meticulously observant, highly professional, and utterly dedicated to delivering a flawless dining experience.  Throughout our breakfast, lunch, and dinner, they welcomed us with radiant warmth and provided superb, tailored recommendations.

​The menus for both breakfast and the executive retreat feature an impressive variety.  Every single creation that came out of the kitchen was a testament to culinary finesse and rich flavor.

​Lastly, the stunning infinity pool is an absolute highlight of the property, offering a serene, breathtaking vantage point above the bustling city.
​We thoroughly enjoyed every minute of our retreat and will undoubtedly be returning.  Highly recommended for anyone seeking an elevated, bespoke stay in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Thomas Wong,

Thank you for taking the time to share such a wonderful review of your recent birthday celebration at Park Hyatt Bangkok.

We are truly honored that you chose to celebrate this special occasion with us and delighted to know that your experience was exemplary from arrival through departure. Your kind words about our team are especially meaningful, as creating genuine, personalized hospitality is at the heart of everything we do. Your compliments regarding the attentiveness, professionalism, and personalized service provided by our colleagues will be proudly shared with the entire team.

Thank you once again for your generous recommendation and for allowing us to be part of such a special celebration. It was our absolute pleasure to host you, and we look forward to welcoming you back to Park Hyatt Bangkok for many more memorable occasions in the future.

Warm regards,

Park Hyatt Bangkok

The adjoining shopping centre also has excellent cafes, shops and a fantastic cinema that I recommend you try. My son loved the views from the pool where you could look at the city as the sun set. Just a fantastic experience from start to finish, what you'd expect from a Park Hyatt.

Park Hyatt Bangkok

reviews.text: What a beautiful place. Had a beautiful suite, breakfast was one of the best I had at a park hyatt, location is amazing. reviews.name: T. F.
reviews.text:
We recently spent 4 days at the Park Hyatt Bangkok, and it was an absolutely fantastic experience from start to finish.
The rooms are stunning—spacious, modern, and designed with an incredible eye for detail. They offer a peaceful escape from the bustling city below.
The service was world-class. Every staff member we encountered was professional, attentive, and went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable.
A special mention must go to the breakfast—it was easily the highlight of our mornings. The quality and variety of the food were exceptional, arguably some of the best we’ve ever had.
We truly enjoyed every minute of our stay and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review. We are delighted to hear that you had such an enjoyable stay and appreciated the room design, service, and overall experience. It is especially pleasing to know that breakfast was a highlight of your visit. We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

reviews.text: I can highly recommend the Park Hyatt Bangkok as an exceptional hotel that provides hospitality at its very best from start to finish across all levels. Rooms are exceptionally well designed and the staff is kind, attentive and highly professional - and facilities from pool to gym and restaurants are superb. Definitely among the very top hotels globally.

Park Hyatt Bangkok
