reviews.name: Shanika Weera
reviews.text:
A Truly Exceptional Spa Experience ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I treated myself to the Seaside Sensation package at Oasis Spa during my stay in Bangkok, and it was honestly one of the most luxurious and relaxing experiences I’ve ever had.

From the moment I stepped through the doors, I felt like I had entered a peaceful sanctuary away from the city. The spa itself is absolutely beautiful, with tranquil water features, lush greenery, and a calming atmosphere that instantly helps you unwind.

The five-hour treatment was worth every minute. Every stage of the experience felt thoughtfully designed, from the herbal steam and refreshing body scrub to the incredibly relaxing body wrap. The highlight for me was the signature massage — one of the best massages I’ve ever received. The therapists were professional, attentive, and made sure I was comfortable throughout.

What impressed me most was the attention to detail. The staff were warm and welcoming, the facilities were immaculate, and the entire experience felt seamless and indulgent without ever feeling rushed.

If you’re visiting Bangkok and looking for a genuine luxury spa experience, I cannot recommend Oasis Spa highly enough. It was the perfect way to slow down, recharge, and truly take care of myself. I left feeling completely refreshed, rejuvenated, and wishing I could come back again tomorrow.

Thank you to the entire team for making my visit so special. I’ll definitely be returning on my next trip to Thailand. 🌿✨💕
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It is an absolute delight to read your glowing review. We’re delighted to know that you enjoyed the serene atmosphere of Oasis Spa Bangkok and that our therapists provided a professional and attentive experience throughout your visit. Knowing that you left feeling refreshed and rejuvenated is truly the greatest reward for our team. Thank you for your kind support, and we look forward to welcoming you back again in the future.

reviews.name: Miki T.
reviews.text:
It's like a hidden gem in Bangkok; you feel peaceful and relaxed as soon
you step inside. The staffs are warm welcome and polite. I like the Hot Oil Aroma massage that made me so relaxed and released stress in my muscles & body. The masseuse is so professional, and you can address the level of massage weight and which part of the body to work on straight away.

It provides a private massage, so you can take a bath afterwards if you want. After the massage, they will give you hot tea with mango sticky rice to make the journey end on a sweet note.

They also offer the ride to BTS or Emquatier if you need to. I love Oasis in both Bangkok and Chiang Mai; it's always one of my favourite places to visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
It was a pleasure to read about your recent visit. We're delighted that you enjoyed the entire journey with us, from the Hot Oil Aroma massage to the sweet treat of mango sticky rice and tea to finish. We believe it's the small, thoughtful details that create a truly memorable experience.

Your appreciation for our private facilities and complimentary transport service is also valued. Our aim is to ensure every guest feels completely cared for from the moment they arrive until they depart.

Thank you for your wonderful feedback. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back again soon.

reviews.name: Anthony Plaxen
reviews.text:
Had a lovely time at the oasis spa. The aromatherapy and coconut oil massage and hair wash were fantastic.

The technicians took care of me very well. And the mango sticky rice and herbal tea at the end was a very nice treat.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your lovely review. We are delighted to know that you had such an enjoyable experience at our Oasis Spa and that the Aromatherapy and Coconut Oil Massage left such a positive impression. Thank you for your support. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa experience soon.

reviews.name: Bebe
reviews.text: My second time here, I called to schedule an appointment which was really easy. The service is excellent, the grounds are beautiful, and the rooms were clean & modern. I had the 2 hour Calm/Relax massage package and she did a wonderful job, I felt more light and relaxed the next day. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are so grateful for your glowing five-star review. It is a pleasure to know that every aspect of your visit, from the ease of scheduling and beautiful surroundings to the skill and care of your therapist, contributed to a truly relaxing experience. Your high recommendation is the greatest compliment we could receive. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another memorable and rejuvenating spa journey.

reviews.name: Littlelu
reviews.text:
Oasis Spa was the best decision I made on this trip to Thailand! I chose it because they offer spa services for children, and it turned out to be even better than I imagined. My six-year-old absolutely loved it—he even said the coconut oil smelled like cookies, haha.

We booked a family room, which was very comfortable. The therapists were highly professional, and the massage was so relaxing that all three of us ended up falling asleep. We’ll definitely visit again next time we’re in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your review truly made our day! It brings us great joy to know that you and your family had a comfortable and relaxing time in our family room at Oasis Spa Sukhumvit 31. We’re honored to have been part of your trip and look forward to welcoming you again soon.

reviews.name: Dianne Wissmar
reviews.text: A hidden gem in Bangkok and I appreciate the free pick up/drop off at BTS Phrom Phong. Had Aromatherapy Hot oil massage with my friend it was so relaxing and the medium pressure was perfect.Staff was amazing the facilities were clean. Definitely recommend this place and I will be back. ❤️❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a delightful review to read; thank you. It brings us great joy to know that your visit was such a memorable experience, from the convenience of our pickup service to the quality of your Aromatherapy Hot Oil massage. Knowing that our team’s care and service made such a positive impression is truly the highest compliment we could receive. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another relaxing and exceptional spa experience.

reviews.name: Alice Chang
reviews.text:
My last visit to Oasis Spa was about five or six years ago, so I was curious to see if the experience would still live up to my memory — and thankfully, it absolutely did.

From the moment you step onto the property, the environment immediately creates a sense of escape from the busy city outside. The greenery, thoughtful landscaping, and quiet atmosphere make the place feel serene and secluded, setting a relaxing mood even before the treatment begins.

The reception process was efficient and pleasant. The team guided us through the details of our booking while making us feel genuinely welcomed. Before heading to the treatment room, we were invited to sit and enjoy a refreshing drink with some light bites, which was a nice way to settle in and slow down.

The spa facilities themselves are tastefully designed — refined yet comfortable. Our treatment suite was spacious, immaculate, and clearly well prepared. The therapists demonstrated great technique and attentiveness, maintaining a perfect balance between checking in on our comfort and allowing us to fully unwind. The pace of the treatment felt calm and unrushed, which made the whole experience deeply relaxing.

Afterwards, we were brought back to the lounge area to enjoy tea and a small dessert. It was a thoughtful way to ease back into the day rather than abruptly ending the experience. The spa also arranged transportation to the nearest station, which added an extra level of convenience.

Overall, everything felt well organized and carefully considered from beginning to end. Even after several years, Oasis Spa continues to deliver a consistently high-quality experience — definitely a place worth returning to.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful feedback and for awarding us a 5-star review. We are so happy that your recent visit to Oasis Spa Sukhumvit 31 was a memorable one.

Your comments about the serene atmosphere and the well-organized, attentive service are greatly appreciated. We strive to create a complete sanctuary for our guests, where every element of the visit is seamless and relaxing, so we are thrilled to know we achieved this for you.

Thank you once again for your generous support. We look forward to your next visit and the opportunity to provide another exceptional experience.

reviews.name: Gwen Lim
reviews.text: Highly recommended for the skill and warmth of the people in Oasis spa. From the greeting to the end of spa session, the little details to the skill of therapist, I am coming back each time I am in Bangkok from now on. A little tip, there is a 20% discount for morning treatment. Go for it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a pleasure it is to receive your feedback. Thank you for your kind recommendation. We are delighted to know that our team's attentive service and therapeutic skills made you feel so welcome during your visit. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa experience soon.

reviews.name: Alex Yong
reviews.text:
A beautifully calming experience from arrival to departure

Our experience at Oasis Spa was nothing short of wonderful, from the moment we arrived until we left feeling completely refreshed and relaxed.

The journey starts even before the treatment — walking into the premises felt like stepping into a peaceful oasis away from the city. The surroundings are beautifully maintained, lush, and tranquil, instantly setting the tone for relaxation. The check-in process was smooth and welcoming, with the staff explaining everything clearly while making us feel genuinely looked after.

Before the treatment, we were seated comfortably and served a refreshing welcome drink and light refreshments, giving us time to unwind and ease into the experience. The spa itself is thoughtfully designed — clean, elegant, and calming without feeling overly formal or intimidating.

The treatment rooms were spacious, spotless, and well-prepared, with great attention to detail. The therapists were professional, gentle, and highly skilled, checking in just enough to ensure comfort while allowing us to fully relax. Every movement felt intentional and unhurried, making the treatment incredibly soothing.

After the session, we were guided back to the lounge area to enjoy tea and a light dessert, allowing us to slowly ease back rather than being rushed out. A thoughtful touch that really completes the experience.
To top it off, transportation to the nearest station was also arranged, which made the entire visit even more convenient and stress-free — a small but very much appreciated gesture.

Overall, the experience felt seamless, calming, and thoughtfully curated from start to finish. If you’re looking for a spa that delivers not just excellent treatments but a complete sense of care and escape, Oasis Spa truly delivers. Highly recommended — and definitely a place we’d return to.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We're genuinely grateful for your five-star review and delighted to hear that your visit was so beautifully calming from start to finish.

It’s fantastic to know that you felt transported to a peaceful oasis the moment you arrived. Creating a tranquil atmosphere is something we take great pride in, and we're thrilled that you appreciated our lush surroundings and the welcoming check-in process. We strive to ensure that every detail, from the refreshing welcome drink to the comfort of our treatment rooms, contributes to a relaxing experience, and your recognition of that means so much to us.

We’re especially glad to hear that our therapists made a positive impact on your visit with their professionalism and skill. It’s important to us that our guests feel both cared for and relaxed during their treatments. We're also pleased that the complimentary transportation added to your convenience, helping to make your experience even more enjoyable.

Thank you again for your kind words and for recommending Oasis Spa. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another escape that provides a complete sense of care and relaxation. Your support is truly appreciated!

reviews.name: J L
reviews.text: Wow!  My daughter and I went for the Oasis Experience and it was heavenly!  We were so impressed by the ambiance, therapist attention to detail and relaxed atmosphere!  Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are absolutely delighted to read your 5-star review. It brings us great joy to know that your Oasis Experience was truly heavenly and that our team's attentive care and thoughtful service made a lasting impression. Your kind words are a wonderful encouragement to our team. We look forward to welcoming you and your daughter back for another memorable spa experience in the near future.

reviews.name: littlepig
reviews.text: A peaceful and relaxing place with a calm atmosphere. The service was excellent from start to finish—both the reception staff and the massage therapists were professional, friendly, and attentive. The prices are very reasonable, and the products used are clean and smell wonderful. I had a great experience and would definitely come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a wonderful review to read! We are delighted to know that you had a peaceful and relaxing experience at our Oasis Spa Sukhumvit 31. It is especially rewarding to hear that our team's professionalism and the quality of our products helped make your visit a memorable one. Thank you for your kind feedback. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa experience soon.

reviews.name: Krittanon Sowapart
reviews.text: Absolutely phenomenal experience. The ambiance, hospitality, and attention to detail were top-tier. My therapist was William, and he was truly fantastic—his technique, intuitive pressure, and overall professionalism made this one of the absolute best treatments I’ve had in Bangkok. I left feeling completely restored. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are truly grateful for your wonderful feedback. It is a pleasure to know that you enjoyed the excellent service provided by Khun William at our Oasis Spa Sukhumvit 31. Creating exceptional and memorable spa experiences for every guest is at the heart of what we do, and we are delighted that we could provide a relaxing and enjoyable visit for you. Your kind words and recommendation are a wonderful encouragement to our team. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa experience soon.

reviews.name: Dom Threlfall
reviews.text:
Beautiful relaxing venue, my wife and I visited after we were given some gift vouchers as a present from our kids.

All the other reviewers have said how wonderful everything is, so I thought I would comment on the "Gift Voucher" experience.

We were delivered the vouchers by email a few months ago after son bought them online for us through their website, it was very easy for us to redeem the vouchers through their website, gave us a choice of their venues.
When we arrived (1/2hr early) they were already for us, had the full experience as per other reviewers, occasionally with other venues the *Gift Voucher" experience can be a reduced service, certainly not here at Oasis

Would highly recommend and the vouchers are ideal Christmas presents for Bangkok visitors.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review! We're delighted to hear you enjoyed the seamless gift voucher experience and full service at our Bangkok Oasis Spa Sukhumvit 31 branch. Your recommendation means a lot to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa journey.

reviews.name: natalie yona
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve had in all of Thailand! Even came here twice!  Such great girls working here, all sweet and pampering. Beautiful spa as well, very clean and aesthetic. Enjoyed every moment. Highly recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are so grateful for your glowing 5-star review and your amazing feedback!  We are absolutely thrilled to hear that you consider your massages at our Oasis Spa Sukhumvit 31 branch to be among the best in Thailand, and we're so honored that you chose to visit us twice!

It's especially rewarding to know that you found our team so sweet and pampering, and that you enjoyed the beautiful, clean, and aesthetic ambiance of our spa. We're so glad you enjoyed every moment of your experience.

Your high recommendation means the world to us, and we eagerly look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing and pampering spa journey soon.

reviews.name: Tim D
reviews.text: What a wonderful and classy spa tucked away in the heart of Bangkok! The staff greeted me the moment I arrived, got tea while they checked me in, asked my preferences on all of the details of the massage, and then whisked me away for an incredible 2-hour massage. The masseuse was very helpful and asked me throughout the massage how I was feeling and on the intensity of the massage. It was a wonderful experience and I'll be back for sure!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review!  We're delighted to hear about your exceptional experience at Oasis Spa. It brings us joy to know that you enjoyed our traditional Thai hospitality, from the welcome tea to the attentive massage service. We look forward to welcoming you back for another rejuvenating experience!

reviews.name: Kiya M
reviews.text: I had an amazing time. King made our experience wonderful and easy. Our massage therapists were amazing and I felt like I was walking on clouds after. Truly made my trip worth it. So glad I found them and I can’t wait to visit again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are so grateful for your glowing 5-star review. It’s wonderful to hear that from the service provided by King to the skill of our massage therapists, every part of your experience was seamless and relaxing. The entire team at Oasis Spa Sukhumvit 31 is already looking forward to your return!

reviews.name: Sumit Chadha
reviews.text:
What can I say - this place is the epitome of relaxation.

I walked-in without an appointment. The staff was kind enough to accommodate me on a busy Friday evening.

I tried the Secret Charms body scrub and it was heavenly. The facilities are amazing, the staff is unbelievably sweet and courteous. Even the bathroom products available scream luxury. I ended up buying some of those products to take them home. The little touches - welcome drink, scented cold towel and the delicious Mango Sticky Rice with Tea post the treatment will make you feel wholesome and elevate the overall experience.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND this place. Special thanks to William and Ploy for the exceptionally good service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review! We're thrilled to hear you found Oasis Spa to be the epitome of relaxation and enjoyed the Secret Charms body scrub. It’s great to know that our team, especially William and Ploy, provided you with exceptional service. We’re glad you appreciated the little touches, like the welcome drink and the delicious Mango Sticky Rice with Tea. Your recommendation means a lot to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa journey soon!

reviews.name: Thanthip
reviews.text: My boyfriend gifted me Coco Mango package (scrub+oil massage+mini face massage). They have their own products. Car service to BTS. The scrub they used on me was very good scent (coconut+mango) and gave me no headache. The staffs are very service minded.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It was a pleasure to read your review, and we sincerely appreciate you sharing your 5-star experience. We are delighted to know that you thoroughly enjoyed your Coco Mango package at Oasis Spa Sukhumvit 31, from the warm hospitality of our team to the delightful aroma of our products. Your kind words mean a great deal to us and inspire our team to continue creating exceptional spa experiences with genuine care. We look forward to welcoming you back to Oasis Spa in the near future.

reviews.name: Amaya
reviews.text:
An absolutely incredible experience at Oasis Spa.
From arrival to departure, everything was perfect: a warm and professional welcome, beautiful and spacious treatment rooms, and truly exceptional treatments.
You can feel the attention to detail in every aspect, right down to the lovely afternoon tea at the end, which is the perfect way to extend the moment of relaxation.
A place where you genuinely feel pampered. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful and detailed review! We are absolutely delighted to read about your experience at our Oasis Spa branch in Sukhumvit 31. It brings us immense joy to know that you felt genuinely pampered and that every detail, from the warm welcome to the lovely afternoon tea, contributed to a perfect moment of relaxation for you. We are so grateful for your high recommendation and look forward to having the pleasure of welcoming you back again soon.

reviews.name: Karyn Suwito
reviews.text: Loved the space very relaxing great for prenatal massage I did package oh mama with Noke she was great! If you have a late flight out of bkk this is a good stop got to shower after the service and they take your luggage highly recommended my package was 2 hours 2900 baht

title: MYTH Urban Retreat | Massage & Spa
subTitle: MYTH Massage
description: Calm retreat from the hustle & bustle of Bangkok's city streets for classic Thai massage.
ownerDescription: For reservation please call or contact Line Account ID: 0811452256
address: 203 Soi Ruamrudee Community, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

reviews.name: Prawut PATHOMYOK
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful massage experience with Khun Usa and was genuinely impressed. The service was excellent, and her massage skills were outstanding—professional, attentive, and very relaxing.

The atmosphere was beautiful and peaceful, making it easy to unwind. I also really appreciated that the massage room has its own private bathroom, which was clean, beautifully designed, and very convenient.

Overall, a great experience from start to finish. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Milen Mindov
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve ever had. The service was excellent — very kind, attentive, and highly professional staff. The place has a beautiful, stylish design with a great sense of harmony and lovely decor. The massage itself was truly outstanding, and the overall experience was incredible. The atmosphere is amazing, and the team is extremely friendly and welcoming. I highly recommend this place to everyone — it’s an experience you shouldn’t miss.

reviews.name: Диана Карвецкая
reviews.text:
It was a good massage!
The therapist was attentive and caring. The place itself is stylish and well-taken care of.
I liked that they have many types of massage and especially head massage and energy-chakra massage - that's rare.
Also, before and after massage you are treated with tea and snacks - that's so sweet.
Definitely recommend 😊

reviews.name: Trancy Zhang
reviews.text: Great hot stone massage experience, really nice staff members and relaxing. They have mixed different types of oil and smells so nice, I really enjoyed the session. Strongly recommend yuzu and jasmines mix.

reviews.name: Helena Lööper
reviews.text: Amazing! So friendly staff, also the owner was very welcoming and speaking good english! We really enjoyed our massages- the whole salon is so clean and beautiful, masseus therapists are very professional and damn they are good! Had a combination of Thai massage and something else, was exactly what body needed, stretching, acupuncture, muscle pain :) Really recommend it!

reviews.name: Alexis
reviews.text: Best massage and tailored oil for you personally is just divine! Wonderful experience from the moment they greet you at the door. Plus, the post tea and little treats are a perfect touch.

reviews.name: Mike Milligan
reviews.text: This is hands down best massage in the world. My masseuse was named Lisa - who is also a physiotherapist, and you can tell. Sorted out all my issues from heavy weight training and Muay Thai training. The spa is very clean, very modern. The owner Kim is fluent in English, and the therapists also have a very good level of English. Kim is extremely welcoming and hospitable from the moment you arrive. My partner and I are coming back tomorrow for a 2 hour couples massage. 10/10!

reviews.name: Smiley Sunbeam
reviews.text: I visited this massage shop two days in a row, but the staff’s attitude today felt noticeably different from yesterday. The lady at the front desk didn’t seem very welcoming and came across a bit unfriendly. Personally, I would recommend their Body Magic Oil Massage, which I enjoyed more. Today I tried the Deep Tissue Massage and Hot Stone Healing. While the therapist’s technique was fairly professional, I ended up feeling sore all over afterwards. Overall, the service is decent, but the experience can vary depending on the day and the staff.

reviews.name: Nancy Tran
reviews.text: The service here is amazing and attentive right when I walked through the door. I got the hot stone and foot massage and omg that was one of the best massages I’ve ever received. My masseuse was so kind and thorough. She periodically checked in with me to make sure I’m doing ok, which I find is a hit or miss with a lot of massage places. She also did a bunch of stretches to me which I appreciated. I’m also very ticklish and dealing with some foot pain and she was super mindful of that. Highly recommend. Thank you I will be back.

reviews.name: Roy Shi
reviews.text: I’ve been in Bangkok for a few days now, and the city never fails to impress. MYTH Urban Retreat offers truly exceptional massages, and the service is absolutely superb. The staff are incredibly warm and welcoming, making the whole experience feel special. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Regina May Francisco
reviews.text: I had one of my most relaxing nights because of MYTH Urban Retreat. I asked for the traditional Thai massage with foot and head massage (1,500 baht).  Professional staff, premium experience. ⭐️ I will definitely come back here when I return to Bangkok.

reviews.name: disoobi
reviews.text: I visited while pregnant, and it was incredibly refreshing. My shoulders had been bothering me, but they were treated so well that all my fatigue from traveling just melted away. If I weren’t flying out today, I would definitely come back every day!

reviews.name: Varangkana K.
reviews.text:
Wonderful massage experience with Pim, who has become my new favorite therapist. The treatment was relaxing, professional, and exactly what I needed.💆🏻‍♀️
Loved the convenient shuttle pick-up from my hotel as well. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Karen Koh
reviews.text: The therapist was really suitable for me. Their skills were all very good and know how to do proper massage. And also they have a while range of massage fragrance and oil to choose from. And it's easy to find. Place is very clean and services are very complete

reviews.name: Carmen Schock
reviews.text: My husband and I were walk-ins after our dinner date and Khim happily greeted us and had us set-up for a couples massage within minutes. The ambiance was very calming and the massages were incredible! Love that they accept credit cards, too! Sharing a pic of the beautiful post-massage tea and cookies.

reviews.name: Chiawen Hsu
reviews.text: We had a 90 min oil body massage, the room is spacious and well decorated! We love the experience! Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ye_Ji Pelden
reviews.text: I had a really relaxing and enjoyable experience with the massage. The therapist was professional, attentive and made sure I was comfortable throughout the session. The pressure was just right, helping to release tension and ease muscle stiffness. The environment was calm and soothing which added to the overall experience. I left feeling refreshed and much more relaxed. I would definitely recommend this massage to anyone looking for a quality and calming experience.. Thankyu Miss Kim 🤍

reviews.name: yesran
reviews.text:
If this place were closer to my home, I’d honestly come twice a week!

I had my massage with MA and she was amazing. the pressure was just right, and her shoulder massage was especially incredible. The space is super clean and beautifully decorated, and the owner is very friendly and welcoming.

One thing I really appreciated was the massage bed. it had a face cradle and i got thai massage on it. Would have a hard time getting neck massages on flat beds because I have to twist my head to the side, and that always hurts my neck. But here, I was able to lie face down comfortably, and the massage felt so much better because of it.

Highly recommend, especially if you’re picky about neck comfort like me!

reviews.name: Jillian Goralski
reviews.text:
Wow! We just finished the most amazing 2 hour hot stone full body massage. It was amazing! We did a couples massage & the room was private & the girls were great! They were delightful, strong & knew what they were doing.
The spa itself is so pretty & smells wonderful - oils, scents & potions galore.
This is a special treat after a long flight, long day or anytime you want to be pampered. 10/10!!

reviews.name: p zaika
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Myth Massage in Bangkok. I did the Thai massage while my girlfriend chose the aroma massage — both were excellent. The staff were professional and asked where to focus and how much pressure we preferred, which made a big difference. I had three massages during my stay in Bangkok, and this one was definitely my favorite. It really felt like a proper massage — not just relaxing, but effective. The place is clean, calm, and well-run. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a quality massage in the city.

title: Mango Cooking School

reviews.name: kiki lam
reviews.text: It’s a wonderful experience! The chef is very friendly and joyful. She’s very patient and good with the kids. Our kids enjoy every single part of the class so much! Highly recommended!!

reviews.name: wangari (Wangari)
reviews.text:
We had such an incredible experience at the Thai cooking class! The teacher was super knowledgeable, kind, and incredibly patient. She explained every step so clearly and made learning Thai cuisine so much fun. We not only learned about authentic ingredients and traditional techniques but also discovered all the little secrets that make Thai food so flavorful and unique.

I attended with my daughter, and she had an absolute blast! The class was very family-friendly and hands-on — we got to chop, stir, taste, and laugh together as we cooked some of the most delicious dishes we’ve ever made. By the end, we both felt like real Thai chefs!

The space was extremely clean, beautifully set up, and perfectly organized, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable and comfortable. Everything was well-prepared — from the ingredients to the cooking stations — making it easy to focus on learning and having fun.

It was truly excellent value for money and one of the highlights of our trip. We left with happy hearts, full tummies, and wonderful memories. Highly, highly recommend this class to anyone visiting Thailand!

reviews.name: Shreya Kasireddi
reviews.text:
what a LOVELY experience at the cooking class!
Serene was an excellent teacher and made the lessons so joyful for us all

absolutely worth the money! 5 courses and by the time we left, we were soooooo full!

reviews.name: Ji Yeon Ku (Sigrid)
reviews.text: Our host, Erica, was super friendly and funny. She spoke very fluent Korean as well as English. Really enjoyed the session with her!

reviews.name: Jineun Kim
reviews.text:
The simplest recipe, yet the authentic taste of traditional Thai cuisine!!

The cooking studio environment was clean and cozy, which made it pleasure to focus on cooking. The instructor was kind and explained everything in great detail, so even as a beginner, I had no trouble following along. The ingredients provided were fresh and diverse, which made the cooking experience even more enjoyable, and the best part was sharing the meal we made together. I learned new skills while cooking, and the entire process was super fun. I highly recommend who wants to learn Thai authentic cuisine! And they have a parents & kids cooking session so I will go back with  my kids!

reviews.name: Macy Y
reviews.text:
What a fantastic experience!

We did a half day cooking class (booked thru KLOOK). Our host was Serene and she was absolutely lovely!

Learned so much about Thai herbs and cooking. Our creations were delicious. Come on an empty stomach!

The studio is very clean.

reviews.name: Ben Scherer
reviews.text: Very nice cooking class. We went to the market in the morning (short) and cooked a 5 course menu which was delicious. The class offers an opportunity to learn about local ingredients and you get the recipes afterwards. Also the facilities are very good. It all comes at a very reasonable price. The only little difficulty is as that we couldn’t phone then, but booking via the 3rd party website worked well.

reviews.name: Onoh Udensi
reviews.text: Fun place to learn how to make Thai foods like Pad Thai. The staff are very knowledgeable and understanding of the process. Would definitely recommend for first timers or even experts.

reviews.name: jiyoon , jenny han
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience at Mango Cooking Class! Over the course of three hours, we learned how to cook five traditional Thai dishes, and not once did the class feel boring or rushed. The atmosphere was friendly, relaxed, and full of energy.

The instructor spoke excellent English and explained each step clearly, making it easy for everyone to follow along regardless of their cooking experience. She shared interesting cultural insights and cooking tips throughout the session, which added a lot of value to the experience. We were encouraged to ask questions, taste ingredients, and adjust flavors to our preference — it felt very hands-on and personal.

What I especially appreciated was how smoothly the class was organized. Each station was well-prepared, and the transitions between dishes were seamless. From making curry paste from scratch to stir-frying the perfect Pad Thai, every moment was fun and engaging.

If you're visiting Bangkok and want to do something truly local and memorable, I highly recommend Mango Cooking Class. It’s a great way to learn more about Thai cuisine, meet fellow travelers, and enjoy a delicious meal you made yourself!

reviews.name: Debra O'Connor
reviews.text: Serene was a wonderful instructor. She took us on an informative market tour and really walked us through all the steps to make pad Thai. She gave us good explanations of all the ingredients and answered all our questions. The classes are well organized and they’ve thought of everything, including giving us fans to battle the heat(during the market tour), filtered water stations and cute aprons. The food was very delicious and she was very accommodating and vigilant regarding dietary restrictions.

reviews.name: Jeongwon Ahn
reviews.text:
It was a great experience making Thai food as a foreigner. Clean studio with easy explained recipes and the teacher was very kind.
I strongly recommend to foreigners traveling in Bangkok to visit and experience Thai culture.

reviews.name: S L
reviews.text:
highly recommended to include this activity into the itinerary, you will have a lot of fun in the 3 hours.   The place is clean, the teacher is nice, cooking is easy and also we can eat after cooking😋

reviews.name: Michelle Johnson
reviews.text: Book this!  Immediately!  We had the most wonderful morning.  The staff were welcoming, attentive, informative and absolutely delightful.  The food was delicious!  We learned a lot and ate a lot.  The class was hands on!  Perfect for kids and adults.  Beautiful facility.  Beautiful presentation.  A highlight of our trip to this awesome city.

reviews.name: Valaya Gaudet
reviews.text: What a wonderful class that was, so well organized and fun! I liked the fact that we didn't have to stand the whole time,only when we had to cook the dish. Very efficient. Our instructor explained everything clearly. She was a delight to be with. I am thinking of going back to learn more dishes.

reviews.name: Hyemee Park
reviews.text: The shop is very clean and has a nice atmosphere. The instructor kindly explained all the cooking processes and made us have fun while cooking. It was my first time cooking Thai food, but it wasn't difficult at all. And I was so happy to eat the food I made with my friends. If you are traveling to Bangkok, I highly recommend this place as one of the best places to make good memories with your family or friends.

reviews.name: Celia Taylor
reviews.text: This was one of the coolest things we did in Bangkok! The class includes going to the market and then cooking a delicious Thai menu. Our guide was so awesome and perfect for teaching. The studio was stylised coolness. Everything was really clean, and the whole class was well-organised, well-planned and of course, delicious! Do not eat beforehand! I was sooo full and I had not eaten. Thank you soooo much Serene! You were amazing x

reviews.name: Jason
reviews.text: Very good cooking school, located in On Nut. Well designed and well delivered class, with the right amount of demonstration and cooking yourself. Pui was very nice and knowledgeable.

reviews.name: Emilia Marchacz
reviews.text:
I was very satisfied with the cooking workshop. Everything was organized in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere, and the instructor was extremely helpful and shared her knowledge in an engaging and interesting way.

I would highly recommend this experience to everyone. I was never a big fan of Pad Thai, but after making it myself during the workshop, it completely changed my perspective — it was delicious, just like all the other dishes.

reviews.name: Lee
reviews.text:
Absolutely beautiful experience
If you’re in Bangkok and have some time to spend come here and learn to cook some really delicious Thai cuisine 😍

reviews.name: Hyeyeong Kim
reviews.text: The cooking class I took with my 11 year old daughter was the best experience I had in Bangkok. She fell in love with Thai food while making it herself.

reviews.name: Steve Lockhart
reviews.text:
If there was an option for 10 stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I would select it.

After a very frustrating experience with another Mercedes-Benz dealer, I was referred to TTC Motor by Mercedes-Benz Thailand and I cannot speak highly enough of the experience.

From the moment I arrived, the standard of service, professionalism, and attention to detail was everything you would expect from a world-class Mercedes-Benz dealership. The facilities are immaculate and the team are exceptional.

In particular I want to highlight Khun Golf (Tananwat) who handled my case with exceptional dedication. My vehicle had a complex set of issues that had been unresolved for nearly two years elsewhere. Khun Golf went so far above and beyond what anyone could reasonably expect. He was available when needed, kept me fully informed throughout, assisted on his days off, and ensured every single issue was resolved properly. He is a credit to TTC and to the Mercedes-Benz brand.

The contrast between TTC Motor and my previous dealership experience could not be greater. This is what Mercedes-Benz ownership should feel like.

If you are looking for a Mercedes-Benz dealer in Bangkok that truly lives up to the brand standard, look no further than TTC Motor. Highly recommended.

ownerDescription:

Certified therapists. Private rooms. Fair prices. Parking available.

Walk-ins always welcome.
address: 47 4 Ratchaprasong Road, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

reviews.name: Ivy Sew
reviews.text:
I’m sorry I have to give this only 1️⃣ star because this has been my WORST massage experience whenever I’ve been to Bangkok. I didn’t compare to high class parlours but I’ve visited many budget friendly massage centres as well that operates very well too.

Me and my friend went for a 120 min full body Thai oil massage, paid 1200 baht each in cash. Ended up we realised that we only got around 100 mins as they cut it short by 20 mins and there was no apology even when we brought it up at the counter politely asking if they have mistaken that we signed for 120 mins and not 90mins session. The lady staff just gave us a long face, roll her eyes and started speaking in Thai to her colleagues, avoiding eye contact with us the whole time. We didn’t expect a refund but we don’t even deserve to get a simple sincere apology.

The massage pressure was way too hard, we literally said “soft soft” a few times during the session but they just said “okay okay” and kept going. Two days later I can still feel the soreness in my back, it hasn’t gone away until I’m back in my own country.

Also just a heads up, this place seems to take in way more walk-ins than they can handle. While we were at the counter the same lady was juggling multiple customers at once, and we saw another customer’s payment get ignored even though it had already gone through, someone else had to sort it out for him. Felt very overbooked and disorganized. Cut short someone else’s session just to fit more customers.

Long story short, they easily scam your time and money or maybe even an apology.

reviews.name: An Phương
reviews.text:
I chose this spa randomly after shopping at Big C, and it turned out to be a great decision. I was impressed by the therapist’s technique and expertise. She was highly skilled, and my legs felt so much better after the massage.

However, this spa didn’t wash my feet before the massage. At first, I felt a bit uncomfortable because my feet felt dirty, but the therapist’s skill was so impressive that it didn’t matter in the end

reviews.name: Sofia Safranoglou
reviews.text: Very relaxing massage with lovely aromas. We chose the Thai massage with herbal treatment and it was a wonderful experience. The atmosphere was calm and pleasant, and we left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Wing Shan Chan
reviews.text: Randomly find a place for massage, and I was surprisingly in good quality. The location in fine, near Centralworld, just a few minutes walk from there. The therapist skill is excellent, really recommend to come!! The environment here is clear and cozy! Great and recommend to come and experience!

reviews.name: Matthew Lee
reviews.text:
I had a massage nearby and it wasn't satisfactory so I googled for another one nearby and found this place with a rather high rating so decided to give it a try.
Walked in and the place looks pretty clean. Went to the counter and told the lady I wanted an hour body massage she couldn't understand much English. Thank god it was available immediately and I asked for a male masseur and one was also readily available.
He male masseur gave me a scrub on my feet then brought me up to the second floor to a room for massage.
I was worried they would use oil for massage and I didn't like those. Thankfully they made me change into their clothes so the massage was done fully clothed without applying anything on the body.
The male masseur who did my massage was rather okay with varying soft and hard touches. I wanted to ask him to massage harder but I let him be and it was still overall decent and managed to relieve some aches of my muscles.
I think its a not bad place to visit especially if one is tired walking along this shopping belt. Do give it a try and the prices are quite reasonable as well.

reviews.name: dj polin
reviews.text:
Honestly one of the best spa experiences I’ve had in a long time.
The place is clean, relaxing, and you feel good from the moment you walk in. But the real highlight for me was my therapist, Manita 12. She’s amazing. You can tell she really knows what she’s doing the pressure was perfect and she focused exactly where I needed it without me even explaining too much. Super super super

Definitely coming back, and for sure booking with Manita 12 again. Highly recommend. 🫶🏼

reviews.name: Wenyi Lee Stones
reviews.text:
During our five day stay in Bangkok, we (5 people) came here 3 times. Their price was reasonable and the environment was clean. 3 out of the 5 masseurs were good. I recommend their Thai massage but not oil massage. Even the masseur that I preferred and were very good at Thai massage did not do well in oil massage. I decided to have a more relaxing massage so I picked oil massage the third day, but they used exactly the same way as Thai massage and just put a layer of oil, which was actually quite uncomfortable.
In addition, since we made reservations for the next day they charged us deposit which was reasonable. However, the third time we paid full amount of money and the lady at the front desk did not give me back the deposit and even mentioned it. Until I finally finished my massage and went to her, she just said “oh yes, I need to return your deposit.” Not so honest.

reviews.name: JAS TLK
reviews.text:
Quick fix for my tired feet.
No. 35 is highly recommended by others and she's really good. Able to speak fluent mandarin and work on the points accurately.

Went back the following day for a full body massage before heading back home. Yes, by no. 35 again.

reviews.name: Illya Khomenko
reviews.text: Went in for a 60-min shoulder and neck massage. First was told to sit for ~15 min by the reception. After they put me in another room for ~10 min, the massage therapist came in and was surprised that I was sitting in a wrong room. They told me to go upstairs in a different room again where I was laying down for ~25-30 min before the masseuse came in and started the massage. The massage itself wasn’t great either, but the price is very reasonable.

reviews.name: Xwei
reviews.text:
By far the worst massage I had in Bangkok.
Environment js very noisy and non-relaxing, the massager has no idea what she is doing and constantly not hitting the right spot. The massage bed is very dirty and full of lint residue. Althoght it is relatively cheap compared to other parlous arojnd the corner, I do not recommend.

reviews.name: D K
reviews.text:

About 40mins on foot + legs
and 20 mins on neck and shoulders.

reviews.name: chun kiong goh
reviews.text: Short distance away opposite Platinum Fashion Mall, looks fairly new. Massage is affordable and masseuse was attentive knowing how much pressure to use. One of those rare shop that I have fall asleep during the massage.

reviews.name: Kalektika Kamil
reviews.text: Ansi 36 & Aew 38 gave us the best massage we have experienced ever. We bought 90 minutes but in the middle of process prolonged it for 120, just amazing!!

reviews.name: Changster00
reviews.text:
Had a 2 hr Thai massage with herbal compress ball. Massage was OK. They put us two in a 4 person room and sometime in the middle of it, a couple was sent to our room. The adult lady from Singapore probably haven't had massage before so she was either giggling or making noise when in "pain", disturbing the peace.
The room doesn't even have soft music and each time someone opens the door, you can hear the lobby and the staff and guests.
The worst is that the clothes they gave me is itchy and now you can see my chest is red. I think it's just me cos my son has no problem with his. But they should QC all!
Also, there's no hole for your face when they massage your back so I've got jaw and neck aches!
I would not go back again.

reviews.name: Vency Nguyen
reviews.text:
Hands down the best foot massage I’ve had in Bangkok. The therapists here are incredibly skilled and clearly know exactly what they’re doing. Every pressure point was spot-on strong where it needed to be, gentle where it mattered.

You can really feel the experience and training in their technique, not just random rubbing. They took their time, paid attention to tension points, and made the whole session deeply therapeutic and relaxing. The atmosphere was calm and professional, and the staff were warm and welcoming. We returned multiple times and highly recommend!

reviews.name: Sithavut Kayuraphan
reviews.text:
HomePro Charan Sanit Wong is a leading home improvement and renovation store located in Bangkok, offering a wide range of products and services for all your home needs. From construction materials to home decor, this store is a one-stop destination for homeowners, DIY enthusiasts, and professionals alike.

Product Range: One of the standout features of HomePro is its extensive selection of products. You can find everything from building materials, tools, and plumbing supplies to furniture, electrical appliances, and gardening equipment. The store also has a dedicated section for home decor, where you can discover various styles of furnishings and decorative items that cater to different tastes.

Quality and Pricing: HomePro is known for offering quality products at competitive prices. Many items are available at discounted rates, especially during sales events, making it a great option for those looking to undertake home projects without overspending. The store frequently stocks well-known brands, ensuring that customers can trust the quality of their purchases.

Atmosphere and Ambience: The shopping environment at HomePro Charan Sanit Wong is spacious and organized, with clearly labeled sections that make it easy to find what you’re looking for. The store is well-lit and clean, creating a pleasant shopping experience. Staff members are knowledgeable and readily available to assist with any inquiries or provide advice on home improvement projects.

Services Offered: In addition to its product offerings, HomePro provides various services, including delivery and installation. Customers can benefit from professional advice on home renovations and DIY projects, making it easier to execute their ideas with confidence.

Accessibility: HomePro Charan Sanit Wong is conveniently located with ample parking space for customers. It is easily accessible by public transport, making it a practical choice for those in the area.

Overall Impression: HomePro Charan Sanit Wong is an excellent destination for anyone looking to enhance their home. With its wide variety of products, competitive pricing, and helpful staff, it offers a comprehensive shopping experience for all your home improvement needs. Whether you’re tackling a small DIY project or planning a major renovation, HomePro is a reliable resource that can help bring your vision to life.

title: Yumoto Spa Private Onsen Bangkok
subTitle: ยูโมโต สปา ไพรเวท ออนเซน แบงค็อก
ownerDescription: Experience pure pleasure and deep relaxation at Yumoto Spa Private Onsen Bangkok. As a pioneer and one of Bangkok's only private onsen destinations, we expertly blend ancient Japanese Onsen bathing culture with traditional Thai massage techniques for an unforgettable spa journey. Immerse yourself in your very own private onsen, featuring special minerals that detoxify, heal, and rejuvenate. Our luxurious facilities also include a sauna, complemented by a full menu of professional services like Royal Thai Massage, Aromatherapy, body scrubs, and skin treatments. Discover a unique oasis in the city center to enhance your health, vitality, and well-being. Book your serene escape today!
address: 29 Sukhumvit 31, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Jacklyn Carlos
reviews.text: So happy to have found this wonderful place. <3 The private onsen with a sauna and spa fully equipped with a private bathroom and shower is a lovely way to relax from the busy atmosphere of Bangkok. My neck and shoulder massage with Mook was amazing and she really helped me with my shoulder pain. 10/10 and would definitely come back! Thank you so much for the wonderful experience.

reviews.name: Tiger Yotsawat
reviews.text:
A really complete relaxing ritual --- shower followed by sauna, then a dip in the onsen, ending with aroma massage. A truly private experience, perfect for couples.

The best aroma massage in Bangkok.

The only reason for the 4-star is because the onsen section was partitioned from the road only by a bamboo fence. Visually private but you can hear the vehicles outside very clearly, especially those loud motorcycles. You soon forget about it though.

reviews.name: pa ph
reviews.text: This is the best private spa in Bangkok, perfect for a private getaway. The atmosphere is great, the spa is clean, the staff are all wonderful and friendly, and the massage Noi therapists are incredibly skilled. It was so relaxing! I will definitely be back again and again. Thank you!

reviews.name: Cha Lim (ชา)
reviews.text: Thai massage masseurs are really good! They even check where to avoid before starting and ensure their pressure is appropriate afterwards. If you’re nearby, you might want to try Thai massage!

reviews.name: AreeyaSweets
reviews.text: My boyfriend wanted to book a spa day for my birthday and we ended up coming to Yumoto! I loved every moment from when we walked in. the space was very clean and calming. We got the scrub and massage package, and I felt so soft and relaxed after. The massage was so good that I almost feel asleep. I highly recommend and would come back again the next time I visit Thailand.

reviews.name: Eugenia Cervantes
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible experience. My husband and I went for the Yumoto signature experience that includes 45 minutes of private onsen use, a 60-min scrub and a 60-min massage. Our massage artists were absolutely wonderful, really worked out some of the knots in my back and the whole experience was truly relaxing. Cannot recommend this enough to anyone looking for a truly relaxing time

reviews.name: Brooke
reviews.text:
Yumoto is amazing! The zen aesthetic ambiance, when you first walk in, is beautiful and instantly puts you in a relaxed mood. The sauna/onsen was beautiful, clean, and great temperature. Perfect to help me relax some tense muscles recovering from an injury. After that a 60 min Thai massage with Noi was AMAZING. I've gotten dozens and dozens of both Thai and oil massage over 3+ years and Noi by far is the most skilled. Can't wait to go back again. Ask for Noi!!!

Edit: I've been back three times now and still love coming here! Great service and beautiful ambiance!

reviews.name: Phixx
reviews.text: My husband and I did the promotional 2hr and 45min couple package. The package includes Onsen, sauna, body scrub, and aromatherapy Of all of the couple spa packages we did, Yumoto is one the top of the best experience. Sauna and onsen relaxes your body, and the massage is so good, you don’t want it to end. The ambiance is perfect. One of Ia few private onsen which is perfect for a date night. The therapists Mook and Noi are very skillful and respectful. The gave just the right pressure and location as asked. I will definitely be back.

reviews.name: cheryl Samson
reviews.text:
My husband and I had the best anniversary experience at Yumoto Spa. We booked a 90 minute private onsen experience and it was perfect because we didn’t feel rushed and we could take our time enjoying both the onsen and the Himalayan salt sauna.

Afterwards, we were able to enjoy our own massages. He enjoyed his aromatherapy massage for an hour and I thoroughly enjoyed my 90 minute massage with Noi. So much that I forgot how healing Thai massages were.

I would definitely recommend going to Yumoto Spa after landing in Bangkok especially to help you to adjust to the jet lag after a long flight. It will be worthwhile & a memorable experience.

reviews.name: sangkent elliot
reviews.text: 5/5 experience, no notes. The onsen was super clean, calm, and perfectly curated—instant reset mode. Followed by a Thai massage that was chef’s kiss: strong but精准, totally knew where the tension was. Therapist was professional, skilled, and consistent throughout. Walked out feeling lighter, refreshed, and low-key reborn. Definitely a high-ROI self-care stop. Will circle back again. ❤️ ❤️ Thank you na ka

reviews.name: Lukas Langer
reviews.text:
We recently tried the Stress Reliever couple package at Yumoto Spa, and it was absolutely worth it. The combination of 45 minutes in a private onsen and sauna followed by a 60‑minute full‑body Thai massage was exceptional. The price‑to‑quality ratio is outstanding, and the whole experience truly lives up to its name — deeply relaxing and rejuvenating.
I love Thai massages, and this one made me feel completely renewed. I can highly recommend this package and the spa to anyone looking for a unique, refreshing wellness experience.

reviews.text: Great spa experience. Private onsen with relax massage. For those we need your sauna in Bangkok, this is the place to go. It really value for money.

reviews.text: I would like to deduct 1 star for the staff’s lack of attentiveness. After finishing drank tea in no one opened the door for us or even said thank you when we left. The atmosphere of the shop is very nice, but the service is not impressive.

reviews.name: Teresa Y
reviews.text: Came here with my husband and did the sauna/onsen, scrub and massage package. We were in the Camellia room and it was heavenly. The onsen and sauna area was very peaceful and refreshing - also beautifully decorated. The massage and scrub were a bit of a blur because we were so incredibly relaxed and enjoyed it so much. I am a deep tissue massage type of person and that was one of the best ones I’ve had. Kung was intensely strong yet managed to put me in such a relaxed state that I fell asleep in minutes. This was a lovely experience for us both and I highly recommend anyone who wants a tranquil retreat in the middle of the busy city to come here.

reviews.name: cwing brian
reviews.text: Yumoto spa is a great place to come. Best onsen experience and massage both very good. I recommend those who want to escape from busy life for few hours. Definitely coming back.

reviews.name: PP
reviews.text:
I chose the onsen + aroma massage package.
The atmosphere was nice, the staff were friendly, and the service was good.
The massage itself was really great.
The only downside was that the air conditioner started dripping water about 10 minutes into the massage, which was a bit distracting and made it hard to fully relax.

reviews.name: Khue Huynh
reviews.text: My partner and I went to this spa and had a wonderful experience. Booking was easy via Facebook messenger, with very quick responses. The onsen and sauna were a dream, and both Lucky and Kung were very skilled and careful with massaging us. 100% recommend this spa if you’re looking for a wonderful time.

reviews.name: Venturafamily Ventura
reviews.text: I had such an amazing experience here at Yumoto Spa Private Onsen Bangkok!!! From the time I stepped in the door and my boots were removed by the receptionist I knew I had booked the right massage. I had two AMAZING young ladies who made me feel beyond comfortable especially as a plus size American woman. I was massaged from my head to my toes in a four hand 90 min massage. I wish I could have just slept in this place. I highly recommend booking them. I must say they are on the pricey side but it’s worth every dime. Plus I did order a four hand 90 min and a 45min private Onsen. Which I must add was cleaner than the board of health. I will MOST DEFINITELY 💯 be back.

title: Market Village Suvarnabhumi
subTitle: มาร์เก็ตวิลเลจ สุวรรณภูมิ
description: Mid-size mall offering various stores, including a supermarket, plus dining, banks & a post office.
address: 99, 29, Bang Phli Yai, Bang Phli District, Samut Prakan 10540, Thailand
plusCode: JPJ6+QG Bang Phli Yai, Bang Phli District, Samut Prakan, Thailand

reviews.name: S SRIPRABA SUBRAMANIAM
reviews.text:
I visited Market Village Suvarnabhumi during my stay near Suvarnabhumi Airport and it was a very convenient place for shopping, dining, and relaxing before my journey. The mall is spacious, clean, and mainly visited by locals, so the atmosphere feels more comfortable and less crowded compared to some Bangkok city malls.

There are many restaurants, cafés, supermarkets, IT shops, clothing stores, and daily essentials all in one place. I especially liked the local food section and small market area where you can find affordable Thai food and snacks. It’s also a good place to spend time if you have a flight layover or stay near the airport.

reviews.name: Ebin Sebastian
reviews.text: I had to stay in Bangkok for one night due to a flight cancellation, and I think it's a good thing now because I got an opportunity to visit this place. I took this opportunity and visited here. Everything is great. Very affordable prices. There are a lot of food, clothes, electronics, and everything here. Once we get a cab from the hotel at a very low cost, we can do some very useful shopping.

reviews.name: Jk
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Market Village is a great shopping mall with a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. 🛍️😊 It has a nice mix of fashion stores, supermarkets, restaurants, and everyday essentials, making it a convenient place to shop. The mall is clean, spacious, and easy to get around.

The food options are excellent! 🍜🍔☕ There are plenty of restaurants, cafés, and dessert shops to choose from, whether you’re looking for a quick meal or a place to relax with family and friends. The atmosphere is calm and much less crowded than many city malls, which I really appreciated. 🌿✨

Overall, Market Village is a wonderful place for shopping, dining, and spending a relaxing afternoon. 🌟 It offers everything you need in one location, with friendly service and a comfortable environment. I would definitely visit again! ❤️👍

reviews.name: Stumbled Upon Places
reviews.text:
This is a very new and clean shopping centre in the suburbs. There is no train to here but by car it is convenient or take a taxi from Bang Na.
A good selection of shops and a large Lotus's supermarket. Also several restaurants and a good sized food court.

reviews.name: Kimi & Lucy
reviews.text: Relaxed, quiet mall with many stores. There are plenty of pet stores, clothing shops, and restaurants. It was difficult to decide on what to eat!

reviews.name: Peter Tay
reviews.text: I visited Market Village Suvarnabhumi and found it very convenient as it is  near the airport and our hotel is nearby. The mall is clean, has plenty of parking, and offers a good mix of shops, restaurants, and a cinema. Great for a quick stop to eat, shop, or relax before a flight.

reviews.name: Payong Chatwiroon

Parking lots were expanded, customers both Thais and foreigners visit in huge amount much more than during these 2-3 years and increasing.
According to its location near Suwanaphume, the same as others department stores around this airport gain more utilities too.

title: BDMS Wellness Clinic
ownerDescription: BDMS Wellness Clinic takes the science of wellness to another level by gathering the finest minds and technology to identify the optimum path to quality longevity. We believe that prevention is key to living a long, healthy and fulfilling life. We offer a comprehensive range of predictive diagnostic services and preventive pathways to reduce the risk of avoidable chronic diseases. Results are interpreted by neuroscientists, regenerative medicine experts, heart specialists and sports physicians to develop personalized health optimization programs.
address: 2/4 Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

reviews.name: Gamonpat Sanganunt
reviews.text:
An excellent wellness clinic with highly respected doctors across a range of specialties, supported by professional trainers, therapists, and a friendly, attentive team.

The clinic is fully equipped and offers a wide variety of classes, including functional training, strength training, yoga, and Pilates. I consulted an orthopaedic surgeon here for an ankle issue, and after just two weeks of training according to his diagnosis, my symptoms had completely resolved.

The clinic also features a sauna and onsen. The facilities are exceptionally well maintained and cleaned regularly throughout the day.

The clinic offers a private and tranquil environment where you can focus on your health, fitness, and overall well-being right in the heart of a bustling city.

reviews.name: Edgar Nguyen (6768)
reviews.text: 2026.08.07 visited.  Very impressive, good service, spacious, efficient and everyone helpful.  There is a beautiful lounge, can rest after checkup.  Good

reviews.name: Ramji Singh
reviews.text:
My experience at BDMS Wellness Clinic was truly magnificent. From the very first moment, I felt supported by a highly professional, attentive, and genuinely caring team.

Taking the hormonal and supplement Blueprint was a wonderful and eye-opening experience. The assessment is deep, clear, and fully personalized, allowing me to better understand my current health status and receive precise recommendations to optimize my wellbeing, energy, and long-term vitality.

The facilities are impeccable, the atmosphere is calm and welcoming, and the medical and technological standards are world-class. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone seeking an integrative, preventive, and conscious approach to health and wellness.

I will definitely return.
Thank you for such an excellent experience.

reviews.name: Alhasan Kaabous Alzaabi
reviews.text: Highly recommend BDMS Wellness Clinic in Thailand for health checks. Top-tier facilities, professional doctors, and a special thanks to the translating staff—they made communication seamless and the experience stress-free. A+ service.

reviews.name: Stan Mayfield
reviews.text: Friendly professional services with reasonable prices to manage health care. 2nd time visiting this establishment with great things to say both times.

reviews.text: I have been coming here for health check up for years, very good service with relaxing environment.   The staffs are very friendly, docs also give the very good advice for health care. Khun Golf is very polite and take care of me very good in every steps. The lounge was also nice.

reviews.name: Jerry Cheung

This is my third time to the clinic. I come back every 1 to 2 years to get treatment here because of their excellent service and results.

reviews.name: Eric Green

There’s so much value it’s difficult to pinpoint any one service that I value more than the other except the staff. They are very professional and efficient. Will definitely come back next year… God Willing.

reviews.name: Sirikamol Kamolyabutra
reviews.text: Staff especially Ms. Mai is very helpful, service-minded, and professional. The check up process is very smooth and well organized. The place is clean and well decorated. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: The consultation services provided were exceptional, and the staff demonstrated a high level of expertise, making the treatment received here highly valuable

reviews.name: Marjorie del rosario
reviews.text: All the experience was really good. The staff was really kind and professional, especially Golf who help me a lot with the process. I recommend highly this place. I will come back for sure

reviews.text: Hair concerns get treatment here. They offer a wide range of professional service including scalp treatment, hair growth consultations, plasma injection, red LED therapy and more. I received the hair and scalp scrub which is highly recommended for the red LED therapy. Staff is nice and the hair doctor specialist suggested the scalp cleanse And red LED therapy. reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Pornsawan at BWC Dietitian.
She is professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about her patients.
Her advice was practical, personalized, and easy to follow.
She took the time to answer all my questions with patience and clarity.
I highly recommend Pornsawan to anyone looking for expert nutrition guidance.

They took the time to explain things clearly and never made me feel rushed. The overall service was professional, thoughtful, and very well organized. I truly appreciated the level of care and hospitality shown by the team.

Thank you to the BDMS Wellness staff for making the experience such a positive one. I would definitely recommend their services.

reviews.name: S I
reviews.text: It was very good service especially Khun Golf who guided me each check up. The environment is very relaxed compared to bigger general hospital so you can have a health check up under relaxed mood.

reviews.text:
BDMS Wellness Clinic is world-class! The facility feels like a luxury spa stunning, clean, calming, and top-tier in every way. The staff is the definition of polite, professional, and compassionate. From concierge style guidance to seamless care across departments, they’ve mastered the patient experience.

A special recognition to Dr. Pinyadapat Vacharanukrauh, M.D., Ph.D. for going above and beyond. She was incredibly thorough, patient with every question I asked, and answered each one with care. Her kindness, warmth, and attention to detail made me feel truly seen and supported. She took her time to explain everything clearly and never made me feel rushed.

If you want preventive care done right  BDMS sets the standard. Exceptional facility. Exceptional people. Exceptional care!

reviews.name: Sofie
reviews.text:
This is the best clinic I have ever been to.
I went to the dentist here and felt so cared fore, even though it was quite a troublesome issue. The team is so patient, nice and through. They made sure to check up with me through texts between my appointments, to make sure I was doing okay, and they really took their time explaining all of the details. The dentists are super professional and extremely good at their job, and the facilities are amazing. I can only recommend this place.

title: Bon Marché Market Park
subTitle: บองมาร์เช่ มาร์เก็ตพาร์ค
description: Street food, handicrafts & produce are all draws at this enclosed marketplace with outdoor seating.
address: 105 Thetsaban Songkhro Rd, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

reviews.name: Xoom Too
reviews.text:
The whole place is very clean, spread out, and there are many options with seating area towards the back (or center of the area) but one thing I noticed is that Google Maps says this place opens at 5am but the vendors say they open at 8am-10:30am which is a big difference. There are a bunch of food stalls of Chinese & Thai foods and you’re bound to find something by the selection.

There are also a handful of stalls where you can buy fresh foods such as fruits, veggies, and meats. I ended up arriving at 6:15am-6:30am and only 5 stalks had lights on but we’re still preparing food but I got lucky with 1 that had been open. Overall, it’s an alright food court/market but it is kind of randomly located so you might have to take public transport or a car to arrive.

reviews.name: Katethip Varanyuwatana
reviews.text:
Community market with all kinds of activities to do. Ranging from simple local produce, ready to eat street, restaurants, fashion clothing area, gems stall, gym, children's tutorials school and even fortune teller stall.
During weekdays, majority of the shoppers are local and seniors citizens in the area. However during weekend, majority of shoppers are family.
There's plenty of parking space at the back of the market and it very clean.

reviews.name: Sandee Tour
reviews.text: Lovely market in the area. Very packed around ready to eat food court area. Mostly office worker and elders living in the area. The food court area has large sessions of Thai streets food to choose from. Ranging from braised pork broth to Thai version of Vietnamese food. Great for a good lunch break and quick shopping

reviews.name: Dach Skol
reviews.text:
A community mall with a big pond in the middle. It has some seating around so you can enjoy your meal or siping your coffee with relax atmosphere.
The mall combining between shopping area, wet market, food court, restaurants and English language Institute. Some shops still closed and may open soon. Some shops are under construction and will be ready soon.
Some rental spaceareavailable.

Parking are availablearound its community and on parking building.

reviews.name: Astrologer Pa
reviews.text: A peaceful European-style market park in Bangkok, located near Chatuchak and BTS Wat Samian Nari.

reviews.name: Wisanu Tuntawiroon
reviews.text: Bon Marché Market Park is a well-designed mixed-use market that blends traditional Thai market charm with modern convenience. Located in the Chatuchak-Lat Yao area, it’s a great destination for a quick lunch, grocery shopping, or a casual stroll with family.

reviews.name: Nicholae Enabe
reviews.text: You can buy fresh fruits and vegetables in this market. A quiet place where people eat various options of meals.

reviews.name: ATK ATRLSK
reviews.text:
Bon Marché Market Park (บองมาร์เช่ มาร์เก็ตพาร์ค) is a popular community market in Chatuchak, Bangkok, known for its clean environment, wide variety of street food, local restaurants, handicrafts, and relaxed atmosphere. It’s rated highly (4.3/5 from over 5,800 reviews) and is especially loved by locals for weekend visits.

What Visitors Say
- Clean and organized: Many reviews highlight that the market is well-maintained compared to other local markets.
- Food variety: A strong mix of Thai street food, bakeries, and cafes. Popular for authentic flavors and casual dining.
- Convenience: Plenty of parking and easy access by taxi.
- Atmosphere: Relaxed, family-friendly, with both indoor and outdoor seating.

Hilight
- Wide selection of food and shops
- Affordable prices
- Clean facilities
- Easy parking and transport access

Best For...
- Casual weekend visits with family or friends
- Food lovers seeking authentic Thai street food and desserts
- Relaxed shopping for handicrafts and local goods

reviews.name: Atthapol Ong
reviews.text:
It is market of fresh fruits and ready to eat multinational food. Also hundred shops for shopping and services, ex, tea, coffee, clothes, dental care, hair salon, music school. Thanks to a big pond at the center of market, create cool air circulation through all market.
Parking during lunch and after office hour is challanging, but finally you will get one spot.

reviews.name: Marco Fattore
reviews.text: A very local market with everything one needs to have a good time and do some nice shopping without the hassle of those big touristic places. There are typical Thai souvenirs, fruits, foods, ready-to-eat dishes and a eating area. Very nice.

reviews.name: Chananvit Wayuparb
reviews.text: One of the cleanest market in Thailand. Big open air canteen near the pond. Parking lot and parking is quite sufficient except the peak hours such as lunch time and weekend. Two very pleasant cafe next to the pond that could allow you to enjoy the coffee. Starbucks is just open a few days ago but I still prefer to sip my coffee at Cafe olak which operating since the market open 30years ago..

reviews.name: Pongpit Pinsai
reviews.text:
• Bon Marché Market is a lifestyle destination located in the Prachachuen / Bang Sue area. The space is well organized and features a pool as its iconic centerpiece, adding a natural and relaxing touch within the city.

• In my opinion, the highlight of this place is the food market and food court. The prices may be relatively higher than average, but they are well justified by the quality of food and overall cleanliness. A great place to enjoy a calm atmosphere with good food and convenient facilities.

reviews.name: Marine Mary
reviews.text: Lots of premiums food and groceries.  Many restaurants you can sit and relax here. Or other services like spa or artists learning you can also find here. With new renovation buildings you will find more good places to chillax

reviews.name: Rei Alexandra Aoyama
reviews.text:
Bon Marché is essentially an open mall. There are a lot of things to offer here. There is a section for food court, a “wet” market for meat and fruits. There is even a section for jewelry stores - good Thai jewelry too. There are also banks in the mall.

The food court are reasonably priced with a lot of options. There are also several restaurants.

Very popular with seniors.

reviews.name: S F
reviews.text: Nice and clean open air shopping center on the outskirt of Bangkok. They have everything here from street food, bake goods, grocery store, jewelry store, and massage parlor. Easy parking but could get crowded on the weekends.

reviews.name: Payong Chatwiroon
reviews.text: “Bon Marche “ is french, the meaning of this name is compatible to good market, fresh , hygiene and good for health. There are many villages, commercial buildings , department stores, temple, police station , universities,including the road ( super highway, expressway and good construction highways that easy access to this market) customers who work in the offices , students and villagers nearby often stop over for their meals. Availability inside the market are foods center, desserts, orange juice, clothings and every goods in needed for daily life. Banks and commercial buildings open for service too.A shop sell delicious fried banana, taro and yam ,customers queue up to buy for tasting, many buyers are regular visitors , after their meal,they will buy back home or for their friends in offices.I have to wait for 20 minutes to reach the front queue.

reviews.name: Jeremiah Leaman
reviews.text: This place has a very nice atmosphere. It's nice and quiet but as a result not many shops open here compared to other markets. Still it's nice to walk around in.

reviews.name: Sukawat Keratimanoch
reviews.text: Good place to come for lunch. There are outdoor shopping market and food court next to the pond. A few food choice to choose from Thai, chinese, Vietnamese to Halal menu. Good price is acceptable but they take only cash. On the weekend, it’s quite busy at lunch time but you can still find a spot to sit and enjoy live music. You are required to bring your finished plate to the cleaning spot. You can also enjoy fresh food shopping and fashion after your meal. Parking is charged and limited.

reviews.name: Thong char
reviews.text: A community mall with open-air food court, a selection of restaurants and shops. A coffee shop is relaxing place with water pond view. Quite crowed around lunch time.

reviews.name: Jerry Napombhejara
reviews.text:
Clean fresh outdoor groceries market.
Many choices of prepared ready to eat meals.

title: Food Mart
subTitle: ฟู้ดมาร์ท
