plusCode: WV39+XV Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri, Thailand

reviews.name: Jan Jenda
reviews.text: I’ve lived next to this store for several years, and today was my first time visiting it. I was pleasantly surprised by the wide variety of items available here. There’s a large selection of Western goods, fresh meat, fruits, and vegetables. A wide range of dairy products. Many types of bread, various baguettes, etc., ice cream, and frozen foods. They also sell cleaning and laundry supplies and household goods. There’s even a section for pets. I don’t have to drive to Big C anymore; I’m happy to shop here.

reviews.name: Benji Harrison
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Food Mart is an excellent grocery store with a great selection of local and imported products. The store is clean, well organized, and easy to browse, making shopping quick and enjoyable. I especially appreciate the variety of fresh produce, dairy, meats, snacks, and international items that can be hard to find elsewhere. The staff are friendly, prices are fair, and it's a reliable place to stock up on everything you need. A great supermarket for both locals and visitors.

reviews.name: J Hern
reviews.text:
I would like to give it a 4.5 but it is not possible.

Positives:
Great location
Good bakery
Farang products hard to find other places
Small but usually available parking
Fast output
Great opening hours

Negatives:
The size limitation makes impossible to have more products, so some desired products are not there.
Price of some products is over average

Overall a great place to shop if you are on the area.

reviews.name: MarioSonicGames dotCom
reviews.text: They have an exceptional range of different types of fresh bread available here, including French baguettes and delicious ready-made sandwiches. They also have a huge selection of foreign beers and wines. Irish Guinness is my favourite beer of all time, and they usually have it in stock. For that alone it's a very good supermarket.

reviews.name: Daton Chris
reviews.text:
It is even more convenient than going to North Pattaya, coming here is easier in terms of transportation. After getting off the bus, I can just walk around or go to the beach within 10 minutes by feet.

The selection of products inside of this super market is very well especially the oven bread section, they are more like western style unlike most bakery in Bangkok that is light and more airy.

Now the bathroom is renovated which is excellent !!

reviews.name: Юлия Евсеева
reviews.text:
Food Mart is one of my favorite supermarkets in Pattaya ❤️

They have a huge selection of products — fresh meat, fish, delicacies, bakery items, sweets, imported products, and so much more 🛒🥩🐟🍰

Everything is always fresh and well organized, and shopping here is very comfortable. I often come here for groceries and always find everything I need.

The store has a great atmosphere, good quality products, and an excellent ассортимент of food from different countries.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a really good supermarket in Pattaya ✨

reviews.name: Jay Roams Thailand
reviews.text: This faded looking supermarket is actually an excellent place to find all types of western imported food and drink at half the price of the big supermarkets. Ready made food like sandwiches and pasta is excellent. Bread, cold cuts, fruit, dry pasta, fresh dips and sauces are all excellent. Plenty of parking in the front and on the road to Jomtien if you're going that way. I've lived here for 20 years and never seen these types of food this cheap. I'll be back here for sure.

reviews.name: Daniel Mommens
reviews.text: good inventory of western luxuries at reasonable price.   It's convenient to the bus terminal.  The interior needs an update

reviews.name: Sorin David
reviews.text: I was looking for sardines in olive oil, as ChatGPT said this would be my best choice. Disappointing,  but the store is very well stocked if youre looking for anything else...

reviews.name: Darren Ruparel
reviews.text: Has so many foreign products.....some cheaper then Big C , 7/11 etc. fresh bread everyday. Also ready made meals that need microwave

reviews.name: Tim Mutimer
reviews.text: Fantastic selection of everything.  Great supermarket.  Fresh baked Breads. Fresh desserts. Meat section.

reviews.name: mark wirsig
reviews.text: Conveniently located... Good variety of imported products.. reasonable prices. Awesome bread.

reviews.name: Rusty Wilson
reviews.text: Glad we found it.  Decent prices and a great selection of alcohol.  Meat selection is decent and some things you cannot find at other places at a decent price.

reviews.name: Monsieur Pôle
reviews.text: While looking for tobacco, I discovered this nice shop. I usually smoke Pueblo Blue, but unfortunately it was sold out today. As an alternative, Google suggested Stanley White, which turned out to be a pleasant surprise.

reviews.name: Douglas Alan Cummins
reviews.text:
Very large Home Pro, with most everything you are looking for, in stock and for show!
Helpful staff, clean, nicely done.
(If you are not familiar with a particular location, you should call to have sure they have Wyatt you are looking for "in stock".  Many of the smaller stores can only order items from the Home Pro catalogue.)

Aside from the fact they are NOT Handicap friendly, which it's more a problem with the mall as a whole...
At least they did have occasional seating for patrons, but as we found out, even the benches were not handicapped friendly,, as they are very low, and quite difficult to stand up from.

Overall, great store!  Okay prices, so ALWAYS ask about the next Promotion Sale!  Why they don't just offer lower prices, to make it better for consumers, idk.  You just have to come back Again, as the next Sale.  Fortunately, the sales are frequent, and you can negotiate on large items.  They also deliver most large items free, to the local metro area!  (Didn't ask about installation.)

Best tactic, when buying large items, is to shop online and have a solid understanding of the expected price. Then, call the store or check the website (both, really) for the next Sales Event, and plan accordingly...  Always ask about Delivery and such ahead of time!  Also, on expensive items, they usually offer promotions like "No Interest with 10 months Payment Plans" - Nice!

title: Herbal Ground Spa
ownerDescription:
A quiet haven that helps you escape the life's hustle and bustle.
A 10 minutes stroll from BTS Phrom Phong Station takes you to Herbal Ground Spa on Sukhumvit 39. It's in the middle of the city, but it's peaceful, simple, and offers a private setting. Surrounded by lush greenery, you'll find peace and relaxation with beautiful nature while you rest and unwind from the daily grind.

We select products that are chemical-free and made from natural ingredients, including a variety of herbs that we hand-pick for our spa.
We also provide massage, skincare, and beauty care treatments, all derived from well-trained and experienced therapists.

Invite you to experience a complete spa that can treat both your body and your mind.
address: 51/9 Sukhumvit 39, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

affordable and good massage.
did the 3hr package (body scrub, signature massage and hot oil head shoulder massage). it was very comfortable and the different components complemented each other very well. i felt very refreshed after the session. there is also shampoo and blow dry after the oil head massage so you can leave feeling refreshed. will definitely be back again when i'm back in bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review. We’re so happy you enjoyed the full spa experience and felt refreshed after your treatments. We’re looking forward to seeing you again the next time you’re in Bangkok. 🙏🏻😊

reviews.name: David Tachon
reviews.text:
I was recommended this place by a colleague who told me it was very professional and that the massage was really well done. This is already my second time here, and I can honestly say the technicians are of very high quality. The massages are excellent, the space is very clean, and they offer tea both before and after the session, which is a very nice touch.

I would honestly come back every week. Highly recommended, especially for the quality of the service and the technicians.

My therapist was Kick, and for now he is the one I recommend to everyone. I haven’t tried the others yet, but from my friend’s experience (he comes here often), they are all at a very good level. What I really appreciate is the welcome before the massage, where you can explain the areas of pain or general discomfort, so the experience feels truly personalized.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed and thoughtful review. We’re truly happy to hear that you chose to come back for a second visit and that you continue to enjoy the quality of our massages, cleanliness, and overall experience.

We’re especially glad to know that kik took great care of you, and we’ll be sure to share your kind words with her. It also means a lot to us that you appreciate our consultation process before the treatment, as we always aim to provide a personalized experience for each guest.

Thank you again for your recommendation and continued support. We look forward to welcoming you back soon. 🙏🏻😊

Good value (though it’s a promotion price currently), interior is beautifully decorated, has a strong local Thai products ethos, & the therapist did an amazing job. I did the 2hrs Herbal Ground Refresh program. Amazing Thai herbal products! Will be back & recommend to others!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful and thoughtful feedback. We’re so glad you enjoyed the Herbal Ground Refresh  and appreciated our atmosphere and products. Your kind words truly mean a lot to us. We look forward to welcoming you back soon. 🙏🏻😊

reviews.name: Wang Xianqi
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Herbal Ground Spa with the 4-hour Deep Sleep Package. My therapist, Cake, was excellent. She took care of me throughout the entire session, and I was pleasantly surprised that she was my same therapist from start to finish, I had expected different therapists for different parts of the package.

The body, facial, leg, and head massages were all excellent. The treatment was so relaxing that I had a deep, restful sleep during the session, which was exactly what I needed.

The spa itself has a beautiful, calming, and peaceful atmosphere that makes it easy to unwind. The prices are reasonable, the only minor downside is that it's a little far from the BTS station, but the experience was well worth the journey.

I highly recommend Herbal Ground Spa, especially if you're looking to truly relax and recharge. Thank you, Cake, for the wonderful service!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful and thoughtful review. We’re delighted you enjoyed our 4-hour Deep Sleep Package and had such a relaxing experience. reviews.name: Navruza Aliqulova

Nikko Thai Massage was truly the most beautiful and memorable experience I had while exploring massage places in Bangkok. A very special thank you to Ms. Meaw, who is an outstanding professional. Her skill, precision, and warm presence turned the session into something truly exceptional. She has a remarkable touch and a true sense of care that made me feel completely relaxed and renewed.

Navruza from Tajikistan ❤️

reviews.name: Камила Курманова
reviews.text: I had an incredible Thai massage today and I'm still floating on a cloud! The therapist was so skilled and attentive, finding all the right spots that needed attention. The combination of stretching, acupressure, and deep tissue work left me feeling completely rejuvenated – like a new person. The atmosphere was so peaceful and authentic. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for true relaxation and rejuvenation!

reviews.name: Jai-La Harrison
reviews.text: Got the best Thai massage from Korn! It was a really good price and the best quality. A 10 out of 10 experience. I will definitely come back.

reviews.name: E K
reviews.text:
Reserved a 5pm slot after looking at the positive reviews but I left feeling slightly disappointed.

I waited till 5.20pm for my turn and before paying, I confirm that I will be given 3 female masseuse to which the staff said okay. When it was time to head in, there was a male staff attending to my father and when I reminded her of my prior request. She gave me a face like a made the most absurd request. She said there are no more female masseuse because we are so busy. If we want a female massuse,  we have to wait longer. I reminded her of our conversation earlier and she turned around to speak to another staff who then approached me to said the same thing.

They then rushed me to my room while I tried to ask her how long it will take. But she got annoyed,cut my sentence and asked me to move ahead because I'm in a different room from my parents.

I'm giving 2 stars purely because after waiting, my parents said that their masseuse was alright. Mine was sub par with some hit and misses. Overall, I felt that I will be able to get a better experience elsewhere. The staff are overwhelmed and get irritated easily.

reviews.name: Dương Nguyên
reviews.text: Good service, all people are very nice. I have excilent experience. Will come back again. Khun Miew's skills is go good.

reviews.name: Master
reviews.text: I am very upset about my massage experience here today, August 23, 2026. I had a one-hour massage with a woman, and 12,500 baht went missing from my wallet. It was a terrible experience. The massage therapist was undisciplined. I do not recommend going here. When I noticed my money was missing, the employee returned it to me and begged me not to tell the owner. She even hugged my legs to plead with me. When my massage was over, I left feeling terrible.

reviews.name: Juanita P.M.
reviews.text:
**Honestly the worst massage experience in Bangkok.**

Don’t let the cozy, Japanese-sounding name fool you. Nothing about this place lives up to it.

The beds are rock hard, literally felt like lying on a wooden plank. I get that some people might like a super firm bed, but it was not comfortable or relaxing at all. Plus, the masseuses completely ruined the vibe by chatting with each other non-stop, starting from the second they washed our feet.

The space itself feels like a sketchy, rundown top floor of a shop house. The room was tiny, the ceiling was super low, and it smelled dusty.

Once the massage actually started, the staff just kept talking over us. We were so annoyed and unrelaxed that we walked out 5 minutes into our 60-minute session. We didn’t even bother asking for a refund because we just wanted to get out of there as fast as possible. Skip this place!

reviews.name: Emily Zhang
reviews.text: The location is very good, and the service is also very good, especially NET and Pang. I tried foot and full body massage this time, which is super comfortable. I will come again next time.

reviews.name: yingxin ye
reviews.text: The first day I came was Thursday afternoon, the experience was really good. The place is neat and clean. Massage was comfortable so I come here again today, on Saturday night(I spent 40 mins from far away just for to come back to this same place). However, there are lots of customers on Saturday night, we need to wait for a bit and then the man on the front desk get me really mad. I says I expect a massage that focus more on head, because last time when I came, the lady said the head bundle will focus more on the head. But this man didn’t hear what I’m saying at all, he is keep talking and keep yelling at me that there is no massage bundle will focus on head only(The main point is he keep saying when I was explaining what I want‼️That’s why I feel disrespectful ). I said I totally understand there won’t be a head only massage. But this man didn’t hear to me at all, which piss me off and get me so mad. I felt I didn’t get respected so I decided to leave. Very disappointed at this store and never come back. I was supposed to recommend this store in social media but now I won’t.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear madam,
we afraid we have nothing to do with this review. As the review above, it refers to other massage service parlor. 
We are Nikko Thai Massage. 
Please kindly remove the unrelated review. Thank you very much for your kind gesture.

reviews.name: MaLaengPorr
reviews.text:
I brought my dad in for a massage and booked one for myself too. We both had the 90 minute aroma massage and it was such a lovely, relaxing experience. The space was calm and welcoming, and everything felt very professional.

My massage with Kun Oy คุณอ้อย was amazing, and my dad really enjoyed his massage with Kun Sauy คุณสวย. We both left feeling refreshed and relaxed. reviews.name: NNchan
reviews.text:
A massage shop located in the Bangrak area. All chairs are in the same room and along the walkway to the upper floors, so it’s quite noisy with customers and staff talking. The staff also chat with each other during the massage, which affects the relaxation experience. Overall, the service is good but could be improved by addressing these issues.

Not sure if my original review was taken down, but if it was — don’t be surprised why the rating here might seem higher than the actual experience.

reviews.name: KTran
reviews.text: Came to Siam Serene Massage to recover after a long travel day on my first trip to Bangkok. The massage was excellent and exactly what I needed to relax and recharge. The facilities were very clean and the staff was welcoming. Five stars!

reviews.name: Irma Maulida
reviews.text: Oh my! I had one of the best massages I’ve ever had in my life! Kit was so good! She knew where to focus. And the pain in my neck was gone!!! I recommend this place, and find Kit! Also, I will be back again whenever I am in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Kate A
reviews.text: Best massage during my trip to Thailand. Exceptional service, starting from giving slippers when you first walk in to giving hot tea after your massage. The masseuses are extremely strong and are very skilled at what they do.

reviews.name: Charlotte Grondin
reviews.text:
It’s was AMAZIIIIING !

This was the best thing we did here in Bangkok! We'll do it as many times as possible during our vacation. It was so amazing! I recommend it 100%. If I could give 10 out of 5 stars, I would. Thanks again! You're fantastic and very professional. Can't wait to come back!

reviews.name: T
reviews.text: I come to Bangkok regularly.  This is my go to place for a relaxing massage.  Moji was amazing.  Gentle but firm touch.  Recommend over and over again.

reviews.name: Kimsong Eng
reviews.text:
I’ve been to this place more than five times. Some of the older therapists only work properly for the first 20 minutes, and then they start slacking off. Their body movements look exaggerated, but they barely apply any real pressure with their hands.

When you ask them to use more pressure, they suddenly make it really uncomfortable, and some even seem to pinch your skin with their nails on purpose.

They’ve been doing this job for so many years — don’t they know what kind of pressure makes customers feel comfortable and what makes them feel uncomfortable? The skill level between different therapists varies a lot.

This time, the experience was even worse than before, and the price isn’t cheap either.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback and for visiting us on multiple occasions. We sincerely apologize that your recent experiences did not meet your expectations.

We understand that massage pressure and technique can vary between therapists, and your comments have been shared with our team for further training and improvement. 

Our goal is to provide a comfortable and satisfying experience for every guest.

We truly appreciate your honest feedback and hope to have the opportunity to provide you with a much better experience in the future.

reviews.name: Gordon Huang
reviews.text: This massage store is very nice. The manager of the store is really hospitable with a big smile. Let to say the masseurs are all professional that gave us a really good aroma oil sport massage. That alleviate my back pain a lot. Really recommend this massage store when visiting this area!!

reviews.name: Lena Norgren
reviews.text: Really lovely place with calm atmosphere and super friendly staff. I regularly have Thai massages and I can definitely recommend this place. There are two branches on the same road, I visited both and they’re equally great.

reviews.text: Can’t believe I stumbled upon this hidden gem of a massage place right in the heart of Bangkok! The vibe was amazing! Super clean, cozy, and smelled incredible. After the session, they even served me some dessert and more warm tea. Honestly, I can’t recommend this place enough. It’s such a great find!

reviews.name: Winston Liu
reviews.text:
The best best best massage place i have ever experienced, the masseur was highly experienced. Very hygienic and soothing atmosphere. Very professional and great hospitality service. Affordable pricing and the best part is they don’t cheat people like other spa or massage places do.
Must must visit 100% if ever you come to bangkok. I will definitely come again. Thank you Bamboo spa for this great service.

reviews.name: Vin C.
reviews.text: Great service. I’m glad that I found this awesome place at almost 8pm and still available for 2 spots. The whole experience was impeccable in terms of environment and massage service. It’s definitely a go-to of massage in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Alisande
reviews.text: This is a really great place! Adorable decor. Therapists very skilled. Quality exceeds that of much more expensive places I’ve tried. Will definitely be back.

reviews.name: Luiza Torrezani
reviews.text: I’ve been coming here for almost 5 years and it’s still the best quality x technique x price you can get around Sukhumvit. Strongly recommend it!

reviews.name: Brian Cox
reviews.text: This is one of the best massage places I have been to in Bangkok. I came here for the first time 8 years ago and have been coming back ever since. Clean rooms, nice decorations and skilled staff. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Nicolas Frauenfelder
reviews.text:
This is a real oasis in the midst of Bangkok! Already upon entering the spa I could feel a sense of peace and harmony... fresh flowers and roses, Himalayan salt lamps, the scent of natural essential oils, it's all cared for so well. The staff is really friendly and professional and I got greeted with a refreshing towel and drink. Even though I usually don't take foot massages, I did upon the recommendation of a friend, and I have to say, 6 stars! I was comfortable all the way through the massage, meaning, massage pressure, temperature of the room, lighting, it was all just perfect! The little "kanom", Thai dessert and high quality tea ended the whole experience beautifully. Highly recommend, will be back soon. Thank you to all the friendly staff.
PS: Big parking lot too!

Very nice environment. Highly recommend!

reviews.text:

Only thing to complain is a for oil massage you might need to share a room with another guest, there are curtain in between to give you more privacy but still felt bit weird. Maybe it’s just me.

Everything else is great. Will consider coming back.

reviews.name: Cynthia Wong
reviews.text: Luckily we make booking in advance, it's always fully booked. We had the spa package - CEO  package. And the shop manager was so helpful to borrow me the charger. Highly recommended to visit if u have time. We enjoyed the spa very much.

reviews.name: NJ
reviews.text: The therapist is very skilled and professional. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Olga Balov
reviews.text: It is our 4th or 5th time coming here over a few years and the stuff always meet and exceed our expectations!

reviews.name: Sunwoo Kim
reviews.text:
Had a really good massage from here. Very detailed and caring as you can see from my photos - you are asked whether you would like a certain area to be focused.
Also enjoy the complimentary dessert🥳

reviews.name: Ben Lau
reviews.text:
Got to know about Bamboo Spa from an online article and wanted to check it out since they are pretty near where I stay.
Service from the staff at the front desk was great as they speak fluent English and appreciate the small talks before I left the place.
Unlike the usual chain massage parlour I go to in the past, this place offers a high bed where I can lie flat down with my head resting on the cut out headrest, feeling much more comfortable while massaging my back.
There were some small talks from the masseur but due to language barrier we didn't engage much conversation, but she will occasionally asked if I felt too cold from the air con etc.
And at the end of the session there was a bowl of mango dessert accompanied with a bottle of water and a cup of tea. All these at the cost of 900bht which I find pretty reasonable.
Highly recommend this place if you are around the area.

reviews.name: Cara Consunji
reviews.text:
I discovered their service on TikTok and reached out via WhatsApp, they responded promptly and suggested booking the promotional package through Klook. I made a reservation together with my friends, and we were all scheduled at the same time.

From the moment we arrived, the staff were welcoming, accommodating, and always smiling. The head spa experience began with a dry massage, followed by a relaxing head massage. They then cleansed my face and applied a face mask before thoroughly washing my hair. Afterward, they moisturized my face and performed a cooling, soothing facial treatment. The session ended with a shoulder massage and a hair blow-dry.

Overall, it was an amazing and truly relaxing experience ☺️👍🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review your support means everything to us. We look forward to welcoming you again.🙏🏻❤️

The massage itself was well-balanced, not too light or too strong, and I could feel the stress melt away. Highly recommend for anyone looking to unwind and recharge.

title: NAPAR Thai Massage @Sukhumvit 32
ownerDescription:
Welcome to Napar 32, your ultimate oasis of relaxation and rejuvenation nestled in the heart of vibrant Bangkok. Traditional massage and Cannabis massage in center Bangkok!

Our skilled therapists are dedicated to providing you with an indulgent escape, offering a range of luxurious massage treatments designed to melt away stress, soothe tired muscles, and restore harmony to your body and mind.
Step into serenity and immerse yourself in an unforgettable experience of blissful tranquility at Napar 32.
Book your appointment now and let us pamper you with the finest therapeutic care in the city.
address: 762/9-11 Soi Sukhumvit 32, Klongton Khet, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Sandra
reviews.text: Booked the Thai traditional massage and topped up to a oil massage for 549baht. Nee attendee to me and she took much care to make sure I was comfortable with her style and strength. The end result was a strenuous deep tissue massage targeted at my body knots and left me feeling relaxed afterwards. Would return for the same treatment!

reviews.name: Tom Harrison
reviews.text:
Really lovely experience at Napar Thai massage
I went to this massage shop without an appointment but the friendly girl at the front desk was able to fit me in with only a few minute wait.
The whole place felt clean and the staff are great.
My foot massage lasted an hour and was so relaxing that I slept for almost the whole time.
Massages take place in a quiet dark area that feels relaxing and safe
I paid 350thb for my massage, which is extremely reasonable for Bangkok
I would highly recommend the experience

reviews.name: Jia Wen Low
reviews.text: amazing hidden gem massage! the whole store was extremely clean and bright, prices were affordable too. did the 899 1h hot oil + free 30min back massage promo (cash only) and it was amazing! my masseuse Ice was extremely knowledgeable and strong! would highly recommend!

reviews.name: Charles Yin
reviews.text: Super awesome find!  A bit far from me but it was on the way to a tattoo shop I wanted to check out.  So glad I found this one— no frills, very reasonable, great strong massage

reviews.name: Emmy M
reviews.text: This is my first time here. It was a great experience and a very good massage. The price is reasonable, and the atmosphere of the shop is warm and welcoming. The therapist was very professional and provided an excellent massage. I had a lot of back pain and wasn’t sure which treatment to choose, but the staff explained everything clearly and gave great recommendations. I will definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Juily Phun
reviews.text:
My husband and I got the best massages. Sometimes in the wild Wild West of massage world, it’s either a hit, miss, or hard draw. We have gotten massages where we felt like we just got patted down. We’ve gotten massages where our bodies were brutally beaten down and twisted.
This felt different. Both our masseuses had a lot of care for our sports injuries. They knew what they were doing to us. My masseuse was Jenny. And I’ll always come back to her (if she works here). I really can’t emphasize how lovely we both feel. Holy cow, it’s like we actually got a real true life dictionary definition of a massage. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ms. Juily Phun,

Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted to hear that you and your husband had such a great experience. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you both back again soon!

Warm regards
Napar massage Team

reviews.name: Sani
reviews.text:
Booking can be done through LINE chat.

650THB for 2 hours thai massage, very affordable, considering the other places i went to has charged 900THB and above.

Place was decent, masseuse was polite, english speaking admin can be more friendly.

My biggest issue was with the technique. It’s not representative of thai massage. The stretching was very lacking.

reviews.name: Varma Bucha
reviews.text: My wife and myself reserved a massage for 90 minutes and the service was excellent. Strongly advise their service.  You need to book via their website or walk-in booking with advance payment.

reviews.name: Chia Chia
reviews.text: I had very good experience in this massage therapy shop! I did premium aroma oil massage therapy for one hour and it’s so good! I’ll definitely come back. Thanks for my therapist auntie Kai.

reviews.name: Mina Kim
reviews.text: When I tell you this a hidden gem in Bangkok, IT IS. Diverse massage types and lengths give you freedom to pick how you want to relax. After coming the first day I immediately booked one for the next day. Prices are the best for the quality of the establishment and service. They speak some English too which was helpful for me. Please make time to visit and experience the clean, friendly, and great service they provide!

reviews.name: Marija Savic
reviews.text:
I came here at the recommendation of friends and seeing so many good reviews here.

However, the experience I had with my masseuse was not great.

Few things she did:
- Throwing my limbs at the side instead of moving it
- Dropping the oil bottle on my back whenever she tops up on oil (instead of placing it on my body or on the side)
- The massage on the left and right side was different. Many spots were missed.
- In general, it felt she was just doing the bare minimum for the time to pass by.

I’m sure others had a good experience, but I will not be back and will not recommend because of what i experienced.

reviews.name: Pii_Ghost_Boi
reviews.text: Best massages in all of Bangkok— we have tried so many places— but nothing compares to Napar. All of the massage therapists have consistently been great. Each one can read your body and figure out what it needs— so the Thai massage techniques are specific to your ailments. These folks are the real deal… the place is nicely decorated, well kept, and organized. ***TIP the staff! Their expertise is worth it!***

reviews.name: Tina Esposito
reviews.text: I have a very nice massage experience in this store. Professional great staff, super amazing price. Very much Clean environment. 100% I will be back to this store.

reviews.name: Xinnagon
reviews.text: This is a very good massage shop if you are walking around Thonglor or Phrom Phong. I recommend choosing this place “NaPAR”. I chose to have a Thai massage program with Mr. Games. He is a very professional therapist.

reviews.name: Andrew Yee
reviews.text: 2 hour foot massage. Repetitive action and monotonous with use of lotion every 5 minutes. My feet and legs were covered in lotion which was not comfortable. Tech was looking at the clock constantly.  Atmosphere was acceptable.

reviews.name: Talia Le Minoux
reviews.text:
Worst place… went there for full body massage… I cry after cause I was suffering during this massage, (I feel was more torture than massage) no professional just so painful, the professional is not professional, the massage have no sense, getting slap, do one leg after do the neck after go to the other leg, never touch the feet but is full body… she massage my head so strong and terrible that I loose my hair so much after… my skin was full of mark, I cry of stress and pain, I got acne this day and the person just touch my acne so hard was so painfullllll ! Put her finger in my eyes ?? Like what is that ??
even for the intimacy, I feel the person touch so much between my leg, likeeee no my leg, but you get the point right ? impossible to get comfortable and relax…
And always feel when you arrived at this place they look at you like “ oooh nooo… another person… again”
I’ll never come back to this place
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ms.Talia Le Minoux, 

We sincerely apologize for what you experienced. We’re very sorry that your full body massage felt painful and uncomfortable.  

We take every feedback seriously especially regarding professionalism, pressure/technique, and safety. We have already shared your comments with our management team to review your visit details and retrain our therapists where necessary.  

To investigate properly and ensure this does not happen again, please contact us with the date/time of your appointment at:  
- LINE ID: @naparsukhumvit32
- Email: napars32@gmail.com 

We would like to understand the full situation and make sure it does not happen again.  

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We hope to have the opportunity to improve our service and make this right.  

Warm regards,
Napar Massage Team

reviews.name: Brittany
reviews.text: Just finished my 2nd massage here in 2 days. Both have been amazing. The facilities are very clean and tranquil. Staff are all friendly and professional. This will become my regular, neighborhood spot ☺️

reviews.name: Passa Tanneau
reviews.text:
I have tried several massage place in the area and I have to say this is one of the best.
I did 2-hour foot massage and 2-hour Thai massage.
Reception is exceptional, staff are very polite, masseuses are professional. They know exactly what muscle they are working on.
Definitely coming back.

reviews.name: Katenapat K

Exceptional service! The masseuse here is fantastic, hitting all the right spots with just the perfect amount of pressure. They focus on what you need, unlike other places. title: Urban Thai
subTitle: Urban Thai Massage and Spa
address: 9, Suriyawong 23-24 Surawong Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: jiji subi
reviews.text: Visited the place for a mini manicure - simple nail clip, buff and cuticle clean up and it was so professionally done. Had friends who can along for gel nails and the service was fantastic! Professional and quick and all three manicurists - Rosa, Tik & Aun were excellent and super efficient. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Rochele Ann Rulloda
reviews.text: Good massage. We just passed by this massage place while walking and decided to try it. Great massage. Worth the try. We got the thai massage. Good if you want to stretch and have muscle pain.

reviews.name: Jack Nathan
reviews.text:
Highly Recommended – Urban Thai Spa in Silom is an absolute gem!
My wife and I recently visited Urban Thai Spa in Silom, Bangkok, and it was one of the best experiences we’ve had during our trip. We both booked the 90-minute Aroma Massage, and from the moment we walked in, we were completely impressed.
The spa has a beautiful, modern yet warmly Thai ambiance – calm lighting, gentle traditional music, and a wonderfully relaxing scent in the air. The staff were incredibly professional, friendly, and attentive. They explained the process clearly and made sure we were perfectly comfortable throughout.
The aroma massage itself was pure bliss. The therapists were highly skilled, using the perfect pressure and beautiful aromatic oils that left us both feeling deeply relaxed and rejuvenated. Every knot in my back melted away, and my wife said it was the most refreshing massage she’s ever had. The 90 minutes flew by, and we left feeling light, refreshed, and glowing.
Everything was spotlessly clean, the facilities were excellent, and the service felt genuinely caring – true Thai hospitality at its best. The location in Silom is also super convenient, right in the heart of the city but still peaceful once you're inside.
We can’t recommend Urban Thai Spa enough! If you’re in Bangkok and looking for a top-quality, soothing massage experience, this is the place. We’ll definitely be back on our next visit. Thank you to the wonderful team for making our afternoon so special! 🙏

reviews.name: Zainab Ali
reviews.text: Had such a lovely experience here, the spa has a calm atmosphere and very welcoming staff. I had an hour long back and shoulders massage from Nin, and it released weeks worth of built up tension in my back, in hindsight I wish I had gone for a longer option. Will definitely be returning and highly recommend!

reviews.name: Jacqueline Rivera
reviews.text: My daughter and I had an aroma oil body massage with Nam and Dea. They did such a great job and it felt amazing. My daughter is 13 and loved it. We were in a private room and it had a shower. The place is very pretty and clean. Definitely would recommend checking it out. Oh, and they give you tea after.

reviews.name: Meena Joseph
reviews.text: We went there seeing the positive reviews. This place is crowded and the therapists are in a hurry. It's not calm even though it looks like peaceful place. We feel like we are having a massage right in the streets. Full of vehicle noises because it's literally on the road side. The interior has a luxury look but it's noisy and the massage was just average when compared to other places. Will not recommend this place . It's just an okay place.

reviews.name: Pisha Thongmoa
reviews.text: The massage was incredibly skilled and therapeutic, but the experience was hindered by the overhead lighting being far too bright for a relaxation space. It’s hard to fully unwind when the room isn’t dimmed, though the quality of the service itself remains top-notch.

reviews.name: Mei C
reviews.text: Deeply disappointing foot massage. Masseuse looks like she using a lot of strength until her whole body is trembling but the strength is not transferred to customer’s feet at all. All it does is make the customer’s chair shake while minimal strength is actually felt. Makes for a very uncomfortable and ineffective foot massage. Did not improve even after giving feedback. Feels like a waste of my 1 hour. 10/10 will NOT recommend.

reviews.name: Ego Ye
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing Thai massage! The atmosphere is calm and relaxing, with soft music and a clean, cozy space. The therapist was professional, skilled, and attentive—she targeted all my tight areas perfectly. Pressure was just right, not too hard or light. I left feeling completely refreshed, stress-free, and my body was so relaxed. Highly recommend this place; it’s one of the best massages I’ve ever had. Will definitely come back!

reviews.name: Wawundi Bruno
reviews.text:
Urban Thai is exceptional!
Well located in Silom.
Dina, the one who did my massage  is exceptional! Very professional, i felt really relaxed after the massage.

The place is clean and very modern.

I recommend the place then time.
They serve you tea after , very special.

reviews.name: Mohamed
reviews.text: Great experience. The staff were professional, welcoming, and the service was excellent. The spa was clean, relaxing. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Clinton Beaird
reviews.text:
I came here and had the four-hands 1-hour foot massage with tiger balm. The women were as strong and talented as they are beautiful. When it was finished, I felt like I had new feet.

The atmosphere is very pleasant - upscale plush leather recliner to sit in, the lighting is easy on the eyes but not too dim. There is nice calming music playing at a very nice level - not too loud or too soft. No cell phones ringing, no masseuse on the phone.

I strongly recommend you visit and get yourself a 4-hands foot massage.

reviews.name: Bridie Cartwright
reviews.text:
I hadn’t had a pedicure in ages, and Rosa at Urban Thai did an absolutely amazing job. She was incredibly professional, careful and thorough, and my toenails look perfect! You can tell she really takes pride in her work and pays attention to every little detail.

Such a relaxing experience and I’m so happy with the result. I would definitely recommend Rosa! Thank you!

reviews.name: Mohammad Alawady
reviews.text: The place was clean and the reception was amazing and had good hospitality. The place offered many packages based on one’s preferences, each being their own unique experience. The workers were kind and their talent is outstanding and they knew exactly what they were doing.

reviews.name: s v
reviews.text: Best massage by Ann. Very gentle and spiritual. Lovely atmosphere, with a private shower in the room and soft music. Truly the best experience ever. Thank you, Ann

reviews.name: Meidi Md
reviews.text: Very nice massage place. Clean, cozy, open space. The staff are very polite and friendly. Each of them is very well skillful. The pricing is very reasonable considering the very nice setting. I am a happy customer. I’ll come back again for more.

reviews.name: Akari Phyo
reviews.text: I came here ( urban Thai massage and spa) without planning and it turns out it was one of the best i’ve been ever been to. Highly recommend if you are looking for the best massage around the area. The staffs are well trained and friendly and can communicate english well. Plz ask for Ms.Mook and Ms. Sa. They are  good at what they’re doing.

reviews.name: MaKayla Malladi
reviews.text: Wonderful place to get a massage! Found on google and walked to location. I had Cat as my massage therapist and she did a wonderful job! I felt so relaxed and my muscle pain afterwards was much better!! Staff was so nice and welcoming and the building was beautiful inside☺️

reviews.name: yhe liz

reviews.name: Reuven Mansharoff

I had the best massage in Bangkok here, thanks to dear SA.
Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Claire Jones
reviews.text:
Absolutely fantastic. Really great facilities, very clean, very calm. Our therapists were excellent. Thank you Risa and Fon!
I had a 90 min body scrub. (Scrub followed by massage plus face and head massage). My husband had the signature oil massage. Also 90 mins. 10% off as before 2pm.
I cannot fault this place and we will definitely return on a future trip to BKK.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are very glad to hear that you had a good experience. All of our staff are always doing their best to ensure your satisfaction. Thank you for your words of encouragement, and we will strive to provide even better service next time.

reviews.name: Christeen
reviews.text: It's walking distance from the Marriott. I tried their 2-hour full body massage and it was really nice. The place is clean and you can even shower in the room.

reviews.name: Wioletta Stpiczyńska
reviews.text: Absolute perfection! I had a full body aromatherapy massage with lavender oil and it was incredible. I came in with a runny nose, but the therapist was so understanding and tailored the massage perfectly to my needs. She worked out all the tension in my body, and I felt completely pampered and cared for. To top it all off, after the treatment I was served a warm, delicious tea and fresh mango in the reception area. Amazing, professional service with a lot of empathy. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Giami Lee
reviews.text: everything is good in the facility. quite and cozy place, friendly staff, reasonable price. booking is easy through online and the price is highly visible, no surcharge on the site. but they did not offer pick up service.

reviews.name: Satleenn Kaur
reviews.text: Had a really good experience here. The massage was very relaxing and professional. My massage therapist, Nut, was excellent very skilled, gentle and made me feel comfortable throughout the session. Also, the girl at the front desk was very polite, welcoming and friendly. Overall, the service was great and I would definitely come back again. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ava Stempel
reviews.text: I got my first Thai massage here and it was AMAZING!! The woman who massaged me was so lovely and she was great at what she did. Also the give u mango and tea at the end and the mango was so fire. YUM. definitely come here!!

reviews.name: Harshal Kalakoti
reviews.text:
If you are staying in Sukhumvit and looking for a genuine, authentic, and budget friendly traditional Thai massage, then i would really recommend this place.
Was greeted with hot towels and tea upon arrival. They handed me a pamphlet on which I had to circle the body parts where I wanted more focus. They offer different pressures also. I was offered different oils from which I had to choose one, and I had a tough time choosing one because all of them were truly amazing. After the massage, they offered me tea some fruits.
It was a truly relaxing experience.

reviews.name: Benny Chow
reviews.text:
Just had a Thai neck and shoulder massage, no queue, drink and fresh cold towel to start.
The form to fill in asked for areas to focus on and areas to avoid, and strength - all very useful information to select from.
Masseuse was a small lady, with powerful hands! Massage was just right to the medium strength I selected, made me wince just a little, bit she checked I was OK during the treatment. Tea and mango at the end to relax! With a waterfall on the glass; such a relaxing space.
Feel refreshed and relaxed.
Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for visit our spa and good review ^^

reviews.name: kevin wong
reviews.text: Best authentic massage so far around this area, had a body scrub 30 mins and aroma oil massage 60 mins. Very professional and clean, the receptionist will ask for your body condition first and you can fill a form. Welcome drink was included. The bed and facilities were clean. Masseuse was an experienced Thai lady, and speaks politely. Pleasantly surprised to have mango and ginger tea at the end of massage.

reviews.name: Successgm Red
reviews.text:
I don't know where they get their mangos from but they're always really good, not overripe, just the perfect ripeness. You can tell how they care about little things like that.

The staff are super friendly.

Yesterday I enjoyed a nice Thai massage. It was so good I couldn't turn around onto my back.. had to lay there a second.

Today I had the aromatic massage. It was great because they offer crew discounts to airline staff, and its convenient to get to cos its close from the metro stations.

Would definitely recommend Ice (her name). She is the youngest one there but you can tell she really prides herself in her expertise.

Would definitely visit again next time I'm in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
좋았다 말씀해주시니 너무 감사합니다. 
고객님께서 칭찬해주신 담당마사지사가 저희샵 막내 맞습니다. 이제 갓 스무살을 넘었죠. 어리지만 마사지사로서의 커리어와 실력은 충분합니다. 많은 고객님께 칭찬을 받는 직원입니다. 고객님께서도 추천까지 해주시며 칭찬하시지만 하루전에는 어떤 고객님께 혼쭐이 났습니다. 타이마사지를 하며 손톱으로 자꾸 찌르는 느낌이라 불편하셨다고..
바로 밑에 있는 리뷰입니다. 

당일날 제가 그녀의 손톱을 확인했으나 문제점을 찾을 수 없었습니다. 손톱은 하얀부분이 보이지 않게 바짝 짧았고 부드럽게 잘 다듬어져 있었습니다. 그녀와 불평후기에 대해 이야기를 나누었고 앞으로는 마사지할때 좀 더 신경을 기울이자는 정도로 이야기를 마쳤습니다.
그러나, 그렇게 한것을 저는 지금 후회합니다

오늘 아침에 다시 본 그녀의 손톱은 붉은 핏자국이 군데군데 보일만큼 더 짧게 다듬어져 있었고 손톱근처의 살들조차 자른건지 갈아낸 것인지 희안한 형태로 바뀌어 있더군요. 갓스무살의 포동포동 고왔던 손이...ㅠㅠ 

속상한 마음, 미안한 마음...여러 감정이 몰려왔습니다. 말로만 아빠와 딸..운운했지 정작 지켜주지는 못하고 그리하도록 내몬것 같아 말할 수 없이 괴로웠습니다. 가슴속으로만 울려했는데 눈물이 조금 맺히더군요.. 

그녀가 못봤기를 바랍니다..

오늘 고객님께 그녀의 칭찬을 듣고보니 속상한 마음에 울컥해 푸념을 좀 늘어놓았습니다. 내일은 그녀에게 고객님의 리뷰를 보여주며 다독여야겠습니다. 고객님 덕에 제가 치유를 얻은 것처럼, 그녀의 마음의 상처가 낫기를 바래봅니다. 
오늘 참 감사합니다

못먹는 술이 무척 땡기는 참 이상한 밤입니다.^^;;

reviews.name: Rim
reviews.text: The best massage parlour. Coming back every time I am visiting Bangkok. Had the best experience this time again. Pui is the best therapist, very skilled  and professional.

reviews.name: Cinry Lei
reviews.text:
From my experience from the past 7mo of living in BKK and have frequent(sometimes way to frequent) massages, being Korean owned is always a good sign. This shop is no exception. Definitely one of the best at this price level.

Very full service massage shop. Not only gives you a consultation form, but also carefully reads it and confirm with you on the details for proper execution, which is very rare even at a lot of the more expensive shops.

The Korean shop owner gave me lasting impressions. He’s very keen on improving customer experience and very gentle with his employees as well.

Overall a shop I know I’ll be back after 1st visit. Same day appointment is still possible at times, which is definitely a plus.

reviews.name: Trung Tin LE (TL)
reviews.text:
​I had an incredible experience here and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Bangkok. After days of walking through the city, this combo was exactly what I needed to recharge.
​Foot Massage: Absolute bliss. The therapist was very skilled at targeting pressure points. It’s the perfect remedy for "tourist feet" and provides instant relief from fatigue.
​Thai Body Massage: A truly authentic experience. It involves deep stretching and firm pressure, which might be intense for beginners, but the physical benefits are undeniable. I left feeling completely "realigned" and tension-free.
​Why I recommend this place:
​Atmosphere: Very calming with soothing music and a clean, professional environment.
​Service: The staff was welcoming, and the therapists were highly attentive to my comfort levels.
​Value: Exceptional quality for the price—definitely one of the best value-for-money spots in the area.
​Pro-tip: If you prefer a lighter touch, don't be afraid to ask for "Medium" or "Soft" pressure, as traditional Thai massage can be quite vigorous!
​I’ll definitely be back before I leave Thailand.

reviews.name: Aaron Smith
reviews.text: I have purchased sevel items from HomePro now and I have always received great service.  During my recent visit, I was considering which small lawnmower would be best for my small plot.  The associate was Excellent.  She took each model down from the rack so that we could feel the weight and handling.  She even set each unit up with batteries so that we could hear the sound level.  Her knowledge of the warranty and service options was also top notch.  They have provided installation servicea on past purchases like hot water heaters and refrigerators.  HopePro is my first stop when shopping for home items in Thailand.  In a world of online shopping, I still prefer to pay a fraction more for great service, the ability to physically compare real products, and the satisfaction of taking them home.

reviews.name: Olaf la Cour
reviews.text:
2020. As so often before, I went without buying anything.  90% of staff know NOTHING about what they are working on.

They sell machines but have no accessories at home.

Update November 28, 2021

Home Pro has a nice selection of things for your home.  They also have enough staff, but they are so little serviceminded that it screams to heaven.

After 10-15 minutes at this furniture I had to find someone who could sell me that set.  There was not one of those present who came to me.

Update on December 2, 2021.
The purchased furniture was delivered on Tuesday as agreed. It was clear that the box had been opened and closed several times and immediately I could also see that the sofa had 2 faults. I knew that well, but I did not see the problem, so you got rid of that sofa. Thats poor.

I was promised another next day, for delivery around 11am. That appointment you changed to 1pm, again to 4pm and once again until 6pm (in the middle of dinner!) You call me 5 times to change the appointment. Think it's PROfessional?

The legs were put on incorrectly, swapped so that it stood straight, but still incorrectly. I wanted to eat, and this morning I changed my legs myself.

Take and train your people AND equip them with the tools and knowledge they need.

reviews.name: Chris Raufeisen
reviews.text:
DO NOT TRUST HOMEPRO

I went to Home Pro Rama III to purchase an office chair for about  5,400 baht, I get home and assemble it, and after some compression and exposure to the air, a massive stain on the seat pan/foam appeared. It is clear that this product was spilled on, returned, cleaned and resold to me. I called them countless times and also chatted via line and email to file a product defect claim, (when a claim is filed they are obliged to pick up my product). Even though I was told a claim was processed they insisted on me taking it back to the store myself. They don't even know their own store policy. I live five miles away and work all day, and do not own a truck, the chair is assembled and bulky, I see they have tons of trucks, But I have to bring it in?? They are the ones who sold ME a messed up chair for 5400 thb...? They don't even follow their own policy.  I will never buy another thing from Homepro, they are just another mickey mouse operation, as unreliable and unprofessional as anyone else. might as well make the gamble anywhere else when you buy expensive furniture. Do not buy anything of value here unless you want a headache.Do Not Trust Home Pro

reviews.name: Puvanai Dardarananda
reviews.text:
I just had the most unbelievably social experience at this home improvement store. It's truly a celebrity-level shopping destination where you simply can't take two steps without someone clamoring for your attention. If you're tired of the silent, isolating experience of shopping for nails and lumber, this is the place to be.
The staff here are absolute masters of proactive customer service. They don't wait for you to look lost; they anticipate your every need with an almost psychic ability. Need to find a specific shade of paint? A friendly face will magically appear to guide you. Just admiring a new power tool? Be prepared for an in-depth, one-on-one conversation about its features.
For those of you who struggle with social anxiety, consider this store your personal exposure therapy. You'll be forced to engage in conversation, practice small talk, and overcome your fear of human interaction, all while trying to pick out a new showerhead. It's a fantastic, non-stop party where everyone knows your name—or, at least, they want to.
So, if you're looking to turn a simple errand into a bustling social event and want to feel like the most popular person in the store, this is your new favorite hangout. Just don't expect to have any quiet time to yourself.

Stepped into HomePro Rama 3 thinking I’d be in and out like a ninja 🥷, but nope—this place sucked me in like a black hole of home improvement! 🌀 Ended up mesmerized by motion-sensor trash bins 🗑️✨, self-watering plant pots 🌱💦, and showerheads that sing to you 🎤🚿. ⚠️ Do NOT come here if you value your safety and comfort. 如果你不想被性侵犯，不要来这个地方！

As a female customer, I had a deeply disturbing experience at this massage center and feel compelled to warn others.
Looking back, I regret not paying closer attention to some of the negative reviews that mentioned inappropriate touching, they were buried under many 4-5 star ratings, but they are absolutely real.

I booked a back, neck, and shoulder massage 1 day before. Upon arrival, I was told only a male masseuse was available. I was reassured that I would remain clothed during the session, so I agreed.

However, once the session started, the masseuse removed my clothing without proper explanation or consent and insisted that I would not be wearing anything for the massage. This was not what I agreed to.

During the massage, he repeatedly touched areas that were completely inappropriate for a back massage, including my chest and private areas. I had to explicitly tell him to stop. It was extremely uncomfortable and distressing. He even put his FINGER into my private part, and touched my nipples and breast despite I was facing down (his hands slipped under my body) and I had to ask him to stop!

This crossed the line into sexual assault. No client should ever be touched in this manner under the guise of a standard massage.

What made it worse was that, shortly after, I saw other customers receiving the same type of massage while fully clothed, and many were attended by female masseuses, even male customers. This made it clear that what happened to me was not standard practice.

This experience has left me shaken and has completely destroyed my trust in massage services. I would strongly advise others to avoid this place.

I've been living just steps from this massage shop for a couple of months and was a regular, visiting several times a week since late November. The massages were always good—relaxing and professional—so I brought my sister, parents, and friends, who all enjoyed it.
But some time ago, I politely asked for a softer massage. The therapist got angry, started yelling, and stormed out of the room.

The massages are good and the location is convenient, but this lack of professionalism has made me feel completely unwelcome. I'm now looking for another place.

- Authentic Traditional Thai massage spa with "Thai Traditional" concept
- Our signature treatment is 5in1 therapy including head, neck, shoulder, hand and foot massage
- Experience relief from backaches, muscle tension or headaches by our traditional massage treatment
- 1 minute walk from BTS Siam (exit 6)

Urgent reservation please call 0959825963
Line OA: @thaithaimassage
address: 392, 42-43 Siam Square Soi 6, ปทุมวัน Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

reviews.name: Melvin Tay
reviews.text:
Hardly I have any disappointment in leg massage especially this nation is popular for its service.
However this shop portrayed another perspective of my negative experience.
I went in for leg massage an hour and was assigned with an elderly masseur. Her skills was so slow mo that I could hardly feel any massaging sensation the whole session. There was hardly strength applied to ease my tired legs and she just did not hit any of the points for relaxing.
To make matters worse I was offered level 3 as I requested for a quiet environment. Upon the start of my massage I could feel the level air con was not cold enough to feel comfortable. And fan had to be switch on the side. Mid way my body was wet from the heat and it just felt so stuffy.
The masseur acknowledged and went to switch on the air con in one of the massage room but it did not help much.
Overall for the price of 499 baht an hour leg massage it is not worthy and I strongly not recommend for this outlet. There are many choices around to experience and some is even lesser than this amount.

reviews.name: Bunga Alika
reviews.text:
I recently had an oil massage experience that exceeded my expectations. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calming and welcoming, making it easy to relax right away. The therapist was highly skilled, using just the right pressure to ease tension and stretch out my body. The combination of warm oil and smooth, flowing techniques left my muscles feeling completely refreshed and rejuvenated.

This is an excellent choice for anyone, especially tourists who have been walking a lot or feeling fatigued from travel. If you need a proper stretch and a moment to recharge, this is definitely the perfect place to go. I left feeling lighter, more flexible, and fully relaxed—something I’d happily recommend to anyone looking for a quality massage experience! Very recommended

reviews.name: Sharifah Nur Sabrina
reviews.text: The atmosphere is super calming and the staff is super accomodating and friendly. We would like to give a huge shout out to Ms Ta and Ms Anom for accomodating me and my friend. Their massages were the best, and we also shared a good conversationa and some good laughs. Definitely worth visiting if you are in Bangkok ❤️❤️

reviews.name: Beatrice Dela Vega
reviews.text: Went for a massage for our last day here in thailand and didn’t disappoint. I think all of my muscles softened after this massage. Had a complimentary tea after and will definitely come back again!

reviews.name: Pyper Ruby
reviews.text: I had a great experience at THAI THAI MASSAGE The staff were very professional and friendly. The massage was relaxing, and I felt much better afterward. The place was clean and had a calm atmosphere. Highly recommended! there are a lot of locations to access. 💙❤️

reviews.name: Tafiani Safara
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience with Ban today! I did the body scrub and aromatic massage, and it was so relaxing. The massage was professional, the pressure was perfect, and I left feeling refreshed and super calm. They also served tea afterwards which was such a lovely touch. Definitely recommend and would come back again ✨

reviews.name: Peter Tay
reviews.text: I visited ThaiThai Massage BTS Siam (Flagship Store) and had a relaxing experience. The massage was professional and soothing, and the staff were friendly and attentive. A convenient spot to unwind after a busy day.

reviews.name: Atchariya Suriyawan
reviews.text: I had a great Thai massage experience. The place was clean and relaxing, and the staff were friendly. The therapist was skilled and helped relieve my muscle tension. I felt much better afterward. Highly recommended 😊

reviews.name: Dalia Nguyen
reviews.text: Very nice spot for Thai massage at the center of Siam. The price is reasonable and place is nice. I got the 5in1 massage at 650Thb with good quality.

reviews.name: Joanna Ho
reviews.text: Great experience in here. Nice and Friendly staff. Massage therapist’s skills is excellent!!! Absolutely with be here for next time. Super convenient location just near BTS station. Cozy and comfortable Massage Shop in Bangkok~

reviews.name: Jason Junior
reviews.text:
My trip was 5 days 4 nights in Bangkok, and I went for massages almost every day. Out of all the places I tried, this is definitely the best place to come for a massage!

My therapist deserves a solid 5 stars — very professional, skilled, and attentive. You can really tell they know what they’re doing. The pressure and technique were just right, and I left every session feeling fully relaxed and refreshed.

The environment was also very clean and well maintained, which made the whole experience even more comfortable. The ambience was calming and suitable for a proper relaxing massage.

Highly recommended if you’re in Bangkok and looking for a reliable place to unwind

reviews.name: Si Thu Oo
reviews.text: The most relaxing experience in Bangkok. After a long walk of shopping and cafe hopping, this is the best place to relax and have a good massage with a reasonable price and the best service. 10 out of 10 experience.

reviews.name: Tara S.
reviews.text: My therapist was great. Very knowledgeable and skillful. The restroom was a bit dirty though. When you go up the room you will walk past so many therapists chilling when they aren’t working. Kind of awkward. I think they need a staff room not just have them in customers area. My stall for massage was so far from the A/C it gotten so hot 😆 we had to turn on the fan. Make sure to ask the front desk if you prefer hot or cold stall for regular thai massage.

reviews.name: L L
reviews.text: Foot massage very good, relax and make the pain away. And the last 5 minute shoulder massage is best ever.

reviews.name: Viktoriia
reviews.text: I come here often with my friends. It’s a great place to relax, they do a really good traditional massage. Everything is clean, the therapists are experienced, and they understand several languages, which is very convenient. I’m very happy with the service — thank you!

reviews.name: Lotie Huỳnh
reviews.text: I came from Viet Nam and this is first time I have experience real Thai massage. The Technician name Tom have done very very good job. Im totally satisfy. I will recommend this shop for all my friends and will come back to find her on my next trip to Bangkok.

reviews.name: Afra
reviews.text: I almost never go back to the same spa when visiting Bangkok because I love trying new places. However, my husband and I returned here two days in a row because the Thai oil massage by Pla and Ann was exceptional. They were incredibly skilled, attentive, and made us feel completely relaxed. We truly loved our experience and would definitely recommend asking for Pla and Ann!

Comfy environment with nice staff p’Ann✨

reviews.text: Not recommended at all. I visited Bangkok many times and also tried many massage, but this one is the worst. The skill is too soft which I couldn’t feel anything, I’m a slim person, so if I don’t feel anything probably the fatter people also no feeling 😅 Need to climb up to the 3rd floor, the stairs are very difficult to climb up to, it’s not friendly at all. Price is on the high side too, charged THB 690 for a 60-mins session, but get this kind of service 😮‍💨

reviews.name: Supawit Chirayukool
reviews.text: This venue is a haven for car drivers, offering plenty of free parking with a minimum spending requirement. With over 10 restaurants to choose from, there's something to satisfy every craving. Additionally, there are three 24-hour shops including Burger King, Starbucks, and A Ramen, providing round-the-clock convenience. You'll also find a K Villa grocery store for all your shopping needs. Plus, tucked away at the back is a fantastic massage and spa place, perfect for unwinding after a busy day. Its convenient location makes it a top choice for drivers seeking a one-stop destination for dining, shopping, and relaxation.

reviews.name: Chris Wong
reviews.text:
I recently visited a rest area located in Bangna highway. I must say that I was disappointed by the parking charges. The facilities were decent, with a hospital nearby and a variety of small shops, restaurants, and a mini supermarket. However, despite spending less than an hour there and even making purchases worth a few hundred baht, I was charged a whopping 40 baht for parking. This is considerably expensive compared to the usual practice in Bangkok, where the first hour is typically free.

While the amenities offered are convenient, the steep parking charges leave much to be desired. Visitors should carefully consider whether it's worth the added expense before deciding to visit.

First time and will never come back again!
Went inside for 20 minutes to check it out and buy some curry puffs.
Didnt bother to stamp the parking tickets due to being there for such a short time and was charged 40 Baht upon leaving.
Everwhere else in Bangna District has free parking for the first hour or first thirty minutes.

reviews.name: Andrew Hubbard
reviews.text: The villa store here was quite well stocked I was able to get what I needed. The Starbucks had plenty of seating. The location is quite good but being on the frontage road located away from the u-turn it can be difficult to get to during peak traffic hours. Several other shops to look around. There is an Australian Bon Pain coffee/sandwich restaurant and a Burger King so some choice of food available.

title: divana Divine Spa

Welcome to Divana, your premier sanctuary for relaxation and rejuvenation. Step into our tranquil oasis and escape the hustle and bustle of city life. We offer a holistic approach to wellness, blending traditional healing arts with luxurious spa therapies. From signature massages to revitalizing body treatments, our expert therapists are dedicated to restoring harmony to your mind, body, and soul. Experience the pinnacle of relaxation with us.

reviews.name: Mia Squillante
reviews.text: Let me tell you about this gem that I found. I have been wanting a Thai massage and this popped in my searches. I booked online and was able to get 15% off. I got the Spring Floral detox for 180 minutes. And I had the most relaxing, pampering, massage in my entire life! My massage lady is Pond. Reception area was very clean and so is the whole facility. Park and Luis were very helpful and and kind. 5 stars for this place. Literally I feel like a rubber band after, very very relaxed.

reviews.name: Hao Ze Chia
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Divana Divine Spa during my trip to Bangkok. From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel welcomed with their warm hospitality and attention to detail. The spa environment was beautiful, peaceful, and immaculately maintained, creating the perfect atmosphere to relax and unwind.

My therapist was highly skilled and attentive, ensuring the treatment was tailored to my preferences. The massage was both relaxing and rejuvenating, helping to relieve all the tension from my travels. I also appreciated the thoughtful touches throughout the experience, from the fragrant welcome amenities to the soothing tea served after the treatment.

If you’re looking for a luxurious spa experience in Bangkok that offers exceptional service, a tranquil setting, and excellent value, I highly recommend Divana. It was one of the highlights of my trip, and I will definitely return on my next visit to Bangkok!
