reviews.name: Vivien Lo
reviews.text:
Dora is an excellent masseur. She was very professional and truly knowledgeable in body stretching and massage techniques. She also understood how to work around my injured hip—she knew exactly when to avoid that specific area and how to adjust her approach.

Most impressive was her control of pressure: she applied it correctly and effectively without causing discomfort, which made the entire session feel both safe and personalized. I left feeling very relaxed and well taken care of. Highly recommend Dora for anyone looking for a skilled, attentive, and relaxing massage therapy experience.

reviews.name: Mavis Kwok
reviews.text:
I had a 90-minute deep tissue massage and my masseur was Kook. it was one of the best massages in BKK. I prefer a firm, strong-pressure massage, and Kook’s strength was just right. She was able to find all the tight spots and worked through them thoroughly without being overly painful.

The entire session was incredibly relaxing, and I left feeling much lighter and less tense. If you enjoy a proper deep tissue massage with strong pressure, I highly recommend De Rest Spa with Kook. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

reviews.name: MCprints
reviews.text:
Badly needed a massage and found this
massage place near my hotel ( Renaissance BKK) . I did 2 massages here and both were great! I didn’t get the name of the first masseuse . As for the second one, she’s KIK and did a body scrub and a Thai aromatherapy massage for me. The whole session was 1.5h ( I wish I pick the 2h one! ) Both were very professional! I would return here on my next trip.

Sessions were taken up very fast at night. Bookings  are encouraged.

This place is clean and well lighted, ambience was good.

reviews.name: Cher Wenxiang
reviews.text: This is a good massage place. The ladies In and Sa do very good Thai massage for both myself and my wife. Nice cosy and comfortable set up. Overall would recommend to enjoy some peaceful massage away from the bustling street.

reviews.name: Daniel Bok
reviews.text: The massage is really good and quite value for money. Not as cheap as the ones by the road but the quality sure is there. Also not as expensive as the chains you see in the mall. Overall experience was really good. Only thing is that there’s quite a lot of people and have to wait a bit. The amount you pay is the one in red

reviews.name: chan jing wen
reviews.text: made our booking through their website but you can also book through contacting their line or WhatsApp! Opted for the aroma oil 90mins massage and you can also choose the gender of your massage therapist! Really clean and convenient location as well!

reviews.name: gia daniela
reviews.text:
One of the best massage experiences I’ve ever had! Great ambiance, attentive staff, and more than qualified therapists. For Classic Thai massage, I highly recommend Ms. Kook. During and after the session, it felt like all of my chakras were re-aligned; super refreshing and relaxing!

So if you’re ever in the area, be sure to book an appointment!

Edit: I came again hehe 😁 Honestly amazing place and yoy can definitely say it’s worth it since I keep coming back!

reviews.name: marisha angelique
reviews.text: First time try massage at De Rest Spa. It’s a nice experience to try the aromatic oil massage here. Nice environment, very clean, reasonable price, service and staff are professional. They even serve a fresh coconut after the treatment.

reviews.name: Pei Chia
reviews.text: Search this massage shop from google review, the person who massage me named Ting is doing very great job. Entire 2 hours massage is very relax and comfortable. Definitely will come back again if I have time.

reviews.name: morfredolme
reviews.text: How amazing this experience was we landed today after an 11 hour flight here in bangkok and searched for a relaxing place to get our muscles kneaded. Didnt expect much but the therapist ive gotten really knows how to make someone feel deeply relaxed. Five stars for the staff and ambience. After the 90min massage we got a fresh coconut 🥥 wich was very sweet and delicious 😋🤤

reviews.name: Supanun Nissen
reviews.text: I’m Thai and this was my first time here. I received a 1-hour foot massage by Sa. The massage was excellent with just the right pressure. The staff were very attentive and professional, and they didn’t chat unnecessarily with customers or among themselves, which made the experience very relaxing. Drinking water was provided before the massage, and tea and snacks were served afterward. I was very impressed and will definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Joel Chu
reviews.text: Wow. The massage by “Nam” is awesome , best to get reservations early via fb messenger . Took the spa set massage body scrub and oil massage. Both showers after both application and ended with coconut water! Love this place and will want to come back again 🥹

reviews.name: Chua Lynda
reviews.text: I had hot oil massage for 60mins. Is totally  worth it as I had a long day walking around Bangkok; after the massage my body feels very relax and totally rejuvenated!  The place is clean and service is excellent!! Highly recommend!!!

reviews.name: Diana Nguyen
reviews.text: I came as a walk in to De Rest Spa and they were very accommodating. The staff spoke English and the whole spa was foreigner friendly. I had a 90 minute massage and it was one of the best massages I’ve ever had. My masseuse was Kung, and she was very skilled. I have back and shoulder issues, and she was able to help relieve a lot of the tension. I’ll definitely be stopping by again during my stay in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Jenna Reeves
reviews.text: Got the back and neck shoulder massage and it was wonderful. The staff were very respectful and the whole time it was very peaceful and refreshing. They provided us fresh coconuts after the service and the price was amazing!

reviews.name: Jerry Huang
reviews.text: Once you try it here, you won't worry about picking other store. Very hard-working and skillful masseur Pinny. She's always my first and only choice.

reviews.name: Siree Danaivichennun
reviews.text: I did a hot stone massage with P’Yuak. My muscle was really stiff from 12 hours flight. She did well reducing the muscle tension. I squeaked  & (sometime) screamed during the massage, but feel amazing afterwards. New body new me 😆 Also got complimentary fresh coconut!

reviews.name: Alwyn C
reviews.text:
My partner and I booked the 2.5-hour Spa Set Couple Package, and it was an amazing experience from start to finish. The atmosphere was peaceful, clean, and very relaxing, making it easy to unwind.

The therapists were professional, attentive, and skilled. The combination of the 120-minute spa/oil massage with the 30-minute head massage was incredibly soothing, and we both left feeling completely refreshed and rejuvenated.

The staff were warm and welcoming, and the overall service exceeded our expectations. It was great value for such a comprehensive spa package.

We had a wonderful time together and will definitely be back. Highly recommended for couples looking for a relaxing spa experience in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Nicole Tan
reviews.text: Tried the special program at De Rest Spa. Service was professional from booking till the massage. Chose the spa set which included a body scrub in the 2h Very value for money compared to the bigger chains. Enjoyed the fresh coconut served after the massage too.

reviews.name: Eugene Chng
reviews.text:
This spa has very nice ambience and in great location very near to Chitlom BTS.

We tried the foot massage and its was great. Very good service and attentive staff.

title: Baanyah Massage & Cafe
subTitle: บ้านย่า มาสสาจ แอนด์ คาเฟ่
address: 181 22ก Singharoek Alley, Khwaeng Bang Sue, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

reviews.name: Aziz Adi
reviews.text:
A hidden gem in Bangkok. Baanyah Massage & Cafe offers a serene and zen-inspired atmosphere with a beautiful aesthetic that instantly makes you feel relaxed. The environment is quiet, clean, and thoughtfully designed.
The service was exceptional friendly, attentive, and highly professional. Every detail was well taken care of, making the entire experience truly enjoyable.
I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a peaceful escape and quality massage. Definitely worth visiting!

reviews.name: Alex Haggis
reviews.text: Phenomenal business. I have been here multiple times now for a massage and everybody I have encountered so far has been great! Highly professional, super clean and a great little cafe downstairs too with a tasty beverage ready after your massage to give you a warm farewell! Couldn't recommand enough, everyone should experience this hidden gem but do remember, they are highly popular with locals so you may have a slight wait at busy times but nothing too much! They even have an external Nail Bar where they have additional pampering services, if that suits of course. 10/10 👌

reviews.name: Supakorn Patcharakulwit
reviews.text: My regular massage place! Great atmosphere with a nice cafe concept. The massage quality and service are consistently amazing, all at very affordable prices for the experience you receive.

reviews.name: Khakanang Areerajjakul
reviews.text: A great experience at BaanYah. The atmosphere is beautiful and relaxing. My massage was fantastic, and the staff were professional and friendly. I highly recommend it for anyone looking to unwind 💆🏻‍♀️

reviews.name: sukhawadee anussornrajkit
reviews.text: Great service and great massage. Many parking spaces available. Very cozy and good vibe. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: ธนิณี วงศ์อกนิษฐ์
reviews.text: That massage shop is great, I totally love it. Their massages are so good at getting rid of aches and pains. All the masseurs there are awesome.

reviews.name: Jelly Jell
reviews.text:
This is my second time getting a massage here and this time I chose the 2hr Aromaoil massage

The therapist who worked on me is named “ Bai (ใบ) ” She gave an excellent massage and was able to target specific areas that needed attention every spot she pressed on turned out to be a sore spot for me, Her aromatherapy massage technique was amazing—relaxing 🥹💞 and not rushed at all, She was friendly and polite. I highly recommend this place, and I will definitely come back for another session !!! 👍🏻🙏🏻

reviews.name: Kevin La
reviews.text:
Update January 6th, 2026:

After a few years, I finally come back here for massage and enjoy a cup of coffee. Staffs are friendly and they welcome foreigners. Some of the masseuse did speak some English which is a plus.

Previously post:

Secret corner to enjoy nature and coffee. I love the vibe here. They have AC and chill music. I went for a spa massage and enjoy an afternoon snacks and coffee.

reviews.name: Piyapatch Par
reviews.text: The place is really clean and cozy. Massager is really polite and professional. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Piyachut Rusmeeroj
reviews.text: I always come here for Thai oiled massage and body scrubbing. The services are great and the location is very clean and relaxing. I will keep continuing coming here

reviews.name: Nin Ninpraphan
reviews.text: A very pleasant place to stop and relax and enjoy a good cup of coffee. The location just 5mins walking from MRT Bang Po station. Before we do the massage the receptionist ask me to check temperature and let me wash hands by Alcohol gel very polite way. The masseuse are very professional and spot on. I highly recommend you all to try Baanyah massage & Caffe. Must come!

reviews.name: Bundit Lornimitdee
reviews.text: A hidden gem in Bang Po and Tao Poon offering great massage. The place is very clean, the staff are kind, and the prices are very reasonable.

reviews.name: bandp's map
reviews.text: Peaceful, good service, clean and nice place. Affordable with many promotions. I made a reservation for 2hrs. Thai massage+shoulder pack. Please check for package and monthly promotion. Parking available.

reviews.name: Queen
reviews.text: Awesome stuff, beautiful place and peaceful atmosphere 💖 it was incredible, thank you so much!

reviews.name: Daniil Tkachuk
reviews.text:
Hands down the best massage I’ve ever had in Thailand, and I’ve been to many in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Samui and Phangan!
Fantastic experience, I highly recommend masseur lady Dok Mai!
And as a bonus, pretty interior and a really good coffee in the cafe after massage. Thanks guys! Definitely 10/10!

reviews.name: ช่อแก้ว ชุ่มอินทรจักร
reviews.text:
Just had a 3 and a half hours' treatment at Baanyah, massage & cafe.
A friendly reception welcomed me and asked me to wait for Khun Lek. Really worth waiting for this well skilled Mo Nuad.
While I was having a shower, she prepared the sauna cabin, and as soon as it reached the propriate temperature I enjoyed it 2 times for about 15 minutes. Then Khun Lek gave me a fine body scrub and my skin felt like that of a baby.
The following 2 hours of the sports' massage were again very skillful, comfortable and relaxing. Khun Lek seems to know every spot of the body that needs to be worked on.
Baayah is a place to remember.

reviews.name: Rinporn Vongvijit
reviews.text: One of massage place that I like to come, There is a shady atmosphere, quiet and the therapist are very skilled. I came here for the massage multi time, recommend to try this place

reviews.name: Mota
reviews.text: Clean and peaceful atmosphere in walkable distance from public transport. Provides a wide variety of massage/spa services for reasonable price.

reviews.name: Austin Lee
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at BaanYah! The ambiance was relaxing, the staff was professional and welcoming, and the massage was truly rejuvenating. The quality of service exceeded my expectations, and the price was very reasonable for the level of care and attention given. If you're looking for a peaceful escape and a top-notch spa experience, this is definitely the place to go. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Fairy
reviews.text: Great massage! I've been going to this salon for over a year now. 100 minutes of Thai oil massage for 600 baht is the best investment.

title: La Salle's Avenue
subTitle: ลาซาล อเวนิว
address: ถนน แบริ่ง - ลาซาล, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand
street: ถนน แบริ่ง - ลาซาล

reviews.name: Lysl28
reviews.text: Huge playground for kiddos & pets. Lotsa interesting pop up stalls selling streets food & decent choices of resto to dine in. Villa Market is convenient for groceries shopping with Starbucks, KFC, Uniglo etc Nice place to chill with friends & family BUT BUT with the new parking system, I’ll think twice stepping in there again. It’s just simply not worth the time. The management must seriously look into this issue honestly

reviews.name: Daren Ng
reviews.text:
A lovely spot to relax and explore!
This avenue has plenty of dining options, restaurants, and outdoor stalls selling fresh fruit and BBQ, a really fun atmosphere. There’s also a shopping area with Uniqlo and a supermarket that’s more affordable compared to city center prices.

Outside, there’s a beautiful green park and a stylish Starbucks. I happened to visit in the late afternoon and caught the sunset, it felt peaceful and relaxing, especially just a few days after the earthquake. There was even some live acoustic music, which made the experience even more soothing.

reviews.name: jisso
reviews.text:
I used to absolutely love going to Lasalle s avenue but now i don’t know what to think about it , I decided to bring my two lovely daughters over to play volleyball at the big field after school but they were rudely interrupted by a guard who told them to stop playing volleyball immediately, i didn’t know what the issue was.

A few minutes later we saw two children the same age but Thai , we asked the guard why they were allowed to play but not my children but he rudely shooed us away. Outrageous.

reviews.name: Julia Semenova
reviews.text:
Parking here is very inconvenient. Motorbike parking is quite far away, and by the time you reach it, park, and walk to the store, half of the free parking time is already gone. 30 minutes was barely enough to quickly buy a few items at Villa Market.

My 343 baht purchase was not enough to extend free parking — assistance is only provided for purchases over 500 baht. I don’t want to use LINE for validation, which makes the process unnecessarily complicated.

It feels easier not to come at all.

reviews.name: Ginny Keong
reviews.text:
LaSalle Avenue used to be my favorite place for a quick stop. Since the new parking system was introduced, it’s been nothing but long queues, congestion, and frustration. Even the main road is affected!

Convenience is gone, and so am I.

Goodbye, LaSalle Avenue.

reviews.name: A B C Traveller
reviews.text: Surprisingly empty. The mall looks new and eco friendly. It is designed not to use a lot of lightbulbs. There is a place on the top for kids to play too. It is free of charge.

reviews.name: deepak singh
reviews.text:
Surprised by this placed somewhat hidden from the regular places. It has everything a spot to play with your pets, large open spaces, food options, shopping options and plenty of parking space. A welcome change from all the other malls you find in Bangkok.

It has all things you would need even a haircut salon from neverysaycutz.

reviews.name: RRAARRIINN
reviews.text: A good community mall for family. There're many restaurants here and convenient store. Mall have the large yard for chillax and allow pet to come inside. And mall just opened the new playground area for children, that's so awesome.

reviews.name: JJ T
reviews.text: Lots of eatery outside the restaurants. Come after 1pm, fresh fruits(delicious Pomelo and Guava) and cheap Thai southern food😋.

reviews.name: ** PYMN **
reviews.text:
A great hang out place for people who living in this area. There are restaurants, coffee shops, a supermarket and many other things.
Parking lots are free, but always be crowded on weekend around lunch and dinner time.

I deduct the stars given, because the A/C at the gym has been broken for almost a month now. While you are working out, it is super uncomfortable and easily out of breathe.
I was informed that the A/C is the common facility. Should have sent someone to fix earlier.

Also, the orgainizer always arrange the events that do not suit the place; such as kid's cheerleading and kid's taekwondo events which took all the parking spaces that are alreafy limited. It affected the  gym comers or routine users that comes usually.

reviews.name: larsonbkk
reviews.text: Can be reached Easily by taxi with minimum cost as you take it from Bearing BTS. Good place for kids to play with sand and sliding. Uniqlo, KFC ,villa market and restaurants. Overall good place for family and friends.

reviews.name: Daviee Jeffreys
reviews.text: Now this in my humble opinion is the very best concept in Bangkok , really lovely gardens , incredible toilets , this stuff is great and really important , a great place to meet .

reviews.name: tubbtitude
reviews.text: I really like the landscape of this mall, it’s not huge bu comfortable, clean and lots of food. The Uniqlo shop stand alone here. The toilet is very clean and fresh.

reviews.name: Steve Lanson
reviews.text: We no longer shop here due to the ridiculous new parking ‘system’! Surely you can see by the brand new huge queue on the road there is something wrong?! There are much better, high tech ways to stop people abusing your car park - better than punishing your loyal, loyal customers. Villa market will be lost without me!

reviews.name: Jasmine Hu
reviews.text: New parking system is absolutely horrible. Not only do you have to pay a fee online, it takes forever to leave the premises because there is only 1 lane.

reviews.name: Paul Miso
reviews.text: Small but has everything you expect from neighborhood mall. What really stand out and make this community mall different from other mall is it lush green open space and huge layground for kids.

reviews.name: A S
reviews.text: Used to be go to place for food & shopping at Villa. But the new parking system is truly horrible and invasive - To go beyond 30 minutes of parking, you have to add a Line account, and give tons of personal information to avail some hours of free parking. After all this, there’s still a queue to get out. Imagine shopping for 7k at Uniqlo, and still have to fill up a form for a 20B parking. Totally mismanaged and absolutely dropped the ball on this one. Will not be coming back

reviews.name: Lee Soon Guan
reviews.text: Interesting suburban shopping center. Has many shops and restaurants serving the residents in this area. There's a big garden lawn for people and kids to rest and relax.

reviews.name: Kaiyee Tay
reviews.text: A super convenient mix of shops and resturants! Nice open space and kid’s playground, a good variety of food options and a Villa market. Still not fully open, but looks like more to come soon !

reviews.name: Worakanok A.
reviews.text:
Nice place with family and friends.
Many restaurants increase and some fun events

reviews.name: M C.
reviews.text: Clean and decently priced. Beside the Novotel so very convenient. Tuk and Koy are superb and really good. You can see the passion in their work. Our 4th time here. Will always come back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're delighted to hear about your positive experience with us! It's great to know that you find our location near BTS Siam Exit 4 so convenient and appreciate the hard work of Tuk and Koy. Their passion truly shines through in the Thai massage treatments they provide. Thank you for choosing us again; we look forward to welcoming you back for your next visit! If you’d like to book ahead, feel free to visit https://zerva.app/en/lekmassage.

reviews.name: Clara
reviews.text:
We chose the 90-minute treatment: 60 minutes of traditional Thai massage followed by 30 minutes of herbal hot compress. Both my husband and I actually fell asleep towards the end, that’s how relaxed we were!

The massages were absolutely incredible. Tei was my therapist, and she was very attentive to my requests throughout the session. I wanted a gentle and relaxing massage, and that’s exactly what I received. My husband, on the other hand, wanted a stronger, deeper massage, and he got exactly what he was looking for.

A well-deserved 10/10! We highly recommend this place 100%. The staff were also extremely kind, polite, and welcoming.

Thank you so much for such a wonderful experience! ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re thrilled to hear about your wonderful experience at Lek Massage! It sounds like you both enjoyed the perfect balance of relaxation with our traditional Thai massage and herbal hot compress. Tei will be delighted to know she met your needs so well. Being located at BTS Siam Exit 4, we’re glad you found us accessible during your visit. We can't wait to welcome you back for another rejuvenating session! If you'd like to book again, feel free to check out https://zerva.app/en/lekmassage.

reviews.name: Veronica C
reviews.text: Always enjoy coming to Lek Massage whenever I come to Bangkok. It’s convenient and the service is excellent. Tuk is my masseur this time round and she has a unique skill to remove the knots in my body.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We truly appreciate your kind words, Veronica! It’s wonderful to hear that you enjoy your visits to Lek Massage in the heart of Siam Square Soi 6. Tuk is indeed a talented therapist, and we’re glad she could help ease those knots for you. We look forward to welcoming you back on your next trip to Bangkok!

reviews.name: Shir L
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience at Lek Massage Bangkok BTS Siam Square. The place was very clean, professional, and well-organized from start to finish.

My therapist, Jan, gave one of the best massages I’ve had in a long time. I’ve had hundreds of Thai massages over the years, both in Thailand and abroad, so my standards are quite high. I know the difference between an average massage and one delivered by a truly skilled therapist, and Jan was exceptional.

The pressure, technique, and attention to detail were excellent throughout the session. If you’re looking for a quality massage in Bangkok, I highly recommend requesting Jan.

That said, I’m sure the other therapists are excellent as well. The overall professionalism, cleanliness, and quality of the experience made it feel like the kind of place you can trust, regardless of which therapist you book. A truly outstanding massage and a place I would happily return to.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're delighted to hear about your fantastic experience at Lek Massage in the heart of Bangkok, near BTS Siam Station Exit 4. Jan is truly a gem among our talented therapists, and we're thrilled that you appreciated the quality and attention to detail in your Thai massage. Your kind words highlight our commitment to providing a trusted wellness experience since 1997. We look forward to welcoming you back for another exceptional session soon! If you'd like to book again, feel free to check out our online booking at https://zerva.app/en/lekmassage.

reviews.text:
We’ve been in Thailand for 6 days now, and Fu Heng Massage is the 4th parlour we’ve visited, and it was hands down the absolute best! I was a little hesitant at first because the shops in Chatuchak Market are quite small and look a bit cramped, but given the price, we decided to give it a go. I am so, so glad we did!

Not only was it the cheapest massage we’ve had so far, but the technique was second to none. Huge thanks to Bo and Dui (the lovely older lady) it was hands down the best massage I've ever had. The shop was wonderfully cool and smelled amazing. We are already planning to come back tomorrow for another after doing some more shopping!

reviews.text:
I don’t quite understand why this place receives so many five-star reviews. I’ve had extensive massage experience in Thailand, and this one felt fairly average to me. (My partner says it is below average.)

Given that the owner sometimes suspects that low ratings come from fake accounts, I’ve attached two photos for reference. BTW, I’m not looking for a voucher or any form of compensation. With so many massage shops available in Thailand, it’s hard to see why someone would return after a disappointing experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ทางร้านต้องขออภัยกับเหตุการณ์ที่เกิดขึ้นเป็นอันดับแรก และทางร้านขอชี้แจงในเหตุการณ์ที่เกิดขึ้น จากการตรวจสอบทางเจ้าของร้านได้ทำการเข้าไปสอบถามเบื้องต้นแล้วจากลูกค้าว่าการนวดของท่านลูกค้าทุกท่านเป็นยังไงบ้างในระยะเวลาหลังจากเริ่มนวดได้ไม่นาน ซึ่งทางลูกค้าได้ตอบกลับมาว่าโอเคโดยการพยักหน้าตอบ ซึ่งหากลูกค้าแจ้งทางร้านว่าไม่โอเคไม่พอใจหรือไม่ชอบการนวดในสไตล์ของหมอนวดท่านดังกล่าว ลูกค้าสามารถเปลี่ยนตัวหมอนวดได้ทันทีฟรีจนกว่าลูกค้าจะพอใจ
ในการกลับมาของลูกค้าท่านอื่นๆที่เป็นชาวต่างชาติท่านอื่น หรือการให้คะแนน 5 ดาวของร้านเรา ไม่ได้เกี่ยวกับความพึงพอใจหรือไม่พอใจของท่านลูกค้าที่ให้คะแนน 2 ดาวกับเรา
 มาตรฐานงานบริการในการนวด หรือการบริการ ทางร้านใส่ใจและดูแลมาตลอดระยะเวลาตั้งแต่เริ่มเปิดร้านให้บริการ ทางร้านมีการตรวจสอบควบคุมคุณภาพมีการอบรมพนักงานการควบคุมฝีมือ
ทางเราเข้าใจในความไม่พอใจของท่านต่อพนักงานของเรา แต่ถ้าหากท่านไม่ได้แจ้งหรือท่านแจ้งว่าตกลงแล้วโอเคแล้ว ทางร้านก็ไม่สามารถเข้าใจลูกค้าได้เช่นกัน ในเมื่อมีปัญหาแต่ท่านไม่ให้โอกาสเรา ชื่อเสียงที่พวกเราสร้างมาจนเป็น 1 ในตลาดนี้ เรายืนยันเสมอมาที่ต้องขอขอบคุณลูกค้าทุกท่านที่ให้ดาวไม่ว่าจะกี่ดาวก็ตาม เราเคารพ ขอขอบคุณและใคร่ครวญขอความกรุณา ได้อย่าเหมารวมการตัดสินใจของลูกค้าท่านอื่นที่มีความพึงพอใจต่อคุณภาพของร้านเรา เพราะลูกค้า 5 ดาวมากกว่า 99% ที่รีวิวให้เราเป็นลูกค้าที่ตั้งใจมอบคะแนนให้เราด้วยความเต็มใจเช่นกัน
ขอบคุณ 
By:Fu Heng Thai Massage

reviews.name: Pratha Agrawal
reviews.text:
I had the most relaxing skincare experience at Jasmin Korean Facial Spa in Bangkok. I had heard so many good things about this place and now I completely understand why it’s rated so highly on GoWabi.

From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt so calming, the interiors are beautiful, clean, and have that peaceful Korean spa vibe that instantly helps you unwind. The entire experience felt premium and thoughtfully done.

I tried their Oxygen Jet Skin Brightening Treatment (75 minutes), and my skin honestly felt so refreshed afterwards. The treatment included deep cleansing, oxygen jet technology, pore care, hydration, and a nourishing mask. I especially loved the advanced equipment they used, the oxygen jet and ultrasonic treatment made the whole experience feel very high-tech and effective.

What made it even better were the relaxing head, neck, shoulder, and back massages during the treatment. The attention to detail, the products, the ambience, and the staff’s care really stood out.

My skin looked brighter, smoother, and had that fresh glow immediately after the session. This was definitely one of my favourite beauty experiences in Bangkok and I would happily come back again.

Jasmin Team 🙏

reviews.name: May Cohen
reviews.text:
We arrived at the place after reading some very good reviews, it was very close to our hotel so we decided to go and pamper ourselves.

We arrived 4 people for 4 different types of treatments. After a short wait at the reception and choosing a suitable treatment for each - we entered separate rooms and the treatments were performed.

Everything was done very professionally and our faces came out smooth and clean. The treatment also included a short foot/head/hand massage.

3 points for improvement:

1. When I got back to the hotel, I saw in the mirror that there were still blackheads left in several areas on my face even though I felt that the blackhead removal was comprehensive and long, so maybe more emphasis should be placed on this.

2. Almost all stages of the treatment except for the use of hot steam were with very cold towels or products, the room itself was also cold from the air conditioner and throughout the treatment (75 minutes) I was quite cold.

3. The branch is located in a small shopping center that appears to be undergoing renovations. Half of the stores there were closed and everything was dark and empty. The restrooms in the complex were also quite neglected, so the experience of arriving at the branch itself was not very pleasant.

But overall, the treatment was very good, the therapists were professional, it felt that quality products were used, and the result was almost perfect 🙏🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We truly appreciate your visit and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again on your next trip to Bangkok.
Have a nice day. 
Jasmin Team 🙏

reviews.name: HappyBunny
reviews.text:
I came across this place on Google Maps — it had great reviews, so I thought I’d give it a try. I’d recently had a 2-hour deep tissue massage at another place, so my body was still feeling quite sore and I felt like a massage to recover from it.😅😆

This time I chose a 90-minute hot stone massage, and with their current promotion it included an extra 30-minute foot massage (or any 30-minute free add-on to extend your current massage). The whole experience was wonderfully relaxing — exactly what I needed. The pressure was gentle (unlike deep tissue), and they used both the stones and their hands with warm oil, which felt amazing. I even drifted off to sleep a few times!

After the massage, they served a small yoghurt dessert with melon, mango, and raisins. It was such a thoughtful touch, and honestly the healthiest post-massage treat I’ve had anywhere.

Before the session, they also asked me to fill out a form, which I thought was the most professional one I’ve seen among massage places I’ve visited. The shop itself isn’t big, but it’s very clean and welcoming. The therapists and the receptionist were all friendly and always smiling, which made the experience even better.

One small note: the toilet isn’t inside the shop — it’s located on the first floor of the same building. So I’d suggest using it before you go in for your massage.

Overall, a lovely and relaxing experience — highly recommended!

reviews.name: Green Life
reviews.text:
Avoid this place at all costs if you’re searching for massage near me. No this is not the place you should go. No no and NO…

Upon entering, we were welcomed by a receptionist whose charm was nowhere to be found. She insisted that we register with our real names as if it were some grand requirement. When we declined, she shifted to demanding our surnames instead. We still said no. She then moved on to asking for our email address, which we also refused to provide, yet she continued pushing as though we owed her our entire life history.

When I later asked for the Wi Fi password, she kept telling me to wait even after I asked twice. In the end, she simply chose not to give it to me. I suppose that was my punishment for not handing over my personal information.

The massage itself was just acceptable, although the therapist left the room several times during the hour for reasons known only to her.

After the massage, the same receptionist returned and asked where we were from. When I chose not to answer yet another intrusive question, she responded with an abrupt remark along the lines of me not wanting to reveal anything. Quite the observation.

Naturally, I do NOT want to reveal anything. Customers are not obliged to surrender their personal data just because a receptionist insists on it. Forcing people to give details they are uncomfortable sharing is hardly an example of good ethics.

And now they know exactly why there was NO tip. The masseurs may have done their job, but the receptionist ensured the entire experience was thoroughly unpleasant.

Should report them to official Thai consumer services for these type of attitude and force. My first time ever getting forced to reveal personal information for just massage.

Don’t need to bar us because we also won’t return. Insanely rude service, and there are plenty of better massages around.

UPDATED Reply to Owner:

Your explanation is simply NOT accurate. I visit Let’s Relax and Healthland regularly, and NONE of those reputable spas ever force customers to hand over personal details. When we declined to provide our names, surnames, and email, your receptionist kept insisting and even withheld the Wi-Fi password afterward. That is not “procedure” - that is forceful pressure.

This small shop should NOT compare itself to reputable chains, they are no where near reputable. This is just a small teeny weeny place that exists everywhere in Bangkok. They are a far cry from Healthland / Let’s Relax standards. Roll my eyes if this small place is reputable. Check my photos. Only 4 beds and some sofas, what reputable please!

Your excuses about forgotten items or “marketing purposes” do not match what actually happened. The receptionist even made a sarcastic remark “OH YOU DON’T EVEN WANT TO TELL ME WHERE YOU ARE FROM” when we chose not to reveal our country of residence, which made it very obvious that the real intention was to obtain personal data, NOT to enhance the guest experience.

What is most concerning is your staff’s willingness to invent stories. My phone was on silent the entire time, and at 10 AM there were no other customers in the shop. Claiming that I disturbed “other guests” is completely false - a fabricated excuse designed to shift blame. This type of behaviour is unacceptable and erodes trust instantly.

And here is the real issue:
When a business repeatedly pressures customers for personal information after they clearly decline, it sends a worrying message. It makes people feel that their data may not be handled properly or could be used in ways they never agreed to. No customer should ever feel that their personal details are being treated like something to exploit.

A warning to everyone reading this:
Be extremely careful with this place, don’t be that 95%. Do NOT hand over any personal details. Do NOT let anyone pressure you. Their behaviour raised serious concerns, and there are many SAFER and ACTUAL reputable spas in Bangkok where your privacy is respected.

We will NEVER return, and your response only confirms that we made the right decision.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Basil, like in most reputable spas, our customers are asked to provide basic details such as name and contact details as part of the check-in and consultation. This is done for several reasons, for example: so we can get in touch with them in case of any forgotten items, ensuring we know how to address them, being able to provide a seamless repeat customer experience. We ask about country of residence for marketing purposes only. All data collection is handled in line with Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act. During your visit we kindly asked you not to disturb our other customers when using your phone. We have various processes and rules in place, which are with our customers' best interest and comfort in mind. We always strive to provide a superior experience for our customers. And we are very proud that 95% of our customers rate their experience 5 stars.

reviews.name: Third Eye Culture
reviews.text:
Hello, I just wanted to leave some feedback about the Thai massage I received today. I am usually very hesitant to leave a poor review because I understand how much reviews can affect a business, and I am genuinely not trying to be mean or unfair. However, I do feel I should be honest about my experience.

Unfortunately, this was probably the most painful and awkward Thai massage I have ever received. The technique felt very unusual compared with the many Thai massages I have had before, and much of the treatment felt repetitive rather than progressing naturally through the body.

For example, the masseuse spent what felt like 20–30 minutes repeatedly digging her elbow very deeply into my shoulder blades. She would work on the right side, then the left, massage and pinch my neck with her thumbs and fingers, and then return again to digging her elbow into the same areas. Deep elbow pressure around the shoulder blades can feel good for a few minutes, but when it continues for that long, it becomes extremely painful.

Eventually, I was hurting enough that I said, “Ow, ow, please softer.” She then moved on to my lower back, but later there was another very painful part when she worked on my inner thighs. The pressure felt like it was rubbing directly against the bone, and again I had to ask her to be softer. The same thing then happened on the other leg.

The biggest issue for me was the inconsistent pressure and what seemed like an inability to recognize when I was clearly uncomfortable or in pain. Areas that had already been worked very heavily were repeatedly revisited rather than moving naturally through the rest of the body. By the end of the massage, I felt more beaten up than relaxed, and several hours later my entire body is still extremely sore.

I genuinely think it would be useful for one of the managers to receive a Thai massage from this particular masseuse and experience her technique firsthand. If she gives the same type of treatment, I think you will immediately understand what I am describing. My intention is not to get anyone in trouble. I simply think management should assess whether some additional training would help with pressure, technique, pacing, and recognizing when a customer is experiencing pain.

I really wanted to enjoy the treatment, which is why I feel disappointed enough to leave this feedback.

On a positive note, the facility was very clean, including the bathroom, and the staff were friendly and hospitable. I really appreciated the cold towel and water upon arrival, as well as the cold water, tea, and cookies afterward. The masseuse herself was also very nice, and I could tell that she was genuinely trying her best.

reviews.name: 小森義之
reviews.text:
I had a very bad experience here.
At first, I was trying to enjoy the massage, but the therapist used excessive force. I told her multiple times that it was painful, but she did not stop. Even when I clearly said “it hurts,” she continued.
She then switched me to another therapist. Unfortunately, the second therapist had an even worse attitude and continued to apply very strong pressure despite my repeated requests to stop.
As a result, I now have a painful swelling around my knee (like a lump), and it is still hurting. This is completely unacceptable for a professional massage service. In my country (Japan), causing an injury like this during a massage would be considered a serious issue.
I stopped the session and reported this to the front desk, but the receptionist did not show any proper apology or concern, which was very disappointing.
On top of that, even after I clearly explained that I was injured and in pain, they only offered a partial refund and still charged me for half of the session. This is extremely unprofessional and unacceptable.
For the price (750 THB for 90 minutes), the quality of the massage is far below expectations. In Thailand, this is not a cheap price, but the skill level does not match it at all. Honestly, I’ve had much better massages at cheaper places. The only good thing here is that the shop looks clean — that’s it.
I left feeling extremely uncomfortable and disappointed.
I do not recommend this place.
I would like the management to take this issue seriously and provide an appropriate response.

reviews.text:
I went today with my boyfriend for pedicure, He chose the spa treatment while i just needed a pedicure+nail polish. The price was expensive but since the place was recommended by the hotel we trusted it, also considering that the shop looked really nice. My main issue has been with the clarity - or lack of it - concerning the service provided. For pedicure they mean basic nail trimming, which has never been in my experience what a pedicure service meant, especially for the elevated price. After applying the nail polish I’ve been told I should “be careful” for 1 hour as I was rushed out, but as I was wearing shoes I asked what they would suggest i’d do given that i would have to wear socks. I asked if I could stay a bit longer so that at least the nail polish could dry up a bit better, but either for the language barrier or for their lack of care I was just given some single use slides and still rushed out, with them repeating to be careful.
They did accept to take me in later in the day in case I would have issues after I suggested it, but the truth is that I wouldn’t have had time for that.
My suggestions are that instead of “Pedicure” the service should be named “Basic toenails trimming”, as that would avoid many misunderstandings and disappointment, and when requesting for the basic nail polish I should have been told it was going to take one hour afterwards before i could wear shoes so that i could have made a more informed decision.
The two girls providing the service were really nice even if we couldn’t communicate very well and the massaging chairs really fun and comfy, but unfortunately this was a negative experience - considering the expensive price for the service.

reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Minimal Massage. From the moment I arrived, they made me feel relaxed and welcome. They started by washing my feet, which was a very nice touch, and then the massage began. It was honestly one of the best massage experiences I have ever had.

My massage therapist was excellent and very professional. It was my first time being treated by him. He is the man shown in the review photos with the tattoo on his neck, and I highly recommend him.

What impressed me even more was their honesty and integrity. Last night, I removed my necklace and left it beside the bed where I had my massage. I had a foot, head, and back massage, and I completely forgot about it when I left. I only realized today that my necklace was missing. When I returned, I was so relieved to find that the staff had safely kept it at the reception desk for me.

A special thank you to the person who found my necklace and turned it in. Your honesty means a lot, and I truly appreciate it. In today's world, it is not always easy to find such trustworthy people, and your kindness did not go unnoticed.

Excellent service, professional staff, a relaxing atmosphere, and honest, trustworthy people. This place truly cares about its customers. I will definitely come back and highly recommend Minimal Massage to anyone looking for a wonderful and relaxing massage experience.

reviews.text: Very very good massage! Fantastic

reviews.name: Ilya Lebedev
reviews.text:
The back massage was great, I loved it.

The thing I didn't like is that this place is located in the middle of Khao San road, which is probably one of the most loud places in Thailand. I specifically asked the receptionist if it is quiet in the massage room and they confirmed it. But it wasn't true actually, the music outside is so loud that it's really hard to relax, moreover, the bass drops so hard that the whole room including the bed under you constantly vibrates.

I suggest you visit it during the daytime when the area is quiet, then I'm sure this will be a nice experience.

reviews.name: aaroncox1000
reviews.text:
We just had a really nice 1/2 hr morning foot massage.
They have a nice comfortable atmosphere and the massages were good! 360baht for 2.

reviews.name: Карина Коко
reviews.text: Nice massage. Relaxing. They use special Thailand creams... oils... I’ve got what I expected! Thank u very much

reviews.name: R K
reviews.text: Great place to get a massage lying outside and people watching on the side of khao san. The massage is top notch too (got 300+ massages in SE Asia over last two years)

title: Urban Calm Massage & Hair Spa (Nap Salon) | นวดผ่อนคลาย & ซาลอนนวดศีรษะ

✨A Perfect place for all travelers and office workers✨
Discover The Original Thai massage and spa experience in the area. We offers a one-of-a-kind experience in the area, allowing you to truly unwind your body and mind with our unique combination of expert massage and a private Head Massage Salon. The perfect escape from the city hustle, ensuring your ultimate relaxation.

🌿 Traditional Thai Massage & Aromatherapy:
💆‍♀️ Head Spa Salon & Head Massage:

✨ Urban Calm: โอเอซิสแห่งความสงบใจกลางเมือง ให้คุณได้หลีกหนีจากความวุ่นวาย ด้วยการผสมผสานการนวดผ่อนคลายและซาลอนนวดศีรษะ เพื่อมอบประสบการณ์การพักผ่อนร่างกายและจิตใจที่ดีที่สุดให้คุณ
address: 55 Phaya Thai Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Khet Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

reviews.name: Weronika B
reviews.text: We booked a 90-minute Thai massage one day in advance, and all I can say is… OMG! It was one of the best massages I’ve ever had. I love a really strong massage, and this one was absolutely perfect. I’ve had many massages in my life, and this was definitely one of the best. The place was spotless, the therapists were professional, and the pressure was exactly what I was looking for. We also really appreciated the warm tea and the hot compress after the massage—it was the perfect finishing touch. I highly recommend this place if you enjoy an authentic, strong Thai massage. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.name: C.
reviews.text: Had a hair spa in this place. Coated 950 baht. It's the worst hair spa I ever had. Obviously the staff is not trained to do this. At first she used her nails to scratch my scalp so hard and was painful until I told her. She rubbed so hard on my scalp for a hair washing and for the rest of the treatment.. the whole process was not relaxing. Please go somewhere else for the hair spa but not this place. .

reviews.name: Xing Er Tan
reviews.text:
I had thai massage for 1.5hours here. It's actually my second time here. Totally loving this place!! Not a touristy side so even better!! The staff are all so friendly and nice, smiling and all. This place is really cozy. Small but cozy!!! I came on a friday afternoon and it was pretty quiet so it feels even more relaxing. Will definitely come back and will recommend to friends and family!

Loved that they washed our feet with soap??(i think) before the massage. And got a hot shoulder pad??? Placed on my neck after the massage with a complimentary warm soothing drink after.

reviews.name: Kim Sheldon
reviews.text:
I opted for the head spa and it was so relaxing, I nearly fell asleep a few times! I didn’t expect the blow dry and hair styling at the end to be so cute - I have a wavy style and my hair feels so soft as product was applied afterwards too. You also got to choose between hair mist and hair perfume at the end.

This place is so reasonably priced if you’re looking for a head spa in Bangkok; I can’t recommend it enough 🩷

reviews.name: giacomo farru
reviews.text:
We booked a massage at Urban Massage Center to celebrate my girlfriend’s birthday, choosing the one-hour back, shoulders, and neck package. The experience was absolutely wonderful.
The massage was very effective: at first it can feel a bit intense, but soon after you really feel your back loosen up and the relief is amazing. The two therapists were highly skilled, kind, and friendly, and they made us feel comfortable right away.
From the moment we arrived, the welcome was warm. They provided special clothes for the treatment, washed our feet, and then guided us to the massage room. At the end, we were treated with a hot tea and a heated neck wrap, probably with salts, which was such a lovely touch.
The center is also easy to reach by public transport, which makes it very convenient. We highly recommend it both for a special occasion and simply to take care of yourself. We will definitely be back.

reviews.name: ᄋᄉᄋ남캉
reviews.text: The best massage place in the Phayathai area — affordable, clean, and with excellent service! They serve water, wash your feet with a nice fragrant scrub before the massage, and offer a warm compress afterward. The atmosphere is lovely with relaxing music. I’ve been coming here more than 20 times already!

reviews.name: Stella Wong
reviews.text: I tried the 2-hour Thai massage and it was great! The location was super convenient, just a short walk from my hotel. I also found a discount voucher online through Gowai, which made the experience even better. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Steve Tham
reviews.text: Saw this place on google maps near my hotel and gave it a try. Did a 90 mins head spa and it was a very relaxing experience.  Throughout the period, I was given a strong and firm massage and I fell asleep even though it was 11am :) At thb 1,200 it was very gd value. Will definitely come again if I have the chance!

reviews.name: Thanthan Thanthanita
reviews.text:
I enjoyed my massage here. The staff were professional, polite and kind. My therapist asked me exactly where I wanted to focus, and she spent a lot of time massaging that area. I felt that good kind of muscle soreness afterward haha. The place itself is clean and peaceful.
I highly recommend giving this place a try

reviews.name: Michelle Lin
reviews.text: Great hair spa at reasonable prices. We didn’t have line so we walked in to book. My partner thought his aroma massage was very average because the strokes were way too rushed and fast but my scalp massage was great. Will come again but probably just the hair spa.

reviews.name: Lola Chen
reviews.text: I found Urban Calm massage is very popular and need to book in advance. I was nearby and walk in, staff are friendly and very skillful. I would love to try head spa next time! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: chris an
reviews.text: Head back and shoulder massage was great. I got the middle aged short haired lady who was very strong. This place is frequently fully booked and walk ins are nearly impossible during peak hours so best to book in advanced. Also a nice restaurant to eat at right below 👇

reviews.name: Niramon Thudthieng
reviews.text: The best Massage in town, i usually foot massage here !i think more than 5 times. I actually feel relaxing and comfy. And The service is top notch. worth for it ! value in your money well spend. I would be recommend must try.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the glowing review and for choosing us time and time again! We're so glad you always have a relaxing and comfortable experience with us. Your recommendation is the highest compliment we could ask for. See you again soon at Urban Calm!

reviews.name: Tim Wilson
reviews.text:
Fantastic! I've just finished having my 90mins Thai Massage. What an absolute treat.
The spa is gorgeous, clean and very calming. The massage was great and much needed after a few hectic days and nights.

I will be back tomorrow

reviews.name: Niko Carter
reviews.text: Lovely atmosphere and massage for such a reasonable price! The Thai aunties were not only skilled massage therapists but were filled with so much joy that was contagious!! The studio was constantly filled with laughter, would recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your lovely feedback! We're so happy you enjoyed your experience and the joyful atmosphere of our studio. Our team's happiness is definitely contagious! We hope to see you again soon for more relaxation and laughter.

reviews.name: Toru Ramen
reviews.text: Incredible relaxing massage ever around here!  I would rate it 6/5, the price is reasonable and the stuff is friendly, I buy the 60 mins course is very legit massage!clean and comfortable must try!

reviews.name: Rosebelle Doroteo
reviews.text:
10/10 would recommend. We got their Aromatherapy massage and it was the best aromatherapy that we had after trying out 3
different places.

We tried 2 other different places — Palace Massage (victory monument) and Sharon (sukhumvit) and honestly, Sharon has the most expensive yet least satisfying massage.

Highly suggest to message their fb for reservation. Check their posts as well because we got 15% off the displayed rate bc of their August promo.

For the oil, Sakura has a sweet smell and it worked best for me. My partner got Orchid.
Will always visit this place in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Peter Seow
reviews.text: Very close to the Phaya Thai train station and Sukhon hotel where we stayed. My wife enjoyed her 1.5 hr aromatherapy massage and I had a good 1 hr Thai massage. The staff were good in the massage and friendly. We had a good warm neck pillow and tea after the massage. Prices were reasonable and the place was clean and relaxing. We will come back here next time we return to Bangkok. They only accept cash. We did not have enough Thai Baht but they accepted the US dollars we had. I would recommend this place. Came back the second time to Urban Calm. Had a good 2 hr Thai compress massage.

reviews.name: Jenne
reviews.text: My favorite massage place – skilled therapists who hit all the right spots. Conveniently located near BTS Phaya Thai and reasonably priced.

reviews.name: denjell112
reviews.text:
Perfect price quality ratio.

Very professional massage.
Everything is clean and well organized, from the beginning till the warm tea at the end 👌

Maybe the boxes are a little bit small but I would always come back here!

🙏

reviews.name: piyada senakoon
reviews.text: มาฉีดวัคซีนกับคุณหมอรวงข้าวเป็นประจำ คุณหมอและพี่จ๋า น่ารักกับน้องโฮปเสมอ คลินิกสะอาดมากๆ แยกโซนเด็กป่วย เด็กวัคซีน ชอบที่นี่มากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: We regularly get our children vaccinated with Dr. Ruangkhao. Dr. Ruangkhao and P'Jaa are always so kind to Hope. The clinic is very clean, with separate areas for sick children and children receiving vaccinations. We really like it here.

reviews.name: Manthana Sinsap
reviews.text:
คุณหมอและพี่พนักงานบริการดีมาก ๆ เลยค่ะ
เด็ก ๆ ที่นี่พ่นยาไม่ร้องไห้งอแง เพราะมีพี่ ๆ คอยให้กำลังใจ เอ็นเตอร์เทนเด็ก ๆ ตลอดเลยค่ะ คุณหมอและพี่ ๆ ใจดีมาก ๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
The doctor and the staff were very kind.
The children here didn't cry or fuss when they received their nebulizer treatments because the staff were there to encourage and entertain them throughout the process. The doctor and the staff were very kind.

reviews.name: นวรัตน์ เทพี
reviews.text: บริการดีมากๆค่ะ ทั้งคุณหมอและพี่ๆผู้ช่วยทุกคนใจดีมากค่ะ คลินิกก็สะอาดมาก มีมุมให้เด็กๆเล่นของเล่นระหว่างรอพบคุณหมอ ที่ชอบที่สุดคือการแบ่งโซนเด็กที่ป่วยกับเด็กที่มารับวัคซีนชัดเจน ตอนนี้มีห้องรอระหว่างการรับวัคซีนเพิ่มใหม่ดีมากๆๆเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The service was excellent! Both the doctor and all the assistants were very kind. The clinic was very clean, and there was a play area for children while they waited to see the doctor. What I liked most was the clear separation of areas for sick children and children receiving vaccinations. They've now added a new waiting room for vaccinations, which is great!

reviews.text:
ชอบบรรยากาศของคลินิกค่ะ เจ้าหน้าที่น่ารัก ของเล่นให้เด็กๆได้เพลิดเพลินมากมาย

มาแล้วยินยอมให้ทำแต่โดยดี…ไม่มีขัดขืน…พี่ๆบริการดีน่ารัก

วันนี้มาตรวจสุขภาพที่คลินิก พี่ๆน่ารัก บริการดี มีของเล่นให้เล่นระหว่างรอ น้ำเย็นชอบมาก

น้ำเย็นไม่สบายตั้งแต่เมื่อวาน…พอบอกว่าเดี๋ยวจะพามาหาป้าหมอรวงข้าวแค่นั้นแหละ ดีใจสุดๆ บริการดีคลินิกน่ารักมีของเล่นมากมาย
reviews.textTranslated:
I love the atmosphere of the clinic. The staff are lovely, and there are lots of toys for the children to enjoy.

When I arrived, my child willingly agreed to the procedures… no resistance… the staff were kind and helpful.

Today I came for a health checkup at the clinic. The staff were lovely and the service was excellent. There were toys to play with while waiting, and my child loved the cold water.

My child, Nam Yen, had been unwell since yesterday… but as soon as I mentioned I would bring her to see Auntie Ruang Khao, she was overjoyed. The service was great, the clinic was lovely, and there were lots of toys.

reviews.name: Prangthip Chaisarn
reviews.text:
สถานที่สะอาด พี่ๆและคุณหมอน่ารักค่ะ ราคาเป็นมิตร
น้องมารักษาที่นี่ประจำค่ะ คุณหมอแนะนำดีใส่ใจรายละเอียดดีมากๆค่ะ น้องไม่สบายมาหาคุณหมอรวงข้าวประจำค่ะ แนะนำแม่ๆทุกคนเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
The place is clean, the staff and doctors are lovely, and the prices are reasonable.
My child comes here regularly for treatment. The doctor gives good advice and pays attention to detail. When my child is sick, we always bring Dr. Ruangkhao to see her. I highly recommend this place to all mothers.

reviews.name: tawanshai nakpat
reviews.text: เป็นคลินิคประจำที่พาลูกมาตลอดค่ะ วันนี้พาน้องมารับวัคซีนไข้หวัดใหญ่ 4 สายพันธุ์ ราคาน่ารัก คุณหมอใจดีเหมือนเดิมค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: This is our go-to clinic for our child. Today, we brought her for the quadrivalent flu vaccine. The price is reasonable, and the doctor is as kind as ever.

reviews.name: som jeen

คุณหมอแนะนำดีมากให้คำปรึกษาดีมากค่ะ

The doctor gave excellent advice and consultation.

คุณหมอน่ารักและใจดีมากๆเลยค่ะ น้องชอบเล่นของเล่นมากเพลินระหว่างรอค่ะ

reviews.textTranslated:
The doctor is very lovely and kind. My child loved playing with toys while waiting.
Today, during the flu vaccination, the doctor was still lovely and explained everything in an easy-to-understand way.
The doctor is lovely, and my child was well-cared for by the doctor. My child recovered after being treated by Dr. Ruangkhao.
Today was a follow-up appointment. I appreciate the doctor's attentiveness and clear explanations, accurately identifying the illness.
1/7/69 Today, my child was sick. The doctor gave advice about the symptoms and how to care for them. The doctor is attentive and treats the symptoms correctly every time. Thank you for your kindness to the children.

reviews.text: I absolutely loved my foot massage! 💆🏻‍♀️✨ From the moment I arrived, the staff were so welcoming, friendly, and attentive. The service was very professional, and the massage was incredibly relaxing and well done. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and completely satisfied. Thank you for the wonderful experience! Highly recommended! ❤️

reviews.name: Duangkamon Jamsiri
reviews.text: I came for the very first time for Gua Sha facial massage. The vibe’s incredible, great refreshment and amazing mango sticky rice! 🤩 Staff are professional, too. For sure it’s worth your time!

reviews.name: arianne oroceo
reviews.text: The massage is so good. You get to choose the oil they will use for the massage. They gve welcome drinks uponarrival and provided mango sticky rice after the massage. What a treat!

reviews.name: Ally Kate
reviews.text:
More of a 3.5 stars - I wish I could give them a 4 stars, really. The service was pretty good; nothing fancy but very decent. However, the facial guasha and foot massage that I experienced were both quite disappointing - not so much the service, but what the process entails.

Facial guasha - there was no clear introduction to the products used and the steps as well. The pressure was very mild (hardly felt a thing) and didn’t target the pressure points for a relaxing experience; didn’t feel any impact of the tension release that usually comes with guasha. That said, the head/neck/back massages were good! But that only took like 5-10 mins of the entire experience (as it should be, since it’s a facial guasha not body massage). Not worth the THB1,770.

Foot massage - again, didn’t target the pressure points. Strength was alright, I did indicate firm but could have even harder. My issue really is more on the pressure points.

Ambience - would give this a 4.5 / 5 stars - very clean, private rooms, and even a shower.

Service - 4/5 stars. The dessert at the end of the treatment was yummy too!

Perhaps the body massage would be better, given it’s a massage place and not aesthetics / facial salon.

reviews.name: Rapat J
reviews.text: I tried  the oil massage spa service today and honestly, it was beyond amazing. From the moment I walked in, everything felt calm, classy, and super luxurious. The therapist was incredibly gentle yet really knew how to release tension in all the right spots. The warm oil, soothing scents, and soft lighting made me relax instantly. I felt completely taken care of, not rushed at all. Every detail, from the fluffy towels to the smooth music, was perfect. I walked out feeling lighter, calmer, and totally refreshed. If you need real relaxation with a touch of luxury, this is it. 🫶🏻✨🧖🏻‍♀️💆🏻‍♀️✅

reviews.name: Khulood Mohammed
reviews.text: One of the best experiences at Kliniq wellness, my mom and I booked the Guasha facial treatment and it was the most relaxing treatments ever done! They even treat you with the mango sticky rice <3

reviews.name: Toni Angeline Dorotheo
reviews.text: The spa is clean and very nice. The ambience is great and relaxing. I had a very nice 90 mts massage. Felt so good. My therapist is Biw. Very professional. One of the best that I had. The Mango sticky rice after the massage is good too!! I will go back.

reviews.name: nashadi fernando
reviews.text:
I had the most wonderful full body massage here, and it honestly exceeded all my expectations. My therapist, Orathai, was absolutely amazing — so gentle, attentive, and professional throughout the session. I walked out feeling lighter, relaxed, and genuinely cared for.

And the best part? They surprised me with mango sticky rice at the end. Such a thoughtful touch and the perfect way to finish the experience. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed the overall experience at KLINIQ WELLNESS SPA. 

Our goal is to ensure that your relaxing journey with us is memorable, and we strive to provide every detail that reflects comfort, attention, and restoration from the moment you arrive until you depart.

We will ensure that your thoughtful feedback is shared with our team to elevate our service quality further. 

Thank you once again for choosing KLINIQ WELLNESS SPA for your pampering destination of choice. 

We hope to welcome you back again soon for more moments of relaxation and rejuvenation.

Wellness regards,
Team KLINIQ WELLNESS SPA

reviews.name: Gillian Caisido
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at Kliniq Wellness Spa, I availed the Gua Sha facial massage. My therapist was P’Koop Kai (I’m not sure if I spelled her name correctly), but she was such a lovely and kind lady. She made me feel very comfortable throughout the session, and I could really tell she was skilled and attentive. The massage itself was incredibly relaxing and rejuvenating, just what i needed for this trip. The ambiance of the spa was perfect, calm, clean, and soothing, which made the whole experience even better. Overall, it was a very good experience, and I would definitely come back again. ✨

reviews.name: Henrietta Tam
reviews.text: Enjoyed the 120mins massage, experienced therapist, great skills, great service. Heated bed and relaxing music. Will come back again!

reviews.name: G Dumaguing
reviews.text: got a Thai massage and guasha, booked via klook since it was on a promo. Great because I'm there for a vacation. First time visiting this place and the front desk is very friendly and spoke English well. she  gave me a form to fill out and give guide to the masseuse which part of my body i want to have more focus on or not to touch. I've been to other massage spa as well in Bangkok but this was the premium one so far. Private room and a shower. No toilet inside, you have to walk outside to get to the toilet but it's very near. The massage gave me a relief in my back pain, it is totally different kind of massage of what I usually get in my country but when thai gave me a massage they always and surely give me pain relief. For my massage here it was great, every touch was heaven, relaxing. I have also a discomfort in my left arm and she just did something and im relieved. she's young but daaang... the guasha was relaxing, my skin was like a baby's butt right after but the "sha" came out immediately which is dark spots which is normal and i forgot i shouldn't have done it since i had a recent cautery procedure so that's my fault. but they did gave me a free arbutin to not make it darken too much. right after all these, they gave me a tea and a delicious mango sticky rice which is great so my blood sugar will not be too low. The mall has a food court so go there, too man options. I'd totally recommend this place. Relaxing and gave me relief in my body pain especially from work and my workouts.

reviews.name: Cassie “Cassie” Zhang
reviews.text: I would not recommend this place to anyone who wants professional service and relaxed massage. Reception girls are talking loud and laughing as if this place is their own gossip home. This is not professional. I had a Guasha facial massage which is their signature massage, the massage technique is not bad but at the end I found so much white stuff on my face that is not fully cleaned. This is highly unprofessional and unacceptable. I would not come and would not recommend.

reviews.name: Earth C
reviews.text: I came back here again, and the massage is still just as good as ever. My favorite thing is the mango sticky rice it’s absolutely delicious! 👍🏼 The reception staff are very friendly and welcoming. They took great care of me throughout my visit. The therapists are excellent as well. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: reviewed
reviews.text: Very nice, upscale spa in Centralworld. Most amazing foot massage ever.

reviews.name: yingfei chai
reviews.text: The reception and staff are very good,I really enjoyed massage here,their English is also good. provided welcome food and tea also

reviews.name: Nicole Lai
reviews.text:
Had an incredible massage experience that left me  and my partner feeling completely relaxed and rejuvenated. The atmosphere was calm, welcoming, and peaceful. The space was clean and beautifully decorated — the perfect setting to unwind.

We tried both Royal Thai Massage (120mins) and Holistic Relaxing Massage (90mins). Our therapist was not only professional and friendly but also highly skilled. They took the time to ask about our preferences and any areas that needed extra attention, and they tailored the session accordingly. Every movement felt intentional and therapeutic — just the right amount of pressure, and a perfect balance between relaxation and muscle relief.

By the end of the session, we felt lighter, more relaxed, and completely at ease. It was easily one of the best massages we have ever had. I highly recommend this place to anyone in need of some self-care or stress relief. I’ll definitely be coming back!

P.S they serve us delicious mango sticky rice and hot tea after each session 😋😋

reviews.name: Rajesh Ojha
reviews.text:
I have been visiting Thailand as tourist since 2009. Spa & Massage has always been integral part of visiting Land of Smiles. In nutshell of my numerous visits here and experiencing the most luxurious to beach sun bed massages, Kliniq Wellness Spa has bypassed & superseded all of them by a mile.

I would like to specially mention RHANG for exceptional Massage Service. Every body part of mine felt rejuvenated & completely relaxed post the therapy.

I would be revisiting soon to re-experience the Magic soon. Keep the great work team, You guys are the best 👏🏻

reviews.name: John Cisneros
reviews.text: I got a 2 hour treatment. Oil massage and sculpting facial. It was truly enjoyable and relaxing. I felt in great hands!

reviews.name: Denise
reviews.text:
Great massage - Thai style 90 mins. Got a discounted price using GoWabi.
Clean rooms and professional masseurs. Really like that there was a massage bed (better breathing when prone) as with other Thai massage places it’s usually a mattress on the floor. Will come back in the future!

reviews.name: Weng M
reviews.text: Love our experience here. Staff were very attentive,.place was easy to find, clean, smells sooo good and the little snack after was unexpected but great+

reviews.name: Kane Z
reviews.text:
I found this place by chance when we were on a tight schedule and happened to discover it near our hotel. I’m really glad we did. The massage was very good — the therapist had great technique and knew exactly how to work on the tight areas. I felt so much better afterwards.
The staff were very friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even nicer. The shop looks quite small from the outside, but it’s actually very clean and tidy inside. Everything felt comfortable and well taken care of. The price is very reasonable for the quality you get, definitely great value for money. If I have the chance to visit Bangkok again in the future, I would absolutely come back.

reviews.name: Florian Bittner
reviews.text: I’d booked an aromatic oil massage for today. It was very professional and relaxing. The staff are very friendly and do an excellent job. They speak a little English but that’s ok. I’m really happy and I will definitely be back.

reviews.name: Jay Woodworth
reviews.text: I am visiting for the US and have had several massages in Thailand.  So far this place, right around the corner from where I have been staying, has been the best.  Joy really allieved a problem that I have been having with my knee.  Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Gupita Widyadhari
reviews.text: I’m a tourist from Indonesia. I noticed that this massage place has branches everywhere, which made me even more confident to give it a try. The place is very tourist-friendly. The staff are warm, the price is affordable, and the massage is great. I’d give it a 9.5 out of 10. I chose the 60-minute package for 250 baht, and honestly that alone was already really good for the price and the massage quality. I recommend coming in the morning when they first open so it’s not too crowded. The place is small and located right by a main road, so you’ll hear a lot of outside noise coming through

reviews.name: Sirisha Sukrutham
reviews.text: We were able to walk in & receive appointment for foot massage. Very friendly & kind staff. Amazing foot massage & great prices. They were able to accommodate my husband only wanting a 30 minute foot massage and I received 60 minutes. They have some employees that are visually impaired, which is awesome for job security. Highly recommend!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback on our services.

We sincerely appreciate your thoughtful review and are delighted to know about your positive experience.

Your understanding and respect toward our staff mean a great deal to us.

We hope you have a wonderful stay in our country and wish you continued health and happiness.

With warm regards,
Just Massage

reviews.name: Where the Cookie Crumbles
reviews.text:
A very reasonably priced and clean shop. Thap, my masseuse, needed few words to find my body relief- I had a back, neck, and shoulders along with thai massage. We stayed together 2 hours after having just arriving into the city and it was the right choice.

As a walk in I was seen right away and my request to move away from the seating area for less noise was accommodated. The shop is small so chatter and laundry could be heard throughout but otherwise a welcoming place amidst a bustling city.

reviews.name: Harsh Patel
reviews.text: The best Thai Massage we ever had! The staff is nice and the prices are reasonable. They spend the full hour on you and don’t skimp out. The beds are all next to each other so changing was a bit difficult but otherwise everything else was excellent.

reviews.name: Karolina L
reviews.text: I like their service. I had foot and head, neck and shoulder massage. It was strong but not as hard as in some other place which I really liked. I could relax.

reviews.name: Ted Cook
reviews.text: This was a great massage experience. I went back for a total of three times in one week.Thep offered me an amazing Thai massage. This is the place to go if you Just want a great massage and no extras.

reviews.name: Charlie Hazelton
reviews.text: During my final hours in Bangkok before my 23 hour journey home, I decided to get a 2 hr massage here. Best decision of my life. I’m almost looking forward to my flight because of how good I feel. Great prices and even better massages. 10/10 will be back again!

reviews.name: Maksymilian Tokarski
reviews.text: My massage here was amazing—very precise and professional. I feel absolutely great after the massage and very relaxed. The staff is so friendly. My massage was slightly delayed, and because of that, I received a discount, which was very fair and much appreciated. This shows that the salon truly cares about its good reputation. I will definitely come back. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Maksymilian,

Thank you very much for choosing our services. We sincerely appreciate your visit and are delighted to have had the opportunity to serve you.

We would also like to extend our deepest apologies for the wait despite your reservation. Your patience and understanding mean a great deal to us, and we truly appreciate it.

💚💚

reviews.name: Kinga Polańska
reviews.text: I visited Just Massage (ร้านนวด พหลโยธิน21) for a foot massage, and I must say it was one of the best experiences I’ve had! From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the ambiance – the place is clean, peaceful, and very inviting. The therapists are incredibly professional, paying attention to every detail to ensure a completely relaxing experience. The foot massage was flawless; I could feel the tension melting away with each precise movement, tailored perfectly to my needs. I left feeling light and energized! I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for top-quality massage in a friendly, welcoming environment. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Viclaus Yip
reviews.text:
My wife and I chanced upon this shop which is 5min stroll from jodds fairs danmerit

We engaged an older masseur and although they can't really speak English but she is GOOD! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kindness review 🙏🏻😇please have a good day

reviews.name: pariyapat choksakulnimit
reviews.text: Clean and good therapist. Has parking. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Everyday Explorer
reviews.text: Saw this place while walking by and decided to check it out. Simple set up, not fancy, but my husband and I both had great Thai massages.

reviews.name: Kasidis Wiboolsamai
reviews.text: This is a great experience thai massage that I met. Good service and good staff. If you want to relax I reccomend this place.Thanks for the good experience:)

reviews.name: Rita APz
reviews.text: The massage was good, but we were pulled by the arm as soon as we got in, as the staff was in a hurry to start the massage ASAP. That part of the experience wasn't comfortable; it set a tone of rush for the rest of the stay.

reviews.name: Raja Amsyar Hillman Raja Badrul Hisham
reviews.text: I had a superb, authentic THAI massage at Just Massage. The therapist was professional and really helped relieve all my tension. The environment is clean, relaxing, and welcoming. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a genuine massage experience!

reviews.name: Jon
reviews.text: Clean shop , Visited recently , had a good foot 🦶 massage here , reasonable price & staff were nice
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your support ka have a good day 🥰🥰🥰

reviews.name: J
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve had in Bangkok so far! P’ Prem is an excellent therapist! I appreciate the kind receptionist as well. I will be back for sure!
