reviews.name: Christele Fock
reviews.text:
Perfect place to rejuvenate yourself, one of my go-to when I’m around Chinatown.

My brother and myself came in the morning as we had an early flight and were in need of some rest before checking in our hotel. We took the 90 mins deep tissue body massage. Foot soaking bath smelled heavenly. The staff is helpful and friendly and even offered us some complimentary hot stone service in our massage.

We had our massage in the room upstairs and the place is well arranged to give you a cozy and luxury feeling at the same time. 😍 It was my 3rd time there in the last 2 years and it didn’t disappoint so far 🥰 Hope to come back again 💗
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Reading your review truly made our day. 💗

Knowing that you’ve chosen to visit us 3 times over the past 2 years means more to us than you know. Thank you for making us part of your time in Bangkok.

We’re so glad you and your brother could slow down, relax, and recharge before your trip. We hope every visit leaves you feeling just as refreshed as the last.

Until next time, we’ll be here, ready to welcome you back. Safe travels, and see you again whenever you’re in Chinatown. 🌿🙏🏻☺️

Warmly,
The An Jing Thai Massage Team

reviews.name: Rin Chongthu
reviews.text: Amazing foot massage at An Jing Thai Massage! My partner and I asked for hard pressure and Da and Ni delivered  firm, consistent, and exactly what our tired feet needed. The place is clean, the staff are friendly, and the whole experience was relaxing from start to finish. The place smells amazing and we love the scented towels too. Highly recommended!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Rin Chongthu,

Your review brought the biggest smiles to our team today. 💛

We’re so happy that every little detail—from the pressure of the massage by Da and Ni, to the scent of our space and even the scented towels—made your visit feel special. Those are the details we quietly care about every day, so it means the world to know you noticed them.

Thank you for sharing such thoughtful words with us. We hope your feet stayed happy long after your visit, and we wish you and your partner many more wonderful adventures together.

With heartfelt thanks,🫶🏻🙏🏻😊
An Jing Thai Massage Team

reviews.name: Rio J
reviews.text:
One of the best massages I've ever had 😭

Ask for the lovely madamme "Kai" and ask for the "Muay Thai" massage. It's not on the menu, but they'll know what it is, even your ancestors will feel the intensity of it.

There should be a Michelin Star for massage places, and this deserves the highest rating.

1000000/10, will come back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Your review truly made us smile from ear to ear 😭✨
Thank you so much for your wonderful words and amazing energy. Knowing that your experience was one of the best massages you’ve ever had means the world to our entire team.🙏🏻😭💚✨🥰

We’re incredibly grateful for your support and can’t wait to welcome you back again for another relaxing and memorable experience. 💆🏼‍♀️🍀✨

reviews.name: Darren Chan
reviews.text: Very good massage skills... I'm a person that always go massage in Thailand and other countries that ia famous like Bali & on Malaysia. And this massage centre is honestly GOOD!!!. I like harder massage so i often take deep tissue massage and this center has a special one name aromatherapy deep tissue massage. I choose the 90min and it's really professional the masseur. She start with soft massage first then increase to medium and then only intense on muscle sore area which she actually can feel it and know very well. Most of the centers when come to deep tissue massage they will just go to intense pressure which makes you feel painful for a few days after massaging. But with this skill in this center really make it feels comfortable and mild pain during intense pressure. Really HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!! They also serve you hot tea & some local sweet delicacy after massage session.... 👍🏻😁❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review and recommendation! 😊🙏🏻

We’re truly honored to receive such kind words from someone with extensive massage experience. We’re delighted that you enjoyed our Aromatherapy Deep Tissue Massage and appreciated our therapist’s technique and attention to your needs.

We’re also happy you enjoyed the tea and local sweets after your session. Thank you for choosing us, and we look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit to Bangkok! ❤️✨

reviews.name: Zelia Cheong
reviews.text: Randomly picked a massage nearby and wow, beautiful decor, super kind staff and I did the deep tissue aromatherapy massage - my masseuse was clearly strong enough to send me to heaven but she adjusted where needed. She also used specific stretching techniques different to what I usually experience in Thai massages. Actually gonna return again tomorrow for a good leg massage! Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Zelia Cheong,

What a joy it was to read your review! 🙏🏻💚☺️

We’re so happy that your spontaneous visit led to such a wonderful experience. Thank you for noticing the care, technique, and attention our therapist put into every part of your massage. Your kind words truly mean a lot to our entire team.

We hope the rest of your journey is filled with wonderful memories, and if your travels ever bring you back to Bangkok, it would be our pleasure to welcome you again.

Warmest regards,

An Jing Thai Massage Team 🌿

reviews.name: Zi Xuan Lim
reviews.text:
one of the best massage of my life ❤️‍🔥

chanced upon An Jing on tiktok and decided to give it a shot! my partner and i had the 90 minute aromatherapy massage and oh my god the masseuse is so strong and it felt so good! super relaxing 🤍🤍 place is tucked away near yaowarat, so its not too far! super cozy & aesthetic, staff are nice and friendly! 10/10 would recc!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review 🙏🏻🥰  We’re very happy to hear that you and your partner enjoyed the 90-minute aromatherapy massage and felt truly relaxed.

It means a lot to us that you appreciated both the massage technique and our cozy atmosphere, as well as the friendliness of our team. Thank you for your kind recommendation, and we hope to welcome you back again soon 🤍🌿✨💆🏻‍♀️

reviews.name: Jarut Chanprapanont
reviews.text: The space was really nice and I enjoyed the massage. I had a 1 hr Head and shoulder (office syndrome course) it was relaxing! At the end of the massage they compliment you with Thai desserts and tea. Saturday well spent!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for spending your Saturday with us 😊🙏🏻
I’m really happy to hear that you enjoyed the Head & Shoulder massage and found the space relaxing.
It means a lot to us that you appreciated the Thai desserts and tea at the end of your session.
We truly hope to welcome you back again for another peaceful and relaxing time soon. 🌿💚😍

reviews.name: Jordan Snyder
reviews.text: Excellent massage place. We did aromatherapy deep tissue massages. The introductory conversation was very thorough, and the host lady asked where we would like our masseuses to focus on and which oils we wanted, and translated it into Thai for us. The oil choices all smelled delicious - any one of them would have been great. Our therapists Kai and Rung were both very detail-oriented and found all the right spots. Very strong, consistent pressure too. The room and towels were very clean, and they played subtle relaxing music during the massage. We both left thoroughly relaxed. Definitely worth trying if you are in the area.

From the moment I walked in, the staff were incredibly welcoming and professional. The ambiance is beautifully designed, with soft lighting, calming scents, and a peaceful atmosphere that immediately melts your stress away.

I tried their Thai Massage using balm, and it was exceptional. The therapist Noi was highly skilled, with an intuitive sense of pressure and focus on my problem areas. I left feeling completely loosened up, rejuvenated, and ready to take on the rest of my trip.

The facilities were impeccably clean, and the post-treatment tea was a lovely, thoughtful touch. The value for money is outstanding considering the quality of service and the central location.

reviews.name: Achita
reviews.text:
Panpuri Wellness is the very first place in Bangkok for me to take a relax, and it set an exceptionally high bar. From the moment you step inside, the carefully curated fragrance that fills the space signals that this is no ordinary spa. It is a full sensory experience.

The range of services on offer is impressive. Guests can indulge in traditional spa treatments, unwind in a public onsen, or challenge themselves with ice bath therapy, a genuinely refreshing contrast that leaves you feeling revitalized. What truly sets Panpuri apart, however, is its recently introduced personalized fragrance service, allowing guests to craft a scent that is uniquely their own.

As a leader in the Thai fragrance industry, Panpuri has also played a meaningful role in introducing public onsen culture to Thailand, a cultural contribution that speaks to the brand’s vision beyond beauty and wellness alone.

During my visit, I had the pleasure of being attended to by three exceptional staff members. Khun Rose delivered a massage that was both professional and deeply restorative. Khun I-Nam guided me through the scent personalization experience with great knowledge and warmth, making the process as enjoyable as the result. Khun Ya led my ice bath session with clear instruction and reassuring encouragement throughout.

Panpuri Wellness comes with my highest recommendation, whether you are seeking restoration, a one-of-a-kind sensory journey, or simply a moment of calm in a bustling city.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

reviews.text: Walking into Panpuri Wellness on a hot and tiring afternoon was literally like entering an oasis. We were greeted with warm and friendly staff. I forgot to book sessions for the body scrub but the staff kindly arranged them on the same day. We were given our sets (towels, disposable underwear, and gown) and shown to the women's only onsen area. It felt like Japan! There were 5 onsen pools (one hydrotherapy one), one steam room, sauna, cold plunge pool, and body scrub room. We happily hopped between the different onsens and settled for a scrumptious light meal and snooze in the sun room. We ended with the body scrub with left us feeling like silken tofu (and my skin still feels unbelievably soft)! Before departing, we couldn't help but be enticed by the luxurious scents and bought some hand creams and perfume oils. It was such a serene, blissful, and wonderful experience for the mind and body!

Stunning Aesthetics with an 'Industrial' Service Feel.

• Products: The Andaman Sails collection remains a standout sophisticated and refreshing. The post-treatment organic rice tea and fresh fruit are a lovely, high quality touch.
• The Service: This is where the experience falters slightly. While the staff is efficient and professional, the process feels too much like a "factory." ownerDescription:
Lek Foot Massage is the original Lek Massage Bangkok shop, serving Siam Square since 1997. Find us on Siam Square Soi 6, a short walk from BTS Siam, close to Siam Paragon, Siam Center and MBK Center.
We specialize in traditional Thai foot massage and reflexology to relieve tired feet, reduce stress and improve circulation with time-tested techniques, perfect after a long day of shopping or sightseeing. Our experienced therapists also offer Thai massage, aromatherapy oil massage, therapeutic body treatments, manicures and pedicures. Don't miss our signature Sleep Salon head and scalp ritual, ideal for deep rest and better sleep.
Clean, comfortable and open daily 9:30 AM until midnight. LGBTQ+ friendly, for locals and international visitors.

reviews.text: The massage was amazing! The staff were friendly, and the pressure was just right. I felt so relaxed and refreshed afterward. I’ll definitely come back next time I’m in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Kosi T
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Lek Nail Salon & Spa

From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel completely welcomed. The energy in the salon is calm, friendly, and professional. Lee did an amazing job on my nails and shaped my eyebrows perfectly—she’s truly talented and pays attention to every detail.

Her colleague also took great care of my feet, and the whole experience felt relaxing and thoughtful from start to finish.

I left feeling refreshed, polished, and genuinely appreciated as a customer. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality service and a team that truly cares.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for recommending Lek Foot Massage. We’re happy you enjoyed your nail experience with our skilled therapists.

reviews.name: Daniesha Nguyen
reviews.text: Amazing ! Thank you from Sacramento, California ! Great service we got head spa service me and my cousin and they lady’s were so sweet even blow dried my hair and I have curly course hair. I taught them how to comb it out and they did a good job on the blow dry!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your review truly means a lot. We’re happy you enjoyed your visit near Siam Paragon and MBK Center.

reviews.name: jonbristolbs4
reviews.text:
Reassuring to see in the brochure outside,  they had treatments for Gentlemen, including what I was looking for, Pedicure, as most of these places look like they only have nail services for women.
I was rather nervous as a first visit to this type of establishment at the tender age of 70 but I was made to feel very welcome and my rather unkempt toes and nails were cared for by a studious young lady for around 45 minutes.
Now I know how amazing this treatment is I will certainly come again.
My new shorter nails were so much more comfortable to walk as I left the shop.
Thank you for an excellent service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Happy to know our service met your expectations 💗

reviews.name: Paola Moncayo Torres
reviews.text: I has a nice experience! The massage was deeply. As a Thai massage student currently studying here in Thailand, it was incredible to feel the technique from such skilled hands. It gave me so much inspiration and motivation to keep learning and practicing. Thank you ! 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're so glad you enjoyed your experience at our Siam branch, Paola! Thank you for highlighting our skilled foot massage; it's wonderful to know it helped you unwind after a long day. Since 1997, we've been passionate about providing exceptional service to our guests, and your kind words about our legacy mean a lot to us. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing visit!

reviews.name: johnny chiam
reviews.text:
Thai body massage 90min 800 baht.
Everything is good. From the reception, facilities, cleanliness all is good.
But the massage is just bad. So bad. One of the worst I had experienced throughout the world. Massage is all over the place, starting from your leg facing the front.
When you got on your back, this is the part which made me wanna leave halfway. 5 seconds on your upper back, 5 seconds to your head, 5 seconds to your neck, 5 seconds to your leg, 5 seconds to your lower back, 5 seconds back to your neck. I mean, wtf it’s all over the place. No flow at all. You just feel that it’s a whole mess, is it that the masseuse just wanna get it over with? Or she’s just not trained how to do a proper massage?

To be fair the foot massage on 24 August was good. 4.5/5.

But today, might jolly well end returning customer.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We appreciate your feedback, Johnny. We're sorry to hear that your experience didn't meet your expectations. It’s important for us to ensure our services reflect our heritage as the original Lek Foot Massage branch since 1997 in Siam. We understand your concerns about the service and will address them with our team to improve. If you have further thoughts, please reach out to us at our hotline 020287783. We hope you'll consider visiting us again to experience our commitment to excellence.

reviews.text: Masi and Pu did my mani pedi and I feel so pampered! They were thorough in cleaning, recommended nice colors to complement my skin, and ultimately helped me slow down after a week of business travel. This branch is right across a hotel so it’s a treat for anyone staying in the vicinity. Highly recommended and I’ll be sure to come back!

reviews.name: Ya-Chun Yu
reviews.text:
Duan was amazing for my 1 hr Thai massage! I enjoyed it so much! Painful/sore but very helpful!

Their oil/aromatic massage was okay (another masseur). I didn’t feel want on my back side (not strong/deep enough and I needed to keep asking the masseur to do it stronger) but when one front side, it’s super deep/strong. I’m not sure why. Interestingly, it’s also the first ever oil massage in my life that they revealed and massaged my breast and belly too. 😯 (the masseur did ask if it’s okay, and I said yes because it’s a female). However, I won’t recommend the oil massage because of the price difference if you’re a Thai massage fan.  Oh but the oil massage room has shower that is free to use to wash off the oil on your body and has clean towel, hairdryer and mirror. (I didn’t use their shared comb 😅)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the review and your support means a lot to us.

reviews.name: Wan Yit Tan
reviews.text:
It is so value for money. I went for full body scrub and aroma body massage, it was so comfortable I totally fell asleep though I just finished brunch. The treatment room came with shower facility, hair dryer and mirror so ladies can touch up after treatment.

There is hair spa too, I will try it next round.

We have a group of six so we sign up for membership to get extra credit to be used for our session (bill together).

Highly recommend! We just walked in and there are 3 outlets nearby each other.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We’re also happy that you appreciated the treatment room facilities, including the shower, hair dryer, and mirror, so guests can freshen up comfortably after the session.

It’s great to know your group of six had a good experience and that the membership program with extra credit was helpful for your visit. Many guests visiting the Siam Square, Siam Paragon, and MBK area enjoy relaxing at Lek Foot Massage, especially since there are several nearby branches to accommodate walk-ins and groups.

We’re also glad you noticed our hair spa service — we look forward to welcoming you back to try it on your next visit. Thank you again for your recommendation, and we hope to see you and your friends again soon at Lek Foot Massage Bangkok! 😊

reviews.text:

​The warmth of the steamed herbs deeply penetrated my body, and all my exhaustion completely melted away. The shop was clean and the therapist's technique was top-notch. If you’re looking for a "hot herbal massage" around the Siam area, this is definitely the place to go. I'll be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: How wonderful to hear that you enjoyed your visit to our Siam branch! We're thrilled you appreciated our skilled Thai massage, which we've perfected since 1997. Thank you for recognizing our team's dedication, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another rejuvenating experience.

reviews.name: Ilroy Agh
reviews.text:
As a caveat, this was not the first time I've visited a LEK salon (I went to a different one for a mani/pedi) this was my first time getting a massage at one.

I've got to say, the same commitment to customer satisfaction was there just like the other one, and my masseuse made sure to check in with me during the massage to make sure I wasn't in pain, and was enjoying it (I was, not too strong or too soft). There was even a friendly rapport, joking around, which put me at ease. While it is in a row of potential options (in a city full of them, haha) I would definitely recommend visiting this massage salon if you don't want to try a lot of them to find a good one.

reviewsTags.title: next to on nut bts station

reviews.name: Frankie d'silva
reviews.text: This venue offered a really pleasant and somewhat exclusive vibe. 😌 Parking is convenient, with one hour free, and if you spend over 500THB, you get an excellent four hours free! Just remember to get your receipt stamped on the 4th floor before leaving. 🅿️👍

reviews.name: Stephanie Valverde
reviews.text: They have a nail market outside. I went on a weekday between 7 and 9pm and they were still there. I got a pedicure with one permanent color for 250 baht and a manicure with BIAB and one solid color for 650 baht :)

reviews.name: Jorge Jetson
reviews.text: This mall does not have a traditional food court where customers buy food from a vendor of choice and then choose a table / chair from a central area to eat their meal. This mall has many food stalls but almost each one has their own dedicated seating complete with signs indicating: "For Customers Only". The Subway (that sells sandwiches) is one of the few food vendors that has no designated seating. When asked, the staff will direct you to the basement (2 floors down, where most of the food vendors are located). This situation is particularly laughable because the drinks include free refills.... 2 floors away! Additionally, the escalators are designed to maximize foot traffic (walk to opposite end of mall to continue up or down progress). Lastly, there is not a single bench for the public to sit and take a break, except the top floor where the cinema has comfortable seating for those waiting for their movie to start.

reviews.name: OnSite
reviews.text: Went here just to walk around and take a break, not to watch a movie. The place is pretty quiet compared to bigger malls, which made it nice and relaxed. Easy to get around, not too crowded, and good if you just want somewhere to cool down and kill a bit of time without the chaos.

reviews.name: Tomas Mendoza
reviews.text: They have restaurants on every floor. They have all you can eat buffets, Japanese food, Thai food, Korean, and steak. They also have hotpots and a bunch of snacks and desserts. A gym and supermarket on the bottom floor, a so-so cinema on the top floor. They also sell clothes and even have a dentist, coffee shops and a hotel.

reviews.name: Art C
reviews.text: Normally I come here to eat, but this time I watch a movie.  The theater is nice, less crowded. The sound system is good as well. I come by BTS and do hoping to the theater. It is very convenient. By the way, the air-conditioning is quite cold, better to have jacket on.

reviews.name: Al Caudullo
reviews.text: Situated adjacent to the OnNut BTS Station, the mall features a beautiful Century Movie Plaza as it's main anchor. Along with that is a marvelous Starbucks which is airy and spacious  with loads of tables for meetings. The ultra long window gives you great ways to relax, sip some coffee and watch the world go by along Sukhumvit.

reviews.name: Shouvik Mukherjee
reviews.text: Great place to buy local thai clothes. Varieties of restro, cafe, mini electronic stalls, clinics etc available. Just outside the mall you will find several clothes shops, food stalls as well. The area is very lively due to its prominent location.

reviews.name: Saroot Lertsuthirasmevong
reviews.text: Great local mall in On Nut area.  Conveniently located right next to On Nut BTS the mall offers a variety of multicultural food selection and a movie theater that is cheaper than most in Bangkok.  The majority of shops here are restaurants so if you want to grab a bite, try dropping by.

reviews.name: Ank Eth
reviews.text:
Not a typical shopping mall so lower your expectations. Here they mainly focus on Movie theater, Japanese restaurant and beauty services and eateries.

Century the Movie plaza is nice place with many shoping options. It is connected to BTS onnut with skywalk. Skywalk is open until 10 pm.

Avani Sukumvit hotel is in same premise.  We have stayed at hotel in past, it was good stay.

They have lot of Japanese restaurant in the mall.

There is mini night market in front of mall.

For movie birds, Theater on top floor is good too.

There is tops, b2s, powerbuy at basement B1.

MacDonald and Starbucks at level 1.

On 3rd floor there are lot of parlours and hair salon.

reviews.name: Patarapol Koopitakachorn
reviews.text:
If you want something a little cheaper, visit the opposite side. If you want something a little nicer, I think it’s better that you come here.  Century has Starbucks, Coffee Club and a bunch of other hangout places. A little bit of shopping and a mini movie theater (if you think about it you’d have to go to Ekamai to watch something new).

The crowd is just right, there’s people but it’s not overly crowded. Overall a good atmosphere.

reviews.name: Atthapol Ong
reviews.text:
Located near Onnut Road, easy access from BTS. A lot of restaurants and eatery; ie,  Salad Factory, Starbucks, Mc donald, Shabuku, Dunkin, Pepper lunch, Katsuta, Hajiban ramen, Subways, Ottoya, BBQ plaza, etc. Tops, B2S, Powerbuys and theatres. TTB bank and many clinics of dental and dematoroly.  There is Avani hotel in the same place.
One hour Free parking.

reviews.name: Janusz Daga
reviews.text: Love the vibes on this small and busy mall. Lot of cool Japanese restaurants Izakaya, a wonderful Salad restaurant where to create your perfect healthy meal, lot of small fashion shop, a Tops fresh market,  large Starbucks and a Cinema.

reviews.name: Catarina Alves
reviews.text:
Great shopping with a huge amount of different shops, has restaurants and fast food stalls also, there’s shops from clothes to home hardware and also a supermarket inside, there’s also a cinema on the top floor with affordable prices.

The temperature inside is great as outside is extremely hot weather and inside the air conditioning is at the perfect temperature.

We came in and had a massage at the chairs for 25 minutes it costed us 50 tbh and it was great.

reviews.name: Moumita Dhar
reviews.text: This mall has a sale for trendy clothes on the ground floor. The other floors are full of restaurants, mostly Korean and lots of Japanese ones. The 4th floor houses the multiplex and several shows run at the same time, including the original English versions of the latest movie releases.

reviews.name: julia lokatour
reviews.text: A nice place for shopping  and dine out with variety of choices not only for food, stuffs needed in house, clinic for eyes, banks, money changer, accessories of phones, movie theater, branded clothes and fashion clothes etc., Conducive place to hang out , date and most of all restaurants internationally are best part of this mall. Tourist people are all over employees here zero English. Still highly recommended!! 555

reviews.name: mathew lawton
reviews.text: Situated next to the BTS line just outside  On Nut station this place is smaller than some of the other malls but still packed full with a variety of stores and a movie theatre. There is also a Star bucks for those coffee lovers and you will always find food stalls outside.

reviews.name: Mant1
reviews.text:
Cinema itself is not so bad, but after the movie starts the staff usually comes with phone light to make picture of something.

But my last story here is about staff is steal my food for some reason 😂

At the last movie what i went, I have banana and cookie box, so need to put in locker, after movie ends no staff in cinema, escalator not works also. So we just go home and next day call them to ask how to get back our food, and they just say it’s nothing left here.
You have staff, you have cameras, and you just say to customers that their items are stolen like nothing happens.
Terrible service and seems like reviews here is correct, idk why owner not reading anything here.

reviews.name: Eat your way through
reviews.text:
possibly one of the worst website I ever seen. Impossible to understand what movie is playing where.
I went to watch a movie that from the web I understood to be playing in Onnut but was actually playing in victory monument branch. I even asked straight to different AI platforms to see resultsand they all gave me a different programs. Come on guys! these are the basics. How can people can come to the cinema if they can't even understand your schedules?

reviews.name: James Kwan
reviews.text: The mall is alright, but when allow stores to double charge customers and not give a prompt refund, that is an issue. The mall should have guidelines to protect their customers so they feel safe going there. I had an issue with Boost Drinks and they double charged my Rabbit and I showed them proof directly from the BTS clerk and instead of a prompt satisfactory response, it was the horrible response, it is not my fault, let's see if you get a refund but if not, come back and we will refund. This was coming from the Boost shop owner directly. I am a tourist and will leave in the next couple days. The amount is small but it was the principle. Mall owners should educate their shop owners better to work with their customers to find a solution.

title: Siam Serene Mahaesak Massage
ownerDescription:
Siam Serene Mahaesak Massage is located opposite with Grande Centre Point Surawong.
We provide massage services with experienced therapists. There are Traditional Thai Massage, Aroma Therapy, Facial Massage, Hot Stone, Herbal Ball Massage and etc.
address: 324 7 Surawong Rd, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: Alina Tarabega
reviews.text: Amazing place and a very good atmosphere. I stayed in Bangkok for 3 nights, and every single day I had a massage here (hot stone massage, herbal massage, Thai massage, and hot aroma massage). Impeccable place and people. 100%—when I come back to Bangkok, I’ll definitely stop by this spa again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are deeply grateful for the kind and thoughtful review you shared about your experience at Siam Serene Spa. Your words not only encourage us but also inspire our team to continue striving for excellence.

Thank you for taking the time to support us. We look forward to welcoming you again in the near future.

Warm regards, 
Siam Serene Team

reviews.name: Wishah Mohd
reviews.text: One of the best Thai massage experiences in Thailand. Highly recommended! They even give you tea and a complimentary pouch. The staff is very professional and knows what they are doing. Place is extremely and clean and smells really nice.

reviews.name: Ariw
reviews.text: I went for a body scrub massage with hot stones. I really enjoyed it for 2 hours. It made me feel very relaxed and my skin was very soft and smooth.  If you have time recommend for 2 hours

reviews.name: Miranda T
reviews.text:
I tried this place due to the convenience of it literally being right across the street from my hotel (Grande Centre Surawong). It actually ended up being better than I expected. I chose the body scrub with a 60 min oil massage (1500 baht) and a 50 minute facial (1500 baht). The body scrub was great and there’s also a private shower for you to rinse after the scrub (before the oil massage). Zee did my body scrub and massage - she was professional and had perfect strength. It wasn’t one of those massages that felt like they were just touching your body lol. It actually felt like a massage and hit the right areas. I even almost fell asleep (which is rare, but it was that good). Siri did my facial which was also wonderful. I’ve never had a Thai facial, but I chose the one with a cold stone facial. Both ladies were super nice.

The only thing I didn’t like was the 5% charge if you pay with a credit card. But aside from that, I’d definitely recommend this spot.

reviews.name: antzarmy
reviews.text:
Stopped for a foot massage today with a few friends. The service provided was excellent. The massage so good that all 4 of us fell asleep. A great massage and a very good price!

Would highly recommend and will come again.

reviews.name: ADHWA' AFIQAH BINTI MOHAMAD AZMI
reviews.text: Been here everyday for my holiday for 4 days and 3 night consequtively, u can request for the massage to be strong or soft and they also offer multiple kind of theraphy and massage. The front desk and the staff is very polite, helpfull and highly praise to come here. Please make reservation if u wost to come here to secure your slot

reviewContext.Services: Spa packages, Pedicure, Massage therapy, Manicure

reviews.name: ponto fino confeccoes
reviews.text: Of all the massages we had in Thailand, this was undoubtedly the best. The team was wonderful. They all deserve praise.

Thank you sincerely for visiting Siam Serene Spa. It was our true pleasure to be a part of your day. Your trust means the world to us, and we hope the care and calm you experienced will stay with you long after you leave. 

We look forward to welcoming you back whenever you seek peace and renewal.

Warm regards, 
Siam Serene Team

reviews.name: Amira Soraya
reviews.text: Amazing Massage. Coming to BKk for 20 years and they are amazing and the best I have tried so far❤️❤️❤️❤️greetings to Siri 😘big recomendation…

reviews.name: Xochitl Vazquez
reviews.text: I love this place. Deep tissue massage was so good put me to sleep. Super cheap for such a high quality place. I got my Mani and Pedi as well. Definitely recommend

reviews.name: Pu Sasi
reviews.text: Wow!!! Here is heaven on Earth!! The best massage that I’ve ever had. The tea is great taste. Spa Manager is very nice and warm welcome. I have recommend booking before arrival. Good value of money.

reviews.name: Ann Huang
reviews.text: amazing massage! this was my first massage experience in Thailand, and i did it together with my family. we chose the deluxe massage and it was great. i used to be afraid of the foot massage because usually my bottom left foot hurts pretty bad even with slight pressure. but they were so attentive and gave the right amount of pressure that fixed the muscle soreness and aches. the service was very friendly, we like it so much and want to come back again. highly recommended!

reviews.name: Feifei Chen
reviews.text: Best sports massage I've had in Thailand. They applied just the right pressure to relieve the tension in my muscles. The receptionists Bee was patient and very friendly!!! Most importantly she recommend the right treatment for my needs. This place may not have the best environment, but if you’re looking for a place to treat muscle aches,  here is an must go place!

reviews.name: Gabriella Oliveira
reviews.text: I got a massage with Stamp and she was absolutely amazing! Very professional. The service was great, they offered me tuktuk from the spa to my hotel, hot tea afterwards and I didn’t have to wait. Love this place and will definitely come back!

reviews.name: Maria Parra
reviews.text:
Zee and Naam were amazing!!!! I had the feet and head massage and I was so relaxing I almost fell asleep 😍 I highly recommend them!!!
Mac is a good massager too.
Service and prices excellent 👌🏼

reviews.name: Hamideh Abarshahr
reviews.text:
Amazing experience!
I’ve had many massages before, but the one at Siam Serene Bangkok was truly outstanding. The hot stone massage was done to absolute perfection – so professional, calming, and deeply relaxing. I’m completely in love with this place. Highly recommended if you’re looking for pure relaxation! 💆‍♀️✨

reviews.name: Laetitia Kubala
reviews.text: It was the best massage ever! I came here last year and today again and I‘ve visited many massages but this one here was outstanding. The staff was extremely friendly and nice!

reviews.name: G G
reviews.text: Wonderful, super professional - one of the best in Thailand! I tried a number of different treatments on different days and each was excellent. Very very highly recommended!

reviews.name: Tia Palmer
reviews.text: Wonderful experience! I had the hot stone massage, and it was amazing. Ended with hot tea.

reviews.name: Pascale Adam
reviews.text: One of the best massages i had in Bangkok:) everything is very clean, the staff is extremely polite and the atmosphere is really calm. 10 out of 10 points!

reviews.name: Amina N
reviews.text:
I didn’t have to look too much to Find this gem! It was just facing my hotel and I follow the recommandation of my concierge! The place is great, clean and my massage was outstanding and very relaxing! Everyone was so welcoming!
C did my body scrub and my massage!  Thank you!💖

title: Feel spa and massage
address: 78 Prachathipatai Rd, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

reviews.name: Oscar Alvarez
reviews.text: Friendly staff, a true Thai massage experience in a clean environment. We were a large group, and the staff accommodated everyone. The rooms are clean, the place is quiet and serene. Music plays in the background to the sound of a waterfall. After a busy day exploring Bangkok, this is the place to be to unwind and experience Thai hospitality. Open until 2 AM.

reviews.name: MSM CHOI
reviews.text:
I was hoping for a traditional Thai massage, but the experience was far from authentic. The pressure was extremely light throughout, with almost no proper technique, stretching, or structure. At times, the therapist appeared disengaged , falling asleep and barely applied pressure, which made the treatment feel ineffective and not like a real Thai massage.

For 600 baht, this felt very poor value for money. I’ve had many proper Thai massages in Thailand before , and this did not meet even basic expectations.

The space also did not feel particularly clean or well-maintained despite the welcoming exterior- see attached photo .

Overall, this was a disappointing experience, and I found the high ratings misleading. I would advise others to be cautious, as this felt more like a tourist-oriented place than a genuine massage experience. I actually left half way through the massage as it felt like a waste of time and money and not a relaxing experience . For context I did not ask to be refunded - I just think the place is not honest with its reviews .

reviews.name: Eva Maria Muñoz Arenas
reviews.text: Amazing massage!!! Authentic traditional Thai massage, highly recommended. Very professional!! Unforgettable experience in our holidays in Bangkok with my family 😁😁

reviews.name: Saman Ahsan
reviews.text:
Spick and span, shiny clean and wonderful place with friendly staff.
On the expensive side as a 1 hour foot massage was 600 Thai baht but it was really good. I'd rather go to a nice place and pay more than a dingy one.

reviews.name: Dennis Plaza
reviews.text: We had a four member family massage and was great. I feel more flexible than I was before the massage. The music and smell were very pleasant and help create a very comfortable and relaxing experience.

reviews.name: Korean Reviewer
reviews.text: This is the best massage parlour in Bangkok. I was very impressed by the well-skilled massage staff, the hygienic environment, and the friendly staff. Be sure to visit this place without fail. All the fatigue of my trip has been relieved

reviews.name: Aliya Medebayeva
reviews.text: I like it very much! Great masters very good quality of massage! Today third day I’ve get a massage here, master Nap very good, thank you. Recommend this spa.

reviews.name: Martina Vujčić
reviews.text: Great massage, great atmosphere, and lovely staff. The night shift ladies were especially amazing – professional, friendly, and full of good energy. We felt welcome every time and had a lot of fun. Definitely one of our favorite memories from Bangkok. Highly recommended, and we will come back for sure.

reviews.name: R A
reviews.text: Very good massage. Went twice, had the Thai massage and the aroma massage. Both very good. Place is squeaky clean.

reviews.name: COCO HO
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience here! The atmosphere was calm and relaxing from the moment I walked in. My therapist was professional, attentive, and really listened to my needs. The massage was both therapeutic and deeply relaxing — I left feeling refreshed and tension-free. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for quality care and a peaceful environment.

reviews.name: Judit Fabian-Bina
reviews.text: Amazing traditional massage!! The best one I ever had! Super nice personal, got tea afterwards and nice chat with the lady from the reception. Just can recommend everyone ☺️

reviews.name: Mathilde Presttun
reviews.text: I was so happy with my massage by Teaw! She gave me an amazing 1hr aroma massage, and was super competent. I am hoping to be back here soon, highly recommend.

reviews.name: 이소정
reviews.text: It was so cool. The store was clean and everyone was so friendly. It was convenient because I could make a reservation through KakaoTalk. I'll come again next time.

reviews.name: Jatin Solanki
reviews.text: Serm was the best therapist.. too professional and best thai massage in khaosan road

reviews.name: lexxx lok
reviews.text: I had a terrible experience at this massage center. The masseuse had absolutely no idea what she was doing — all she did was press randomly without any technique. Compared to my partner’s massage, mine was awful. Definitely not worth the money.

reviews.name: Jen Gerrard
reviews.text: Took a chance based on reviews and journeyed across town. They were late opening but we were able to wait in the hotel lobby. They were attentive enough to come get us when they were finally opened. You pay in advance. Menu is limited to the basic treatments. Nice foot wash at the beginning. You wear a top/bottom combo throughout that they provide. My gal was rather “pokey” in her massage vs smooth strokes. She did a nice stretch/flexibility movement at the end. My husband had a gal who massaged with more long smooth strokes and no stretching so he was happy with his. I think for the price you are paying for a nice atmosphere vs a quality massage from a trained professional. Overall the massage itself  was average, while the atmosphere was lovely.

reviews.name: Johnny
reviews.text:
Listen up!
I am not the person who reviews every single experience. But I think it is necessary to review this shop.

Run away from this shop and do not dare come.

1. Well, I know this is the shop on the 1st floor of the hotel. And it must be expensive than any other massage shop on the street.

2. 3 times much expensive than the ordinary shop. Alright, although we paid 1300 bahts for 1 hour massage, I thought there must be something special.

3. But, there was nothing special for service and i needed to tell the massage therapist "stronger, please."

So, if there is one who dare looks forward to being there, RUN!

reviews.name: Zeke Gancena
reviews.text:
LOVED the 1-hr Traditional Thai Massage. So worth the price and I even told the masseuse that I had just gotten a new tattoo prior to the appointment and to be careful in that area — she was very professional and was careful.

My only regret is that I didn’t opt in for the longer massage.

reviews.name: Tim Schuurmans
reviews.text: We went here for a 90 minute Thai massage at the start of our holiday. The massage was wonderful! We both felt reborn, a bit soar but way more flexible during our stay in Thailand. I wanted to end our stay with a massage here again, but unfortunately they were fully booked. I highly recommend Feel Spa and Massage.

reviews.name: Meg M
reviews.text:
After reading the Google reviews, my partner and I chose to get our first Thai massage here.

My partner prefers a lighter massage and communicated this to the person on reception beforehand, and was assured his masseuse would be told. I prefer a harder massage but being new to Thai massage, I was a bit nervous about either the masseuse going too hard on me, or going too soft because of my partner's request...no need to have worried, we both had great experiences!

We were massaged in the same room so I was able to tell that my partner's masseuse was going lighter on him. At the start of mine, my masseuse told me to tell her if I experienced any pain and she checked on me constantly throughout and was very communicative. We even had a giggle because I clearly had no idea what to do throughout it but she guided the massage well.

This place is a little bit pricier than places around it but as a Thai massage newbie, I'd rather pay extra to know I'm in safe hands with a professional who communicates well. It was also a lovely clean facility, highly reccommend!

The Most

reviews.name: Rajneish Totla
reviews.text: The Most Bangkok is a stylish and vibrant place with a great ambience, tasty food and excellent hospitality. The atmosphere is lively yet comfortable, making it perfect for both casual outings and special evenings. Beautiful décor, good music and attentive service make the overall experience memorable.

reviews.name: Boonta Chutvirasakul
reviews.text: Very warm and cozy restuarant with loft style, it was very nice to chill out with friends. The food was delicious and so creative. The service was fast and the staffs were very welcoming. In-door and out-door areas are available. Live music starts in the evening, we enjoyed and had a good time at this place. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Warren Austria
reviews.text: No one speaks english here, but they do have english menu hidden somewhere. Place is relaxing and the bands music was great. Though I dont understand Thai, they play music that is not too disturbing to our ears. Food and service was great also

reviews.name: Ernst J
reviews.text: Spacious place, I was amazed by how huge the whole area is. They have both indoor and outdoor seating, good during covid risky time. Food was decent, there’s so many food options, price and portions are decent. Alcohol choices are many as well, and variety enough. Service was great. There’s live band. Overall i do like the place.

reviews.name: Mac Vichien
reviews.text: I'm very satisfied this bar and restaurant. Positive energy  excellent service and mouthwatering dishes. I plan to go back soon because the boys are back in town and we deserve nothing less than the best.

reviews.name: Sareena S
reviews.text: Big nice restaurant with good service.Been here several of times.Food always good.Friendly staffs.Has a lot of varitey of food.Have thai food as well as italian.Pizza here is very yummy.Have vegetarian options and also can adapt some of non vegetarian dish in to vegetarian. Very reasonable price.Have plenty of parking.This place is good for coming in big groups too.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review.Hope there will be another opportunity to serve you again.

reviews.name: Dach Skol
reviews.text:
the most restaurant is a relax atmosphere and cozy with a good service and a fine dish to dine in. Their service include karaoke room for private party.
Parking are available for around 50 cars.

reviews.text:
This is my favorite place in Ratchapreuk. The restaurant is spacious, offering a variety of dining zones, including open-air with live music, air-conditioned seating, and private karaoke rooms.
The menu selections are extensive, allowing you to enjoy any kind of drink. However, if you're a beer lover, like one of my friends, be aware that they only offer Heineken Tower, otherwise, it's imported bottled beers, which can be expensive."

title: Dahra Spa Silom
ownerDescription: Luxury spa in the heart of Silom Road, Bangkok. We focus on providing quality massages in a clean environment for attractive prices.
address: 154, 8-9 Si Lom Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: Gee
reviews.text: Had the 3 hours and 45 minutes treatment today which consists of a body scrub, body wrap, massage and facial treatment.  It was super cozy and clean. 4 stars because I wish there could have been a mango sticky rice at the end and the tea was too sweet, my facial would have been better done while I was on the wrap so as to save time because towards the end I can tell the lady is quite exhausted...other than that my masseuse was super professional and skilled(I advise to omit the direct elbow massage its quite painful) However, she is keen and listened to all my requests.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Gee for the feedback. We are considering the mango sticky rice treat at the moment. Hope to see you soon again!

reviews.name: Moniek
reviews.text: We come in Bangkok regularly, and Dahra Spa is so far the best place we've found for massage! The masseuses here work with love and attention, and that makes a big difference compared to many other massage salons in Bangkok. I can truly recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Moniek, 

Thank you very much for your kind words and rating us with 5 stars. Reviews like this is what keep us delivering the best we can!

We hope you will soon have a chance to visit us again!

reviews.name: Minming Lim
reviews.text:
I went early in the morning and the shop was clean and empty. I decided on a facial and aromatherapy massage for 90mins. You get to choose from low to medium level pressure, and the type of facial.

The treatment was good, it included a facial massage where the masseuse pressed on strategic points on your face to release tension. She also did a bit of foot massage when waiting for cucumber mask to take effect :)

Super happy with the treatment and masseuse. Will be back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words about our spa and therapist! Very much appreciated. We hope you will soon have a chance to visit us again!

reviews.name: Devesh sharma
reviews.text: Great spa in Silom. I have been there few times and had great experience always . The spa itself is clean and has quiet rooms with all the facilities . They offer few packages which are great value for money if on discount. But even without discount the price is justified. The staff is very attentive and helpful. I was assisted by an at the reception who was very polite and booked my treatment . This time my therapist was alice who spent almost 4 hours with me . Each treatment was done nicely by her . Looking forward to my next visit .
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your 5 star review Devesh Sharma. I am glad you enjoyed your visit and will pass your kind words to khun Alice. We look forward to welcoming you back to our spa soon!

reviews.name: KK SASANA
reviews.text:
I had such a beautiful experience at Dahra Spa Silom a few days ago and I’m still thinking about it.

The space is incredibly clean and beautifully decorated — you feel calm the moment you walk in. I had researched at least 15 different places before choosing this one, and I’m so happy I did. It was absolutely the right decision.

My therapist, Mali (I hope I’m saying her name correctly), was excellent. Her massage technique was strong, precise, and very professional. She really understood where my tension was and worked through it with confidence and skill. At the same time, her voice and energy were calm and soothing, which made the whole experience feel very grounding.

The staff were friendly and professional, and everything felt smooth and well-organized.

I also have to mention the music. As a DJ, I’m very sensitive to sound and atmosphere. Most spas play the same looping playlist, but Dahra Spa had a varied and thoughtfully chosen selection of tracks. It made a real difference. During my body wrap, the music helped take me into a deep meditative state and elevated the entire experience.

I left feeling refreshed, reset, and genuinely happy with the results. I will definitely return. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear KK Sasana,

Thank you so much for this beautiful and thoughtful review. It truly means a lot to us.

We’re especially happy to hear that you felt calm from the moment you walked in — creating that immediate sense of peace is exactly what we hope every guest experiences. Knowing that you carefully researched many places before choosing us makes your kind words even more meaningful.

Mali will be absolutely delighted to read your feedback. She takes great pride in delivering strong, precise, and intuitive treatments, and it’s wonderful to hear that you felt both her technical skill and her calming presence. That balance is something we value deeply in our therapists.

Your comments about the music made us smile. We put genuine care into curating our playlists to avoid the typical repetitive spa soundtrack, so hearing this from a DJ with a trained ear is a real compliment. We love that it helped you reach a deeper meditative state during your body wrap — that’s exactly the kind of immersive experience we aim to create.

Thank you again for your trust and recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you back to Dahra Spa Silom for another moment of relaxation and reset.

reviews.name: Sikatsoo
reviews.text:
Royal Thai Massage [3.75/5]
💪 For the Royal Thai Massage, you have the option to choose your preferred strength level—light, medium, or hard. They then match you with an appropriate therapist based on your gender and body size.

💆 Medium strength was just right for me, and the therapist's skills were adequate. While I did experience some pain during the massage, I found it quite enjoyable and effective in relaxing my muscles at that moment. However, I noticed that, compared to my last visit five years ago, I didn't feel as relaxed after the massage this time around.

📝 After the massage, they provide a satisfaction form for you to rate various aspects of their service, including massage skills and communication skills.

👍 What stood out is that the therapists don't ask for tips during any part of the service, which was a positive experience.

Service [4.5/5]
🍵 The concierge staff were proficient in English, and while the therapists had limited English skills, they were all highly professional, friendly, and considerate. They even offered ice water and a cold towel before the massage and warm ginger tea afterward.

Ambience [4.25/5]
🏞️ Despite minimal furniture and decor, the shop manages to create a relaxed atmosphere through its cushions, lighting, and background music. I thoroughly enjoyed the ambiance, which allowed me to unwind completely. The only minor drawback was that the air conditioning felt a bit too cold. Apart from that, everything else was perfect.

Value [2.5/5]
💲 The establishment offers a 10% discount to both booking and walk-in customers. A one-hour Royal Thai Massage is priced at 540 baht after the discount, with each additional 30 minutes costing 180 baht. This pricing falls within the market average. Personally, I'd recommend opting for a 1-hour and 30-minute session, as I found the 1-hour session to be a bit too brief for my liking.

The foot massage and head & shoulder massage are really good. All the staff here are really nice. Will definitely revisit again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Kar Men, for your wonderful review! 😊 We're so happy to hear that what started as a random visit turned into a place you came back to twice during your trip.

It's great to know that you enjoyed both the foot massage and head & shoulder massage, and that our team made you feel welcome. Comments like yours truly mean a lot to us.

Thank you for choosing Pratunam Thai Massage, and we look forward to seeing you again on your next visit to Bangkok! 💆‍♀️✨

Pratunam Thai Massage @ Phetchaburi 31

reviews.name: 유시아
reviews.text: I come here every time when I visit bangkok, i really like the environment it’s really cozy and clean!!! I had oil massage at a very nice price, thank you for your recommendation and services ~
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful review! 😊 We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed the cozy atmosphere and felt comfortable during your visit to Bangkok.

It's great to know that you were happy with the oil massage and found it to be good value. Thank you as well for trusting our recommendations and services. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back on your next trip to Bangkok! 💆‍♀️✨

Pratunam Thai Massage @ Phetchaburi 31

reviews.text: Ting and Ai were superb. They made us feel so comfortable and loved through their massages. 10/10 should request them as your masseuse. Will definitely come again
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Pratunam Thai Massage @ Phetchaburi 31

reviews.name: Jaemie Pearl Falcon
reviews.text: The staff are very professional and the massage was superb. I did not noticed the time. The complimentary tea and biscuit at the end caps the service. Very satisfied client.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🥰 We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed your massage and found our team professional. Knowing that you were so relaxed you didn’t even notice the time makes us especially happy! 💆‍♀️✨

We’re also glad you enjoyed the complimentary tea and biscuits after your treatment. Thank you for choosing Pratunam Thai Massage and for sharing your experience with us. Your kind words mean a lot to our entire team. 🙏💛

Pratunam Thai Massage – Phetchaburi 31

reviews.name: ___rustwish
reviews.text:
From the moment I walked in, the experience felt warm and welcoming. The receptionist was genuinely friendly, attentive, and made the whole check-in process smooth and comfortable—it really set the tone.

The masseurs were just as impressive. You can tell they truly care about their work and their clients.

Overall, it wasn’t just a massage—it was a thoughtful, relaxing experience from start to finish. I’ll definitely be coming back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your thoughtful review! 😊 We're truly delighted to hear that you felt welcomed and comfortable from the moment you arrived.

Your kind words about our receptionist and therapists mean a lot to our team. We always strive to provide not only a great massage, but also a warm and caring experience from start to finish. Knowing that you felt well taken care of makes us very happy.

Thank you for choosing Pratunam Thai Massage, and we can't wait to welcome you back for another relaxing visit soon. 💆‍♀️✨

Pratunam Thai Massage @ Phetchaburi 31

reviews.name: chubs
reviews.text: Did 90 min aromatherapy for 2 pax. Got the private room. Was very comfortable and soothing until my partner fell asleep. Very clean and comfortable place. Will recommend ! Whatsapped and firmed the price before coming down. Quite value for money
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review and recommendation! 🥰 We’re delighted to hear that you and your partner enjoyed the 90-minute aromatherapy massage and felt comfortable and relaxed in our private room — especially knowing it was relaxing enough for your partner to fall asleep! 💆‍♀️✨

We’re also happy that you appreciated the cleanliness, comfort, and value for money. Your kind words mean a lot to our therapists and the whole team. 🙏💛

Thank you for choosing Pratunam Thai Massage. We look forward to welcoming you both back again for another peaceful and relaxing experience! 😊

Pratunam Thai Massage – Phetchaburi 31

reviews.name: Shaveta Sharma
reviews.text:
Warm & Appreciative
Had an excellent experience at Pratunam Thai Massage. The atmosphere is clean, calm, and very relaxing. The therapist was highly skilled and really understood where the tension was, especially in my shoulders and back. I walked out feeling refreshed and completely relaxed. Great service and very professional—highly recommended!

reviews.name: Jean McGinnis
reviews.text: Highly recommended!!! 🤍 The staff are all so lovely, especially Nim. Her massage was absolutely amazing! I travelled all the way from Dubai just for this, and it was definitely worth it. Nim exceeded my expectations, and I’ll definitely be coming back! 🤍

reviews.name: leeann chia
reviews.text: Happened to chance upon this place and really liked the ambience and cleanliness. The staff were friendly and skilled. My family and I had a good time here. Honestly worth trying if you're in the Pratunam area of Bangkok ~
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We’re so happy you and your family enjoyed your time here and loved the relaxing atmosphere and our team’s service.
Your kind words mean a lot — hope to welcome you all again soon whenever you’re in Bangkok! 🌿❤️

If you are looking for an authentic Thai massage with friendly service, this is one of the best option for you!!

We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed our clean and comfortable environment, as well as the personalized service from our team.

We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another relaxing visit! ❤️

— Pratunam Thai Massage @ Phetchaburi 31 —

title: The Circle Ratchaphruek
subTitle: เดอะเซอร์เคิล ราชพฤกษ์
description: Open-air neighborhood mall with upscale shops, kids' play areas & many international restaurants.
ownerDescription:
WE BELIEVE THAT THE CONCEPT OF
‘GREEN COMMUNITY’
or being close to nature would lead to a happy and sustainable lifestyle for residents nearby our community. Therefore, we put great effort into making sure every detail of our customers’ needs is at the forefront of our transformation under the “simple but unique” communication approach
address: 39 Ratchaphruek Rd, Bang Ramat, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

reviews.name: Day 25
reviews.text: We are amazed by the design and landscape to organize the shop function layout serving the clients and visitor with a variety of restaurant, cafe, gym, salon, playground, puff pastry, sweets from reputable brands and several food cultures in one place. The Circle has fulfilled with a perfect indulgence to relax in the spacious garden design and good food taste which are good rejuvenation and recharge the energy after our tiredness from work in order to walk around and spend our leiture in lifestyle city - shopping in the forest architectural design

reviews.name: Jk
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ The Circle Ratchapruk

The Circle Ratchapruk is a charming community mall with a cozy and relaxing atmosphere. 🌳☕ The open-air layout makes it a wonderful place to enjoy good food, coffee, and quality time with family or friends.

There are many restaurants and cafés to choose from, and the entire area is clean and beautifully maintained. 🍜🍰 It’s one of my favorite places for a casual evening out. 🌟

reviews.name: Eernietv
reviews.text:
Pet Friendly? No.
Pet Tolerant. Yes.

Having 1 or 2 pee stations doesn’t mean a place is pet friendly. Yes the outdoor area you can walk with your pup and enjoy. But dining options, space to seat etc with your pup? Minimal.

reviews.name: Ben Werakit
reviews.text: The upscale shopping village for the wealthy Thais where you will find all the high end shops, food and services. Quite difficult to find parking during weekends or long holidays. Great place to watch people or browse around even if you don’t plan to buy anything.

reviews.name: Srkl Bas
reviews.text: Nice landscape and atmosphere. Suites for family all range of ages. Cool playground. Pet- friendly space. Many restaurant to try. Love events they arranged ex. the Circle Green Day.

reviews.name: DJ
reviews.text: This is an outdoor community mall with lots of restaurants and a supermarket. Some big brands are here like Swensens and Arno's but there are also lovely Indy type places like Cocoabar, Gram. If you like desserts then this is your place. By the way it's dog friendly too 😉🙂

reviews.name: Selvi SF
reviews.text:
Another nice place to find a variety food. There are many restaurants, mostly in air conditioned rooms.

Parking is at the back. Plenty of them but can be a little tricky to get one.

reviews.name: Shane de Mello
reviews.text: Nice spot to come for meals or just to wander around. Probably not enough to warrant a random trip here without purpose, so I'd plan to come to visit a restaurant or particular shop within the complex.

reviews.name: Patchanipa Sridaeng
reviews.text: Another terrific shopping mall, popular restaurants, cafes, dessert shop and etc. Modern, big and good vibes. Free car park 3 hours if you would like to free car park more pls dining total the receiept of money total 1,500 THB so, free more 3 hours.

reviews.name: Les JTH
reviews.text: Variety of food places and weekend family entertainment, including the ubiquitous kids edutainment. Some nice restaurants but not really much else. Just outside is a children's playground which is nice but a little pricey.

reviews.name: Pixie R. Siya
reviews.text: The best taste of authentic Korean cuisine with premium-quality ingredients and top-notch service — especially the kimchi, it’s so good! Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Selvia Suryadinata
reviews.text: This place is so nice, especialy if you visit at the night time. The lap is beatifull and have alot of food options are there.

reviews.name: sumpun Thammacharoen
reviews.text: Open​ air​ shopping​ mall &​ food​ center.​ There​ are​ many​ resteraunt​ here.​ Villa​ is​ the​ main shopping​ store.

reviews.name: apiwatbob
reviews.text:
Great place for walking during winter.

I love that they keep this zone empty without those pop up stalls. A great view without those selling cheap Chinese stuff that ruin the atmosphere.

reviews.name: H M. I
reviews.text: Nice place with variety of food and store . But it s quite difficult to park as it is always busy

reviews.name: Pavinee A
reviews.text: You can only walk your dogs in here. Cz most shops dont allow dogs and some only allowed outside and very poor mindset towards dogs especially R.. I have been couple of times they used to be better waiters but this time the experience was so bad. If you claim to be a pet friendly space all the restaurants should comply.

reviews.name: Jonathan van Olderen
reviews.text: Nice outside mall with great restaurants. Very nice to go for shopping and dinner!

reviews.name: sam gagan
reviews.text: We Went around 40 peoples for my daughter's birthday at swensens my favourite place at the circle ⭕

reviews.name: Satvinder Bakshi
reviews.text: Good place for a hangout with many restaurants to eat

reviews.name: Piyaphan Hovilailux
reviews.text:
I feel that the Circle have lots of Japanese and Korean restaurant, I think it would be better if here have Thai and Italian food.

Anyway, the mall provide free of parking for 3 hours although you don't stamp ticket.

title: SARIN THAI MASSAGE & SPA
subTitle: SARIN | THAI MASSAGE & SPA | Cove Hill เจริญกรุง
ownerDescription: ร้านนวดไทย และสปา I SARIN | THAI MASSAGE & SPA | Cove Hill เจริญกรุง l Thai Massage นวดไทย | Foot Massage นวดเท้า | Neck & Shoulder Massage นวดคอบ่าไหล่ | Aroma Oil Massage นวดอโรมา | Deep Tissue Massage นวดกดจุด
address: ชั้น 3 Cove Hill, ถ. เจริญกรุง Wat Phraya Krai, บางคอแหลม Bangkok 10120, Thailand
street: ชั้น 3 Cove Hill, ถ. เจริญกรุง

reviews.name: Karen Chua
reviews.text:
I visit Bangkok on a yearly basis and had tried many massage centre. Yet , Sarin managed to top it all. The experience is pleasant. The masseuse called TA , is extremely skilful. She managed to hit spots which were not found by other centres. I wanna bring her home with me if I could 😂 highly recommended.

Located on the 3rd floor of a commercial complex , it’s easy to find with banners guiding you upstairs. The place is warm and welcoming , soothing music. Quiet , respectful place. No one hurried me like other commercial centres.

reviews.name: Isabella Caproni
reviews.text: Amazing massages and excellent service. We had massages with Tom and AE. They were excellent!! Clean facility which is always important and good prices for quality massage. They even provided us with welcome drinks and  tea with delicious cookies at the end of our service (see photo).

reviews.name: Priyanka Muthukrishnan
reviews.text: Had an automatic warm oil massage and it was super relaxing. The ambience and service was great. The staff were very friendly, and the masseuse herself was a professional, making the whole experience very pleasant.

reviews.name: merdey dee
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Sarin. Everyone was very pleasant and welcoming from start to finish. I was especially impressed with how smooth and professional the scheduling process was.

The massage therapist was excellent, and the overall atmosphere made the experience even more relaxing and enjoyable. The tea served after the massage was also really good and such a thoughtful touch.

Overall, I left feeling very pleased and would definitely recommend this place to others looking for a great massage experience.

reviews.name: Victorria Saldana
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing! I would fly all the way from the US just to have this experience again. There is nothing else like it. From the moment we walked in it felt like we were in heaven. We left feeling so relaxed, refreshed, and happy with the service. Truly grateful to have had this experience. Best massage we have ever received!

reviews.name: Blossome
reviews.text: I received a body scrub and an oil massage for 2 hours. It feels very refreshing and my skin seems to have improved. If you're staying at the Chartrium Riverside Hotel, I recommend it.

reviews.name: Si L
reviews.text: Value for money 💯Did their Thai massage 2h - it was in a shared communal room with curtains (not private room) but for the price it was very worth it! Therapist was really skilled and friendly, highly recommend!

reviews.name: Vanessa Chan
reviews.text: Purple electrolyte drink before and a sweet (chrysanthemum?) tea after. We had a wonderful deep tissue massage in the couple room. Our masseuses checked in with us throughout to make sure it didn't exceed our pain levels. We nade the appointment day-of.

reviews.name: Dhanup manilal
reviews.text:
Very professional and very clean service.
Had an amazing experience at SARIN Thai Massage.
Very friendly staffs as well.
The best in Bangkok to be honest.

reviews.name: Girishan Balasuntharam
reviews.text:
The massage was amazing. Had a third degree sprain and I explained to Nok. She understood and did amazing to accommodate the pain.

Ae did my father’s massage and she did amazing too.

reviews.name: Airlie Hogan
reviews.text: I booked into Sarin via Instagram messages prior to arriving in Bangkok. The communication was absolutely fantastic. The tranquility package was superb with a very experienced masseuse. I would highly recommended Sarin as a positively exceptional spa. I’m left feeling like a new person!

reviews.name: Ray Anderson
reviews.text:
Very nice thorough Thai massage by Ae.
Nice facilities .
Friendly .
Cash only .good value .

reviews.name: Keelyn Costello
reviews.text: The Thai massage is great here! The space is very clean and zen too. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Rokesh Jankie
reviews.text:
Did the foot massage and what an experience...it was both legs up until upper legs which hot a treatment.
I will be back!

reviews.name: HK44
reviews.text: Ae gave me an amazing Thai oil massage today. She's very skilled (on par with my  exceptional registered massage therapist back home who is Chinese and Chinese trained). Spa is very nice and calming. Price is very reasonable, especially for such a great massage. Front desk staff is very polite. Would go back again, but we're leaving Bangkok tomorrow.

reviews.name: You En Lim
reviews.text: Easy to locate. Professional massage services. Facility is very new. Environment is nice. Strongly recommend. Great experience.

reviews.name: Piyapha Piyanonthaya
reviews.text:
This spa is very nice and clean. The aromatic oils smell fresh and natural. I would highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to refresh their mind and body. Importantly, the pricing is very reasonable—considering the value, quality, and service, it rivals the offerings of many luxury hotels in Bangkok.

All in all, I’m very impressed and will definitely be revisiting this place soon!

reviews.name: Yael Francisco
reviews.text: Beautiful place, wonderful service and people! Very friendly and welcoming to internationals. I had a relaxing aroma massage of 90 minutes my masseuse was very thoughtful. Would recommend if you are staying in chatrium riverside since it’s so close by!!!

reviews.name: Caretta Morris
reviews.text: I just had a grand 2 hour session at this establishment and it was amazing!!! The staff were kind, respectful, and my massage therapist was very strong 💪🏾 I enjoyed the before and after beverages (tasty flower drinks) and the little cookies were delicious as well as adorable. I would greatly recommend anyone to give this place a try.

reviews.name: Chris Nicholson
reviews.text: Wonderful Thai Massage. Best 2 hour massage I’ve ever had!

ownerDescription: Designed in the modern style with basic gray earth tone color, the new branch offers a perfect setting for relaxation and rejuvenation. reviews.name: Diva Shafiera
reviews.text:
overall, the place is decent with reasonable pricing. i took the dry massage package (feet, hands, shoulders, and back) for 1100. they provide complimentary drinks and mango sticky rice, which is a nice touch.

however, the massage quality is inconsistent. some therapists apply too much pressure, others too little, and the rhythm isn’t always right.

it’s good for a basic massage, but could be improved with better therapist training, especially considering how well-known the place is.

reviews.name: Larry Cortez
reviews.text: Let's Relax Spa is always a satisfactory massage place to go to. I've been to many and this place is strategically located where people do a lot of shopping and walking. Which is why I stopped in. When walking miles through the malls and looking at interesting street vendors your feet quickly get tired and begin to hurt. I saw this place on the 5th floor and quickly booked my appointment for the next available spot. Since it was before noon and not too busy I was ushered in quickly and started my 90 minute foot massage. You are given a cold towel to refresh your face and a nice refreshing drink before your shoes are taken away for slippers. You walk towards the back into a large lazy boy chair, recline and the staff places pillows for your head and a warm fanny pack to put on your stomach. She lays a covering towel and cleans your feet with a hot towel. Now the real massage begins, she pours a small amount of oil and works every inch of your feet ankle and lower leg. After several minutes you are so relaxed you are trying not to fall asleep (afraid of snoring) so you are fighting the urge to close your eyes. After 90 minutes you wake up and disappointed because you want the masseuse to continue for another hour or more but you know its time to leave. Overall, any massage is such a privilege, a blessing and a healing experience that you want to have it done every single day. Let's Relax Spa and its branches throughout Bangkok is Highly Recommended!

I had an amazing experience at Forest, with an aromatherapy massage. Everything was good from start to finish.
The massage therapists are professional and very attentive. One of the things I really appreciated was the ability to customize my experience in advance. Before the session, you fill out a form where you could choose the pressure level and specify which areas to focus on or avoid. It makes the whole experience seamless, without having to explain everything during the session.
The spa itself is clean, modern, and beautifully maintained. The atmosphere is incredibly relaxing—you start unwinding the moment you step inside. There’s no rush or chaos, just pure tranquility.
Highly recommended!
