This place offered reasonable prices and great service.

What stood out to me the most was how they offered me tea after the session and asked me to sit down and complete a short survey.
It was impressive to see that they genuinely cared about feedback and were making a real effort to improve their service.

reviews.name: KEITH ANG (ANG SHENG MING KEITH)
reviews.text: Very good hidden gem, massage is really good & hard strength. From head to toe. Love the onsen bath & choices of essential oil. Totally a unforgettable relaxing experience in bangkok, will visit again. They do have a off peak discount on the package at 2050baht. For 2.5hrs.

reviews.name: Marjorie Capun
reviews.text: Stopped by due to heavy rain for me to find an amazing, fresh made, natural watermelon smoothie. It was splendid. The receptionist's service, the air freshener dispenser (which I believe to be the aromatherapy machine?), and the atmosphere of the spa with the ambient lighting and music made it an enjoyable experience to sip on some watermelon smoothie. The glass was really cute as well!

reviews.name: Monica’s Taste
reviews.text:
The Forest Onsen in Thonglor is an absolute hidden gem! 🌿 From the moment you step in, the atmosphere feels calming, natural, and beautifully designed to transport you away from the city’s hustle.

What stood out most to me was the unique signature scents they use — there are two different fragrances in the onsen, both incredibly relaxing and refreshing. The aromas add such a special touch, making the whole experience feel more immersive and luxurious.

The facilities are clean, modern, and very well maintained, with a real focus on detail. Whether you’re there to unwind after a long day or treat yourself to some quiet me-time, this place truly delivers a sense of peace and rejuvenation.

Highly recommend for anyone in Bangkok looking for a high-quality onsen experience with an extra touch of elegance and sensory delight. 🌸

* They also serve organic watermelon juice without ice and sugar.

reviews.name: Suwannee Homprasit
reviews.text:
Relaxing vibes and nice service. The staff checked the water temperature and explained everything well. The room is clean and no any insects or bad smell.

The male staff at the front is very helpful to coordinating with the spa owner to extend the voucher expiry date which was bought directly from the spa. Appreciated.

reviews.name: Minte Wei
reviews.text: First time trying forest massage as it’s near to hotel am staying. What a gem! Excellent service and most importantly the therapist knows all the hidden spots to release the tension and knot! The place is relaxing and seems relatively new. Easy to reserve via line and prompt in reply. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Eiry
reviews.text:
In such weather is the best option to set your mind with onsen and massage. Relaxing vibes and nice service.
It was my first time for onsen so the staff gently explained me everything. The room was clean and minimalistic modern that I like so much.

Such a care from the entrance to the end of treatment. You just have to relax.

reviews.name: Beth C
reviews.text: Fantastic massage so good we came back - very clean, quiet and wonderful therapists

reviews.name: Jing
reviews.text:
A cozy, woody-style massage shop tucked just off Sukhumvit 55. The overall ambiance feels like a forest cottage retreat—warm lighting, wooden textures, and a calm, comforting atmosphere. Massage rooms are private and relaxing, with solid techniques offered by experienced staff.

Prices are on the slightly premium side, but I feel they’re justified—especially if you book via the Gowabi app, where deals are often available.

One highlight worth mentioning: the shop has recently fixed the previously broken ceiling at the entrance. The front now looks much more inviting and aligned with the calming interior vibe. This small but meaningful improvement really lifts the shop’s image and makes me more inclined to return.

reviews.name: Wendy Chang
reviews.text: Best valued spa in Bangkok, extremely professional therapist attentive to your needs and very friendly. Clean environment and quiet spa room. A small distance from BTS Thong Lo but definitely worth the visit.

reviews.name: Melvin Tan (meltanec)
reviews.text:
I recently visited Forest Massage and Spa in Bangkok, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The online booking process was incredibly easy and hassle-free, making it convenient to secure an appointment. Upon arrival, I was immediately impressed by the beautiful and serene environment, which set the tone for a truly relaxing experience.

The therapist I had was not only skilled but also very kind and gentle, making me feel completely at ease. The massage itself was wonderfully soothing, with just the right amount of pressure. Considering the quality of service and the calming atmosphere, the price is truly value for money. I highly recommend Forest Massage and Spa for anyone looking for a rejuvenating experience in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Keyron Phillips
reviews.text: Whilst the environment is beautiful and calming, and the hour in the onsen was very relaxing, the subsequent massage was very poor. The woman mostly used her elbows for the hour massage, often pushing on bone to a point where it was painful. She never asked if the pressure was okay and ignored all the requests I had made on the form in reception when I arrived. She seemed disinterested from the start. To make things worse, I was freezing from the AC and the same three Xmas songs were on a loop for the whole two hours. A shame, as this was a Xmas gift from my wife.

reviews.name: Andrew Yee
reviews.text: One of the best massage spots in all of Thong Lo.  This place is usually busy and walk-ins may not have availability so reservations are recommended. Technicians are extremely skilled. Worth the price point. A+

title: Spring Massage & Spa
ownerDescription: Thai massage;Physical Treatment;Detoxing;Relaxing body
address: 21/2 Sukhumvit 24 Alley, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: J Sze
reviews.text: While the place and service are very good, but do beware that their signature massage include a pelvis floor massage. the Chinese name, when googled, says that it is a traditional Thai massage technique targeted at reproductive system, and in small print, women are charged 200baht extra. But the English translation doesn't mention pelvis massage. so for the unsuspecting person who has never heard of this technique, I felt conned. they have other massage pricing, just choose carefully!

reviews.name: Angelica P.
reviews.text:
We came because of a friend's recommendation and chose royal spring massage. And it turned out to be a wonderfully relaxing and comfortable experience. After settling the massage fees, we were asked to fill out a survey to indicate our preferences for massage pressure and specific body areas to focus on or avoid, which made the session feel personalized and thoughtful.

One thing to note: if you're a smoker, be mindful of the no-smoking policies, as there are clear notice stickers displayed.

Overall, it was an excellent experience, and I'd happily recommend it!

reviews.name: Lee Candy
reviews.text: I came to this shop after the heavy rain. The shop was full of soothing aromas. The front desk was very polite and helped to introduce a massage package suitable for me. In the end, I chose a two-hour essential oil massage. The masseuse was very polite and the whole process was not noisy. It felt very peaceful and my muscles were relaxed. I will recommend it to my friends.

reviews.name: Benny Lim
reviews.text:
The service protocol is expected.
The matured looking therapist is attentive to ensure that I am not suffering due to pressure applied, always get my feedback if is ok.
The place is clean and properly equipped . May be booking is full, the receptionist just act normally without the warm where I visited other outlets.

reviews.name: Lawrence Ang
reviews.text: Apparently one of the legit place for private tendon massage. Located on 3rd floor and staff are professional and all good

reviews.name: Stone Eli
reviews.text: Very good and professional massage skills make my body comfortable. The room I stayed has the big bathtub and widows . Soft background music let me relax and enjoy the massage. Price is a little expensive than other massage.

reviews.name: Henson Quek
reviews.text: Professional massage. Truly recommended especially genital massage. To avoid long waiting time better make reservations first.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: thank you , hope can see you again 🙏

reviews.name: Nonthakorn C. Lui
reviews.text: This is my first time to this shop. A friend recommended it to me after coming here for a massage. This time I finally had time to come. There is a refreshing smell in the lobby that is very soothing. Mineral water is provided. The front desk service is very enthusiastic. During the massage, the masseur will increase the strength as required. After one process, I feel a lot more relaxed. It's great!

reviews.name: 陳煒捷
reviews.text: Special massage. They get a really technical skill on massage. Better to call them to make an appointment before you go.

reviews.name: Chanapon Mongkalanangoon
reviews.text: I have been to this shop before and had a good experience. I was very relaxed after the massage last time, so I made an appointment for an essential oil massage with the same masseur this time. The massage was very powerful and the sore muscles were very relaxed. The whole process was very quiet and soothing. There was also hot tea after the massage. I like this very much.

reviews.name: 阿成（阿成）
reviews.text: I booked a massage a day in advance through Line. bec the new year, the spa was quite busy. when I come out, I saw many people waiting. The massager was great. she ask me to make sure I was comfortable.

reviews.name: Soso km
reviews.text: I have tried almost all massage parlors, but this one was quite surprising. It is very close to public transportation. The front desk enthusiastically recommends massage programs suitable for me. The masseur also introduces tips on how to make the body healthier. After the massage, my body is very relaxed, which is very surprising.

reviews.name: Emily Xu
reviews.text:
I encountered several issues at this massage establishment:

1.	Policy on Accompaniment: Despite my clear request to have my partner accompany me during the massage for personal comfort, the policy at this facility disallows it. The response from the reception was less than accommodating, emphasizing pre-arrival requests. However, my attempts to reach them by phone beforehand were unsuccessful.
2.	Booking Process: There seems to be a disconnect with their online booking system. I attempted to book through their website and awaited confirmation but received none. This led me to book in person at the shop. It’s puzzling why there’s a booking feature on the website if it’s not actively monitored or used.
3.	Receptionist’s Attitude: The receptionist’s manner was quite off-putting. I believe a customer’s personal choices, especially regarding comfort during treatments, should be respected. Expressing the desire to have a partner in the room for support should be considered a fundamental aspect of patient consent and personal rights, especially in a setting that involves privacy and personal care. It’s important that such preferences are accommodated within professional standards and service delivery.

I hope this feedback helps improve the service and policies for future patrons.

reviews.name: Frank Yen
reviews.text: Special experience in Bangkok! Registration through Klook in advance is recommended!

reviews.name: Theerapat Vijitpoo
reviews.text:
I was disappointed with the overall experience at this spa, including the cleanliness, price and lack of refreshments after the massage.

Additional, I was concerned to learn that the therapist discussed me after the session.

I suggest exploring other options for more satisfactory massage experience at a more reasonable cost

reviews.name: Martin
reviews.text:
The reservation via Line for 90 minutes
Spring Signature Massage went smoothly.
The masseuse was friendly and professional, with a lot of experience.
The whole body is massaged with cold and warm coconut oil, also hot stones are used. It is difficult to describe this amazing massage, because so many massage techniques are used in 90 Minutes. In any case it’s a kind of energy massage for men. After the massage, I slept better than I had in a long time. The Spring Massage alone is worth a trip to Bangkok and is
absolutely recommendable!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, hope will see you again 🙏

reviews.name: Jason Cai
reviews.text: Really great experience, healthy and comfort.

reviews.name: Himiko Arikane
reviews.text: Enjoyed the deep spring massage! A unique experience, relieved stiffness and felt refreshed after the massage. Will definitely come back to enjoy again!

reviews.name: Jeffrey F
reviews.text: The traditional massage, especially with  their "purity" package (men's libido) is really good. There's no hanky panky and their masseurs will give you a strong and relaxing massage. Was informed that they only have 6 masseurs and thus would advise to pre-book
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you ka 🙏

reviews.name: sc
reviews.text: The massage is good, but the experience is not very positive due to the terrible receptionist. The lady in the reception always tired to sell the most expensive package instead of what I originally want to do, which made me feel very uncomfortable. In addition, 3% fee needed to be paid additionally for credit card payment. For 3500 baht massage, you are requested to pay 100 baht credit card fee? I never hear this in Bangkok.😅😮‍💨 And please be attention, your package includes 20 mins shower. For 2 hours package, you will receive only 1 hour 40 mins massage. However, you will not be informed of this until you pay. I will never visit this place again, and I suggest that you may find similar massage in a better place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear customer , thanks for your visit.the 3% additional fee is charged by the bank, not our shop, so far as I know, many shops in Bangkok charge same amount,it’s not our company policy. And about the shower, we have notification on the reception desk to notify every customer, because during the massage there always some massage oil left on the body, so the shower is necessary, normally, we left 10mins for customer for shower. For example: a 90mins massage include 10mins shower+80mins massage.same as 2 hours massage,if you finish shower early, you can call the therapists to come in.  The therapists are eating outside the door.We will improve our service. Agin, thank you for your visit.

title: Ice Queen
subTitle: Ice Queen - Artisanal Ice Cream
ownerDescription: ราชินีแห่งไอศกรีม (Ice Queen)
address: 350, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
plusCode: VVQG+9H Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri, Thailand

reviews.name: chris
reviews.text:
This place and the staff there are simply incredible. There aren’t many places in Pattaya that sell ice cream and affogato at night. But this place is one of them. Since we were there an hour before closing time, there weren’t many people, which was also a big plus.

The waffles were very tasty—soft on the inside and crispy on the outside. We didn’t have to wait long for our order.

Unfortunately, we lingered too long—it was closing time, and we still hadn’t finished eating. We were pleasantly surprised that the staff didn’t even approach us, didn’t ask us to leave, and didn’t give us dirty looks.

They simply let us finish our meal, and it was both lovely and nice🫠🫠

There are so many ice cream flavors here —something for every taste and preference ;)

reviews.name: Prachya Ounamornchailkul
reviews.text: I really like this ice cream café. They have many different flavors and menu choices to try. The taste is good and enjoyable, though fairly standard for the price. I love the bright pink décor and the cute cartoon characters around the shop. My favorite part is the location—it’s directly opposite the beach, making it a perfect spot to sit back, enjoy some ice cream, and take in the view. 🍦🏖️

reviews.name: Martin P
reviews.text:
Big range of ice creams and cakes. Lovely decorated for kids. Tasty and sweet, so not a place to
avoid calories 😇. The only minus is the restrooms being in a different location.

reviews.name: Sutatta Tuntearapong
reviews.text: I recommend Ice Queen ice cream. They have a wide variety of ice cream flavors. We can try them at the display first. The staff are friendly and provide excellent service. The ice cream is delicious and the price is reasonable.

reviews.name: U E
reviews.text:
The ice cream is okay, but nothing special. It tastes like standard industrial ice cream that you could also find in a supermarket.
Calling it “Artisan Ice Cream” feels misleading, as it doesn’t seem to be handcrafted or small-batch. The name sets higher expectations than what you actually get.
Prices are quite high, although the shop is in a prime location with a large setup and several staff members, which probably explains the pricing.

Overall decent, but in my opinion slightly overrated.
The employees are all kind

reviews.name: Richard Latham
reviews.text:
I was very excited to come in after a long day of work to enjoy an ice cream. Made an order and chose which flavor ice cream I wanted; 1. Ferror Rocher 2. Lemon Meringue 3. Blueberry Yoghurt. You would expect when ordering in order from 1-3 that your first choice would be the most preferred or even there at all. To my misfortune, the one I wanted the most (Ferror Rocher) was so small I couldn't even get a taste for it. I can understand and speak Thai then heard the staff gossip about how they know they messed up my order but didn't seem to care to fix it.

Heard another guest ask for the WiFi password and they treated to ignore him and we're very unhelpful.

reviews.name: Abigail Corpuz
reviews.text: I went here in an afternoon. They currently have a happy hour around 8 PM - 2 AM. There are 3 flavors of Baskets (Toppings and syrup) to choose from; Chocolate, Caramel and Strawberry, and 2 scoops of your chosen ice cream flavors. It’s only 145 Baht. 1 basket is normally good for two unless you’re craving. 🤤There’s a lot in the menu to choose from aside from the baskets. I liked it, however, I am not a fan of super sweet ice creams. So it’s alright. 👌🏼☺️

reviews.name: Borwonkhun Tontivuthikul
reviews.text: Amazing variety of classics and creative seasonal scoops.

reviews.name: Jon H.
reviews.text: Best Ice Cream in Thailand. I love Mango and coconut ice cream that can be found everywhere in Thailand, but Queen of Ice Cream has about 50 gourmet flavors.  High quality creamy flavors, not just fruity flavors.  Macchiato Almond, and Dark Night (extra dark chocolate) were amazing.

reviews.name: PAM NIMPOOLSWARD
reviews.text: Ice cream Cafe. Decorated in pink and pastel colors. Good for photos and relaxing. It is located on the beach road. So, you can have sea view while you're enjoying ice cream, cake, coffee, and drinks. Taste is okay, not that wow. Price for the drink and cake are not bad. Ice cream rate is a bit high. However, if you're looking for some place  to sit back, relax, clean, and pretty for photos with the beach view, this place can suit you.

reviews.name: Daton Chris
reviews.text:
If you knew Swensen’s Iced Cream, the franchise ice cream in Thailand you would pretty much know all menu of Ice Queen’s. Good thing is that when you ask for ice cream sample...the staff will give you pretty much mouth full taster rather than a small lick like when you taste ice cream at Swensen’s.

Today I ordered, Banana Boat with passion fruit and strawberry yogurt flavors, they are awe some, especially the passion fruit. It was so real that you can eat and bite the its fruit seed, I like it.

I have to admit that I tried almost ten flavors in oder to make decision which flavor that I really wanted to have.

The interior is in magnificently pink tone, I love it though.

reviews.name: David M.
reviews.text:
I first noticed this place while walking by so I decided to stop in and was pleasantly surprised as to how good the ice cream is! I ordered 1 scoop then but wished I had ordered 2 by the time I finished. The chocolate brownie is delicious!

I came back another time and had their 3-scoop brownie split, which was also very delicious. I also like that they give you a free small glass of filtered water to drink with your ice cream.

The place is clean and the staff is helpful and friendly.

This review only loses a star because they don't accept credit card payments. While they do accept QR payments, you need a local Thai bank to use it here so tourists must still resort to cash, unfortunately.

reviews.name: david nicholls
reviews.text:
I started going a few times now as it's like a once a month treat for myself and girlfriend that are both gym enthusiast so the calories are important but you can treat yourself to a delicious helping of the best ice-cream you will taste here . It's very presentable and colourful. The fancy bowel you get it in the cleanliness of the sit in ice creamery is so. Good . I recommend this place to every one including gym goers .great yourself a treat now and then . You  can work it off .
.

reviews.name: AJ
reviews.text: Great place for some dessert, fair prices.

reviews.name: Wim Van den Eynde
reviews.text: On beach road in jomtien verh nice place for eating icecream but choice. Good service not to expensive. View at sea if you want sit outside. Nice to ho there with children and friends.

reviews.name: Lebua Tower
reviews.text: Top Location for Home made Ice Cream and Cakes. High Class Quality Products, very delicious and a big Range of different Ice Cream. Direct on Jomtien Beach Road

reviews.name: Jon Sirkis
reviews.text: Happy happy with the ice cream.  Definitely royalty, even as compared to a Swensons, this is MUCH better.  I have never seen a better shop better than this in Thailand for the sheer variety and quality of ice cream.  The French bakery was also superb.  We took the baht bus down from N Pattaya, for a day of walking, 20 baht per person each way.  This was definitely the highlight of our hot day of exploring. Second visit was just as yummy.  Lol, Smurf flavored ice cream?

reviews.name: KaungKhant MaungMaung
reviews.text: Good service ,good atmosphere and good ice cream .Have the home bakery also .

reviews.name: Claudio Bourque
reviews.text: Best ice cream place in the city. Children will love it. Home-made ice cream. Many flavors. Reasonable pricing. Great decors for children and adults.

reviews.name: barbara scorpioni
reviews.text: My dreaming place with the best ice cream downtown!!!!!

title: SO/ SPA at SO/ Bangkok
ownerDescription:
Say ‘Hello’ to the urban wellness in the heart of Bangkok.

Looking for the best luxury spa treatment for your spa day in Bangkok? Experience an exceptional collection of facial, body and beauty treatments that transcends the corners of science, fashion and lifestyle with SO’s unique sociable vibe at SO/ SPA

Inspired by the Asian folklore of the mythical Himmapan forest, SO/ SPA is an urban spa retreat where worldwide ancient traditions meet Modern skin care systems in the multi-award-winning hotel spa in Bangkok.
address: 2 North, Sathorn, S Sathon Rd, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: jh kang
reviews.text:
Absolute perfection! Life-changing massage.

I had an absolutely incredible experience here! A huge thank you to Bow and Aom for their outstanding service. They were both extremely kind, welcoming, and professional from start to finish. The massage itself was hands down the best I've ever had in my life. They tailored the pressure perfectly and managed to melt away all my muscle tension. If you visit, I highly recommend requesting Bow and Aom-they are

truly amazing! 10/10, will definitely come back.

I chose the lavender scent and felt truly healed throughout the entire hour. I especially wanted to focus on my shoulders and neck, and it was deeply impressive how she worked on them so thoroughly yet gently.
It wasn't painful at all, and all the tension in my body melted away, so I feel ready to head out for my evening activities with a light body. I definitely want to visit again during my trip. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: RattoWanderlust
reviews.text:
SO/ SPA is honestly one of the most beautiful and immersive spa experiences I’ve had in Bangkok. From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere immediately felt calming and luxurious, with soft lighting, relaxing scents, and panoramic views overlooking Lumpini Park. It truly feels like escaping the city without actually leaving Bangkok.

What makes this spa stand out is not only the design inspired by the Himmapan Forest, but also the overall attention to detail throughout the experience. The therapists were professional and attentive, and the treatments felt deeply relaxing and thoughtfully personalised. I also appreciated that they use high-quality wellness and skincare products, which elevated the entire treatment experience even more.

The interiors are stunning and very different from a typical hotel spa — elegant, modern, and almost cinematic in atmosphere. Perfect for anyone looking for a luxury wellness experience in Bangkok, whether for a relaxing afternoon or a full spa day.

Definitely one of the spas I would return to again. !!

reviews.text: Great experience! Rin provided a relaxing massage and listened carefully to my requests. Nan at the reception was very friendly and helpful. Thank you for the comfortable and pleasant service!

They welcomed me with a signature drink (because stress isn’t allowed inside), then made me smell every oil they had. The oils were great, but after sniffing too many, I got dizzy 😂
So I picked the first scent… because my nose had officially retired.

The package was cheap: oil massage for two, two hours each. Super clean room, gentle but insanely relaxing massage, and the oil smelled amazing.
Finished off with another signature drink.
10/10 would sniff myself dizzy again. 😌

reviews.name: Pao Pao
reviews.text: I came to massage Warm Oil massage 90 minute. The therapists who provided the service were skilled ,professional and gave a good massage, exactly as I wanted. They’re  polite and kind service. Both the receptionists and the therapists were very polite. The atmosphere in the shop was relaxing. After the massage, they served mango sticky rice to eat. It was the best massage experience I have ever had.

reviews.name: Lucas ROY
reviews.text: Amazing experience! The place is exceptionally clean and relaxing, and the staff were very welcoming. The massage was incredible and really helped relieve all my muscle tension and fatigue. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Echo Tsai
reviews.text:
I think this is the best massage I’ve ever had in BKK!! Relaxing atmosphere, friendly and polite staffs, professional therapists, privacy, cleanliness, it absolutely deserves 5 stars.
After the massage course, they served mango sticky rice, which was very delicious, and hot tea, it really helped warming up the body after massage! Truly satisfied with the experience this time and definitely will come again!!!
(The therapist Ms. Iangfa is highly recommended 👍👍👍)

reviews.name: Saruta
reviews.text: Today I visited the branch near my home and was impressed by the atmosphere — the shop smells pleasant and feels clean. I received excellent service from the front desk staff, who paid great attention to detail, and the therapist was very skilled.

reviews.name: Agnese D'Alfonso
reviews.text: Amazing experience! I had the aroma oil massage and it was absolutely great, probably the best I had in Thailand! The overall experience is very good, they serve cold tea before the massage and hot tea with mango sticky rice after it. It’s also possible to take a shower to wash away the oil - which is great if you can’t go home right away.

reviews.name: Ravisara L
reviews.text:
We went in a group of 7 people to get the massage. All 7 of us had a great Thai massage at Let’s Relax at this location. All of the masseuses are very well trained.

I had a lower back and neck pain before the treatment, my masseuses slowly helped me relieved the knot. I felt very relief afterwards.

Highly recommend anyone to visit this location.

reviews.name: Jennifer Chu
reviews.text:
Got the two hour Thai massage with my partner for $1200 baht each. We were able to walk in and schedule an appt about 1.5 hrs later.

Overall experience was nice. You're greeted with some tea and a cool towel before they bring you in, wash your feet and given clothes to change. The whole experience does take the full 2hrs. I felt like my masseuse spent more time on one side over the other and the pressure was different for each side. Thus a lower star. They end the whole experience with some jasmine tea and mango sticky rice that was well made.

reviews.name: Mamoris
reviews.text: Today I had a Dream package massage. The atmosphere in the shop was peaceful. The staff provided excellent service. The masseuse was polite. The massage was skilled and made me feel very good.

reviews.name: kachun Kwok
reviews.text:
Terrible experience at Let's Relax – do not recommend.

The therapist had no real technique. Pressure was completely off, and asking to adjust made no difference. None of my tight areas were properly addressed – I left feeling more sore than before.

The attitude was also poor. The therapist seemed bored and distracted, and the front desk staff was cold and unfriendly.

For the price, I expected basic professionalism. Instead, I got a careless, ineffective massage. Save your money and go somewhere else.

reviews.name: Victor
reviews.text:
The only massage outlet where you get served mango sticky rice after a good massage session.

Prices were decent, especially if you choose combo packages. Both our masseuses were highly professional and helped relax our body.
Excellent service, money well spent.

Definitely worth it if you are in Chinatown and need a nice place to relax your muscles.

reviews.name: Nutthamon Chin
reviews.text:
Very good exp here. Staff is kind and helpful.
Therapist is very good and expert !
Facility is clean and new.
I went there with my mom and she is very happy. Recommended and valuable !

reviews.name: Tsunami33
reviews.text: Great experience and session for 90 minutes. Would do more next time. Surprise snack afterwards too!

reviews.name: Jo-Lynn Teh
reviews.text: Great service. Had 120 min Thai massage for 1,200 THB. Got served with lemongrass juice with ice towel, which was perfect for hot day. Massage therapist was professional and able to go hard and gentle in specific spots. Facility is very clean and comfortable. Body feels relaxed after the massage. Got served nice hot tea and mango sticky rice as dessert. Worth it. I recommend it if you stay in ASAI hotel next door because it is convenient. Best to book ahead and go in the morning to ensure best therapist.

reviews.name: Jo J. (JoTravel)
reviews.text: Very professional massage salon. It’s in a small mall, top floor. When you enter the salon the receptionist welcomes you in a very nice manner. The salon is very clean! The massage options are endless and in my opinion very reasonably priced. Before your massage they offer you cold sweet tea and a cold cloth. You are given slippers for inside the salon. Also before the massage you’re asked to give your preferences, on a tablet you can mark the firmness of the massage and the areas you like to be touched and not to be touched. If you’re not happy with the massage you have the opportunity to ask for a different therapist within 15 minutes. The massage therapist I had, was very good and professional. She found exactly the spot that needs most attention. Afterwards you get a warm tea and a cookie. I recommend booking an appointment, since it’s a busy salon. But walk ins are also welcome. Ten out of ten experience.

reviews.name: Helen Lee
reviews.text:
I am Thai and I go to spa regularly. I must say that I have had the best spa experience ever here! I did ‘Let's Relax Experience 210 mins’ the body scrub then the aromatic oil massage with hot stones was just wow and last session was facial treatment which I loved too ❤️ plus, the spa bed was heated which I found very impressive.
My therapist named Tha (ต้า) was super nice, very delicate handwork, polite and caring so I highly recommend this young therapist 🫶🏻 The place itself is very well decorated - fancy looking and clean ✨The receptionists were also very friendly and kind.
The complimentary Mango sticky rice at the end just made this spa place a gold - It was super cute  and thoughtful 😊🍋

reviews.name: Toni Pluke
reviews.text: Professionalism at front desk making a walk in booking, VIP treatment on arrival. The spa is decorated with class and sophistication and all the message equipment are executive level. We did the dream package for 2 people and definitely the best foot massage I have ever received anywhere in the world. Masseuse gave me the impression he was an acupuncture master as he massaged every single part of my foot. Would definitely recommend to all Travellers, its not just a spa, its an experience. I will definitely be going to the Chiang Mai and Phuket branches

reviews.name: Athena Ng
reviews.text: Very modern, clean and comfortable interior. Massage and overall service was excellent. Surprisingly both iced and warm team was very pleasant to drink too.

reviews.name: Karen Ramos
reviews.text: Excellent massage and service. I had the thai massage with hot herbal compress. Time flew by in the hands of the expert therapist! I came in with pain everywhere and knots in my neck and shoulders from a very long flight. I came out new!!!  Highly recommend!!!

reviews.name: Nadine Amann
reviews.text:
I asked for a massage for back & feet and was offered for 90 min Dream massage (30 feet, 15 hands, 45 shoulder) -> I got an appointment 40 minutes later :)
Upon arrival, I received a welcome drink and was able to choose my priorities for the massage. It started with a foot soak, followed by the treatment itself: first the feet, then the hands, and finally the back and shoulders. Note: the legs are uncovered up to the knees. I asked for a towel between my skin and the leather chair, but that wouldn't have been necessary as my legs were placed on towels shortly after anyway.
It was amazing. Running is no longer painful – quite the opposite, I feel like I'm floating on clouds and I'm totally zen.

Afterwards I got an jasmine tea and mango sticky rice - it was very tasty.

Thank you so much <3

reviews.text:
Overall, the price is quite high for the experience. This was our first time trying the massage here. The therapist who massaged me was good and applied the right pressure at the right points.

However, the service could be improved. Some staff were criticizing each other in front of customers, which I think is not appropriate. Near the end of the session, they placed a warm towel with a light fragrance over my face, which felt nice, but the towel used for the face rest smelled strongly of laundry detergent, more like a washing smell than a pleasant scent.

During the massage, we could also hear loud noises from upstairs - it sounded like someone dropping dumbbells on the floor several times, which made the atmosphere less relaxing. After the massage, we sat on the sofa for a while and noticed many therapists resting on the sofa across from us.

Overall, I feel the massage price here is quite expensive compared to the level of service provided.

reviews.name: Chris Ee Ting Wong
reviews.text:
Nature massage has many outlets and this is the better one. It's newer and bigger and they have more private rooms on the second floor.

I went at 10:30 a.m. hence there was no other guests.

I took the 1 hour Thai massage with Tiger Balm. It was good medium and strong strengths. But maybe because I was not familiar with Thai massage, she was doing more firm pressing bit by bit.

At payment the manager said she has to charge me 3% for using credit card, despite I told her the outlets at Siam soi5 did not charge me 3% when I paid by credit card yesterday!? She gave me a collect stamp card, which was not given to me by Siam soi5 outlet. Seems to be different practises at different outlets

It’s along Sukhumvit Rd. few doors down from The Pablo. Bit far of a walk from Asok BTS.

I like this location because it’s still very new. Receptionist spoke very good English and was easy to make a reservation over the phone.

Everything was Professional, clean and probably the best ventilation and central air system I’ve seen (see photo). In a city full of old buildings, humidity and black mold, YES, this matters.

reviews.name: m m
reviews.text:
I had the 5-in-1, 90-minute massage, which included a shoulder, neck, and foot massage, and it was absolutely wonderful. It was so relaxing that I actually fell asleep during the session—and I slept very deeply!

I’ve had massages at many different places, from luxury spas to local massage shops, and I can honestly say this place stands out. It was very clean, smelled wonderful, and everyone was so friendly and kind.

A special thank you to my therapist, Kathy. She was excellent, and I truly appreciated her care and skill.

I would definitely love to come back again. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ryan GLOBETROTTER
reviews.text:
Nice place for a massage with a calm and relaxing atmosphere.

The massage rooms are separate, which provides good intimacy and comfort. Everything was clean and well maintained and having a shower available is definitely a plus.

I chose a combo massage including an aromatic stress release massage and a facial deluxe, priced at 2,790 baht as of December 2025, and it was very good value for the experience.

The quality matched the price well and the treatment was professional and enjoyable.

They also accept contactless payments, which is convenient.

Overall, a good option if you’re looking for a clean, comfortable place with fair pricing and a solid massage experience.

Relax 🧘‍♀️ 🙏🧘💆‍♀️💆💆‍♂️😎

reviews.name: Connie Chang
reviews.text: The best Thai massage ever! The shop is clean and the masseuses are very professional. My daughter and I had Somi and Green for the 120 minute Thai massage session. It’s so soothing and relaxing. I wish I could have massage every week. Very affordable and strongly recommended!

reviews.name: Kim Kevin
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience regarding this shop’s cancellation and refund policy.

On February 27, I booked a 7:00 PM massage for the following day and was required to make full payment in advance (1,840 THB for 90 min) by credit card. I chose this shop mainly because it is very close to my hotel and convenient. In fact, there are many other massage shops within a 5–10 minute walk that offer similar or better services at lower prices.

The following morning at 10:00 AM, when the shop opened, I went in person to request a cancellation because it was my last day in Thailand and I needed to adjust my schedule before leaving. The appointment was still 9 hours away.

I was told that credit card payments cannot be refunded the next day, and that only same-day cancellations are eligible for refund when paid by card. I was also told that if I had paid in cash, a refund would have been possible. This difference in policy depending on payment method was never clearly explained to me at the time of booking.

The confirmation form states that “deposit payment in advance is not refundable.” However, I was required to pay the full amount, not a partial deposit. The use of the word “deposit” is misleading when 100% of the service fee is collected in advance. There was also no written indication that refund rules differ depending on the payment method.

From a customer’s perspective, this lack of clarity feels unfair and insufficiently transparent.

What was most disappointing was the complete lack of effort to find a reasonable solution. The staff and manager (Ms. Niracha- she ia rather rude and didn't willing to listen to me) repeatedly insisted that a refund was absolutely impossible, without showing flexibility or willingness to consider the circumstances. It felt like there was no attempt to resolve the issue from a customer-oriented perspective.

The situation escalated to the point where I had to call the police. The officer who arrived was polite, professional, and clearly made an effort to remain fair and neutral while mediating the discussion. After the mediation, the shop’s attitude noticeably changed, and a voucher usable at another branch was offered. This suggested that some form of compromise had been possible from the beginning.

The entire process, including repeated discussions and police mediation, took nearly three hours of my last day in Thailand. It was extremely frustrating to spend such valuable travel time dealing with a situation that could have been resolved more reasonably from the beginning.

In the end, I accepted the voucher as the only available option, although I would have preferred a refund.

I strongly recommend that the shop clearly explain its cancellation and refund policies in advance, especially when requiring full prepayment.

reviews.name: Rebecca Untalan
reviews.text: My wife and I booked the 120 minute massage with the herbal compress and fell deep asleep to the relaxation. My masseuse was Green and she was absolutely sweet and did a really pleasant job. It was the best massage yet I have had here in Bangkok! The whole place was comforting and beautiful. Recommended! I’ll be back again :)

reviews.name: Faith Cubillan
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience at this massage spa. The atmosphere was beautiful and relaxing and the massage was amazing! All staff were so lovely and friendly. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Xavier Chow
reviews.text: Landed in Thailand this morning and walked in. Environment was clean and serene. The staff were very friendly and the massage was  well done and relieved a lot of my tensions from flying across the world. Would come back very soon!

reviews.name: Tricia Kaye
reviews.text:
I recently visited this Thai massage studio and was genuinely impressed by how well they balance quality and affordability. Despite the very reasonable prices, the overall experience felt comparable to far more expensive spas.

From the moment I arrived, the staff were warm, professional, and attentive without being intrusive. The space is clean, calm, and quietly decorated—nothing overly luxurious, but thoughtfully arranged so you immediately feel relaxed. The reception explained the different types of Thai massage clearly (traditional, oil, foot, etc.) and did not push any unnecessary add-ons.

The therapist’s technique was excellent: firm pressure, precise stretching, and careful attention to problem areas, especially around the shoulders and lower back. They checked in about pressure several times and adjusted quickly when asked. Importantly, the session lasted the full booked time, which is not always the case in many budget-friendly places.

Considering the skill level of the therapists, the hygiene standards, and the overall atmosphere, the pricing is extremely fair—even budget-friendly. This is an ideal place for people who want a genuinely therapeutic Thai massage without paying “luxury spa” rates.

I highly recommend this studio for anyone looking for the best value-for-money Thai massage: professional service, excellent technique, and prices that make it easy to come back regularly.

reviews.name: Napim Narongritthi
reviews.text: I just went there yesterday, and it was amazing! I've never been to a spa that impressed me this much. After a long day at work, this place was perfect since they're open until midnight. They offer a wide range of services, and you can even choose from different aroma oils to suit your preference. I have to say, it was truly a worthwhile and relaxing experience!! ❤️

reviews.name: Kevin
reviews.text:
First time having a Thai massage and it was amazing.
So much so I went back the following day.
First day I had the traditional Thai massage 90 mins with Joy.
Stretch me in ways I didn't know possible.
Felt like I was an inch taller when I left.
The following day I chose the Nature Signature Fusion for 120 mins with Ben.
She found blockages in my back and worked them out, feeling them with her hands and working them out with her feet.
The pain I've had in my middle of back is gone.
Was worth the trip to Bangkok alone to have this pain gone.
Such a pleasant and unexpected surprise.
Thank you all Joy, Ben and the entire staff.

reviews.name: 김민
reviews.text:
We were greeted by a friendly and clean facility. The massage technique was so good that I almost fell asleep. Fortunately, they covered us with warm towels when we felt a little chilly. The warm tea and shower were also very impressive. I would definitely return. It was a satisfying experience.

(조금 추우니까 추위 많이 타시는 분들은 에어컨 꺼달라고 하세요~)

reviews.name: Aquilla George
reviews.text: Wonderfully relaxing experience. I had Oyl (oil) he was gentle and caring from the foot wash to the massage to the stretches. I fell asleep halfway through. At the end they give you warm tea and coconut rolls which were equally delicious. Definitely worth it!

reviews.name: Thomas
reviews.text: I had some really good massages at Nature Thai Massage in Bangkok. Strongly recommend this place to anyone. Thanks Nanny 🤗🙏

reviews.name: Audrey Brault
reviews.text: I had a fantastic time at Nature Spa. Very clean, pretty decor, fabulous therapist (Penny), very quiet and loved the tea afterwards. Will come back!

reviews.name: Grace Chuu
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I had a 120-minute aromatic massage, and it was amazing! They gave us a couple’s room, which was clean and smelled really nice.

The massage therapists were gentle but strong and knew exactly where to focus to help with our body pain. The room also had a shower and a bathtub, which made the experience even better. They even provided a hair dryer—very convenient!

After the massage, they gave us hot tea, which was a nice touch. We felt so relaxed and refreshed. Highly recommend this spa!

reviews.name: Nilesh Agarwal
reviews.text: I had the most amazing experience at this spa in Bangkok! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and professionalism. The atmosphere is serene and beautifully designed, making it the perfect escape from the busy city. My therapist was highly skilled and attentive, tailoring the treatment exactly to my needs. I left feeling completely relaxed, refreshed, and rejuvenated. Every detail, from the soothing ambiance to the excellent service, exceeded my expectations. I can’t recommend this spa enough – truly one of the best in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Tasha (AutismFamilyTravelGuide)
reviews.text:
Harbor Mall Laemchabang is a large, multi-level shopping centre with around six floors of stores, making it one of the biggest malls in the Laemchabang area. It feels much more like a full city mall than a small local centre, with a wide range of shops and services spread across several levels.
Inside you’ll find a mix of fashion stores, electronics, beauty shops, homeware, cafés, fast-food outlets, and everyday services, so it’s easy to spend a few hours here browsing. The layout is spacious with lifts and escalators connecting all floors, and it’s fully air-conditioned, which makes it a great escape from the heat outside.

The mall is clean, calm, and not overwhelmingly touristy, giving it a very local feel while still offering everything you’d expect from a modern Thai shopping centre.

Good for:
✔ Longer browsing sessions
✔ Families needing space and facilities
✔ A relaxed mall without huge crowds
✔ Travellers looking for a proper shopping break near Laemchabang

A solid, well-sized mall that works perfectly for shopping, food stops, and taking a breather during your day in Laemchabang (very popular area for cruises to stop for Bangkok and Pattaya).

reviews.name: Annabell K
reviews.text:
My friends and I chose this place based on its strong Google reviews, but our experience didn’t quite match the overall rating.

After visiting, I took a closer look at some of the lower-rated reviews and found feedback that raised a few concerns. One review mentioned:
“They have a fake promotion at the end where they promise a free 30 minute massage voucher if you leave a 5 star review. When I tried to redeem it the next day, they said I have to purchase another 1 hour to redeem the free 30 minutes. Not good customer service and not nice to lie to customers for fake reviews. Please be mindful of this.”

While I can’t fully verify that myself, it’s something potential customers may want to keep in mind when evaluating reviews.

As for the massage, unfortunately it didn’t meet expectations. We had two different therapists, and while everyone was polite, the techniques felt quite basic and not particularly effective. We also tried switching therapists to see if the experience would improve, but it remained fairly similar. My other friend was nearly burnt during the hot herbal massage while mine was lukewarm and barely heated. Very inconsistent.

Overall, the visit felt underwhelming and didn’t provide the value we were hoping for. It may be worth considering more established venues, which can sometimes offer more consistent experiences.

reviews.name: Flo Y.
reviews.text:
This massage spot offers a slightly upgraded experience compared to a basic massage parlor. It hits the essentials – cleanliness, private spaces, a calming atmosphere, and reasonable prices. However, it doesn't quite compare to the more luxurious spas in Bangkok.

Across a few visits, I tried their Thai, neck and shoulder, and foot massages. I personally preferred the neck and shoulder massage over the Thai massage, as it involved more kneading and less stretching. The foot massage was undoubtedly relaxing.

The strength of the massage seems to depend on the assigned masseuse. My neck and shoulder massage was a bit too gentle for my preference. However, considering the price point, my expectations weren't exceptionally high.

It was not a relaxing massage as you hear the clink clank of the pot used to warm up the stones and they dropped the stones and tray two or three times. So I really don't recommend the massage with hot stones. It will be better off without all these noises. The staff are friendly and the place is neat and clean. It's just a short walk from our hotel on Wittayu Rd, Lumphini. After the massage they serve us a nice cooling coconut. And if you write a review before you leave, you get a free 30 mins massage on the next visit I think.

reviews.name: Mark Zhang
reviews.text:
I had a Thai massage here and it was the worst experience. First of all, the massage technique was very poor. They did not work on proper pressure points and instead used excessive brute force, which made the massage extremely uncomfortable. After the session, my lower back felt sore and painful rather than relaxed.

What made the experience even worse was the hygiene. After wearing the clothes provided by the shop, I developed a serious skin allergy on my arm with red rashes. There was also no towel covering the pillow, which is very concerning from a cleanliness perspective.

Overall, this place lacks both professional massage skills and basic hygiene standards. Avoid this shop!

reviews.name: Jaume Planas
reviews.text:
After reading several reviews and seeing that they offered the best price for the length of massage, we decided to give this place a try. The space was pleasantly surprising: very clean, with a warm and attentive reception. We chose a foot massage, carried out on comfortable reclining sofas, with relaxing music and soft ceiling lights. The room is spacious but with only a few seats, which creates a calm atmosphere and is much appreciated.

A nice touch is that before and after the massage they serve a glass of milk and tea with candied pineapple, a simple gesture that adds hospitality and makes the experience feel more complete.

The less positive side was the massage itself. It felt more like a superficial relaxation massage, almost a repetitive “light touch”, rather than the therapeutic style you usually find in Thailand. In other places, when they notice a knot or tension, they work on it with pressure and technique; here, however, the massage follows a set routine, without personalisation or depth. On top of that, the therapist occasionally chatted and laughed with her colleague during the session, which made it harder to fully switch off and enjoy the experience.

Overall, the centre stands out for its cleanliness, atmosphere, friendly reception and thoughtful details like the drinks with pineapple, but the massage lacks the intensity and personalisation you would expect from a genuine Thai massage.

hotelDescription:
This unassuming airport hotel is 8 km from Suvarnabhumi Airport, 11 km from King Rama IX Park and a 2-minute walk from the nearest bus stop.
 Laid-back rooms and suites offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges, plus microwaves, en suite bathrooms, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Some have separate living areas, wood-paneled walls and/or whitewashed exposed-brick accent walls. Quaint cottages add terraces and kitchenettes.
 Parking is complimentary. Other amenities include a restaurant, a gym and a convenience shop, plus an outdoor pool. Breakfast is available.

Rooms: Family room had two queen sized beds and was very clean and comfortable. There was also a small kitchenette which came in handy.
Bathroom: Clean and modern. We had some plumbing issues, which maintenance effiently tried to repair.

Area: within a short 10min walk there are some wonderfull malls (Robinsons) and supermarkets and food eating areas.

We absolutely loved and enjoyed staying here. It was a very comfortable stay and will be sure to return for future short term airport layovers.

reviewContext.Rooms: Family room was spacious and comfortable.
reviewContext.Walkability: Easy to walk in the neighborhood.

reviews.name: J H
reviews.text:
We have now stayed at this hotel for five times
and every visit has been absolutely fantastic. From the moment you arrive, the staff are incredibly friendly, welcoming and professional! Everyone goes above and beyond to make you feel comfortable, and you genuinely feel at home from the moment you walk through the door.

The rooms are always spotlessly clean and comfortable and beautifully maintained. On our latest stay, we were lucky enough to stay in one of the brand-new villa, and it was absolutely fantastic — modern, fresh, comfortable and finished to a very high standard!

The hotel also has some really thoughtful facilities, including laundry, which is incredibly convenient, as well as a lovely eatery with great food and a welcoming atmosphere.

What really stands out, though, is the people. Every member of staff is super professional, warm and helpful and they make such a difference to the whole experience.❤️❤️❤️

After staying here five times, we can honestly say this hotel never disappoints. 🙏😇We will definitely be back if we travel to Thailand again and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable hotel with fantastic service and a truly welcoming atmosphere! There is also a beautiful garden if you stay in a villa and the cleaning service is fab!!!

Thank you to the whole hope to  see you again soon!⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: 971huf
reviews.text: The hotel is a 20 minute drive from the airport, so it is very suitable for early departure. The room is clean and spacious, providing free snacks, coffee, and bottled water. Because we were transferring to Bangkok and arrived at night, we had to leave at 7 o'clock the next day, so our family didn't have time to use the small restaurant, swimming pool, and gym in the hotel. However, they looked good. The shortcoming is that the glass door of the work balcony cannot be locked, which makes us very worried about whether someone will sneak in after sleeping.

reviews.name: Richard187062
reviews.text: I wanted an overnight stay close to the airport, quiet, clean, homely, good and pleasant service all at a reasonable price. I got it, all good. Every aspect was to a good standard. I was allocated a very comfortable chalet-like room, with all amenities. I ate at the adjacent restaurant, served by Mai and Champo, both happy and smiley who looked after me well. An extensive menu of delicious Thai food, presented in  glossy book - impressive. Airport very accessible and I ordered a Grab car online each way.

reviews.name: michaelagJ5353HC
reviews.text: We stayed in the hotel just for one night for a stopover. The hotel is near to the airport and therefore perfect if you have to get an early flight or if you arriving late. ||The room was clean and had everything we needed.||The reception is 24 hours open and it was no problem to check in in the middle of the night.||The staff was extraordinary friendly. We would stay there again!

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: I had a really pleasant stay at this hotel. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, always ready to help with anything I needed. The room was very clean, well-maintained, and comfortable, making it easy to relax after a long day.The overall atmosphere felt welcoming and convenient, and everything was well-organized. Considering the quality of service and comfort, the price was very reasonable. Definitely a great value for money. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Coastal38303727744
reviews.text: The place to be for a short stay the day/night before your flight. No stress of traffic on the day of the flight because Suvarnabhumi is just 10-15 minutes away. Staff is extremely kind and prices are very reasonable. Shuttle bus to the airport is just 200 baht for the whole family.|Large family room was provided with up to six beds. We will definitely use this option again during a next visit to Bangkok. We were there already two times. Not in the last place for the super tasty food we had in the restaurant. One of the best Thai meals of the entire holiday

reviews.name: 744kamrula
reviews.text: Only stayed here for one night layover but what a clean and amazing little place! The room was more then what we expected with all the amenities required for the night. Might have been a little small for comfort had our stay been longer but for short stay it was perfect! Very close to seven 11 and food stalls (although halal food options are very limited) the hotel also provides a shuttle bus to airport 24 hours!

reviews.name: E W
reviews.text:
Excellent room; was clean, well put together and even had free instant noodles. The hotel staff were friendly and there’s a nice pool.

The location is very close to the airport (15 min drive), but for some reason, grab is still ~150B with no traffic.

This location is very difficult to get to unless you take a taxi/grab as if you take the closest train station, you still have to walk across a highway.

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: The staff there are very nice! All of them. They all carried smiles on their faces! Excellent!Facilities are clean and well maintained. Of coz its location is one of the best that is close to the airport and it is an excellent option for those who arrive BKK late like us, or those who need to catch an early flight. As we could find a car to drive us to the hotel, we arrived late (like 1:20am). All my kids were exhausted. But once we got to the hotel, they only spent like 3mins to complete my check in without any deposits payment, then we can rush to the room and get my kids to sleep!But, there is one drawback of this hotel, we found ants in the kitchen (the sink) area, and there was some water leakage near the water tap of the sink. But, this would affect the overall good experience in this hotel.

reviews.name: QuietMiles
reviews.text: I had booked here for more than a fortnight but the rooms werent clean and was dusty, had lizard poop and real heavy dust on teh high ceiling. both of us had allergic reactions, whilst I only had sneezing and itching, my wife developed rashes, colds and a fever. ||I went out and booked another place and asked if they could refund in full as we didnt even stay a night and paid a non refundable rate for the whole stay. They staff were nice and they offered other rooms but since we didnt want to risk it, we moved out. I eventually got a 40% refund which I appreciate but I would have atleast expected a 80% if not a full refund, considering what we told them and why we xouldnt stay.||Especially when I booked the highest category of room they had.

reviews.name: ofer malik
reviews.text: The location is perfect, especially with its close proximity to the airport, making access incredibly convenient. The beds are very comfortable, which made our stay even more relaxing. The staff are warm, welcoming, and always ready to help with a smile. It’s always a pleasure to come back here🤗

reviews.name: Anthony Western
reviews.text: Very beautiful hotel with a very stylish, comfortable and spacious room. Staff are friendly and their restaurant does decent food and delicious Thai milk tea. It has a nice pool area which is a nice place to chill with a Singha soda. It is located close to BKK airport but far away enough that plane noise isn't an issue. In the area itself, there is not that much to do but there is a Robinson's shopping centre located a 15 minute's walk away and some Thai restaurants too. I really enjoyed my stay and will be coming back.

reviews.name: BC SailingDoc
reviews.text: Nice little hotel. Very clean, comfortable rooms. Friendly staff. Pool is a little small, but useabke. Location good for airport. Not a lot around... eating out requires longer walk (10+ min)... except for large sukiyaki restaurant nearby. (Fortunately, the hotel has a decent restaurant connected.) We would stay here again.

reviewContext.Food & drinks: Good restaurant. But 10 minute walk to nearest 7/11.

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: I have stayed at this hotel more than once and it is always clean and very good value. Service is prompt and always friendly . It is a short shuttle ride to the airport. It is off a main road so quiet. The restaurant serves excellent food and gives very good portions for the price. I would definitely stay here again if I had an early morning flight.

reviews.name: Harbernt
reviews.text: Good service from the staff and a quick check-in process. It’s always a pleasure to stay here. The rooms are spacious and clean. Great location if you want to stay near Suvarnabhumi Airport. Parking is available for cars as well.

reviews.name: The Patchetts
reviews.text:
🌎 LOCATION:
- Easy.. ..paid shuttle from BKK THB 100/room each way. Go to the mezzanine muster location at arrival.
- 10 minutes from BKK, in house restaurants, excellent.

🛏 ROOM / SPACE:
- Rooms are small but very functional and very clean.
- Beds are comfortable, bathroom does the job well, air-con is great, in-room Wi-Fi is great (free)

🧑‍💼 STAFF & SERVICE:
- Staff are super friendly and helpful.
- Check-in-out easy peezy.

🏊 FACILITIES & AMENITIES:
- Outdoor pool but inside the building (not in the parking lot), elevator.
- Everything works well.

💰 VALUE:
- This our goto if we are transiting BKK.

reviews.name: Nicky
reviews.text: First impressions - fabulous after 24 hours flying to Bangkok. We were met with our booked hotel transfer, we arrived at hotel within 15 mins. Very friendly reception. Room very comfortable, beds great - full nights sleep! Cute, gorgeous restaurant attached to Hotel, we ate very tasty meal. So pleased it was attached to Hotel as we didn't fancy hunting places to eat after our flight. Shuttle took us back to airport in morning. Would definitely book hotel again. Perfect for stayovers!!

reviews.name: Rod Mac
reviews.text: Good location close to Suvarnabhumi airport and hotel provides airport transfer for 200B a room. UNIQLO factory outlet around the corner and Paseo mall shopping, food hall and night market 15min walk. A bit noisy for rooms facing the street ie city views which is really just buildings & flyovers. Otherwise good for easy quick access to airport.

reviewContext.Rooms: Bed mattress is hard like sleeping on concrete and pillows not soft. No milk for tea or coffee not enough bottle water for kettle. Otherwise room was okay and clean and comfortable.
reviewContext.Nearby activities: Paseo shopping mall and night market

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: I have stayed twice at the At Residence. It is a great place to stay when you have a flight the next day. It is clean, the rooms are a good size and the staff are very helpful.It is a short walk to the small shopping and eating area. The hotel staff are excellent and communication remotely through email is good to have.
